lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You work so hard, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Dr. Kal'tsit told me you have to be 100% focused on your work to maximize efficiency. So... yes, that's what I'm gonna do!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island has achieved cruising speed, Doctor. Would you mind sorting out the navigation log for me?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I still have a lot to learn as leader of Rhodes Island. I hope you'll be there to guide me on our path to the future.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Maybe it's just wishful thinking, but I hope Rhodes Island can be like a second home to everyone.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Making it this far has cost us so much. Sometimes, I can't help but ask myself... is it really worth it?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Sometimes I remember where I came from... It was cold, and the air smelled of rusted copper. Rhodes Island is a cozy place in comparison. I'll do everything I can to protect our home.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hehe… Dr. {@nickname}, let me tell you something: I picked up the violin again.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: We've still got a long, long way to go, Doctor. This might be a journey without an end, but as long as you're with me, we'll be okay.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: There's still lots of work that needs to be done, Doctor. We can't afford to have you resting.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm so glad you're back, Doctor. Now we can walk this path together, me with you, and you with me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I see... thank you, Doctor! I've learned so much from you.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm so excited to fight by your side again, Doctor!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: What I saw that day... the despair stuck in my throat, hopelessly trying to scream... I want to bury it all deep inside my mind and never let it out…

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I won't let you down.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Operation commencing!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Incoming! Get ready, everyone!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm right here, Doctor.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got it!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Roger.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I know what you're thinking.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Everyone believes in me...

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Are you afraid of me?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I hear... someone crying?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No matter how difficult the mission, we can handle it as long as you're here, Doctor. I've never doubted you.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We may have achieved a perfect victory, but we still can't let our guard down.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Well done, Doctor! You must be exhausted. Be sure to rest when you need it.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm fine... Get it together, everyone!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: You want something to drink, Doctor?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh? Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ehehe...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! Please make sure you get lots of rest today... Y-You've already worked for the better part of the day? Did I get here too late? Sorry...Blaze just asked me to get my height measured... Oh, you're just joking? Thank goodness.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Welcome home, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, if you can remember even some of your past... That would make me really happy. Right, I'm still not very good at the violin, but... since you're the only one here to listen, there's a song I'd like to practice. A sort of nostalgic song.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I remember the names of those who've left us, and I can still feel the lingering fear, rage, and pain of battle. But if I'm to give a speech in front of everyone, I want to tell a story of hope instead. Doctor, I'm a little nervous... Could you hold my hand, please?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, please sit. I'm just here to give you a physical examination, so relax. If there are any irregularities, please tell me in full. Meaning? We'll set aside what it means to Rhodes Island for now. To me, the meaning it holds is quite significant.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I will conduct scientific examinations on you at regular intervals, recording your vital signs and state of consciousness. No other personnel have this authority. If anyone wishes to conduct an examination on you, you have the right to refuse. Do you understand?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Medical is the core Department of Rhodes Island. Theoretical research and practical treatment both require medical talent, and the need for medical staff on field missions is always growing. Please remember that in the time to come, you will need to recruit ever more Medic Operators.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm sure, on a daily basis, you interact with many Operators. When you converse with them, you must be alert for any speech that attempts to influence your will. Remember to preserve your ego; at necessary times, I suggest you seek my help. Of course, for you... I should be unnecessary, shouldn't I?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Amiya has left to eat with the young Operators. She is a child too, and you should accompany her as well. These lands have no mercy on the basis of age, but children will always be our unvarying hope. I very much admire this notion of... a certain someone's.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, do you ever doubt the meaning in your own existence? I do. Life upon these lands is tremendously tenacious. It evolves to suit a unique niche, often finding nurtured tameness and confrontation futile. What is our destination, Doctor? I believe you will find an answer. I can only persevere in that belief.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Don't spare too much worry for me. Rhodes Island shouldn't be so fragile that one person's departure would leave it unable to proceed on. What is it? No, it's only a slightly hyperbolic supposition. No matter what, I thank you for your concern, Doctor. But more than myself, I am concerned for you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The path along which Amiya grew into Rhodes Island's leader was considerably troubled, and the sacrifices we've made bear testimony to that. From the faintest glimpse you caught in that stretch of the past, you may gradually come to understand the meaning of it all. You can make your own choices, Doctor... someone once told me that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My hope? It is to protect yours and Amiya's hopes, Doctor. Though our definitions of 'protect' have nothing in common, it's an oath I will never abandon. I will be standing here with you, until the very end. We are unable to forget the past, but a different future may await you.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you awake, or still in a dream?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, my appearance here indicates that the situation has turned for the worse. You must concentrate on continuing to accomplish your mission.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Not bad.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: With strength comes fragility. Such is the principle of all living things.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Mon3tr and I will protect everyone. Especially you, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I will see to them.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Now you need only devote yourself to operation planning.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You know the plan. Move to intercept.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What's the situation?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Optimize your deployment.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Arrived at designated position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Mon3tr, with me.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Mon3tr.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Perform your task.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Awake.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Make sure a video record of this battle is properly cataloged.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mon3tr, collect tissue samples.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Assess the risk coefficient of those fleeing, as well as the possibility of a reprisal attack by enemy forces.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Secure evac route. Prepare to operate!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: How is the infrastructure project here developing?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You seem to have grown used to your own work and responsibility. You've become much like a leader.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It is once again the New Year. I only hope that you will find a suitable manner with which you can enjoy this brief holiday logically. Additionally, I wish that you will enjoy this upcoming year in good health, and won't spend too much time in the infirmary.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: So this is the day you've chosen, is it? I won't ask you about the significance of the date. You are free to keep the answer to yourself. I only hope that your choice will serve to give more meaning to Rhodes Island's existence. Of course, if you would like, I can offer you my well wishes, too. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It is not for anyone to tell you what the significance Rhodes Island carries is. Neither should you be bound by your unreachable memories. Instead, the current you must find that answer yourself. There will come a day when you'd decide Rhodes Island's course. I trust that your decision will bear responsibility to the ideals that we discussed.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Forgive me, Doctor... There are limits to what I can do, including in conversation... but I'm honored to be your assistant. I look forward to helping you with your work.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, time heals all wounds. Please have more confidence in yourself. Your Operators have chosen to follow you because we believe that you will bring positive change.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Many Infected have relocated to Rhodes Island... not because they have any particular goals to achieve, but simply because they want a place to call home. The world outside no longer accepts them, after all...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Owl may not seem very friendly, but she's got a good heart. Please excuse her and pay her no mind.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: 12F? That was the day I 'came to' this world. You could consider it my birthday.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I might not be able to spend my entire life serving one person... but at least I can start working on it now.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: She has finally found you, Doctor. What a perilous journey it's been. You're very important to her, as well as to everyone else.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'll be by your side watching over you, Doctor, even in your sleep. So rest easy, you have nothing to fear.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You have my thanks for allowing me to join you. From now on, I will do my best to serve you, Doctor, with my alchemical skills. I have never had a name... but if you must call me something, you can refer to me as 12F.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I see, I understand now. Thank you for your guidance.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I may not possess outstanding skills, but I will do my best.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Will it be alright for me to be the leader? Anyway, thank you for your trust, Doctor.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Relax, Doctor. We will complete this operation in no time.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Everyone, get ready for battle.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Your orders?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready for action.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Copy.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Please show me the path.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Burn to ashes.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Clear away all obstacles.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Watch out, Owl!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I'm used to failure... but a victory after countless defeats is always the most precious one. Don't you agree, Doctor?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: This victory is all yours, Doctor. And I am honored to be a pawn in your game of chess.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: That was a hard-won victory, but we did it. Are you all right, Owl?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Failure is only normal. Don't be discouraged. I've been in many wars, and my experience tells me that your victory will come soon.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: If you'd like, I can help. No trouble.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Aah! Be careful.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I am so thankful for all that you have done for me. I feel ashamed I have so little with which to repay your kindness. Forgive me, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: 'I want to live through the coming year.' That's probably every mercenary's wish they only dare think deep down, and never risk saying out loud. Doctor, may all be peaceful in your New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I'm very curious, actually. Is this your real birthday, or is it maybe a particularly significant day to you? Oh, perhaps I'm prying too much. Please, forgive me.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I was just a lucky survivor, and found a place to call home in Rhodes Island. I will devote all the power I have, and I look forward to the ending that you lead us towards, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I will be your bodyguard, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I've always had my suspicions about Rhodes Island. Still do.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why are you staring at me? Nothing better to do?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hmph.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I know every nook and cranny in Lungmen. The docks, the neon signs, the winding paths, I can see them all in my mind, clear as day. I'll never forget them.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Things around here have deteriorated lately. I'll be on guard, but I'll still need you to be careful.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Maybe one day that man will take note of my efforts, but until then…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Amiya trusts you completely. When I see you two together, it makes me wonder... what if I had someone like that by my side?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I've... I've never been able to rely much on anyone, not even...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? You fell asleep? Hmph. No nerves to keep you awake, then.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ch'en. Leader of the L.G.D.'s Special Inspection Unit. For my own reasons,I'll be joining you for a while. Seeing as we're already well acquainted from our prior work together, I'll ask you to take me to my workplace now.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's all in the service of more efficient operations.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? I've been through these things before.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Roger. Just give me all the missions your usual Operators can't handle.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: No problem.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Listen up! We'll be much more efficient if we work together.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Everyone! Prepare for battle!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ready? Stick to the plan.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: This is Ch'en.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready to move.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Moving out!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Take them out fast.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Slash!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Flash!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Drop your weapon!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't force my hand!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Your evil must be stopped. I will do so by any means necessary.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Where did you find the courage to challenge me?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The wounded wait here for a medivac. The rest of you, stay on guard.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Tactical retreat. Don't break formation!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: So this is Rhodes Island's base? Bigger than I expected.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey! What are you doing!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you're in a good mood. Is it because that operation went well? Same here.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, about that last report—You're still working? That's unexpected. With all the commotion out there, I thought I'd open the door to find a room full of celebrating operators. Happy new year, and here's a printout of the report—

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, it's you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here I am, what do you need…? Your birthday? You have time for stuff like this? What are you waiting for, am I supposed to sing for you? In your dreams… Happy birthday, I'm leaving.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I left Lungmen in search of something. Something that I can only find on my own... But you Rhodes Islanders, you have the strength to win people over with your ideals, and I hope you won't let me down. Me? I'm not there yet, I need to be faster.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: C'mon, I'm no good with paperwork. You sure you want me here in the office? I'd be better out in the field. Wouldn't you rather I brought home some wins?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I fight for the Infected. Life for our people is rough, anyone with eyes can see that. It's just that most people don't give a damn about our lives. But I do, I care a lot. We've got so many operators here counting on me, and I'm NOT about to let them down.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The reason I work for Rhodes Island? Because I've got nowhere better to be, naturally. But I've gotta be honest, I can't think of any place better than here. The pay's good, the medical treatment is cutting edge, and we've even got a cute little rabbit. It's just brilliant. What could be better?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm one of Rhodes Island's frontline breachers, I don't have powerful Arts that wipe the field, and it's not like my combat techniques could down a whole army. But, if I combine the two things I'm good at, then BOOM! You get quick results. I think that's what they call a chemical reaction.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Amiya is one of the most talented fighters I've ever met. She keeps a clear head in any situation, and her Arts are enough to scare even me. You know, Doctor, I can't help but wonder, how did she get so good at fighting, as young as she is? Honestly, I wish she was picking up joyful, happy experiences, not the combat kind.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: If you need my help, no need to be shy - just say the word! You put your trust in me, and I return the favor. You command, I fight. It's symbiotic. Aw, look at us! We're the best partners in all Rhodes Island! Oh, don't tell Amiya I said that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The crew's been buzzing about who you used to be, before your memory loss. They were talking back before I even met you. It looks to me like you aren't the same person anymore. Soooo, I guess I'm talking about two different Doctors? Past Doctor and Present Doctor, hah!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Dr. Kal'tsit says you're going to really shoulder responsibility for Rhodes Island someday. She saved my life, and I trust her. She also asked me to decide what kind of person you are for myself. And I'm going to do that, at least until Oripathy takes my life.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, pass me that towel, would you? Yeah, just finished training. I need at least six hours every day to stay combat-ready. Gotta roll out whenever the order comes in, you know. Alright, I've kept you waiting long enough. So where are we going this time? If that's the plan, I guess you're picking up the tab?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Would people get the wrong idea if I carried the Doctor to bed? Maybe I'm better off leaving well enough alone…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Rhodes Island Operator, Blaze, reporting in. Here, the authorization letter signed by Dr. Kal'tsit. Now I'm under your direct command. Alrighty, Doctor, let's show the other squads what we can do!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I've seen a lot of battles like this. But tougher times might still be ahead of us.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Hehe, can you feel the air getting hotter? No? Reeaaally? Then I'd better kick things up a notch. Aww, I was trying to get you fired up.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Us Rhodes Island Operators put all our trust in Amiya, Dr. Kal'tsit, and you, Present Doctor. Because you've never given up on any of us. Fighting for the Infected is the right thing to do. It's worth it, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Time for combat? Count me in!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Alright, I'm the leader, huh? I got this, I know all about wiping out hostiles!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Us frontline breachers have high standards. Try to keep up!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: It may be a little gruesome, but I love shredding steel and crushing bunkers!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: You know, it wasn't easy learning high-temperature vapor dynamics!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Let me show you the chainsaw techniques the other elite operators taught me!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This place could use some heat.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hear the roar of my chainsaw!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't worry if you see fire, that's just a side effect!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Surrender now if you don't want to get sawed in half!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: My blood's only gonna make this place hotter!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Fresh blood coats my saw, and boils the whole battlefield!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No sacrifice is meaningless, and no victory comes without a cost.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The rights of the Infected will only be won by the actions of the Infected!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Let's work harder next time. We can always do better, right?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's just say luck wasn't on our side this time.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Any new facilities at Rhodes Island this time?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey, knock that off!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Wait a second! I'm way too sweaty!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: 'Scuse me!—Oh, hey, Doctor, Happy New Year, one sec, I gotta get all three of these drink crates to the canteen, and then move the movie projector for 'em—ah—and a few offices need decorating... and then I'll come back for you! Hey, Amiya just passed by, I gotta drag her over to get her height measured!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, when are we heading out on our next mission?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Here's an extra-extra-large cake for you! Yeah, I can't hold birthday parties of my own, so you got the kind of cake I wanna eat. Any other presents you'd like? I don't mind if it's a tricky request. I could carry you twenty clicks to find the right shop!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I don't have such crazy Arts, but reading this mission summary for the year, I've been in a bunch of tough battles, huh? Sure saved a ton of Infected too... You're worried for my health? Hey, what's to worry about? My stamina training figures are always on the rise.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, what's wrong? Oh, I'm fine, just a little tired. Please check these two files in a moment. A lot of new Operators have joined Rhodes Island, and we can't disappoint them.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island and this land at large have already lost so much. We will put a stop to it... Rage may destroy us, but when confronting malice, ever more people have no other choice. Until the land finds peace, no one will be able to extinguish this fury.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My rings look different? I couldn't hide it from you, Doctor... You're right, one of them broke. But it's okay, Dr. Kal'tsit helped me switch it for a new one. Did... that have something to do with when I blacked out, you ask? Doctor...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: In this whole operation, we gained no commercial profit at all, and we gave so much... But there are many things you can't weigh in terms of business value. Rhodes Island was never a company born exclusively for profit, and this land needs more than just physical medications.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Chernobog's Reunion... it's over, and is there any more point to denouncing what they've done? Think of the people who trampled them, abused them, massacred them... hatred breeds hatred. That was something that should've never happened in the first place.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Once, there was a Sarkaz betrayed, who walked this land bent on vengeance, only to cast his own life into the cycle of revenge. What I can't understand is, he'd already settled on his own end before he drew his sword. In his rage… he settled on death, with a clear mind.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Death should be carved into our memories, never to be forgotten, no matter who brought that death about, nor who was brought to. Our mistakes will never be right... those scars should always remind us, warn us how frail we are.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Even now, they still sometimes come to mind. Misha's gaze, FrostNova's roars, Patriot's cries... Ace, Scout, and so many operators sacrificed their lives for a single belief. But the Infected all across Terra—what is it that they've died for?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor... recently... have I been a little less like myself? The nameless anger that rises up, time and again... is that mine? If so... no, even if so, I won't give up. I will protect you, Doctor, by this sword.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, are you okay? Do you need to rest a little? I'll help carry you. Don't worry, I'm doing fine. So long as you're rested.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, it's so good to see you. My appearance? Um, please don't be afraid... I can explain this. But don't worry, Doctor. Whatever happens, I won't ever let you come to harm. I swear it.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: 'If the fight is unavoidable...' This is what the person I most trusted once taught me.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I shoulder the wrath of so many others.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Operation commencing. Let's go!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Incoming! Ready, all members!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Amiya here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: This sword thirsts for revenge... I won't permit it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: My sword is cloaked in Chi Xiao's shadow.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Madam Ch'en's swordsmanship... flows within this weapon.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Drop your weapon!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Your thought, your Arts, I can cut them.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: 'With what do I answer your failure of justice?'

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Do not... make me angry.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, thank you for always supporting me. Our battles will only get harder from here, but we can't give up.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: How long do we fight? How long until the flames of anger on this land die down...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, good job. Let me handle the clean-up.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: ...What happened? This shouldn't have...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Phew... we can take a little breather now, right?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whuh, Doctor...!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, could you... hear me out for a bit? Is that okay?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: For a brief moment, I could hear a voice growling deep within my heart: The suffering on these lands is eternal, and nothing can be turned around in such a short span of time... No, I refuse to accept that, Doctor. I trust that our journey and our fight are meaningful.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Welcome home, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Does it feel strange at all to celebrate a birthday that you don't remember? Does it... feel like... that's not you? It doesn't? Thank goodness. Doctor, I'd like to take out my violin and give it another try. Perhaps this time I won't break any strings.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: There is no avoiding pain if we are to end the vicious cycle that is hatred. Nevertheless, I believe there will come a day when I can set down this blade. Doctor, until that day comes, I'll protect you at all costs. I only hope that... it won't be you who gets hurt.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I have some free time, so I guess I could help you out... What's this? This has got nothing to do with disasters and Arts, just some normal paperwork? Hey!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You wanna try some fortune-telling? Well, that brings me back. I haven't done it for a while. I could take a look at your fortune to kill some time, I guess. Hmm, if your luck isn't beyond words as always... Well, you're gonna have to prove my results wrong.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I do research on Arts because it's part of my responsibilities as a Caster. If I can't even do that, how am I supposed to protect those who... Huh? You got sweets? For me? Uh, thanks...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hibiscus... My sister always helps people whenever they need, even if it's not part of her mission. It's like she's not a Sarkaz at all, what with how kind she is. She treats this world with kindness, but how many people know to repay it?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Why I'm not into fortune telling anymore? 'cause the fear and curiosity that people have about the future usually has to do with natural phenomena. That, and I've realized the results you get with fortune telling don't really mean much, having come face to face with so many cruelties.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: In terms of performance, books and staffs are just about the same as Arts conductors. If you ask me, I think knives are much more practical. When you run short of your Arts and have to throw yourself into a melee, or you're out in the wilderness, just trying to survive, all those words in the books aren't going to do you much good.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: It's a pain to fight as a team, but when I look back on those times I fought side by side with my Reserve Ops teammates now... It brings back memories, I guess. If I get the chance to fight alongside them again... No, never mind.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I wasn't that grumpy and curt now, was I? How come Hibiscus still treats me like a kid who hasn't grown up yet? It's like she's doing it to pick on me! We finally managed to make up, but it just ticks me off when I see her act so calm about it!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The times we live in are so messed up, there's just way too much malevolence going around in this world. We have to change that. I can't stand all those rotten hypocrites acting all kindhearted treating my fellow Sarkaz like that... just because of who we are.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sheesh... You always look so peaceful in your sleep.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hey, what's the big idea? Who let you come in without knock—Oh, it's you, Doctor. Why am I wearing this? Well... I'm hitting the training grounds to test my limits once more. Wanna come watch, Doctor?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I got it all down.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: There are lots of talented Casters out there, but I'm not so lucky. That's why I have to get stronger if I want to be able to save the world. Thanks for helping me out, Doctor.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I've got the hang of fire Arts now. If I keep working on this, I might just make it to the boundaries of modern Arts theory... I might even be able to manipulate space and matter.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I've got a good idea of the enemy's weaknesses. Let's go.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm not good at this kinda stuff... Just gotta get this over with quickly, right?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'm counting on you to have my back while I take care of the enemies.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You've strayed from the path of righteousness. Your sinful souls deserve no mercy.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: No time to hesitate.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: It's time!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Let's get this started.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Prepare to cast.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hah!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Tear them apart!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Too weak. There's no point in hiding!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Your tricks won't work here!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: It's only by overcoming challenges that we manage to accomplish something.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmph... Accept your defeat in pain and fear. Evil will always be defeated.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: This shows how powerful we are now. It's far from enough, though. I know I can do better than this. I have to do better.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Gah... I gotta... eradicate all evil...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I still have lots to do. Let me stay here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: D-Don't pat my head!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm reading. There's still a lot I need to learn... It's time for tea already? Let's get going, then.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Helped yourself with the desserts there, Doctor? You can't run for the hills on an empty belly, and we need sugar to replenish ourselves. Why run for the hills, you ask? See that ominous red tint looking over here from the corridor? If you don't want to get caught and tortured with crap movies, you need to move your legs fast!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: You've already been waiting here? Tch, you got me this time. Anyway, you can thank me for the present later, for I have something to show you, so quiet now. Just to let you know, we fortunetellers have found a way to boost one's luck. And look no further for its inventor because she's standing right before you. I see... I see... See that? My divination says you'll get even cooler in the future. Also, Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Where are we making our next stop? Seems the truth of this world always extends far beyond the catastrophes we've learned from papers, just as this dagger in my hand turns out to be more helpful than those words in the books. One day, after I've turned the last page of them, I'll be out there, finding out the truth myself.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: As I am now, will my presence inconvenience you? Will I remind you of past miseries? I... long for being with you. When the time comes, we will leave this place together, okay?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You thought we could not survive if away from the sea? A myth, it is. My kin and I will soon be able to swim through the air. In the end, even those places devoid of anything will be our ocean. We simply need to evolve, and we only need to adapt.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My former friends tried to grant me my eternal rest with their hands. They refused to confront their true selves, but I do not resent them, and I could not hurt them, even if they rejected and attacked me so vehemently... Perhaps everything I did was bringing them harm. My regrets died along with them.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: This box? My past lies within it...the fragments of my past. Fractured as they are, they still suffice to tell that I am not an empty puppet... that I am not a phantom. Gradually, I was reborn into what I am now, bit by bit.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, was a future like this also in your past vision? You may have nothing but hatred for me now, but I do not fear it. Hate me as your heart desires... while you are still able to.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Your companions, Kal'tsit and Amiya, said that you are worthy of my trust until the very end. But one can never save the others. I failed to save my friends, and you failed to save yours. We both have lost everything, but I was granted a rebirth, and following that, a new future. This... is just unfair to you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Long ago, my family was murdered when I was still in Ægir. I always assumed the sea monsters did it, but I never expected to learn that it was all the handiwork of the Ægir. My blood kin and my songs are scary, they all say, but they are wrong. It is the people who are scary.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I did struggle, I did resist. But to what avail? When the tide rises, no traces of lesser lifeforms will remain undrowned. You are my very last friend. Will you also be like them, rejecting the ocean for a futile end, even if it costs you everything? Do you wish to be what I used to be?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Am I sick? Or am I still dreaming? I dreamt that the black sky was our ocean. When the others and I swam up, we did not feel ourselves sinking at all. Strange, so strange. Is this our future? Their faces are so blurry, they... They... No, no.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Dream... What kind of dream will you have? Where are you now? Will you find it there... just another dream?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I have been waiting for you. It's been so long, far too long that... I have forgotten why I am waiting for you here... But none of this is important anymore. It's not that important anymore.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: These things... I have seen them too many times. Nobody needs things like these anymore.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Formalities of the past... what good are they now? Nothing has survived, except you and me. We will cast those aside, and all we need is to be a step closer... Join me, Dr. {@nickname}, and be my blood kin.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Nevermore shall my eroded sword cleave, Nevermore shall my former friends breathe, and nevermore shall I feel the warm blood flow inside me. Still, I am satisfied. I have become one with the ocean. Doctor, come with me — your true form is still waiting for you beneath the waves.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Fight alongside the others? Against whom?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: No more lives should be lost.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: What will it feel like... when their arms penetrate this body?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Treat me not as a calamity, for death is not my wish.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What do you wish to do? I shall obey.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: No longer do I walk alone. My blood kin are with me.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Now, harken to the song of the distant sea...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Rest at ease. The tide also rises.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The sky and the land... both a drought to relieve.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: May the song seep into your souls.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: With me, to our eternal home we will return.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Fear not, my kin… The time is nigh.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: They will become our blood kin. They no longer need to feel the suffering of aridity. Their prior existence was already too painful.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Will you treat me the same way? Is this also the ending you designed for me? If that is what you wished for, I will not deny it.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Why must you flee? This futile struggle will only bring about more senseless terror.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Run, Doctor... Run away, from here, from me... Leave.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Sooner or later, this place too will return to its primordial form.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: ...Why am I still wearing this hat?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: We failed to protect everything. The harmonious future is our only hope.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I still remember this day... but time has no more significance at this point. The sea and sky, and all life, will never change anymore...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor... Come, with me.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I can feel the joy of a life being born... but, how should I share this joy with you...? Dr.{@nickname}, don't stray too far from me. We can embrace this new life, together...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, leave. There's nothing left in these ruins. Everything familiar has vanished. The memories still sting us... Doctor, do you hate what I say? But we've both lost our families, all of them... Would you become family with me, as I am now?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You're not the type to sit around the office. It's easier to guard you if I dress more casually.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I won't doubt Rhodes Island anymore. Your cause, Amiya and Dr. Kal'tsit, and all the other operators here are worthy of my respect.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The way operators are supposed to see things and deal with problems is nothing I've known before. It'll take some time to get used to this.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I heard from Amiya what you went through in Siesta. Sounds like you had a tough holiday. What about me? It was terrible. Maybe not terrible. That's all I can say.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My roots are in Lungmen. That will never change. The world I knew there will stay with me wheresoever I go.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: When I left Lungmen, I thought there was an answer to find, but now I get it. There's no such thing as answers, only actions and results.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, it's been a while since I left Lungmen and came on board as a Rhodes Island operator. It's about time you treat me as an operator too. It's hard for me to do anything if you are always on your toes around me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I've got a lot of people relying on me, and I used to take that trust for granted. It may be harder than ten sets of advanced training every day, but I'll be worthy of their trust.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The events in Chernobog and my experiences in Dossoles both proved one thing—Whether fighting or saving, I must first understand my target. I need to broaden my horizons and open my eyes, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Asleep again... You've done a lot of work already, so I'll let you have ten minutes.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ch'en, reporting back in from my holiday in Dossoles. I have a lot of reports to write about my trip, so I'm just passing by to say hello, Doctor. Let me know if you've got something. Now that the holiday's over, everything's back to normal.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: There is always someone out there who's better than us.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You're giving me a promotion as a Sniper operator? No problem. I'm sure I can set a fine example.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: To tell you the truth, I never thought my shooting would get to this level. I'm more used to fighting with a sword, but shooting is indeed more convenient in certain scenarios.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Orders received.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: No need to fret. I'll take care of it all.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Buck up and get ready for battle!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Are you all ready? Let's go, then!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Enemy spotted.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ch'en here. Ready at a moment's notice.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I will take care of this place.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Great spot.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hmph!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't let them get away!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Laying suppressive fire!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Time is limited.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Pure evil and a little torment is nothing to be afraid of. But there's never anything pure there, that's what's terrifying.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was some beautiful teamwork. Well done, everyone.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Help the wounded, and if you got any strength left, I need a few of you to stand guard with me.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Stay calm and fall back! I'll bring up the rear!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hm? Another new room? Engineering's doing a good job.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You never learn, do you, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, do you have a field operation next? I'll come with you.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: A New Year's party? I'll be there. Hoshiguma and Swire are both here, and that's special. By the way, Swire told me she brought snacks from Lungmen, you and Amiya should try some.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, you seem well.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: This party gets more and more impressive by the year. Last time I came, you didn't have a present pile like this. Maybe I should just keep your present for myself... Just kidding, here, take it, don't get it all mixed up with the others.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I'm still learning to use my gun, so I'm not touching Chi Xiao for a while. The more refined my swordplay becomes, the more I think it's not the weapon itself that defines right or wrong, but the one who wields it. So, are the moves I've made right or wrong? Do they have any meaning?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm gladdened to be by your side once again, Doctor... Yes, may the light be with you as always.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Being in Kazimierz was no easy thing. The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi and the General Chamber of Commerce are still constantly at each other's throats, and the day when glory once again shines on Kazimierz seems very far away still. Only at Rhodes Island can I let my guard down, and regather myself with peace of mind.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Are they still well? How is Liz's health? Has Shining been pushing herself too far in combat? In my time back home, my mind's eye often wandered to the scenery I saw by their sides. Once, they journeyed home with me, but next shall be the time when for the sake of their ideal, the Radiant Knight devotes her light.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I was absent from Kazimierz for too long. It's as if I'm all too used to life at Rhodes Island now. Whenever a Knight of kindred spirit wished to travel with me, it cast my mind back to my days here. That said, processing multitudes of paperwork is more tiring than I remembered. I still have much to learn from you.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: A victory nodded in by capital bears no glory. Yet it was thus I first came to meet those souls who harbored faith, and was able to light that flame. I pray that this flame can show the way forward, that it may inspire those who crawl to stand back on their feet and forge ahead, that it sheds the darkness, that it reveals the true light of hope. Doctor, I have always firmly believed so.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: This weapon? Heheh, there are only a few who know. My grandfather wielded in his youth a swordspear alike, which my father inherited, teaching me swordsmanship with it in turn... When I returned to my home, the scenes of my younger years came back to me. That's what led me to this weapon.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Maria has realized her own truly beloved undertaking. She's gifted, highly assiduous, and with Zofia beside her, I couldn't be more reassured. It seems now that the forge's hammer suits her better than the longsword. I truly hope that this honest, sincere passion of hers may forever last.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Kazimierz's struggles are unlike those of other lands. Without the constant conflict in light and shadow, we know only swollen greed and twisted regulations. That Maria and her cohort could stay aboard Rhodes Island is a good thing indeed. Though people of like minds aren't few in number, we still find ourselves barren, barren of virtue.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: In this age on the verge of collapse, I once... felt alone. But Shining and Liz shone upon my fate, and Rhodes Island became my home to return to. I once was shone upon by others, Doctor, so I know profoundly, a beautiful vision and a faith identified, are enough to change the world.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Tiredness has not called on me yet. May you first rest.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Oaths and trust both are unchanging in the passage of time. Isn't that so, Doctor? The Radiant Knight, Margaret Nearl, rejoins you here.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The particulars of tactics have seen some adjustment. Hm...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: That I could once again experience this gladdens me greatly. 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness.' Doctor, I shall go together with you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: So long as I hold radiance in my hands, so long as my heart beats with faith, the hardships of our world will not fetter my step.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Upon changing armaments, my combat style will also be obliged to adapt. Take due note when deploying me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I will keep in mind your instruction.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: 'Fear neither hardship nor darkness...'

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Sin is to be punished.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Awaiting only your orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Yes, I am fully ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I shall lead the assault.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hindrance shall be no more!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: O sun, bow to me!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: May the light imbue you.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This long night too shall now end.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: To grasp bright power is so as to sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I have never held the slightest hesitance to entrust my life to your hands.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: There will come a day when we clear the mist of hardship and darkness, awaiting first light's rays, awaiting... an even better tomorrow.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I hope that they may seek a proper path anew.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The time has not yet come to give up, Doctor. Please allow me to defend the rear alone. I leave the regrouping to you.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is my previous dormitory still left for me? Thank you, for going to the trouble.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hahh... just a simple prank, then, Doctor...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I am delighted to once again browse your library. May I borrow this book to lend to Maria?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Does it surprise you that I'm here? Yes, the deskwork piles up without end. But as the clock strikes the new year, I find myself yearning to be sat here on Rhodes Island's deck, gazing over the barren land that light has yet to reach. Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Have you been doing well lately, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Today is your birthday—naturally I'd remember. Please, accept this handcrafted trinket. Kazimierz's products may aim to dazzle, but in all truth, it's never anything more than new packaging... You'd like a Radiant Knight souvenir figure? Please, spare me your jokes, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Since returning home, I've come across more and more knights who support me. While I was once steadfast in piercing through Kazimierz's long night alone, it's now my greatest honor to stand with kindred spirits. What about you, Doctor?  To what corner of the land has Rhodes Island delievered its brilliance this past year?

lines.title: 任命助理
lines.text: Dr.{@nickname}，今天没有急件要送，我来帮你整理一下文件吧。放心放心，这么久了，这些文件的分类我早就一清二楚了。

lines.title: 交谈1
lines.text: Dr.{@nickname}，这些是我从雷姆必拓带回来的伴手礼——胡萝卜面霜能改善皮肤，占卜书会建议你每天干什么、不干什么……哼哼，我是不是很有眼光？

lines.title: 交谈2
lines.text: 信使不能只盯着脚下的路，如果因为太忧心包裹里的秘密，而错过了沿途的风景，那也是了不得的遗憾……没错，我的确在想，等到哪天闲下来，我说不定能写一本游记呢。

lines.title: 交谈3
lines.text: 这张照片？上次我和塔妮她们在天台吃午饭，发现了一辆巡逻小车，四个人就一起对着它摆了个pose……Dr.{@nickname}也想拍一张吗？好呀，我现在就带你去！

lines.title: 晋升后交谈1
lines.text: 我已经不是刚来时那个高中生啦，这些年除了工作，学业、朋友我也没落下。真要说有什么遗憾的话……如果可以，我想参加一次自己的毕业典礼呢。

lines.title: 晋升后交谈2
lines.text: 我偶尔会不自觉地想起那片雷姆必拓的废墟，想象舰船如何变得支离破碎……不，不要紧的。现在的我只想飞得快一点，再快一点，快到无论发生什么事，我都能及时赶到你的身边。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈1
lines.text: 如果能回叙拉古生活，我会回去吗？虽然我很想念故乡的父母和朋友，但就像罗德岛的大家习惯了有我的生活，叙拉古的他们也习惯了没有我的生活。为了更好地相见，先用书信传递彼此的思念吧。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈2
lines.text: 当信使久了，我也养成了写信的习惯。感染者的一生实在短暂，如果终有离去的那天，我希望我写的一封封信，也能以另一种形式陪伴……我不愿忘记的人，和不愿忘记我的人。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈3
lines.text: 看，每送出一封信，我就会折一颗纸星星。对，纸星星无法升上天空，但它们是安洁莉娜的星星，它们仍然可以离开狭小的玻璃瓶，飞翔、环绕、起舞……在这片星空中，和我跳一支舞吧。

lines.title: 闲置
lines.text: 咖啡的味道和以前一样，我们之间也和以前一样……嗯，这样就好。

lines.title: 干员报到
lines.text: 安心院安洁莉娜，回来向您报到……嘿嘿，突然这么正式是不是有点不习惯，Dr.{@nickname}？

lines.title: 观看作战记录
lines.text: Dr.{@nickname}，你看你看，我的作战影像也能被收录进教学记录了！

lines.title: 精英化晋升1
lines.text: 从实习到现在，真的过了好久好久啊……但不知道为什么，每次到这种时候，心里都会有点紧张呢。

lines.title: 精英化晋升2
lines.text: 我从很久以前就在期待这枚奖章了，甚至在床头专门留了一个位置……现在终于如愿了。

lines.title: 编入队伍
lines.text: 每封信件都很脆弱……就算不是什么大问题，也不能掉以轻心。

lines.title: 任命队长
lines.text: 由我来做路线规划吗？没问题，我看一眼就能知道怎么走最快。

lines.title: 行动出发
lines.text: 如果地面走不通，就从空中……空中也有敌人？别担心，有我呢。

lines.title: 行动开始
lines.text: 既然争斗无可避免……抱歉，我必须对我的寄件人负责！

lines.title: 选中干员1
lines.text: 你的信，我肯定加急派送。

lines.title: 选中干员2
lines.text: 这封信要送到哪里？

lines.title: 部署1
lines.text: 平稳落地~

lines.title: 部署2
lines.text: 安全着陆！

lines.title: 作战中1
lines.text: 我也不是只会让东西变轻哦，老实待在那里吧。

lines.title: 作战中2
lines.text: 跑得不够快的敌人，是会被风吹落的。

lines.title: 作战中3
lines.text: 没写清收件地址的信件，是会被退回的！

lines.title: 作战中4
lines.text: 让开让开，还有人等着这封信呢！

lines.title: 完成高难行动
lines.text: 本来想送完信直接去逛街，这下灰扑扑的，得回去洗个热水澡了。

lines.title: 3星结束行动
lines.text: 轻飘飘地赢了战斗，回去路上放点轻松的音乐庆祝一下吧！

lines.title: 非3星结束行动
lines.text: 呼，总算结束了。刚才有一瞬间，我差点失去平衡了……回去看录像总结下经验吧。

lines.title: 行动失败
lines.text: Dr.{@nickname}，这次是我们准备不足……你的指挥没有问题，我相信你！

lines.title: 进驻设施
lines.text: 啊，家——我回来啦！这次一定要多待几天！

lines.title: 戳一下
lines.text: 嗯哼？

lines.title: 信赖触摸
lines.text: 稍等一下，我补个唇彩……好啦，我们出门吧！

lines.title: 标题
lines.text: 明日方舟。

lines.title: 新年祝福
lines.text: 还在加班吗？烟花表演已经结束了……真是没办法，你看好哦。小水滴慢慢飘起来，越来越高——嘭！这是我送你的小烟花，以及，新年快乐，Dr.{@nickname}。

lines.title: 问候
lines.text: 早安，Dr.{@nickname}！我今天有外出任务，所以跟你提前说午安和晚安啦！

lines.title: 生日
lines.text: Dr.{@nickname}，sorridi~生日快乐，以后每年你生日，我们都要拍张照片留念，然后集满整本相簿……到时候你想要相簿当礼物？不行不行，还是由我来保管吧。

lines.title: 周年庆典
lines.text: 你不知道我为了赶上庆典，究竟是怎么跋山涉水的。唔，我是该先对你说周年寄语，还是和你讲讲这一路的见闻……噗，我真的有好多话想跟你说，反正时间还有很多，我们慢慢聊吧。

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Were you looking for these documents, Professor? Here you are. I personally believe that some of these theories aren't explained in enough detail. If you wanted a springboard for your ideas, I suggest referencing these two papers. I've added some of my own commentary, so feel free to look it over.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The little lamb didn't go away even after the volcano erupted. It's actually been staying with me the whole time, and sometimes gets into trouble. H-Hey, you can't go standing on the Doctor's head! That's terribly rude! Sorry, Professor. Um, Can you see the little lamb? It's right here, hand to the right, and then down a little. Yeah, you're petting it right now.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This coat was Mom's old protective gear. Professor Keller once told me, this mark came from a sudden burst of magma. It almost left a scar on her, but Mom just laughed, saying she had good luck. If I were to go on an expedition with her, I'd probably need to be the one to lead.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Shh. Here, Professor, I snuck these over! I saw it all – you were muttering about how badly you wanted some snacks earlier, right? I've actually gotten pretty good at reading lips. Not to brag, but I might be better than Rhodes Island's intelligence agents by now. But, just maybe.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm getting ready to head out, Professor. Another volcano is about to become active. While luck is still on my side, I need to go a bit farther, a bit deeper. I want to wear the brightly-colored ornaments, and get to the truth in the hot magma, just like Mom and Dad did.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Professor, in a few days, I'll be going to Leithanien to attend a press conference and the premiere of my documentary. Our research is too obscure for the ordinary people who want to learn about volcanoes. But I still hope that one day, I can use this method to show everyone the beauty of volcanoes.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Frostleaf has been going to Mousse's book club a lot these days. Earthspirit and Provence have been trekking far and wide. I've been exploring more volcanoes... Professor, I still remember those early days, when Mousse was so nervous she couldn't even talk, and Frostleaf was always alone. But look at them now... they're getting better.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hehe, Mr. Kahn's letter just arrived. He says he's really mad that Professor Keller and I went rowing on a sulfuric acid lake without protective gear. Mom and Dad did crazy things just like that before they had me, and they didn't bring Professor Keller along. So this time, so I took her with me!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: One moment, Professor, I'm changing out my hearing aid battery. Hmm? You're... Did you forget, Professor? I can read lips now. Besides, the sign you want should be like this, then this. What you just did was 'I have been suppressed by the volcano.'

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Phew... Even without my hearing aid, I can still pick up the little sounds of Professor's breathing…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Professor, I'm back, and I brought some souvenirs for you. I'll send them over to Dr. Kal'tsit and Amiya in a bit. I also managed to get a good amount of new data and specimens from Siesta's volcanic eruption. Would you like to come and take a look with me?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: A volcano's every change and movement is fleeting. Only by capturing them on camera are we able to preserve every last detail.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Our documentaries are being taken seriously? That's great! During my inspections in recent years, I've seen a lot of governments that don't trust our judgment and won't allocate resources to evacuate the residents. I hope I'll be able to make a difference.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I know what you want to say, Professor, but I've never made my expeditions hard for myself. Starting from the smallest example, I bet you've never fried a fowlbeast egg over lava before, but I have!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: How about a slice of lava cake before we head out? It was one of Mom's traditions.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Volcano field investigations are extremely dangerous. Everyone, please follow my instructions.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Please double check your protective gear. Also, remember to keep a safe distance from the lava, and give regular status reports.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Relax, volcano. We're just here to collect a few precious samples. Please don't get mad.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: This time, we can make up for the missing data in the last report.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Don't worry about me, Professor. I've scaled a lot more volcanoes than you can imagine.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Volcanic soot contains lots of Originium particles. Let's not stay too long.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Magma will dredge up Originium veins. Keep your distance.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Melt away, life-depriving stone...

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Ashes from volcanoes, they consume and erase, then nourish and propagate.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Those particles have no place here. I'll send them away.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Oh, flowing magma, please slow your steps.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: We are one step closer to the truth of this land, Professor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Perhaps there will still be people gazing across this volcano a century from now. Their footprints will cover ours, and the seeds buried beneath the ash will bloom into even more beautiful flowers...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Why…? I'm not seeing any errors in the formula or the data... Um? I think I see something surfing through the lava...?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Phew... Thankfully, the volcano didn't want to keep me that badly.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Professor, I brought the documents you asked me about.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I heard you coming, Professor. I recognized your footsteps.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Professor, I know how good you are at learning. I can tell you're doing the wrong sign on purpose just to make me laugh!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: A pebble encounters countless other pebbles during its life. They will collide with each other and become magma. When they reach critical temperature, they erupt. In the end, they turn into the ash that nourishes new life. We're just like these little pebbles, Professor– Oh! Why didn't you tell me the fireworks already started?!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Professor, the fault lines of mountain ranges and trenches are quietly moving beneath our feet. Little by little, they inch us closer to the volcanoes we hope to visit.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: The obsidian in this brooch comes from a volcano you haven't climbed yet. When you're not busy, we can go volcano-climbing. We'll visit the volcanoes one by one. And you'll know exactly which volcano I'm talking about once you get to the top. The scenery up there is magnificent, and the other half of your present is waiting for you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Professor, I read in a book that after thousands of years, we will all re-enter this land's cycle. Maybe I'll become a little plume of magma, reshaping the land along its rock formations. When that time comes, I'll be able to forever look out across the land, with what nourished me, nestling up against me.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: A Dublinn spy, one of Caster's lackeys, the leader of the workers, plus Wiš'adel... Fancy that, a full house? In any case, I take it I can rest while you handle my business? Since you did let me tuck myself back onto the ship.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: What's this? It's one of those healthy meals they hand out outside the training grounds. 'Help yourselves', they say. What's that look for? It tastes good enough, better than the emergency ration handouts in Londinium by a country mile... Tell you something I know better now, Doctor. It's bloody hard, as it were, to keep a city's worth of bellies full.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My sword here has enough legends to fill a storybook. Even my teacher had his version to tell, flourishes and all. Yet, people only seem to remember those who wielded the sword, not the ones who forged it first... I won't stand for that, Doctor. I'll be there to tell the stories of the unsung heroes.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Sometimes, after a night of dotting Is and crossing Ts, I'll climb up onto the roof of Westhaleg and watch the sun come up. Down in the street, there'll be costermongers hollering, workers delivering goods. On occasion, you'll spot my boxing gym mates, all hungover. A few of them'll look up and see me, and we'll wave at each other. I love this city a lot, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: All this regalia's from an old friend. It's not the lightest thing ever... I'll tell you what she taught me: If you've got a noble 'calling' that pisses you off, then go on and get loud about it. Give it hell, and hold nothing back. I can't argue being Speaker now weighs on my shoulders, but my spirit will stand tall, and I'll have her as my witness.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: 'Victoria'... I know to a lot of people, it's not me that sticks out, it's my name. But so what? The things they're so desperate to scrounge from me are the things I'm off to smash to bits. It's in my power to force that through their heads, sooner or later. The fight's only just started.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Alright, I've been coming back aboard a bit much recently, I admit. Mm-mm-mm, I'm not skiving. It's just hard to meet some of the people here otherwise. Delphine's dead set on calling it 'diplomacy'... And I don't just drag you along as a safeguard, Doctor. I have to be honest, I do want to learn a little more from you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My face? Just a blister, nothing big, helped Indra and the lot in a fight as I was passing through Norport. Heh, even the ones challenging our turf don't come half as strong as they used to. I've seen babies punch harder than... My clothes? Oh, flip, I forgot to change into my casuals!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Can you believe it? A simple trick like that and Dr. Kal'tsit's got the whole Glasgow Gangers on Rhodes Island. Wait, you knew all along? Haha! Come on, no need to dodge. There! A playful rap on the head, that's how we boxers respect our opponents after a match is done.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Wake up, Doctor, you've got tons of business to sort out still— hah, finally I get to tell someone else that.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, to be clear, this is not official business. What it is is two old friends, reuniting now the war's over. And about my old files... I think I'll finally fill in my name. Vina Victoria. No more hiding from it.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Can't help feeling the itch... I might go and file for time off with Parliament.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I lost a lot of mine, on the way back home. Parliament awarded them all these posthumous medals, and I still don't know who to even give them to... We weren't told how heavy glory weighs. I came out knowing.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I know clear as day what's up ahead. If I'm the only one left at the end of this all, so be it, I won't hesitate. But in my heart, drinking with her best mates until we drop in the sunset, that's the happy end to the story of Vina, the story of the Siege.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I fight alongside you once again, Doctor, with a sword that's not just for show.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll adjust my combat style to fit you all.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Recon, strategize, deploy… then, the siege.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I've been through crueler fights.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Finally I can limber up.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: It's the frontline for me after all.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Wish I didn't scare you.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Get up! There'll be no bending of the knee!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I forbid your retreat.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Who says you can't hammer with a sword?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Negotiations are useless here.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Violence too, is an effective means.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: My teacher was right. With each step forward, I still learn something new from you.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Getting to lump you with the thinking work feels bloody refreshing. It's been forever since I had a stress-free scrap!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The most precious lesson war taught me was this—there's never an absolute best-case. Regret is its own kind of mercy, and that goes for us and them both.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Not time to give up yet. Follow me, I'll bring you all home.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: ...Really calms you down here. Think I'll get my forty winks.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Um. My cape... you're stepping on it.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Eh? Did you say something, Gawain?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, if you're wondering about the prezzie pile in the cafeteria, that's from Londiniers all over. They had their local branch send them in, as thanks to Rhodes Island. Not one person who's alive will forget what we paid... Happy New Year, and do have a butcher's around the city when you can.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I always feel a bit awkward gamboling about Rhodes in this outfit. Need me to change back?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, if you'd like to accept these! Here we've got a well-wishes card from Morgan, here's some handmade boxing gloves from Hannah, and here's a medal engraved by Dagda... Hold on, where's mine? Oh, flip, I left it at the gym! Wait, it's your birthday today and you forgot?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Ever since that upheaval, Rhodes Island has been on every central nation's watchlist. Each future step you take might well cause new turmoil, but clearly you lot have set your hearts on something. Doctor, when Rhodes Island is in its most crucial moments, Londinium will be there to aid.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Yahoo, Doctor! Whacha doing? Looks like fun!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Does Rhodes Island have a karaoke place? It'd be great if we had a place to sing the night away, especially when we don't have battles to fight!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My job as an idol is to make the fans happy with my songs and performances. But what should I do as an operator of Rhodes Island... ?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hi, hi, Doctor! Anything I can help with? Don't judge me by my look— I actually do some heavy lifting at Penguin Logistics.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Yup, my special skill is singing! I can do a cappella, lead vocals, choir singing, pop music, and I can even rap, yo yo! But, I guess that's not a very useful skill for an Operator. If only I had a more practical skill…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: M-My ears...? Uh, I can't tell you! A-And even if you ask Texas, she's not going to tell you either! Ehhh—Sorry, I'll explain if I get the chance someday…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You know, Texas actually saved my life. She also taught me so much I never knew. Which is why I... want to be there with her whenever I can... I, uhh, I'm just trying to show my gratitude for her, that's all!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You think I look upset? Um... it's because... Exusiai went on a mission with Texas again, right? If only I were as good as Exusiai…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor! Could you teach me to use a weapon? My songs have no practical use except for support and encouragement. If I could fight with a weapon... What? You're not good at fighting either?!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Texas... are you listening to my song?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: (｡･∀･)ﾉﾞHiiii! I'm the loveable idol from Monster Siren Records: Sora! Oops, sorry, introducing myself like this at Rhodes Island must be kinda weird. Aww…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Leveling—up!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Do we also have an idol ranking on Rhodes Island?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I can feel the surge in my heart. It's like back to my first concert. I'm just delighted that you trust me so much, Doctor! All my hard work has paid off! Hmm? My ears? Wh-What about them?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: As a squad member, I'll try my best to learn from the basics!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm the leader? Is that like standing at the center of the idol group?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Singing on the battlefield... Now that's a fresh experience!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: If only my music could put an end to all this fighting...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Is it my turn?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Yes, I can handle this!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: It's show time!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Alright, let's make some noise!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Come on, we can do it!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You have my full support!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Now we change the game!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't lose heart, we can win this one!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I heard your cheering loud and clear, everyone! Thank you!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Awesome! A smashing victory! Texas, did you see how I sparkled on the stage?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We did a good job, team. Thank you for your hard work!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm sorry... I wasn't good enough to be your help...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place is much bigger than the dorms at Penguin Logistics!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Sparkle spark!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ehehe, thanks, Doctor!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It looks like I can't hold a solo live this year, but that doesn't change my desire to sing. Happy New Year! This year, I'm going to bring even more smiles to my fans—um, no, that's not the word... Oh, right! I'm going to bring even more music to everyone at Rhodes Island!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I hope you have a fantastic day, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: A lot of fans say my singing can bring people true happiness, and I really hope they're right. Doctor, today I've got a song just for you. Happy birthday! This is for a beautiful life and a cheerful you, all year long!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Idols and Messengers are both jobs about passing on love. Seeing fans and audiences smile is a source of happiness in my own life. I'm sure, together with everyone at Rhodes Island, we can spread this blessing even further. It's a tiny little dream, but I'll do my best to make it come true!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: There's a lot more I can do for you now—more than secretarial work. I won't be opposed to fighting anymore. But still, to be here, writing for you, is... a great honor of mine.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: What would you like to ask? Maybe you want to know—how much power Dublinn has... no? Oh, just how I'm personally doing? I'm still no more than a shadow, but—not my sister's. Dublinn's flame is lit by so many people, so many ideals, and the shadow cast by that firelight—that is what I am now.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: It's getting dark. Around this hour, there'd be people walking leisurely along the grey pavements, perhaps fowlbeasts gathering by the ponds—that is the Tara I remember. It's no special thing, but neither has it truly existed before. Doctor, I believe everyone should have a home to welcome them back.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I can't make myself out to be a comrade of yours—there are some by your side that surely hate me. But—once Dublinn no longer needs these raging, burning flames, then I'll come back here... I want to come back here.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
