lines.text: In my spare time? I still like prose, and poetry, both reading and writing... and I like to hear others sing. I know a few folk songs—very pretty ones, but no record has been made of them. Doctor, have you ever heard, how the stems of reeds can be used as whistles? Yes, the reeds that would burn away at the brush of a flame.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Once you've caught Oripathy, living can become very painful... Do I resent it? No, I just used to not understand... life is so fragile, so much is ready to steal it away, yet we were meant to withstand that—to resist each and every trouble? But now... I can see you fight not just to resist—you fight to give people back their lives.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Do not fear, but do not disregard. Be light, be gentle... that is how you touch another. I remember learning this from you, Doctor, and it ensures my flames won't turn others to ash. Don't worry, I can bear the pain that accompanies. My fire won't die out.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Many prophecies say similar things—'it is the Draco's nature to fight.' I won't stand for that. But—if my sister stays blind to what will become of the land, once blanketed by the fires of death... then I will stop her. I know what kind of Leader the people put their hopes in—and that's not what she is.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My mind's not at peace, Doctor. Is my every choice truly right? Their lives stoke our flames in the night. Yet in the end, if they fail to burn through the darkness... No, why should their lives even be mine to dictate...? But still, I will walk on. Now I bear a duty, and I will walk on.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Not a word needed... It's always so tranquil, by your side.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I know—you'll have many new questions for me, about my identity, about my goals... but—I am still the same Reed.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: No matter how many times, you'll still choose to fight like this...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What is it you seek, from those who earn this medal? Tell me more about your dreams.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Upon the damp soil, there struggles life after life. While my flame does not yet die, I will reach them—I will.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I understand the objective you've set.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You fight not by my will, but yours. You choose to be warriors. So I will stand with you, shoulder to shoulder.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: What blocks the way, I will burn through.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: It is your tyrannies that fuel this flame.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Where do you wish to go?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm prepared to fight.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Please, trust in me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Your lives are mine to protect.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Your lives, now ignited.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This endless burn, you needn't bear.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Fear not the firelight.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I am Dublinn.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: In honesty, it's hard to even tell whether your battles are victories, given your dreams still lie so far, far away. But at times like these, it strikes me—perhaps we may all see the day, when peace comes.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: To drive them away with fire is easily done. But—if we're to ensure they'll never come back to hurt us, then a fire is not enough.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Did they flee? I have no hate for those who do—but here on the battlefield, I will pursue them.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The pain of burning, I can bear much more of. Just—don't let anyone else—disappear to the flames again...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I remember how I hid away in the ship's cabins. I miss those days.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: ...I still burn hot, don't I?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: The poems I've transcribed? I can read them to you, if you're interested. It's okay if you don't understand Taran—perhaps you'll still feel the emotions' touch.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Can I sit here, and watch the flames? Mm, I'm not here to celebrate this day, not at all... but—hearing the bells echo through the wilds, it makes me glad for the firelight, on this night.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ah, Doctor. Yes, some things never change.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: You read the poem I left in your gift...? To tell the truth, it wasn't written for this day. It's just—last night, while wrapping your present, the perfect rhyme suddenly came to me.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You and I are different. Dublinn is a dream that took shape long ago, long before it found itself in me. But Rhodes Island—you take something so hard to envision, and convince people to believe in it. You are what saved me, and I will always remember that.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: We'll be alright without sorting these files, won't we? Then you can lie down and sleep for a bit longer. It's good for your health. At least you can get rid of those bags under your eyes.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Got a heap of useful info from our mission in Yan this time. It's all written up in a report, submitted and filed. Come on, Doctor, I'm not a reserve op anymore. I can pull up my socks and write a report start to finish, easy enough.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: At the end of the day, the best thing to do with apples is munch them outright, or bake them into pies so you can share with everyone—it's too wasteful using them as targets. And if you just want to split one in two, you're better off with a kitchen knife.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I've got a bucketload of magic tricks to bring friends closer. The 'marathon alarms,' the 'invisible warning tape,' the 'hollow cake,' they're all brilliant. Which ones do you fancy learning, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm awake, Doctor. I'm not like I was then—it's not that easy to sleep even if I want to. So where do you need me? Any field missions? Maybe instructing the reserve ops?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Accidents always happen too quickly. Quicker than a bolt flies, even. And I can never react in time. And then I just watch things happen one after another, and... Sigh, it'd be nice if I could see things coming a mile away like you, Doctor. At least, when it comes to preparing, I've got confidence I don't botch anything.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, don't tiptoe behind me again! I know when you're close up most times, but on the off-chance you sneak a bit too well, I might just give you a bad scare out of reflex.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: We all came out of that fight in Rim Billiton a bit more grown up, but... *exhale*... It'd be nice if getting better didn't come with a cost, you know...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: There's no place you can escape to, and no dreams you don't wake up from. When we face something terrible, we can only choose to give it our all, hard as we can. Might leave a sting or an ache, but at the very least, you won't carry that regret all your life.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You know, it's a happy thing to fall asleep like that.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hi-hiii~! Doctor! I'm back! Haven't got caught up in hassle lately, have you? Haha, that's good. Right, I'm heading back to my room to rest up. If there's anything you want dealing with, remember to give me a shout.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Some still fight the same as ever. It's nice to see.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I've gotten these badges how many times now? But whenever hand me one, Doctor, I'm as happy as could be.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Once you raise your crossbow, the only things left swimming in your eyes are your sight and your target. But before you pull the trigger, there's so much you've got to think about... I won't be careless or neglectful ever again.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Hi, everyone! I'm here to slack off~

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Alright, time to assign the tasks.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We're heading out. Remember, mind your cover.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Relax, the targets aren't that bad.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Go ahead, I'm all ready and set.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Oh? Is it my turn?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Shh, don't make any more noise.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: On alert.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Where d'you think you're going?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Here I am.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Stand still.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Bye byeeee~

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That's spot-on work. Have a rest, Doctor, I'll keep a watch on the follow-up.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: So long as it turns out well, a little pain's no big problem.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They won't be much threat. Do you want me to catch up with them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Orderly retreat! Don't panic!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place is nice! Maybe I can find some beauty sleep in here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Heheh.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Not that way, Doctor. I've left an extra-special 'surprise' for my friends over there!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! Mmh, that's my greeting in. I'm going back to rest now. You too as soon as you can, Doctor. You have to unwind on your days off~

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Yaaawn... good morning~

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've left your prezzie in your bag. What, been forever since my last prank? I suppose it has been. We've known each other for so long, you've seen practically every trick I have in the book. Or perhaps you're saying you miss that sometimes? Well, I can indulge you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I'd say the meat roll Lava brought out for this year's dinner party was extra tasty! But the caramel pudding wasn't sweet as last year's. Come to mention, still nothing's beating that light show Closure put on three years ago. You bet, Doctor, I remember them all.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: What might you want my help with, Doctor? Why don't you decide?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Here's the operational report from the Athenius branch office over the last two quarters. You'll be able to gloss what you need from the summary… Hm? You want to hear me report in detail? Now that would take quite some time. Things have been eventful for me, since my return to Minos.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor! Visiting the Convalescent Garden? Perfect, we can catch up while we—hmm? Is that… Podenco? Did she move her entire bed into the greenhouse? *sigh* I'm barely aboard these days, Doctor. Keep an eye on her so she doesn't overwork herself, please?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: All the new names are gradually outnumbering the old on the Garden's guestbook… When melilotus ripens, its slender pods can fire its seeds a great distance away. So too has Rhodes Island ripened… Melancholy? Me? Well, for all you know, I'm only waxing poetic as Minoans do.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Going back to Minos isn't without its own headaches. Minoans all think their dreams of heroism are dashed the moment they contract Oripathy. They become totally apathetic. They hardly even bother with treatment… Do you know what? I'd have those wandering bards touring the Three Poleis, singing tales of how Infected can become heroes too!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: People can't help absorbing themselves in their own proficiencies, can they? That's what being a perfumer is for me, and I spent the longest time sheltering within it when I came aboard Rhodes Island. These days… Now that I know I'm made of more than that, I think it's finally, truly become mine.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Origanon, thyme, Athos's parsley... It's back to keeping the Minoan plants I knew best of all in my seed pouch. I used to keep such a distance from these, and now they're in my hands again… These seeds haven't changed a bit, but young Lena would be shocked by just how she's grown.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Me and… Lydia? Oh, dear, I didn't expect that name to come from you… Well, she's one of my cousins, a bit of a dependent type. If you want to know more about her, I can tell you, certainly. But if you want a story, well, I can't say the way it ends is very fun.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, your fragrance today isn't quite the same as the usual. Did something happen? Or, did you run out of the perfume I gave you…? If it's the latter, then tell me beforehand from now on. How else will I top you off in time?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Oh, and you're not even using lavender today. Let's see, I'll just put you on break for the next two hours… Hmm? What on Terra are all these deferred holidays for?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm back, Doctor. Oh, these boronias on your desk are fresh. It seems Podenco's been minding you and the Convalescent Garden well. Anyhow, I'm back on Rhodes Island for a spell. Home for the holidays, I might say… No, no, that's a joke.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oh… You seem to make more sense to me now, Doctor. I used to think you were a little slapdash here and there, but now I see how almost frighteningly meticulous you are.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: When I first took over the Convalescent Garden, I had every intention to spend the rest of my life here, never to leave again… Whenever I intend that, fate points me in a different direction. Still, I'm starting to grow fond of how the 'unexpected' feels.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: My odyssey to Minos wasn't as hard as I thought it'd be. It only struck me, when I was standing in front of my family again, just how… old all those old pains had really become. Not worth dwelling on any longer. Now I'm the perfumer Lena of Rhodes Island, and that suits me just splendid.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Certainly. Remember to have everyone double-check their supplies.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Of course. I'm getting quite comfortable in the lead now.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'll look after you, everyone.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Remember to put safety first.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Doctor?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Someone's deep in thought, Doctor.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm in position. Assistance is at the ready.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Don't worry, everyone. I have your positions confirmed.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Deep breaths. Let the odor molecules enter your circulatory system.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I know it stings, but this'll promote your blood flow.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Calm, now. Give your lungs time to exchange those gases.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I know it's bitter, but this'll help ignore the pain.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Mm-hmm… there it is, that incense. I smell it about you from time to time after a high-risk mission. Oh, I've missed it so, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I might like to learn your knack for seeing the big picture… Say, in exchange for a 'present', how about you explain it to me when we get back? I have a lot more to mentally juggle these days.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You might need to destress a little, Doctor… Don't let your nerves pull you thin.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, give the order. I'll conduct the evacuation… Don't let it get to you now, it's alright.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: And I'm home.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Today's scent? It's cardamom.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Keep this up, Doctor, and before long you'll have my scent on you.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's certainly takes me back. They light the colossal torch in Athenius, but I think I much prefer to see the white smoke of Rhodes Island as it sails… You think I just wanted to see you? Oh, my, you have seen right through me.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor… Oh, my, still half-asleep. Hold on… Give this a smell? How's that, nice and awake now?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Could I invite you to the greenhouse, Doctor? I've been growing a flower that just so happens to be blooming today… What are you laughing about—right, fine, it doesn't 'just so happen'. But there you go, that's my present. Now, will you come to the greenhouse and collect it?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It was through being 'lent' Rhodes Island's ideals that Lena Athopoulou could become 'Dr. Lena'. It's the kind of future that the young Lena could never have imagined, and yet it's better than I ever dared dream… I get to be here with you all, doing the right thing. I couldn't be happier with that.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, if you want me to talk to you, then at leaaast give me some topics I can show interest in.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, don't blame me for having no interest in your grand endeavors. To be honest, the reason I became an Abyssal Hunter is hardly as lofty as you imagine. Abyssal Hunters bear a grave mission, but me? I just think the life suits me more, that's all.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You want to know about my life in Ægir...? After so much time, my childhood memories are a bit of a blur. Maybe I'll remember a thing or two by telling you about it. Originally, I was meant to be a sculptor...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My combat style shows no restraint compared to the past? Doctor, I think you might be misunderstanding me. If you call me mad, I'll take it as an insult. But if you call my combat style mad... I'll take that as a commendation.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Hark... to the boundless master of all creation, embraced by darkness, murmuring soliloquy... Let me take a stab, Doctor. Maybe you like the old me rather more than the present me? I'll be honest, I've got a soft spot for that me too. It's nice to be so pure, isn't it?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, you always worry so much. Do something for me, tear this sheet up, yes, just like that. Sometimes, things aren't so complicated. Survival is splitting everything in your way in two. It's just that simple.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: *Sigh* Doctor, I'm dying to get you visiting our city. That's the only way you can understand how tender my comment is on the life quality of Rhodes Island. It's a shame your body'd be too delicate for it. All the more shame I don't even know whether our city still exists.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Even if I've got a list of gripes about Rhodes Island, you people haven't abandoned the collection and preservation of art. I can retract all my criticisms just for that. Doctor, forget your job for a moment. This, is a work you shouldn't miss, not in a lifetime.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You want to hear me sing? Of course I can indulge you. But I'm so sorry, singing has a special significance to us that you just can't share, not being one of us. Doctor, Doctor, it vexes me that I have so many things I want to share with you. Just how could I convey them to you?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: May you too stay lucid in your dreams.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I recognize you, and you recognize me. We don't need all those boring introductions. But you still don't know me, and I still don't know you. If I recall correctly, dry-landers use simple enough means to get to know each other, so let's get communicating.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are you trying to tell me… my combat style should be more 'fit-in?'

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: For politeness's sake, I accept your commendation. But, to us Abyssal Hunters, combat is the means we have to master to survive. We don't need applause or flowers for it.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You chose a dangerous way to learn of the Abyssal Hunters and our enemies, Doctor. With nothing but your delicate body, the tides will drown you. But at the same time, you can count your lucky stars, because I invite you to hide behind me.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Shall the hunt begin?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just let me think, whether you are here to help, or to trouble me like a whelp.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: It's high tide.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The time for fun has now begun.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My patience is limited, Doctor.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Waiting is its own art, too.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Every battle deserves to be enjoyed.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'm in a... gorgeous mood right now!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Good morning.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Good night.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'm not yet satisfied.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Come, more, more!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: We might not define danger the same way, but I'm willing to respect the genuine joy of others.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Do we have a ballad of victory? Yes, but not now. We're still a long way from true victory, aren't we?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Incompletion has its own beauty. That's how you're comforting yourself, isn't it?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm to blame too for placing my trust in you. But don't worry, I'll bear the responsibility together with you.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: You want to hear my opinion of this landship? You'll be disappointed.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh? I knew it was you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You've got a strong hunger for knowledge, but it lacks direction at times, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: A New Year's feast? Your desire for seeking joy in suffering is truly admirable... Of course I'll join. When on land, do as the landwalkers do, no? I'll see you then, Doctor. Happy New Year, and here's to death come closer to us still.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I hope you have a meaningful day today, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I heard today was your birthday. I support chasing all sense of ceremony, even if it's not going to mean anything. So, happy birthday, Doctor, and congratulations on notching up another year of suffering.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I can sense that the madness which used to bind me is slightly different to the Oripathy you're attempting to overcome... and what's interesting is, even having the knowledge I do, I can't give a clear solution. On that exploratory note, at least, I'm prepared to work with you all.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor—oh, no need to panic, I'm not dragging you into a checkup, I'd just like to sit down in here for a moment... Out of all of Rhodes Island, it feels like your office is the one place that hasn't changed.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, we're about to partially renovate Rhodes Island's wards to better meet patient aftercare needs. I've written down all the supplies we need here. Would you like to check over it quickly? Yes, I am in charge of this work now.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, I've adjusted the flavor of my healthy meals based on everyone's input. I came to realize that blindly insisting on my own views might not actually be best—you can only resolve conflicts better once you listen to the other side, and stand in their shoes... It would've been nice if I'd realized that sooner.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I've always been so hard on everyone, keeping them to healthy schedules, never letting them do anything bad for their illness. It turns out I was the one failing at all of that, heheh... But don't worry, there's still a lot I've got to do. I'm not giving in yet.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Diseases don't just torment the body—they impact the mind too. 'How will others see me? Can I ever live how I used to?' Everyone has worries like that... If I can't help my patients put them to rest, then my treatment isn't done yet.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I once saved a child in Leithanien. When she came to and saw me, she screamed for her life and ran away. Before that, I never thought there was much of a difference between Caprinae horns and Sarkaz horns. We can't change how everyone sees things, but at the very least, I don't want my patients to fear me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I think Lava's really changed lately. She gets up and sleeps early without needing me to remind her, and she barely ever talks back when I nag her, but it's all the more worrying for some reason... Doctor, if you ever feel tired or depressed, you can come vent to me! I'd be perfectly happy!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: This flute? It's actually an Arts staff. It's from when I went to Vyseheim. It was there I used Arts to harm someone for the first time, and it was the first I saw a friend leave us forever, just out of reach. Every time I hold this staff, all my feelings in that moment come back to me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: We happily see off recovered patients, and say goodbye to former companions with a smile. People come and leave. Our varied dreams may lead us to different paths, but we'll always mean something to  each other... Doctor, would you be open for food with me today? I'll go and ask Lava along.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, you might be reliable with work, but you act just like a child when you're off. Now you're sleeping on desk again. I've told you so many times, it's bad for your spine, and you might catch a cold just like that... *sigh* If I'm not there one day, could you really take care of yourself?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, I'm back—Umm, Doctor, I know my last field assignment took longer than usual, but don't look at me like you don't recognize me... Medic Operator Hibiscus, reporting in.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Everyone's taking charge of themselves, now—that's nice to see.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm suddenly reminded of my time in A1, training with everybody... Everyone's matured so much now. I'll keep up the effort, for all we've been through.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Bodily trauma can be treated through medicine and surgery, but how do we cure the pain from hostility and prejudice? Healing people's hearts, Doctor, that's what I will devote myself to.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I won't fail you—this time, I'll be sure to protect everyone.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm leading? I wasn't usually the one doing that before... No, I won't shirk responsibility.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't be afraid. I've got your backs.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'm not going to let you harm my friends.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'll make sure everyone's safe.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor, I'm here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: First aid ready. Medical support standying by.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I wish this to be the last time, if possible…

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: If we can prevent more harm this way, I'll stand my ground.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Please tell me if this hurts.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I can do more than just heal.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hold it. There's no sense in getting any more hurt.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: It's always easier to harm than heal. But... is it really something to be proud of...?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I'm so glad everyone could come back safe...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Prioritize treating the wounded. I'll guard against counterattacks.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I still couldn't... protect everyone...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Some beds have emptied.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You need me, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, here's your healthy recipe for today. Make sure you eat on time.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Let's relax—we don't get holidays often. But still, you have to watch your junk food intake, and don't stay up until sunrise. I'll be keeping an eye on you. Mmhm, I'll watch out for my own health too, I promise.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Staying healthy is just as important as working hard, Doctor. Don't let either slip.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, I—made you a birthday cake, actually. I used low-fat butter and dark chocolate, and I cut back the sugar as much as possible, but still, the calories are flooring me. How should I even... okay, just for today, I'm making an exception! Thank you for the good work, Doctor. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island didn't just grant me knowledge, but a dream worth fighting my whole life for. As a Sarkaz, as an Infected, as a doctor, and as a sister, I've found my home here. Honestly, I need to say just how fortunate I am. Right now, I want nothing more than to protect all this.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, got any trouble for me to handle? What? Just haul these files for you?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I gotta hand it to her, Doctor, this axe Zumama made for me turned out great, but I've already got this muscle memory from whacking enemies with my staff. See, still carrying it with me. I'm here to save people, after all, not beat 'em up. Gotta work that out.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, check it out. Getting extra weapons' kind a juggling act, so I found a solution. Trained my tail a little, and now, I can use it to hold my staff. Only downside is—I think my tail got thicker after all that exercise.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: How's that, Doctor? Shoulders feel much better, right? I told you, controlling my strength's a piece of cake, it's just none of you wanna believe me. I've been practicing medicine as a pro for years now. It's about time you recognized the fact, don’t you think?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Oh, right, Doctor, it’s been a while since your last trip to Acahualla, right? Join me next time I visit my home, if you can spare the time. They told me it's a party there now. Even I'm wondering what my home's gonna be like when I visit again.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, you know there's times you can trust your intuition. You've got all these Operators who trust you, see. Even with your eyes closed, your fists are still real strong—What? Compared to mine? Hey... I could K.O. you before you even made it out of this office, so I'm the stronger one there!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Zumama can build machines, Tomimi can manage people, and Inam's a damn-good lord ameer... Man, my friends rule! But my medical skills aren't bad either! Huh? What do you mean that's the one thing they’d argue?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Y'know, Doctor, I never understood why you made everything so complicated all the time. But now, I kinda get it, in a small sorta way. To put it in plaintalk, you're just finding ways to get bigger fists. So let me get real here, Doc. It's time you worked out with me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Zumama was right. All I gotta do is think about how to get stronger, and how to throw my fists. So I've got an extremely serious question to ask you, Doctor... If I get Zumama to build us a two-seater Raging Ironhide, do you wanna ride driver-side or passenger?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Alright, how should I wake the Doc up...?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hold on, Doctor, I know what you wanna ask, and my files are still up in Medical. But, y'know, Dr. Kal'tsit's got a point. Doesn't reflect well on Medical to have a physician steamrolling around the front lines, so from now on, this is how I'm heading out.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: There... wouldn't a quick axe chop do the job?!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: *sigh* Just doesn't give me the same kick I get being endorsed for my medical skills...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, doesn't matter if I've got an axe or staff in hand, I'm just hoping to accomplish a little something, make everyone's lives a little bit happier. I've managed to do a bunch so far, and before my body gives out on me here, I'm gonna do more.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave the front to me. The rear's all yours!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You get to follow me under one condition—you all stay alive and well. Got it?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go! Oh, speaking of which, what was our objective again?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Alright, guys! Let's make some noise!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Doctor, leave the big guys to me!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'll charge the weak spots!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Fear not, here I come!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll take the lead! The rest is up to you guys!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Relax, it'll be over in an instant.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Face me!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Who's next?!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Ha! Kick ass!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Uh... might be kind of weird to say at this point, Doctor, but nailing down a tough mission on nothing but trust for others—that's pretty damn neat.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Everybody good? We've got another battle waiting for us. Pump yourselves up! We're gonna crush this mission together!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: No rush. Doesn't matter if we're chasing 'em down or watching for a counterattack, just leave it to me. I want anyone who needs it to rest up!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, hold on tight to my shoulders! Don't go blaming me if you fall off.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I guess I'll drop in at Medical before the mission.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What's the rush, Doc? Not like I'm gonna run away.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You look pretty free to me, Doctor. Just so happens I am too. Wanna take a walk?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year to you, Doctor. Oh yeah, you heard, right? Me and Zumama are gonna prep an Acahualla-style New Year's feast. We've done it your way, I think it's about time you saw how we Tiacauh do a festival. You're gonna come, right?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor! ...Oops, my bad. Didn't bruise you, did I?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: So it's your birthday again, Doctor. Craziest day of the year aboard Rhodes Island, apart from New Year's. Seriously, Rhodes Islanders are taking some hell of a shine to you. Here, a present from me. Also, I'm watching you, same as always. You're not doing a second of work today.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: We don't need to exchange any sappy words here, do we, Doctor? I'm Gavial, the medic-slash-warrior of Rhodes Island. Where there's people with Oripathy, I'm there. It's that simple, isn't it?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: There's a limit to the types of documents I can help you with, Doctor. But I'll try to learn. I'm hoping to lead my own major engineering project someday, so I gotta accumulate knowledge from different domains.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Just spending some time reading. No, I'm not pushing myself too hard. Oripathy doesn't leave me too much time, so I must... Oh, sorry, I didn't mean to make things awkward.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I've gotten quite a bit taller in the last couple of years? Hehe, I'm still growing, after all. My ears have gotten perkier? Er, I guess it's also because I'm still growing...?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: No, Doctor, I haven't gotten more talkative... but Engineering veterans say we have to sound certain of ourselves, in order for our skills and designs to feel certain... I'll keep working at it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Looks like the upcoming courses are even more complicated, and Engineering's idea of an internship is a little… *sigh*… never mind, I can handle it. Yes, I'll be sure to get enough rest. Rest is important to studying efficiently.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Mankind may have learned to overcome the darkness of night, but there are always shadows that even the brightest lights cannot breach. If I can continue to improve this technology, and bring warmth and light to those who shiver in the cold night...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Though I now fully leave the line patrol work to my drones, it doesn't mean my early intership years are worthless. Look at my physique now, even Medical doesn't have to worry about me anymore... um, Doctor? Why are you crying?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Volvort Kochinski... I've seen their mark on Mamá's equipment. Not even Rhodes Island intelligence has been able to track down Mamá since the incident. Is she covering her tracks, running from something?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, I'm going to visit a client to help with PLC testing. It won't take too long. You can use Rhodes Island Messengers to contact me if you need something... but I'm sure you can handle anything that comes up.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor... Doctor? Asleep already?... I see... This next segment is prone to bugs. I should set alerts to silent...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. This equipment was my graduation project. My initial plan was to... huh? Putting it into service? Dios mío(My goodness), so this is the 'Doctor's Thesis Defense' that Closure talked about?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: No matter how much I watch, I just can't help but feel… everyone's style is so individualized, it's hard to summarize anything for general application…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: It's an honor to earn your recognition, and that of Engineering. I know this is just the starting point, and I'll keep working to make sure that I don't let you down.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Countless frontiers remain uncharted on this land named science, waiting to be mapped and discovered. Though our latest technologies help get their views from afar, we have yet to set our foot on them. My dream, Doctor, is to be the pioneer that explores these realms with engineering.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: A practical field study... in combat?  Sure, no problem.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Understood. I'll compile a deployment report with suggestions for improvement.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We're into an assault mission. Before we breakthrough the enemy defenses, I'm counting on you to hold the line.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Battlefield is where soldiers and war machines witness their own prime… and their own end.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Output stable.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: On your call.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Environ parameters set.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: EM trajectory calibrated.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'll create an opening.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hit them in the face!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This will be the breakthrough!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I choose you!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Things were worse than expected, Doctor. Even our contingency plan was pushed to its limit... but we still did it!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew… Everything went according to plan. All equipment in good condition. We're ready for the next phase.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Effect on target below expectations, risk of potential failure… The re-simulation of both Doctor and PRTS  are required for next steps.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No obstacles on the evacuation path. It's time to retreat, Doctor!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: These facilities could use an upgrade...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: One moment, I'm almost done here... just a few lines more...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Here so early, Doctor? Give me a moment, I'm almost done...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Want to watch the light show together tonight? I designed this year's New Year show featuring my latest eco-lights, and they're sure to impress. After I'm done with their modification with Engineering, I'll donate them to offices in remote regions as disaster relief supplies.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Everything going well, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Here's a gift I designed for you. Why don't you take a look inside? See? There's a button on the side of the base. Just press it... and there we go! 'A town lit by home lights under a starry sky' in this little crystal ball, lovely isn't it?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I never thought I would have the opportunity to learn so much and do so much... with determination and hard work, even one little spark can light up the night sky. This is the most important lesson that I learned from Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm your bodyguard again, just like old times, Doctor. And it's not just a job, it's a reunion. That's something worth cherishing.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: How does it feel to be back in Siracusa? Not great. It's for wise guys and famiglie, not me. I'm only staying long enough to cut ties with the past. After I'm done washing my hands of the whole business, I'm heading back to Lungmen to pick up the girls, and then going out for a nice drive.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I didn't want to get Penguin Logistics involved, but it was a relief to see them in Siracusa. My noisy friends, that life of freedom... Looking back now, staying with them in Lungmen was the best decision I ever made. Just, don't tell them I said that.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Sometimes I hear Siracusans talking about the downfall of Famiglia Texas. No two versions of the story are the same. Most are pretty dull, and some make for interesting fairytales, but in the end, they're all pretty embellished. The real story is... I just got exhausted, and decided to leave.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Ever noticed how even the rain here stains the walls outside? Dirty rainwater can't wash anything clean. And that's Siracusa. Siracusans might be used to it, but I'm not.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've got no interest in joining Greyhall. The dons sit in their chairs, acting all high and mighty, hiding their plans. I decided to confront Signora Sicilia because she thinks she can tame everyone, and that's one thing I can't stand.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I saw Lappland in Siracusa. Oh, you haven't seen her in a while? Not like she needs anyone worrying about her. If she's over me now, she'll find something else to cut. As for the score we haven't settled, I say it doesn't matter. We'll meet again soon enough.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I was born in Columbia, but my grandfather wanted me to become a proper mafiosa and sent me to Siracusa to learn the trade. But to this day I don't understand why the people here like macaroni so much? I used to go to this little place for macaroni myself, but it closed down a long time ago. The owner died in a back alley.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: In Siracusa, there were a whole lot of people trying to guess what I'd do. It wasn't that complicated. I was there to do what I had to do, and help those who deserved help. Doctor, all I ask is that we continue to get along just like we used to. This relationship, built on real trust, is hard to find there.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: It's quiet here. No hitmen haunting the shadows, no wolves waiting in the alleys.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: We meet again, Doctor. The Siracusan rainy season always gets my tail wet, so I prefer the climate here. Don't worry, Exusiai and the girls will keep taking care of the deliveries, but I'll handle any jobs assigned to me personally.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thanks. Doesn't seem much different from your average delivery run in Lungmen.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm not helping you for the money, Doctor. But still, go ahead and send my salary over to Penguin Logistics as usual. I'll pick it up from Emperor.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I still have a lot to take care of before I can enjoy a peaceful life, and if the only way to shake the past is to smash it to pieces, then that's exactly what I'll do. Simple as that.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Order confirmed, crystal clear.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Alright. Try to keep up. Let me know if you can't.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: No need to make a scene.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't leave bloodstains. They're hard to clean.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Moving to designated location.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Need speed to succeed.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got a problem that needs solving?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I see them. I'll be right back.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Bad luck, you ran into me.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You saw nothing.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Pass on your last words? No.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: This will keep you quiet.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The only way to solve a problem is to clear all the obstacles in the way, no matter what they might be and keep moving.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A battle without an explosion or cheering makes me feel a little uneasy. Let's head back. A drink? Maybe next time.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: There's still more to clean. When's our next sweep?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I can take out a few more. You go ahead and retreat.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place reminds me of Lungmen. It's quiet. Doesn't have the constant pitter patter of the rain.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey. Stop it.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, where's the hair dryer? I'd like to dry my tail.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's a brand new year, so Happy New Year. Sora gave me a CD to listen to, and it's a totally different style. Very relaxing. Looks like her time in Siracusa expanded her horizons too. Want to give it a listen?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Great, this place is the same as it ever was. Morning. Got any new plans?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. You're another year older, and you'll have another chance to grow. Since it's a special occasion, want me to call over the Penguin Logistics girls and throw a birthday party? Even I get in the mood for a little bit of fun and excitement with my friends. That's not the kind of 'excitement' you'll ever find in Siracusa.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Sometimes I think to myself, what Rhodes Island is trying to do is really hard, but you're actually doing it. Me? I don't think about anything so complicated, but I'm more than glad to help out. All we're looking for is peace.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm to assist you? One moment, then. I'll go and change into more appropriate uniform... What? No need?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I'll be honest, even now I'm not used to life with my mask off—it always feels like there's something missing from my face. Still, it seems I can operate freely in daylight now. Please, give me more daytime missions, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The combat style the Felynes have taught me is like nothing I've known before. Unbroken strings of attacks as a defense, swift evasive maneuvers, different styles combining to achieve completely differing effects... Even though I've been training day and night, I still can't say I've mastered it.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: These clothes have your attention, Doctor? They confused me just as much when I first put them on—they have a startling defensive capacity, despite their obvious design. How it's achieved is completely beyond me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: There's a strange force in these dual blades. They attack with thunder, but without the use of Arts... Is it the materials that cause it? I was definitely more proficient with my old katana... but when it comes to protecting us all, I'll shy away from no weapon.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The Felynes never cease to mention monsters even more fearsome than Rathalos—the kind that could bring about Catastrophe-scale disasters with the flap of a wing. If Rhodes Island ever faced such a threat... no. After all we've been through, I wouldn't fear an enemy like that anymore.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Though I've changed my loadout and gained new skills, I'm still the same Yato you know. Just give the order, and I'll take on whatever role Rhodes Island needs of me, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Noir Corne's always been this way, fussing over minor details, dragging down the mission. Still, I admit he's occasionally helpful... okay, a little more than occasionally. The point is, I don't hate him.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Operators are often worried about the way I do things, wondering if I'm putting myself in harm's way. Honestly, the concern's unnecessary. Thinking too much on my situation would only slow me down, but when it comes to what my friends are going through, trust me, I will care.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: It seems you need some rest, Doctor. You can try this, if you want. It's a Felyne blend of a remedial plant they call Sleep Herb and some kind of mushroom. I hear it works very well, sleep-wise.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hey, Doctor. That's right, it's me. Op Team A4 Captain Yato, back and reporting in. As for where I got all this new equipment, you have the whole story from me in the mission debrief.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hold on, I had notes on the locale. Let me find them...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Whatever role I'm in, I'll bring everything I have.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Another medal for me? I'd love to wear them, but I don't think this outfit has anywhere for them to go. Still, thank you, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave it to me, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Alright, it's in my hands now. The success of our mission is assured.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Target confirmed. They won't know what hit them.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Op Team A4 Yato in position.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Standing by…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Finally, am I up?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Engaging.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: So that's our target?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hnf! Haah!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: That all you got?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Flurry!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Fight or flee, it's no use!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: We owe this victory to your fine command. I still have a long way to go.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Take victory as a whetstone to hone the cutting edge.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Was this your mercy? Understood.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: This falls on me. You make a retreat, and grant me one more attempt.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'd like more dangerous or challenging work, but if these are your orders, I'll gladly accept, Doctor.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What is it, Doctor? Intrigued by the materials for this outfit?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh, hey, Doctor. I guess I'm not used to dropping the mask after all.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year once again. It's often during festive periods that the enemy lowers their guard. If you have any ops planned, you can leave them to me.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor. You're the same as ever. I wonder if I'm any better than I used to be?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Could you drop me from field missions for the day, if that's alright? Noir Corne says he's got plans, see...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Look at all the time we've spent together, Doctor. Rhodes Island gave Noir Corne and I a place to call home, and I feel the weight of everyone's faith in this blade. Come what may, I look forward to taking on much more for Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: My next mission is to protect you, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I don't say much? That's because I'd rather avoid thinking about most things.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Our job is to deliver life and death.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I usually listen to Sora's songs when I'm driving.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Cigarette? Oh, no, this is chocolate. You've gotta replenish your energy regularly. Which reminds me... do you want some coffee?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: How long have I worked for Penguin Logistics? When did I start...? I don't even know how long it's been.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Watch out for the Red Wolf. She's not evil, but... she's not like us.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: No matter how hard I run, my past will catch up to me one day.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My independent lifestyle and rowdy friends have brought me a lot of trouble... but I kind of like it this way.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Is it time for a break?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Code name Texas. I'm responsible for driving, moving cargo, and keeping our people safe. Try to get the mission briefings as concise as possible, please.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This will work as payment.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thanks for trusting me, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: What do you need?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm not good at barking orders.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Exusiai, cover me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Awaiting orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Draw swords!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's begin.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hah!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You can't stop me.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Cut them to pieces!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Shut up.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Whew... No problem.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Weaklings.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A few of them got through.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I may have underestimated this operation.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Do you need any supplies? Just let me know.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What is it, Doctor?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year. I was just about to give these to Exusiai. She said she'd be hosting a big party tonight, to celebrate her results not being rock bottom. The other girls? Croissant was hauling a huge batch of goods she got in earlier, so I figure she's got a stall laid out now. As for Sora... have you heard her new single, Doctor? I'm pretty into it.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Morning.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here's a box of vinyls from the boss's collection. I got it from Lungmen. Take it, Doctor. No need to worry about my boss. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I like how Rhodes Island does its anniversaries. Here's a couple wine truffles I just picked up, rum and bitter almond flavor. Tastes pretty good. Why don't you give them a try?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Alright, I'm here to help! Chill, I'm all good with this gear now. Bumping into everything? That's the old me!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Out in the field, it's pretty important to watch what you and your teammates eat. Just a while ago, I learned how to use this simple BBQ spit to treat raw meat. Here, lemme demo for you right now!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I've hauled butt all across Terra, and I've never seen gear both as sturdy and as comfortable as this. Feels like when I wear it, my attack power gets boosted, plus I can hit enemy weaknesses way better, and my fire attacks are stronger too! Yeah, uh, I figure that might just be me? Haha.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The Felynes say the more experienced the hunter, the more thorough the pre-mission prep. Packing all your potions and tools is just as key to the hunt. Still, Yato loves to chew me out, saying I'm always bringing too much stuff on missions. Rock and a hard place, y'know?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Feels weird, honestly, not having my ol' reliable shield on hand. Still, the Felynes say if I get good enough with this long sword, I can basically fend off every attack under the sun. Guess my training's got a long way to go.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You only really master combat technique after taking on enough enemies. I guess no shortcut to getting promoted after all, huh? Especially for dummies like me, haha.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I get that whetstones aren't thrilling, but they're a tool you can't go without. Even a blade with sharpness this fine is gonna need nonstop polishing its whole life.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I just wanna do my job as a guy in the background, even now. Us nobodies, we've got our own duties, our own worries, and our own things we wanna protect.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ditching the shield, using a long sword like this, it keeps reminding me of the old days. Bad times I hate to remember. But without our past, I guess Yato and me wouldn't be who we are today.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Get your rest on, Doctor. Leave the place to me.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Operator Noir Corne, back under your command with all-new gear! Alright, Doctor, don't care if it's bandits or nightmare bizarro creatures, you leave it all to me!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Lemme scrub back a sec, I want a closer look. Yeah, mm-hm...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I've gotta give thanks to my kickass gear for carrying me this far. But obviously, the biggest props go out to you and everyone around me for all your help!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This is Operator Noir Corne, everyone's shield through hell and high water! And hey, I guess I can handle being everyone's sword too!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: No prob. I'm all readied up.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You want me to lead, without Yato? You sure? I think it'd be better if you got her on.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Everybody done eating? Alright, go time!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Mission start! Target position is a lock!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Which area am I heading to?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Primed and ready!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Draw!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Nice, right here!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Haah! Hey!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I'm going in!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I see through you!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: That's my window!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Now THAT was a good battle. Take pride, everyone, and good work!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete, perfect job! We gotta get back to Rhodes Island, because I'm looking forward to celebrating!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Good work, Doctor. We'll do better next time, don't you worry.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor! Got your Farcaster from the Felynes? You need to ditch, fast. I'll come right after you, no worries!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, steady. Lemme put my sword away first.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What's up, Doctor? Need me to head somewhere?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Haha, what do you say, Doctor? How about a round of drinks?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! You're not missing out on this honeywine, are you? The stuff's a special recipe, straight from the Felynes. You gotta try! I just drank a mug, and I'm ready to take on the world while I feel on top of it! C'mon, we've got the perfect way to welcome in the New Year!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: It's another fine day. Take care of yourself, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I hauled everyone in to wrap up as much of your work for you as we could. No drinks on the agenda today, either, we want you to get some major rest. Call that my present to you, haha.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Man, another year gone. Guess I've really gotten used to life at Rhodes Island. Believe me, I'll trust in you all forever. Rhodes Island is going to lead the way for so many people, just like it did for Yato and me. I count my blessings every day that I can be here to help.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Let's commence work, Doctor. We have a mountain of issues to face.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, can you pass a message onto Ifrit for me? I'm returning to Trimounts—there's some urgent business that requires me in person. So she'll have to eat dinner with Saria tonight. I... I'll make it up to her next time, I promise.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Do you need coffee? This is a special bean Joyce prepared for me that keeps me up even in the daytime. After all, I can't coop up alone in the lab day and night like I once did. I have lots of meetings that I'd rather not take, and lots of reports to read that I'd also rather not.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My thoughts on returning to Rhine Lab...? I'd rather not reflect on it like that, if I could. All I can say is, I used to perennially expect someone would come to my aid, but now I understand—I can only rely on myself if I am to achieve anything.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Guess what this stack of papers is? They're whistleblower reports. Some labs think they can protect themselves by airing other labs' dirty laundry to me. The more they do this, the more anger I feel welling up inside.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Return those gifts to senders, and have them convey to whoever's behind them, that I'll be making a personal visit, and they'd better be prepared... Sorry, Doctor, am I bothering you at work? I'll excuse myself for now. Yes, alright, I'll be back in Trimounts later today...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: This contract pertains to the ensuing direction of our partnership with Rhodes Island, Doctor. You'd better take a look. I don't want us to blindly accept Rhodes Island's aid. Of course, I do hope that outside of work, we'll remain good friends.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Yes, Doctor? No, I'm no longer restricting Ifrit from seeing Saria. Honestly, on the contrary, I hope they see more of each other now. Ifrit is grown up, after all. And more importantly, her presence will remind Saria that,  not all prices are numbers, and reports do not remove scars.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: To be honest, being domineering is an awful sensation. When people come to my desk, the way they look at me makes me uncomfortable. But that's something I'll gradually adapt to. I'm going to rest for a short while, Doctor. I'd like to hear your thoughts after I wake up.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'll deal with some minor affairs for you, Doctor. Rest well.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, my time aboard Rhodes Island will be inevitably diminished in the future. There is one thing, however, that I can guarantee: my relationship with Rhodes Island will only grow closer, because I trust Rhodes Island, and I trust you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Some battles are unavoidable, I know.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: The pharmaceutical I took part in developing is highly effective? That's excellent. Though I have to devote more of my energy elsewhere, I would never want to give up my research.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I know what you want to ask. The path I'm about to walk is a thorny one. Am I really prepared for it…? I don't know whether future me will come to regret this, but at least right now, I will firmly walk on.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Support role aside, you can delegate some tactical planning work to me too.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll see to it our tactics are drawn up.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We should probe into the significance of the fight, and not indulge its outbreak.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'm a physician, but also a member of the squad. Let's go.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Any change in tactics?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I concur.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't act rashly.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This is an excellent opportunity.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I hope nobody is hurt.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Just as planned.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, I always find a great deal to learn from you, though I hope I never have occasion to use these tactics.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The samples in this area... We've taken these before. Let's move on.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'll organize aid for wounded personnel. Everyone else, please assist in maintaining the perimeter.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor... it looks like we should reformulate our tactics.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place still feels like home.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: ...Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, I happen to have some issues I'd like to discuss with you. Are you available right now?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, I imagine Ifrit sent you, didn't she? She tries everything she can to get me to put down my work. She's always making trouble for me—she even threatened to burn my lab reports. You're the third one she's sent... Alright, we'll break here for today. Let's go.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Coffee, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Here's your cake, your card, a small gift, and... I seem very practiced? Yes, indeed. I've definitely grown somewhat used to celebrating birthdays. Days like this lift your spirits, don't they?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When I first joined Rhine, research was my everything. Following the Diαbolic Crisis, Ifrit and her Oripathy were my everything. But now, as I come to know more and more, the things I want to do grow in volume too. Still, Doctor, we'll reunite at the same destination, when all's said and done.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Yes, I have received the notification that fragmentation mines are forbidden in the corridors. But rest assured, Doctor, the high voltage fencing installed on your door violates no ordinances.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Indeed, I was the one who introduced recent Lateran Operators to Rhodes Island. If you have no objections, I will continue to introduce functionaries with special circumstances to you. I hope to study how Sankta live outside Lateran, and how it compares to their life within.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This mission may call for a piano performance? Do not worry. I have memorized the complete scores of over a hundred classical pieces, and I can play every note in accurate order. Any properly trained executor should be capable of this. That does not count as playing the piano? I do not understand.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The title 'Saint' can neither enhance my abilities nor reveal any precise mission to me. Though it has added difficulties to my work, I cannot fathom why I was chosen. Its objective and demands are something I must seek myself.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, this is my medical examination report, please confirm. Currently, no horns have grown on my head, and my halo has seen no changes in shape or form. Indeed, my violation of the law has not had a physical effect on me, but it's nothing worthy of celebration. Abnormalities have been on the rise. This is an omen of disaster.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, during my recent missions, my limbs have been acting before I complete my thought processes. This phenomenon can impede successful completion of my missions. I am troubled. Could you tell me whether it's a kind of disease? Will my condition worsen? Is there a medicine that can heal it?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Most confuse Arturia's Arts as tampering with cognition and mental faculty, but I know the fact is just the opposite. Arturia is interested only in the truest emotions, and cares not for where these emotions lead. The influence she can command is far worse than anyone can possibly imagine.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: What are you doing, Doctor? Bodily contact is no replacement for spoken language. I cannot decipher your thoughts through your limbs. You think that I need comfort? If that is your judgment, then I have no reason to refuse. In fact, I am merely thinking back to my recent mission. What leaves a man no other choice, but death?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: As you can see, this is a burnt flower. I have, to the best of my abilities, maintained its condition in order to bring it to you. It is not a gift, because it does not meet the criteria for one. It's a question in my mind. I am still pondering the things behind this flower.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You lack sleep, Doctor. You need more rest.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You seem surprised, Doctor. Please rest assured that the change in my equipment won't affect my ability to complete my missions. If you find yourself ill at ease because of my attire, I can change into my previous garments before I enter Rhodes Island. No need? Understood.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I have attempted a few combat techniques, and they have yielded excellent results.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You put together an all new profile. Is this a false identity for my next mission? If the need arises, I know where to prepare identification that can pass checks. No need? This, too, is a normal promotion?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I am trying to understand the law. Is Laterano's foundation truly these words alone? Is that applicable to lands other than Laterano? I must admit I have indeed been affected by it, to a certain degree. I will attempt to find the answer posthaste.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The law itself has no power. It calls for enforcers.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I require those who can act on their own judgment.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Move out.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Commencing operation. Please confirm the mission objective.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your request is reasonable.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Prayers are unnecessary.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I shall ensure the integrity of the law.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Target confirmed.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Destruction is the most naive behavior.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Annihilation is the most common result.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Violated taboos hold no power.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No casualties, no commotions. All good.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The result is acceptable.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We need to reformulate our battle plans.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Maintaining a dedicated room is a show of respect? I see.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I have heard there are certain hobbies that are not easily understood by others. Perhaps this is one such hobby?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Speak the word if you need anything, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Changes in numbers and symbolistic objects are how man reminds himself of the flow of time. Yes, I can understand, in spite of the fact that I need no such reminders. However, if this day brings you joy, then it is indeed very meaningful. Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You have changed greatly, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Gifts need to be packaged properly, so its contents cannot be seen on a single glance? Is this a compulsory requirement? My apologies, Doctor, I am not well-versed in such matters. I will prepare an unscannable safe and a new gift. Please give me a moment.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I have been looking for you, Doctor. The cleaning agreement that I have entered into with your company is nearing its end. If you desire a new agreement, you may refer to these items I brought with me for reference. The Notarial Hall has never entered into a long term agreement with a foreign corporation. Our partnership with Rhodes Island will be a new challenge.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Alright, chop chop. Finish your work during your coffee break so the rest of your day is all coffee break!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: It's a holiday, so of course I gotta dress a little more casual. I may not have taken as many field missions these past few years, but I still passed the L.G.D.'s physical exams, in high heels.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If Rhodes Island's looking for business partners, you can definitely trust these companies. Hey! Why are you looking at me like that? I'm just genuinely listing off my recommendations. You're making it look like I'm plotting a hostile takeover of Rhodes Island. If I'm actually planning an M&A... I just need to talk you round, right?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Ahem... I've taken a glance at our recent mission records. Looks like Rhodes Island's tactics have got more professional over the past few years. Not bad, not bad... Excuse me?! What's wrong with your former training consultant checking your operators' records? I absolutely have not been looking at Ch'en's files!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: It's not really a big deal, being L.G.D. chief. I've got a little more on my shoulders, a little more to worry about, and I can put myself in Ch'en's shoes a little more now... Oh, let me reiterate: I'm taking over the L.G.D., not taking over for Ch'en! If that stupid Lung came back right now, she'd have to call me 'Chief.'

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I may have left my family's company, but I still deal in business every now and then. It's a way to build Lungmen, so there's no need to avoid the subject. And now that I've figured out what I need to do, I don't find my grandfather so scary anymore. Hmhm, Once you've made use of your fears, that's when you've truly conquered them, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The new Siesta's an interesting place. Even without its beaches and volcano, it's still worth a visit for its sky pools and natural springs. My investment there has resulted in pretty decent returns too. Doctor, if you find the time, you should go and see for yourself. Heading back to a place you haven't been in a while... might be just like a reunion with an old friend.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Things are looking up for the trading company I'm running with Bison. Transporting one country's goods to another, sharing the cultures of places afar, these are the charms of commerce. Many are afraid of breaking barriers, but, Doctor, I'm sure we can find common ground.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
