lines.text: Is this the last document you have? Alright! You really kept me waiting this time, but finally, time for supper! I know this new place that's not so bad. It's on me tonigh—Oh, You don't want me spending money? Umm... alright, then it's on you. I know some other places.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Rawr... Ahem... You finished your work?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Long time no see, Doctor. Ahem, let me introduce myself again. Beatrix Schwire, soon-to-be Chief Commissioner of the Lungmen Guard Department—I really am the chief! Whoever said the L.G.D. chief can't take holidays?!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's been a while, but that's quite the improvement—Excuse me!? Why must you emphasize that this happened when I wasn't working here as an instructor?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Exceptional talents earn exceptional rewards. That's just how things should be.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Alright, alright. I get that you can't do without me anymore. No sense beating around the bush like that. If you need my help, just say the word. I'll always be here for you, as your friend.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Really? Not making me captain?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just follow my command and it'll all be fine.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's try to take up as little of our holiday time as possible.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I don't really want my holiday mood ruined, so hurry up and stop resisting arrest.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I haven't taken orders in a long time… feels kinda weird.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Follow your orders…? Fine.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Wait for my orders.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Start the operation.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The moment you break the law, your back's against the wall.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Where are you trying to run?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Be good, be cuffed, I'll hear your motive after taking you in.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Freeze! Hands in the air!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That's all the men and wares accounted for. Let's call it a day here.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Don't get cocky. This is barely a pass mark by L.G.D. standards, but if you manage to keep this up, I guess I could still commend you.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: If you can take care of something in one go, it's best not to do it twice. Keep your costs under control.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's wrap it up here. I'll take care of the mission report.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place hasn't been redecorated even once this whole time? You serious?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Doctor, do you know the consequences for attacking a cop in Lungmen? Don't worry. I'm just teaching you about the laws there.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh, you like this fashion brand? I can pick out an outfit for you.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! Perfect timing. Come carry these things for me. I've got gifts for all my friends here in Rhodes Island—Oh! Be careful with that! Pure gold's very heavy!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning... Hm? Just saying hello. What were you expecting? Rawr?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Over the last two years, I've come to realize more and more that only shallow friendships need all that shallow pretense to maintain, so I didn't get you anything this year. Doctor, take the day off. If there's anything you want or anywhere you want to go, I'll keep you company.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The relationships you build on the battlefield are not something you can fake. Hoshiguma seems pretty concerned about your relationship with the L.G.D., but I know why she's beating around the bush. Hehe, next time, I'll drag her to Rhodes Island to join the parties.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: While you were out, I tried to sort the documents on your desk for you... It shames me to admit it, but... I haven't made much progress when it comes to desk work.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I ran into Franka and Liskarm on my way to the dorms. Even though I hadn't seen them in so long, we talked like we were never apart... Um, Doctor, do you think, maybe, I c-could apply to serve on missions with them?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I don't have as much money on hand these days. I argued with my father a lot about pioneering in the barrenlands. And so... I stopped drawing from the family trust fund. But I can still earn some money out there pioneering, at least enough to maintain my equipment.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: When I was little, everyone always had so much on their plates. Only my retired grandfather could stay at home with me. He would tell me stories about his time in the army, so that he can cheer me up this way. Even though his past never stopped tormenting him, he was still willing to fluff it into tidy little stories, just to make me smile.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: There was a soirée a while ago where someone brought up the war in Victoria. I chimed in with my own experiences. Only a few words, but enough to ruin everyone's time. You know, Doctor, that was the moment I finally realized why Blacksteel mercenaries rarely talk about themselves.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm nominally still employed by Blacksteel, but it's been a while since I've done any mercenary work. No, it's not that I regret the decision I made back then; I'm just tired of responding to disaster, always one step behind. This time, I want to be there to protect something from the beginning.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor... Would you mind coming to the training room with me? I don't need a spotter, it's just... new operators keep coming to me for advice, and facing them alone makes me feel a— a little nervous.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Oh... You want to know about the flower on my chest? Actually... it wasn't an accessory to begin with. It was a shard of metal that got lodged in my leg. After it was surgically removed, I... decided to turn it into a buttonhole flower instead of throwing it away. Y-Yeah, I guess it is kinda weird. I'm not sure what I was thinking.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I know now that there's no shame in crying... or having a soft heart. If you're sad about something you can't put into words, why not express your feelings with tears? It's part of being human, so there's nothing to be ashamed of.  Um... Am I right, Doctor?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You look a little worse for wear every time I see you... Are you doing alright these days, Doctor?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: It's been a while since we last met, Doctor. I'm glad there's still something I can do for you. That's right, I have changed a lot. If you could find the time, I'd love to sit down with you and catch up...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I just dug up my old combat records, which proved to be pretty useful. Comparing my before-and-after, I at least know what mistakes I shouldn't be making again. Ugh, I really looked like a... bumbling idiot back then.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm just glad to receive your acknowledgement, Doctor. The rewards are secondary.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, are you giving me a promotion? Then, can I... make a teensy tiny extra request? It's nothing big, just... Can I... have a hug?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Come in, Commander, this is Jessica. On the line and ready to roll.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Rally on me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: ETA six mikes.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hostiles sighted, over.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: In position.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Roger, wilco.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm headed into the thick of it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: With all of you behind me, I won't take a single step back.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Drawing a bead on the target.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't come any closer…

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Requesting permission to fire.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Be advised. Target… eliminated.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No resting on your laurels now... We've got more fighting ahead of us.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was close, I almost... A-Anyway, good thing I managed to pull through in the end... Sorry, Doctor. Please, give me a minute. I need to get my emotions under control.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I think... a minor setback is no big deal. It's already enough that none of our people got hurt.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, an apology doesn't even begin to cut it... I'll try to make up for this failure on subsequent operations.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: How I miss the time I spent on this landship... If only I could've stayed longer...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Go ahead, Doctor.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You looked a little surprised shaking my hand just now... D-Did my calluses scare you, Doctor?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: For me, Doctor, it's already like a dream, get to sit here with you and say 'happy new year'. I remember that time in Bolívar, the only thing I had to share the New Year with was a gun thiiiiiiiis big. Yeah, bigger than me.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Glad to see you again, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I brought you a gift from the frontier... A jar of all-natural maple syrup. Though it's not as fancy as the stuff I used to get you, it's a rare treat where I live. You can't even buy it with money; you have to head out to the forest and collect it yourself.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Goals and achievements to score in the future, those were what I used to be so preoccupied with. But my experiences in recent years have shattered those fantasies. It's already good enough, if you can grant some happiness and dignity to the people around you.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Huh? You sure? What did I ever do to make you think I'm some kind of loyal bodyguard, who wants to serve you all day and all heartily? Getting cold feet? Sorry, but I've accepted your request. Remember, it was you choice, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You heard? Ines and Hoederer are actually gonna open a shop in Kazdel. I know the places they've been looking at, they're all shitheaps. But I guess my li'l revenant here could help mop the floors with his party tricks? His opinion? Lemme ask. Oh, he's fine with that.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Theresa and Amiya... Both of them love gazing off into the distance like that. I went and had a look myself, but there's nothing special out there. What are they always staring at? I'm gonna figure it out someday.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I haven't had a day of peace ever since I picked up this grumpy hunk of scrap metal. Can you imagine what it feels like to have an old, undying geezer babbling on about the past, right into your ear, day in and day out? Oh, you do? Well, well, guess misery loves company, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: You wanna work with my team? Do I look like a girl who'd fall for the same trick twice? Yeah, yeah, save the explanations. You know what you did. But be warned, my mercs pick their own roads now. While I'm gonna take out the scumbags who dare treat us like pawns. Should I start with you, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: How many Sarkaz mercs just like me has Her Highness seen? Does she really remember all their names...? Whatever. Mine is the only one she picked herself. Oi! Say my name, Doctor. Wiš'adel. Not some codename picked out of a pile of stiffs anymore. It's. My. Name.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Tch, how dare that little bunny bossing me around. She thinks I'm gonna go along with it and be her errand girl, just 'cause she gives me that gentle look? Drop it. No one can be a second Theresa. Even that bunny does have some... some... Whatever. At least Rhodes Island's still moving, and all the naive dumbasses haven't died out yet.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You seriously think we're getting along? Wanna guess what it is I'm holding right here? Hmph, relax, it's fear you're gonna bear for what you did. Wouldn't be much fun to cash this thing out that easy. So, when are you gonna let your guard down again, Doctor? I'm really looking forward. To. It.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Evil spirit'… is the current you still qualified for that title? Doesn't matter how mysterious the soul boxed up in your little frame there is. You're a lot more... honest, than I thought. And I'd much rather put up with an idiot, than waste my time with scum.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You can sleep when I'm around, huh? How about we make sure you don't ever wake up?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Wiš'a... del. I sign my name here, right? Her Highness says this name means 'wishing for a home.' I don't make wishes, though. Huh? My handwriting sucks? Screw you, who are you to judge.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: You don't have to prove anything to me with your videos. We'll see how you take advantage of people's lives. We'll see closely.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Can't you come up with something new, Doctor? Other than this useless little garbage? Why don't you, say— have Kal'tsit sing me a song? Or if that's not sincere enough, you could join in, gimme a duet?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I don't have the energy to waste on saving this land. I just wanna kick in the Military Commission's front door and make Lateran Candles outta the guys inside, then blow 'em sky high, spreading out into the Babel logo with fifteen different colors. I'll send you an invite to the show. It's gonna be one for the ages, I gua-ran-tee.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: If I die here, use the pension to buy some roast potatoes for the gang! Hahaha.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Somebody's not happy with me as captain? Sounds like a you problem.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Aw. These wonderful days just never end.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Whose turn is it to get blown to bits today?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: The revenant's babbling again. Son-of-a-gun's got a filthy mouth.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: So you racked your brain, then came up with a plan of plopping me here? Bravo.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Wow, looks awfully dangerous. You call me out for this?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Trash the mission briefing. I know what you want.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Poor little guy. It's your unlucky day.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Now now, wait in line. We got plenty for everyone.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Always so focused on the ground. But have you forgotten... to look ABOVE?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Boom! Who says there's always a countdown?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: What a thrilling battle. Now what does this Doctor standing next to me think, looking out over the battlefield? Nah, save it. I'm not all that interested.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Do you like my nails? Guess what I used to paint them.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You're not happy with the results, Doctor? How about we blow the whole place up, burn everything for a bonfire? Wouldn't that light you up? No? Shame.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: That was pathetic, Doctor. We might just die here today. It's what we deserved, right? Hahaha— You scared? Then follow me close. Step only where I step. Otherwise... Today might actually be the end.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: If no one's gonna do anything about this door, I'll just fix it myself. Hey, revenant, get the hell out here and start working.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Finally ready to die?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What's up? You bored? I got some fun things we could do. But don't blame me if you end up— dead.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's? You even celebrate the New Year? Hehehe. Oh yeah, you know I love to party. I even left gifts for everybody, all in your name, Doctor. And soon, things will be a blast... literally.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh joy, there's your face again, Doctor. What a great start for the day.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Oi! Why are you bumbling around me all this time? Were you…expecting something? Pfff, maybe take a look under your desk? Cut the blue wire. That hint is my birthday present to you. Real thoughtful of me, right?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: No matter what, this place's never gonna be Babel again… You know, I hate morons who can't stop nagging about the good old days. So why don't we talk about what to blow up tomorrow?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I've arranged today's paperwork by category, Doctor. Allow me to assist you with it.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I ran into Hibiscus and Lava the last time I came aboard. They were bickering about something or other, as per usual. The two sisters might've grown a lot, but they still love their daily squabbles. Doctor, do you think everybody has one thing about them... that they can never change?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What do I do with my time off? Hmm... Well, last time, I went to see the Red Hand Gang and the survivors of that incident. Their perseverance helped me understand, on a deeper level, why Rhodes Island helps people.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Please don't avoid necessary training, Doctor. You see, I never missed a single training session. I wouldn't say it makes you totally untouchable in battle, but it can keep you alive. My two scars are proof of that.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I often think back to when Ace encouraged me to join Rhodes Island. He said I'd become a great operator. That's been my motivation to keep me going through my training. But... it was only when I officially became an operator, that I understood the weight of his expectations.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: What has war revealed to you, Doctor? When I finally stood on the battlefield myself, I came to understand that many commanders see their troops as sacrificial pawns for victory. Ever since, I've always been reviewing and reassessing how I lead my squad. I'm not going to let myself become that kind of commander.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Once back in Londinium, some soldiers from the coalition of dukes laughed at us, calling us fools. But if Rhodes Island's operations really are foolish, then I doubt any action on this land could be called wise.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I sometimes go to the training grounds to guide the recruits. Most times, I'm more worried than they are about any mistakes. I always feel like I should be doing something to help push them along faster. But as Instructor Dobermann always says, I need to relax and give them more time. It looks like I still have a lot to learn.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Oripathy and the Infected are two very big and complex topics. The only thing I can worry about is protecting the people in front of me. But I'd like to believe that, someday, we'll find a solution to those problems. I'll be supporting you the whole way, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor...? Oh, you are asleep. I'll handle the rest of your work, then.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Rhodes Island Operator Fang, reporting in. I look different from before? Yeah, that's right.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Now I better understand what I've learned.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for the promotion. I'll work even harder to improve myself.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: To support the weak and protect my friends. That is my creed. The firm hand guiding me forward.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I've read the intelligence report for this operation. Awaiting orders.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm leading the squad? No problem. I've got plenty of experience.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't be nervous. Trust your training.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: All units, prepare for contact.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready whenever.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Arrived at the objective.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Squad, form up!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Halt! Freeze there!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Charge!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Ready to advance.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'll run you through!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: As long as we stay united and keep pushing forward, we have nothing to fear, even from the strongest enemy!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Excellent command as always, Doctor. The team is pretty excited. Why not let them congratulate you?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We barely managed to accomplish our objective. I'll get the team together for a postmortem debriefing. We'll do better next time.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We've been blindsided! All units, ensure your safety, retreat now!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'm back. Oh? Everyone's here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ah! It's you, Doctor. I thought Kroos was pulling another one of her pranks.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. This past year's been really busy, but I got to see many places and experience a lot with Rhodes Island. Alright. Let's push ourselves just as hard next year too!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I'm always here for you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Do you have a birthday wish? No no no, don't tell me now. But If there's anything you'd like my help with, you can tell me directly. I'm always at your service.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island's another year older... Time sure flies, and all the former members of Reserve Op Team A1 have joined different departments... Ah, look at me. This is no time to get nostalgic. There's still plenty of new problems for us to tackle.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, are you busy? Oh, it's fine if you don't have time to chat. I need to get some work done too, how about we eat together after we're done?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor...? All is well. I'm just reading this book. I suddenly realized that Theresa once read it to me, though even now I don't know how it ends. Tears...? Maybe it's because... it's such a heartwarming story.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Yes, another ring of mine broke. Dr. Kal'tsit says no material could stand against such intense emotion. But even though this ring is broken, I still want to keep wearing it. It's both a restraint and a blessing. I'll make good use of it.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, Blaze invited me to an event she's organizing. It's to celebrate our return to the landship, and a lot of elite operators will be there. Will I be joining them for drinks? No, of course I... Doctor, you and Dr. Kal'tsit are always looking after me, so you should know I've grown up a bit, but not that much.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've come to understand more and more how difficult it was for Theresa. What should I do? I think... I'll go and see Kazdel, as it is today. W will stand with me. And... there'll be more, others, in the future… Yes, I'm feeling more confident now.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I touched and felt Theresa's every emotion. She was full of love and hope... for this great land, the Sarkaz, the people by her side, and herself. But all of it came to a sudden end, along with her life. She was holding onto so much sorrow... and so am I.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Dr. Kal'tsit has seen so much death. She was forced to watch many of her loved ones go, one by one. It's just... too painful. I've grown up now, so I can shoulder more responsibility for her. She doesn't have to walk alone anymore. Doctor, I want her to know that we're here for her.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I expected as much... Thank you. Oh, Doctor? Do you want to talk with 'Civilight Eterna' too? Alright, come over here, don't be nervous... Just like this, feel the flowing energy. Feels like she's holding your hands, right? You'll get along well, I'm certain of it, and I always have been.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, I can feel your guilt, confusion... and sorrow. But you shouldn't be trapped by your past. This is what Theresa and I both wish for you. We still have lots of work to do. The one who ignited the flame of hope may no longer be with us, but the fire still burns. Babel never truly fell.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, are you well-rested? If you're still feeling tired, you don't have to force yourself to work. I'm here, after all.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Don't worry, Doctor, this is another one of my powers. I still can't heal every injury I see.... but I'll keep you safe. I'll protect the ones I love.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Could I use all my different powers in the same fight? Oh, Doctor. I was just talking to myself.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I can feel so much sorrow… so much sadness…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's keep moving forward.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Fighting... is the only option here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Amiya here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm here, Doctor.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This staff is bound to my thoughts.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Mine and Theresa's emotions... I'll manifest them here.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Love will heal our scars.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Tears will bathe new life.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Nostalgia... won't slow my steps.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'Through the grim perils of the longest night, we shall breach into the promised dawn.'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I don't want to lose anyone else. I'll carry on this fight, for every sacrifice, and all those still alive.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The flames of hatred still spread. I'll try to extinguish them, no matter... how many times it takes.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I've made a few slips... No, it's not your fault, Doctor. I could have done better here.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I won't let anyone hurt you, Doctor. Hold onto me, and don't let go, okay?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'm so glad to be home.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yes, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, do you have something to say?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Where's that form...? Hmm... I'm looking for a financial statement from Closure. Where did I put it...? Right here! Oh, it's a summary report from HR... Which reminds me, I haven't checked the new purchase order yet either... Doctor, I won't make it to the party. So I'll wish you a happy new year right here. Ahem-hem: happy new year! Oh? You want to stay with me?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Welcome home, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Do you want me to... play the violin like before? I didn't get to sneak in much practice... Oh, the time we have to ourselves just gets shorter and shorter these days... But luckily, I know your favorite tune by heart, and I'll never forget it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Another year has passed, and Rhodes Island is still sailing onwards. Doctor, tonight was just so wonderful I wish I could hide it away, deep in my mind. Thank you for staying by my side. We'll spend this very same day next year, together.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Leaving all this work to me? Hahahaha, I appreciate your trust.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: It's Siracusan tradition to mask up and dress formally for a kill, but the people of Nuova Volsinii think such costuming means embracing a new life. But no matter the occasion, you must find the best tailor for the job, no? I certainly have.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Ah, what nice weather today—Siracusa's rainy season is over, and the Grey Hall old guy can no longer stay in their seats as all the hungry opportunists rush in. Hahahaha, could the Carnival have been such a roaring success without my help?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: If the left sword drops first, we donate the wineries to the city. If the right sword falls first, then the wineries offer free admission to everyone at next year's Carnival. Hahahaha, even as that obsessive, controlling father of mine rots away in jail, the Siracusans will never forget him!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The families, the government, Signora Sicilia... every party has proved their own theories for their own gain. But how is a new city enough? What they want is a brand new country! And me? I want to see all their wishes come true, all of them!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Quiet. I won't have another 'wasteland', or 'civilization' enter my ears. Our new game is not so boring. You must learn quickly how the humans play… Oh. Hehehe, you overheard me, Doctor? Then how about you be my enemy? Come, stand against me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Texas said I'd show up eventually? Aha! She knows me so well. Anyone would burn her prison to the ground, but how many dare to remain and see what's left in the ashes? Hehe, there is no shame in running away. But after that, you pray every day! Pray that the inferno won't haunt your nightmares!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Whiskey, on the rocks, with a mint garnish. Don't mind me, just knocking a few back while you carry on with your grand ambitions. But if I were you, I'd ease up on the goodness. Or the suffering will double when it all comes crashing down.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You care very much for Rhodes Island, much as Texas cares for her companions. Woo yeah... that serious look on your face! Very good! Why don't we make a wager, with this landship... You count me in as part of this place too? Hmmm... Very interesting, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh, dear Doctor, what would you trade for the peaceful nights you once knew?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Long time no see. Oh no, did my weapon take your seat on the sofa...? A pity I was here first. What happened on the Carnival stage, you ask? Why so curious?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Bah. What a bore!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I refuse. I don't think Rhodes Island could throw a decent Carnival, even if we put a mask on each and every one of you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Are you trying to placate me? Or do you think the game isn't fun enough...? I just can't see through you. No wonder I find your trust so entertaining!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Where stand the wilds? Where stand the cities?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: A wolfpack I am.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Ah, the parade's here.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The mad lead the blind! Hahahaha! 'Tis no wonder they never tire!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: The show hasn't started, and this place is already such a riot!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Look, Zaaro! See the game we humans are born playing—

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Your weapons are right at your fingertips, why wait?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: No need to cover up! If secrets go public, then everybody is in the game!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: What should I do? I knew who you were right away.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: What are you waiting for? The curtains are about to fall!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The spotlight shines on us. Hahahaha!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Do not disappoint tonight, my friends.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: A grand spectacle, a perfect show, a dignified exit. Bravo, Bravo… But I won't applaud, not without an accident befalling the act, haha.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Work's over, time for a drink. Where is Texas?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Come gawp at those whose masks have fallen. Some carefree, struck with panic. Some let loose, so free and manic! Oh, what fun to prowl this ball!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Defeat? Hahahaha. That's just the end of Act One.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's quiet in here—not afraid to miss the excitement outside?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Haha... is this how you greet Texas too?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Come here! Dance with the wolves.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! You're inviting me in? How will you introduce me? Texas's archenemy, the Saluzzo traitor, or the white wolf who would conquer all? Hahahaha... Enjoy the evening, Doctor. For tomorrow, the twin moons shall rise for the hunt... like always.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Here's a Carnival costume. Put it on.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: One birthday, my father brought me to tour a vineyard in bloom. I wondered why there was no monstrous vehicle to run it down to ruin, along with the whole of Siracu— What? No, I bought this bottle of wine off some random shelf. That manor became a trash heap long ago.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Hah, the things you and the Rhodes Islanders do are quite interesting indeed. Siracusa, no, everywhere of this land is a filthy swamp, yet Rhodes Island manages to hold on still. Is it because you're so adaptable, or... did you have a hand in writing the rules of the game?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, since you've decided to join our voyage, you'll need to contribute. Think you can handle steering the ship? Here's the wheel: turn right to go right, turn left to go left. Clear? Very good. Let's set sail. Joking? No, I'm dead serious.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Here's your hammock, Doctor. The seas have been gentle these past two days, rocking like a cradle. But when the wind rises and waves swell, sleep won't come so easily. So I've brought you this bucket, use it if seasickness strikes. Just be sure to aim well; our cleaning crew won't take kindly to a messy deck.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, I'll be occupied with my alchemical research. Can you helm the ship in my absence? No, not a word to the crew. My last experiment, while successful in improving engine efficiency, left our hull compromised. The crew wasn't pleased. At the celebration banquet that followed... They voted to hang me from the mast the entire night.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: These silvery liquid orbs, 'Corazonix', now form my right arm. They convey to me the movement of all things: the wind, the waves, fin-schools... and even the subtle currents of blood within the human body. That sensation... is as if I am merging with the very pulse of all existence.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: People forge connections by accepting fragments of others into themselves. That's what my maestro once said. He came from the Church of the Deep, so I initially misinterpreted his words. But in truth, his meaning was profound: we enter life as hollow vessels; we are incomplete until shaped by communication and shared understanding.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: In the past, I could only answer your questions about Iberia through second-hand stories. The glory of its past and the desolation of its present have never stirred any sense of belonging in me—Rather, its future is what I yearn to shape. With this ship as my lodestar, I shall forge my own narrative for Iberia.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: We're about to run out of provisions, so I'm taking the dinghy out to go fincatching. Care to join me, Doctor? Use a fishing rod? No, too inefficient. It's better to dive straight into the ocean, and hurl fins aboard with Destreza. Not a swing wasted.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The ship's now entering the eye of the storm! Hard to port! Steady, sailors! Don't panic, Doctor. I hold these raging tides in the palm of my hand. I promise you won't be swept overboard. Oh, sorry. Didn't expect you to get all soaked…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Oh, Doctor. How did you find this sanctuary? Me...? When the crew gets too rowdy, I retreat here for some peace and quiet. Isn't it strange? Out here, where the only sound is the wind and the waves, I somehow hear the echoes of voices from Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Asleep already? I never expected you to adapt to the rocking waves so quickly... Though, I've heard that people find rest where they feel secure.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, welcome to la Cuna de Nene. I... am her captain. Ahem... The name wasn't my idea. We let the First Mate's pet draw the name stripes.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Is this footage from my previous missions? You actually brought it aboard... That move was full of openings. It clearly wasn't properly calculated.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A gift to celebrate my promotion to captain? That happened a long time ago, though. Why bring it up now, Doctor?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Congratulations, Doctor. In recognition of your exceptional service aboard, and the profound bond you've forged with the First Mate's pet, the crew and I have voted unanimously to promote you to the distinguished rank of Senior Groomer.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Doctor, take the helm for now. This will be a tough battle, and my crew needs me to fight shoulder-to-shoulder with them.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Give me your orders like before, Doctor. I will follow them.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Hoist the flag, sailors! Tell the enemies, we are here.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Starboard stern, batteries ready! All hands, prepare to fire!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I can hold here myself. I know what to do.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Please help me, Doctor.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Once the wind fills our sails, it's time to act.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I hear the waves drumming against the hull. They herald our victory.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Probes, functional. Corazonix... Good to go.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Clear images... Hmph, check the data.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Not bad... Reasonable data. Try processing it.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Is it correct? Or not quite... Whatever, let's have a go.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: A truly resounding victory. Let us bask in the cheers of this moment.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What we just encountered is but a minor hiccup before lengthy voyage. Cheer up, Doctor. Far greater trials await us ahead.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: There's no need to pursue a spent force. Let's return to the ship.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Turn downwind and set full sail! We must get clear of this region immediately!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Why the surprised look? Even a captain isn't exempt from cleaning duties. Could you pass me the mop? I need to finish before dark. Thanks, Doctor.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: They sense you coming, Doctor.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: My braid's come undone, will you help me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Seeing how ecstatic the crew is tonight, I doubt the rum in our hold will last through the night. Oh, I must remind you, Doctor. When the revelry begins, keep clear of the railings. We can't risk a tipsy Doctor going overboard. Ah, why am I even concerned...? Ahem, just, uh, trust me on this one.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. We are sailing towards the rising sun.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Today's your birthday, Doctor? After drifting on the seas for so long, my chronometer might be a bit fuzzy, despite my best efforts to keep it calibrated. Ah, look, migrating fins swimming beneath our hull... Fascinating, isn't it? Individually distinct, yet moving in such sublime harmony.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Back then, Doctor, I was still aboard YOUR ship... I once considered dropping the anchor, ending my life of wandering, to settle on Rhodes Island. But no one can stay in one place forever, and every journey has its end. What truly matters is that we have each other in this moment.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hey, leader! Got some work for us?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Leader, how about we throw a party? We can play some hip-hop and eat apple pie. The best life is the party life! No party, no life!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Locked and loaded, ready for action! What's the objective today, Leader?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Some people believe money can buy anything. But, uh-uh, that saying doesn't really apply to me. Wealth won't make a lick of difference to where my targets end up.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My first wish: more guns! We angels all have a patron firearm, a special gun we grow up with, but owning just one gun is kinda lame. I want eight more!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My second wish: get someone to turn off this light over my head!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I've always got Texas covered, that's why she lives so carefree. So obvious it goes without saying, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: If you ever run into an angel with black horns oozing ominous vibes, please tell her for me: I've never forgotten her.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Us Penguin Logistics girls ain't so bad, right? What do you say, leader? Wanna come be our boss? Hehe, just kidding.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh Lord… is this another soul for us to save?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Password: 'Long live the Penguin Empire.' So you're the client? Call me Exusiai. I'm nothing like that Lupo ice queen. I'm always down for some fun!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I'm lovin' this feeling!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thanks for the promotion, leader.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Leader... No, savior, I swear on this gun in my hand, I will protect you until the day of reckoning.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Squad combat? I'm very familiar with that.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You've got a good eye. No one makes a better leader than me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go! Take them all by storm!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Relax, I already called dibs on the most lucrative real estate in Hell, to share with all of you.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: All right!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Is it my turn?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Follow me!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let me double their trouble.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Divine judgment!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Rock n' roll!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Barrage!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Apple pie!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Perfect! Let's keep up the momentum and charge on!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: May my hail of bullets bring you eternal peace.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Victory is a heavenly melody. Alright, let's go home and grab some beers!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Life is like a gun, sometimes it just jams. Don't get discouraged, leader, we'll get'em next time.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Wowee! I love this place!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Leader, wanna try out my weapon?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Leader! The party's about to start, Employee Performance Competition Night's over, and I'm not dead last! Here's your booze and apple pie. Let's heat ourselves up to the hip-hop beat, and set this firework tower to the sky~ Here we go! Three, two—BANG!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Sup, leader!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Leader, c'mere, c'mon! Welcome to your birthday party! Turn out the lights and blow out your candles! Oh, but remember, even as the candles go out, my halo will shine on you in the dark. Never worry that you'll lose your way—the angel's Blessings will be forever at your side.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: We are led in differing directions. But by your power and wisdom, you may guide us on our journey together. Should the soul in you that protects us be a constant, we too will open a brand new path for you by our souls of honesty and ardor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Here. I've sorted these files according to how important or urgent they are, and whatever's left, I'll—Why do you look like you don't recognize me? C'monnn... Get these done so you can send me back out there already!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Ahhh... why did the little bunny run off when she saw me? Not like I'm gonna give her an airlift hug during work hours! I've been acting weird? Hah. After everything I went through, I get so excited to see everybody, it makes me wanna—Uh? You're not going anywhere? Then... a-one-and-a-two, up you go too?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: How did you know I was researching this in my dorm? I'm trying to see how big my Arts can make the flames in this furnace, but I just can't believe—You got a tip about a fire hazard? Ahem, here's a bag of Cystymilk toffees, so *ssh* keep this a secret from Amiya, alright—Y-YOU WANT FIVE PACKS?! That's brutal! DEAL!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Let me do it, you rinse the bowls like this. It's not about making them squeaky clean, Yanese dining culture's just funny like that. Oh, there's something I really love about it, though—doesn't matter if you know your dinner mates or not, everyone sitting at one table shares the same dishes. So yap away while enjoying the same stuff, and bam! We're all friends now.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I made a few new friends on my trip to Baizao, went to a bunch of feasts, and tied up some loose ends. There's so much on this land that's unfair or unavoidable, and my work as an Elite Operator remains the same. It's got my blood boiling a little too—Oh, did I burn you? My bad!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My life's been pretty fantastical, huh? All those twists and turns and yet I survived, even ended up here at Rhodes Island—Is this what they call fate? If those accidents hadn't happened, I wouldn't be here right now—Oh, no, no, no! I prefer my life as it is, with the little bunny and you, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Right, let's go back and visit your mom. Wait, I mean visit my mom? Agh, that's even worse! Uh, Doctor? You heard all that? It's less trouble than it sounds, I'm happy to take my sister back. I just wanted to sort this out first—my messy family. I guess I'll just have to get used to it, haha.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The image I have of my dad is a silly guy around my age—subsisting on crumbs, and saving his lunch money to get some treats for his baby girl. Huh? Sounds like something I'd do? Mm...I guess, but he could be such a coward, I feel like I just wanna punch him. I'm more like my mom there.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Yeah, you're the contact listed on my ID. When the day comes, I hope you're the first to hear the news, hehe. You know every single thing I haven't said, all my unfinished business. With this, I can throw myself into battle with no regrets. Wait, how did you know—I said I dropped it somewhere!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: These sleeves are so tight, I can't stand it! Phew… Much better. *Ssh* Don't tell Leizi, or she's going to nag my ears off about disrespecting her clothes again…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ta-da, I'm back! Yep, signing with my real name this time—Gu Zhuhuang. After stashing it away for so many years, I can finally write this name out in public. I'm still the same old me though, so just call me Blaze like you used to, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Doctor, you know I've pored over these battle records, studying them inside and out, so you don't have to drag me into a watch session, you know? Wait, these are—No! Not the one where my tail caught fire! That's when I was totally green, I learned quick after that!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Phew—Gave me a fright, I thought you were gonna talk about work. So, this means you think I'd make a good Caster? Yay! That's an extra six hours of training for me now!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Yes, I accept. I know what you're up to with this whole setup. We've got an unspoken understanding, right? Uh, you're really just giving me the medal without a word?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: There's something I want to try. Send me out on a mission, Doctor!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll BLAZE the trail for you.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The flames in the furnace are jumping for joy!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Surrender now, and I can still turn down the heat.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: You know, it wasn't easy learning Originium Arts Automation either!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: My blood is boiling.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got the situation down crystal clear!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Air's burning my lungs. Temp's just right.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Step right up and taste my fireballs' power!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Triple flames, scorch the heavens! The furnace... how did the rest go? Who cares, won't affect my flames!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Daybreak? That's my boiling blood turning the horizon red!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Better run faster, before my fire swallows you whole!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I got your back, Doctor. Doesn't matter who's picking fights with who. Even bigwigs have to own up to their mistakes!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: My furnace flame will burn as long as I'm still standing!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Let's go eat! There's nothing a good meal can't resolve—my favorite Yanese saying, haha.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: If you're unsatisfied with the results, I'm ready to move out anytime.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Where did my drinks in the fridge go? I was only gone a few days!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yikes! That's cold! My skin's too hot? Your hands are practically ice!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: This furnace even has medical uses. They say it heals any illness if you smoke yourself over it every morning and night, with... what did they call it again—Aizhi? Aijiu? What is that smell?!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's just fire, wh-what's got you all so into it—Uh... Amiya, Doctor, and you guys... Fine, just don't stand too close to me, or you might get burned. One, two! Wait, I did it? So peacetime flames can look as pretty as fireworks…

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey. Gotta go train, see you later!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doc—tor—C'mon! Put more oomph into it! I'm at my limit, it's over for me—Doctor, I didn't think you were this good at arm wrestling... Huh? I let you win? No, you beat me for real, I—Yeesh, just wanted to make you happy on your birthday is all, why not just play along!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I'm only third on this year's Training Room user rankings? Who's number one—DOCTOR?! Oh, so newbies use admin login before they get their own passes. Scared me for a sec there. Wait, then who's number two? C'mon! Tell me, no way I'm losing this year too!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Leader, I left a package at your door, so remember to scan and sign for it when you manage to pull your head out of that stack of documents! Huh, weird... didn't you delegate a whole bunch of work already? How are you even busier than before?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: A—Achoo! Wut? Sheesh, my sister just texted to check if I'm good. Nah, overempathy's a pain sometimes, you know? It feels like you've been living in my head, sis. I need some personal space, you know!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Would I be sad if everyone couldn't stay together? Leader, you're overthinking it. Look at it this way: if we went our separate ways all across the lands, then I'd get to meet up with a friend anywhere I went, right? Keeps me on that logistics grind! And it's the perfect chance to throw a party!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: How come the shop's still shuttered? Ahh... the disaster repairs will take too long, and everyone's going to need time to get used to the new empathy now that the Law's changed... who knows what the future's gonna be like? Ey, is that an ice cream truck I see? Leader, quick! After it! The future? It's right there, in the new flavor we're about to try!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I always try to stay upbeat in a crowd, no matter the vibes. All the pain and sorrow stop right here with me, while I'll give out all the joy I have... Don't I get tired? Course not, I love hanging out.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Yep, I saw the Sankta 'Lord'. The Lord was talking about stuff like genesis, crisis, future... But eh, it's a whole thing, you know. Who's supposed to keep track of all that? I think the Lord's better off staying put in 'The Saints' Travels', and leaving the future for us to decide!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You found my diploma?! Yeah, I could've become an intercity network expert for the Notarial Hall, or maybe a mobile confessional designer, if I hadn't run off. Do I have any regrets? Duh! But dwelling on them is pointless. If I hadn't joined Penguin Logistics or met you—Nope, not thinking about it!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I didn't expect the halo to light up again after all that. Does it mean our Law and faith had nothing to do with it the whole time? I don't really get it, and we're stuck with it either way. There're no streetlights on our little path, so without the halo, we'd be smacking right into utility poles.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You're asking what's so fun about sitting alone in a confessional? There's oodles of fun to be had, like a maple bar in my hand, the breeze blowing in from outside, the sun shining from on high, it's perfect! Of course, there's you popping up all of a sudden. Even if you're barging in on my private moment, turns out I'm still glad you came to say hi.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Lord, please bless the Leader with a long and wonderful dream, and let that dream... come true some day.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Long time no see, Leader! Radiant as ever, aren't you? If you've got anything that needs delivering in Laterano, you come straight to me!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Relax, Leader. I'm going to one-up my lame old performances in these battle records.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Giving me such a long list? Hmm... I'm not worried about finishing it, of course. I'm worried I might do such a good job that you'll drop all your delivery work on me next time, you know?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Leader, I can tell how important this thing is to you, so I swear on this gun in my hand, it'll reach its destination safely.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Relax, Leader. I'll make sure your package gets there intact. That's not what you're worried about? Oh... I get it now. Whatever you want blown up, I'll wipe it off the face of this land.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't worry, just follow me and you'll never get lost, there's no place in Laterano I haven't blown up at least once... Why the face, Leader? It's easier to understand something once you crack it open for a look-see, right?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Need some lighting? All good, this light on my head will illuminate the path ahead... long as it doesn't die out. I don't think it will. Probably.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Get in line for my bullet buffet—!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I knew you'd come straight to me, Leader!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Uh... maybe you didn't come straight to me, but don't forget to pay my fee straight away.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Real estate question: this wonderful realm or a panoramic view of hell—which did you want again?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Okaaay... this is awkward, but I'm the only one who knows how to handle the chaos I created, haha.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Divine judgment, traditional!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Rock n' gospel!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Barrage sky-shattering!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Apple pie, with char siu!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Yes! No place is beyond reach.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Leader, don't forget to invite me out for drinks on your tab, okay!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: No biggie. Out of bullets? Get a new mag. Gun jammed? Just use another.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ahem, I'll compensate any losses suffered during delivery, so just relax.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's a little messy here... we're prepping packages to deliver—oh yeah! Leader, my hands are all full, so could you cut me some tape?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: An apple a day means seven apples a week, yay!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hey, I'm always the one making you laugh, so why don't we switch it up for New Year's? You're awfully quiet, Leader. We've fought side-by-side so many times, I'm sure you know my weak spots. Don't tell me... you don't have a clue what gets me laughing?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Express delivery for you, Leader!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Phew... I drove for two weeks plus straight, and fi... finally made it to your birthday party! Good, good, hah, this means I get to shove your face into a cake before the clock strikes twelve! So don't you hide, Leader! It's an expensive custom job, so it's not going to waste!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Going somewhere new and meeting new friends is fun and all, but going back to your usual turf to hang out with old friends is even better. Going somewhere new with old friends? Now that's the best. So, Leader, wanna go on a trip with me?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I've brought myself here in the flesh. You may stop watching my videotapes.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Ever since doing away with the suppressor on my throat, Miss.Christine has deigned to lead my vocal training, teaching me how to sing unto people's minds without damaging their psyches. You'd like to hear the results? Hm. You did once request a lullaby, which... isn't my forte. I'll need practice still.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: It never struck the Crimson Troupe just how their rejection of critique, their scorn of video, laid bare their cowardice and mediocrity. I used to avoid watching anything I performed in, such was my disgust... But perhaps it's time for a better seat. I see you holding those film tickets, Doctor; you needn't hide them. I accept your invitation.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: There are people after me. They are disenchanted and voracious, screaming in chaos, dying to find the maker for their crazèd flock. For how could Tragodia truly die? He is but one of countless graven images to fall on the steps—He and all his kind are wholes made of shards, idols formed from syncretism. As it was with that mad and lonely stage director, snobbish soul, old friend of mine.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've read that evaluation report; Dr. Folinic is suggesting I exit from the frontline for the time being. I can't maintain constant sobriety, that much is true; after years with these hallucinations for company, they are among the few friends I can count on my fingers. But I remain your assassin... Call me, and let me see to the work I know best.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Upon his followers, the troupe leader bestowed masks. Before long, I will set out in companionship to find those followers, one and all. Abandon reason and surrender to violence as they may, I will simply create, perform, and weave their dreams. Till they awaken from despair, till they can reexamine their souls in the mirror, wretched yet free, for better and for worse.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Some unfamiliar operators invited me to a 'movie night' after I reboarded, and the Vampire madame from Engineering seems somewhat soft on me too. So generous is the drama, it bathes its actors in halo even outside of the silver screen. Pardon? Rhodes Island's operators trust me on principle...? Mmm. They ought to be a little warier than that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: It is harder to resist destroying beauty than demonstrating it. It's a notion I try to stifle, but is it so simple to shake my bloodstained creative impulses? They were the one excuse in the troupe to touch on love and hate; they were a poison to tempt the audience; they are an inextricable yet unwordable part of me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I must recall—the conspiracy, the slaughter, the false performances. Does creation break me free of the shadows about me, or does it bring me closer to them? Perhaps my thirst, reignited by death, will one day finally catch fire and rage. Doctor... Witness it. Grasp it. Endorse or reject it. Do not stop it.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Close your eyes. The dark of night now shrouds your consciousness; the sharp discomfort fades. So tell me, what is it you long to see... a ship, a sea of flowers, and us... That is all you want?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Permit me to shirk our operators' curious gazes for a spell. The curtain has finally fallen on the longest play, and I need some time to reorganize my thoughts. I'm sure you understand, Doctor... Pardon? I have to sign the returnee ledger with my Wrankwood autograph?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Would that they could break free of the slaver that is Hate, what then would they do...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I've woken from a nightmare, yet I still am in the night. Would you journey with me even then, dear Doctor?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The symbol of a troupe member's honor was a medal bearing Tragodia—a sentencing to days with thought and taste imprisoned, a painful past I tried again and again to cut away. But you give me a present to delight... and I will cherish it.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The stage is set.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: To lead or to dominate—they are but a hair apart.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Alas, the scent of strife; I know it well.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Below the stage stirs not a soul.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here I perform as me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: The apron and the wings are but the same.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I am everywhere.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: The shadow beneath your feet is not your own.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The killing urge doth seize your flesh.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The burning hate doth speak your minds.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Resist me not; come to my song.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Shh... Listen.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Heeding your direction always leads so simply to ideal results. I ought to be on guard...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Stay the curtain call... the time is not yet come.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Flee... until your nightmares catch up to you again.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: If this is not the ending in your heart, then rewrite it.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: ...Could you take some of those film posters off the walls?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yes, this attire is too formal.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Once this one-act play is... roughly ready, would you like to be the first to watch?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: On and on do new days come, yet shadows squat in the crevices of bygone days, so loath to leave. Doctor, be careful, please. Don't wallow too deeply in feelings of regret, in cursing fate. Accept failure, unease, fear... and then carry on walking.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: History and murders aside, Wrankwood is a fine vacation spot.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Pierced by Originium crystal, this larynx of mine is a ruthless weapon, and proof of how the arts intoxicate me. Now that I've finally recovered my singing technique, I wonder, would you mind if... As you wish, then. Allow me to dedicate this long-overdue ballad to you. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Perhaps this sailing ship we stand on is a clear glass reflection, and Rhodes Island is but a fantasy woven by you... Yet oneiric emotions can move just as deeply as waking ones; if you believe this is all one beautiful dream, don't wake so soon.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Give those documents here. Steady diligence paves the way to grand vision. During my cultivation retreat, I would grade ninety-nine assignments for the Tianshis every day—Halt. Where do you think you're going? Are you planning to dump your work on me to loaf about like the rest of them? Very well. Ignorance of consequence is bliss.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The case is closed. I can only hope Blaze is no longer shackled by her past, though it's hard not to worry for someone with her temperament. Never mind, I am simply visiting this time around—She won't be back for another two weeks? Ahem, staying a few more days will do me no harm. If there is anything I can help with, just say the word.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I must stress that Lei Fa is neither for quick-charging batteries nor invoking rain and storm! This Tianshi garb attracts many curious questions, and I am compelled to answer them all—Repairing a burnt circuit...? Give it here. This has nothing to do with Lei Fa either! I simply have a lot of practical experience in this field.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Zuo Le has been taking on more important duties at the Sui Regulator, but he still possesses the heart of a youth. He may seem a cautious young man, but he lets emotion get the better of him at crucial moments. How is one not meant to worry...? Why are you looking at me like that? I promised my sworn sister I would look after him, so naturally I'm concerned for him—Seriously, why are you looking at me like that?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: During my studies at the Tianshi Bureaus, I would never dare to neglect my Lei Fa drills or memorization of the law. But work at the Judicial Review Office requires human interaction. I was at a loss, but I came to realize something at last: when all is said and done, what both roles seek is nothing more than the truth.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I may have shed my mandarin's robe, but I do not dwell on it. As a former enforcer of the law, I am well aware of its imperfections. There are times when swords are chipped and thunder falls silent. The law, Lei Fa, and the longsword are simply tools to punish evil and drive out wickedness. So long as the wielder is of resolute heart, there is nothing they cannot overcome.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Of course Tianshis are ordinary people, not cultivators of immortality. The Tianshi Bureaus were placed atop a mountain's peak simply for solitude's sake, allowing students to focus on their studies. Inconvenient? The Originium contraptions produced by the Chamber of Alchemy are perfectly sufficient to our daily needs. Besides, one can ride a Tianshi's Wing to the Baizao market and back in the span of a single joss stick. There's nothing inconvenient about it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You are worried. If life's challenges have left you with a weary heart, then follow me back to the Tianshi Bureaus to seclude your mind. Choose a research topic to your liking, suffer the torment of fanciful and enthusiastic Tianshis for a few years, and your heart shall be clear as crystal— To decline with such formality... Are my jokes still too serious?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I once saw a dastardly criminal who had been pronounced innocent struck by a bolt from the blue on his way home. Not far off, there was my little uncle who had no business there. I had hoped to question him, but in the end, I hid it away in my heart—Why am I telling you? Weren't we exchanging secrets?!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Do not push yourself. As a leader, you should recuperate when appropriate. A well-rested mind is an agile, observant mind. You can't finish your work? You want my help? Ridiculous! Preposterous! ...Give it here.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am here to terminate my investigation authorization with your company. And here is my new application for—'Thank goodness'? I am applying as an ordinary visitor, merely here to talk. I, Leizi of Great Yan's Tianshi Bureaus, do beg your pardon for my continued presence.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It is worth considering Originium Arts doctrine in a complex battlefield environment.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I do not grant my trust lightly, but Rhodes Island has proven itself a trustworthy organization. Do not disappoint me. Oh, I was talking over you? My apologies. Please, go ahead.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: When I first joined the Judicial Review Office, I strove to be the best in all things. I thought the higher I stood, the more I could do. And yet, it was the same thought that bade me leave. Do I regret it? No. Listen to the rumbling of the thunder. Where can its mighty roar not be heard? Where can its brilliant bolts not reach?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: When one learns from experience, the lessons never cease.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Levin crack umbra, luminate the path.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: With my blade, I decree—

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: There is no cure for the shameless.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I am here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: A fine decision.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Practice without principle is the height of folly.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Amidst lightning flash, thund'rous sword shall clash!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Five thunders, smite the wicked!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: With trine blade shall evil be excised, with righteous fulgur's strike shall demons die!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Tremble, villains! Quake, ye ghouls! For thunder roars, and heaven shakes!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: There is no flight from Heaven's bolts!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You should maintain such a high standard in future battles. You are the one who sets the standard, of course, but that does not mean you can be complacent!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You have improved. Less admonition next time? That would be complacency. I rescind my earlier praise!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew...What you need is time to clear your mind. As one of Rhodes Island's leaders, you must not make the same mistake twice. Remember this.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Stand and fight alongside me! I know you are not so easily defeated!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: My idle days must be spent on thorough study. If there are any further explosions outside my door—There won't be? Very well. I trust you.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Calm mind, tranquil heart—I shall not bicker with you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: It's only a handshake, no need to be so cautious. I haven't shocked anybody in years—Ah. Static does not count.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Fresh atmosphere brought by Spring squalls, many wills make new walls—Does this call for a little more passion? Hmm, I'll clench a fist at the end. Alright, from the top. What do you mean, 'there's no need'? Since Rhodes Island invited me to participate in the New Year's performance, I shall give my full effort!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: According to the schedule, you should not be resting here right now, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Congratulations on the anniversary of your birth. I, Leizi of the Tianshi Bureaus, offer you this device, with absolute certitude you shall put it to good use. You need only press the button—Don't point it at yourse—... Are you alright? Wake up! I was about to say you should press it when you are in danger, at which point the lightning I stored in it would be released...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I must admit, I had many reservations about Rhodes Island due to your connection with that particular case. But now, when I join you on missions, it is not for observation's sake. To aid the weak and demand justice are not such different goals. May our collaboration continue on.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Just like old times, Doctor. You're safe with me around.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: New weapons? Nope, Hannya just got reforged, and I shared a connection with this blade from early on. I prefer old-school stuff for everything, except my bike—though I do keep my retired rides all nice and clean in the garage.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: One time I showed up to work with this outfit on, and Lungmen's triads were especially well-behaved that day. Too bad Missy ordered me to switch back after the L.G.D. hotline got flooded with residents asking us to handle an 'Unidentified Dangerous Individual'... what a shame.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Monks talk of 'Prajna' as a transcendent wisdom beyond mortal comprehension, but the Higashinese are more familiar with 'Hannya', the angry face on this shield. Being born in Higashi as an Oni is already lucky enough for a Sarkaz, but who can say how many of us seek liberation, or die in battle?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Kyoukaku? Xiá? Sure, your gallant swordsmen dedicated to lofty moral codes, you hear about them in Higashi's Chuushingura and Yan's wuxia tales, but I'm not the type at all. Those are vigilantes, going against the law with violence; and once you have law enforcement turning into vigilantes, or a vigilante with no choice but to join hands with the police, then everything will—Yeah, stuff's been messed up for a long, long time.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Yeah, I chose Lungmen in the end. After so many years, I'd long stopped expecting Mitsukue sake to take like it used to. But I never imagined it'd distill itself into tastelessness. All we got left is straight paint thinner. Booze like that, I don't drink.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I took Missy to dinner after she got back from Siesta. It was before she got sworn in, so imagine how red her face was when I let a 'Commissioner' slip out—Oh, Commissioner Swire! What an honor to have you grace Rhodes Island!—Ow! Milady—I mean, Missy, please, have mercy!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: In his final moments, Ah Faat asked Old Ch'en to take care of me, but she's actually the one who can't keep out of trouble. Today, I have the entire L.G.D. behind me, but her? Ugh... Promise me, Doctor, if she ever asks Rhodes Island for help, don't make a fool of her.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I don't take vows lightly. Moral values are inherently messy, and bending over backwards to do stuff for other people only adds to the horrible hotpot. But you—I trust you. I know you can tell right from wrong. I've said before I'll heed your orders, and that will always be true. You heard me, a promise is a promise.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Here, the coffee machine. I kept watching you run over to it, so I just made it easier for you. It's light enough.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Defender Operator Hoshiguma, reporting in once again—Special Inspection Unit Chief? Yup, that'll be my job title soon. Though on Rhodes I'm just Operator Hoshiguma, it's more chill for me that way.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Best I learn from you how to command others.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'll still protect you even without this medal... That said, it's an honor getting a commendation from you. Thank you very much.

lines.title: Promotion 2
