lines.text: Another medal? Enough of these stuffy things. If you really want to thank me, why not write something on Hannya's underside? I vow to you, as long as I hold the shield, your inscription will be there forever.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Mission time? Perfect, I get to stretch my legs far, far away from paperwork.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just focus on offense, no matter how the fight might go. Yup, go wild. I'll keep you all safe.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: If you're stumped, just leave the hardest task to me.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Prepare yourselves. The battlefield might get a little crazy once I make my move.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Time for me to get serious?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Don't panic, I am here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Where's their most annoying guy? I'll take him down.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Where's the most dangerous spot? Send me there.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Decided what to carve on your graves yet?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Not scared? You've got guts, but that might be all you've got.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You're not the one I'm looking for. Move.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: …What a pity.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: ...Just like all those years ago? No, I'm following your orders this time, so no regrets on my end.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Don't bother checking the battlefield again. I saw every enemy off myself.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Call it a day here? Hold on, I haven't had my fun yet, so I need to blow off some steam—Phew... So? I seem less scary now, right?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't worry, they'll stay clear of you as long as I'm around. See you in a bit, once I'm done with them.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Here I am, Doctor. Huh? Oh, I've spent so much time here, it's muscle memory for me to duck my head.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What was that?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Careful, my horn's pretty sharp too.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, here's a bike I got for you. Give it a spin. Why did I get it? Uh, the ad was really cool, and they told me they had a New Year sale too... right, so you accelerate here, and this one... wait—Doctor?! Slow down! The bike's out of control!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Want a glass? It's just mint tea. C'mon, you think I'm the type to grab a drink at this hour?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Only for your birthday, Doctor, will I follow you anywhere, no matter how dangerous or silly it gets, even if you take full responsibility for the risks. So, figured out where you wanna go yet?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I hate how time has taken people away from me, but on the other hand, everyone still with me is precious, and that includes you... so before time washes everything away, why not chill with me here for a bit, Doctor?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Your time and sanity should be left to more consequential matters. Surely you can find someone suitable to handle these trifles in your stead? Very well. For you, I shall happily serve.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Gnosis and Degenbrecher have taken over my Karlan Trade duties. Since this was not what I originally promised for their careers, they understandably have some complaints. There is not always a clean boundary between method and aim, but when I used this sword of mine to cleave the bridges behind me, I saw it, clear as day.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: When I was surveying the land to find a suitable site for the observation station, I already understood the sight of it would attract numerous gazes. In this era of radical change, those timid conservatives and ignorant opportunists will meet similar fates in the dustheap. But I, SilverAsh, must ensure Kjerag is never again left behind by the times.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I've met with the Speaker, yes. Those of similar ideals face similar issues, perhaps even similar… kin? When Father left for Victoria, he would never have imagined a future where that nation was to be our enemy. It was indeed a simpler time, one to which we may never return.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Those who seek power out of cowardice shall find nothing at the apex of authority. As for me? My friends and enemies both ensure I am unlikely to forget the importance of how I conduct myself. But I am dearly looking forward to the day I take the final step towards the peak, and find myself standing opposed to you.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Kjerag seeks to build ever-greater institutions, but we shall not stand tall among the nations because of them. When we faced a true crisis, I began to believe in the strength inherent in the people of the Snow Realm. I must admit, Enya is right. It is not that I do not care for faith. I have simply long since found a belief of my own.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There is no such thing as a chessboard without uncertainty. In a sense, every move we make is a gamble. Only when maximizing one's odds of success do one's wits come into play. Ah, the burdenbeast I bet on crossed the line first. According to custom, you are to down your glass.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Ensia cherishes her friendship with you. Asking you to take care of her was, at the time, a somewhat unreasonable request of mine, but now I see that there could not have been a better choice. Let us not speak of the barriers between her and me. Rather than reaching any so-called understanding, I would much rather see which peak she decides to conquer next.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ohh? You are worried. Those in power cannot take the weight of responsibility lightly, but neither can they allow it to hold them back. At times, you need only make decisions, then entrust the rest to others. There is nothing simpler, yet more difficult. A lonely life? No, though I do look forward to having an opponent who could stand shoulder-to-shoulder with me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: …The snowfall hath relented. Let us go for a walk outside.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: It has been quite a while. The land teems with misfortune, but neither Kjerag nor Rhodes Island have fallen to the floor just yet. Are you ready? I believe we can re-establish our old rapport rather quickly. I, SilverAsh, have joined your cause as a sworn ally.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I have always found Rhodes Island's methods quite… refreshing.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: When you accepted my proposal, did you not suspect Rhodes Island was becoming part of my schemes? Then again, you rather enjoy this sort of challenge.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: How shall this cooperation of ours end? Will the two of us conquer all of Terra together, or will we face each other across a board near-finished, our conflict inexorable? No matter where the dice may fall, we await the outcome with bated breath.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I have learned some new tricks, since the last battle.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: They shall learn whom they face.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: How nostalgic…

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The outcome has already been decided. They simply cannot see it yet.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Great minds think alike.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Make your decision, fast.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: The situation is crystal clear.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Everything is under control.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hark! Ne'er hast thou questioned the road thou'st strayed upon.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Thy trampling of this hallowed ground shall beget bitter rue.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Wait, for the snow shall bury this all…

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: …As ice yields to gentle warmth's embrace.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Has this battle left you unsatisfied? I eagerly anticipate seeing you dictate the flow of an even grander chessboard.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: An astonishing result. And here I thought myself inured to you bringing home victory.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Am I to believe you did this intentionally…?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ultimate victory will not be decided by a single check. Do not miss the chessboard for the squares.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: A new beginning, yet not an unwelcome one.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: If you are ever in the mood for some chess, I shall be happy to oblige.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: …I am awake.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Enya is very happy aboard Rhodes Island. With Ensia to accompany her, I daresay it might be the happiest time of her life… I shall avoid intruding upon them. I will say, you are the only one who could make such a suggestion without crossing a line. Let us head out to enjoy the snow. Happy New Year, my ally.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You haven't weathered one bit, my friend.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: A meeting between Karlan Trade and the General Chamber of Commerce? You are frightfully knowledgeable about my schedule. But it is clear that today, I, SilverAsh, have much more important plans. There is no doubt you are worth a blemish or two upon the Silverash name. Happy birthday, my ally. How do you wish to spend the day?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island's cause will reshape the fabric of this land. This point may be beyond the comprehension of most, but I am not most men. I believe we have both heard our fair share of similar comments, but remember: those who truly have the ability to change this land are often those arrogant and conceited enough to think themselves able to do so.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Serve as your assistant…? Hm, from what I have seen, there is not much difference between administrative work and organizing the scriptures of the Vine-Bead Court. I know how to do it, but… are you sure there are not more important things for me to do?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: During my days at the Vine-Bead Court I would clamber up and down ladders to consult ancient records and scripture as thick and heavy as bricks. Based on past Saintess selections, the girl who is to become Saintess must have a strong, healthy body. Hm, I believe I've figured out the reasoning behind these traditions.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hm? Oh, this? This is something I knitted for Ensia's birthday in my spare time. It's like when I was little, Father and I would knit new cloaks or scarves for the entire family every three years… I know what you want to ask, but please don't.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Why do foreign envoys still believe Kjerag to be a land of spirits and sprites…? Hmph, it leaves me no choice but to meet their expectations, and take on a most fearsome form. 'If you do not wish to be snatched away by the Tschäggättä, then you must show some sincerity.' That will make them good little ambassadors who sign our agreements.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: What is a miracle, you ask? Hm, who knows? Perhaps a gust of night wind, or a beautiful rainbow, so long as it inspires the devout and puts fear into the heart of sinners. When you feel troubled and know not what to do, pray, and the divine in your heart shall give you strength.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: It is not that Kjeragandr taught us virtue, but that She is made manifest through the virtue in our hearts. So too does all sloth and sin find release through this understanding. She shall not scold you, for recognizing oneself is a difficult thing, and She will always show a path through the wind and snow for her children.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There aren't enough funds for dormitory maintenance? Allow me to make a donation in the name of the Vine-Bead Court. The funds shall come from the personal account of the president of Karlan Trade—ah, no, no need for that. The medical support Rhodes Island has given the people of Kjerag is plain for all to see. Sir Enciodes won't utter a single complaint.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You'd like to help me comb my hair? Nmph… it wouldn't be an easy job. If it weren't for Kjarr and the other maids, I don't know how much time I'd have to spend each day caring for it. I've considered cutting it short, but I understand some of the people would be sad if I did, so…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: 'Merciful Kjeragandr'… She has clearly run off to that snowy mountain to fool about… Perhaps once Her spirit has recovered, She will awaken once more. How will Kjerag have changed in that time? If there really are gods, then please, help her find a way back home.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hm? Documents that need to be signed? Err… The Doctor is currently in an emergency meeting, would it be alright if these got back to you later? Alright, I shall pass them on for you… *phew* Getting an afternoon nap is no small task for Dr. {@nickname}.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Amidst the undying winds of the Snow Realm and the unending fall of snow, Pramanix of Kjerag now stands before you… How's that for a preamble? Now let me in already, we'll have plenty of time for greetings later.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: 'When in snow, seek the footprints of those heading forward'. This is the simple wisdom of Kjeragandr.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: No, no more gifts or ornaments, please. A Saintess's garb is heavy enough as it is. You want me to feel light and breezy, don't you?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: 'Of what has been gained, renounce it all. Of what has been lost, forget it all. We need only strive for truth and question ourselves, and in the end, we shall return to Her embrace.'

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Victory belongs to the faithful.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I shall guide you in Her stead.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: May the unclean be purified, and the blizzards dispersed.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You shall go no further…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: She is omnipresent.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: She cannot be sought.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Hear Her words.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Pray with all your heart.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Cold winds care not for whom they chill.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Ice and snow know not mercy.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Behold the power the mountains pledged to me.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Your struggles are feeble.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Karlan has witnessed this victory. O warriors clad in frost and gale, let us return home.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: 'After hard work comes a good night's rest.' The Saintess decrees it so.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: …In the end, our gain is greater than our loss. Before the snow hides their footprints, we must discern which bad habits it is time to let go.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: …The snow shall cover our tracks, and grant us the chance to return.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Have you widened this place since last time?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: 'Kjeragandr on high, smite those who play pranks by depriving them of snacks with their afternoon tea.'

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Here, a pat on the head… A blessing? No, this is not the Saintess's blessing, but Pramanix's. It is, in a sense, the rarer of the two.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Old Kjerag custom dictates that I spend the entire night atop Mount Karlan praying for Kjeragandr's blessings, but… It's a rare day off for me, so let's not speak of work today, shall we? Hm?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: The same arrangement as last time. You don't tell anyone I'm here, and you provide me with a blanket… Oh, this one's my favorite. You actually remembered…? Haha… It's like we're of one mind, when it comes to sneaking away for a nap.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I expect the gifts you receive will be enough to fill a small dormitory, so… Hold out your hand. The first snowflake to descend upon Rhodes Island shall fall into your palm. Before it melts away, it shall be my gift to you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The snow atop the Matterhorn's peak did not fall in a single day. The road ahead is much the same. Rhodes Island has been following this path for so long, what could possibly be left to bar your way? Forge ahead. My blessing shall be with you forevermore.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm used to being your assistant, so I bet I can take care of any work you throw at me. But don't you pile everything on me just because I said that!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: It's so much easier working at Rhodes Island than the observation station. You have no idea how busy things get there! Not only do I have to pull all-nighters, but everyone's always coming to me for help. They even said they'd push for me to become a section director… You think I'll make a good director? Hehe, it's still too early for me to think about that.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Kjerag? I like the place. Everyone there takes really good care of me. When I was testing Originium samples with my local assistants, they all suddenly bowed their heads in unison. It kind of freaked me out, and it wasn't until later that I found out they were praying to Kjeragandr for me and the experiment.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My coworkers at Rhine Lab like to tell our new staff how I used to be, half-jokingly. Stuff like how I insisted on recording data even during a liquid Originium leak, but that 'just because something is dangerous doesn't mean it's important.' Gotta say, I'm actually pretty miffed about that. Whether it was actually important or not is something we'll have to wait for the future to find out.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Pramanix's a really good friend. I doubt I'll ever revere Kjeragandr as much as she does, or anyone from Kjerag, but I can feel just how crystal clear and resilient their minds are. For real, this is god's presence.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: There was a researcher in Kjerag who told me he's afraid of new discoveries now, because of how they always shatter the framework of current science. I know not everyone who believes in science looks forward to its changes, but me? I always love seeing the new possibilities.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Not long ago, my parents sent my sister a long letter and a whole bunch of goodies from our hometown, meant for me. I may not have made up my mind yet, but… Doctor, do you have any gift ideas for old-fashioned types?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hm… Oh, hey, Doctor. This is an astrological star chart I got from Sia. I wanted to make some adjustments based on the observation data I got at Kjerag… Since when have I been interested in astrology, you ask? This too, is a field that those who walked before us explored. It may be riddled with errors, but that doesn't mean it's completely devoid of value.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: In Kjerag, I witnessed a power that I couldn't comprehend for the first time. The further I walk down this path of science, the more I am pushing the boundaries of the unknown... Don't worry. I respect all explanations for the unknown, and I know I will one day demystify it.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Huh? Is the Doctor asleep? Then I guess I'll take the chance to get a nap in, too.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: It's great to see you again, Doctor. I reviewed my time onboard and my workflow at Rhodes Island. I'm pretty confident I can handle anything that comes my way. Hm? You've always been satisfied with my work? Hehe…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: There's still room for improvement. Looks like I will have plenty to do once I get back.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Huh, still the same medals as before. So pretty.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Nothing exists independently of us. Rather, we observe and change everything. That's why I believe in science.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Long time no see, everybody. Time to work together again.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: 'Switching firing position!'… Got everything memorized. We'll be fine.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't worry. I know our departure time.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: In position to engage the enemy. Ready your weapons.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yep, I'm here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Same tactics as before?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: In position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll do my best!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I convey my starlight to the darkness.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I have charge of this sector.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I will stop you.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: There is no limit to the power that mankind may realize.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Incredible commanding, Doctor! Hm? My performance is incredible, too? That's giving me too much credit. I came prepared, that's all.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A victory meeting expectations after careful planning. Now we can all relax.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Huh? This variable…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Oh, don't worry. Once we identify the source of the problem, we'll get this taken care of, easy.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Let me set my alarm.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whoa?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Don't let anybody know I'm slacking off—wait, you didn't know? Drat...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hello Doctor. The lab's too suffocating, so I came out here for a little fresh air. Are you here for a break, too? Hm? Happy New Year? Wait, is it past midnight already?! I was gonna head out with Sia and get some snacks… Oh well, it can wait. Happy New Year, Doctor!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor. Do you have time to come to the lab and check out my latest breakthrough?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy Birthday! I have a present for you—a planetarium I made myself, by hand! When I was a kid, my parents wouldn't let me make them, and it took me so much work just to fix one myself. Come, switch off the lamp and check this out. It even lights up! You think it's a little cliché? Come on, Doctor. Don't say that, even as a joke.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Anything that mankind can gain from these stacks of paper pales in comparison to the reality offered by planting your feet on the ground or gazing up at the stars. I look forward to witnessing more miracles in the mists of the unknown… both at Rhine Lab… and at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: 任命助理
lines.text: 今天的工作一如既往地多，博士。别担心，我会和你一起处理。

lines.title: 交谈1
lines.text: 这会儿，组里那帮人肯定又给我闹出了一些岔子。算了，每天不这么闹一下，我反而不习惯。而且，没有那帮吵闹的家伙，也没法衬托宁静生活的珍贵——我知道，这么安慰自己我会好过一点。

lines.title: 交谈2
lines.text: 最近许多人都说，我换了一身衣服之后，给人的感觉都变了。虽然原因其实在别的方面，不过这样也不坏。说起来，换装确实能够改变形象，博士要不要也试试？我可以免费帮你设计。

lines.title: 交谈3
lines.text: 春天的时候，我打算带组里的人一起去一趟东国，去看看那里的竹林。那里当然不会有一个叫“泡影国”的国家，只是，我有些怀念风吹过竹叶发出的声音了。

lines.title: 晋升后交谈1
lines.text: 仔细想想，这帮人虽然天天惹事，但是交给他们的工作在磨磨蹭蹭之后还是都完成了，好像也没必要苛责他们什么……不行，不能对他们太好。斑点，这份报告太潦草了，给我重写！

lines.title: 晋升后交谈2
lines.text: 泡普卡，怎么了？……月见夜和斑点又偷偷去训练了？我知道。大概是因为我和空爆最近训练比较多，让他们有了些危机感吧。唉，死要面子。不过，我可不管，走吧，去给他们送点夜宵。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈1
lines.text: 我在想，凯尔希医生一开始让我担任A6的队长，是不是因为看穿了我的性格，知道我无论嘴上怎么说，实际上还是没法放着身边的人不管。我还挺好懂的？呵，博士，这堆文件你自己看着办吧。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈2
lines.text: 月见夜对待许多事情都很严肃，空爆会为了喜欢的东西倾注所有心血，斑点有他的骄傲，泡普卡懂事又能干。我总觉得，他们的这些优点应该被更多人看到，但或许，只有我知道也足够了。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈3
lines.text: 博士要尝尝吗？这是他们做的蛋糕。我吃过了，以初学者的水平来说，还不错，也不知道他们什么时候偷偷学的这一手。我总是说，A6不可能一直存在，但我甚至都要忘了我们在一起几年了。

lines.title: 闲置
lines.text: 博士也是个随性的人呢，算了，反正博士没什么需要我操心的。

lines.title: 干员报到
lines.text: 我征服了异国的国王和将军，最后带领队伍战胜了超级怪物？啧，空爆，你给我等着。不，也不能说她在胡扯，只是，唉，该从哪里说起呢……

lines.title: 观看作战记录
lines.text: 糟了，我之前保存的弓的教学视频哪儿去了？！

lines.title: 精英化晋升1
lines.text: 杜宾说我最近去训练场比以前频繁了？……不，只是练习使用弓需要全神贯注，所以我可以强迫自己不去想一些有的没的。

lines.title: 精英化晋升2
lines.text: 比起利用武器跟野兽战斗，我还是更喜欢拿起笔跟文件战斗。唉，人生总是无法事事如意。不过至少，我最近画设计图越来越顺畅了，也算一件好事吧。

lines.title: 编入队伍
lines.text: 我已经读过任务简报了，交给我吧。

lines.title: 任命队长
lines.text: 那么，由我来布置作战任务。

lines.title: 行动出发
lines.text: 我已经确认过后勤物资了，没有问题，出发吧。

lines.title: 行动开始
lines.text: 按照计划执行任务吧，没必要慌张。

lines.title: 选中干员1
lines.text: 要开作战会议吗？

lines.title: 选中干员2
lines.text: 我有一些想法，聊一聊？

lines.title: 部署1
lines.text: 对方的弱点，我已经看出来了。

lines.title: 部署2
lines.text: 快点结束吧，回去还有许多事要做。

lines.title: 作战中1
lines.text: 翔虫，拜托你了。

lines.title: 作战中2
lines.text: 暂时忘掉工作上的事……

lines.title: 作战中3
lines.text: 将精神集中在眼前……

lines.title: 作战中4
lines.text: 为了应对这种情况，我早就做了准备。

lines.title: 完成高难行动
lines.text: 每次完成这样的任务之后，我都会想，这种挑战并不适合我。对我来说，能够守住自己的一方天地就足够了。

lines.title: 3星结束行动
lines.text: 清点损失，报告伤员……博士，这些麻烦事就交给我吧，我也算是这方面的专家了。

lines.title: 非3星结束行动
lines.text: 博士，别担心，我们的损失很小，还能继续追击。

lines.title: 行动失败
lines.text: 果然我还是不擅长战斗这种事情啊。

lines.title: 进驻设施
lines.text: 这里的吵闹我也已经习惯了。

lines.title: 戳一下
lines.text: 等一下，别拉我的袖子！

lines.title: 信赖触摸
lines.text: 博士，今天的工作到此为止，下班！

lines.title: 标题
lines.text: 明日方舟。

lines.title: 新年祝福
lines.text: 泡普卡，为什么你变成了一棵树？月见夜，这座香槟塔又是哪来的？空爆，这是新年聚会，不是战利品展览会！还有斑点，求你别用投影仪播放漫画了——我错了，我不该答应让你们自己布置场地的。

lines.title: 问候
lines.text: 博士，有什么事需要我帮忙吗？

lines.title: 生日
lines.text: 生日快乐，博士，我给你缝了一个护身符，里面放了一小块我从“泡影国”带回来的“火竹炭”。把你的生日愿望写下来，放进护身符里，说不定就会实现哦？

lines.title: 周年庆典
lines.text: 我的过去没什么好事，来到罗德岛，遇到A6小队算一件。某种看不清摸不着，但确实存在的东西把我们联结在了一起。我总说我们有一天肯定会分离，但最离不开这个小队的人，说不定是我自己。

lines.title: 任命助理
lines.text: 让我们充满活力地开始工作吧！——虽然我想这么说，不过，还是老样子，先玩会儿游戏吧。

lines.title: 交谈1
lines.text: 糟了，我感觉现在没法面对月见夜了。我以前只觉得看他搭讪失败很有趣，现在，我知道他其实是个很认真的人之后，就觉得……超级好笑，根本忍不住！什么，你早就知道了？嘁，没劲。

lines.title: 交谈2
lines.text: 我们认识的斑点，其实没有完全发挥他的潜力，他只要努力一下，说不定能造出和罗德岛一样厉害的大家伙呢。所以，我们一起想个办法让他拿出真本事吧！哎，别走啊，我是认真的！

lines.title: 交谈3
lines.text: 我的心里现在有两个我在搏斗！猎人的我想要去狩猎，但懒惰的我不想离开沙发——这简直比和雷狼龙战斗还要艰难！梓兰姐，你快来劝劝我……随我的便？不要啊！

lines.title: 晋升后交谈1
lines.text: 你看，把剑这样插进盾里，它就会变成一把大斧！帅不帅？虽然我讨厌被当作卡西米尔的骑士，但用这把斧子逗逗这样想的人感觉也很有趣，我甚至想回去参赛玩玩了，嘿嘿。

lines.title: 晋升后交谈2
lines.text: 嗯？杜宾今天又不在？训练任务我都已经完成了，还想找她多布置些呢。试试战斗以外的课程？不行不行，那种我还是老样子，三分钟就睡过去啦。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈1
lines.text: 我嘴笨，说不上来，但是，和雷狼龙的战斗，是我第一次觉得心里有什么东西被满足了，所以，回来之后我也想找一些那样的刺激——我知道错啦，泡普卡，我不该因为这个惹你生气的。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈2
lines.text: 黑流树海、焚风热土、萨米冰原——听说这些地方有不少厉害的怪物值得挑战。不过一个人去好无聊，得想个办法拉上大伙一起。偷偷改一下梓兰姐的团建申请表好了！

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈3
lines.text: 我回来了！累死我了，沙发，我最喜欢的沙发，我要在上面躺一辈子——身上这些伤口？别在意，小伤而已。对了，狩猎的成果在仓库里，是个大家伙。我不管了，我要睡一会儿，晚安！

lines.title: 闲置
lines.text: 博士，我打磨武器的声音，是不是听着特别安心，特别催眠？要不我再多磨一会儿，让你好好睡一觉？

lines.title: 干员报到
lines.text: 博士，只是换了身装备，这种事走个过场就好了吧？那几个战斗任务的申请？别在意，只是想尝试一些新鲜事物而已啦。

lines.title: 观看作战记录
lines.text: 啊！这一招原来还能这么用！我去训练场试试！

lines.title: 精英化晋升1
lines.text: 我最近还挺努力的，杜宾肯定有夸我吧，让我看看评语！“战斗技巧的提升和心态的转变导致我行我素的问题愈发突出”……哈？！

lines.title: 精英化晋升2
lines.text: 战斗的目的、拿起武器的意义，这些事情真的有那么重要吗？好吧，我决定了！我的目标是——狩猎大地上最厉害的野兽！

lines.title: 编入队伍
lines.text: 时间到了？好嘞，我正好休息够了！出发！

lines.title: 任命队长
lines.text: 最厉害的家伙交给我，其他你们解决，没问题吧？

lines.title: 行动出发
lines.text: 等会儿，我忘了带砥石！

lines.title: 行动开始
lines.text: 虽然我讨厌战争，不过狩猎还是很有趣的，嘿嘿。

lines.title: 选中干员1
lines.text: 再等一会儿，我的肉要烤好了。

lines.title: 选中干员2
lines.text: 一起吃兔团子吗？

lines.title: 部署1
lines.text: 你们就是我的对手？还不赖嘛！

lines.title: 部署2
lines.text: 我现在精神很好，你们可要小心了！

lines.title: 作战中1
lines.text: 小翔虫，到你出场了！

lines.title: 作战中2
lines.text: 吃我变形斩！

lines.title: 作战中3
lines.text: 瓶子，没问题。充能，没问题。好，该上了！

lines.title: 作战中4
lines.text: 我的盾正在发光，知道这意味着什么吗？

lines.title: 完成高难行动
lines.text: 大丰收！瞧瞧这大家伙，赶紧带回去给大伙炫耀一下吧！

lines.title: 3星结束行动
lines.text: 哈，看到我刚才那一记完美的超高输出属性解放斩了吗？！

lines.title: 非3星结束行动
lines.text: 啧，让它给跑了。不过没事，我已经记住了它的招式，下次一定能做得更好。

lines.title: 行动失败
lines.text: 政宗，快给博士准备板车！

lines.title: 进驻设施
lines.text: 嗯~还是回家好啊。

lines.title: 戳一下
lines.text: 博士，我就知道是你。

lines.title: 信赖触摸
lines.text: 博士，下个任务去哪里？

lines.title: 标题
lines.text: 明日方舟。

lines.title: 新年祝福
lines.text: 年终自评好麻烦啊，我这一年不是在狩猎就是在玩，但要是就这么写上去，梓兰姐肯定会杀了我的。对了，我就写，“在自我提升和集体活动参与方面颇有建树”，完美！

lines.title: 问候
lines.text: 博士，一起去狩猎吗？

lines.title: 生日
lines.text: 博士，你是不是闻到了一股肉味？你是不是觉得自己饿了，产生了幻觉？没错，你应该放下手上的工作，吃一顿烤肉庆祝你的生日——糟糕，博士，快点开窗，烤煳了烤煳了！

lines.title: 周年庆典
lines.text: 如果没有罗德岛，我多半没办法这么自由自在地活着。虽说你们肯定不需要我的道谢——啧，感觉留下这种录音也不是我的风格。总之，博士，随录音给你寄了点这次狩猎的战利品，我很快就回来了！

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: So, do you want a bodyguard, or a cop to watch you work 24/7? Just joking. I haven't forgotten how you do things here.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: It's Rhodes Island's visitor logs? Swire, Hoshiguma, and Lin too… Right, assuming they're always asking about me, but there's no way they're coming this much for—Hm. I know a lot of people are waiting for me. It's not too bad, being on someone's mind.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Worried about my health? Guess we ought to be checking up on each other, Doctor. I've been through a lot these past few years, time sure does fly. The more you experience, the easier it is to fall into confusion and helplessness. Sometimes I do need a reminder… my time is not infinite.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Oh, you've noticed my blade? I was told it can erase history's mistakes, but that's practically half of whatever's been archived in the last thousand years, and there's no way a single blade could clean that all up. Let's look to the future instead—the ideals we seek still lie ahead.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I followed her and Reunion to many places, and saw many sacrifices made. The people went from being lost and fragmented to becoming united and awakened—on that long and winding road. Many of them were left behind in the huge blaze in Deity Grypherburg, yet it was this very fire that ignited their hope.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: We're a long way from a place where everyone is treated equally, and I have no clue if I'm any nearer to this goal. But I've never doubted the equality I envision is real, for when we step up to rage against the injustice we see, we prove it exists.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I've been back to Lungmen a few times. Other than the loss of my favorite cheongfun shop, the changes are nice to see. There are fewer L.G.D. patrols on the streets, and you hear less talk of the slums… There's no lying to myself and pretending I don't care for the city.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I asked that man why my mother and sister had to suffer, and unsurprisingly, I didn't get the answer I was looking for. It's too bad Chi Xiao can't sever blood ties, and this writing knife can't scrape away recorded history either. There's no granting any forgiveness in their stead, no one is worth sacrificing for any 'greater good', ever.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When things calm down, it would be nice to take you around Yan. Not just Lungmen, and not for any investigations either. Just a trip to watch the people make something from nothing in that beautiful land. There's nowhere else like it. You won't have to pack anything either. A sword and a boat. That's all we'll need.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Need a break, but can't sleep? Yeah, you have a lot of pressure on your shoulders. Sit up straight. I'll teach you some Yanese breathing exercises.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Long time no see, Doctor. I know things have gotten pretty serious, so I'm back to lend a hand. In case you need a reminder, I'm still with Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This battle… Rhodes Island was there too?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You have a lot of people who trust in your command, and depend on you to direct them… that's important to keep in mind.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I spent a long time mastering Chi Xiao's techniques, but the answer I got was different from the lessons I was taught. Chi Xiao has seen my determination, and when you need it, it will never waver.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Doesn't feel too unfamiliar yet.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't worry, I wasn't always on my own these past few years.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Move out. I'll make sure no one gets left behind.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Suppression by force isn't an option on this field.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Fear not the power of this blade.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I know very well why I draw this sword.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll stop all evil in its tracks.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Chi Xiao, unsheath—

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: As move unsheathing blade, cleave now as cleft.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: As move at teardrop's point, once known be deft.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: As sword of stratus rent, once stood stand fast!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: As sword of heaven's plaint, bid dawn as cast.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Nicely done, Doctor… you're mistaken. That light in the sky wasn't from my swordplay.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: One day, we won't have to make right with might.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They'd best take this chance to repent.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Come on, don't lose heart over one setback.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Furnishings haven't changed. Nice.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Doctor, careful you don't poke yourself with the end of my blade.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You don't have to ask—I'm the same old Ch'en, haven't changed one bit.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I've seen many different kinds of new years. Once, I watched a group take shelter under huge Originium clusters, promising each other everything would get better while they clinked muddy cups of water together, silently waiting for the sunrise… it's nothing, Doctor. This day only comes once a year, so let's go celebrate with the others.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, you haven't changed one bit.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Perfect timing, Doctor. Here's a Bolívarian wood carving, a Victorian tea set, and an Ursine... I'm not asking you to choose, they're all for you. It's been a few years since we've seen each other, so I owe you a few birthday presents. Don't be shy. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I remember the first time I collaborated with Rhodes Island. A difficult fight, but a single Black Snake is nothing to worry about. What's scary is the countless villains out there who use despair to force people into doing their bidding. There's no winning our fights with brute force alone, so we have to keep improving ourselves.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You do know this isn't my kind of work… right?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I didn't think something this big would happen to Rhodes Island while I was away. You still hanging in there—Oh? Sounds like you never forget how I said I'd replace you. You need to keep working twice as hard, then, because I didn't forget either.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Medical decided we weren't ready when we first showed up, but this time, I brought everyone back without a scratch, and the Ursine office is all set up. I wasn't so optimistic myself, you say? Look, the job's done, so why can't I be a little happier now?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Istina gave me a new list of books to read. She says if you want to unite more people, you need to learn lots of different things, and she's right. You're just about to head to the library? Then you tell the librarian I'm still reading those dozen or so books I borrowed last time. It's slow-going, but I will return them before the due date.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Oh, this is my new weapon, took it off an absolute scumbag. Using power that's not even his to bully the weak… I get a lot of joy breaking the noses of bastards like him.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: There was a time I was gonna break up the USSG, but then I thought: it's good to have a place where everyone can relax. Hmm… Rhodes Island is kinda like that for us too.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Don't worry, we might have run into some trouble, we handled it fine. Zoya even officially joined the USSG. But Gummy has been pretty distracted lately, some thing with her parents, and we're all thinking of a way to help her… If you have any ideas, remember to tell us.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When did I start thinking about going back to Ursus? That place buried my parents, and it nearly buried us too. I used to hate… no, hide from it, but there was always going to be a point where you can't run anymore, and that's when I knew I had to get up and face it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You're like Istina, always lecturing us on grand truths before doing something stupid. Sure, I don't really listen to you two when you talk about that stuff, but I know we've always seen eye-to-eye on what is to be done. Let the truth be as grand as it wants. It doesn't matter how high the walls they built are, we'll tear them down.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'm going out for a walk. If you feel like stretching your legs, come and find me.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Here's my report: the mission to set up an office in Ursus was a success… I need to actually write a report? What a pain…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: When's the real fight?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: My medals need re-issuing? It's standard procedure? Man, if Ursine nobles were half as strict as you, I'd have never gotten out of their lockdown.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: By the way, who actually makes Rhodes Island's medals? I'm thinking of getting some with the USSG's insignia on them. The first batch goes to Istina and the rest, of course, but after that… A few extra wouldn't hurt.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Fighting is still the easiest option.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Same old, same old?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: C'mon, let's go already.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hmph, hope those scumbags are stronger than they look.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Send me where the biggest fight is.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: So, what's the plan?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Steady, everyone. I'm here.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Here I come!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Get over here, if you want to die!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Who's next?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: All for one, one for all!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Charge! CHARGE!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ah… That felt great!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was just enough for a warm-up.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Damn, they run fast…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Leave the rear to me. Don't mess things up next time.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Phew, I'm back…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You really got nothing to do, huh… Whatever, do what you want.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: It's good seeing everyone like this.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Man, Rhodes Island is so damned rowdy today… Oh, you're here. Come, try some blini. I made them with Gummy. We're heading out to mess around once we're done eating, you want to come along?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, you doing alright?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here, a leather jacket I brought back from Ursus. Think it suits you—See the USSG insignia on it? Drew it myself. What, you not happy with it, or…? Okay, that's good… Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The Self-Government Group used to just be about survival, but now that we're on Rhodes Island, we can't stop ourselves from thinking about the future… And for me, I think, when everyone is happily walking their own paths, I'll be there to make sure nobody stumbles.

lines.title: 任命助理
lines.text: 不必过分在意我的状态，我会尽快适应生理机能的些许变化，这不会妨碍我的工作。从现在开始，还是由我来担任你的全科医生。

lines.title: 交谈1
lines.text: 石棺的核心装置正维系着我的生命，短时间内我还无法脱离它而行动。谨慎对待自己的生命状态，对我来说也算是从未有过的体验。许多事物我都要重新熟悉。也许这一次，我还是会需要你的指引。

lines.title: 交谈2
lines.text: 你们在最危急的时候带领罗德岛找到了航向，阿米娅无疑已经是成熟的领袖，我也从未怀疑过可露希尔的才能与你的决策。罗德岛不会因为离开谁就无法前行，失去的一切同样造就了现在的罗德岛。

lines.title: 交谈3
lines.text: 我很高兴Mon3tr可以用这种方式融入罗德岛，虽然没有同类，但所幸还有许多人将她视作同伴。她不会忘记与我一同承担过的使命，你可以完全信任她。此后的时间里，她会陪伴你更久。

lines.title: 晋升后交谈1
lines.text: 普瑞赛斯暂时不再威胁罗德岛的安全，她将选择交给了你。源石异变撕裂了这片大地隐藏起来的旧创，如果不加以引导，绝望很可能会先于灾难毁灭我们。无论何时，文明最大的敌人都是人类本身。

lines.title: 晋升后交谈2
lines.text: 如今的你还会迷茫吗？可以让人们寻找自身意义的支点唯有生命的本性，但对我而言，是一项使命，一个承诺。我不会再质疑自己存在的意义，在旅途的尽头，名为凯尔希的个体已经找到了她自己。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈1
lines.text: 那些离别无法释怀亦无法挽回，我也不曾想过还能得到另一次的生命，我很庆幸，也很感激。我只是像做了一场梦，而你们一定经历了煎熬的等待。抱歉……你说得对，这样的离别并不公平。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈2
lines.text: 我们的交谈不会再受到限制，对现在的你来说我已经没有什么秘密。我乐意与你分享过往万年的见闻，可是那些思绪与感受恐怕难以用言语传达。好，在这些记忆淡去之前，我会尽可能讲给你听。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈3
lines.text: 我永远不会忘记有人曾与我谈论过生命与爱，我终于可以在这副躯体有限的时间里做出回应。我会耐心接受时间的磋磨，也会将立下的誓言履行下去，直到下一次，真正的死亡使我们分离。

lines.title: 闲置
lines.text: 所幸……这并不是另一个梦。

lines.title: 干员报到
lines.text: Dr.{@nickname}……？

lines.title: 观看作战记录
lines.text: 往后的状况只会更为严峻，我们应当吸取经验。

lines.title: 精英化晋升1
lines.text: 你有了很多可以信任的同伴，作为领导者，你应该习惯让他们成为助力。

lines.title: 精英化晋升2
lines.text: 你已经不再需要我的指引，而罗德岛与这片大地今后会更加需要你。不要忘记你最初的辩题，“去找到你自己”。

lines.title: 编入队伍
lines.text: 我可以参与制定急救方案。

lines.title: 任命队长
lines.text: 没有问题。

lines.title: 行动出发
lines.text: Mon3tr，不用担心，你更应该留在这里保护好博士。

lines.title: 行动开始
lines.text: 尽一切可能减少伤亡，我们需要为泰拉保留更多希望。

lines.title: 选中干员1
lines.text: 治疗准备已就绪。

lines.title: 选中干员2
lines.text: 我相信你。

lines.title: 部署1
lines.text: 全域治疗单元已部署。

lines.title: 部署2
lines.text: 安心执行计划，我会保障干员安全。

lines.title: 作战中1
lines.text: 方舟生物协议启动。

lines.title: 作战中2
lines.text: 指令：修复。

lines.title: 作战中3
lines.text: Mon3tr，我需要你保护伤员。

lines.title: 作战中4
lines.text: 不要害怕，这种力量只会用于治愈。

lines.title: 完成高难行动
lines.text: 也许我们能够看到那个属于所有人的未来。

lines.title: 3星结束行动
lines.text: 没有伤亡。

lines.title: 非3星结束行动
lines.text: 战场在变得复杂，我们无法避免计划之外的变数，但总还有补救手段。

lines.title: 行动失败
lines.text: 让其他人先撤离。Mon3tr，我需要你协助我进行善后工作。

lines.title: 进驻设施
lines.text: 和过去一样。

lines.title: 戳一下
lines.text: 不必频繁确认我的状态，这副躯体与常人无异。

lines.title: 信赖触摸
lines.text: 如果你的确很在意的话，我现在很好。

lines.title: 标题
lines.text: 明日方舟。

lines.title: 新年祝福
lines.text: 又到了这个节日，我终于能够感受到时间在我身上流逝。这并不可怕，时间因有限而珍贵，或许这样的体验才更接近普通的生命。Dr.{@nickname}，祝愿你在新的一年平安健康。

lines.title: 问候
lines.text: Dr.{@nickname}，我在。

lines.title: 生日
lines.text: 时间已经抹去了你原本所属的那个世界的痕迹，为生命计数的历法都已不复存在。所以，我更愿意用这片大地的方式为你送上祝福。我希望能让你相信，即使属于你的旅程漫长而危险，你也从不孤独。

lines.title: 周年庆典
lines.text: 罗德岛的理想已经团结了许多人，在经历了无数不堪与苦痛后，依然有人在期冀着未来。无论我们能否跨越这一切苦难，罗德岛承载的愿景始终属于整个泰拉，而它理应被铭记。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 虽然你已经不会再记得。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 这片宇宙曾孕育过辉煌的文明，在那时，知识的边界几乎等同于宇宙本身。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 人们的认知可以抵达想象的每一个角落，即使最遥远的恒星也像桌上的书籍般触手可得。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 可即便如此，人们依然无法回答关于自身的问题——

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 生命是否存在某种与生俱来的目的？

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 也许这是造物主留下的最后一道帷幕，

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 对意义的求索没有出口，生命注定在各自的旅途中走向孤独。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 哲人与学者最终放弃了从可观测的世界中寻求答案，选择将信念寄托于我们的本能。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 因为我们只能相信，在无解的孤独与困惑之外，爱的存在同样不可置疑。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 最深沉的绝望也无法阻止人们在茫茫星海中寻找自我存在的回声，

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 在寂静降临前，人们依然会为了相隔数万光年生命的痕迹而落泪。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 我想，我在旅途中终于理解了这种感动。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 生命是美丽的，在宇宙的尺度下，“生命”与“希望”等意。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 我无法将过去的记忆交还给你，只能试图与你分享我的感受。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 我会相信你的本性，也希望你可以相信自己选择的意义。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text:
你会感到无助迷茫，因为没有人可以与你永远同行，
也没有人能够理解你的孤独。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 罗德岛成为了许多人的家，

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 我希望在那个时候，罗德岛也可以成为你的归宿。

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 我的愿望是守护好你的愿望，

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 希望在这场旅程结束时，会有人陪伴你，见证你期待的未来。

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: We're changing shifts right now, Doctor. Just ignore me and get on with your work.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Back in BSW, I was appointed as a BPRS... you know, Biochemical Protection Response Staff. You can probably imagine what it was like... bulky hazmat suit and all that...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hmm? You think I'm a clean freak? Well, Doctor, I see you're unexpectedly direct! I admire your courage.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Some of the Operators' rooms are in dire need of cleaning. For example, the one belonging to that high-and-mighty teacher's pet. What do you think?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: You want to see the intricate pattern on my sword up close? Sure, hold it tight, then. Don't let go—it'll heat up to 2,500 degrees Celcius in 3 seconds! Haha, just kidding! Don't be scared!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Stay clear of that room full of chemical haze, toxins and harmful radiation... that's right, I mean Dr. Kal'tsit's lab.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You're asking me for advice regarding the prevention of biochemical contamination? Well, for example... always brush your teeth after eating?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Liskarm's been looking so flashy since she got her promotion. 'Hey! Hot girl here! Get your gunsight on me!' I bet that's how she greets the enemies.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Good golly, if this is how free life is at Rhodes Island then I might just quit my job at BSW. Liskarm would be upset, though.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: There's a mosquito on your arm, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm chemical specialist operator, Franka, here to do my bit to help minimize the pollution wrought by Originium.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I could perform these techniques anywhere, anytime!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Wooow, you're giving me a promotion? I'm having a lot more fun here than at BSW.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: *Giggle*, you want to see my sword at its most glorious? Too bad, Doctor—you're not qualified yet! If you work at it, maybe one day you'll gain the privilege!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: All right, I'm ready.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: The best thing about training capable subordinates, is that I get to let them handle all the annoying stuff for me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Well, let's go, then.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Too bad... these people have already been contaminated. In that case...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Gotta hurry!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: No time to hesitate.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Offense isn't what I trained for, but hey...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Heavy defenders are SO scary... Hehe, just kidding.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Weak spot, Sighted!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Let's burn it up!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Hold your breath now.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Tricked you!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Obsession with power is a fool's game.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was perfect from start to finish. Well done.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Just as expected.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: What, you still have time for that upset face? Fall back now.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Say, do you have black tea here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Need something?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Want to hear about my time at BSW?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Thanks for the end-of-year bonus, Doctor! It motivates me to work even harder next year. If you've got any tough missions, leave them to me! (Now to get a bonus from Blacksteel too...)

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Gooood morning, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Here's your gift, no tricks attached. Don't forget to make your wish and make it come true! You only live once, after all.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a more interesting place than Blacksteel. The medics always look like they're attending my funeral when I get a checkup. It scares me... Yeah, yeah, I know, I'll be good and listen. I have too much on my bucket list to give up now.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I'm on shift today.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Take all missions seriously: that's the guiding rule for us security professionals.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm actually not that good at dealing with people like Franka. I'm not even sure how we became partners in the first place...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: There's a strict selection process before you qualify for BSW. I'm short, have no outstanding Arts talents, and I'm not from any particularly prestigious bloodline. No one believed that I would make it... not even myself, once upon a time.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: BSW is a top security contractor and a great fit for me, I think. But I do enjoy a little more freedom here when dispatched to Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Isn't it amazing how far I've come? I feel like a real dragon... uh, ahem, forget I said that... Anyway, I'm okay with whatever as long as it helps our side in battle!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor, for trusting me this much.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: People who know me always say I'm more easygoing than I seem. Do you think so too, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Franka is telling you about our time at Blacksteel again?  Ahhh, for the love of... Just don't believe anything she says, okay?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, we're still at work...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Defender Liskarm, awaiting orders. I've been involved in multiple special operations like VIP protection, assaulting fortified positions, rescuing hostages, and clearing out threats.Your safety is my mission, and I will use every tool at my disposal to guarantee it.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Upgrade complete.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for appointing me to this position, Doctor.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor! I will devote myself to defending Rhodes Island, as your trusted Operator.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Understood. I will ask my team to rigorously adhere to the guidelines and procedures of Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Permission to attack granted.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Waiting for further instructions.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: In position.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Liskarm, ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I have a visual.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: On standby.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Thunder roar!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Thunderstorm!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: One bullet each.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Charging!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: This is nothing. Franka and I have been through much worse.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Clear. All targets down.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: All green. This area has been secured.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Emergency squad, retreat with the injured Operators! Everyone who can still fight, follow me and hold back the enemy!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is this room protected against electrical discharge?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Watch out you don't get shocked.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, is Franka still being treated? By the way, you need to rest after work.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! Doctor, Franka says the speech I had prepared before was too standardized and plain, and nobody would go out of their way to ready a New Year's greeting in advance... I don't know what I should say, in that case, so simply wishing you a Happy New Year will have to do. *ahem* Happy New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, watch out for Franka's birthday gift. Not one gift she's ever given me has been normal. A two-meter steel sword, a pair oversized paw-shaped woolly slippers... I mean, these quirky presents are clearly up to something! She must be expecting to see me make a fool of myself. Anyway, my present was picked out in earnest. Here, a solar-powered flashlight.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: And I'm done writing. I won't go wrong following this plan—by this time next year, Rhodes Island and I will have made even more notable progress. Restricted? Yes, I put editing privileges in place, or else Franka would've probably added her plans in too and made a whole mess of things.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, these are your tasks for the day. Yeah. A whole pile of work. Let's get to it.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Is Ifrit making trouble again? Sorry. I'll discipline her later.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Zzzzz… Sorry, I was taking a nap… I'm still not used to working during the day.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My reasons for quitting Rhine Lab? So much happened since I signed on, I don't even know where to start…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Have you ever heard of a woman named Saria? Like me, she was once a scientist at Rhine Lab, and she was one of the people responsible for the creation of Ifrit…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Our biology research at Rhine Lab went so far as to implant Originium Shards into living bodies… Sorry, we'd better change the subject.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Saria? You mean she's here at Rhodes Island too? Is she here for Ifrit…? After she walked out on us like that, why would she come here right now…?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I will not allow Ifrit to see Saria. Please trust me, this is for Ifrit's own good…!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Are you trying to cure Oripathy too? I heard that you were involved in the development of medical technology at Rhodes Island. Heheh… you must be looking forward to a breakthrough, as a researcher yourself.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: …Asleep already? All right. I'll handle the rest of the work.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Olivia Silence, an Originium scientist from the Rhine Lab Medical Research Institute. My hope is to rid the world of Oripathy… even if it means risking my life in the process.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I will make good use of this new power.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Is my medicine effective? Wonderful. This news brings me even greater joy than my promotion.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, I am looking forward to the day when the world is finally cured of Oripathy. In fighting and studying with you, I think that day may not be far off.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Understood. I'll focus on support.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Come on, team, let's fight with all our might.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Originium… Are you to blame for this battle?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Observe and determine the form of Infection. Such data will be useful for research.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Doctor, let me do it.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: No abnormality detected.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Concentrate.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Stay calm.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'll heal you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: No need to panic.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Deploying.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Support incoming.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: In order to defeat stronger enemies, must we make further use of Originium's power…?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Medical team, please take tissue samples from the Infected, we need to see the composition of the Infection in this area.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: All wounded personnel, please remain calm. The medical team will get to you.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: …Now is not the time for despair. We must withdraw immediately.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room… Ugh… It's like it's designed to make me sleepy!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you're kinder these days.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Have you seen Ifrit, Doctor? They're shooting off fireworks outside, so I'm a little worried… Yes, I'm going back to the lab after I put her to bed. No, I haven't forgotten what day it is. This is just how I want to welcome the new year. Oh right, happy New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good day, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, I have a proposal for your review: a new medical drone model. Oh, and I've heard it's your birthday. I didn't mean it like this, but hopefully you find it a practical gift.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: There's no lack of ambition and idealism in the field of life sciences… I myself was drawn by those ideals before I found my true calling. But thanks to Rhodes Island, I now know what I'm researching and fighting for.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Alright, Doctor, your tarot card for today is...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Would you like to learn more about your future?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Bear it in mind that excessive reliance on unfathomed power will eventually backfire on us.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Tarot cards aren't divine, all-seeing tools. Instead, we use them for guidance when we feel lost.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Destiny is like the world we walk upon—no one can escape it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Humans might never be able to escape this world... but we can change it. Our actions belie endless possibilities.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There are countless topics for which you can consult the tarot, the most common one being your luck in card games. To change it, however, you must be brave enough to change your fate first.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: We have a ritual among diviners that's all the rage these days. We call it the 'Hand of Fate.' Would you like to try it?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: It's a divination taboo to do readings concerning death. But I don't believe death is the end—it's the beginning of something new.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Dreams can often enlighten you in strange ways. If you have an enlightening dream like that, you'd best remember every detail, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Following the guidance of the arcana, our paths have finally converged. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I feel inspired now.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'd already foreseen this promotion in my crystal ball. Heheh, just kidding.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You want to know your destiny, Doctor? Too bad, I can't help you. I'm not the one to share it with you, for the fate forbids me to do so.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Wait a minute, let me predict the results of this battle.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Well then, let me pray for everyone.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Fate is a fickle thing... only the victorious will be forever revered.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I can see the outcome. Victory belongs to Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: A very wise choice.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: My turn.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Draw a card.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Do not resist your fate.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The tower of void.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The flying chariot.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The Emperor's scepter shall break.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: All will fall before the Priestess's might.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Will fate have us in a chokehold… or will we turn the table?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I have moved all of them to the graveyard.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Time to reshuffle the deck.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Impossible... this isn't what I saw in the cards...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Bad omens seem to lurk inside this room. May I use my powers to help you manage them?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm? What can I do for you?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Want me to do a reading on your future? All right, please give me a minute.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy new year, Doctor. I bet you are eager to learn your fortune this year from me, aren't you? I have, truth be told, stolen a peek into it. My divination was reliable, as always. Still, only by unveiling the fate's mask with your own hands will you discover what lies beneath, don't you agree? No need to worry, I will be there to help you.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, you're blessed by the winds of luck.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. As my birthday gift for you, I will answer any one question from you about the future. Yes, anything will be fine. I would like to remind you though, that I don't offer this kind of chance everyday, so think twice before you ask.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: There's no preordained path where one shall walk, nor predestined fate which one shall suffer. And everyone on Rhodes Island has proved that many, many times. Here, Doctor, Peek into the crystal ball. As long as your heart is not shadowed by the clouds, you will see the light of hope at the end of the haze.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor. Can I paint a portrait of you? And don't worry, I'll try not to... bring it to life. Besides, it's not like I can bring everything to life, you know.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Maybe I wasn't supposed to appear here?…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor... what color are you, reflected in my eyes?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: There are lots of fun, creative things here at Rhodes Island. I'm feeling inspired…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: See my lovely 'assistants'? Hehe… What? You think they're scary? But, but they're so cute!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Heh, so these are the colors of your soul…? Alright then, look at me. And paint me in those colors, your colors.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: That's right. Even if no one understands me, I'll keep making art. No matter what kinds of monsters my works might become…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: We artists are a unique breed… We spend at least thirty days a month stuck in a rut, thinking all our work is trash. And we only make any progress when inspiration strikes after midnight.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: In the end, the mottled world sleeps peacefully in the dark depths—Yes, that's the true color of the ocean. Black is the only color you see? Looks like I still have more to share with you…

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you... dreaming? Is the world in your dreams as colorful as the beings of this world, Doctor…?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Deepcolor, a painter. Yes, just a 'painter', nothing more.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: What's this unsettling feeling...?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Um, could you just... stop caring about me? If you keep treating me so well... I-I don't know what I might become…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor. Now, let's complete this work of art, shall we?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: You're sending me to fight? Seriously?!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I can't lead so many people.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Do your best, everyone!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Is that who we're fighting?!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What do I do?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Scumble-scumble...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Aww, I just need a minute!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: No need to rush.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Let's take it slow.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You'll have to get past my 'assistants' first.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Can you defeat my little ones?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: If you really make me mad... you won't like what happens next.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Let me sketch these triumphant heroes.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Aw, got my clothes dirty again...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: If only battles were like sketches. I'd just erase that one and redo it…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room's got a nice design.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, since we happen to have some time off, want to see my latest work?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. What colors do I see for the coming year? Hm… the aroma of food, smiling operators, and presents full of kindness… a warm, tender turmeric? It's like nothing I've ever felt. I have to get this onto a canvas.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here's a hand-drawn birthday card. Do you like it? Heheh. I have two birthdays myself, in a way. I achieved a new form, after accepting the gift. Here, Doctor, look—I created this color, but it is entirely yours.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: What day is it? Oh, of course. I see my 'assistants' are all joining in on the fun. Alright, why don't we let them make an even more beautiful piece for Rhodes Island?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You're still not done assigning tasks? I'll wait a bit longer then.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Keep calm and carry on.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Our meals used to be fairly nice in the past... but the quality's gone downhill since we joined Indra's group.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I had a dream... a dream where the sun rises, and in the distance beyond the horizon... there was my hometown. The place I might never get to return to, ever again.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Before I knew it, I'd gotten accustomed to this drifter's life... It's a strange thing. In the past I never imagined this was how I'd end up.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Gawain and company? I wouldn't say they ran into me, more like they picked me up off the streets.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I used to stand side by side with Indra's team when we fought in the streets of Victoria... Looking back, I suppose it's a fairly fond memory to me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Stay on your guard! I know you've done the best you can, but there may be unknown dangers beyond our abilities.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: If we're ever put in a tough situation... then I may well act on my own motives. And if it comes to that, Doctor, I hope you'll join me too in... no, never mind for now.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hm? You fell asleep?... I wonder if you ever dream of your hometown, too.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I've passed the strength test, right? So assign me some missions. Don't let this hammer get too bored. My codename? They call me the Siege. Curious name, but it's got a nice ring to it.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Feels pretty good.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Interesting...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Another promotion? All right, thanks... Life is strange like that, you know? Once upon a time, I was the one assigning new ranks to people.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Tell me, is this battle inevitable?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You'd better get used to my combat style.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: For want of a nail... the kingdom was lost.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Run while you can. Better to be a coward with a pulse than a martyr with a grave.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: What a pain.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: We'll take them out all at once.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: My weapon chooses its worthy wielder.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Get lost!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: A warrior must be ready to face death on the battlefield!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: My rule is the balance your lives hang in.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Can bluff, can't take one blow.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Those who refuse to surrender don't deserve mercy.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Are we done here?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm... more tired than I thought. I apologize...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Do you mind if I get my forty winks in here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Tsk...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: It's too noisy out there for my tastes... I think the silence of your office suits me more. Let me stay in here for a bit, will you?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's like I can hear an all-too-familiar chime again... I hope the new year's sun will be enough to tear through the hazy Londinium skies.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, it's you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I look back fondly on the way I used to celebrate this sort of thing with Indra and the gang. We'd drink ourselves half to death, right on the street, and make a racket to match, but that doesn't seem so appropriate now... Still, I've got some lollipops on me. Want one?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, as a leader, do you ever find yourself confused too? Do you feel the same heavy burden when your choices can impact the fates of so many? I'm not one to flee from my duty, but there is so much that requires careful consideration... I may want some guidance from you.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Truthfully, I've thought up countless possibilities about coming back here, looking out at the same scenery that she saw that day... But I never could have imagined that I'd actually be standing here with you. Heh, It's just too outrageous, 'Doctor.'

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Where'd I go? Can't tell you. Kal'tsit bypassed you and gave me a secret order... I'm lying? Oh my, I'm almost touched by how much you trust her. Fine, fine. I just went to splurge on a bunch of clothes, that's all. And I've already gone through inspection. What, are you surprised?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Some of your little cuties are always glaring at me through gritted teeth. But when are they actually gonna find the balls to pick a fight...? Kal'tsit already explained the situation? They're dealing with it? C'mon, show some respect for the needs of your staff. Just let 'em come at me. I'm bored out of my skull here anyway.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You used to like working with us mercs a whole bunch. Mercenaries are efficient instruments of war. Just like fast food, ready to eat and easily disposable. You want to know what happened in the past? Hmm, some people would prefer I keep my mouth shut about that topic. Say, it must be such a blessing to not remember anything, right?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Save the Infected? Almost all the Sarkaz in Kazdel are infected, and you haven't even seen the kinds of oppression and conflict that go on there... So, how far do you plan to go with this 'salvation'? You got Kal'tsit, who can't even protect ONE single Sarkaz. And you, a goddamned hooded amnesiac. Now, tell me, what are you gonna do?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Look at these fresh operators of yours, starry eyes, full of naïvety. Can't help but wonder, if they had to watch those kind and gentle folk die, one by one, would they still do things the same way, with the same old song and dance? Hey, I'm not trying to look down on anyone. I'm just reminding you, don't just go twisting her ideas into some stupid little joke.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Hey you, ever noticed those little thingies Amiya wears? You do know that Kal'tsit is keeping stuff from you, right? Man, I thought you were super smart and observant and good at getting everyone to trust you, considering you don't remember a thing. Honestly, it's kinda weird that you can even trust other people. Makes me wonder what those two jerks would say if they saw you like this.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: This place sure does get all kinds, huh? A lot more weirdos here than before. Oh, don't get me wrong. I don't give a shit what they're thinking. But I gotta say, Amiya's doing a pretty good job. At least she's working hard to become more like a certain someone, and I can't say I hate that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, since nobody's ever mentioned this to you before, I'm pretty curious how you'll react when you start to remember what happened— Don't give me that confused look. For now, just remember this name: Theresa. Yeah, Theresa.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Somebody's got it easy. Never thought there'd come a day when the {@nickname} would be napping here completely defenseless... The past doesn't bug you at all, huh? Sleeping like a baby…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Sarkaz mercenary, W. It's been a while, but I guess 'a while' might be something totally different for you. Aw, don't worry, the 'you' here isn't the 'you' I'm looking for. So you're safe, for now. Just for now.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This is all too familiar. Kinda scarily familiar. Be straight with me, did you really lose all your memories?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I'm listening. Didn't think you'd be this hands-on with stuff. Honestly, I'd rather snatch a medal off someone else than suffer this honor from your hand.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: It's a funny little thing that I get to fight alongside this version of you. And look, it turns out the two of us can get along. At least, until you remember what happened that day…

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Hey everybody, let's try to stay alive.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: A mercenary's leadership is about practicality. Don't expect a babysitter.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Yep. Another beautiful day.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Kill them all to finish the job, right? Not that simple? What a pain in the ass...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Roger that.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Who knows, I might sneak off somewhere.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Nice, nice, I'll take a power nap over here.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Who's gonna hit the jackpot today?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Step right up, plenty of surprises for everyone!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You've got until 'three' to surrender. THREE!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Boom! Ahahaha!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Seeing you pull a hundred and ten percent out of everyone out there… I feel the nostalgia.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Did you see that guy's face just now? The total despair when he realized he was gonna get blown to bits, no matter what he did? Wasn't that hilarious?!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You don't usually make mistakes like that. Are you getting rusty, or is there too much on your mind?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Retreat? Keep casualties to a minimum? Heh, can't believe those words are coming out of your mouth.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This door seems to be repaired, huh.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Looks like there's a lot more stuff here, but far fewer people.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: ...Which side of you is the real one?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I hardly ever see Rhodes Island this lively. I take it you guys are fine with kicking back and relaxing then? Unfortunately, I only managed to prepare a few 'surprise' gifts. You should already know what's inside, right? Don’t want any? You sure? Your loss then.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, what would you like to do for Rhodes Island today? The usual?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: It's today, isn't it? It was a cinch to get my hands on the detailed profile of Rhodes Island's 'Doctor', which means your security sucks as bad as the bombs I made when I was three years old. And look at this, it's your birthday? How many birthday songs packed full of love have you heard by now?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
