lines.text: What a merry little get-together. This how you and Kal'tsit celebrate the status quo, holding a dinner party in the safety of this place? You know who should really be seeing this? Definitely not the current you, absolutely not the current me, and sure as hell not Kal'tsit, with that perfect memory of hers.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm here to help. So? Whose ass are we kicking next?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You can't go out without permission? Что? Aren't you the one in charge? Screw the rules, let's just get out.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You said something? My headphones were on.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The leader of Rhodes Island looks younger than even Istina. How can you let a kid like that go to battle?!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Why do I stare at you all the time? 'cause I'm onto you, gotta see what you're doing.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Every soldier wants to be the general. And I trust you have no opinion on me taking your position someday?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Plans for the future? Don't have any. You got a problem with that? I'm still young, no need to plan ahead.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I found Istina and the girls out there in the field. We used to have a bunch more, too. What happened to them…? I dealt with 'em. Had no choice, they wouldn't play nice.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Huh? Chernobog? Who'd ever wanna go back to that miserable city? We've got new lives here at Rhodes Island. So, let's keep it together, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: …You really finished all your work?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Zima, leader of the Ursus Student Self-governing Group. I can make do without one, but my comrades need a place to call home. Let's cut the crap, gimme a job to do. I know lodging here ain't free.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Not too bad.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Cool! So I'll keep getting promoted if I keep doing a good job knocking heads, yeah?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I'll be frank: if I keep getting promoted, I might end up replacing you someday. Oh, you think I'm joking? Sorry, pal, I'm dead serious here.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Don't care if I'm leading or following. Whatever.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What a pain...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Time to go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Roll out.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Duh, it's me!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm heading into the thick of it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Spineless scumbags.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hah.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: What're you scared of?!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Bring it on, bastards!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: For power and glory!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Victory or death!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Who else has a death wish? Happy to help!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Not bad. A solid win.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Anyway, this place is ours now.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Man, you suck. Get lost!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What do you want me to do here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey, you're getting better at giving orders these days. I bet you also see the fun in fighting now, eh?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Morning. Everyone's so damned noisy today. All those grown-ass people running around crazy excited for New Year's like a bunch of kids… Say, you aren't planning to waste the first day of the year sitting around here, are you? I bought a whole ton of fireworks, so you're gonna come have some fun with me.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You need something?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Privet, this one's for you. Hey, who said you could open it right now? Whatever, not like it's anything special. It plays music, same model as mine. Gets the job done, as far as I'm concerned… You've had my back for a while, so a little token of appreciation is the least I can do. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island gave us a place to live. I'm not about to forget that. I'm gonna get stronger, strong enough to make sure I'm worthy of the 'General Zima' title - for my comrades. Now, you'd better work twice as hard from here on, or that chair's gonna be mine. I'm dead serious!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Pardon, but that report you submitted to Dr. Kal'tsit... we could barely read the last few lines as they are nearly indecipherable... Please don't stay up late so much...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: So many things in here I've never seen before... Oh, sorry, I shouldn't be looking around... sorry...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I know herbs are rather bitter, but people could pay more attention to how effective they are…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Um, Doctor... is Harmonia still not getting any better? ... I see... I'll attend to her as soon as I finish work.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I know my herbs aren't popular because they're bitter... Aww...but I don't know how to make them taste better... Oh, you mean I should ask around for tips? Bu-bu-but... I'm not that good at small talk... I guess I'll try my best…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Harmonia and I would explore all sorts of places together when we were kids. Yeah, we grew up in the city ruins, and were really hoping to see the world outside back then...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Harmonia is both my oldest and best friend... But I'm the one to blame for her Oripathy infection, and what she is right now... I will find the cure and make up for the life Oripathy has taken away from her. I promise.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Ms. Perfumer suggested that I add some spices into my herbs and now they taste much better! I'm so glad I managed to summon the courage to ask everybody for their advices...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Harmonia says I'm in higher spirits these days. Do you agree as well, Doctor? It's all thanks to your timely advice. I wouldn't know what to do without you…

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor... oh, are you asleep? Yay! Now I can look around the office to my heart's content.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Myrrh, an herbalist. Dr. Kal'tsit gave me this title... she said myrrh symbolizes the ephemerality of life and wanted me to keep this in mind.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you so much! This way I'll be able to concoct even better medicine.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This is called a... promotion? Is that it...? Um, I don't really know much about stuff like that…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This reminds me of childhood with Harmonia, when we explored secret places and abandoned buildings. The more dangerous the place was, the rarer the ingredients we could find.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Uh... I'll try my best not to drag everyone down...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll start by doing my best to make eye contact...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Ah, Doctor, I'm ready to go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'll do my best to make sure no one gets hurt...!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm with you.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm coming.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I need to be careful.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Does anyone need healing?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Gotta aim more carefully.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Here's the medicine!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Medicine here. Please, take it!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: It's okay, it's curable!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: We won? Really? Even against those really tough opponents? Wow... you're so cool, Doctor!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: How's the medicine this time, everyone? ...Um, I guess I'll ask when we get back...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: So much to do in so little time... Thank goodness I didn't mess up too badly…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: My vials... All shattered...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Uh... I can still smell herbs on my clothes...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wahh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Excuse me, Doctor. I made you some herb soup good for soothing the body and calming the mind. It's just... a bit bitter…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I'm getting the seeds ready to plant my herbs once spring comes. I hope they'll grow strong and healthy, and that... that I won't even need them this year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh! Good morning, Doctor

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've prepared you some pills, based on your health records. They'll help you relax and sleep better. And don't worry, I've coated each one in cake-flavored frosting. If you like them, I can make more for you whenever you want!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I came to Rhodes Island to treat my closest friend. But when I got here, I found even more people who needed my aid. I'm so glad my herbal medicine can be useful... I hope that, one day, my herbs will be the most bitter thing anyone in this land has to deal with.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Shirayuki, at your service.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Princess Fumizuki is my master, and you're my employer.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My hobby? Standing on the coast, watching the snow fall.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My affiliation? Secret.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My birthplace? Higashi.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My weapon? A shuriken, the Silver Wind, made by Eastern Heavy Industries.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Favorite food? Sushi.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My age? Confidential.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My duty? Protecting you.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: How tranquil...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Shirayuki. Princess Fumizuki told me to assist Miss Ch'en and follow all your orders.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: You have my gratitude.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? I, Shirayuki, am honored.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I, Shirayuki, may devote greater strength to you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Orders received.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Commencing operation.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: A snowstorm will bury this battlefield.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Very well.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Roger.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Exterminate.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Shatter.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: All ends on the wind.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Sever.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The enemy dies, I advance. I advance, the enemy dies.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The enemy has fallen. Total victory.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Of their ranks, some flee. Wariness, a must.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Should we fight again, we will return the favor one hundredfold.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: A very nice room.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Your consideration, I, Shirayuki, will engrave upon my heart.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year. May all proceed as you will it.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Yes, employer?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. Please take this present. No, 'tis no bidding of the Princess.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I, ShiraYuki, here ever keep my watch. In duty, and our bonds.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Did you call for me, Doctor? I feel so happy to be with you!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor! Dr. Kal'tsit said that you need to look after your health more. In two words, E-A-T L-E-S-S! So there!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You know, Doctor, if my sister starts getting all bossy with you, you have to tell me! She needs my treatment or else!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Dr. Kal'tsit teaches me a ton of practical stuff, although it's tough to actually learn! At least I've always had a knack for nutrition, so I think I'm doing well with that!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I feel better about everyone here, compared to when I just joined Rhodes Island! And they all eat my healthy food on schedule! But... why does everyone pull these weird faces when they finish?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Tadaaaaaah! A special healthy meal just for you, Doctor! Decaf coffee and a hamburger without meat, cheese, pickles, or lettuce! Oh, and a mixed salad made of 12 different vegetables!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, where does your family live? Are they doing well? I know there's things you can't tell them about because they're your family... but, still, I think you've got to reach out. You have to try, at least.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Isn't it lonely cooking all by yourself? Let me help you out! Oh, right, and let's get Lava in here too!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, did you fall asleep? Have a good rest then. You need to sleep plenty to stay healthy.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: This is intern Hibiscus. From now on, I'll be in charge of managing yours and every Operator's health at Rhodes Island. Thank you for your cooperation!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oh, I see! So that's how you do it!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: It's my honor to be promoted! I'm looking forward to working under you for the health management of us all, Doctor!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I won't fail you! I'll protect everyone!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Acknowledged! I'll take good care of everyone! First, I need to get my special sustained-release medicine ready...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Please take good care of yourself while I'm gone!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ready to heal!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Don't be afraid!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: There we go.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: It's safe here!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Please come to your senses!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I can heal that wound in no time!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Even if everyone gets wounded, I can heal them all with my staff!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Looking after everyone's health is my greatest motivation.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor! Everyone! Are you alright?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No... First aid needed!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Anything I can help with?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, my~!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, do you want to have a taste of my new vitamin drink?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Here, Doctor, your new customized healthy daily schedule! Relax, given this full table of gourmet food we have here, I will make an exception today. I will allow you — one bite of fries! That'll be my most generous offer!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor! Would you mind tasting this?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Stop hiding the cakes, Doctor. They aren't escaping my eyes!... Look at all these cakes you have here! It takes three full teaspoons of sugar to whip the cream for just one of them, let alone the milk and butter that went in there. I know, I understand they are just tokens of appreciation from your fellow operators. But you could have just looked at them — Hey, don't steal a bite when I'm talking!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: They had a celebration today? I was so occupied that I hardly noticed… Doesn't matter, as long as there are wounded looking for treatment, my job's not finished. Not to mention the goal I set for myself to become a better medic. See you then, Doctor, for I still got works to tend to!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Need something? If you don't ,how about some divination?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Just tell me when there's work to do. But don't ever put her and me on the same team. I hate her guts. And don't get me started on all the weird food she makes me eat... Just thinking about it makes me... euurghh...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: No one told me Hibiscus was at Rhodes Island before I got here... It's too late for me to quit now.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: If you grow up sheltered, you don't know how to taunt, how to destroy, and how to handle yourself in a real fight. Am I right, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Have you ever heard the saying 'little sisters are justice'? If that's true, then my big sis is evil by default... at least as far as I'm concerned.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Instruments? I can play the piano a little. My teacher in Leithanien said learning an instrument can improve your Arts affinity. It also apparently eases the impact that Oripathy has on your mind...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm starving... Huh, what's this? You keep sweets in here? Nom... I'm in the middle of training. Should I really be eating this?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: See, like, I don't have a big beef with Hibiscus... It's all water under the bridge. I'm fine with her as long as she doesn't force me to eat her medicine and food. After all, she was the one... who saved my life...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I almost envy your ability to sleep like a log...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Lava, a Caster, here to join you simply because I'm bored and want something to do… But I heard my sworn nemesis is here too, though... Can I just quit now?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Did you forget? I don't need a cause to work for, and I don't need a team... but... thanks, I guess...

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: As far as teamwork's concerned... I don't mind, as long as nobody messes up.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm not good at this sort of stuff, but if you insist...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go. Keep an eye on my back.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I can see their souls. They're mine to reap.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What are you waiting for?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hurry up.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Come on.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: That's it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: It's game over for you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Even the dead can't save you.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The supreme form of Arts. I'm interested in seeing what it's like.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I foresaw this result earlier. A perfect victory.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Well… My fortune telling isn't always right. Sometimes there's a lot of external noise that affects the outcome.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Dammit... These evil spirits are too strong...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Oh, come on. I'd rather be alone.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Don't touch me! Uaghh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Eh, you're not scoring any points with me like that!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I need your help, Doctor. Tell me, Just in what world do I fall under the category of 'Out of Shape?' I was feeding myself some fried-foulbeast, and that annoying Hibiscus took it away, before peeling the coat off and handing the rest back to me! The crispy, crunchy coat! She took it! Gone! There's *NO* way I can get my hands on what I want to eat with her around! There's gonna be a fight... Ugh! Never mind.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, it's you, Doctor. Morning.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Here, I made you a pair of gloves. And take a look at these beautiful patterns on them! Cool, aren't they? I got them from my divination, which always comes true. You too will learn that in the future.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: My infection made my sister's life hell as well. It may not look like it, but deep inside my heart resonates with hers, because what we all want is to help those in need with our hands. Speaking of which, isn't she still on shift today? Huh, how can someone have the right to call me the one that worries when she pushes herself this hard?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I'm your guard for the day! Don't worry, I won't let any sketchy people near you! Just relax!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: My training score for today...? Um, I mean, we could talk about something else...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I can't shake the pre-battle jitters, and that makes Captain Fang really nervous too... What should I do? Doctor!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hibiscus and Lava always complain to me about each other, but both of them are my good friends, and neither of them are wrong... Doctor, what should I do?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Instructor Dobermann always told us, 'Even when after you finish your training, your number one goal on the battlefield is to stay alive.' Urgh... How can I become as strong and awesome as she is?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I'm still a rookie Operator, but I'm working hard! Hehehe, I'd really love a compliment or two, if you agree.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My Oripathy? It doesn't bother me all that much, I'm used to it. I just want to be with the people I care about until my disease gets cured... Ughh...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I didn't have much confidence before I came here, but I'm so glad that I can protect you and everyone on Rhodes Island! It's my dream to protect everyone! I really wish days like these could last forever.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Aww... seeing the Doctor sleeping all vulnerable like that makes me want to doodle something on a certain someone's face...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: My codename is Beagle! I know I didn't do very well on my assessment, but I'll still do my best at my internship!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I did it! I've become stronger!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Finally, FINALLY! Now nobody's going to call me 'the Rookiest Rookie in the Rookieverse' anymore!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll do all I can!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Huh? I am the leader? I don't feel right about Fang not being the leader...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Everyone, let's roll out!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Everyone, enemies incoming!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Grant me strength!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Is it my turn?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Target location reached!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: This is the place!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Haah!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Watch this!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: It's my duty to protect everyone! My resolve will never falter, no matter the odds!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: All enemies have been defeated! We Rhodes Island Operators are the finest!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hooray, we won! Although a few enemies managed to get away... *sigh*...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm sorry... so sorry...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What can I do for you?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Doctor! Th-That tickles!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, can I come to your place to study every day?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! Today's a day off, right? So that should mean we don't have to go to training... But just a minute ago, I saw Instructor Dobermann and a bunch of other operators at the training grounds. Maybe that means I should go too...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hi, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: D-Doctor, happy birthday! Huh? I—I'm not nervous, not at all. We got you a birthday present, so can you come visit the dorms real quick? But you'll want to be careful! And please don't tell Kroos I was the one who warned you!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I think—what scares me more than Oripathy is the idea of separating from my friends. I love being here at Rhodes Island with everyone, and making a bunch of new friends too! As long as I keep doing what I can to get stronger, I'll be able to protect them all!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Is there anything I can help you with, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Thank you for believing in me! I'll keep up my work!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hibiscus and Lava are fighting again... What a pain. Why are they like this? They're sisters.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Instructor Dobermann puts us through mock battles a lot, but I can never get a handle on her skill. Doctor, next time you and Amiya observe our training, would you please give us some notes?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Someone on my team is late again, huh? I'll make sure that gets fixed.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Lava and I are both Infected, but I didn't get a talent for Arts like she did...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island is our home and shelter, Doctor. I will protect everyone here with my life.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The ever-honest and reliable Beagle, the perceptive Kroos, the resourceful Lava and the energetic Hibiscus. I like everyone in this team... as long as Hibiscus doesn't force her health food innovations on me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Shhh! The Doctor's resting. We can talk outside.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Lancer Fang, captain of Reserve Op Team A1. My team and I will do our best to serve Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you for your guidance.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Your approval means so much to me, Doctor. This promotion proves my hard work is paying off.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I know the captain's duty well. Rest easy.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Team, check your gear before departing.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy spotted. Prepare to fight!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready for action.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: On standby.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: In position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Leave it to us.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Thrust!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Everyone, follow me!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: With the right plan, even rookies like us can win a tough fight!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We have accomplished our objective as planned.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We can't call a mission complete if we let even a single enemy get through. Beagle, let's do better on the next one.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm sorry I failed you, Instructor Dobermann...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Yes. I'm back. Is Kroos here too?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ahh...!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Am I helping?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Our team's going to eat dinner together, and we were just about to invite Instructor Dobermann. Would you like to come as well? I have some combat-related questions I'd like to ask, too... Oh, sorry, I know I shouldn't be mentioning work on a holiday.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I'm ready whenever you need me, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! We got you a birthday present as a team. Have you seen Kroos? We agreed to do this together, and she still vanished. Anyway, whatever she told you, just don't believe a word of it, we did actually—awgh! Krooth! Whah ah yoo cavvarin m' mauph phor?!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Looking at our set goals, I've already finished all my training, the other members of my team have made huge progress under Dobermann's instruction too, and we're adapting better and better on the combat side of things. Doctor, I'll be a better captain than I'm now, I promise.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, it's such a nice day, so can't we take a little nap?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hmm...? We're about to leave? But I just got up... Wait, is this the Doctor's office? How'd I get here?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why am I always squinting? Because I don't want anyone to see my eyes. Nope, nobody~

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm really careless and get hurt a lot... But Hibiscus heals me every time, so I'm not afraid of getting injured. Oh gosh, that 'Curing Cuisine' of hers though, I'm terrified of it...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor! Someone left 10 alarm clocks by my bed! Who would do something so awful?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, let's play a game~ Put an apple on your head and we'll start~

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm always looking for fun things to do as a way to ease the pain of my Oripathy, I guess. Plus, I love seeing other people smile~

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: One day, our journey with Rhodes Island will come to an end, and hopefully we'll all get to have a warm, neverending dream, lying in the sunshine~ That's my number one dream~

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Can't believe the Doctor's a heavier sleeper than me...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hi-hiii~ I'm Kroos~ I might be inexperienced, but I'll do the best I can~

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you so much!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion~ What a lovely dream~ Huh? I'm not dreaming?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Umm, where's the rally point?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Huhhh~? Fang would make a better captain than me!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Listen, everyone~! Stay calm~

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Why can't everyone try to get along...?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Sure!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Let's take it slow~

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Mmhmm, I'm listening~

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I won't sleep on the job~

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: There you are!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Heeere I aaaaam!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Take aim!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew, that was tough...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I think we did alright!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmm, I guess this was a bit of a letdown...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: S-sorry... I'll fight harder next time...!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Can I get my beauty sleep in here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ughh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hmm, have I matured?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor Happy New Year! I'm really sleepy already, so I'm just wishing you a good year ahead of time. How was that can I gave you, tasty? If you liked it, I could give you a few more.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor~ *Yawn*...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Fang! You're awful! Doctor, don't be scared, come with me. Hmm? What are you crouching for? There's no water bucket on the door. Pff, your chair's got all four legs too. No hot sauce in your cake either. Heheh, Doctor, Truth is, I haven't pulled a single prank at all! That's what I'm fooling them about!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It's so fun having everyone together like this. Not a care in the land except what's coming up next and what eats there are. How nice it'll be if every day was like this. Oh, the light show's starting? Let's get moving, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I sense something familiar in the wind. Where are we?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Do you feel the wind from Kazimierz?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island is very different from the places I used to live. There's nowhere to start a campfire here... too bad. Maybe on the deck? I'd like to create a space where everyone can talk and grow closer together.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Umm, how does this mission signup system actually work? I'm really bad at electronics…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: There have been lots of new faces at Rhodes Island. I'll gladly help them adjust to the environment.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: That Kazimierzian knight... Oh, it's her. I knew that girl years ago. She used to be a shy, bookish type. I wonder what made her change so much.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Shh... look what I found! A solitary Doctor... gotta catch this one! Oh, did I scare you? Haha…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I sometimes recall the time back home in the forest. We had lots of different competitions every year…ah, the good old days. I wonder what my hometown is like now.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I'll always have your back, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: So you can fall asleep without a care, just like that? Heheh...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Meteor, the archer from the woods. Do you need an Operator who excels in long-distance support?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Archery requires constant practice. No one can afford to slack off for even one day.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm honored to receive this promotion.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor, for recognizing my skill. I'll continue to do my best to serve you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave the long-distance support to me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll keep everyone safe.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Everybody, let's go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Time to show them what we can do.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Awaiting your orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I've been waiting for a while.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: The wind is blowing in the right direction.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll stay vigilant.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Perfect chance!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Feel the wind.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This is the shot!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Critical hit.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No matter how difficult the battle, we can handle it, as long as we work together as one.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Perfect! You all did well.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: All injured personnel, please stay put, don't move. I'll be right there.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm sorry... I didn't want it to end up like this...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's hard to get used to such a small room.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh? Need anything?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Being by your side feels like basking in the spring sunshine. So warm, so comfy.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Another year gone by. I wonder if the forests are as I left them? I'm still not too used to modern life, and people still fear Oripathy as much as ever, but the arrival of a new year means the land is once again shining with new life. There's still hope, for everything.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I found this plant a few days ago on a field mission. It's quite a miraculous one. Even when it's wilted, all it needs is to soak in water for a few nights, and it'll regrow all its leaves and stems—a method that lets it live for a very long time. Happy birthday, and may our fellowship be just like this plant.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Oh dear, these electronic appliances never make it easy. But I've been making progress, don't you think? Some of the things you call 'old-fashioned' just suit me better, like this bow. After using it for so many years, it has my total trust.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Uh... w-where should I stand? O-oh, you want me to sit? Then... where should I sit?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: That little bird is my friend. But it's always disappearing on me these days... Oh no... It's not disliking me, is it...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The way I look... is nothing like an Operator at all... And I understand having someone like me in your team won't make you pround... But don't worry, I won't go around saying I'm with Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You've probably noticed, but my hair is quite difficult to style... So I have to let my hair down like this... It's not very appropriate, is it?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My mutant horns... they don't really fit in with the crowd... I thought I was used to other people staring at them... but … but it's still embarrassing...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The friends I made in the wilderness... they're all coming to Rhodes Island too. So... I'll feel less lonely. I'll do my best to fight hard and protect everyone.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Actually, ever since my childhood, I've always been dreaming to be a... a princess... I-I mean it's okay if you find it ridiculous...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The bad guys always call me 'freak'... but… yeah, I'm a freak, a freak that wants to protect you and everyone else.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Um... that really energetic doctor... she's an Archosaurian too, huh? I do want to talk to her... but I'm still a bit scared…

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: No one's staring at me now, right? Ah, finally...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: H-hello... Uh... s-sorry, my horns... I accidentally broke your office door with my horns...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Powers stronger than what I already have... can I really control them...?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? What's that?... I don't really get it, but I think it means that I've been helpful, right?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor, for giving me a bit more confidence... Now I am starting to understand what to do and how to wield my power.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: P-please don't look at me...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Wahh... me? R-really? Is that really okay?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Uh, everyone... it's... it's time to attack! I-is this how I'm supposed to give orders?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I... I won't let the bad guys win!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Huh? Me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Let me do it!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: My pushover look should pull a lot of enemies here...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: To intimidate the enemy... I... I'm capable of that, right?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hah!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I-I won't let you pass!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I won't let you escape this easily!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Fear me, please!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I can do better... yes, even better!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Are you proud of what we've achieved, Doctor?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Great... we won, Doctor!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: In the end... I'm good for nothing... just as expected...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Wow, this place... it's so spacious! I love it!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Um...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You're always so kind to me... I... I'm so happy!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor... My wish is to get along better with everyone. Will I be able to do that? And make more friends as well... is that allowed? Having friends...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: D-Doctor...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, this is a gift I made... My friend on my head shed a bunch of feathers, which I made into a pendant. I hope you like it...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Fighting makes me feel useful... You've always thought so? T-Thanks, Doctor... And outside of battle as well? I... Gavial and Tomimi said so too? Am I... dreaming?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Greetings Doctor. How may I assist you?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Deep Sleep Mode enabled... Zzzzz... Setting advanced config and power interface... Zzzzz…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My racial traits, in conjunction with my infection, may cause me to fall asleep in mid-conversation. Do not be alarmed.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I met Dr. Silence at Rhine Lab. I assisted her with data and risk analysis on a secret project.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Warning! Formatting Rhodes Island database... Don't worry. It's just a joke. Please don't panic.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I recommend you refactor my data if optimization fails to increase my performance. This will improve communication efficiency, and Ptilopsis will... Zzzz...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The way I speak? It is a side effect of Originium poisoning. By no means do I enjoy articulating my thoughts this way.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Warning, system has recovered from a fatal error. Reconfiguring to last normal system boot point. Do not be alarmed.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: It is, in fact, quite burdensome to speak in this manner. But this is a necessary measure to prevent the system nexus from being devoured by that other voice. Doctor, if I lose control, please guide me back onto the right path.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: System... is now in Sleep Mode...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Ptilopsis, former data analyst at Rhine Lab. Please submit your orders via the Command Line.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Reading package data… Installation complete.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Update installation complete. Ptilopsis's system permissions have been revised.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Warning. Reverting Rhodes Island database to previous save state. Time since save state: two years… Just joking. Please calm down. System update complete.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: New data used to assemble package build.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Squad leader permissions acquired.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Direct memory access for application map and enemy coordinates authorized. Please stand by.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Tactical support system online.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Program initializing.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Initiation complete.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Arts Unit charging.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Target marked.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Initiating healing process.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Loading complete.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Healing Mode enabled.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Activating Arts Unit.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Even such a challenging scenario couldn't stop you, Doctor. Perhaps one day you will find the solution to the non-deterministic polynomial time problem.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Your logical deduction was absolutely correct. What a perfect calculation.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A number of errors have been detected. Please confirm.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: A fatal error occurred during the operation. Reboot the system to proceed.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is this place like a disk array?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Error occured.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Detecting affection increase for the Doctor within Ptilopsis. Would you like to skip to the next dialogue choice?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Loading… Loading complete. File name: New Year. Date modified: twelve hours ago. Updating entry contents: Doctor, Happy New Year! Your present has been placed on your desk. Open it and take a look!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Date rollover complete. The Doctor is now online. Detecting emotional surge within Ptilopsis.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, people celebrate their own dates of birth. How do you wish to celebrate yours? Acknowledged. Increasing favor rating of Doctor. Error: Invalid operation. Cause of failure: favor rating is already at—maximum.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Zzzzz... Detected passage of the Doctor. What is the Doctor laughing at...? Scanning hairstyle condition of Ptilopsis... Detected three pigtails, five bows, five colored bands, two clips. Assumed to be practical joke by Ifrit... Final assessment: Adorable.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Greetings, Doctor. You're glowing today. To see you so well... it's all I could ever hope for.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I prepared an antidote to nullify the effects of any common poison. I'd like you to take one dose before every battle. Do you mind?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Actually, the toxin in my body is an ingredient in some high-quality medicines. That's why Dr. Kal'tsit needs me in her lab a lot.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hmm, why do you keep staring at me... You mean, it's because my eye color is special? Is that a compliment, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm the one our enemies fear the most. After all, who wouldn't want to kill me before I can torture them to death with my poison? What really worries me is that my teammates might think the same…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Why am I staring at this cake? Actually... I baked it to share with everyone, but no one wanted it... Would you like to try it, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, you're always wearing the same outfit. How about I choose some new clothes for you? I think I have pretty good taste. Oh... it's a uniform? So you can't change it? Okay…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm 'toxic'... so people prefer to stay away from me. But now I have you by my side, Doctor, and I'm really, really happy.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My body isn't that different from everyone else. I may be 'toxic,' but nothing bad will happen if someone touches me. Doctor, if you can prove this to everyone, then maybe they won't always keep away from me. Could you... hold my hand out there?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Oh, already asleep. Gotta find a blanket to keep the Doctor warm...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you, I'm Blue Poison. I'm sure Dr. Kal'tsit must have told you about me. In that case, it'll be up to you to decide how to use my 'toxic' powers.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I think I hear the sound of toxic liquid boiling, like music to my ears.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you so much... I'm so glad I get to help out in all these battles. It's like a dream come true.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I used to hold back and hide my 'toxic' self, but now I've accepted what I am, trying to move forward to change my fate. I have you to thank for helping me make this shift, Doctor. You have my sincerest gratitude.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Great. I'm good at supporting assaults.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'd be much better off supporting the others. Wouldn't want my poison to harm you, Doctor...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Everyone, there's no need for you all to stand so far from me...

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I prepared a 'gift' for you. Like it?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Awaiting your orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Please don't be scared of me.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Don't worry, my poison is not contagious.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: My toxicant is ready.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: My toxins will slowly burn your life away...

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Are you hallucinating?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Honey to me, poison to you.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Poison kiss.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Use poison to fight the evils and crimes... Isn't that ironic to you?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I've got a poison to melt away all these remains in an instant. Want me to show you?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Good, finished before my clothes got dirty.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: How ridiculous. Feels like I killed myself with my own poison...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Resting when you're tired helps you focus on your work.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: D-Did you just touch me? C-Can you do that again? Please?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Well there, Doctor, Happy New Year. Although, given what day it is, won't you take your uniform off? I was assuming you'd put on something new, but maybe you just don't pay much attention to your appearence.  It's a little frustrating—I have no idea what would be a good gift for you.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. A dessert from me—please, take it. And if it's okay, I'd like you to give it a taste right now. What is it? Everyone's watching? I don't see the problem. You're a regular whenever I make snacks, aren't you?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I am a 'toxic' person, but I still have a place of my own here... It makes me so happy. The operators might still be slightly scared of me, but that's it. They don't reject me that much. Just give it enough time, and the relationships between us will be fine, won't they?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, are the new recruits keeping up with my basic training regimen?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: A balanced, regular diet is also an important part of daily training. Any complainers get fifty laps around the deck.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: As a military instructor, it's important to achieve the perfect balance between strictness and leniency. To be honest... I may be a bit too hard on Fang...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: When putting your Operators into squads, it's crucial to assign them positions where they can exercise their skills to the fullest. It's true that Operators' ability is important, what's really being tested here is your judgement.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, when training Operators, you need to work on spiritual fulfillment as much as improving their physiques and skills. After all, they need to be mentally strong enough to survive interrogations and all sorts of attacks on their minds.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You're looking for the newbies? They're training out on the deck. Yes, I do realize what the weather's like right now. Of course I do.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Anomalies... ha. You can never fool the eyes of the 'Hound'.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: If you believe that command allows you to slack off whenever you want, then I WILL correct your misconception, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: If I hope to remain at your side through all the difficulties to come, I must be even harder on myself. After all, with the world around us being what it is... the only way we can keep it together is to keep training our mental strength.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: No slacking off!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Attention! I am Dobermann, former military instructor for the Bolívarian armed forces. Now, let's cut to the chase. Hand over the list of Operators in need of training.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This is how our training pays off.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion, huh? Thanks. I'm just doing my job.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The responsibility for training the future of Rhodes Island is on my shoulders. I will do my best to be worthy of that responsibility.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Then show me the briefing docs for the mission.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Calling all hands. This is not a drill!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Time to interrogate.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Your orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Orders?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Commence tracking.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Filthy scum.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Take that!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Tear 'em up!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hang in there!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No matter the challenges we face, strong fundamental combat skills can mean the difference between life and death.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Come back when you're less mediocre.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The operation was successful, but we still have room for improvement.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We have failed. I am the one to blame.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The newbies are intimidated by me, you say? That's only natural.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Please mind your behavior.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You want to cheer me up? Hm, let me interrogate someone, then.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Whether a workday or a holiday, I'm always on standby. You should keep your guard up too, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Today is a day worth celebrating, but nevertheless, I'll have to ask you focus on work before this evening's birthday party. Sorry, please forget everything I said about 'birthday party.'

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I always feel a sense of pride, watching as the novices grow step by step. Of course, I don't view that as a contribution to Rhodes Island, but I do walk together with them. Doctor. Never forget your calling, on the road to come.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: {@nickname}, compared to the old ones, today's battle are too relaxed and juvenile. They are weak. Weak enough to make weapons rust. And once a warrior's weapons rust, death soon follows.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Life is but a brief flicker before the vast maw of annihilation. Cherish that view of the sunset while you still can, {@nickname}.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Practical exercises? Nah, I'm not interested. While Rhodes Island boasts many powerful warriors, squandering one's physical strength on a game is wasteful. Only on the edge of life and death does the clashing of swords have value.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm not concerned with the plight of the Infected? Hmph, don't misunderstand me - fighting in vain is what I hate. No enemy worth spilling my blood has come forward, and that's all there is to it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rampant slaughter liberates your inner instinct, 'teamwork' only robs you of it. What 'trust' and 'strategizing' buy you are nothing but illusions of security. And these illusions, {@nickname}, will one day cost you your life.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: This blade ran through two crown princes, and this other one slew three generals. In our chaotic world, anything can happen. I don't know who will claim my life, but on that day, I sure hope it'll be more exciting than when I took these lives.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Shining, huh? A pity, she could have been a worthy adversary. But after she got pulled into that mess with the 'Confessarii,' I bet she felt her blade had been besmirched. Hmph, Swordsmen without faith in their swords are beneath mention.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: {@nickname}, you remember that battle, right? After killing all the ambushers, I led the survivors and charged straight into the traitor's fortress. I was the only one who made it out alive. How did it all start? Oh, you know the answer to that. I've seen you before, and my memory is very good.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: {@nickname}, help me fetch those seeds in the cupboard, won't you? Thank you. Yes, I'm actually quite fond of flowers. No matter how brilliantly they blossom, their petals must wither and fall into the wind. When will the petals wither next, Doctor?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Vigilance can keep you alive, {@nickname}.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: We meet again, {@nickname}. Don't worry, I understand the situation you're in now, and pose no threat to you. I shall be your blade, so use me as you see fit, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The skills a great warrior needs are those which defy recording.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? What? So you actually care about these rituals now?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I have no concept of what it's like to be Infected. Perhaps Rhodes Island can help me understand. I don't care, but if you have your own considerations. Fine, I'll hear them out.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Ahh, I've longed for a hurricane of blood.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I've been a captain before, and it didn't end well.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I will bathe in their blood.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let's begin.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Do not interfere.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Mind your own business.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: So, who shall be my opponent?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Will it be you? Or maybe you?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The blade brings the flame.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The bone falls with blood.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Whose name will you cry as you pass?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I don't give a damn.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Did this battle satisfy you?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A weak enemy proves nothing. Search for a worthier battlefield.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A dedicated opponent will prove to be a worthy adversary in the future, let them do just that.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The rest of you, go. It has always been my job to destroy the pursuing enemy.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's pretty quiet here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You're just in time, I find myself in need of a whetstone…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Time never ceases to pass. If you make no progress at this stage in your journey, then as a wizened tree does, your hours will rot away, and lose any ability to meet the coming spring. Happy New Year, {@nickname}, and don't forget your own goals.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Not bad, you're still alive.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here is a flower I grew. Take it. You don't need to assign it too much meaning. All I hope is that before you greet life's withering, you come upon a time in which you blossom at full might. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I think of what reasons brought me to Rhodes Island, Doctor, and there is only you. I allow you to use me as your blade, but in kind, you provide me amusing prey and durable whetstones. But don't disappoint me. For if you do, I cannot guarantee that someday this blade will not point at you.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I may be in your employ, but every murderer is probably somebody's old friend—so if your conduct is even slightly suspect, I won't turn a blind eye!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This Rhodes Island has no less of a suspicious smell about it…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Careful observation is fundamental to all investigatory work! Elementary, true, but it always comes in handy!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You there! Face this way, hands where I can see them! Ah, sorry, I thought you were someone else…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've always had my misgivings about that penguin. I mean, it spends money like water, and it's a PENGUIN! It even has a gold necklace on! Do you know how LITTLE detectives like us make in a month?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Mmmgh... so frustrating! How do I get my investigation on that suspect logistics company started? Do I break in? Hrmm, not when those two guards look so dead fierce... No, no, I'm not scared... I'm just warming up the little grey cells!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: What are you giving me anpan for? I don't eat this sort of thing while I'm mid-investigation—you must be getting funny ideas from all those TV shows! When a real detective's on the case, it's doughnuts or nothing!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You told me it was only for three months. But after three months came another three months, and another. I've been almost ten months undercover, guv! ...Hey! I see you there! Stop eavesdropping on my call!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, I fear that penguin has noticed I've been investigating it... I fear for my life, too...!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Wake up! Waaake uppp! No sleeping on the jooob!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Royal Detective May, and I ask you cooperate with me in my investigation! Eh? I've got the wrong address? Impossible! That penguin's holed up here, and I have the evidence!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Don't I look so dashing when I'm on the case?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for the promotion, guv'nor! I'm so grateful you... Wait, forget that! You're not even my ACTUAL superior!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Elite team? Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait, I'm a Royal Detective! Why is some mercenary organization the one promoting me?!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: No letting any suspects sneak onto the team, okay?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Heheheh! Leader? Nay, call me DETECTIVE CHIEF INSPECTOR!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All units move out! Mooove ooout!!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You criminals! Behave and turn yourselves in!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What's happening? An incident?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Yes, guv, understood!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Crime scene investigation!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll need to see proof of identity!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: This is your one warning!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Stop right there, criminal scum!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'll give you a taste of my taser!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: It won't hurt, you'll just get a little buzz!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: For a master detective, there is no case that can't be solved!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I want all these suspects taken away! Ohh, fine, I'll do it myself...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmm... I feel like we've missed some clues, haven't we?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: R-requesting backupppp…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: My instinct tells me there'll be a case afoot here!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You and your villainous hand! I'll remember this!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: D-don't think this is some express ticket to clearing your name...!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! I solved plenty more cases last year as a Royal Detective! The only thing is, I'm still a little ways away from baring the truth of Penguin Logistics... Not that an inspector leaves any puzzle unsolved! I've got to give it my all this year too!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: There you are, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Shh, shhh—not a word, hear me out first! I'll bet you anything it's your birthday today, isn't it? You see, I didn't seek ANY verbal testimony, not when I could simply let the available clues inform my mental deductions! By the way, I also happened to deduce this is a present you'll love—doughnuts!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Streamers stuck up, snacks laid out, balloons of every color. Yes, one truth prevails! Doctor, based on my deductions, today must be some holiday celebration! What? They sent an advance notice to every operator's terminal yesterday? It can't be!!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Why is this office so damn cold?! Hey, you there! You okay with me using that for kindling?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Oh, How much did you say this book costs? Haha, pricey. Call me Mistress Ifrit and I'll give it back to you.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Huh? You want me to read this book? I hate it when people try to tell me… It's from Silence? Really? Urgh... Wha-what does this word mean here?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I hate it when you white coat creepers stare at me... Yeah, I mean you! What'cha looking at? Go stare at something else!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Um... Okay, fine. No more scaring people with fire.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Back off! You... Why are you coming at me like that? You wanna strap me to a lab table too?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Saria's here? I want to see her— Silence says no? C'mon, what's the big deal? Just take me to her and keep it off the record!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Why are Silence and Saria arguing all the time? I don't get it... Hey! You gotta know how to get them to make up, right? C'mon, just tell me… I mean, please...?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I don't care what you think of me, but you'd better be nice to Silence. When she wants something, you go get it for her! Do that, and your wish is my command.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You little...! You've got guts to ignore me and slack off like this!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You stand before the almighty Ifrit! Hmph, Silence says Rhodes Island's a nice place, but there's nothing I hate more than you white-coat science creepers... I mean, except Silence...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Stronger...? Hmm, that means my flames can burn brighter, right?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What's this? Promotion Manual for Rhodes Island Operators? Guess I'll give it a peek... What the hell? So many rules even after I get promoted? Nah-uh, pass.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Haha, that's right! I don't give a damn about all those rules. But, if you say you're counting on me, then that's all the words I need!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Yeah yeah, I heard ya.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm the captain? So, just do like Silence would, right?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Hey! They made me the captain, so I'm the one calling the shots here!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Yo! How 'bout another barbecue!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hey!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Too slow!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Let the world BURN!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hellfire, locked and loaded!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Does it hurt? I bet it does!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hahaha! Keep screaming!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Shriek all you want! Nobody cares!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Get in the line of death!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Weak, you're all too weak! I am invincibllllle!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Why don't we torch all the trash into kindling? It'll be nice and warm!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Nothing but cinders left now. I could've handled this all by myself!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Damn you... You made a fool out of me!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What kind of place is this? Huh?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: The hell are you doing here?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Heheh, you're nicer than I expected. Wanna hang out?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's? Hah, no sweat, Silence taught me about New Year's forever ago. You celebrate all of last year, and make your resolutions or whatever for next year! My resolutions? Hey, what's with the homework? Silence said I don't have to do any today! Beat it!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You need something?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Feast your eyes on the great Ifrit's handmade chocolate cake! Silence taught me, and I got it right on the first try! I know, I know, I'm the best! ...Wh-What the hell? How come it melted?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: What's the deal outside today, why's it so noisy? Whoooa, there's a party! Is there a barbecue? I'm really good at barbecue, everyone should come eat mine! Which means, it's time to stoke the fire… What? We're not doing it on a charcoal grill? Boring! Where'd my grill go? Shaw confiscated it? Arrrrrrgh—

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: No problem. I've done all of this before, and I won't have any trouble handling it, but let's be up front, Doctor: If you come to me in the evening with a stack of documents and tell me to sort everything out that night, chances are that you might not get what you want.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Research is actually kind of a pain. Sometimes, you go all in on your research. Other times, you have to spend time going over progress with somebody else. You need to know your specialty like the back of your hand, and you also need people skills. If I wasn't already decent at both, my head would've exploded a long time ago.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My sister Astesia is really good at our family's chicanery, but she only ever uses it to help people. To think there would be such a pure, kind-hearted shyster running around... Oh, Doctor, don't tell anyone about this! Please, I'm begging you! If she finds out I told, Astesia will whap me upside the head!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Rhine Lab? Hmm... Sorry, I don't really want to talk about them right now. If that place were really so great, I wouldn't have asked for a transfer to Rhodes Island, right? Okay, break time's over! Back to work!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm the one who got infected, but then even Astesia... *sigh*... You probably can't tell, but she's actually pretty depressed. Enough is enough, I gotta do something to help her.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Columbia's technology keeps advancing, and as a researcher, I can almost see that future I'm looking for. My dream is right there, and I'm going to make it come true.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Our family's... well, how should I say this? My parents are the old-fashioned type that like to order people around. They don't care about your opinions, only the joy of being in control. It sucks. That's why I haven't been back home since college. Now they can't stop me from studying the stuff I like.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: There are those who help because they really want people to have a better life, but there are also those who help so they can use people as stepping stones. Doctor, you know how to tell the two apart, don't you? It's easy. You just need to look at the way they smile.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My dad's kinda famous back in the city, and our names are a little peculiar, so I thought I'd give myself a new name to get away from all that trouble. But feel free to call me whatever you want, Doctor. We're friends, don't sweat it.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Yes, this is the Doctor's office. Yes, the Doctor is resting right now. Please call back later.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Researcher Elena Urbica of Rhine Lab. A pleasure to make your acquaintance. We're supposed to call each other by codenames here, right? No problem. In that case, call me Astgenne. It's simple and easy to remember.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I don't think I've seen a problem like that before. Gotta take notes...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What a pretty medal! Let me help you pin it on. Hm? How come you're the one wearing it instead of me? Isn't this commemorating your good eye for people?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Let's join together and break the shackles, Doctor! The future is unfolding right before our eyes!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Hello, everybody!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Hold on a sec. I'll finish reading the team leader's messages in a jiffy.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All charged up and ready to go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'll show you the power of technology.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: How about here?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Alright.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Acknowledged.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Miracles don't just drop out of the sky.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Computations complete.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'm not gonna sit here and wait for my demise.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: My lightning will illuminate the starry sky!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You had even the finest details under control. You must be a professional.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I knew everything was going to be okay.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Everything's under control~ Just a little scuffed, that's all...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No way... How could my calculation have...?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Let's see how far this is from my workstation...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ahh?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh, Doctor! What a coincidence running into you here! Why don't we go shopping together?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hm, that's another year, come and gone. It's time to come up with new plans. No, it's not really that much work. All you have to do is make a wish and keep it in mind. Your first wish of the year is always the easiest to fulfill. Give it a try.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Need a hand?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday! Come, come! Here's my present for you. Crack it open~ What do you think? This music box is great, isn't it? Hehe~ Doctor, you know when my birthday is, don't you? I'm expecting a surprise when the time comes. It's a promise~

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Time to get up and stretch a little, Doctor. All that trouble won't go away just because you spend a couple more minutes grinding away. Come on, share a dance with me and move your body. Don't worry, it's not hard. Just take my hand, step forward. Right... Right, like that. Does it feel like your body just lightened up some?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Relax, Doctor. I'll keep you safe.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Lots of new recruits lately, many new faces. Don't let your guard down.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If something happens, don't forget to use the emergency communication channel. Just call me and I'll come running.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I sound cold when I talk? I'm on the clock. I'm a lot less serious when I'm off.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island needs more than just combat Operators. You need experts in education, PR, and all kinds of stuff.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I used to only get called in for the nastiest fights, but now every fight is a nasty one.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: This shield has a name: Hannya. I brought it from my hometown. Its 'father' and mine were old friends. Back in the L.G.D., my superiors would always tease me about it, but together we've proven that a shield makes a great weapon, and so do I.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hannya's tasted plenty of Lungmen gangster blood. I never thought it'd win me many friends, but the ones who looked down on me started showing me some respect after all that had happened. Or maybe they're just scared of how big I am? What do you think?
