lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: How about another shot...? Oh, you've had enough? Don't sweat it... I can carry you back to your room if you pass out. What? That worries you even more? C'mon, don't be a buzzkill.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hm? Heh. Nothing. Just guarding you, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hoshiguma, Defender Operator. I'll be your shield, your blade, your fortress. Very glad to meet you, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's all thanks to your teaching, Doctor.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm honored.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: No one tells me where I'm going, and no one can stop me once I make up my mind. And now—I've made up my mind to follow you, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I will protect everyone.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Protecting Rhodes Island is my responsibility too.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I want everyone to get home safe.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: If you've got a reason to fight, you've got a reason to die!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes, Sir.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Not one step backwards.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Not one step forwards.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hannya will crush you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: If you want to hurt my friends, you have to go through my shield first.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Seeing is believing.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hannya, unleash the rage your father poured into you!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The harder the journey, the stronger you'll become.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hurting my friends right in front of me? I'll make you pay!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Are you hurt? I'm sorry. I failed.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Fall back, now! I'll bring up the rear!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: With my size... it's kind of hard to get through the door.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you should take a load off now that we finally got a break.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Seeing as both you and I have the day off from official business, how about we head out and shake ourselves off? Want to ride on my bike and catch the breeze, or maybe let's find some place to drink? It's your call. Oh, but, hehe, can't do both. Never drink and drive.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Phew, arrived on time. Didn't ride all that way for nothing—I was almost speeding, actually. Anyway, Doctor, happy birthday! I brought you a special pre—uh, where's my bag? I didn't drop it on the way, did I...? Ah, shoot. Doctor, how about I bring you the present next time, and I'll treat you to some food for today?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I might not be alongside Rhodes Island forever, but the camaraderie we built in battle, that's something the L.G.D., my Hannya, and me will remember. My commitment to protecting Rhodes Island will never change. Doctor, when times are troubled from here on, give me a call.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Boss, let's go grab a bite. On you this time. What? You bought last time? Doesn't sound right to me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Use my head to win fights? Hmm… Hmm… Pummel them until I win, train harder if I lose. That's using your head!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Honey's sweet, but getting it hurts. I went for some the other day… They really give me a hard lesson.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My knuckles? Haha~ They're my precious babies. Wouldn't have racked up all those wins without 'em!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: There's more rules in the underground fight scene than you might think. Plenty of gopniks dove in before they had 'em figured out. They usually ended up dead.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Oripathy? Who cares? Infected, Uninfected... They're all the same after I knock their lights out.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: What? The fin in the kitchen? Hah! Right here in my belly now!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My book of names here? Ah, looks like that big brain of yours doesn't know everything. Gotta meet people to fight people, right? I don't want to run out of enemies.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The only reason I joined the underground fight is 'cause I didn't have two kopecks to rub together. But here on Rhodes Island I got that load off my mind. It's all thanks to you, Boss!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Smells like grilled fish!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Yo! Boss, you know a winner when you see her! Now, put your hands together for the strongest underground fighter out there. The one! The only! BEEEEEEEE-HUNTERRRRRR!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I really don't wanna study. Send me out to fight already!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Hah hah hah! Somebody likes me a lot!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Hah! After this promotion, ain't no way I'm gonna let you down! Lemme show you what I can do in a fight, Boss!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Here I come!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Chow's on me after we win this one!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Relax, Boss. Ain't nobody can go three rounds with me!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: So you're the ones looking for a beatdown. You guys?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What's up?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Gimme the bell!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's do this.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Eat this!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Get over here!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: One-two, one-two, one-two!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: C'mon, c'mon! Bring it on!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The stronger the matchup, the more pumped I get!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: K.O.! Check it out, Boss. See 'em all piled up there?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: That's a wrap. Let's head back and chow down!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ouch… Where's the Boss? Is the Boss okay?!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room's a lot better than any I had before!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You brought food? You're the best, Boss!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hey, hey, hey! There you are, boss! I was just out having some honey with the others! Man, it's nice to have a stable income. Now I can buy as much honey as I want. Sure beats gathering it myself, with all the stinging... You're the best, boss!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What's up, Boss.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Honey-grilled fins! I just came up with the recipe a few days ago, and it's sure to be a blast! Same goes for fin jerky with honey. Why aren't I sharing any then? I couldn't hold myself back and ate it all last night.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The way Rhodes Island fights is different from what I'm used to, but that doesn't bother me one bit! And I only learned after coming here how many people look down on the Infected. But don't worry! Me and my fist will change their minds!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Ehi, Doctor. Hope you don't mind if I bring my weapons inside. I'll plop myself right over here.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Somebody out to get you, huh? Then have a long, hard think about who you might've wronged in the past.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If someone's out for revenge on you, don't hesitate, just take them out. Once you decide to pick up a weapon, you don't need a reason to kill.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It's been a while... I see that Texas made some friends. Hehehe... Affascinante! Can't wait to get to know them!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: You think I'm an assassin, huh? Yeah, alright. Call me whatever you want. I can be anyone, do anything, kill anyone anytime. Just so long as I want to!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I love power, Doctor. And you offered me a job where I can use my power to my heart's content... Love it. Honestly, the only joy I get out of this insane world is using my power to conquer it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Texas? Ha, she's afraid of me, but I don't wanna do anything to her, except maybe try to bring back the old Texas. The one we got here's a cucciolo impaurito.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: That red one... oh... Doctor, keep her away from me! She'd definitely kill me in a fight. But I have this feeling... this feeling... ugh, why do I want to fight her so badly?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You want to know what happened between me and Texas? Hehe, you don't have a single idea of what you are sticking your nose into. You'll find out the truth someday, but not from me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sleep tight... enjoy your sweet dreams while you still can.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: A great evil stands in the way of justice. My master, in the name of hatred and revenge, lead the weak onward!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Don't you just love how I keep getting more and more powerful?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Hahaha! Bene! I love how much you trust me. You can't say the same for Texas, right?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Molto bene! That's more like it! Strength, unfettered and unchained! That's what I'm talking about!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Make Texas the leader!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Put Texas on my team!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Haha, you people... I don't think I'll even remember your faces after this one... Anyway, let's just get started.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: We're fighting you guys? Then please do your bestest job, or I'll be really bored.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Show me what you've got.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Tell me, what's your plan?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Solid positioning.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Ahahaha!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: C'mon! C'eri quasi, tesoro!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Can you do it?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Just try me!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You'll have to try harder than that!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: It's over? Ah, che noia!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hahaha, sliced 'em up like a millefoglie. How do you like it?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Not my best work. You can lay it on me for letting a few get away.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Bravo! Now I want to crush them that much harder! Hahaha!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hm? Did I see a red shadow flash by?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Haha!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: The more I get to know you, the better I understand Texas. I Love it.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Where's Texas? It's almost time for the countdown, shouldn't she be at Rhodes Island? Hah, to think I don't even get to see her on a day like this. Where are those precious friends of hers? I'm going to find Texas. Wanna come with, Doctor?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Heh. Ciao, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Is it so strange that I got you a gift? Do you not like it, or did you just not expect it…? I can tell by your face, you loved my gift, didn't you? What did Texas give you? Let me see! Whose do you like better?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Here, take some whiskey, add a little amaretto, then put it on the rocks. Wanna sip? Hehe. In Siracusa, we call this a 'Luci Spente,' and one sip means you're killing the guy next to you. Texas? She'll never tell you this, but she used to love this drink. Come, salute!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Didn't notice me behind you, eh? It's only natural. I'm a cat. We're known for being silent prowlers!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hey, don't touch my hat... it's crazy, you know! If it feeds you too many secrets, Doctor, you'll be in trouble.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: So rare to see a pharma take in runaway kitties from a jail. Did you all want a peek at my maps? Or,  was it some advice on prison breaks?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: We thieves have our own principles and standards too... perhaps. Who can say?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Meow, meow, meow... Meow? Never you mind, I'm just talking to myself.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Anytime you want. Don't you worry, I have friends everywhere. Eyes everywhere.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Curiosity can kill a cat, you know.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm in a good mood right now, so here's a riddle for you. 'Why is a raven like a writing desk?'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Thank you, for this 'Haze' I'm now.But... did you catch a peep of any of them, along the way? Any of, well... my secrets?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Asleep like a baby... Time to get 'meown to business,' then.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Haze. I like relaxing work environments, and an employer who knows better than to bother me with too many questions.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Yummy.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? What's that? Does it taste good?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Finally out of those old shackles... and here I am, straight into new ones. The destiny of a thief's no wonder.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Give me a bit of freedom and I'll be happy.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What do we need a leader for? Can't everyone just fight on their own?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Meow... It's driving me wild... this sweet, sweet smell of freedom!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Everyone, no need to have cold feet here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Meow?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Here we go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Out and about.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Like a shadow.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: How do nya like this?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Careful, kittens. Don't lose your mittens.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You think you've got all the trimmings, don't you?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Nah-ah-ah, Don't get carried away.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No one stands above a kitty in the end!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Perfect victory? Whatever. A victory's a victory afterall.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Do you know how many enemies you let go? That will be a spanner in the works.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm no stranger to running for it, but this is just too embarrassing...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Kotatsu. Where's the kotatsu?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Meow?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Meow? I'm not satisfied yet. You know my rule: if I can't have it, I want it.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New year? A year is such a long time for a kitty. And happiness won't come knocking if one worries about more than just today. Speaking of which, today is really nice for napping. Doctor, how about we just spend this day with some lazy, cozy naps.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, nice to meet nya.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Meow? My best wishes aren't enough? Don't tell me you want some presents, you greedy kitty. Well then, what do you want? Shall I give you a riddle, or allow you to rub my ears?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A kitty visits gardens that provide food. But if someone tries to lock the kitty up, it will surely run away. When the kitty's in a good mood, however, it can bring back some tasty stuff as thanks. Know what I mean, Doctor? Be sure to make Rhodes Island a garden that everyone likes.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Good day. Please allow me a moment of prayer... before I resume my work for the day...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: O benevolent Herald, hear my prayer: please watch over my dreams and ward my soul…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hehehe… Cutting things... cutting things is such fun... Yes, some things were disconnected from the very beginning, their integrity only a false fiction...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Ehehehe... Hahahah... AHHAHAHAHAH!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Ehehe…Why were you dodging my sight? So pointless... because I already know exactly what your heart desires...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I have always, always wanted to bring you to a special place... A place where secrets are imparted...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: What did you do to me...? Why was I made to drink that strange medicine? Who brought me to this place? PLEASE ANSWER ME!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: That person's words are the complete and utter truth... Dissecting them, dismembering them, disemboweling them... it all grants them salvation...!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You see many things in your dreams that are hard to comprehend?... Those things you see are that soul's despairful tidings... And I, as the messenger, here to convey this exhortation to you... heh…

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hearken... Hear the whispers of vast creation's master, echoing from the deep...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Specter, that is what the spirits call me... That kind doctor informed me that I may receive further treatment by helping Rhodes Island... Yes, of course, my powers are yours to command.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Power... is flowing into me...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I have no right to go against your will...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Will this position be a new source of joy for me...? Or... will working for you become my life's joy...?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Good night, my brothers and sisters.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: As you wish.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: This will be a path paved with sacrifice.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: All these lost souls on the battlefield... I offer them to you.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Humbly awaiting your command.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Please let me know the results.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I come from the depth of the ocean…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You are the one who woke me.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Grant joy unto me!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Return to the abyss!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I care not for valueless ones.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: There's no escape.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I have conquered all trials you gave me... Were you watching me?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Please guide these lost souls to peaceful enlightenment...!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: None of you shall leave this place!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: They shall pay for this... They must pay…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: May I ask you to assign me to a room where I can see the starry sky?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Heheh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor... What is it inside you… that is driving me to this blissful ecstasy?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Another year has passed? Ahh, how long my years were spent in the sea, so long I cannot even remember how I last spent them... Never we mind. Tell me, Doctor, would you like to be with me by the windowsill today, to watch the stars?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You are... Ah, the Doctor, isn't it?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: How did I spend birthdays before now? Heheh. I don't remember too clearly... While I'm still lucid, Doctor, take this. An illuminous pearl, to be a valuable speck of light to you in the dark of night, there among illusory visions…

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Heheheh. I may have seen some vision or other... You should be careful, Doctor. On the route you've chosen, disaster is unavoidable, and it is far more, and far closer, than you ever bargained for. And I—will live in the true field of battle…

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: This place smells… dangerous.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I prefer to work alone, by myself.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Name, bounty, kill. Simple. That's the agreement with Kal'tsit.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Wolves have fangs, I have my blade. Wolves do not rest, neither do I.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Granny's calling... I can hear her.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Bleak wind, corpses on the ground, screams under the stars... I smell them all, the scent of wolves. I join the hunt.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Family? I have no family. I am always alone. Do you need a family, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: They avoid me... I just want to touch their tails. Provence, and Texas... I like their scent.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, sometimes I wonder... if I weren't a wolf hunter, would my life be different? Oh, you mean… I should answer the question... myself?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor... no, nothing. I thought you fell asleep. Don't sleep, not now.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Projekt Red, wolf hunter, smells wolves.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: As long as it helps me hunt.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: As you like it.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: A promotion? This will disguise me. I accept.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Infiltration successful.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The hunt begins.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The scent... it's thick.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hurry up.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Simple and clear.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Speed.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Skill.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: From shadows!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Distract them.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: No way out, for you.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Your death... is in my eyes.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Targets, all down

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The one way a hunt can end.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: This kill... too small.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Sorry... My blade... not sharp enough.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I prefer to be outside. But… it's okay.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Watch your hand. I might cut you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: *sleepy noises*

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: A new year? That means a new hunt? Not yet? Understood. Then I rest… Doctor, you rest too.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Tired, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've seen people. Many people. They went to the Doctor's room, and left things. That spells danger… it doesn't? Birthday presents? Oh, well… I'll lend you this fluffy ball to touch. But you have to give it back.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island has many walls. But I can feel the wind on the deck. Kal'tsit and the Doctor are here. I... like this place.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: If you need your room cleaned, I'd be glad to help, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You seem really interested in my tail, don't you? You say it's furry and looks cute? Well, wanna touch it? No one else has a tail like this, you know!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Water is precious in the wild. Rhodes Island is in no danger of having a drought right now, but that doesn't mean we should waste water.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It's my duty to search for and rescue those who encounter Catastrophes. I rarely find any survivors though...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Retrieving beacons, exploring mineral deposits, and recycling... Then we can call it a day!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Mr. Grape is my buddy and a capable partner I can rely on! Where he came from, you ask?... Uh, hmm... Now that's a good question. Where did we first meet?...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: W-what's with that red one...? I... can't stop trembling... uh... Doctor, can you lend me your arm? I'd feel much safer that way...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Those who do Catastrophe relief work often develop all kinds of mutations. What mutation do I have? Well, it's better not to ask. The more you know, the more dangerous it gets for you, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Catastrophe relief workers in the wilderness... don't usually come out unscathed. No need to worry about me, though! I'm already very happy to have a chance to rest at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Aw, falling asleep in this kinda place again... Guess 'safety' isn't a part of your vocabulary.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Provence, your average Catastrophe relief worker. Hmm, why are you staring at me like that? Interested in my tail?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: So... does this bring me closer to what you imagined I should be?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: It's fun working with you, Doctor!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I sense a storm approaching Rhodes Island. But don't worry, leave the evacuation to me! I'm an expert at Catastrophe prevention!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Who will I be teaming up with this time?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't worry. Everything will be fine.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: My job is to bring everyone home safely.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I despise natural Catastrophes and enemies equally!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Is it my turn?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I am in peak condition!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Let's greet 'em with a warning shot.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Arrows loaded. Ready to go!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I've warned ya! Now time for Crowd Control!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Pinpointing enemy weakness!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'll distract the enemy.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: The wilderness has its own rules.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Compared to natural Catastrophes, these enemies are really powerless.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Disaster assessment report: we received zero damage!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Everyone worked hard. Even if we suffered some damage,  let's not be discouraged!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Aw... my assessment was off. This'll leave a spot on my record for sure...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It'd be nice to have a room to rest in!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I've got a fluffy tail~ a fluffy tail~♪

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I'm measuring my tail, because I think it's grown since the last time I checked... Could you hold the tip for me? And here's a ruler... let me see...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, good morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: This is the kind of day to try new things, Doctor. Trust me, the memories you make on birthdays will last a lifetime. I've already looked up the weather and lay of the land, and I've got backpacks ready to go. Let's head on an adventure for a couple of days!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Stopping Catastrophes is still beyond me. We might not have a real solution for decades, even centuries. But what I hope for right now is to save as many as I can, from both Catastrophe and those who would exploit it.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Greetings, Doctor... Is there anything you'd like to discuss?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You look quite pale... You say your chest hurts? Don't overwork yourself, please get some rest. Don't be afraid, I'm right beside you. Everything will be okay...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You've seen my healing Arts somewhere before?... That must have been your imagination. Yes, our memories do deceive us on occasion…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: 'Confessarius?' Where did you learn this word? My apologies, but I'm afraid I cannot continue this topic.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: We Sarkaz combined our inherent Arts affinity with the power of Originium to develop new healing Arts,  we've been doing this for quite some time to succour those who drag themselves in the mire.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Now, you ask? Now we have nothing left. That war bereaved us of all hope.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Who is Nearl to me? Well... She's a travel companion, and I trust her with my very life.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: There are those who will sacrifice their all to deliver others from their pain. And Nearl, she is just the kind.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Once upon a time, I followed someone who shone bright as the beacon of hope, until wicked machinations took the light away. But this time, the incandescence will cease nevermore, even at the cost of my life...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: This quiet… it reminds me of my time back home.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Shining, the roaming medic. I look familiar to you? It is possible our paths have crossed.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The power to merely heal wounds... is not enough.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A medic's hand cannot reach all those in need.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Yes. I must be more than a medic—I will live on as a guardian. As has always been my goal. Doctor, please bear witness to my oath.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: To the battlefield, are we not?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: A battle for our own delieverence, is it not?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: War, ever inevitable.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: May the war grant us the redemption we seek... or will it?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Let's begin.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Yes, I'm listening.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Flourish, or perish.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: 'Tis but a flash in the drift of time.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Your life is mine to protect.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Fear not.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Grief, ever echoes in our souls.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Agony, ever etched on our hearts.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Our wills and spirits are ever burning against the fiercest enemies.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No matter the sins, all will fall to ashes with lives at the end of time.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Return not to the battlefields. You will find no redemption here.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Victory and loss... are insignificant moments in an endless cycle.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I will be fine, so long as I have a quiet place to be alone.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yes? What is it?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: It's been some time since I've known such serenity. I can even hear your heartbeat.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Fireworks... beautiful. I used to be one buried in research, pitting myself against death, lingering about the battlefield, and no more. Now, I have myself a moment of rest in which to gaze up at the night sky... Life's turns truly surpass anyone's expectations.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How are you feeling today, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: The day of your birth, is it? When a young life leaves the womb a newborn babe, the happiness and the hope in that moment will dwell in them, as well as their loved ones, for ages to come. Doctor, it honors me to the core, that I may celebrate a day so special alongside you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Chaos still arises without respite across this land, and the most we can do is save the wounded. The peace Rhodes Island has brought me is one I've never chanced to feel before. But, Doctor, the road ahead still stretches afar, and those oldest dreams of mine, I still continue in the wake of.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Salutations, Doctor. May the light be with you.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, I ask that you give me the most dangerous assignment available, such that my shield and I can best protect those in need.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The title of 'Knight' should be a symbol of honor. And yet now, it's been reduced to a mere commodity...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: As long as the light continues to guide me, I will neither bow to cruelty nor kneel to violence.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm grateful as always for your service, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The Kazimierz chivalric spirit should have been a force of salvation for all who suffer in this world. But now, it's nothing more than a rotten legacy, used to benefit the rich. Nothing is more shameful.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Shining, too, is a beam of light that guides me forward. She carries the hope I've long sought.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Something flickered in Shining's eyes when she heard the name Rhodes Island. I had no idea what it meant...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: In this time and age of a world plagued by Oripathy, may the ray of hope from Rhodes Island light the way.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Let us embrace this momentary respite.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Margaret Nearl, the Radiant Knight of Kazimierz...and now a Rhodes Island Operator. I will defend your life and your honor with my shield.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you for granting me power.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor. These new powers shall bring relief to those who suffer. This I shall engrave upon my heart.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Shining once said that dawn remains distant. But I believe that, one day, we will revive the dying glory with our very own hands.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I shall protect them from all harm.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I shall not blemish Rhodes Island's name.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I am ready. Set out!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Honor must be defended.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: In your name.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I shall give my all to you.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I shall cover you!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Get behind me!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Light, heed me!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I'm with you!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Don't be afraid.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Revitalize!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: A true knight will not bend to the threat of violence. Now, repent for your sins, in front of my warhammer.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Let us go forth. And there will be one day…

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A true knight will not chase one who's lost the will to fight. Everyone deserves a chance to choose a new path.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We must not give up now.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I shall keep watch here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I sense an intru- Oh, Doctor?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, umm... may I enter your office? I've heard you have a vast collection of literature.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Tonight in the Grand Knight Territory, the corporations who've won the bidding war for firework permits will blanket the sky, and out in the barrens, destitute settlements will warm themselves on firewood as a rare luxury. While you can have your name written in those New Year's fireworks, I'm more than glad that I have brought those people firewood.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Aplogies that I don't have anything that might pique your interest with me, but perhaps you'd like this book on the history of the knights of Kazimierz? Forgive me, I've already given you my knight's oath, and anything I could grant you beyond that is negligible by comparison.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When I was bestowed the title of Radiant Knight, the General Chamber of Commerce didn't much appreciate my shine. Fortunately, neither Shining nor Rhodes Island have since found me too bright to look at. As vast as the land is, I imagine the rays of the sun will only reach so far. In that respect, I will strive until I can strive no more.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Better to get your job done first than wasting time on chitchat.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You'd better remember that failing to adapt makes you a useless burden.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Work, eat, run, repeat. Big fricking whoop. Isn't that how life is for anyone these days?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My job was to take care of 'troubles' for my employers. Eventually they started to call me Scavenger.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Just like the two sides of a coin, no matter how splendid the face is, the backside is always stained with dirt.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've adapted to this place really well since I joined? Pfft, rubbish. It's just that I've gotten used to working on the surface.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: That's Provence, isn't it…? The wretched girl who got Infected while rescuing people from a Catastrophe... Look at that massive tail she's got...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You know, Doctor... I hated the idea of working with other people, at first. I figured our methods would clash. But at some point, I came to realize that's not the case.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: If only she were still alive... Now all I can do is carry on alone, carrying her dreams on my back.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: How can you sleep so soundly when you're defenseless…?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Scavenger. Leave the dirty work to me. Just pay me like my other employers and we'll be good.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: No, it's not enough...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This still isn't enough. I need to become stronger...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thanks, Doctor. I feel like I have a reason to fight now.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Do I need to quip just 'cause I joined the team?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't you hold me back.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Conceal yourselves so the enemy won't find you.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hmph, time for a clean up.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hurry up.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Are we doing this?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Tch.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I know what to do.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Garbage.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Keep writhing in the gutter!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: There is no turning back for you!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You get no sympathy!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Gotta say that mission was a special one.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmph. They have only their own weakness to blame.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Tch, some of them got away. I'm disappointed in you.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Dammit! Screwed up again...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Just give me a dark corner.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Argh! Let go of me!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What? You want me to dispose of you too?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's? Tsk, just another day, nothing different. But if you need a reminder, crowded places mean more stupid crap can happen, so don't get too lost in the fun, okay?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You got a job for me?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I did use to take birthdays seriously... but who's out there still counting every year they live these days...? Whatever. If you'd like, I could wish for you to have fun today or something.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Ugh. Just waiting for you to clear out before I grab some cheese from in there. What? My job's never been anything but cleaning up the filthiest of places. Telling me my name's gonna show up on your honor roll?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You want me at your side to see if Rhodes Island can live up to the talk. Hmm... Alright then, so long as your security doesn't give me too much trouble.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Life in the Truckers Mutual Aid Association? We drive, we deliver, we drink, we mess around and have a good time. Nobody bares their fangs in Nuova Volsinii... But as my mentor once said, the Fangs will never truly disappear.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: At first, I couldn't get used to pizza and spaghetti. My mentor was the one who taught me to mix finsauce into spaghetti, and replace the salsiccia on pizza with bacon. Had to find a way to fit in with the wolfpack, she said. So, I've eaten like this through all my years in Siracusa. Why? Because it tastes alright.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Truth and Justice... That's the book my father used to read to me when I was little. He even took me to meet the author, who was later imprisoned by some duke, died in jail, and was buried in a mine. Pretty awful, no? But that's how things were, at the time.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My father said that Sergei would become the greatest of all scientists, even if he was born in Ursus. I thought they were friends, partners, and kindred spirits... Yet Sergei stabbed them all in the back. He deserved to die, but I also doubt whether the blame was his alone.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Where did I learn to fight? From my mentor. She taught me to turn hatred into power, but not to hate. She taught me to fight, but not to step onto the battlefield... What a strange 'wolf' she was. Too bad I didn't figure out her final lesson sooner.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Director Kal'tsit, Dr. Kal'tsit. No matter what hat she wears, she's still her same, cold-blooded self. Yet, I do find it believable that she didn't betray my father. Maybe she's not as ruthless as she looks, after all. Hmm, what do you think, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: In all the time I stood behind Talulah, I watched her crush dream after dream, morphing into our very own tyrant... That was my mistake, and one I will not make again... Kill her? No. What I want is to tear off the tyrant's crown.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You've united many under your banner. This is familiar to me. I've stood with such people, and also against them... But do beware, leaders like you are known to make grave errors. When you do, I'll look you dead in the eyes, and I won't hesitate—Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: She learned her song by snow, she learned her blade by rain… She learned to show her courage, by fire that swept the plain… She learned to topple crowns, by all the silent pain... Oh, you're awake. No, it's nothing. Just a Siracusan nursery rhyme.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Crownslayer. It's a name we both know well, so let's keep it. Maybe one day you'll come to understand its true meaning.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Old combat records? Got anything with me in it? Come on, let's give it a try. I won't lose this time.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Alright, alright. Enough with the formalities already. I couldn't care less about your little medals and ribbons. Do you take me for some general or noble? Or, would you prefer I test my blade on them?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island chose to trust me, so I'm willing to return that favor. Acceptance speech? Wait, you people aren't really expecting me to give one, are you?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Just give me a target. My smoke will be their grave.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Lead a squad…? Alright. I'm actually curious how you Rhodes Islanders do things.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Move out. Watch the smoke, and don't get separated.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Contact. Everyone, spread out!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My old methods still work.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: My knife hasn't dulled.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I strike from the smoke.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll slay the crown.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Drink deep of the suffering of the deceased.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Taste the fury of the forsaken.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Hate. It's all you deserve.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Weep. Those will be your last words.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Very well. I'm honored to be part of this victory.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Sound strategies, and outstanding execution. No wonder your operations are so efficient.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The necessary lives have been taken. Mission accomplished.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Smokescreen deployed. Retreat, we'll find another chance later.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Not sending me out on a field mission today? Suit yourself.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Y-You can see me? But, I threw down a smokescreen...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Take off my mask? I'd rather not. Hehe, hard to breathe with all the smoke, right? I keep it on for a reason.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Never imagined I'd be welcoming the New Year on Rhodes Island. But here I am, with all of you… Looks like we've changed a lot. Happy New Year. To you, and to Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Have you been on the ship all day, Doctor? Uh, Me? No, I just happened to be behind you. It's pure coincidence.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: That crown on your head... It's just a prop the operators made for your birthday? Happy birthday to you then. Hehe, don't worry, I won't slay this crown.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Infected or otherwise, there are so many on this land who yearn to live freely and with dignity. Some of them have failed, but so many more are still pressing on. May you continue to move forward with them, Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Here I am! What should we play, baseball or board games? Oh, you're working?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Where was I born, you ask? Well, umm...no idea. But that doesn't matter, right?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hello, Professor Rhodes Island! Wait, am I calling you by the right name?...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hm, what's my assignment today? To capture some long, sleek animals?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Hey! Don't knock on my backpack! Oh, sorry, I'm not mad, I'm just worried. If you're not careful, you could hurt your hand! Here, let me show you how it's done.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: If anyone dares to hurt you, I'll smash them with my baseball bat. Oh, uh... so... there really are people who hurt you? Um... actually, I'm not that good at fighting, hehe…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I love spending the whole day just walking down the street. I get to watch the people, enjoy the sunshine, and then… lose my way!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You've been treating my sickness, and you gave me a place to live... you're really so kind...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, are you my big brother? Or big sister?... Well, does't matter! I'm not leaving you, even if you throw me out! It's not like I can walk far anyway.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh, the Doctor is busy. I'll just play by myself then...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hm? Where am I? Who am I?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I can make myself super tough! It's my only special skill!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? What's a promotion?... Whatever, let's play for a bit longer! You and me, together!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: New position or not, I don't really care. All I want is to be by your side every day. Can you grant this tiny wish of mine?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I've got lots of friends here!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everybody, let's go!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We'll be fine if we stick together!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Everyone, let's play!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm here~!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Ora ora!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hey, dummies, bring it on!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Muda muda muda muda!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: C'mon, show me what you got!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This is my playground!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I won't back down!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Was that tough? Didn't feel much different from any other battle.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Homerun!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Safe!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Aww... struck out…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Just don't throw fireballs at me, okay?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wow, fun!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey Doctor! Can we play a little bit longer? Just a little bit!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy new year, Doctor! I'm looking for the place I was first found. It's somewhere around on the deck. Was it here… or there?... Hm? Why am I looking for it? Because I was actually having a cozy nap when you guys found me. The sunshine was so warm... And I want to take a nap like that again! Hehe...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Heya! Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Hey, hey, Doctor! Happy birthday! These are for you: this baseball bat, these mitts, and this baseball! Come on, let's play!... You still got work to do? You're working on your birthday? Can't you take a day off? Aww…

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Hehe, they're all busy having fun outside! I'm gonna pack up my bag a little, then get out and return with cool stuff loaded on my back! What's in my bag? A baseball, pair of mitts, and… Doctor, just between you and me, and promise to keep it from the Medical Department—I also got some snacks in there!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hey, Doctor. I'm here to hang!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, don't look down on me just 'cause I'm little. Back where I'm from, all the kids looked up to me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Durin used the name of our race as her codename because she's so lazy, but isn't it kind of dumb how calling me 'Myrtle of Durin' made me sound like I belong to her or something?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I understand how all the machines here work, but it still feels weird using them. Some have a lot of different parts, but some are surprisingly simple.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My banner? Good eye, Doctor. It sure is a tablecloth from my house. I sneaked it out with me because it can't get dirty. My dad is probably pretty mad about it!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Is my apple really that great? They're popular back home. You can study or play with it if you want, Doctor, just don't break it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There are still many things I'm not used to on land, but I love the many delicious foods. The cafe on Rhodes Island is my favorite!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I do have to point out the fact, Doctor, that I am a full-grown adult! And I'm tall by Durin standards! Please tell everyone to stop patting me on the head and giving me candy!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Say, Doctor, are you interested in my homeland? I can take you there! But it's pretty far, so wait till I'm in the mood.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you taking a break? You can use my banner as a blanket.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Reporting in! You must be the Doctor? Call me Myrtle, Myrtle of Durin. Durin said I could get a job here, so what have you got for me? I may be small, but I'm tough!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Cool fight... Got some more, Doctor?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Oh, did I get promoted? Does that mean I can go somewhere I couldn't before?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I told you I'm tough! Told you!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: There's a mission? I wanna go!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't anyone wander away.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't worry, you got me!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Whoa, almost dozed off...

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Good scenery here, Doctor!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'm here to help!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I have to get serious now!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Gather around me, guys!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: We're counting on you again today, little apple.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew, I'm exhausted! I wanna go to lie down, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Flawless victory! I was pretty good, wasn't I, Doctor?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We won, Doctor, and that's what counts!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Run!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Wow, Rhodes Island is huge!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey, that is fun!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Why can't the cafe open 24 hours?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Take the flag down, tie it up over here... Good! That's my cloth sack done! Oh, Doctor, you're here, too. Come, we'll eat up all the tasty food in the canteen! It's the first day of the year. Let's kick it off by eating our fill!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Any more fun things to do, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: So, Doctor, today's your birthday, huh? Then as a mature adult, let me give you a little present. Hm, Doctor, kneel down a little... Ahem-hem. Good job, good job... Alright! That was a compliment from the Generalissimo herself. You did well, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I guess I followed Durin to a pretty nice place. I've seen huge nomadic cities, beaten up so many baddies in battle, and eaten so many great foods I'd never seen before. Once I get home, I'll turn all these stories into a travelogue and get it published. It's bound to be a bestseller!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You want to chat future op planning? You've come to the right person, Doctor, love. I'm the entire stuffing brains of Glasgow.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Eugh, this doesn't taste right. Is this can gone off...? Ay, get Hannah to try this for me, will you? Oh, and if she scoffs the whole thing in one go... well, waste not want not, yeah?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why do I fight with such a naff-off big machete? Because I'm trying to be efficient here! If I scare some enemies off, that's enemies I don't need to do in. I mean obviously, I'm handy with me fists too. 'Cuz you spend as long as us on the streets, you learn how to scrap from every angle.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: When we left the Glasgow Gang behind, see, I thought we'd all be back in a jiffy. But here we are ages later, and still on the go. Everything's changed. Vina, Hannah, Baird, and especially me... yeah, I might have changed most out of us.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I had my grievances, I did. While Victoria was booming, I was living on scraps. Who said I should pay the price once the bloody place went arse-up? But look at me, I came back anyway. I mean, my life, everyone I care about... all of it's here still.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I guess me old Morgan's Memoirs is gone. Probably lost it in the Glasgow Gang base, if you'd even call it a base... and if the Glasgow Gang still exists. War's not some heroic fantasy. There's moments of deathly honest grief... just, instants you can't describe.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I got a good head on my shoulders, don't I? Not like I'm book-smart or anything here—the most I'm good at is scheming a thing or two in the street. Be honest, sometimes, there's this thought that plagues me, how maybe I'm no help to Vina at all... What, that's rubbish, you think...? Yeah, alright, fair dos, love! I can't be quitting now!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: It might be easy for us to follow the leader, but you know what? While we go after Vina—who's Vina got to go after? I don't want to be behind her anymore, Doctor. I want to go with her, or take her along. That way, when she gets tired, at least she'll have my shoulder to rest on.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Once we succeed with all this, I... hahah, the ffffirst thing I wanna do! Is go out and get smashed with the girls again... Doctor, promise me, you'll come crawling with us. We'll have a right hoot... forget all our troubles. Sound good, love?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Ay-yi-yi, someone's wide open. I could do some face painting on you, love?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Alright, Doctor? I'm Morgan. Vina said you'd like some assistance from me? I've got brains to pick and brawn with a machete—whatever you need, love, just ask.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Not bad, not bad, learned a thing or two. In exchange, why not have a copy of How to Fight with the Glasgow Gang?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Well, I'm honored! You've got a sharp eye, Doctor, just like Vina.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: There'll be plenty more trouble in future for the Glasgow Gang, but you won't catch me running. Whatever we can't handle, you bet I'll keep trying to figure it out. Whatever we can handle, you let my machete and Molotovs do the work!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Coming, love, coming. Not too late, am I?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: No prob. Minding you lot's a breeze compared to Glasgow.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Doctor, love, how'd you even come up with these plans?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Maybe let's try ambushing them?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Machete's all sharp.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Alright, who am I hacking up?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Watch. There's method to a brawl.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Can't just be all brawn.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ay-up! Watch your left.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Nah, mate, I'm on your right.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Lessee, who's the next sap getting duffed up?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You don't win until you beat us all.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: All that command was complex stuff... I'm having trouble keeping up now. Doctor, love, once we're back, can you break down today's battle for me? You'd do me a solid!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, want to celebrate the Glasgow way? First me and Hannah grab a leg each, then we shut our eyes, and then we hip-hip-hurray and send you flying... ay, no need to run, love, I'm just joking!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I know every bend around these parts. Give me one minute, and I'll root those bastards out.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm not... I'm not falling here. The story of Vina and every one of us... is NOT over!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Dead quiet around here... hahah, makes me wish I could do it like Vina and kip somewhere.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ooh, surprise Doctor attack!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Got some good news to share, Doctor? Because if you don't, let me tell you a joke.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's a New Year, and I want to see Vina happy, Hannah mucking things up less, and I'd like Dagda to loosen up some. Right, and for you, Doctor... mmm, a bit less work, a bit more time to yourself. That way, I could take you around Londinium for a proper stroll.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Alright, Doctor! Fancy seeing you about.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, thank you for giving us a place we can call home. Here—I ordered in a whole box of Victorian-make lollipops, a YEAR'S worth, just for you, love. Come on, try try try, see how the... soap flavor tastes first, yeah?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Norport's a borough full of Infected. Them, and the mariners out of a job and the old workers and the thugs like us, we're all people Londinium doesn't want. And then here... everyone gets equal work opportunities. *sigh* Why can't it just be like Rhodes Island out there?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: If you got enemies about, just scream. I'll keep ya safe.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Where's that kid gone off to? Y'know, her... the really tanned shorty who's always trailing our Master... 'Morgan' is her nam- Oi! Stop right there!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours, we keep it real that way, yeah? You treat me with respect, I'll do the same for you.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Seems our Majesty's really into your place. Don't see that every day, seeing as we're never anywhere same for long.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Work or what have ya, you've gotta have guts!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, chew before you swallow, mate! HEY! SOMEONE BRING US MORE MEAT! This girl's got an empty belly to fill!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Bleeding Morgan... she might seem like a layabout mostly, but she's our tactician when push comes to shove. Gets the job done. Gets on my nerves otherwise, though, and she loves it. Tch...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doesn't she look brilliant, like a liege with a hammer in hand? I'm even more keen to see the look of her holding a sword, though.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Out with it! Don't beat around the bush, just say it: who do you want dealt with?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Tch. look at you spacing out like an idiot... Your own bloody fault if a tiger bites you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Indra. I don't have any of those weird crazy powers -- I let my fists do the talking. Nice to meet ya!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Niiice, this is good stuff.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotions are great, almost as great as fighting is!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Don't be afraid. I'll protect ya.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Where's the battlefield?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: So, who's in the market for a walloping?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Mind your own sodding business and let me be!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Come on! Show me what you've got!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Oi!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Get on with it, plod!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Haha!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: All right, it's my turn!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You bastard!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Nothing can stop me!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You're dead meat!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Give it up!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That's the stuff! That's what I call a kick!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You don't go home happy without some bloodshed!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Tch, we've got some who fled. Bunch of cowards.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Not bad... But I'll get you back for this!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What's this room about? More of a squeeze than anywhere I've been.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oi! You got a bleedin' death wish?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: C'mere, lemme get my arms around you! Yes, I mean hug you!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Ooh! Gotcher end-of-year bonus? Haha, I must be due for one too, scrapping so much on your behalf! You and me, we're fellows now, no two ways about it! Get up, I'm taking you out for food!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What's up, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Hah, it's your birthday today, then. Here's a prezzie: these brass knuckles. They're the tiger's choice, get all your average muckers done and dusted! You should learn to watch yourself too, I say. Can't always count on me being there when you're in danger, right? Still, if I'm around and anyone picks on you, their arse is good as kicked!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Vina trusts Rhodes Island. That's why I take orders from you, no hesitation. But you listen here, Doctor. You need to feel the weight of that trust. Else I'll make you feel it, even if I need my fists to do it—and I don't mean wanting to scrap with you. But you just keep what I've said in mind.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Siege's ordered me to serve as your assistant. I'll be a harsh supervisor for you, if it's called for.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Huh? Do you have a problem with my metal claws? They're totally brill! ...I mean... They're very... Wieldy. Please don't get the wrong idea about my taste.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Morgan picked this outfit. Obviously, something with a knightly air would definitely suit me more. Although this street style... is just a little bit... wicked.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Indra's a mess, both the way she lives and fights. That said, she'll go through hell and high water for her mates, and she'll fight to her last breath for Siege—maybe, she's more knight than some knights out there, and she's never even had to try.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Most of Victoria's people live out their whole lives in their own cities, while everyone aboard Rhodes Island has left their homes to drift around this land. It just bowls me over.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The Montague name and the title of Knight of the Tower used to be more precious to me than anything. But gradually, I came to see how change for Victoria was unavoidable, and it doesn't just stem from the flames of war before us. I may have to abandon my past to follow Siege, but I'll follow through, unto the very end.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Bound to uphold Victoria's dignity, the Knights of the Tower never once shrank back in the face of the Sarkaz's blades. I was the only one who escaped, protected by my brothers and sisters in arms... I often think to myself—if... just if... I could've fought to the end with them...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Siege said I should choose the life I truly want to live when the war is over. Once that day arrives, how will Victoria turn out to be? And how will I turn out to be? I... I can't imagine it. All I hope is I'm still able to stay by their sides.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}... From here onwards, my blade belongs to both Victoria, and you. You can call me either Dagda or the 'Dark Blade.' Isa? T-Too frivolous! But if you've got to... then keep your voice down!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: It's a Knight of the Tower's duty to stand night watch. May you rest well, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Knight of the Tower Isabella Montague. On behalf of Siege and our little alliance, I express our sincerest gratitude… What do you mean I don't dress like a knight? L-Looks can be bloody deceiving!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Umm...I'm seeing a wide gap between these tactics and my old training.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A medal? I can't accept any that's not Victorian... hmm, but you are the Doctor of Rhodes Island. Okay, I'm making an exception just this once.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Ever since we left Londinium, I've trained up a million more techniques than just knightly combat! Now you're going to see my true strength!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I've got no need to hide my identity if I'm fighting for Rhodes Island, yeah?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What style of command do you want from me? The knight type, or the gang type?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: A fight? Wicked, bring it on... Ahem, as a Knight of the Tower, I accept your challenge.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: These punks are nothing compared to the foes Victoria's surmounted!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Is this an order?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I await your word.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: To the death I go.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: As you bid.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Forward, back, forward. Got ya!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: For Victoria!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Even without a blade, I can run you through!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Any soldier's will is worthy of respect.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Be of firm enough conviction, and it won't matter what difficulties you face. You'll have nothing to be afraid of.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Is that it? I didn't get to show off my real skills yet... If there is a next time, permit I continue to stand by your side.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You can't reach perfection without pushing yourself to the limit. I must do better.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: If only I had a blade on me, I could... No, I can't give up now. Doctor, I'm ready to enter the next battle.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'll assume guard duties for this room.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Where do ya need me?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Stop calling me Isa...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Whenever they rang the last bell of the year, we Knights of the Tower used to stand still at the tower's top, watching the lights across Londinium dim one after the other... I'm the only one left, but I still want to hold a torch in my hands even now, to protect Victoria's light in its darkest hour.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good day, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, I wanted to do my bit for your birthday party, so I asked Saileach if she could teach me these desserts. Morgan and the rest like to say I'm bad at expressing my feelings out loud... So all I could do is try and make the cakes a little sweeter. I hope you like them.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Another year's come and gone. We've been through plenty of hard times together, and the path forward remains thistly. Even then, we shouldn't give in. In the end, I believe we'll triumph over everything, Doctor, and greet the day and watch the dark clouds scatter.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm keeping an eye on our surroundings. So far everything seems fine.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You should know that some of those eyes on you hold nothing but malice. You're not safe, not even at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Don't be afraid of those hostiles hiding in the shadow. No matter how those criminals try to hide, they can't escape my eyes.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'll have my revenge... even if I must lose my life for it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My clan, my friends, they all perished in the woods of our hometown... The only ones who mourned them were the trees, which gave unto them their leaves.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: This crossbow is manufactured for the sole purpose of punishing sinners. The day will come when I use it to pass my final judgement on those who deserve it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Meteorite... we used to be friends. On the day my hometown was destroyed, we were part of the small group that managed to escape.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Since then, I've never stopped searching for the traitor who led the rebel army to our town. Could it be Meteorite? No, I... It couldn't be her...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: ...Oh, did I fall asleep? Sorry, I've been spending more time patrolling these days... It's fine, you say? But... um, thank you for caring.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'd like to take a nap...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Firewatch here. I'm a sniper. To avenge my fallen clan, I need all the power I can get.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I need more power...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thanks for appointing me to this position.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you for the promotion. I hope you'll keep using my powers for the right thing. If you don't, however...

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The team is complete.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All Operators, get ready!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemies spotted. Taking action.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Awaiting instructions.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Searching for enemies.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I am in position.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Laying suppressive fire.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Target locked.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Strike inbound.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Firing!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I'm not done until I have my revenge...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: All targets eliminated. Mission complete.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission accomplished, request search for remaining hostiles.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Retreating... immediately...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'm not used to being in a room with so many people...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh!?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Uh, please don't touch my antlers... it tickles...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's? It's noisy, but I remember days like this back in the forest. We used to sing around the campfire, give each other bracelets weaved from vines... Do you want to hear the songs of my homeland? I've never forgotten them.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Huh? Oh, it's you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: You want to hear my harmonica? Fine. What are you in the mood for?… Calm and leisurely… Alright, here's a little tune called 'Greenleaves.'

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Today will be noisy. I think I'll find a quiet place to hide. Have fun with Meteorite and the others.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Since you summoned me, you must be eager to feast your eyes upon my elegant dancing form, right? Uh...? Help you move the luggage...? Hey! I didn't come here to do manual labor!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You're such a weak and ineffectual leader! How could you be so fragile? If it wasn't for the sorrowful tears Amiya would then shed, I'd convict you right here, right now!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You don't even know what conviction is? Now prick up your ears! The art of conviction is an assassination technique created by the first Conviction master, who combined traditional dance moves with ancient fighting techniques. And now, standing before you is his third-generation successor!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Conviction is not some barbaric fighting technique! It's an artform where beauty and ideals are poured into the fist, then delivered through the fist straight into the heart! Now you know!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: This art is the crystallization of hard work and great insight. When people ignore the true value of art and use this sacred product as some sort of game, Conviction will descend to right all wrongs.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Do you not revere in awe my aestheticly perfect image and overwhelming pressure? Then you're unworthy of your place on the same team as your savior! Ughhh! Con! Viction!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
