lines.text: I'm actually someone infected with Oripathy, an incurable disease?! Curses... is this my destiny? Is this the fate of all who wield the Conviction Punch? Hey, why are you all looking away! I'm clearly telling you a sad story!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You also wish to become Conviction? In that case, chew upon this question! 'You're standing at a junction in a railroad, with a train full of Durin people approaching. The junction splits off into two tracks, one upon which several artists with meager artistic achievements are...'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You don't even have the gumption to answer the easiest of Conviction's dilemmas! You have no artistic talent! Taaaaake this! Conviction - Second Style!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: ...Hoo! Hah! No, wait, wrong move. Let's try again!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Conviction. I shall use this name, with all the faith it entails, as my code name. You ask what my talents are? I'm a master of the deadly and beautiful art of conviction! Now shiver in reverence!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: An opportunity like this to become stronger is readily taken!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Ahaha, a promotion! The day when Conviction's hidden powers are released is not far away!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This sensation... it feels as if my artistic accomplishments have deepened, but also like something is welling up inside me...!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Due to my tendency to sometimes convict teammates, it would be safer for me to work alone.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: At last, your conviction arrives!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Your judgement is nigh!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Now, count up your sins!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: On my way!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: All right!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Here I stand!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You think you're a worthy opponent?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Con—vict!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Haah!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Hmph!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Back down!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: History is written by the winners… This is the doctrine of Conviction!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: How about it! Aren't you awed by my heroic majesty-- Hey, wait up! Don't leave me behind!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: It's fine. This victory might not be the most gorgeous, but it'll still serve us well.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ugh... the magnificent Conviction must never allow such a blunder…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's going to be another dilemma for me to convict this room…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Woahh! What are you trying to do this time! I'll teach you to behave!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy! New! Year! I bring Rhodes Island a dance most rich with the fragrance of Art. Enjoy with bated breath! All will receive a baptism by my gorgeous fistwork, and gain life anew!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, if it isn't the Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Your office entrance is all filled with finely-wrapped boxes! I've convicted each and every one of them! Now partake in this gift from me: Soldiers Assemble: Barrage Fortress! The Firestorm Update!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Even beside those who don't understand art, those who misrepresent art are the vilest! The despair, the drowning despair! To think that penguin's music should find so many worshippers—that it should earn Number 1! Who was the contractor for that showdown? I will! Con! Vict!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm? You want to watch me forge weapons? Sure, but be careful not to get singed.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Only weapons that don't see use go undamaged. Therefore, a spotless weapon is actually a terrible sacrilege.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Nowadays, weapon and equipment manufacturing is all modernized. Traditional craftsmen lose their livelihoods because of it. Times change. Those who can't keep up get left behind... that's only natural.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Firearms… these weapons will change the world completely.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My right leg? Oh, It's no big deal. You know, all craftsmen make mistakes.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you for giving me a chance to show what I can do.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You saw my name engraved on some equipment? Well, no need to mind that. Probably has nothing to do with me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Steel and bronze form the bone, and then…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: If me and my hammer can still be of use to you, I'm honored.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: They're promoting new drinks at the bar... What should I have today?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Vulcan, that's what everyone calls me. I can do maintenance on your weapons, if it comes up. The equipment I need for the forge is listed here, in this blueprint.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm… I'm feeling inspired. Gotta start the blowers. It's time to work.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A skilled craftsman is crucial to a military organization. I see you understand that well.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Keeping your weapons in good condition is the best way to keep your people safe. You agree with me? Seems I made the right choice joining you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I just want to focus on my work.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You're making me the leader…? If you insist… Still, I'm much better at designing and producing weapons than giving orders.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Can I stay behind and work? No?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hopeless imbeciles...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm on it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Ready and waiting.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Armed up!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Let the fires rage!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I don't need healing.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Your weapon will shatter under my next blow!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Please bring me any enemy equipment you find. I want to know what they're making now.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A victory, just as planned! This is why we need high-quality equipment for our fighters.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Please submit damage reports for all of your equipment. I'll work on repairs when we get back.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: My skills are still lacking…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Do you have a furnace here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Argh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Any equipment you have in mind? I can try making it for you.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. A moment please, I'm working the forge. In our trade, we believe that the flames must burn bright over the new year, so that we'll be able to craft strong equipment.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I'm not precisely sure what to give you as a present, since you don't need weapons. But the bar has been mixing some new drinks lately, and they've still got the ones I like. So how about I buy you a drink?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: People at Rhodes Island are beginning to understand the wonders of weapons. I was used to being alone, but now I get a few regular visitors... not that I mind. It's kind of fun, actually. Sometimes I even feel like a few more would be nice.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Um, it hurts my eyes in here... Doctor, could you turn down the office lights a bit? I'm not so used to bright rooms...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Um, did you really bring me here to be an Operator? Not to keep a watch on me? What about that doctor, Miss Kal'tsit? What is she going to do to me...?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My staff was passed down to me by my father. Its magic does something called 'Evernight' to those it touches. Anyone trapped in that illusion will... have trouble waking up the next day...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm used to being alone. When I feel lonely, I'll just talk to myself. Eheh... Hmm? Is that weird?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Stare deeply into my eyes. Feeling sleepy, aren't you? Hehe... Now, wouldn't you like to do something for me? Tell me, where does Rhodes Island store all its Originium?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You called for me? Oh yes, my disease is worsening. That's because you wouldn't give me your Originium, which means now this body is gradually disintegrating... So, just what should we do, Doc-tor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Um, please let me apologize! I mean, erm, I m-might still end up saying something weird, but please don't get angry... I just have no way to control 'her'…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Say, Doctor, if I were to suddenly end you, right here, how would everyone else react...? Argh! Grgh! No! I have to stop myself from... Hehe, I really would like to see it...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, don't you get tired of it, from time to time? Your work,life, feelings, everything... What would you say to just forgetting all of it, all at once? With my power, things like that can be arranged...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Your sleeping face is so cute, it makes me want to...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Nightmare... Ah, that's a code name. My real name is Gloria. But, if you don't mind, I'd rather you call me that... I think my code name... is kind of scary...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: You're making me stronger... but why...?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I came here as a patient, to get treatment for my disease. But now, I'm given to understand that that doctor wants me to fight for you, doesn't she?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Don't you think I'm only barely qualified for this promotion? Not that it matters—go ahead and call your shots. At this point, I'm just lucky to even be alive.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Alright, I'm coming.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I can't do this alone...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: What sorts of incredible powers will you show me? I can't wait to see.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: So these are our enemies? Well, well, you look like fun.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Um, is there anything to eat?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Say, why don't you let me take you on?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This is... the battlefield...!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Ah, the battlefield. How I missed you.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ahaha, why so serious?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Come on, relax for me.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: May you have sweet dreams...

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You'll run if—if you know what's good for you.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Victory... Always so refreshing.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Well, sorry, but this is the end I prepared for you.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We won. What more could you ask for?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: What... have I done...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'll be fine in the corner...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Argh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: D-did I do something bad again...? J-Just, please let me apologize. I'm so, sooo sorry...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor... My wish? Good health, so that I can help you out more... Ah, well, then my wish is for this wish not to come true so easily.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! It must be hard always carrying such heavy responsibilities, you deserve a break. Come closer, close your eyes, and let me bring you sweet dreams... Doctor?! S-Stay back, don't listen to me!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island feels so lively today. I like this sort of energetic atmosphere... Huh? A party? Er, maybe not... I'm happy enough watching everybody enjoy themselves...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: The fire alarm's gone off? Sorry, it was only me passing by your office. My body temperature must've sailed too high again.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: There's no language that's impossible to learn, no Arts that are impossible to understand. Isn't that the plain and simple truth? ...What? I'm the exception to the rule, you say?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My life plans...? Tch, everything was going swimmingly until that dreadful attack. But after Reunion murdered Phil, their eradication jumped to the top of my to-do list.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Rhodes Island's methods aren't nearly tough enough. All they'll do is drag King's Wand down.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Can you talk to Amiya for me? Poor girl, her kind heart clouds her judgment. As far as I'm concerned, total annihilation is the only fitting end for the wicked.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Your current skills wouldn't compare to even the average level of a King's Wand member such as myself. Ha, yes, I'm powerful... and the power of all five of us put together... words wouldn't even begin to describe.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Luminarie's blade was a gift from Shiro. I heard that the owner before Shiro was a swordmaster who could fell all the cherry blossoms of Higashi with a single swing. But even that legendary swordmaster was no match for Shiro, and had to surrender the blade.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: What happened to your shirt? What? I burned a hole in it? But... impossible... my self-control is impeccable, don't you think...? I... well, I'm sorry. Really, truly sorry.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: We might be on opposite ends of the spectrum when it comes to ideals, but I do enjoy seeing the people of Rhodes Island sweat away with bright hopes for the future. Yes, that is a compliment. It's a heartwarming sight.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: How lazy. You think it's fine to just sleep here and while away the precious day?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Skyfire of King's Wand. I will remain at Rhodes Island until my objective is accomplished. What's my objective, you ask? To burn every last Reunion thug to ashes, of course.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This is no way to go about unleashing my true power.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Naturally.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Ha. Enjoying the privileges I deserve from time to time is a good way to relax.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: This battlefield needs some heating up.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: The rays of the sun are my shield.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Now's the time to attack.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Kneel before the flame of the heavens.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Out with it.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What are your plans?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Bad luck is always in waiting for the weak.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: The wise alway take the initiative.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Here we go!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Fire! Blaze! Inferno!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: May the flames of the sun devour you!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: May the rays of the skies set you ablaze!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: There isn't a soul who may survive the sunflame.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Pathetic... you're nothing but ashes now. Were you hoping to leave a trace behind?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Is that it? I had  higher expectations.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Impossible... how could I...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Couldn't you ready a slightly cooler room for me?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Are you trying to get your hand burnt?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, could you explain this theory to me? I'll need twelve minutes of your time, that's all.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hmph, they won't let me near the fireworks. They say I could lose control and blow them all to kingdom come. They even set Logistics operators to guard the things. Why, I never—Eek! Get a fire extinguisher! …Anger causing a rise in body temperature is a perfectly normal physiological phenomenon. I—I'll steer clear of them!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How are you doing today, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Manipulating Originium Arts to bake little clay treats is a lovely way to practice my fine control of the flames, and it's quite safe. Here, this delightful cup is for you. Ah, and it even heats itself, so you'll always have hot water. But do be careful when you sip from it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I find I do think rather simply about some things. Pure power won't actually achieve everything I set for myself. It may hold the other side off for a while, but it doesn't get to the root of the issue. I must press on, Rhodes Island, I have much more yet to learn here.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, Dr. Kal'tsit sent me to take a blood sample from you. We can chat as I'm getting the needle ready.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Can I control the urge to feed, you ask? How dare you underestimate me! I'm a trained professional. Of course I can tell patients from food!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: It's my job to track blood indicators for all our operators, even if they aren't exactly happy about it—huh...? These blood bags? They're samples, of course! What were you thinking!?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: There's another one of my kind here. And she's an... engineer? Hm…maybe she likes the smell of machine oil more than blood?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Why I chose to become a doctor? I can't say it was any sort of lofty calling. It's just that, you know, OUR kind... we don't exactly have the brightest prospects. But it turned out my skills were actually in surprisingly high demand, so... I just went with the flow.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: How do we fight the urge to feed? We actually have a course that helps us control our desires. And we've invented artificial blood, so we drink that if we need. We can be very resourceful, you know.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: This is the standard procedure. It's the same for everyone getting blood drawn. Don't move, Doctor. Ah... blood... your blood... it smells delicious... It's just… it's just… captivating...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Replenishing saline solution! Changing filters! Sterilizing sand and charcoal canisters... all done! Doctor, you'd better keep your medical supplies well-maintained. As Dr. Kal'tsit said, when your kidneys give out, these machines are going to save your life... aw, come on, just kidding.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Fine, fine, I'll come clean... I have tasted lots of blood of many different types from all different races. And I do enjoy the subtle differences in flavor, okay? In fact, the only type of blood I've never tasted is... yours, Doctor. Heheh...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hm? So you still have time to sleep? I'm jealous.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Warfarin, the blood-scientist-slash-doctor. Besides typical healing Arts, I also bring you specialized medical treatments, courtesy of my remarkable expertise in hematology and plentiful experience. Anyway, look forward to working with you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hm, my work efficiency seems to have improved.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Are you even listening? We're having trouble collecting rare blood types for the emergency blood bank. So—what? What did you say? A promotion? Now?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This only means more work for me, right? Ha, I saw that a mile away! I'm an expert in this field after all. Don't worry, I am well prepared!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Wait, I need to prepare my equipment first.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: A leader reports only to you, right?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: My equipment is ready. We can start any time.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I don't have the leisure for enemy intel at the moment. Taking care of our operators has already occupied my whole schedule...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Medical equipment set.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Call for help immediately if you're injured!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Commence treatment.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ready for blood transfusion!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Get the hemostat!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: First aid here, take it!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'll be right there!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: It's really nerve-wracking being in the medic squad. Support troops are really under lots of pressure! Good thing I'm already used to it.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The battlefield is a place of tragedy. I hope they come to understand this one day.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Forget about those fleeing enemies at the moment, our priority now is to help the injured.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I am sorry, we've even ran out reserve medicine…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I guess I'm more accustomed to figuring things out myself...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh? What are you doing?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, isn't it almost time for your annual checkup?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's? My, the moment I turn around, another year passes. Time really does fly fast... Anyway, did you come on your own, Doctor? All alone? Good. And did you run into any other operators on the way...? That makes this easy, Doctor, let's test your blood. Oh, settle down, I'm just joking.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Apparently this confection is popular in Higashi. You get strawberry juice in a plasma bag with an IV drip as a straw, and the sensation of drinking it is macabre but completely novel! Want one, Doctor? What are you sniffing it so hard for? It's just strawberry, of course it is! There's no weird additives in it at all!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Look at how spry and active they all are. If only they could come back from field missions just as lively. It's a doctor's lot to worry, but some operators really don't know to cherish themselves. They don't fear me, so they don't listen. Maybe this calls for me to be a little more fearsome, like, Kal'tsit-style?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: There are better ways to kill time. Care to try one?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Why the constant sullen face? Can't you at least smile for me? Good. That's what I want to see... Yes, there's no one better suited to solve your problems than me... Isn't that right?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: That girl... Amiya, I believe her name was? She's no ordinary girl. If you don't put shackles on her wrists today, you will find yourself placing a crown upon her head tomorrow.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The stability of the alliance between Karlan and Rhodes Island depends solely on your state of mind, and mine. As such, we should at least try to get along, my friend.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I suppose... it's high time I signed this contract. Of course, I do know that the terms are in yours, and Rhodes Island's favor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm well aware that this contract offers me nothing... But what does that matter? I shall nonetheless accept this unequal treaty. The reason being that I, SilverAsh, recognize that you warrant it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Is Ensia giving you trouble? My apologies. It was originally my own responsibility to foster and guide her, but it's unlikely I will be able to do so. So I must ask... could you do it in my stead, {@nickname}?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Could you show me to Rhodes Island's deck? No, I'd just like to get a view of the area. Tenzin needs to spread his wings every once in a while as well. He must be longing to soar through the night sky.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: If this continues, there will come a day when you and I confront one another... I seem delighted, you say? Hah, perhaps I am. You would be a worthy opponent, that's for certain. Let us make the most of our time before that day comes.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: When the aether darkens, 'tis an omen that snowfall draws near...'

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I, SilverAsh, have joined your cause as a sworn ally. Whatever your plans may be, do not disappoint me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: For one to travel such an arduous path, one absolutely must have experience.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Ostentatious titles are one thing, but the trust accompanying them is what concerns me. You surely know that.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: It takes a daring soul to drag me into their war. That being so, I, SilverAsh, will show my prowess for all of Rhodes Island to see.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: We all have our roles to play. Use my abilities as best you see fit.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You wish me to act as your proxy? Very well. But you must pay me due tribute later.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Compassion saves no one on the battlefield.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Show me what you're made of. Amuse me, if you even can.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What are you planning?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Made up your mind?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Acknowledged.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Very well.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: 'The fool flaunting his gallantry reaches none with his vanity...'

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: 'Fool, for what reason hast thou come?'

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: 'Art thou mine worthy enemy, or art thou naught but a jester?'

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'Thy pleas falleth upon deaf ears.'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The fiercer the battle, the more jubilant the victory.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A satisfying battle. It brought palpitations even to my heart.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We should strive for better.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Retreat at once, while there is still time.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: For a place to rest my feet, it is acceptable.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Let me rest for a brief while. I'm more tired than I thought. My apologies.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The snow falls heavy... The blizzards of far-off Kjerag continue year after year, but the political landscape never stands still from one moment to the next. For those who fail to catch up with the changes, this age-old snowstorm will come to bury them beneath.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You haven't changed one bit, my friend.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Oh? Does my appearance aboard Rhodes Island today surprise you? The journey here from Kjerag certainly was an extensive one, but you shouldn't underestimate the fellowship between us so. Happy birthday, my ally and my friend. This present aside, do you have any birthday wishes?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Multiple times now, Rhodes Island has shown its ability and its responsibility as a medical firm. But I'm very curious. In your eyes, will this merely stop at Oripathy? What new ripples will you send across the lands in future? I have great expectations.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Uh... Doctor, you really need to work out more, you know.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Everyone's really nice here at Rhodes Island. Too nice to prank. Oh, is it time for lunch? I'll help!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Mountaineering's not just a hobby of mine, it's my career! You heard me: career!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The hoop on my leg? Oh, you mean what it's for? It's just for decoration. I've got this crystal over here, see. Wanna touch?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My brother sent Matterhorn to look after me, didn't he…? Ugh, why can't he just come out and tell me what he's thinking? It drives me mad.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've always wanted to climb the holy Mt. Karlan, and I've only wanted it even more since my sister left us and became the Saintess. So Doctor, train me more, yeah? So one day I can reach the peak of Mt. Karlan and bring my sister home.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: When it comes to Mountaineering, I won't lose to anyone! No one knows these tools better than me. They make great weapons too!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Yeah, Oripathy really changed me. But if I keep wallowing in self-pity, that wouldn't be like me, right? So, no matter what lies in wait in the future... I should continue working hard on my chosen path.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ah, it's snowing... We Silverashes can't go back to the way we were... I get that. Everything's changed. Only the snow is the same—the same snowflakes that I watched falling back home.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctoooor? Doctooooor! Heeeey! Fine, if you're just gonna sleep, then so be it. Bye-bye!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Cliffheart, and I live to conquer the peaks! It's nice to meet you!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm... what a novel experience!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? Wow! Let's celebrate with some cake. Look, I grabbed these from Logistics. It's fine!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Well, well, you really know what you're doing, Doctor! That's right, I'm really talented. You'd better use my power well!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: All right? I'm feeling motivated! Time to climb all the way to the top!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Eh? You want me to lead? This is all so sudden...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Say goodbye to the reckless Cliffheart. I'm taking things seriously from here on out.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'll show them what I can do!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Over here?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave it to me!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'm raring to go!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'veeee got yoooou!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: My hook never misses! I've got this!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Amateurs are doomed to fall to their death!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: For the Silverash name!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: There ain't no mountain too high, no situation too bleak!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Of course we won with me around!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Wow, they sure are good at running away!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Dangit... I messed up...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's so warm here... I'll hang out over here for a while!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: W-wait! Whuah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm gonna teach you all about Mountaineering next time, Doctor! You'll love it, I promise!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! Look, Doctor, I've prepared all this Mountaineering gear for you. Let's go! Huh? It's still midnight, you say? It's fine! We need to set off earlier so that we can catch the sunrise at the peak.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Mornin', Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Speaking of which, lemme have a look at what my brother gave you! Aww... he's still into this pricey boring ornament stuff. Zero times as practical as my present. Anyway, check this out, Doctor! A choice set of climbing equipment, just for you. Once the weather's good, let's go scale some mountains!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: My brother and sister are still butting heads, but their relationship's smoothed out a bunch, I can feel it. Gotta thank you for melting the ice between them, Doctor. But still, I really wish hanging around home was as chill as being at Rhodes Island…

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm? You're here to pray? Sorry, I'm busy right now.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hm? Yes, I'm the current Karlan Saintess. But everyone swamped by work deserves a little break from time to time, don't you think?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Wasting time on trivial affairs is what I call slacking off. What I'm doing right now is… taking the opportunity to recharge.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Work hard, play hard, right? Don't force all those rigid rules on me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The Karlan Goddess? We share a good relationship, thanks to my duty as the Saintess.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'd be happy to help you, but the life of a Karlan Saintess is a busy one. Well, I guess I'll make an exception for you this once, but please make it short.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: My sis... Ensia... you people at Rhodes Island are all pretty fond of her, right? So it's not like she received any special treatment from that guy. And now... well, I think I get it now. It's fine like this. I'll just keep watching over her. It's fine.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I twisted my ankle once when I was a kid. My brother carried me on his back all night, going from house to house until someone agreed to take us in. I decided that very moment that I wanted to grow up to become someone like my brother! But now... heh, forget it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Huh? How did you find me? I'll freeze your toes—Um? Coffee? For me? Thanks. Oh, right, Doctor, wanna hang out here with me for a while? The view is pretty nice. But let's keep it a secret, okay? A secret between just the two of us—aw, this coffee is so bitter!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: It's rare to get to rest like this.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Shh, I sneaked out—oh, um, hi, HR Director! I... I'm here to lend my powers to Rhodes Island. Pramanix, Karlan Saintess, at your service. Bless you, my friend.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I hear a voice... repeating something in my head...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: 'You shall emerge victorious one day.' This is the pledge of Karlan, and what I'm praying for as well.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Since when did you need blessings too? Can you wait a bit? I'll get ready.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: May the Holy Mt. Karlan be with us.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Follow the bells and you'll find the way.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let me pray towards the mountains for you.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Impurities must be purged.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Be careful.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I am ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Let us begin.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You have my blessings.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: O Spirits, hear my prayer.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Here come the bells, cold winds binding my enemies.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: These powers are a gift from the Holy Mountain.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: As the bells ring, the impenetrable armor shall be no more.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: It was simple, thanks to the Spirits' power.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The light of Karlan was shining on us.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: If only we could have won without bloodshed... just my wish...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's not looking good... I suggest we retreat at once.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's a really peaceful place.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Close your eyes and I'll bring you somewhere new... Do keep your eyes closed, okay?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: What am I doing here? You see, Doctor, Ensia's aboard Rhodes Island, and as her big sister, it's only natural for me to pay her a visit on New Year's. You won't have the heart to let Ensia spend the holiday out there alone, would you? How very cruel that would be.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You have my blessings, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: So—how does it taste? Nice and cool, isn't it? It's my own handmade frosted chocolate. Do you like it? Good, that's a relief, I really spent a lot of time studying it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: My brother's here too? Oh, no need to worry, Doctor, we all know what our business is. On this day, we're no more than operators for Rhodes Island. This place is like a little pocket, and I'm here from time to time just to relax, not for anything else.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I apologize... It's my job to attend to you, but my body simply won't move like I want it to...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I once breathed in some kind of Originium toxin... it damaged my memory and the nervous system in my lower extremities... at least that is what Dr. Kal'tsit told me. So I often wonder... what was my life like before then?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This little blue bird often comes over and chats with me. Sometimes, I dream about turning into a bird myself... flying free in the skies, without a care...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Once upon a time, I was imprisoned in an empty room. I only saw another human being when they needed my healing...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: With this staff in my hand, I can heal as many as I will. Is this... really an ability I was born with?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Shining told me that the sins we carry... the guilt of starting the war, as devils... will one day catch up to us and we will have to face judgment. Those people who imprisoned me said the same thing. But...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Amiya... I feel a sense of deja vu whenever I see her. Perhaps we met sometime in the past?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The memories I have are mere fragments. My people... Originium... my mission, the rebellion, the war... but tell me, why are you in one of my memories too?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: How did I end up like this? Why must I suffer all that I do? Doctor, do you have the answers?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Do you too dream of flying freely through the skies like a bird?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Liz... that's my real name. Everything else is just cloudy, indistinct memories...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Why is there a need for me to grow stronger?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? I see. It sounds like something to rejoice over. But... I apologize, I don't feel any joy within...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you for personally informing me of my promotion, Doctor. But... to me, it doesn't matter as much as the story of the world outside that this little bird is telling me right now.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Is this the rendezvous point?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I shall do anything you command me to.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I need only do as the manual said, yes?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The battlefield... a place where lives are taken...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Doctor...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Who will you choose?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This is... the battlefield...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: It's not my wish to take lives.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: My power is all yours now.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Take flight.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You will not come to harm.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I shall protect you.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No matter how difficult the battle gets, I will always…

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: To fight to the very end... that's our destiny.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Perhaps they've already escaped this cage called fate...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Is this... how despair feels?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rooms... They too are a type of cage.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yes? What is it?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor... is this... what is known as 'intimacy'?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy... New Year? I'm sorry, it seems I've forgotten what this holiday entails—just make a wish and that'll do, you say? Then I would wish, in this coming year, for Margaret and Shining to be safe and sound... as well as you, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good day, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. You still remember your own birthday... how fortunate, truly. Alas, I can't procure any present for you... Would you tell me what your birthday wishes are, Doctor? Your wishes may bring hope to me.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Shining notes that since we came aboard Rhodes Island, my health has taken a turn for the better. When by your side, I feel this warmth, too. But why can I not shake this harsh premonition... Doctor, after I recall everything, will Rhodes Island still welcome me with open arms?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Professor, I've finished all my Catastrophe studies notes. Do you have any more I could read?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Huh? What? Why do I call you 'Professor'? Well, you're an expert on Catastrophe studies, so you're like a professor, right? Aren't we all supposed to address our superiors with respect?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Pardon me? Please say that again? Oh, you're wondering why I'm hard of hearing? Well, I got infected with Oripathy back when I was doing research near a volcano...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Besides completing the tasks you give me, I have to go to Dr. Kal'tsit regularly for checkups. The doctor said my symptoms are pretty serious...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I have to work hard to finish the research my parents began! I want to prove that their work was meaningful, and that it could maybe even change the world!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My parents... they've passed on. A pyroclastic flow hit them when they were conducting studies near a volcano... I have to pick up where they left off and finish their research, no matter what!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: My playmates? I'm pretty friendly with Mousse and some others, so I don't feel lonely at all! If possible, I'd love to start a book club with them too. Could we hold our club meetings in your office, Professor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Dr. Kal'tsit told me... I'm losing not only my sense of hearing, but my sense of sight too. …Well, what else might this disease do to me?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: How could I tell you were behind me? Because I could feel your warmth! My eyesight and hearing aren't as sharp as they once were, but my other senses are still the same. Can't bring me down this easily, you know!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Professor! Oh... You're asleep...?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Eyjafjalla. My career before joining Rhodes Island was in the field of volcanology. I'm a bit hard of hearing due to my Oripathy. I just hope I won't be a burden to you, Professor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Please teach me all you can, Professor.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? Really? I'm so happy to have your approval, Professor!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: My mother gave me these little lambs. They're cute, aren't they? Huh? They're scorching hot? Be careful! You have to put on oven mittens before touching them!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Understood, Professor.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't forget to prepare emergency supplies as well as weapons!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We can take care of ourselves, Professor. You just focus on giving orders.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Stay safe, everyone.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Professor?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Please give your orders, Professor.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll be careful.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: All the best!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Temperature is stable!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This may be a little hot...

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Watch out for fires.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: How's that?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I'm so glad you're safe, Professor...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Why must our world be enveloped in strife?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Is everyone okay? Anything I can do?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ow... It's... It's okay... I'm fine...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room makes me feel safe.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Eek! You startled me, Professor!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Thank you, Professor, for helping me become a stronger person.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Professor! Everyone's happily prepping their presents and decorations, and so many operators have come to talk to me. I can't hear them clearly all the time, but when I see the looks on their faces, I'm sure they must all be very warm words. Professor, I wish you that warmth, too.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Professor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Professor, do you know there's a cake that's both named after and inspired by volcanoes? It's called 'lava cake.' I asked Gummy and Mousse, and they taught me how to make it. When you cut it open, the chocolate inside comes spilling out. Here's your cake, Professor, Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Thank you for everything you've done for me over the last year, Professor. I'm delighted to be here with you. There's still so much I don't know about volcanoes and Catastrophes. Before I get to the point where I can't continue my surveys and research, I'm devoting all my energy into this. That way, I can live with no regrets.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Listen to me, Doctor, it's for your own good.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: How do you like this fragrance? You feel refreshed, right? It's all thanks to Melantha. Her samples inspired me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Thank you for building me that flower greenhouse. It'll be a good place for our people to rest and ease their minds.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Oh, you're up? Try stretching, see if you got all the tiredness out. Nice. I put a lot into this new fragrance. Glad it works.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Narcissus, rabbitear iris, kalanchoe, boronia... I always carry all sorts of flower seeds on me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Oh, you mean this little one? She's still young, but she's been a big help with my fragrances.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I've heard that scents are the foundation of ant society. The relationship between perfumers and their clients is the same.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You seem to visit the greenhouse a lot these days. Oh, there's some pollen on your sleeve. Let me wipe it for you… Alright, you're good.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You were asleep for quite a while. What did you dream about, I wonder?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Doctor...? Wow, the lavender was much more effective than I expected…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor. I'm Lena, the perfumer. Interesting job, right? Have you heard the word before?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Please take a look and tell me how I did.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion...? You came to tell me in person? I'm flattered. Oh, just a moment, Doctor… There we go, your collar was wrinkled, so I smoothed it out for you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I don't appreciate violence as a tactic... But I'll do my best to get used to it for Rhodes Island, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: With pleasure.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Whether you need me as a perfumer or a healer, I won't let you down, Doctor.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Do be careful, everyone.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: What kind of battle will it end up being, I wonder…?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: That's fine with me.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: So this is a battlefield…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I won't be afraid.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Let fragrance revive your mind.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Come on, chin up!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: How do you like this scent?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Stay calm, my friends.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I always knew we'd win, Doctor, so long as you're the one in command.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Very well done, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Good job, everyone. Go get some rest.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's too bad we didn't win, but I won't let it discourage me.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I always feel best when I'm at your side, Doctor.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I sense… a pleasant smell from you, Doctor

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I'll just put all the New Year's plants right here, if you're fine with that? They might only bloom for four days, but so long as I'm around, your office will be filled with color and fragrance no matter the season.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Perfect timing, Doctor. I was just about to go look for you. Come take a seat, I have a special aromatherapy and dessert prepared. Go on, take a deep breath and relax. Just for today, this greenhouse's flowers bloom only for you. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I admit I have had a lot of regrets about leaving home. But now I run this little garden on Rhodes Island. This job has its own blessings, filling everyone's lives with wonderful fragrance. You know, Doctor, there's a saying in Minos: 'When a flower leaves its branch, it is embracing the whole land.'

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I've finished sorting the Originium from the other ores, as you requested. Is there anything else?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Oripathy is indeed troublesome. I can't even go on operations without approval from Dr. Kal'tsit. Oripathy shortens one's lifespan, you say? Yes, that's true, but I don't really mind.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This tuning fork? It's actually a staff — not only a weapon but also useful for geological surveys. I find it always comes in handy.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Without Rhodes Island, I'd probably still be a full-time geological researcher. And without you people... I'd probably already be dead.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: What? I have dark circles under my eyes? Aw, I knew it…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: What's that behind me, you ask? Well... ah, never mind, it's really hard to explain. I'll tell you when we have more time.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Some rocks talk to me, you know. They chatter and even squabble away. Sometimes, I lose sleep because of it… You think I'm kidding? Do I look like I'm kidding?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Provence is as careless as always. She needs to be careful or she'll end up like me, seriously ill. You'd better give her a good talking-to.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Astonishing...! Look at this, Doctor! This surface... it couldn't have been formed without high pressure in the crust three hundred and fifty thousand years ago. Isn't it incredible…? Guess what, Doctor? The theory is correct! Those who refuted it are the true fools!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor—oh, you're sleeping? You must be tired from all your hard work.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Earthspirit, a geology scholar and Caster, reporting in. I work eight hours each day. Make me work any more and you'll have to pay me extra.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hm, is this academic data, or something else?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: We must continue to refine our scientific method.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Forgive my bluntness, but do bear in mind you are paying me only a single salary. No matter how far you promote me, I won't do more than a single person's work.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I hope this squad performs well in all types of extreme environment.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't worry, we'll be right back.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: We can't let them misuse Originium like this.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What's the battle plan?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Where are the enemies?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Sink into the earth!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The power of the earth...

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This ends here!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You shouldn't have set foot here.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: What the enemy was doing… would only bring disaster.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: All enemies have been dealt with.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A fine victory, Doctor.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: How is this possible…?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This environment is quite suitable for research.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Um...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: This piece of ore is… for me? Really? But… it must be very expensive, no?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Take a look at the vast strata under our feet. Do you think they pay attention to the new year? Mhm, so neither do I. It's nothing more than an ordinary day off to me, so any tasks assigned to me will be treated as overtime, including attending any parties.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, time to get to work.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. This gemstone is for you. Very pretty, isn't it? I found it in the wilds after a Catastrophe had passed through. Does it confer good luck, you ask? Stones like these have already gone through countless arduous years of settlement and compression to become what they are. Asking it to control fate on top of that seems a bit much.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: There are too many unsolved enigmas in my research, and I only have so much time. Thus, I have to maintain a clear boundary between work and life. So long as each finds its own separate meaning, my time on this land will be worthwhile. I count myself lucky to have found this balance at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: We've got more kitties! Yeah…

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Laterano cakes are so delicious! But we operators have to pay attention to our diet, right?... aww...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Not my gloves... I'm sorry, I can't take my gloves off... I don't want you to see my hands. That's the one thing I ask... sorry…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: A-Are we departing now? Al-Alright, let me just prepare one moment...!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Do you think it's odd that I have two tails? Do-do-do I look even stranger than I thought? Umm...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: When my symptoms aren't flaring up, my hand stays all normal... It feels so nice, just being able to hold the kitties like this...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, what kind of cake do you prefer? Mango, or matcha? I tried making a few, and... you already ate? Oh, umm, Okay...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: D-Doctor! Sora... sh-she's the super idol, Sora, isn't she?! I'd recognize her anywhere! I'm her biggest fan! Why is she here at Rhodes Island? And... and... can I ask her for an autograph?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, have you heard of the Avenue des Champs-Élysées? Yes, I happened to be born there. I really wish I could go back and visit one day... what? Oh, no, I appreciate it, but I'm not lonely. I have you, after all! You're my family.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Aw... Doctor... why are you ignoring me...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Good day... p-please call me Mousse. And... and please don't stare at my hand so much...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This is a favor I'll never forget!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Huh? Pro...promotion?! I-I'm not prepared for this...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, I know there's a limit to what I can accomplish, so I swear... I'll do all that I'm able, as well as I'm able! It's... It's the only way I could ever repay you, Doctor...

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Yes, I'll do my best!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: This is in my hands! You can do this, Mousse!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I essentially blend into the walls, so I'm a good choice for scouting...

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Scouting complete. Sending you enemy coordinates.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm ready!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Here!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm not scared...!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: From now on, this is my battle...!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Yah!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: No, stay back!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I can fight too!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You-You'll regret this!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: It was a tough fight... but I stayed steady through it all...!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Yay... Oh, oh, sorry, it's not that I like battles that much, but...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: D-Did I drag us all down?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I can... keep going...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: E-Excuse me... May I come in...?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: D-Doctor... I really can't hold it in anymore... do we have a scratching post? Urghh...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy new year, Doctor… Help yourself with the pastries there! I personally made some of them, and they go well with the tea I prepared. With my gloves on me though... they may not look as great as what I used to make. B-But should still taste good, I think!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, could you accept this felt doll? I made it with the fur those kittens left behind. It was a lot of fur for a small doll, so I tried a few times to get it right. Do you recognize it, Doctor? It's you... N-No? Aw…

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Sora just gave me more of her albums, and they also came with her signature on them! How nice of her! She also gave me this little heart-shaped doodle on my gloves, saying these are the coolest gloves she's ever seen, and that I looked really special with them. Doctor, I'm thinking, maybe... I'm not as weird as I thought?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I get it, you deserve a nice rest in your off time. But you gotta get your treatment right now.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Huh? You want me to be gentle and caring? That's nurse stuff, pal. I'm a doctor, from top to toe. That means healing. Treatment. Don't waste my time with the fluff.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Strange, why does Dr. Kal'tsit keeps telling me to 'be nice to patients'? She's been doing it ever since I got here.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Your average doctor's biggest concern is keeping herself safe. Mine, on the other hand... it's getting my patients to stop being scared of me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Treatment time, ears open! Eyes on me! Hands up! Don't move!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctors and fighters... life-savers, life-takers. People think we're polar opposites, but I think we're one and the same—we both sacrifice.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Huh? I didn't beat anyone up, I just wanted to say hi. Watch, lemme demo... I initiate physical contact, and that's how I get closer to people, see?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm kinda missing my homeland... I chose to be a medic myself, but it's crazy it all turned out the way it did. Life sure took me down some wild paths, huh?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor... you and I are both travelers on a lonely road. I guess that's why we understand each other so well.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: What the... you're asleep, huh? Heheh.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Medic Operator Gavial. First things first... Don’t judge me by the way I look. Got it?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Tch, I thought we were gonna have combat class.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Everyone's so scared of me treating them... You're the only one who accepts me for what I am. Thanks for that.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: All right, no more fooling around. I'll be serious from now on.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave the rear to me. Go show what you're made of!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: All right, get in line, everyone!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All right, ladies. Let's keep it cool.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Coming!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Let's begin.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Where do you need me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Ready to heal!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Who needs healing? Come over!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: If you want treatment, you gotta come closer!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't get yourself killed, dummy!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Come on, get it together!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hang in there, I'm coming!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Meh, pushovers. I wasn't even breaking a sweat.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Man those guys were weak. I regret not giving 'em a few whacks with the staff here.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Have you guys never taken emergency response training courses?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Darn it... I'm not giving up yet!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Let's see if there are any interesting people here!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey, knock it off!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You want me to just nod and listen? No. Freaking. Way.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Finally, New Year's! The croc doc is in and she says today's a rest day! Speaking of, they really celebrate New Year's peacefully out here. I kinda miss the Acahualla-style ceremony. Kal'tsit probably wouldn't approve holding it here at Rhodes Island though...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday to you, Doctor. Speaking of, I oughta give you a little present... Let's take this opportunity to give you a full, thorough physical exam!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You want my thoughts on what being a Rhodes Island doctor's been like? Nothing too special. Whether punching enemies into submission or using my staff to make patients listen, there's always a sense of accomplishment. It was my choice and I made it, so there's nothing to waffle over.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Queching the flames of war demands prolonged suffering. To ignite them, however, it takes naught but a lapse of thought.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The fall of Chernobog dealt a devastating blow to Azazel, our clinic. I must rebuild it for the children. As long as they can have a shelter to call home, any place will do. You don't need a reason to try for your family.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island is in a respectable position, but the Infected of Ursus face prospects far worse than anyone could imagine. They must be ready to resort to violence in order to survive. At the end of the day, virtue and dignity hold meaning only for those who live to see the next dawn.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: All Ursus should take pride in their nation and their Emperor.' I, too, fought for Ursus once, but I don't have the passion driving me anymore. Time has robbed me of too much.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Life in the military has taught me two things: First, have faith in your fellow soldiers; second, have faith in them, but do not trust them. This dilemma has always plagued our lands, and none can escape it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, a limitless future awaits you, just as it does for those children. Though I can neither let go of yesterday nor look forward to tomorrow, I shall fight for you till my last drop of blood, so you may be part of that future.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I am fine with Ursus as my enemy. Once I swore my utmost loyalty to it, but that was returned with endless disillusionment and shame. For the children's sake, I will never falter, much less surrender.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Once there was a long battle. When I finally broke into the enemy headquarters, I was too late... All I could do for my dying friend was take his pocket watch and sword. The enemy lost their commander, whose death brought us a brief victory. That day, Ursus enjoyed her momentary triumph, but I knew my war was over. A war where I lost everything.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The photograph inside my pocket watch? Hahahah, so you saw it... This is Neon from when she was little. Isn't she adorable? She's not so quiet anymore, but she loves herself now, and that's all that matters... Live free, Dr. {@nickname}, that's my wish, even if it is trite.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Don't lose focus. You must be alert at all times on Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hellagur, an infected mercenary. I will work with Rhodes Island in order to rebuild my Azazel Clinic and protect my family. But be advised, I have no medical skills.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Battlefields may change, but not the cruelty.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm used to it as a soldier, but I find it fascinating as an infected. Thank you for the ribbon, Dr. {@nickname}.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: War will never truly be over, but I believe even this land will end eventually. Maybe you can end our suffering one day, Dr. {@nickname}. Now, give me your order!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Only butchers thirst for blood. We are merely paying the price of survival.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll have them following orders to Ursus army standards!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I don't mind losing my life, if that is enough to end this all.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You have never seen a real war, pathetic runts.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I was born to fight.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: A slip of the mind is the difference between life and death.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Killing is but the last resort.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I've never truly left the battlefield, I know.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: A lash of blade, the flesh to flay.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: A thrust of whip, the sword to rip.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: A cleave of spear, the armor to tear!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Decapitator'… Our sacrifices were not in vain.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You leave the fight behind, and pay for it with yet more fighting.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Avert your eyes, I'm about to end their misery.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Keep your guard up. One flaw is all the enemy needs to turn the tables.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: There is no shame in failure. At least you had the chance to learn from it.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: If only I can find shelter for the children.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Would you like a candy? I still have some. But watch out for cavities.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It escapes me how many New Years I've spent in trenches, or under the blaze of artillery. War is no stickler for timekeeping, and the greater part of my life has been embroiled in it. This holiday won't turn new pages for me anymore. That being said, don't the children look happy? Hah.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You look well, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: As every child has a birthday, it gives me hope that maturity will come to them. Age will overtake me, like it or not, and I can only hope they'll still live safely after I am gone. You're still growing too, Doctor. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I must express my gratitude to Rhodes Island. The longer the war stretches on, the more I realize the importance of a place to rest. Has the technology Azazel brought to Rhodes Island been of help...? That is good. After all, I can do little else but wield my blade in your service.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Did you call me here for a new hunt? No? Gah…

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This claw pendant? It's a symbol of revenge. The Ursus mercenaries who hurt my people treat these things as dogtags, so there's no mistaking them.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: A beast took my left hand when I was hunting. Luckily, a mechanic gave me a prosthetic limb, so I can draw my bowstring again.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: There was a time when I would've turned anyone who mocked my scars into a pincushion! But if you ask me now... Well, people like that aren't even worth the trouble.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: If you're ever facing a difficult decision, let your instincts decide for you. Your body won't lie—This is what I've learned after a lifetime of hunts.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've been living alone ever since my village was wiped out.  So, I… I'm still getting used to being around people... But since you trust me and give me important work, I swear I'll return the favor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Ehh, a pebble got stuck in my prosthetic finger...? Darn it, I'm going to need a mechanic to fix it... N-No, I don't need you, I can handle this myself!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You'll make sure I don't ever lose anyone else? Hmph. Big words. But I'll see for myself if you can back those up.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The doctors here offered to get rid of my more recent scars, but I said no. I want to keep them. They're proof of my work here... You, you understand what I'm getting at?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You're sleeping? Looks like this one can fall asleep almost anywhere. Well, that's a trait we hunters share…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Vermeil, hunter. You won't regret giving me work.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Can I take another look at that?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you, but... are you sure it's okay to promote someone like me?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I don't really care about stuff like Oripathy or 'the rest of my life.' Right now, the happiest thing I can imagine is fighting by your side.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You want me to be the captain? Am I... really cut out for the job?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The big game hunt is about to start!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You don't seem to understand your situation here. You've fallen into my trap.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'll go ahead.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Give me the order.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I can smell the game on the wind.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll be waiting here.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You'd better start running, or there's only one way this ends.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't underestimate the people of the wilderness.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Watch where this arrow goes!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: This arrow will find your throat!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Strong game is still just game.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Nice. If you were born in Siracusa, you would've been a great hunter.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The target got away. I'm going after it.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We can't let it end like this…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place has walls and a roof… that's enough for me.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wha?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: ...My plans for the day? Help you with missions. Shoot at enemies. Use up all my arrows. Finish the mission. Eat dinner, go to sleep. Simple enough.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Everyone's celebrating New Year's... It was never this easy in the wild. We got a little cured meat out, ate a few berries we had stored, and that's how we celebrated surviving another year. Maybe it wasn't worth celebrating...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ah, it's you.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: This cloak's for you. I learned to make this back with the other hunters. If you get lost in the wild one day, that hood you've got isn't gonna save you from sandstorms. Obviously, I'd rather be there with you to protect you, if I could.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I never forgave any of my old enemies, and I'll never forget those who showed me kindness. The old Lateran guy's dead, but there's still Rhodes Island. I have a clear reason to fight with the time I've got left.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Don't worry, Doctor. No matter what happens, I'll protect you.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Liberi have excellent eyesight. According to legend, some can even tell one droplet from another in a rainstorm. Sounds incredible, huh?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I take everyday life too seriously? My apologies. I think that comes from my time serving as a Laterano Guard. I'll work on that in the future.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: To most Lateranos, heavy armor doesn't serve much of a purpose. Of course, when we perform the large-scale rituals of our homeland, we do dress up in ceremonial garb.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I appreciate your faith in my abilities, Doctor. I won't let you down.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Right... I submitted a request to the HR office... to become your personal bodyguard. I guess maybe I miss my old job too much.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I grew up in Laterano and didn't really have the chance to learn about other cultures. Here at Rhodes Island, I get to see such diversity, way beyond my imagination. Actually...it's not so bad.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I have no regrets. Yes, true, they did drag me out of Laterano against my will... but this has been a great adventure. I've enjoyed it.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: It is my duty to protect you, Doctor. Rest assured.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: My name is Plume, formerly of the Pontifica Cohors Lateran. I will be your sword, and your wings, as I defend your very life.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ah, so tactics can help you overcome a more skilled opponent, huh?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor. As your bodyguard, your approval is the best reward I can ask for.

lines.title: Added to Squad
