lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: As the leader, it's my responsibility to keep everyone safe.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Watch the friendlies!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Keep your guard up!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Ready for overwatch.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Understood!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You think you're faster than me?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: No move can escape my sight!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: My resolve lies with my spear!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I fight for the glory of Laterano!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Nothing can hold me back.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Like a wave crashing against an immovable stone, isn't it?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Regroup! I'll look out for the remaining enemies!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I can't... fall... yet!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Should I patrol this area?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Anything over there?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor... it feels like I'm abusing my position...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Lift the corners of my mouth, don't knit my eyebrows...good, hold steady, then ease my mind, relax... Okay, now get in and greet everyone… Ah! Doctor, you scared me. Um, Happy New Year!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: So today is your birthday, Doctor? Alright, happy birthday! I promise I'll see my guard duty through more vigilantly. Uh, I mean, if you're going to hold a birthday get-together like the Laterans do, then I'll ensure your safety, and take responsibility for the aftermath.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Someone once told me that the honor of protecting Laterano was the sole reason I fought. But now, I have more things to protect. My beliefs, my companions, and you. It all weighs heavier on my spear, but I will never let it slow down.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Want to listen to some music? I'll lend you my headphones.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Sorry, please keep a little distance from me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I never imagined that I'd have the chance to become a rescue worker.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I picked up this axe a long time ago, maybe even before I learned to read.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The songs I like are probably not so popular. They're only good for humming to myself when I'm alone.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Don't blink—you have but one moment to witness this epic move.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Want something to drink? My treat. You should relax a bit after work, you know.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I only realized how precious life is after everyone around me died, one by one. Ironic, huh? I think so, too.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I'm a mercenary. I just do my job. As for the purpose of my mission and its consequences, I don't have a say in any of that. So, from now on, all my responsibilities are your concern.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Dun... dun dun♪dun... dun dun...♪

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Frostleaf, former mercenary. From now on, I'm your operator. Assign me any job you want, I can do pretty much anything.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Things are on the right track now.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Whew... not bad. Feeling fulfilled for the first time in a while.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll do my job.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Go your own ways and do your own jobs.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Great, I feel like some exercise.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You will shatter.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your orders?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This should work.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hm, okay.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: My bodily fluids aren't the only thing that's chilling.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Extend my edge!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Life, brittle as frost, fragile like leaves.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Let's chill down some hot heads.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I've been through countless battles... seen the carnage, witnessed the silent nothingness at the end.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I remember every enemy I fought. Not a single one escapes.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We didn't lose anyone, did we?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'll hold up the rear.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'd like... a more private space.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ow.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: How about a drink?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I never celebrated any holiday like this before coming to Rhodes Island. Even on a peaceful New Year's, I wouldn't have a room as safe and warm as this... Sorry, Doctor, can I just—listen to some music on my own for a while? I'll come and catch you in a bit. Thank you.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Here's a charm I made for you. Inside it are some lyrics I extracted from a song, the one I always listen to when I'm feeling down. I hope it'll protect you from any hurt enemies might deal you. Oh, it's coming on too heavy? Not at all. Life's the most important thing, trust me on that.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You don't need to be too worried. My past experiences weren't all bad. They taught me what living wrongly looked like. And my time at Rhodes Island has made me want to stick even harder with this all-new outlook, to explore even more unknown places across the lands. Maybe you'd wanna come with me, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Make you a deal, Doctor. I'll help you with work, and you teach me whatever it is you're good at. What do you think? Shake on it?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, you know this language, don't you? How do you pronounce this word…? Ooh, that's right! I remember now. I knew I could count on you, Doctor. Just wait till I get back from my trip, I'll have a souvenir for you!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Heh! Hah—! Get up, all of you! Weren't you going to fight the USSG? Now look at you all, lying on the ground already! Bunch of babies. You don't see my girls much on the landship these days, but there was a time when we followed the Doctor around, conquering the world... Yow! Anna...? Why'd you hit me?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Honey drunk? Who's honey drunk? Beehunter? I told her to slow down already, but she won't listen. And now she'sh all drunk and shays I'm the one getting... Wait... Doctor... Shtand shtill, shtop... shaking... yer making me dizzshy...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: What are Sonya and the girls going to do? You're asking the wrong one, Doctor. We're friends, yeah. But aside from Lada, the rest of them don't really talk to me about that kinda stuff. Especially Sonya—she'll go to Anna when she needs something, maybe Natalya, but she'd never come to me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Lada had a secret talk with me recently. Said she wants to open a little shop in Ursus, and we could all chip in and get our share. As for the shop, it'll be our headquarter. All the girls can have regular meetups there. And I can go over to hang out whenever I miss her, too. It's gonna be great!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Has you-know-who been to Rhodes Island? Oh, so he spent a whole day sitting in the reception before you shooed him out...? Thanks for that. It's fine, I've got nothing to say to him anyway. Hmph, he wasn't there when I needed him, and now he feels bad enough to try to make up for it? Keep Dreaming!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: What do I think? Ummm... first of all, you should stop treating us like kids. Come on, Doctor, you don't need to worry about us so much. If you have time, why don't you teach me a few more formulas for Anna's Math lessons? We've counted you as a friend all this time, so if there's really something bugging us, you'll definitely know.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I know we'll have to go our separate ways someday. But so what? We trust each other with our lives. The USSG won't fall apart, and we'll never forget the days we spent together. The same goes for you, Doctor. Call me anytime you need my help, and I'll be there, no matter what.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, let me play you a refreshing tune on my guitar!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hey, Doctor. You already know me, do we really still have to do this? Formalities matter, huh? Fine. Leto of the Ursus Student Self-government Group. Reporting in!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Meh, I've seen this one.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Sooooo…. How long did it take for Sonya to get promoted?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: What's this? Promotion gift for 'General Leto'? Ah... That's a name I've not heard in a long time. Time really flies, it's like years have gone by and I've done nothing.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Field mission? Count me in!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: For real? Are you trying to improve my teamwork again?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'll lead the way!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Requesting a solo op!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: All warmed up!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I can go anytime.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm in tip-top shape today.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You're all dead!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You thought that would knock me out?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You can't hide from me!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Here's a few bolts to eat!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'll take on all of you!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew—I always thought I was pretty adventurous myself, but now? I think you really enjoy living life on the edge, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We have to toast to occasions like these. Who wants in?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: This isn't over! I can still fight!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No way I'm gonna swallow this... Can we go one more round?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I've been here a while, but I still gotta say... Rhodes Island is crazy big.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What? An ambush?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, are you heading to Medical too? Let's go together!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, the USSG's having a feast tonight too, so of course you're coming? Oh, also. Mama's gotten much better lately, so she's been thinking of hosting one of our own in a couple of days. But it'll be too quiet with just the two of us, so she asked me if you might be interested?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, want a drink?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday! Here's a medovik for you, I even asked Lada to... to teach me how to make it. I snuck a piece for myself, and it's really tasty! Hurry up, try some! Honey drunk? Oh, yeah, no wonder I've been feeling... a little dizzy... Whoa, look out! The cake!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Here, a souvenir from my last trip. It's pretty good, so you gotta try some. Hmmm...Is it me, or did Rhodes get a lot more crowded since I was away? Whatever~ I don't care if you keep onboarding more people, but you gotta make sure the USSG's clubhouse stays as-is. Deal!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Greetings, I'm here for my shift… That's a peculiar look on your face. Do I seem so unreliable?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: We don't throw ourselves into battle because we want to. We just have a stronger will to survive than most. If you understand, that alone would be enough.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Zima, the girls, and I all came from different schools. But all the students in the city knew the legends of General Zima. Doesn't that sound cool? Literally. Zima is Ursine for 'winter', you see. Hm, yes.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: How did we escape from Chernobog? Hmm... you really don't want to know. Sometimes the truth is better left untold.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Oh? I'm reading a mystery novel… As a matter of fact, it taught me some lessons that proved useful in getting me through that terrible time.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My favorite books? Hmm, I enjoy topics like politics, economics, and dialectical materialism… Baking magazines and stuff like that are nice too.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Home? My hometown? Obviously, we can't go back there. You know as well as I do that there's nothing left of it. Even if we rebuilt Chernobog, I still…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island is safe. And there are so many books here in your office... If I could, I'd really prefer to stay here…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: What will I do in the future? Hmm… No idea. My books don't have an answer for that. I hope someone will offer me one, someday…

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Such a twist is beyond my imagination. 'Every last one of the passengers on this train, you're all murderers!'

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Istina. I'm still a student, but I was recruited for my ability to use Arts… Yes, it is rather strange for a student to serve here, isn't it?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: You want me to be stronger?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Do you feel like you understand me better now? Naive, you're far from really knowing me.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Now that you've offered me such recognition, I will reveal my true power. Allow me to demonstrate by reducing this office to a fine powder… Just kidding. There are too many precious books here. I would never do something so awful.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Hmm… The team is somewhat different from what I imagined.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's show our determination, earnestness, and boundless passion.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: May the star of victory shine upon us.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What is it, Doctor?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I have a distaste for war.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: It seems we must fight.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Come at me.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Please, no need to rush.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Let us take it slow.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Time to teach you a lesson.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Why do they fight... even when it may cost them their lives? What do they gain from it?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, if you have to commend us, now is the time.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Those enemies who fled... We probably won't see them again.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Neither our numbers nor our efforts were sufficient…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: A secret room, where, shall we say, interesting things happen.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: It's too noisy here, I'd rather read in the Doctor's office.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: No, I, I'm not honey-drunk, Sonya just poured me a, a little, but I just felt I should convey to you, a, Happy New Year... Er, are these Sonya's flowers? For the New Year? Why is this flower, burning hot to the touch…

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. This hardcover is my gift to you—Ah, well done, you've discerned without so much as a flip that it contains not literature, but cake. No, I wasn't at all hoping to see you scoop up a handful of icing…

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: 'The Silver Branch', 'Mathematical Theory of Originium Arts', 'Superpropositional Logic'... Hm? I'm going through the books I've read this year. Suspense fiction has its merits, but dipping into all manner of knowledge is comforting, in a sense. It lets me believe, undeniably, that I am moving forward.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hello, Doctor! You hungry? Heehee, I heard your stomach growling from a mile away! It sounded like thunder!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: My shield? I can lift it easy! One, two, lift! Hehe, see? Oh, Relax, Doctor. I'm not gonna drop it or anything. You don't have to stand all the way over there.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The bad guys who destroyed my hometown are gonna pay! I'll smash them with my frying pan!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Zima says she'll protect me, but I'm not a baby! Me and my shield kept everyone safe before we made it here! It's not a shield, it's a vault door? No it isnnnn't! I can't believe you're calling it that!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, you wanna taste my cooking? Hehe, you can try it soon. I've already asked Closure if I can work the cafeteria! Just waiting to hear back.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Tadaaah! Here comes Gummy's specialty: bacon and eggs! So, do you like it? It's tough to get the heat right when I'm out in the field, but most days I can make it perfect!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Me and the other four weren't always together, you know.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Why am I always so cheery? Umm, actually... After the things we've seen, it's hard to be cheery... But I really want my friends to forget about all that awful stuff. So I need to pull myself together and smile a whole bunch to make that happen!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I... I miss my parents, and I do want to find them. I think about them all the time... but if I leave now, I don't think I could do anything by myself... So... Doctor, could you please teach me how to fight? I don't want everyone to think of me as some kind of kitchen girl!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you sleeping, Doctor? Hmm, maybe a bit of reading here would be okay, I guess?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: My name's Gummy! You must be the Doctor. Thank you and everyone from Rhodes Island for helping us! I don't have any special skills, but I'll do what I can as good as I can!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I can feel my power surging! I might even be able to lift you up, Doctor!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'll become a three-star Rhodes Island chef after the promotion, right? Just kidding! Hehe.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I want to do much, much more besides cooking! I don't know if I'm strong enough to do everything you want me to, but I'll give it my all!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Gummy, ready to go!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Что?! You're making me the leader?!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Just wait for us to get back, Doctor!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Nope, I'm not scared!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Let me do it!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Pick me! Pick me!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm ready to fight!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll protect everyone!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Try some of my specialty!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Here's something yummy for you!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Anyone hungry?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Push forward, team! Ura!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The bad guys should just give up! With the Doctor on our side, they'll never beat us!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I didn't want to have to do that… but if we don't fight, the bad guys will get us!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We won, and that's what matters! It's a good thing!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ughh… did anybody get hurt…? Doctor? Is the Doctor okay?!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Wow, what a big room! You could get so many people in here!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ahahahahah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, I know my food tastes great, but don't eat too much of it! You'll get fat!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, I've been busy all day today in the kitchen. Zima went out to do something early this morning, and Rosa's still busy decorating the hall. Even though we all promised to make New Year's dinner together... Istinaaaa! You can't set off fireworks inside!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, you want something to eat?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Afternoon, Doctor... a big crowd kept me in the kitchen late last night, I had to make cakes in all different flavors... But I got the tastiest one I made right here. Happy birthday, Doctor! Say aahh—

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor! Come try the piroshki I baked! They're even tastier than before, right? Heheh, I'm growing up too, you know. And then Mama and Papa, and Zima and all my friends won't have to worry about me. I'm going to get even stronger!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It is an honor to serve you, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I was once naive enough to think I could have anything I wanted. Now I know, while that may be true for most things, it is not for others. Those I can never get. Not on my own.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Any work you might have, please feel free to let me try. Don't worry, after what I've have been through, the dignity of a noblewoman is the least of my concerns. Now I am just like Zima and the girls, an ordinary student under protection.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, if you would like to know more about Chernobog, I may be able to provide a unique perspective. I was only a student, but you know, the Student Council President does interact with society at large, in some ways.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: People like Istina, who forgo the opiate that is entertainment in pursuit of greater knowledge, are quite rare. Even at a noble school like I attended. If she had been my classmate back then... No, it's no use thinking about that now.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: To hate the world on account of a tragedy is as shortsighted as loving the world over a comedy——Is it? Doctor, have you already decided how to handle all that you will soon face? And how should I? I'm still unsure.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, I have a favor to ask of you. Would you please look after Zima and the girls... specifically their mental health? They look like they're adjusting well, but I know they're not. Even I, occasionally, think back to those times...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, I wonder if you could ever understand? I was a victim, at times, I know. But at some point, I found myself an unconscious victimizer. And I even… 'indulged' in it... I... I can never forgive myself for that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, is it easier to forget, when you're fully grown? When I come of age, will I be able to forgive myself? Will becoming as mature as you allow me to finally deal with the misery in my heart?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: The Doctor is asleep...  Looks kind of cute.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Greetings, Doctor. Allow me to once again express my gratitude to Rhodes Island for taking in me and my friends. I've had enough of a break working in Logistics, and I'd like to do as Zima and the girls do.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I too must prepare for the battlefield…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: It seems my experience in student government is paying dividends in my work life. How delightful.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: There is still much I don't understand about what I am doing, about my future, about myself, and about so much more. But I am young. I still have time to think. Don't I, Doctor?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Let us put my training to the test.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I will do all I can.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Comrades, let us move out.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Comrades, let us keep to the plan.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Is it my turn?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Stay calm, relax…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: First, remember the combat manual…

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ready, aim... FIRE!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Huh? A misfire? Eek!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Rosa, believe in yourself. You can do it!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: This is nothing personal...

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, we did it...! Oh, um, ahem, truly a delightful victory!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I hope I've met Doctor's expectations.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: My apologies, Doctor. If only I had tried harder...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We must review this carefully after we get back…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I wonder if there's anywhere quite like the salon?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Another lovely day today.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy new year, Doctor. This is a busy day, but I'm glad that I can contribute towards the party. I hope everyone likes my floral arrangements and desserts. Oh, I just remembered something. The USSG and I will be hosting a small private gathering this evening. You're more than welcome to join us, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, it's great to see you.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: We had to be extremely careful with our gifts at school. A slight mistake may just trigger a sizable scandal. But that's something I no longer need to worry about, and I can express myself however I wish. Happy birthday, Doctor. Gummy taught me how to bake these cookies. Thank you for taking care of us.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I may never be able to free myself from the nightmare. But since my arrival at Rhodes Island, I gradually found the courage to face it. It's all thanks to you and my friends at the USSG. You always stand by my side and lead the way... I believe one day, I will finally be able to start my life anew.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's not the duty of a guard to stand here and do nothing. Why don't we chat a bit?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: With perfect positioning and a suitable environment, my letters will arrive just fine. After all, it's my job, right? I need to do well to survive.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Are you hungry? If you want something to eat, just say the word. I can't compete with Matterhorn in the kitchen, but I can at least cook a decent meal.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The comms equipment here at Rhodes Island is way too good. At this rate, I'm going to lose my job...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Anything else you need? Just don't keep me on the line for too long.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Huh? There's a faint smell on the letters? No, you must be imagining things.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I owe my life to Master SilverAsh. If necessary, I would do anything for him.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You want me to transport... all these? That's a lot, Doctor! Come on, I'm not a miracle worker!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Seems I'm no match for you. I suppose it's time to retire my business smile for now... *Ahem*... I'd like to show you my true face, from now on.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, there's a new message for... Ah, never mind.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Esteemed Leader of Rhodes Island, your ally—Courier of the Snow Realm—is here at your service. If you get into any sort of trouble during your contract with Master SilverAsh, just snap your fingers and I'll be there.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Whoa, that's an incredible job well done.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You'd save a lot of trouble if you sent me onto the battlefield.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: As a Messenger of the Snow Realm, I'm sure to appear whenever you need me.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave the scouting to me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I won't blemish the name of the Snow Realm.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Too bad some people just can't live and let live.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: They'll pay for what they've done.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: At your service.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your orders.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Mhmm.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Forwards!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Attack!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: How's that?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Haaaghh!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Speeding up!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I'll bring news of our victory to Rhodes Island right away!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Let's grab a nice dinner after we clean up the battlefield. My treat!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Anyone injured? I've got medicine and bandages.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's get out of here first. Here, this way! Hurry!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'll greet my roommates and neighbors first.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: How can I help?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Alright, I'll whip up a meal for you later.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, I've brought you some food from Kjerag to celebrate the New Year. They're still warm, so would you like to try...? Are they to your taste? D—Don't eat so many! The beastmeat isn't that easy to digest!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Call me whenever you need me.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! I have a present for you. You'd like to open it now? How about guessing what's inside first? Mm-hm... Correct, it's a scent sachet! I hope when you're carrying it around, you can feel as though I'm by your side.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It was Master SilverAsh's choice to partner with Rhodes Island, but I believed in his decision. And my days at Rhodes Island have proven not only how right he was, but also how trustworthy you are.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I've moved your belongings where you wanted. No worries, it wasn't heavy.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The shield is a symbol of a steadfast guardian.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I've been responsible for protecting Young Master SilverAsh... I mean, Master SilverAsh... ever since he was young.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It's not exactly polite to talk about Miss Enya behind her back, but... *sigh* I do pity Miss Enya for what she has suffered. She really deserves a better life.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: If my shield gets damaged, I should take it to the artisan called Vulcan for repairs. Is that correct?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: This is far beyond my expectation. That artisan is truly skilled. I need to thank her properly.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Life at Rhodes Island is fun. The Snow Realm is rather bland in comparison.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Master did send me to protect Ensia. But I honestly don't think she's the type who would sit there and ask to be protected.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I am slowly starting to understand why Master SilverAsh holds you in such high regard. Doctor, from this day, feel free to command me as your shield.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sometimes, I suddenly start missing my life in the Snow Realm.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ally, I salute you in true Snow Realm fashion. My codename is Matterhorn, and I am one of the guards dispatched here by Master SilverAsh.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: You have my gratitude.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for the approval, Doctor. I am greatly flattered.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I will not step back, not even if this shield shatters the very next second. Not because of my loyalty, but because of my conviction.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: At your service.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I am honored.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I shall protect the team.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: All is ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I shall be your vanguard.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: My shield is ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Hm!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hoo-yah!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Retribution!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I'm not here just for show!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: With my conviction, I shall bring any monster to its knees!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You don't have what it takes!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I wasn't even giving my all!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Their strikes can barely tickle me.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'll pull off a perfect victory next time for you, I promise.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I should not have taken the enemies lightly. Now I pay the price.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Very nice room, this one. Furnished tastefully, with a peaceful atmosphere.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Mhmm.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: This is my signature dish. How do you like it?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's only natural for a guardian to keep his eyes peeled on New Year's day. Troubles do not shy away from celebration days. Rather, they are more likely to jump on people when they let their guard down. Rhodes Island is a comparatively safe place, but you must not lower your defense, Doctor. Happy new year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good day, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: It's your birthday, Doctor, isn't it? No need to worry, for I dare not forget the date. It's just the gift I prepared... I'm really not sure if you are going to appreciate it... So please, Doctor, do me a favor and open it after I leave. Thank you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I'm actually not familiar with what lies outside the Snow Realm, since most of my job was to simply perform the duties my master has entrusted to me. I need to broaden my horizon. Even though I'm no more than a guardian, I need to learn more and see more.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Close your eyes, don't rush to open them. They may feel slightly hot, that's normal... Shh, stay calm, I crushed some herbs to help your eyes relax. You must have been staring at some dangerous thing. I do that a lot, trust me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: A guide...? I guess Simone is a better fit for the job. She's also a veteran hunter like me, so I know you'll be in good hands, and won't get into... trouble. There have been some misunderstandings and a few tribes now turn me away. Just remember, if anyone tells you I'm a man eater, they're lying.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hands off. I've told you before, no one gets to touch my bow. Not you, not the smiths. You don't have the skills to hunt shadows in the depth of Sami, so you shouldn't draw their attention. I know your kind, I know you're curious. I'll just repeat myself over, over, and over again until I get through to you.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Check the logs from the research teams. See? These little hornbeasts are friends, they're harmless. And this kind of snow needs Arts to control, so call me if you run into some. Good, go ahead and add some notes to these pictures, you're pretty clever. Why the look? Is it so strange that I know how to use electronics?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: You all are strange, just like Magallan, insisting on comprehending the land on your own terms. I've seen your hard work, you'll come to know the whole of Sami as you see her in your dreams someday. But now? You aren't there yet. I'm worried about you, but since we're working together, just listen to me and you'll be fine.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Put that navigation instrument down, you're no professional, it's wearing you out just carrying it around. Let me lead the way, just like Arges used to do for me. She always says pitfalls and pains guide you to destiny, but I find I can get where I want by just following the sound of the breeze and the twigs in the trees.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You've never tried sleeping on a cave floor before? What about a bed made of vines? You should give it a try, I can't get a good night's sleep if I don't hear the heartbeat of Sami. How could I even close my eyes if I can't wake the moment I get a vision...? Yes, I have a lot of nightmares, what about it?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: ...You called for me? Did you come across some trouble? If everything's fine, let me sit here alone for a while... I'm looking at the dead. The unsullied dead will walk among the beasts of the forest... I'm still looking for my parents.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Have I ever gotten lost? Hmm... Maybe. I left my home at first to find revenge, but when I saw all that sullied snow, I could only think to draw my bow and aim, to show the shadows that I was the true hunter. Can you be a hunter, too? Or can you be a companion to carry me out of danger when I'm hurt?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Does the Doctor have the same kind of dreams that I do? Hm, probably not, we aren't in Sami, after all... Lucky enough for you, the shadows won't be chasing you through your dreams then.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: If you come across any abnormalities while we're working together, I'll take care of them for you... Codename? Typhon is my only name. I found it on the horn ornament my mother left behind. Some people say it sounds scary, though.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are you trying to show off your camera skills? No...? But how can you even call this combat experience, if you don't experience it yourself?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Um, what's this promotion badge for again? If it's useless in combat, then let's wait until we settle the danger right in front of us, then you tell me the story behind it.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Many travelers to Sami find death in avalanches caused by loud boasting, or other arrogant behavior. They never even get a chance to see Sami's shadow. You won't make the same kind of mistake, not with me accompanying you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Take these weapons and tools. We need them more than extra hands.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Got it, I'll take the lead. Don't be nervous, I can handle this.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Stay close, don't run off.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't let them out of sight, even if your eyes are hurting.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Stay calm and make your move. No need to worry, I've got your back.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What do you need of me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Time to choose our prey.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Good timing.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'll pin you to your shadow.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Cowards break the silence first.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Nature should not be disturbed.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Get out of my home!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Each of my arrows slows the black that taints the Sami snow.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I see you managed to complete a mission without causing any unnecessary pain to the quarry. Um, not bad, not bad. Sip a hot drink and get some rest.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: If you've run out of arrows or let your target escape, then you should give up the chase. You've already lost.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Grasp these seeds tightly in your hand, and run. Don't look back. I'll take care of things here.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Can you explain how these machines work? I've got a good memory, Magallan explained the structure of the research station last time, and I still remember it all... Well, at least, I think I do.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Nope, you'll have to be faster than that to even think about faking an attack.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Do you have someone you trust standing guard? I want to rest for a bit, your camp is so warm…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Oh, there have been more and more people celebrating this festival. Will you have a feast too? What about fireworks? Always? Seems I've come to the right place. I'm going to look around for activities I've never tried before, so you don't have to entertain me.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What's up, Doctor. Where have you been? You're not lost, are you?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I helped you find a safe spot. Trees, water from freshly melted snow, the rotting flesh of beasts buried in the soil—you have to thank them for joining your spirit and letting you walk on this land. Come, take my hand.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It's good practice to always check up on your prey, because the hunt never truly ends. I've seen you defeat many opponents and save many lives. Good on you, but... you wish to fully wipe your enemy from the face of this land? No, a permanent extermination is just wrong.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm...? What should I do? Just put these papers in this box?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, are you working? Can I watch? Yay! Here I come, sofa.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm super strong! Forget one bad guy, I can take on a hundre—Uhh, maybe a hundred is a bit much... But ninety-nine is no problem! Um-hum!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I found a bunch of these little bottle things in some room, and the sauce inside tasted pretty good. Spicy? Umm... a little. But it's really yummy! Want some, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My den is right here. Doctor's den is above my head, and Vulcan's den is on my left... Okay, got it! One more time? Um, sure. My den is above my head, Doctor's den is on my left, and Vulcan's den is right here!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Whoa… So this is where I started ? Oh, oh, then how far did I go? And where did you catch me? You can find it all on this map?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: So hungry... My tummy's been grumbling for hours. Can we go to the canteen yet?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I don't know much about Arts, but when other people try to use my weapons, they can't make all those cool sparky things happen. Anyway Doctor, don't worry. As long as I'm here, the bad guys can't hurt you. And I can tell who the bad guys are.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Bad guys usually come in groups, and I don't always have friends around. But the more weapons you have, the more power you have. Am I right? So, can I get another hammer for my bag? Or a javelin! They're super useful! No…? Hmph! But I need it!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor's snoring sounds funny.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You seem pretty nice. They call you 'Doctor,' right? My name is Ceobe, but if that's too hard to say, you can also call me Kay. I'm staying here from now on!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I'm watching! I really am!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This little button is for me? Alright, I'll put it on. Hmmm... Done!  Do I look cool?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: One's not enough, two gets the job done, and three is for safety. As long as I bring the right weapons for the job, I'll take out every bad guy I see!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm all ears, Doctor!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm in command? What's a command?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Are we gonna eat goodies when we get back?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Phew... Alright!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Loud and clear!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave it to me!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: See you later!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ha-yah!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Dadadadada!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Stay still, my prey!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: With your brains, my job is super easy! You're the best, Doctor!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: All you need is a little bang, bump, pow! And they're done!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Are you hurt? Should I wrap your ouchie?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Hurry! Run! Before it's too late!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This thing's super fluffy. Lying on it's gonna feel great!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I'll bite you!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, can I follow you around?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Today a holiday? Does that mean I don't need to do anything? Then I wanna stay here the whole day! Vulcan baked a lotta Kay-shaped honey biscuits, and I brought them with me. Hm! Doctor, eat up! Or I'll eat them all!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor! Mhm, that's a proper greeting, right?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Today's the Doctor's birthday, this is the Doctor's cake. I can't eat it before you, I must wait! But there's so much fruit on top, and icing, and jam... Doctor, when are you going to blow out the candles? They said once you blow out the candles, then we can start eating it!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I used to go hungry all year round, and I was really happy when I could just sleep safe and sound. Now I have a warm bed every day, so I'm happy. Oh, and it would be even nicer if my room could have all these snacks like yours does, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Man, I'm so bored... Might just go shopping... You know what, yeah, we're doing it! Come on, put your shoes on. Yeah, we're both going out, that's why I said 'we'!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: That lame look of yours is grinding my gears... Here, have a toy to lighten up. You're busy with work? Who cares about some boring-ass work? Just one thing: don't lose sight of this little doll, or it'll vanish in the blink of an eye.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Maaan, I'm so hungry... But as they say, gourmet food takes a gourmet cook. My brother's a great chef, you get hungry at one of our family reunions, just call him up and he'll take care of you. Now that's what I call service! Rhodes Island's food tastes like crap compared to his.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Lungmen's a pretty chill place, but their cuisine? It's got no kick to it! How can they eat that flavorless baby food? Listen up: spice is a way of life. Once you taste a little pleasant pain and feel that explosion of heat on your tongue, you'll realize what you've been missing all this time.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I used to just focus myself on what I needed for daily life, but I'm the type to really absorb my surroundings. And somehow or other I keep getting into fights. So I guess I could say it feels weird to NOT carry a weapon around. So it goes, I guess.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Rituals get passed down from generation to generation not 'cause they have any inherent meaning, but because people find their own meaning in them. A performance has its rewards, and a wish has its fulfillment. And when one of my favorite stories is involved, you bet your ass I'm gonna participate.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: If you're out of touch with reality, you'll end up crushed beneath its boot, sooner or later. You'd think that's common freakin' sense, but some of my siblings ignore reality for what it is. Their dull lives are only gonna get harder for 'em as time goes on.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Your dreams turn to haze when you've lived as long as I have. But I've got better stuff to do than dream all day, and that's why l feel so alive. Sure, life is suffering, but seeing people carve something out for themselves is incredible. And as for you: think you got what it takes to be the anvil to my hammer?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Blacksmithing may just be a regular old occupation, but it was also a part of early civilization. I'll keep metallurgy well and alive, even if everything else dies out. That's the future I chose for myself long ago. And you, you've made important choices before, haven'tcha? Don't ever go back on them. Stay true to the end and see it through. That's what it means to complete something.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You're sleeping AGAIN? Wake up, sunshine! We're going shopping! C'mon, hurry!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Anybody home? Heard from one of your guys that I can make a comfy living here! Something about free lodging and food, with plenty of free time left over... Hm? This area is for staff only? Don't be like that! You make it sound like I don't belong here!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Huh? What good do you think this stuff's gonna do me? Skills like these are only useful to people who value them.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? That takes me back... I got something like this once before. Anyway, that's cool, I guess. You have my thanks!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: People are like tools; you can classify 'em. And you, you're an interesting one... Or should I say 'unusual'? I could forge you a good sword, but since you ain't gonna swing it, let alone fight in the first place, it'd just be a waste of metal.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Guess one thing's never gonna change with time: swords will inevitably clash.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Say what? Lead the team? Never led anyone before, but I guess I'll try.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: A smith's gotta be ready to pay the debts accrued by the weapons she forges.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: My sword's gonna cleave your bodies and values alike.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Oh? You want me to handle this(, personally)?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: A knife, a life; weapons are the basis for society.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: 'When 'tis a choice of life and death, why shouldst thou lay down thy arms?'

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's just get this done with.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You dare strike my shield with your spear? That's gonna end with you in pieces!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: My body burns at over 1,400 degrees!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Even a virtuous king must, from time to time, look to the sword.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Why do I gotta waste my precious time on the likes of you third-rate amateurs?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Not bad! I see some faint promise in you!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: These small fry ain't even close to quelling my hunger.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Man, you sure messed up. What'd I tell you about air bubbles weakening the iron?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Terrible... If I really let myself loose, things would get a whole lot nastier... for everyone involved.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Mind if I do some redecorating in here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Dude! Stop it!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hold still! I'm making you a little something for your ear. It'll look great, just don't move!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Aww, yeah! Today's the day I've been waiting for! It's time to release my brand-new masterpiece! That's right. Unlimited Showdown in the Siege of Monster Doomsday. My blood and sweat went into making this one a special effects blockbuster. You're not gonna watch? Wait, wait, all of you got the day off, right? Why aren't you coming?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Yo, Doctor, you had lunch yet?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Birthdays, huh? Yeah, heard of those. You guys know where you came from, when you got here, so you like to celebrate the day. Here, this hammer's for you. Can't lift it? Hehe, of course you can't. I like to see people live and grow, you know. If after all these years, all we've forged is weapons, without honing our people, then the weapons are just some lumps of metal too heavy to wield.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The food was bad, but a fun time was had, sort of... Well, I know they had fun, but I just couldn't enjoy myself. All I see is Rhodes Islanders putting down their weapons, and coming to munch on spice and play mahjong with me. And when the party's over, they pick those weapons right back up. It makes me think, damn, what a shame. Hey, what are you gawping at me for? C'mon, let's take a walk.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm? Did I not explain that you were forbidden to enter without my express permission, after knocking? Oh? This is your office? You're working? Then have I not come out of my room to work as well? What is the meaning of 'your office'? Get out! I'm still sketching it out.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You want to see my painting? You may. For you, I could even give you the painting. But if you like it, I won't give it to you. You don't like it? Huh, then you wouldn't want it anyway. This is who I am. Deal with it.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Haa… I'm trapped on this ship. If anyone asks, you tell them so, and you do not let them into my room. I'm taking up space? I'm refusing to perform my operator duties? Hello, I am Dusk, the great painter trapped in this room.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm not going out. Don't try to make me go out, I don't want to go out. I no longer care for the world outside. Do I dislike it? I like it fine. The mountains and rivers, the flowers and feathers, the pools and forests, the common folk, young and old, I could paint forever, I could watch forever, and yet, I will not go. It does not hold my interest forever.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I loathe the word 'taste.' What gives these people the confidence to demand something good just as they open their mouths to lock the gates to others? It is unbecoming. If you are satisfied, you are satisfied. Should you enter, you must not bar the gate. Do you see the twin moons thinking only of themselves?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: An opportunity to watch me paint in earnest comes but once in a lifetime to one in ten thousand individuals. 'When the time comes, the strength of heaven and earth are one.' Ch'i, bone, shape, color, method, pouring out as a vast river, fine like the shadow of mountain bamboo, such is my brush, and it will not stop.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I took the time to partake of some contemporary works. Films are not bad, they are like paintings. The good ones all have a unique strength of character, with form, and with decent meaning. Right, poetry and painting have a legacy. Do you have time to help me burn Nian's mountain of garbage? She is denigrating the very concept of cinema. Please.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Food? Oh, thank you. Hm, where does this drink come from? It's good. Quite good. But I feel like it's missing something. You want to know what I usually eat? Then close your eyes. Ah~ You feel nothing, yes? That's because if you don't look, the food in my paintings does not exist.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Take a look at Nian's carefree expression. You know the truth, don't you? She cares quite a bit about our lives, and our deaths. As for me? I may not get along with the wretched scribbler, but neither of us care much. When people die, the paintings remain. When I die, my work remains.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Dreams are like unto life, like unto the scroll. One sleeps this sleep, will one sleep for millennia?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Oh? {@nickname}? Another contract? Very well, please don't bother me again after I sign this one. Here... I should tell you here and now: I, Dusk, do not give out my paintings. Not to anyone. And I don't take commissions!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hm? A swing of an axe becomes rivers of blood. Do you mean... you want me to paint this?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Why use a sword? There is a reason. 'With an inkstone sheath, one may learn the annals. With a brush sword, one may paint the celestial.' Is it true? Naturally, I speak off the cuff.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Ahh, to make it this far with me... I should paint you a scroll. But be careful! Do not get caught up within it. The world I paint is much more fascinating than this one. How many have been lost, since ancient times? How many have escaped?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Don't keep me too long.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Captain? What does a captain do?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's get this over with.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'm in a good mood today. I'll give you this one I've titled 'Bones on the Sand'.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Don't go too far.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Better leave the fine brush at home.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Would any of you like to be my paint?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: This battlefield would do well with a splash of ink.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Too difficult to explain, let me paint it for you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: With the setting of the sun, the brush draws up the peaks!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Copy the infinite with the tangible, bring the intangible to life!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I am rather attached to you. Most of the time.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Once, painting and war were quite different. But with this power, battle is art.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Not bad.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hm... a failed painting must be destroyed. It will bring shame.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Slipped on a stroke? Start over.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Do not bother preparing the room for me. I will handle it myself.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You'll spill my ink!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey, don't get paint everywhere.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The New Year? A human's life is brief enough as it is. It's like partitioning a tiny dot on a scroll, thinking what to draw here, what to draw there, coming and going full circle, living and dying in exhaustion. But whatever. A moment of laughing and feasting is valid enough, I suppose.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What was your name again? Oh, {@nickname}?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: What? You wanted me to celebrate your birthday? Don't think I came all the way out here just for that, I'm only getting some fresh air and happened to run into you. Oh, and here, a painting I messed up and stopped caring about, so now it's yours. What did I draw? Why don't you go look in a mirror and compare.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I keep saying, don't bring me out for nothing. You want to celebrate together? Celebrate what, me being trapped here this long? Get out, get out, honestly... No, the decorations on the wall were me scrawling randomly, and I didn't draw them just because Closure asked me to. Once again, I don't take commissions.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: This here Croissant guarantees yer safety, no matter where yer headin', Baws! Oh, 'n payment's upfront! 'Member that!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Make a buncha money workin' yer butt off! We can't be livin' in no poverty, after all!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Yer kiddin'! All yer people got such shiny gear on 'em! Lemme have a touch too!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Boy, I sure love orderin' new gear! Feels like I bought enough stuff to fill the whole depot! This what they call a 'shoppin' addiction'?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Every month there's more 'n more bills to pay... 'n that's why I sell some stuff I find on the side! Everythin' I got is cheap 'n high quality!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Move this, lift that. If we gotta be haulin' things, might as well pick some easy-to-use and yummy-yummy stuff!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Baws, Baws! Found this here heckin' tasty thing lyin' around, ya want a bite? Ya ask me, the only thing second to gud gear is gud food!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Baws, c'mere a sec, wouldja? Take a gander at my wares! From fancy clothes 'n everyday items to office supplies and gear, ya name it, I got it! Buy in bulk 'n I'll give ya a discount!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Baws, I gotta thank ya! With all them referrals, I can buy everything I ever wanted! Yer the best, Baws! Love ya lots!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Aw shucks, gotta tighten my belt again this month...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: The name's Croissant, and by golly yer in luck, Baws! Won't find nobody as good at their trade as I am! I'm strong, don't break easy, 'n if ya hire me right now, I'll give ya a 20% discount!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I reckon I'll get more work if I get stronger!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank ya kindly, Baws, fer helpin' me find such a nice job.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Baws, Baws, I made good use of that there bonus ya gave me! Check it out, I don’t got myself some new gear. All the better to keep ya safe!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave the defense to me!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Listen up, y'all! Let's do this here mission nice and cleanlike!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We'll be back with the best results ya ever did see!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Well lookee here. The bad guys're comin' to donate their gear!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What can I do ya for?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Time to try this here new gear!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: H'all righty!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Here we are!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: End of the road!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Ya ain't gettin' through me!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: THUNDERCLAP!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: That ain't gon' work on me!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ya reckon the enemy dropped a treasure chest or somesuch?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Yeehaw! Mission accomplished!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Dagnabbit... the enemy got away! That ain't good for my rep…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Aw, shucks… First I lost the fight, and now my wallet…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Ya got any treasure chests hidin' 'round here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Baws, Baws, got any nifty stuff on hand? C'mon, I wanna see!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Baws! The Penguin Logistics girls're countin' on yer business. And my hammer and shield'll keep yer goodies safe wherever they need to go. Hehe, if'n ya trust me enough, feel free to cut out Emperor and send the job straight to me!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Howdy, Baws!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Shhh! Rise n' shine, Baws. Get'cher clothes on! We gotta move before the others wake up. Texas's got the engine runnin', and Exusiai's talkin' about a champaign buffet with all the rubber bullets we'n shoot. Relax, Baws, we know a thing or two about birthday parties.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Even yer most carefully-laid plan ain't gonna carry you outta the swamp when yer all stuck in it. That's when ya come lookin' fer the unstoppable force! Hold the shiny equipment! That's the reason Rhodes Island n' Penguin Logistics're like two peas in a pod! Here's to keepin' that unstoppable force rollin', Baws!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Evocative so. Years and an age ago, the very palace rained and drizzled in the whisperers of consultants.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Yea, when Yan scholars speak of Sui, that is us, and It too. Facts hardly worth covering up; Nian's worries are not mine. After all, I am only me, and my death, no more than death is. The only shames would be this wine and world, for at day's end I love them long.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I was of the mind I would finally meet someone past, an old friend. Never did I think this is how you now present yourself. From knowing not one is one, isn't this like a dream? However, {@nickname}. It is fine to be as yourself. Long have I contended with myself; myself I shall prefer to act.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Where the heart is as will, and its utterance is as verse. If wells your chest with depths manifold, wouldn't failing their writing be shame to meet yourself? Hm? My tail? Ah, so too do I make use of a common brush, naturally. But it is at times inconvenient, as an extremity would be. My body is an unfettered one; who says I can't use my tail?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Poetry, speech, lyric, essay. Though they all differ as their own, they are common in places. A pity the people of now are, by and large unable to exercise patience. To listen to a song, to read a poem. I take no objection to it, but how must our present scholars suffer.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Nian is too impetuous, Dusk timid, yet to see the two as they are now, it seems they already know what they like, and want to do. So why probe at veracity or falsity or object or subject? To bicker and squabble every day, knowing emotion's gamut, is that not what a person is?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: {@nickname}, would you want for me to compose you a verse? Hm? Nay, I'm simply in the mood. I need not write it, nor record it. Ah, wait, if it were a song... that would be quite good too! But to dance a song, I fear I would need some preparation. Good! You sit there, and await me a short while.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I am drunk? Hah... I have not yet seen the sky throw wide, moon rise, seas race, ice break, to wait true for all the world's sobriety would be but the withering of a bud, to want true for deep intoxication would be far too early still... {@nickname}, now, why do you say I am drunk?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Last night I dreamt of you. Nay! Perhaps it's you who dreamt of me. Oh, can you not recall? A shame; it delighted me so, yet I cannot share this revelry. Delighted how? Hmm. That eight thousand years of springs, eight thousand of winters, all dreamt, were no more than a brief handful of autumns. That is all.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Clouds ranged as billows, distant-run roads withered. I, departed of the vistas, sailed a ferry in late autumn.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ling, you can call me. Have my two troublemaking sisters vexed you any? Hm? You've seen me before? Ah... perhaps so, in a dream.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Though antithetical at a glance, your nature is quite similar.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Hm... 'General, I heed thy order,' should I say? Ha, do not take it seriously. I only suppose that if you were truly a field marshal, then I may not mind once again serving as a strategist.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Nian was not wrong. This farcical dream of a thousand autumns is only right to wake from.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The river bends a thousand times, a city lone in desolation, vivid in the mind's eye.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: To scatter the fill of a brimming cup, to share the sip for a soothed sorrow.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Plotted schemes, waged wars, crossed arms, shed blood. An eternity, unaltered and unfailing in its challenge.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: To gaze the fire from afar, knowing not its heat.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Has it come to my turn?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Truly evocative.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: And thus has autumn made reckoned her arrival.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: For the marching, a warsong. For the fallen, a lament.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The split halberd sinks in the sand, great aspirations unrecompensed.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: One word to address all beneath the heaven, one scope to spare none upon the earth.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: When will the hate sunk beneath the battlefield disperse?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Speak as your heart wills, and be as your intoxication wishes.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Another song, sublime and majestic. {@nickname}, perhaps you and I truly are as two entwined friends.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Duly satisfying, as a cup filled to the brim. We should remain level and humble, yet... we ought to sing your praises, yes. You did well.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Mm... things disappoint on occasion; there's no need to blame yourself too hard. Leave the rest to me.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Victory and defeat are commonplace in war. As we have freedom to maneuver, this is not a complete loss.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rhodes Island's interior... I'm lost as to whether I should say it's reminiscent or curious.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm? Do you need me?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What is it? Would you like a cup? You wouldn't? What a shame.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Nian can have her boisterous way. I see Dusk, for all her reticence, has brought out her scroll's creation to join the children in play. Heheh, what troublemakers they are. I will say it charms me, that we siblings tint in this human nature as we live each to our own.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Why, how are you, {@nickname}?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: A birthday? Though all life and death's abundance makes but a farcical dream... Nay, should you be free at ease within, then a toast from me to you is only becoming. You may not be the old friend that lives in dreams, but that we lock eyes and converse apiece here is no misfortune to me at all.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Yea, they are my writings over the walls. A fair accompaniment to your feastful merrymaking, I would tout. Why would I write, you ask? And what would be writ-worthy? Nay, it is but that the drinks flow free and spirits run high. To speak of which, your arrival is just so. I would still essay to hear from you—of much of Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You would like to be my 'kung fu recorder?' The way Rhodes Island treats its guests truly moves me. It is no wonder my sisters love this place so much… I misunderstand?  No problem, I have no qualms with being your subordinate either.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor.' Your title reminds me of the Yanese scholars. Experienced and knowledgeable, they see the forest for the trees. You feel like we've met before? It's true that after awakening from my dream of chaos, I have traveled to many places... Sadly, the more friends I make, the lonelier I feel. Perhaps we are alike in that respect.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: As you can see, I note down only my experiences and insights, rather than any specific kung fu moves. What really matters to the martial arts is 'Yi' — your intent. If you let yourself be constrained by those gaudy forms, you will find it hard to break out of them. Take Dusk's paintings, for example. If I couldn't grasp the intent behind them, and sought to discuss techniques and styles with her, she would only shut the door on my face.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I agreed to be a 'fight choreographer' for Nian's movie. It keeps her from making too much of a racket, or getting too lonely. Dusk is timid, and Ling is too fond of drink. I will look after them as well... We are far from a normal family. Nevertheless, we are siblings, and not the collective 'we' as we are often called.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Death is a daily occurrence to warriors on campaign. But the real challenge they face, is preserving their humanity and morality after facing such morbidity, rather growing jaded and desensitized. Indeed, conflicts and mortality have been the way of these lands for eons. But only those giant, terrible creatures are cold-hearted enough to think so.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The world is a vast place, and wonderful sceneries abound, yet man has limited strength and time. It is impossible to see all these sights, much less defend them. To those who practice the martial arts, all we can do is train day and night, from the depths of winter to the height of summer. It may sound like a clumsy and brutish method, but the result is giving every last drop you have, leaving no regrets.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: That sword is an unwanted possession that must not be cast away. Huai Tianpei keeping it is an outcome that all concerned parties can accept. My duel with him, you ask? He trained for forty years, and landed a single heavy blow on me. But how many comings and goings of spring and autumn have I trained? All things considered, I was the one who lost.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: 'Who am I'... For this question, you need only gaze upon the water. Be it human, beast, mountains, foggy woods, or the reflection of the twin moons on the night sky, whatever it is you see, that is your answer. As for the distant, radically different future, whether we siblings will return to chaos and seek new answers, is an entirely different question.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The scholars at court seek perfect answers in everything. The kung fu practitioners who wander in jianghu seek revenge, status, glory, or a simple resolution. Their obsessions run deep, yet their time runs short. Often, they spend their whole lifetimes chasing a single ideal or undertaking... All those people, how woeful and pitiful, how respectable and regrettable.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: The spring comes and goes, leaving a lonely autumn.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, thank you kindly for taking care of my sisters. I hope you will excuse me for intruding upon Rhodes Island for a little while. Please call me 'Chongyue.' It's a name given to me by... an old friend of mine.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The colors that once embellished the autumn grass, hues long buried by war.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Often I think about those soldiers who traveled from all corners of Great Yan to Yumen. They risked their lives in battle until death took them, or their age crept upon themselves... yet never for their own ends.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Battles we have fought, death we have braved. Doctor, no need to say more.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Lit, quenched, then lit again… The signal fires never ever rest.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: In that case, Doctor, will you beat the drums for me as we sortie?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The sunset weaves a silken river. Heaven and earth bolster me upon departure.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Warriors from afar rest scarce, the armor they wear spurs them to march.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: One should spar from time to time.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: At your command.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Look at this spectacular sight. Alas, it is now a battlefield.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Many intellectuals must join a battle before penning a decent verse, including that sister of mine… This too is an opportunity.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Unsteady posture, wavering intent. Much to learn yet.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: A thousand moves in one breath!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Strike, and sunder the tides cleft. Retract, and leave no peace bereft.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: After all this time, you still turn to war for solutions!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You calmly place your pieces to plot your victory... Doctor, a weiqi player like you is a truly rare sight.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A thousand armies move at the beating of your war drums, with a handful of sand to clean the blood from one's armor... What a tremendous victory!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
