lines.text: There is never a true victory in brandishing a sword and formulating a strategy, while looking for gains and losses is an even greater folly. So long as you leave no regrets, then all is well.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: All warriors must face defeat. Don't lose heart.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This is much more comfortable than a military tent. Can I even manage a good night's sleep without the sound of drilling soldiers…?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Doctor, have you figured out how to counter that move from yesterday?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: The times are changing, and man along with them. So too does the scenery change.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Nian, Dusk, and Ling are already drunk? It's not often Rhodes Island gets this lively...Let them be. Relax, I will keep an eye on them. Our sibling 'reunion' may be an extraordinary event to most, but this too is human nature. Who are we to reject participation in these traditions?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, I did not see you at this morning's training session.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Once I traveled through Sargon and taught the locals a few moves for their defense. From what I heard, they became very fierce and instigated many riots. Ever since, I have been careful who I teach. This booklet contains instructions on how to strengthen your body and health. Take it. It is a joyous day, after all.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Yumen throws a banquet rather like this every year, to reward its warriors for their work the year prior. The men would clatter their weapons and sing along with the beat. But the next morning, they would still be up for duty, no matter how inebriated. Just like that, Yumen has traversed the lands and defended Great Yan's peace for a hundred years. Doctor, what is it that you defend?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, all life requires both sunlight and water to grow. While this potted plant seems to have its needs met, I don't think you've had your ten cups of water yet today.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Who am 'I'? The answer lies only in all that I've seen. The same way seeds are inanimate, and yet they germinate after you put them in the ground. I too lodged myself in a seed once, to feel the growth of life. You wonder what it's like? Hehe, take a deep breath and you've more or less felt it.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I am no fin, and yet I can reason what one is thinking. You may say I've spent the whole day idling. But you are not me, so how can you tell I've not been swimming freely with the fins in the ever-flowing streams? Yes, I know you think this water jug is too small for fincatching, but who's to say I can't drop a line in?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My eldest brother Shuo guards the border all year round, while my eldest sister Ling sleeps her days away clutching a pot of wine. Without me worrying over the rest of us, we would've ceased to be 'siblings' long ago. Hmm? Of course it's my duty to look after them—I'm the sixth out of us twelve, making me a big sister to five.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, give me your hand. I'll read your palm. Hmm... Your heaven, earth, and human lines are really impressive. Your past is dim and vague. Your journey is fraught with peril. Your future is criss-crossed with conflict... I see, Doctor. You are an 'ordinary one' who 'stirs up a storm fighting for a good end.'

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: A pity? How so? Petals fall to the ground, so the soil may be nourished, allowing new flowers to bloom the following year. Rivers flow into the sea, but the water will condense into clouds, raining the drops back onto the mountains and streams. Even if this great land is to meet a snow-white end, the cycle continues. When spring comes, there will always be buds sprouting anew.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Grain Buds is teaching some children how to make string figures? Yes, it's a Yanese children's hobby. A millennium ago, my younger brother had just arrived in Dahuang, where he invented this pastime to entertain the lonely children. A string in his hands could turn into countless hours of fun... Ah... it's been a thousand years.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, there's a pond up ahead—Nian! I see you adding chili oil to Dusk's cup. The villagers tell of a huge fin—Dusk! Pouring ink into Nian's bowl is going too far. Oh, Doctor, would you like to go fincatch—Are you two still fighting?! ...Get over here, both of you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Our lives vary in their spans, and in their spans only. Just as how this landship holds so many people on its decks, a fallen leaf floating in that puddle is a sufficient vessel to sustain an ant for its entire life. Our burdens only grow as we gather more, yet you and I are naught but a single millet grain in our respective realms.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: In east sun lifts; in west moons fall. Spring cold foretells rain; summer chill, clear skies.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nian should have already told you my name—'Shu'. With my eldest brother, eldest sister, and my two younger sisters here, I feel as if I've returned home… Intriguing. Has that boy from the Sui Regulator not caused you any trouble yet?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Sow no reason for retaliation—point your blades at one another, and strife will never end.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: The people of Dahuang pray for a year of peace and harvest with this jade cong. The ceremonial artifact also serves as the source of the one I hold in my hand. Summon wind and rain? Hehe, of course I can. Want me to demonstrate?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The fertile fields stretch to the horizon, the fragrance of rice spreads from the golden ocean... Day after day, year after year, with constant work, it finally draws near.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: A day of fine sun and gentle breeze. I hope everyone makes it home safe.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just don't get yourselves hurt.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Reap not what's sown by malice.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: When were the seeds of this tragedy planted?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I wasn't supposed to act, but…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: If you're really incapable of settling this, then let me handle it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Spring breeze, timely rain; now we sow the grain.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: 'War'... A word I've not heard in a long, long time.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Clear skies for Qingming, rain clouds for Guyu.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Sow the mountains when summer leaves a white dew. Seed the plains when equinox paints russet hue.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Branch and bone bear weeds; mounds and ruins bloom fields.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'll plant you into the soil to grow anew.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Seeds are now in the field—another season full of hope.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Good, good. I had no idea you were so clever and learned. I was going to ask you help me make maiyatang, but with such a good head on your shoulders, I'm feeling a little bad now.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Perfection is a tall order, just as our crops may suffer from inclement weather, Catastrophe, and pestilence. These problems may not be solved in ten thousand years. You tried your best, Doctor.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Fortune and misfortune are two sides of the same coin. What you have sown is not necessarily wicked, so why lose heart?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Now let's see... where's a good spot for my fincatching tools?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You want me to plant you in the soil too, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hm? You want to come fincatching with me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: 'The third nine days after Winter Solstice, all lakes and rivers frozen to ice. The fourth nine days, we can still walk on them.' Soon those ice surfaces will be thick enough to carry us, and the coldest time of year will arrive. Did Nian's hotpot warm you up? If not, you could ask Ling for some of her drink. Come on, let's go out and see if it's snowing. An auspicious snowfall tells of a bountiful year, and perhaps the new year will bring us a good harvest.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, come over here for a bit. Let's see... Hmm, the crops cultivated in Jiangqi this year are indeed taller than a man.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. You want me to tell your fortune for the year? Hmm, I see a prosperous one in store for you. Your effort will surely bring you gain, and all your wishes will come true. Truths or lies? Like I've told you before, the answer's in your hands.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Hehe, what a crowd! It calls to mind some sights in Dahuang. I would take you to enjoy the local opera, if we get the chance. In the old days, its people numbered no more than a hundred, but today it truly is a city. I see you've gained a good number of new faces too. For tens, hundreds, and thousands of years, the ancestors led our way, and newcomers joined our path. And you see, we are never alone.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Ah, I see this is a fine location. Alright, then… 'Daily desserts, fresh out of the oven, in limited quantities.' Heehee, there we go! Oh, Doctor? Nothing special here. Don't let me keep you.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, I don't know what Nian told you, but I must emphasize this: I. Don't. Cook. Without good reason. A chef must be particular in his prepara... Wai-wai-wai-wait, that bag of snacks is your lunch? Tch, aiya... stop eating that, I'll whip something up for you.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm fairly confident in my culinary arts, but just as there are those who indulge in exotic delicacies, there are those who prefer bland flavors. You can't satisfy everyone, and it's also a matter of whether fate allows for a chef and a diner to cross paths. So, do you find this dish to your liking? If you want any special treatment in the future, you'd better nod right now.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm laying low on Rhodes Island to dodge my debts? Who said that? I owe Ji a little rent, but he's had plenty of my cooking! My siblings only ever think of me when they're hungry. Doctor, now you know who's the dependable one in the family!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: 'A nobleman stays clear of the kitchen.'... Hmph, I wonder which bitter scholar dreamed up such nonsense. Just because you ignore something, it ceases to exist? People eat five grains, and then they have six desires and seven emotions. Nothing could be more natural. The work of this kitchen is, if you ask me, the most significant thing in this land.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I love the mortal realm. I mean, who would want to go back to that primordial chaos after tasting all these different flavors? Sour, salty, bitter, spicy... miss any one of them, you'll never master cookery. Likewise, joy, sorrow, separation, reunion... if you don't understand all of them, you'll never learn how to truly be a person. Yeah... Now, I've come to understand all the tastes.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Blaze went home, and brought Miss Ning along? Ah... Good for them... Shh... nope, I didn't fan the flame or anything. Oftentimes, what matters is who sits around the table, rather than what's upon it. All I want is for my patrons to enjoy their meals. The land is home to many flavors, but nothing compares to the taste of family reunion.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: 'Who am I?' My siblings have all thought things through. Me? I'm not ready yet. There are still many dishes I haven't tasted, and too many TV dramas I have to finish... Hey, wait a second. Doctor, just play your tile already. Bringing up philosophical questions right when I'm about to win? That's cheating, and it's way too obvious, you know!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Here we come to this moment again... You are just like that brother of mine. Once you've got your mind set on something, nothing else matters, and there's no going back. Hey-ya... You see, Doctor. Soup needs to be simmered slowly to develop its flavors, but it can be so mentally exhausting. That's why... one must always take care to eat well.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'm still not used to the quiet without a kitchen fire burning nearby… It makes me so sleepy…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, you must be the Doctor. I'm here to visit my brother and sisters. Do I sign the visitor's log here? Alright. Hmm...? Logistics Operator Employment contract? Nian! You tricked me again!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Maybe we should watch something else while we're eating?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Bitter gourd is in season now. Deseeding, blanching, and adding it to the soup brings out the most flavor. Some find it too bitter, while others are absolutely in love with it. Palates differ, and sweetness or bitterness are unique to each individual.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Oh? Trying to keep me here? Haha. There's nothing to be ashamed of. You've had a taste of my cooking. If you could forget that flavor, wouldn't all my years of culinary practice have been in vain?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I won't fight for nothing. But for the right price, hehe, I'm in.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: A-hem! The chef has the final word here.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The mung bean soup is already simmering. Whether you want your beans intact or fully dissolved depends on how quickly you return.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Line up, line up. We have plenty of good eats for everyone.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Patience, friend. Heat control is everything here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Quickly! The spare ribs have been stewing for so long, they're falling apart!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: So long as you're here, have some hot soup before you go.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You will get what you deserve. I mean, what you ordered.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Cold oil into a hot wok. The heat is just perfect.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Slow-simmer on low heat. Patience is not optional.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Tough to swallow, huh? Try to behave yourself next time.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Still misbehaving? Then let's kick it up a notch!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Not bad. This recipe will stand the test of time.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Daring to add ingredients like that? You've definitely got the potential to be a top chef.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The taste's passable, but the appearance falls short. Customers won't be as accommodating as me.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Messed up the dish? Sometimes getting messy is the spice of cooking, and life. Wash it out, and the wok will be good as new.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: No open flames? Hmm…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Haha, stop tickling me!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Are you hungry? Give me a moment.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Nian, quit sneaking bites and go call Dusk out. Ling, could you lend a hand? Shu and I are swamped in kitchen. Where did Dage wander off to now...? Ah! Doctor! what took you so long? Come, have a seat and join us! Happy New Year!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Come, have a seat. Make yourself at home. You can order anything on the menu.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy Birthday! This is a present I've treasured for years...my private cookbook. If you follow the instructions step-by-step, you too can become a master chef. If Yu can cook, so can you. What? Still want me to cook for you? Hehe, OK, OK. I'll make an exception today.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I never knew Rhodes Island could be so bustling during festivals. I have literally been cooking on all burners today. But, well, it's all worth it. Just look at all these young sprouts, so full of promise... Ah! What are you doing? Open your ears, and don't measure me! I-I didn't grow any taller...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It has been centuries since the post of Great Yan's Weiqi Attendant was discontinued, and yet you… You simply wished for me to help you in managing these documents? No, I do not understand what you mean by 'can't be in two places at once'.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: If you require someone to share your burden during my time on Rhodes Island, I shall do my utmost. Though there is no need to ask me for advice on medical company work... You wish for a round of hand-talk? There is no need to rush, until the day you take your first step on the Dao of weiqi.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The Dao of weiqi is abstruse, but in the end, it is merely a game. You will not learn of military tactics or political maneuvers upon the gridded board. I have seen no small number of people who enjoy making such fantastical claims. As for the story of the general sitting in his camp, breaking his enemy with ease during a game of hand-talk… According to the Laws of Yan, a general making such merry during wartime is to be beheaded.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I have never seen my younger brothers and sisters act in so ridiculous a fashion before. It seems they have plenty of time to waste now that this affair is over. No need to inform them I am here. So long as they can live together happily like this… You have already informed them?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Through a thirst for victory, seek peace. In this point, and this point only, can it be said warfare is connected to weiqi. People seek egress from all sorts of unbearable struggles, yet it is thus that they can speak of their future. I cannot read your future, but I believe the choices you make are in accordance with the proper moves on the board.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: That game with It has come to a close, all resentment, gains, and losses stricken from the ledger. Can it be considered victory? We have paid a bitter enough price simply to find our place upon this earth. Surely you too understand the weight of the word 'decision'… One must have no regrets after placing a stone, but can one truly be free of regret?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: We no longer obsess over leaving something behind. The exception is our masteries, which each of us has spent more than a thousand years honing. They are worthy footnotes in the fickle realm of humanity, and it would be a pity to lose them to oblivion... The fact that they may leave things behind is, for most parts, a treasure, though far be it from me to pass down knowledge.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Quibbling over seniority is inherently ridiculous for us. Not even in ordinary families would you see an elder brother make every single decision for his younger siblings. You do not need to act as my elder brother's messenger. Once this game is over, I shall go to dinner. I am aware Yu is manning the kitchen today.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I have calculated every possible outcome, yet I cannot see a conclusion where these muddy waters run clear once more. But I know she is still there. A move in a weiqi record, a page in a history book. This simple faith shall suffice… You do not need to question my determination. Surely you too have people you care for.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: …After our parting, the blizzard-lashed night outside my window…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You are Dr. {@nickname}? I am honored to finally meet you. As you've already met many of my siblings, I shall not belabor my introduction. I am Wang, a former strategist. As for our earlier encounters… Let us consider them not worth mentioning.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Do you truly wish for me to point out all the flaws I see here?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: The weiqi players of Yan are divided into nine ranks, from the Ninth Clumsy Defender Rank to the First Nearly Divine Rank. As you are now, your prowess should grant you the rank of… This is meant to denote my rank? Preposterous…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: There has only ever been 'me'.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Have your strategies plotted beforehand. You should know how the battle will end before it begins.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You truly wish to entrust this authority to me…?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Three Armies, heed these orders: we march.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Come, take your seats.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Spare them or slay them. The choice is yours.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Simply place your stone. Why ask me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Observe the entirety of the board. There is no one point that decides victory.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You have been drawn into my plans.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Warmongering as ever. Even now, you have learned nothing.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You will not escape this jie so easily.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Admit defeat now, and spare yourself the embarrassment.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: …Why must you insist on struggling?!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: …I am content.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Take it away. I have no need for battle reports.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Such blunderous command.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Guileful moves indeed… Another game, what say you?!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: …This is much more spacious than my last dwelling.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: …Remain silent while you spectate.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I have some spare time today, so I do not mind a game.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Its name is Sui, or 'age'. It seems the people of antiquity knew that time is a terrifying, evil beast. All things are worn away by its passage. I too do not know how much longer I will remember her. Before my memory leaves me… Yes, no need for further urging. I shall come and eat now.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor. I have heard from others that you are not accustomed to rising early.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I have not prepared any curios to offer you upon your birthday. Some seek out pearl shells from the southern depths to make stones and fragrant nutmeg-yew wood from the northern ridges to make boards, but such luxuries will not help them play any better… I grant you this ancient record of a game. Since you now understand the Dao of weiqi, you shall be able to discern the thoughts present on the board. The player? Nothing more than an obsessive like yourself.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You have chosen the most difficult game in this realm to play, but if this is enough to make you consider a retreat, then you have surrendered all chance of victory… Merely a warning from someone who once walked the tightrope and lost it all, whatever that may be worth. Do not fret. By my reckoning, this game is still far from over, and there are still many variables at play.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I've checked your schedule. Isn't it time you took a break? If you'll excuse me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Evolution is the law of nature. But Rhine Lab attempted to tamper with this law, even to take control of it. What a foolish endeavor…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: As a researcher, have you ever participated in some experiments you probably shouldn't have? No? That's good.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Don't you think it's too noisy at Rhodes Island? Everyone should be quiet and focused during work. You should enforce discipline on your subordinates.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My true power has nothing to do with first aid. However, I have slightly adjusted the operation of this power to accommodate it to your command.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You think Calcification Arts only makes organisms weaker? You're wrong. I can condense calcium into a tough enamel. The enemies can try as they want, but no one can break my shield.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You've seen me arguing with Silence? Yes, we do that a lot... Sorry for causing trouble for you and Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Please tell Ifrit on my behalf, 'No matter what happens, I will protect you'... Meet her? No, I'm not ready for that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Even in the most desperate of situations, one must stand fast to be a symbol of strength for the people they hold dear. That is where I draw my line and how I live my life. You'll do the same, won't you?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'll go back to my room if there's no further assignments.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Saria, formerly of the Rhine Lab Medical Research Institute Experiment Team. As for now... I need Rhodes Island's help to bring the astray back to the orthodox.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Good, you must continue motivating your subordinates with your ideas if you hope to maintain influence over them.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Promotion? I don't want any special treatment. But for Ifrit's sake, I do need your help to correct all those twisted laws and rules.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I am within my rights to oversee and bring up my own opinion on your command.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Send me the operation briefing, I will review it.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All operators must maintain strict discipline.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Are they the ones who caused such destruction and started all this conflict?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: It's my turn.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Suppress them.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Forward.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Vermin.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Just who are you weaklings going to stop like that?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This will be over soon.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Solidify.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Yielding is not an option.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Your tactics appear modern, yet the ideas behind them are primitive at their roots. Just who are you?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: All must return to the existing order. None may disobey the rules.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The routed enemies may be calling for reinforcements. We must not drop our guard before we find the last of them.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Where did I go wrong...?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room has interesting decor. I'd be more fond of a futuristic style, though.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm? What?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you might do a bit of research into the past in your free time. You will find many a thing of great interest.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Life is the accumulation of maturity. Hone yourself well in the coming year, {@nickname}.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, are you well?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: According to the rota, you have a workday today. I'll tell any operators who come with gifts to wait to celebrate until you're done with work. The gifts, I'll accept on your behalf and place at the entrance. I'll be placing my present among them as well. Happy birthday, Doctor. Time to get to work.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The founding of regulations and traditions symbolizes that they might be broken, and it is not my job to judge nor to punish, but simply to see disorder rewound to order and chaos returned to organization. The road is a challenging one, but I won't be stopped.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: *Yaaawn*... Doctor, could I take a quick break?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Don't worry about my bow. I keep it well maintained. It's much tougher than you, so stop asking about it already.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: There are so many interesting people at Rhodes Island. Would be nice if I could make a friend or two to travel with.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Nowadays, the Knights of Kazimierz are little more than a bunch of musclehead jocks, or clowns obsessed with billboards and firework shows. Man, it's so lame.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I was planning to return home after finishing this job, but now I've changed my mind. Why, you ask? You should know better than to ask a girl a question like that.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Want to know the origin of my codename? You see, there are different ranks for the Knight Assassins in Kazimierz. There's three Darksteel and two Lazurite assassins above me, but I and I alone bear the rank of Platinum, from now till the day I die. So I figured it'd make a good codename.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Ah, it's Miss Nearl! No, no, I wasn't going to lay a hand on her. I'm just worried she's going to charge at me with her hammer.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Kazimierz is... a boring place. *Sigh*, I'm almost mad at how much more amusing life here at Rhodes Island is.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Have you thought about how you're going to maintain your relations with everyone here at Rhodes Island? You know, all suits of armor have small gaps which leave you vulnerable, and that's where the enemies always try to jam their blades. One hit to your weak point can bring down everything you've painstakingly built.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'm so bored. Hoping something amusing happens.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Assassin of the Armorless Union of Kazimierz here as per our agreement. What am I called? Hmm... Call me Platinum, then. Nice to meet you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Good. My bow feels even lighter. Thank you.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? Isn't the rank of Platinum already intimidating enough? Oh, you are an interesting one.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Hah. Do you have the guts to gaze upon the true face of the one called Platinum, my dear Doctor?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Platinum, reporting for duty.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Really? I'm commanding? It's not my strongest suit, but all right.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Will this battle be an interesting one?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You may as well attack at the same time. You're all too weak anyway.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Your orders?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Who's my target?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll make them disappear.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Moving to intercept.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: First, break their legs.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Second, break their armor.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: And third, pierce their flesh.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Now, it's checkmate!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Nice. I had quite an enjoyable time.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Checkmate. I'm sorry, but victory is mine.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: What a pity that we left some alive.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't give up... He who laughs last laughs best.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The atmosphere here is surprisingly good.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Want to go on a walk? If you're busy, there's always next time.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Huh? Wasn't expecting to run into you here. Me? I'm just feeling the breeze. It's too noisy down there, and too many people. I want to be alone. Hm. Still sticking yourself here like a little dope after you've learned my answer? Could it be... You want to stay with me a bit longer? Ugh—whatever, this place is boring. How about we just ditch in secret?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You look well, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: A kind little reminder from me. Those tickets I gave you WILL expire. Don't make me tie you up and drag you there, okay? ...Day after tomorrow? Alright, it's a deal then. No backsies. What, why am I smiling? Is this your first time going to an amusement park with someone? That's cute. Interpret it however you like, little dummy.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Missions: boring, enemies: boring, but it's still way better than Kazimierz no matter how you slice it. Just getting further and further away from there feels great. The wind from Kazimierz will never again blow my arrows off its mark, and I never want to breathe its air ever again.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I can spend some time discussing matters with you before my next experiment.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You are spending far too much time outside the laboratory, Doctor. As a researcher, you must know this only hinders you from making great strides.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: SilverAsh's sisters? Yes, I've met them several times... Hm...? What more do you want me to say? I know nothing about those frolicsome, ever-changing creatures, and I certainly am not interested in them.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It is incredibly ignorant to simply write off the symptoms that arise upon Oripathy infection as a mere disease, and then to go on to think only about how to 'control' and 'heal' this disease. Don't tell me this is how you think as well.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Shining. I knew I would find her here... Hm? No, she is an excellent scholar, and we collaborated for a period of time until she disappeared one day. That's all.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I am not working for SilverAsh; our objectives merely overlap. Of course, I won't deny what he is trying to achieve holds great significance for the future of the Snow Realm.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The best way you can earn my trust is by showing me your true academic strengths, and it seems you've already realized as much, Doctor. I am not like SilverAsh. I am not interested in deeper emotional exchanges.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: If you understand SilverAsh well enough, you know he is not a callous man. From my point of view, he might even be a little indecisive... That, is your weakness too, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Much like SilverAsh's, your endeavors require the help of countless supporters. However, the more supporters you have, the more you have to worry about. Since you cannot disregard them, you should avoid getting entangled. That is my one and only piece of advice for you, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: It seems you are rather lax in maintaining your own health, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Pleasure to finally make your acquaintance, Doctor of Rhodes Island. I've been eager to meet you ever since Karlan began its relationship with your company. You may call me Gnosis.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: War is merely a means to an end. That said, if you claim there are more efficient ways, I'm happy to learn.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I am far more interested in gaining access to Rhodes Island's databases than I am in a salary increase.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: If Rhodes Island is willing the cross the line, I am sure you will see results that far surpass what you are currently achieving... That said, with SilverAsh as an example, I do understand the reasons behind your convictions. Hmph, allow me to offer a helping hand, then.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: You're in luck. I just completed my experiment.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Fulfill your roles, and leave the rest to me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I can only hope this mission won't prove to be a waste of time.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Follow the plan.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Right.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: You disrupted my train of thought, Doctor.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: A fine choice.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's put an end to this as soon as possible.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: As expected.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I have an idea.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: What a ruckus.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Do not disrupt my thought process.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I look forward to seeing such spectacular results from you in your research, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Having prepared appropriately, these results are unsurprising.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Sometimes, there is much to gain from the unexpected.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Were there too many variables outside our control...?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Time to head to the lab.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I have an idea. Care to hear it?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: My experiences of Kjerag inform me that today will be a raucous day... Well, Doctor, I still have experiments to perform, so if you'll excuse me. As compensation, I will provide you some novel research results. Oh, one more thing: Happy New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You should spend your time more efficiently, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've gathered from the hollering and hooting of the operators out here that today is your birthday. This book will serve as your birthday present. Accept, and then I ask you to please pacify the people outside the laboratory... SilverAsh is here too? Hmm, it seems you do carry a beyond-average estimation in his eyes.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Celebrate, out there? I have no interest. I've made my way out of the laboratory and given you my greetings, so there is no further reason this occasion should keep me, unless you think I can produce novel research results for you in conditions this clamorous.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: H-Hello, Doctor... It's nice meeting you...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Um... Sorry... I'm not a good talker...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Yes... My parents are Victorian merchants. But I haven't been able to contact them for a long time... I picked this code name because it reminds me of home.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Th-That masked Operator... makes me feel... nervous...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: It's not that... I'm trying to avoid people, it's just, I'm not sure... what I should do...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Sorry to make you worry again, Ansel... But you don't have to give me special treatment. Many more people need your help.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Oripathy granted me powerful senses, but they're slipping away, little by little... Even so, I will not crumble... There's so much more I want to talk about with everyone...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, could you take this bottle of perfume, please? I brought it from home... This type of perfume lifts spirits. I often take a sniff when I feel down.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Merry? Keep it down... The Doctor is very tired.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Melantha... From now on, my blade is yours.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you... for your guidance.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you very much... Um, were the others promoted as well? I think they all deserve it just the same.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Understood... I'll follow your orders.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: The leader? But I'm not particularly good at giving orders...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's work to make the world a more peaceful place.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ansel... I'm counting on you now.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Please give me instructions...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What are your orders?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll do my best.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You will fall...!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Attack!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No matter what difficulties are in store for me, I will keep on advancing.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We won? Thank goodness for that...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I can still fight.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We failed... How did things end up this way?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is there... anyone else here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wh-Who's there?! Oh, Doctor...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, thank you for always taking care of me... Um, actually... I'd like to keep taking on the fight.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Um… Happy New Year, Doctor. My parents sent me a letter and a present. I'm also doing a little better today, in terms of perceptiveness. It's a happy day for me. I hope… it puts you in a good mood too.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, thank you for all the care and encouragement you've given me. This is a present from me... some refreshing fragrances. I've already tried them, they don't clash when mixed together. So you can blend them however you like…

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor… How have we been doing? Um… yes… Thank you. I hope I can do better, bit by bit! My squadmates have been supporting me all the way. I hope to repay them… with my strength.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hello! It's my shift now, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: What does my 'Cardigan' codename mean? Ahh, It's actually the name of my clan. It's a family tradition to use it as a codename.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Wow, I found one of my people on another team! I've got to invite her to hang out with me sometime!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I was born in the north of Leithanien, a place full of snowy forests. Oh, that reminds me, I can teach you to ski, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: A lot of people say stuff like 'it's a Defender's job to hold her ground,' but that's such an outdated concept. Speed is what you need! This is the age of maneuver warfare! Mobility is the key to victory!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: *Sniff sniff*... I recognize that perfume, it's gotta be Melantha! I hope we can become closer friends... 'Cause then we'll be able to work better as a team!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hehe, I really enjoy playing with kids. Back in my hometown, I took my brothers and sisters sledding every year. I really miss it! Oh, speaking of sleds... I wonder if Adnachiel can make one for me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I have plenty of things I don't like. Oripathy, for instance... But there's no point in worrying too much. I would rather live my days in happiness! Plus, I've got you with me, Doctor!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Woof!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Heeellooo! I've never been in such a big mobile facility before! I'm so excited! Merry of the Cardigan here. Are you the Doctor?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ehehe, thanks!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Yay! I will keep fighting hard for my next promotion! I'm sure it will come in time!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Awesome! Finally, my time has come!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Ansel! Come on! I promise I won't lead everyone on a wild-goose chase!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Formation ready! Advance to the objective!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let's go! ...Steward, what was I supposed to do next?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: There's no hesitating in battle!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: All right!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Understood!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I will protect us all!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Aha!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Your attacks have no effect!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I knew we could do it. Right, Adnachiel?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Yeeaaah! A flawless victory!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Thanks, Medics! You saved my life...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ughh... Sorry, Ansel...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Steward, what should I do next?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Woah! Roller coaster—!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Melantha? Huh? Why are you here, Doctor?!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! I wonder why there's no snow outside. And after I spent all that time getting my sled ready… When will I ever get to rocket down the slopes straight into a snowdrift like I did when I was little?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I'm right here, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Yay! Happy birthday, Doctor! Hm, something smells good. You got a gift from Melantha, didn't you? What a scent! Melantha taught me how to make perfume, actually, do you want to try with me?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I promise I'll be more careful, I won't break anything! Sorry… Honestly, my salary won't even be enough to cover the damages if I keep breaking things… heheh…

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Welcome back, Doctor. Steward at your service.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Steward is my surname, as well as my Operator codename. Doctor, I'm sure you can tell from it what my ancestors did for a living.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I didn't expect to see another from my clan here. Is she looking for someone? I know how that feels... Oh, never mind.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: People often say our fur has the 'color of snow.' Doctor, have you ever seen snow?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Lava has a very distinct fighting style. I thought she was going to cast with her book, but her real Arts Unit is a dagger. Her style reminds me of the mystic who taught me Arts.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: It is my honor to work for you, Doctor. But if possible, I do hope you pay some extra care to Melantha. She's always alone…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Adnachiel is a mysterious one... No one can tell what he is thinking.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ansel... It's okay... I stopped caring about my identity as an Infected long ago. In fact, I received a lot of help because of it. Before the infection takes away what's dear to me, I will use it to create a place where everyone can live in peace.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you tired? Do take a good rest, Doctor. Rhodes Island will need your skills tomorrow.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Caster Steward reporting in. I'm glad to be working with you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I have learned a lot. Thank you.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm glad that you are satisfied with my work. Instructor Dobermann will be happy too.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: What can I do for you?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Cardigan, always read the situation before you act.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Well, I'll be sure to bring you some good news.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: They probably won't make it to tomorrow.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Awarting orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Gladly!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Freeze!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Down you go.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: With the right strategy, we'll make it through any tight spot.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A perfect victory. Good work, everyone!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Ansel, please check the casualties for me. We must prepare for the next battle.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Did we make a mistake somewhere...?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is that you, Cardi— WAI-WAIT! WAIT! Don't touch the equipment!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, is there anything I can do for you?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Heavy snow always dominates Kjerag at this time of the year, burying everything from the last year beneath. With that, our calendar turns a new page. If possible, Doctor, I really wish to give you a tour of my hometown. But, the wilds there are dangerous on snowy days, and you'll need me as your guide.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Awaiting your instructions, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! And allow me to be your personal butler today! Steward, at your service.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Had I not come to Rhodes Island, I would't have had the opportunity to continue my study on Originium Arts, let alone making friends with my teammates in Reserve Op Team A4. I will cherish all I have at present, for chances like these don't grow on trees. So, Doctor, let us keep up the hard work.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: That device you're holding seems to be in poor shape. Would you mind if I take a look at it?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hey, Ansel. Cardigan looks good today. Anything I can help you with?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: We have a squad of very interesting people, especially Melantha. She always seems to be hiding from me, but I can sniff her out.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Cardigan, what are you doing? You look so happy.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Not every Laterano has the right to use guns, rare weapons that they are. In my hometown, we're pretty good at making knockoff gun parts. The crossbow crafting industry is also on the rise. The result is what I have here - a crossbow with a tactical rail attachment.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Would you like to try some of my handmade sweets? I'm kind of ashamed that I can only make 25 types of desserts. It feels like I've disgraced the Laterano people.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: What's wrong with my halo? I don't know why, but it seems to have deviated slightly. According to Dr. Kal'tsit, it probably has something to do with my abnormal hippocampus.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Instead of watching you from afar, I feel much better standing by your side, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, you strike an impressive figure, even when you rest like that.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: My name is Adnachiel. I'm a Sniper from Laterano. Although I'm not yet certified to carry a gun, I can match the veterans with my crossbow!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Put me to good use and I'll be more than happy.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you very much for the promotion.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: We will be fine.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: If anything breaks, bring it to me. I may be able to fix it for you.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: It's time to go. Are you ready?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let the hunt begin.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I will follow your orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: You better run away soon.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Okay!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Gotcha!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Locked on!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Everything went just as you planned, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We have the Doctor's orders to thank for this.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Our operation was a success, but something feels a bit off...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm so sorry...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place has a great vibe.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor? I'm so happy to be with you!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Just like here, everyone would get together on this day to celebrate in Laterano. Some friends would even come visit just for the occasion, and see whether my halo was righted yet. Well, it's a shame I wasn't able to get my own gun before I left, but I guess I clicked with the crossbow anyhow. Slick of me, right?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: May the Lord bless you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've learned how to make fifteen more desserts this year, and though that's a long way off from how many desserts Laterano has, it should be enough for you to choose your birthday cake. I'd lean towards a fruitcake or a raspberry mochi—sweet and delicious in spades.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, nothing's made me happier than getting to work with you so long. I can't count how much you've cared for my squad members over the past year. Whichever way you guide me, Doctor, that's the future I'll sprint for.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, it's time for your injection. Oh, um, are you alright?! Are you scared of needles?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Like Dr. Kal'tsit is always telling you, Doctor, you really need some exercise. I'm new here, but you still need to listen to my advice.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Cardigan! We've told you, if you move like that when you strike, you'll wind up getting hurt.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Good grief... Doctor, you need to take care of yourself. You can't make us do it for you.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Are you worried about my health after so many night shifts? You shouldn't be. My race has a unique way of producing hormones, which allows us to handle night activities better. So I can hand my shift over to Hibiscus at just the right time.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You must stop with the midnight snacks. Don't go bringing up my eating habits. I eat at night because of my race! Yes, it's a racial trait!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm Ansel. It's a little embarrassing to admit, but I chose to become a Medic because I've been sickly since I was young. But now that I'm an Operator, I'll make sure not to burden you. So please treat me just the same way you treat the others.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I know everyone does what they can. But I heard from Dr. Kal'tsit that Steward and Melantha's conditions aren't looking too good... My job is to make their lives as easy as possible. Doctor, let's redouble our efforts, together.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Adnachiel, could you ask Cardigan to settle down for a moment? The Doctor is resting.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Ansel, a medical intern. I'll be assisting with surgery and internal medicine, among other things. I look forward to working with you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I hope I didn't cause you any trouble.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm glad that you care so much for the wellbeing of us Medics.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Ready whenever.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Medical support should be the top priority for any tactical squad.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Alright, all medicine has been prepared.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Injections ready. Prepare for battle.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: First aid box is ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Awaiting your orders.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Ready to heal!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Please hold on!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Clear!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Your medication is here. Take it!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew, thank goodness I brought enough medicine. Please don't worry.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I was very impressed by everyone's performance. It was fantastic.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Please hold on, I'll treat your injuries right away.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We've sustained injuries! I need to get the wounded to the rear. Cover me!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'm checking on the medical supplies here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whoa, Doctor, please don't mess with me!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, I'm very glad that you like me.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The Medical Department actually gets busier around New Year's. People hurt themselves setting off fireworks or gorging on food... I get wanting to indulge in the holiday spirit, but you need to keep yourselves safe too. You know how to take care of yourself, Doctor, don't you? Very well. With that, I wish you happy new year. May you spend the year without that kind of visit to Medical.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good day, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, good evening. It's just past midnight, so I think it counts as your birthday. Happy birthday to you! I got you a cake, but my advice is to wait till tomorrow to eat it. Oh, come to think of it, does this make me the first to wish you a happy birthday?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I only came to Rhodes Island at first because no other place would accept my resume. It seems more like a kind of destiny now. All of A4 are maturing, and I can't fall behind, Doctor. The good news is, test results show my health condition has gotten a lot better over the last year.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Heheh, aren't you the lucky one, Doctor? I don't have any work for the day, so I wouldn't mind keeping you company for a bit.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The marketplaces of Lungmen, the suburbs of Ursus, the ancient ruins of Victoria... Doctor, these lands hold countless beautiful sights, but very few people ever slow down and take them all in.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, do you want to hear a story from my travels? In that case, I think we should get some fine tea cakes before we sit down. Otherwise, even the most captivating story will turn boring.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I've watched plenty of organizations rise and fall, but so far, Rhodes Island is the most interesting one I've seen. Will the epochs bend to your will, or finally swallow you whole...? I'm dying to find out.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, I have a few ideas where we can get some good food at our next destination. Interested?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, you seem to already know a thing or two about fallen angels. Unfortunately, I can't give you any more details than what you've got. Even if I shared everything else with you someday, that would stay my one secret.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, you don't need to worry about maintaining a good relationship with me. Friends, family, and love... I've got nothing against them, but I don't need them either. Heh, not like that's going to stop you from trying, right? Well, I don't really mind, so give it your best shot.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, I'm back from... Whoa, were you waiting for me here? You even prepared a whole table of snacks... Hehe, all right. How could I turn you down after a gesture like that? In return, I'll tell you about the fun I had on this last delivery run.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: ...I see now. The spark of joy I felt when I thought of having a friend like you wasn't fake after all. Scrap what I said before, Doctor. Maybe I do need a bit of warmth in my life.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hehe... Sweet dreams, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hey there, Doctor. I'm Mostima. You might've heard from Emperor that I'm not bound by the contract between Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, and can therefore act independently. Having that said, I'll probably be staying here anyway when I'm not busy. Sooo, I'll see you around.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Well then, let's see how Rhodes Island fights.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You know, Doctor, relying on me isn't a very wise decision.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You really want to see me go all out, Doctor? Just for the record, I have to ask… Do I have to pay for the collateral damage I cause? No, right?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: OK.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Hmm... Sorry, but why don't we let everyone do their own thing?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Ah. I know this place. Let me lead the way.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Get in, get out.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Uh-huh?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Heh heh…

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Nice weather today.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Great view from here.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Seventy percent-ish should do the trick.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: It's about time to wrap things up.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I have nothing against you guys. It's just the story of our lives.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I wonder what we should eat after this?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Feels good. Guess I could use a thrill every now and then.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hm? I thought I missed a few, but I guess that's a job well done.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The results of a battle don't really matter to a Messenger. Just surviving is enough of a victory.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Gotta admit, this 'teamwork' isn't really my thing.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Mind if I go wander around?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Let's have a chat, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: This day used to be like any other for me. Wouldn't stop long at any one place, wouldn't form any serious friendships, wouldn't have fun like everyone else. I never imagined I'd enjoy the holiday atmosphere here. I gotta admit, it isn't half bad. Happy New Year, Doctor, hope we all enjoy it.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How's your day going, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: So today's your birthday, Doctor. Happy birthday. Would you take an incredible story from my travels as a present? I guess not... alright, how about we take a trip together? I'll pick the scenery, you choose the time.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The more dangerous the place, the more enchanting the views get. Once you make it through every layer of danger, to finally stand in the eye of a Catastrophe, you're a part of the scenery yourself. In the end, where will you lead Rhodes Island, Doctor? I'm still dying to see.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You give Kafka the work that needs doing, Doctor, and then I pass it all on... okay! This's just like how underground gofering goes!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Seeing as you're my friend now, Doctor, you can ask me for anything. Oh, but, apart from lending you my shears.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island's fulla all sortsa people I never met before. Everywhere I go, I sees what I wants. Hm? You're wonderin' WHAT it is I want? That's a secret, y'know. Secret.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hmm... still can't read your eyes. They're calm as a lake... But there'll come a day when I get your number, Doctor, just you wait!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, Silence kicked me out againnn! Hard times for a Kafka, sob, sob... huh? I started it by messing up her experiment? Aw, nerts, Silence got to you first... eh-hem, well, good talking, I'm just gonna mosey on out now!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Well, until I can get what I want, I guess I'll lend you a hand. Just lending it, though, okay?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Story goes, I used to live in a real maaad kinda city, dealing with bad people alla the day. But then I came landship-side, and everyone's been some kinda nice with me, even givin' me snacks and all! Mm-hm, and that's why I like it here at Rhodes Island!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: ...Y'know the secrets everyone tries their best to hide? They're like monsters, hidden in the dead shadows, waitin' for their chance. Beautiful... and dangerous. That's exactly why I do my darndest to collect them! Doctor, don't you got anything for my hoard?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, if you've ever got a problem, we can always call my 'friends' from Columbia in to help. Though you don't really gotta. One Kafka'll sort out all your troubles head to tail!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Bet you think I'm goofing off right now, Doctor. But I ain't.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Whatcha need me for...? Hey, hey, wait, no bean-spilling, not in front of everybody! Just treat me like a normal gardener, okay?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Just gotta figure what they're aiming for, and I can draw up some counterplans. C'mon, ain't I a wiz?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Seeing as you really need my power, Doctor, just c'mon and say it. Be like Kafka here, all serious and open, yeah?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Gardenin' or fightin', I didn't start doing either for compliments. But having my own efforts get noticed by you and the rest, well, that makes a Kafka real happy.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Wonder what we can harvest this time?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just leave it to me. I guarantee you're all in for a fun time!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Ah, thinkin' sucks... I guess I'll be listenin' to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Look at all these naughty li'l saplings. Ain'tcha cute... sit tight and Kafka'll trim ya up.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Kafka, roger!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Right here, I guess.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hm-hmmm.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Watch your eyes... I see all your weakpoints in 'em.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You're all just hedges who know how to walk.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Lemme break ya right there.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Kafka knows you're scared. Tremblin' li'l bare branches.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Smooth sailin' just like always, Doctor. Alright, makes a Kafka wanna go get 'em!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Man, were those enemies pushovers. If I'd known sooner, I coulda saved a Kafka some effort.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmm, guess I gotta be more careful with the pruning next time.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Whaddaya doing, Kafka... you can read their plans, can't you?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Where's Silence's lab, again?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: ...Whaddaya think you're doin'.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, Kafka here wants to deck out your office with some bonsai. Don'tcha worry, I'll make 'em look real good.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, let's build us a snowman! First we roll up two big snowballs. We make the hat kinda round, then we do the clothes reaaal long... Ta-dah, one 'Doctor,' made to order! Oh, I dunno though, feels kinda sad seeing a Doctor all alone on the deck!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What work you got for me today, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, birthday cake for you! See the flowers around the outside? Pure bespoke craft by Kafka hands. Careful you don't lose count counting 'em all, heheh! C'mon, yannow fine work like this ain't no sweat for me and my shears. Not that I got anything against working up a sweat for my best bud—hey, whoa, whoa, paws off! No eating yet! You admire the freakin' thing first!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Yannow, I've been here long enough to see all you Rhodes Islanders are real good people. And nothing gets me more heated than good people getting bullied. So if there's ever any bad guys you just can't handle, you drop me a line. A Kafka's always saving some secret sauce—what, no need? Fine. You're the boss, boss.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Umm, excuse me… I've been waiting here... for two hours…

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Sorry… I know people keep ignoring me... But... my Arts aren't to blame…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My Arts... make me undetectable to people... in certain environments…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I… I've never had any friends... S-surely no one wants a friend that…  they can't even notice… right?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My tail... It curls up when I'm not fighting... So please, don't be afraid…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor... you can leave the dangerous work to me... After all... my Arts were made for that…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: These ID tags around my neck… I collected them... I like holding onto evidence... that someone once existed...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Don't let that 'Nightmare' girl near me!... She's dangerous... My Arts don't work on her... Why…?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I… I really want to cure my Oripathy. But if it's cured... what's going to happen to my Arts?... If they're gone, will I... still be of any use...?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor's ignoring me… I don't like it, hmph...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Manticore... My Arts can take out lives silently... Please don't be scared, you're not my target…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you... I-I'm looking forward to you teaching me... more...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Finally, I got a promotion... I always thought I wasn't good enough… so you didn't promote me…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Did I... manage to help you? I don't have anywhere else to go... My home is here... at Rhodes Island... So please, let me protect it with you...

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Okay...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Nobody will like me... as their captain...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Please don't leave me behind…

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Please choose tactics that make use of my Arts... even if it's something crafty and underhanded... I won't mind...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I-I'm ready...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm…right here…

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Manticore… going dark…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Ready... to ambush...

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: That must... really hurt…

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Please, Don't come close…

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I don't like this... either...

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Farewell…

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Even in such terrible battles… your judgement and decisions didn't seem to waver… You're incredible, Doctor…

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A victory by all means... Still...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I can handle the runaways... if you wish...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm sorry... It's all my fault...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'll sit... in the corner...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Eeeeeek!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Thank you for paying attention to me... I know it's your job... but it still makes me happy…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year... More people have  noticed me... in the last year... I'm a little scared, but... a lot of them are very warm, and kind... So, I'm going to try as hard as I can... to adapt...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello... Doctor...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I'll just put the present on the table and leave... Doctor, happy birthday... Eek! Did-did you notice me...? Um, Happy birthday to you... Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I don't want to go through the experience... of losing a friend again... I will defend everyone, with my own life. Even if it's somewhere none of them will see me...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I hope you're not a pain to deal with like Monica, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Monica sure has a weird taste. Did you know she thought about using things like Seer or Baker as her code name? Incandescence sounds about normal now, yeah?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Skadi and Specter are Ægirs, like me. Whenever I see them, I feel like… You know, my heart starts racing. Geez… If this is what I think it is, maybe I should dress up…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: To be honest, I wasn't really interested in coming to Rhodes Island at first. After all, Monica was the one you hired, and I'm just her bodyguard. But then she didn't need one anymore and finding a new job gets my tentacles all tied in a knot, so I decided to tag along and take my chances here.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Monica and I lived together back in Iberia. Taking care of someone as unorganized and impulsive as her was a pesky chore… But she was the best option I had. I don't get along with my family and she was the one who took me in.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The Inquisition used to give me loads of trouble for my crossbow. They'd disassemble it, inspect the structure, and then give me a tongue-lashing for modifying it to look like a rifle. Yep, I know my weapon gives people the wrong idea, but I don't care. The Inquisition eventually gave up and just asked that I don't go scaring people with it. Heheh.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, Rhodes Island doesn't have anything against operators making friends, right? Nah, I was just thinking about hanging out with those Laterano folks. I have been into their guns since I was little, so I tried to style one myself. And that's how this beauty came to be.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You know, my Mom once told me that something happened to me when I was little, but I can't remember it for the life of me. Mom doesn't seem too eager to tell me, either. Meh. I'm doing fine now, so I guess it mustn't have been a big deal.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I gotta hand it to you, Doctor. Taking care of Monica alone takes everything out of me, but you have to take care of so many operators… Anyway, let me know if you ever need help. You know, you're not the only caretaker around here.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Your work-rest balance is all out of whack, just like Monica. Alright… where's the blanket…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I used to be Monica's... Err, I guess it's Incandescence now... Anyway, I used to be her bodyguard. She finally found herself a proper job now, so I'm free to do other stuff. That's all. Hope we get along well.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: So this is how the pros do things...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Before I came, I thought to myself, a security guard at a pharmaceutical company would be pretty chill. And if I didn't make the cut, janitorial work would also be fine. Not gonna lie, I'm starting to regret my decision a bit.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Honestly, I never thought I'd achieve something like this... You know, getting stronger wasn't on my list before, but this feeling isn't half bad. Thanks, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Time for the mission? Got it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm leading? Mm... I'll try my best.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Hope we don't find trouble.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Shoot, here we go again.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready to move.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'd like to listen to some music.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Enemy unaware, for now.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: The visibility's pretty good here.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Breathe… Focus…

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hello. And goodbye.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: That person's pretty fashionable…

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: So many enemies. How annoying.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, want some candy? You can relax now. I'm spent, too.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I'll double-check to see if we missed anything.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: That's good enough, right? Saves us both the trouble.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's go, Doctor. I've secured the retreat route.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Guess I'll take a look around first.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey...
