lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, is there anything I can help with?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. This is my first time celebrating with so many people, and it's not bad at all. Oh, speaking of which, I was supposed to write a letter to Mom before I left, but I totally forgot. Gotta write one now.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, want some candy?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday! Here's your present. I bought Monica one, and it worked really well, so I got you one, too. The bane of you people with messed-up work and rest schedules: an ultra-mega alarm clock. Fail to follow a schedule and you'll get an alarm loud enough to cause a tsunami.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I never had many plans for the future to begin with, and I never thought I'd come this far. Looking back, I made the right decision to come here with Monica... How do I see the future now? Hm... Man, what a question. I got nothing.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's time for my shift. If I'm interrupting your work, I can wait outside.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Have you gone through every new operator's personnel files and info?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Nowhere in the world is completely safe with a war going on. Not even Rhodes Island. Please remember that.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: To be frank, you're surrounded by people from all walks of life. That can be quite dangerous, don't you think?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm surprised that so many other Sarkaz have come to Rhodes Island. What's more surprising is that they actually get along…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My bowgun may not be easy to operate, but it's just as powerful as the Laterano guns. I use it to defend the glory of my people.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I see Firewatch is here. I can't believe she's using the name of our old guerrilla group as her codename. It's like time stopped for her the day her home was destroyed...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: As for what happened between Firewatch and I... she'll tell you when she's ready. All I can say is that I was not the one who led the rebels to her village... but no one would believe the words of a Sarkaz, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: She wants her revenge, and I have my duty. Even though we've met again at Rhodes Island, it probably won't affect anything. Our paths aren't likely to cross.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: What's that sound? Is someone monitoring this room? Or am I just… imagining things?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Codename Meteorite, a freelance mercenary. I'm Sarkaz, as you can see. Do you still want to hire me?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: My aim with my bowgun has improved.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You want to promote me? I see that I made the right choice to work here.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you so much for this, really. I can't believe someone like me could work a stable job here at Rhodes Island. I'll do everything I can to repay your trust in me.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Reporting for duty.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Me, a leader? To be honest, I'm not that good at giving orders.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'll do my best to take care of everyone.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy status confirmed. All units, prepare to engage.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: All right.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: No problem.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I've got a clear shot.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's take them all out.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Fire!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Open fire!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Focus fire!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Get back!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I don't want to see anything laid to waste in the fires of war ever again. Let us put an end to this, once and for all.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Trying to escape after I laid you to siege? Don't be silly.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Someone's escaped. Not the time to let our guard down.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Retreat! Back to the stronghold and regroup.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What's this place?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh? Huh? What?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Is this for me? Thanks.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: That's another year, come and gone. Getting to live one more year is certainly worth celebrating as a merc, but more than that, I don't want anyone else living with this kind of uncertainty... Doctor, I got some presents for the kids of Rhodes Island. Could you hand them out for me?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How's it going, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I want to take this chance to express my gratitude, for you are always looking out for me. I wasn't sure what would be a suitable gift... but I will give you an oath, I'll give it all I've got to protect you. Um… is that okay?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Before this, I'd never stayed with an organization for such a long time, and I haven't figured out my plans for the future, but I really wavered when I heard Amiya say, 'I want to help the Sarkaz.' Maybe there are still lots of people out there, with hope for the future in their hearts.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Reporting in, Doctor! Patrol completed. Nothing out of the ordinary!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I'm starving. That battle really took a lot out of me... You say you've got something to eat? Just for me? Whoa... It's… it's an apple pie! Thanks a lot! It looks great!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Everybody here at Rhodes Island calls me 'Tiny,' but it really doesn't bother me. The boys back on the force always teased me the same way. Hey! Don't pat my head! Or rub my ears! Or squeeze my cheek for that matter!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, I might not make it to training on Wednesdays or Fridays... Right, I need to be out there helping the civil corps to keep the peace and catch the bad guys! Wh-waht? I have an important mission on Friday?!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island has lots of strong Operators, but there's no one who can match my speed!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Time flies, Dcotor. We've been working together so long. I will never forget anything we've been through. But we can't stop now! We have to keep striving for that bright future, don't we?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I just bumped into Skadi in the hallway... Doctor, you think she's cold and distant, don't you? She's actually very kind. Really!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Compared to everyone else, I'm pretty ordinary. I don't have any superpowers, or spectacular achievements to brag about... But I don't need magic or claws to make the world a better place. I can do that with my own two hands! But before that, we still have to eat well.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, you always worry so much about your people, but you never remember to take care of yourself. You can't do that! No matter what dangers you may face, I promise I'll be there to hold your hand! Definitely, you have my word!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm? Why do you smell so good, Doctor? You're definitely hiding something tasty, aren't you?!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Mounted Police Officer Grani, here to answer your call for help! Fear not. From this point forward, I will protect you!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I see. That's another thing I should watch out for. Got it!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: An elite promotion medal? For me? Thank you, Doctor! I'll hang it up with my police medal!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Since the day of my first mission, I've been leaning on this lance to get back on my feet. As long as I grip it tight, my heart will brim with the courage it needs to protect the people and their dreams.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Shall I go scout the battlefield?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You're making me the captain? Okay. I'll protect the whole squad!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All right, let's bring home a victory!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Your crimes stop here!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Leave it to me!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Sure!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: In position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Moving out!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: My lance will clear a path!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Set! Ready! Charge on!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Only one comes out on top when the lances are crossed!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: My battlefield extends well above the ground!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: If you look to harm those under my protection, you'll have to go through me first!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Nice! That was an excellent fight! You all did splendidly!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, please stay close to me. There may still be some enemies around.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Damn it... I can't let myself fall here!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Anyone need help here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Careful!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: If we get the chance, I hope we can see the world together, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! It's been another year, and the energy at Rhodes Island gives me the drive to do more things to benefit Terra. Can't do it on an empty stomach though. What are you guys having? Smells good.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I've tried this a few times with the other operators, and it's super fun! Come, get on my back. Ready? 3, 2, 1... go!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: This lance has been with me for a long time. People say I don't use it to its full potential, but I only hope that justice is served wherever my lance can reach. I won't lose to anyone as long as I know I'm fighting for justice.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Assistant? The one where ye just stand next tae folk, aye? Nae bother, saw that plenty in the army myself. Wait, I have tae do paperwork too? And assess combat data? And compile reports?! Th-that sounds mighty hectic.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Back in school, Chenchen always had a pissed off look on her face, made no end of enemies at first, but tha's just the kind of girl she is. Nae time at all, she had people seein' her wi fresh eyes. But y'know, bandagin' up her wounds, cookin' for her, teamin' up wi her squad and all that... I had tae look after her a fair bit, and that was no easy thing.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm great at drivin' machines! Harvesters, tractors, tillers, I'll be right at home wi anythin'. Hm? PDAs? Screens? Wireless systems? If yer meanin' little gadgety stuff, I'm nae so—ah crims, I just barely touched this—why's it smokin'?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Ye didnae get a proper supper in yesterday, did ye? No, I dinnae want tae hear aboot 'work, work, work'! If yer body gives out on ye, ye willnae be able tae get a thing done. Tell me what ye'd like, and I'll whip it right up for ye. Ah, na anything too fancy though, aye? I'd be lost tryin'.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: This Rhodes Island ship is... crivens, it's a million times more wonderful than Victoria's warships! We've got sunlight, wheat fields, herds of stockbeasts... Doctor, what if, we try growin' somethin' too? Like potatoes, say? I know all aboot growin' potatoes!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Where d'ye think someone's hometown ends? The hoose furthest from the tractors? Or where the land meets the sky? Does it stop at the fronts we keep drawin' and redrawin' maps wi, all reds and blues and lines and arrows...? Y'know, after so many battles... sometimes I cannae recall what my hometown looks like.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I'm sure that I ran across her once, that Reed lass. But she looks so lonely the noo, so pitiful... can she really be the same terrifyin' person I met before? It's right strange. I should go ask her...  What? I cannae talk tae her? Why no?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My mum's part of the reason I ended up runnin' off to military school at all. Always bangin' on like 'Vouivre women must keep gettin' stronger', she is. ...S'pose I wanted to be cheeky about it, aye? Though lookin' back on it, no need to be AS tough as my mum. Och, I'm still more soft and cute than hard and chiselled, wouldn't you say? Go on, say?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When I was still in the army, I came across this spectre-like force. Hauntin' the dark edges of Victoria, and most of the people who witnessed them went missin'. I've a duty to expose them, and that's why I've been scramblin' aboot. Oh, dinnae you step in for me. You've got yer own callin' to worry about, na?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Ah! Fancy that, skivin' off! Aww, got me jealous. Doesnae beat a nice hay pile for a few winks though, aye? I'm noddin' off just thinkin' aboot it... Wouldn't hurt tae take a wee kip myself...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello! You're the Doctor, aye? Officer Ch'en fae Lungmen said I'd be able tae find some helpers here! I need tae sign my name first? Aye, right enough. Baaag...pipe. There! Eh? 'Become an Operator?' 'Full-time bed and board'? Ach, what's goin' on here?!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Whoa, you folks here at Rhodes Island sure can fight!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Hmm... cannae say if I like it or na. For soldiers, more responsibilities means more battles, and a greater risk of mistakes.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Joinin' Rhodes Island has been a good thing for me. Oripathy and the Infected may seem a touch scary at first, but runnin' from it willnae solve a thing. That's what I've learned here, and I mean it when I say, thank you—I see my way now, right ahead of me.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Stand to attention!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Assumin' leadership! Team will hereby carry out the operation!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Honor your orders! Move out!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: All units, spread out!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Orders, please.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Standing by.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Forward!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: My spear and I hail from Victoria!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: 'Tactics sharpen the mind!'

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: 'Discipline strengthens the will!'

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: 'Bravery shall overcome evil!'

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'Benevolence shall save lives!'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Be it school or the military, I've still seen worse.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew... I've managed tae live up t' the reputation of this uniform once more.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Enemy routed! All units, pursue only wi' caution!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: You get out of here! Go!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: How do I get tae the greenhoose?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whoa-whoa!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Wanna go on a picnic? Just the two of us!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The toon always used tae get together at New Year's back home. Roastin', drinkin', dancin' aboot bonfires, playin' bagpipes loud and proud, and then gettin' all kitted out in fancy dress and jumpin' straight intae the freezin' lake. Oh, it isnae anythin' too serious really, just a daft auld way of sobering up a wee bit.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, how's about we go farmin'!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I heard the news! Today's yer big day, Doctor, so that means a meal on you, aye? Me and Chenchen'd always treat each other to supper back on our birthdays at school, heheh. Oh, right, I've got a wee prezzie for ye, too. Here y' are! It's one of the potatoes I planted a wee while ago- just sprung up proper today!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Thinkin' over it, I've been through a fair few battles wi all the folks at Rhodes Island by now. I really do miss the days of lyin' in the hay havin' a nap sometimes. But nobody'd have an idle life to live if I put this spear doon and left, ye ken? So you'll no catch me moanin' aboot it!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Oh yeah, my dude, when you're callin' my name to get my attention, don't forget to stress the K at the end. Or else I might assume you're stammering or somethin'.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, hold up! Is that vampire lady none other than 'Mr. Blood'?! Man, we've still not settled that medical score we had a while back, and this is the perfect opportunity! I'll have to set up my experiment equipment later... Heheheheh!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Lemme guess, Hung's still tellin' you to watch out around me, ain't he? Oh, just to 'look after me'? Yeah, that sounds like him all right. But listen, Boss, I know your type. You're like me, and you just wanna do whatever you want, right? Then just ignore that guy. We can do whatever fun stuff we like.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Yeah, I develop new drugs, do surgery, and nurture bacteria cultures, but those are all just fun hobbies to me. Doc. Aak? Nah, don't call me that. I don't save anyone, 'cuz I can't teach them the value of their lives. All I can do is just prevent 'em from dying.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The medical department guys are askin' for me? Man, give me a break. I don't dig those professional physicians. They firmly believe that being a doctor's this noble job, and are content with saving more lives... before everything just comes crashing down when their faith got shattered. I've seen that happen time and time again. Honestly, it makes me sad.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I don't dislike Rhodes Island. Instead, I think you guys are doing your job just fine. People are dyin' in the world right as we speak, and with all those doctors cooping up in labs, waiting for patients to knock on their clinics' doors, diseases ain't rid themselves of these lands. Hardly anyone gets it, but you people seem to have it in mind... Keep up the good stuff, will ya?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Me, a cynic? You got me wrong, my dude. I simply pity all the people on this land. Everyone's got their own hardships to deal with, and I know that. But what's the point of curing pains and sufferings when we can't cure their source? What medicine saves a man who's being murdered? Terra doesn't need more doctors in suits, my dude.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My pops was an amazing doctor, and he was all about saving people's lives. But his colleagues slandered him, sidelined him, and framed him. That's how he ended up as a underground doctor, the nastiest among the wicked. Stuff like that ain't so unusual, but I'll admit, what happened to him really changed my own life.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Have Waai Fu and Hung left? Really? Aight, I'm gonna hang out in your office for a while then. Y'know, if anyone can make this land a better place, it's gotta be people like them. You, meanwhile... Well, guess we are simply two peas in a pod, aren't we?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Aha! You Feelin' tired? Then come try this new compound I made! Free of charge, of course!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: So you're the Doctor, eh? Nice to meet'cha. My name's Aak. That's right, two A's with a K. Anyway, I'm here 'cause the agency got some business here at Rhodes Island. A quick question before we start: does the phrase 'medical mishap' put you off?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Huh... Does this mean I might get involved in combat scenarios like this? Surely not, right?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Almost too good to be true, man. I knew my agency has been exploiting me all along!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Honestly, I dunno if I'm helpful or not. The way I see it, you've gotta be nice to be helpful, and I'm not blind to how people perceive me. But in any case, if you ever get sick, you know who to call.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: We goin' on a mission? Sure, let's do it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: All right, team, gimme your thoughts on my new meds after this is done.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Once I start an operation, there's no stoppin' it.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Relax, guys. You just can't die with me by your side.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: When prescribing, I always go double-down on the dosage.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I ain't one for battle, but treating peole is so much fun!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Time for a clinical test of my new meds.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Learn to treat yourself with kindness, or regret when sickness treats you.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: All lives are equal... while yours is a deviation.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Just take the shot. You will be amazed.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: My potion might give the bad guys a new leaf to turn over!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Medicine, a box you wish you've never opened!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I doubt I can make the world a better place on my own, but at least I can stop it from gettin' any worse with your help.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Could we capture some enemies for a little experimenting? It's not violating ethics as long as no one sees it. Not a chance? Aww.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Letting 'em get away like that? You are a saint.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't worry, my dude. I can fix any injury as long as the patient's still breathing.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Now, now, let's see. Which of these rooms is my new lab?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ah?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Yo, my dude! Found any new experiment samples for me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, my dude. Hung just made a bunch of food, wanna try? I don't really do holidays myself—big rowdy pointless time, when you could be sittin' here takin' the breeze in. But hey, want some tong sui? I got it from the dining table, and man, it's not half bad.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, my dude. What's cookin'?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Heheheh, here's a cake, fruits of my research! I assure you, it's pure cake, nothin' but the same stuff you find in every cake! ...You heard weird laughing from the lab yesterday? My dude, there was no such thing, and I think your ears might be goin' funky. C'mon, a bite of cake'll fix you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Does it matter that much? I don't really super-mind the kind of man I turn out to be in the end, but it's like Waai Fu and Hung keep having these hopes of somethin'. And Rhodes Island's a little better than what I was thinkin' here. So no duh, I'm happy to keep goin' with you guys.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hi, Doc. Have you eaten yet? Here, I got some cookies if you're hungry.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doc, I know Aak's been a nuisance to you, but could you be lenient with him? He teases people a lot, but he's not a bad person. Also, let me know if he ever gets under your skin, I'll give him a lesson on that.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Just call on me when you're hungry, Doc, and I'll make you a little something to eat. I may not look a like a chef, but I did learn a recipe or two from Mr. Lee.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Say, Doc, do you give any lectures on machines here at Rhodes Island? I've got an interest in that stuff and was hoping I could learn something new.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Hahah, just between you and me, Doc, for the longest time I thought all detectives do the same stuff as Mr. Lee. You know, taking sips of tea at the scene of gang fights, that sort of thing.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm sure you already know, but with the intellect and talent that Aak's got, he's destined for great things one day. But personally, all that matters to me is that he doesn't ever go back to what he used to be.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Me and Mr. Lee, well... How should I put it... I was a bit scared of him at first. He seemed like a clever guy who's got a lot going on, which had me on edge... But now after knowing him for so many years, I know I have nothing to worry about, haha.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hey, Doc, If you need info on something or someone, just tell me and I'll ask Mr. Lee for you. Nothing in Lungmen happens without him knowing about it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: To be honest with you, I actually don't like getting into fights. I'd much rather we could all get along with each other. But I won't back down from inevitable conflicts; there are things I'll fight to protect. Things like the agency, and now, Rhodes Island as well.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Do– Phew, almost woke the Doc up... Guess I'll take this opportunity to rest too.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You must be the doctor that Mr. Lee talked about. The name's Hung, it's a pleasure to meet you. My fields of expertise are security and repairing machinery. If you ever need a bodyguard for a public appearance, or if your TV or fridge break down, just give me a holler!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Woah, your operators never cease to amaze me... I've got to work harder.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thanks, Doc! I'll be giving it 110% from here on out!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doc, don't hesitate to give me all the work you need done. I might not have the brain for many things, but I've got the brawn!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: A mission? I'm ready whenever.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I personally guarantee everyone's safety.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Stay close behind so we don't get split up.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't worry, you've got me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'll handle this!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Where am I needed?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll cover you!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'm here to protect you all!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You shall not pass!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Anyone need healing?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You're not hurting anyone on my watch!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: A little scratch ain't gonna stop me!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: *pant*... *pant*... Sorry, Doc, but could you give me a minute? I'm totally burned out.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You can stay here and rest, Doc. I'll clean up the battlefield.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Stay beside me, Doc. There are still enemies around.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Hurry, Doc, climb onto my back! I'm getting you out of here!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Leave patrol duty to me.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Any broken machines need fixing?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Sup, Doc? Anything I can help you with?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doc! ...I'm in a good mood? Haha, of course, who wouldn't be in a good mood during a pleasant time like the New Year? Anyway, I'll be counting on you this year as well.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Morning, Doc.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doc! Birthdays are big days that shouldn't be muddled through. You've got to celebrate right! If there's anything you want me to make, just name it! ...Sitting here with you? Is that it? Um, okay... guess I'll save those groceries I bought for another time...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doc, congrats on making it through another year. Aak's a lot more steady than he was a year ago, and now he knows the right path to take. Waai Fu? She hasn't needed me to worry about her for a long time. By the way, Doc, it looks like Rhodes Island is holding a dinner party. Anywhere you might need me?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Heheh, Dr. {@nickname}, What can I do for you today?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Combat missions take up most of my job, where I just havoc around with my hammer... It feels nice to get to sort files like this every once in a while.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: When I worked for RIM Billiton, I was in charge of a lot of things: mining ores, doing geological surveys with electromagnets, all kinds of stuff. Hmm... sounds like a mouthful, right? To put it simply, I smashed what blocks the way and kept digging down!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Amiya has a lot on her shoulders. If only I could help share her burden a little... And perhaps yours too, Doctor. Don't hesitate to let me know if there's anything you need help with!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Providing cover, trailblazing, area denial... I might not be able to literally shield my teammates like the Defender Operators, but I can still protect everyone in my own way!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Did... did I manage to keep everyone safe?... *Sign of Relief* I'm so rapt... Please, Doctor, from now on, let me stay with you and Amiya!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, want a cabbage veggie salad with mushroom pies? Yep, I made three servings! Yours, mine, and another for Amiya. She loves the pies I make!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The running backs on the football field are unstoppable. They just keep charging forward in spite of everything, all to clear a path for their teammates. And then they just fall down and leave it to everyone else to finish the job. Isn't that sort of like what I do? It's very cool! I hope I don't have to get tackled though.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, as long as I get to stay with you and Amiya, it's enough for me. Memories belong in the past, while the future is waiting for us to color it in. Amiya and I will continue to create more memories with you in the days to come!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, seems you've got some time to spare... Then let's go get groceries for tea tonight!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Savage, from RIM Billiton, reporting for duty! The moment I got the message from you and Amiya, I rushed right over to see what I could do. Huh? You don't remember anything? Strewth!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ooh, I see. Uh-huh… I totally understand it now!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I feel a lot better taking orders from you, Doctor. I won't let you down!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Don't worry, Doctor. No matter how many enemies there are, as long as you're with me, I'll smash 'em all!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Savage, in position!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everyone, follow me closely!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Begin the attack!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Target located. Attack!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm ready!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What's next?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave it to me!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: This one's mine!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Haaaa!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Mjolnir-3, full power!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Piece of cake!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Incoming!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Hmm, guess no mission's too difficult for us!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What? It's over already? Easy-peasy!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: ...I'd give my performance a C.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's too dangerous here! We have to fall back!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Huh? You're really trusting me with work this detail-oriented?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm? Nnngg?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: All done with work for the day!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! And also to you, Amiya, my little beaut~ Here's to the year you grow tall as a tree. And Doctor, here's to... augh, well, here's to a lighter workload! No more overtime!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Yahoo~ Doctor! Good morning!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I remember you used to love—oh, I bet you don't remember yourself, do you? Oh well, I'm sure you'll still love this butter and pulled-meat pie! It's the taste of a happy life. Amiya's words.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I'm a little dazed all of a sudden, seeing everyone at Rhodes Island so happy. After all we've been through, just having you and Amiya here, safe and sound, is already more than I could ask for. I'll be with you from here on out, fighting to preserve this happiness.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I-Is there anything I can help with? Just say the word and I can do it.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Franka and Liskarm are so incredible! I really admire them. I want to become as great as they are someday. I can... I can do it! Will you help me, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Um, I heard word that Vanilla's here too? She was in my squad when she first joined Blacksteel. We went on missions together! She's become such a reliable Operator now... but I'm still just me...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, do I come off as... spineless? I know I shouldn't let people walk all over me... I'm trying to change...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Sometimes I feel like I'm back in Blacksteel, even after going through so much with Rhodes Island. I'm not the old me anymore, either... it's weird. Is it because I miss how it was back then? No, no. I don't miss the person I used to be, I know that for sure...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Hard work doesn't mean anything without results. That's what I think at least! That's why I don't want anyone to see me training alone. Having you, though... it's really comforting when you're with me, for some reason.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I pulled a muscle training a couple days ago... but don't worry, I-I'm okay! Urk...! I won't let this get in the way of you or anyone at Rhodes Island, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Freeze, hands in the air! Oh, did I scare you? I'm sorry, it's just Franka told me to be bold and assertive, and I only wanted to try it out... I'm really sorry...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Everyone at Blacksteel and Rhodes Island is so amazing and talented. I know I'm nothing compared to them... but, still, just every once in a while, I really like it when I get compliments...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor... Doctor? Are you sleeping? I'll clean your desk up for you, then...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Um, are you Dr. {@nickname}? Nice to meet you. I'm Jessica from Blacksteel Worldwide. Sorry... I'm really bad at introducing myself...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This seems a lot more effective than training by myself.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor... I'm... I'm so happy you're honoring me... Just... let me cry it out for a bit, I'll be fine...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Ah, Doctor, does this mean you think I'm a great Operator? Thank you so much for all your help. You were by my side all the way...!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Just give your orders and I'll carry them out!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I won't let you down!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Stay focused... look straight ahead.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'll definitely prove myself this time!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Standing by...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Haah?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Ughh...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: All right...

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Y- you'll pay for that!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Freeze!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Not one step backward.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'll show them what I can do!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I'm going to climb to the top of the mountain. I won't stop halfway!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I... I really did it? I managed to protect everyone by myself?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I could do better. I can't get complacent just because we won!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Requesting medevac! I dragged everyone down... it's all my fault! Sorry! I'm sorry!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I wonder if the people at Rhodes Island are nice...?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Where are we going...?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I can do a little cooking...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Uh... S-Sorry, Doctor. I think I pushed myself too hard. My hands won't stop shaking... But I can hang these balloons on my own, no problem! Alright... Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, doctor...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Sorry… I can't make anything myself, so I had to buy you a gift… It's too expensive? It could pay for a whole month of training? B-But isn't that pretty normal for a gift?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Back at those Blacksteel ceremonies, when we all got to meet the really highly-decorated mercs, I would find myself wondering if I could ever match them… But since coming to Rhodes Island, I'm always thinking about how much I'd like to go on the really tough missions with the senior operators.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doc~tor~, you didn't forget anything, did you?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Picking pockets to feed myself? Yeah, that was how I grew up. I didn't exactly have a choice. I woulda starved to death otherwise.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If you want sturdy grappling hooks, the key thing's a good rope. Hm? Why do I like my hook so much? Well, go scale a building with your bare hands and you'll see.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Fine, fine, your word's the word, Doctor. Can I go back to my room now? I've got stuff coming up. What? Still no? C'mooon, cut me some slack! Pleasie please?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: If it wasn't you Rhodes Island, I'd probably still be rotting in jail. Say, how'd you find me anyway? Hmm… Maybe you heard about my skill through the grapevine?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: There's lots of ways if you wanna survive in the slums, though more people simply die without a way at all. Never had much of a choice myself. Hope you can understand, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: My parents kicked me out, and I had to fend for myself on the streets. Compared to my days in the gutter, life at Rhodes Island is a massive improvement.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Saw a lot of people get same disease as mine who didn't end well. I kinda gave up on myself too, until I got lucky enough to be found by you guys… Tell me straight, Doctor. You can cure me, right? You...you can't? *Sigh*, I can live with that, I guess.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Before, I was always looking for the next meal. Now I can really eat my fill. Gotta hand it to you, Rhodes Island's alright in my book. Huh? You wanna hear me say 'thank you'? Nah-ah, in, your, dreams. *Gasp*, I just said it...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Ugh, this chair... ahhh….dangit... so comfy...!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: The name's Rope, nice to meet ya. Oh, here's your ID card, don't forget it. Huh? Why do I have it? That's a se-cret!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Does watching this stuff actually help?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: C'mon, lets talk about payment. Promotions are cool, but my salary is what really matters.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Fine, fine. Now that I've got my due, I guess I should give my best.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: All right, coming!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm doing captain biz? I would've asked for a bonus usually, but I can let this slide since it's you.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Look at the map and figure out your route before we get in there. This is experience talking.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: So, what kind of good stuff will our enemies be carrying today?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I don't really do straight-up fights.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Put me to good use, ooo-kaaay?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Sneaky sneaky…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hmm, is this a good spot?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Aha!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Good, good, a little closer!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Huuugh!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Once I hook you, you're not getting away.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: A lot more excitement on that one than usual! A lot more profit too... whoo-hoo~!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: It'd be a waste to leave all that good stuff here. The enemies don't need them anyway, right?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Some of 'em got away? Just leave them be. They might turn over a new leaf, who knows.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Hey! Let's just bug out now, Doctor! We must save ourselves first!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is there an air vent in this room? Nothing, just curious.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Aaaagh! Am I under arrest?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I mean, I'd like to figure out how a normal girl lives sometime... but, you know... I mean, maybe that's not really me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Piping hot food, big wide smiles, piles and piles of presents... It's the kind of scene I would only be able to steal glances at through windows. Thank you, Doctor... Aw, c'mon, I was being serious there! Anyway... happy New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hiiii, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. Got your present here. Go ahead. Yep, it was your wallet, until the moment I took it from your pocket. No harm in giving it to you here as my present, right? Okay, okay, jokes are over, now look inside. I spent forever hand-drawing the card, y'know?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I know. I've been at Rhodes Island so long, I oughta get used to my new life already. I'm gonna stop crawling through the vents, and I'm really gonna cut down on stealing stuff as a prank... Doctor, do you think, that after so many field missions—I've learned to use my skills for the better?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Aaaahhh! You want me to stay by your side? I can barely keep my heart in my chest!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Fascinating...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Don't mind me, just continue with your work.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hmm? What am I looking at? Why, you, of course!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: If that's what you ask, Doctor, I will do what it takes to become stronger.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Heheh... You don't need to worry about any ambushes or assassination attempts. Because I'll aaalways be here with you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Are you finally... a little bit interested in me now? Well, I've always been a big bit interested in you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Thanks for taking such good care of me these days. By my knighthood of Kazimierz, I hereby pledge to repay your kindness with my life—huh? You're not used to me talking this way? But I'm an honest-to-goodness knight. Surely I can improvise a speech or two.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ever since I was taken away to Kazimierz, it's rare for someone to be so kind to me. So, if you don't mind, Doctor... I, Gravel—no, I Senomy, on my honor as a knight, shall serve you always at your side.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: When I'm here with you, don't you feel your heart racing?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Mmmwah. Hm? What's wrong? Your face is beet red. That's just how I say hello. Don't think too much about it. Anyway, I'm Gravel, a knight of Kazimierz. It's a pleasure. Heheh.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are you the one who comes up with all the Rhodes Island's battle tactics, Doctor? Oh~ that's even more intriguing.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You think I'm doing well, Doctor? Yaay!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This means you need me, doesn't it? Heheh.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: You want to go together? Hehe...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Oh~ You chose me!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'll come with you~

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hehehe...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Any orders for me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This is the place~

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Surely a good spot.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I am your shadow.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hehehe...

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You really think you'll get away?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Gather up, my rats!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Of course the Doctor's tactics are flawless~

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: My blade hasn't even been stained red yet... hehe...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Run all you like, Let's see how far you can get.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Sorry... did I... mess up again...?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hmm, looks like there's a lot of good hiding places here in this room~

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hehehe...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Yes. I'm right here, always and forever.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Give me your hand—mmmwah—hm? What are you so surprised for? Kissing the hands of those we've sworn to protect is how us knights of Kazimierz celebrate the New Year, you know. You've never heard of it? Sounds like you need to pay a little more attention.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How are you today, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: How daring of you to tear open a gift package with no sender, Doctor. With that little caution, trouble's bound to come knocking sooner or later~ Actually, rather than being on my toes all day as your bodyguard, how about I just open these up for you, hm?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, does it ever keep you up at night... that you might never find any trace of your past again? Whenever I step out onto Rhodes Island's deck, I wonder, would walking away from here bring me any closer to my forgotten memories?... Say, Doctor, don't you know you're supposed to console me, when I bring down the mood like this?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Awaiting your orders, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The two seniors from the BPRS squad are here too? In that case... Could you assign me to their squards in future missions, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Huff... huff... three more sets of physical training and I'll be half-done for today. Doctor... please... fetch my water bottle for me...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You want to know about my hometown? My hometown… it's a cruel wilderness. Even survival itself is a difficult feat there. Compared to that, Rhodes Island is like heaven.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've become stronger than when I was an intern for Blacksteel.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The 22nd rule of Blacksteel: 'Anyone who loses her weapon no longer belongs here.' That's why I always bring my hellebarde with me wherever I go. The rule doesn't apply to everyday situations, you say? But... if I remember correctly... wait, let me check. 'This rule only applies to contracted Operators and new recruits under training.' What?... Ms. Franka didn't tell me about this part...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Instructor Dobermann's really got a heart of stone! Why choose me other than anyone elase to deal with all those live Originium slugs? I... I just can't!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I think I know now why Franka and Liskarm decided to stay at Rhodes Island. Compared to Blacksteel, this is a place we can call home. There's lots of fun things to do here besides the missions...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Shh, the Doctor's having a rest now. Keep your volume down, would you?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Vanilla, trainee Operator from Blacksteel. Looking forward to learning from you, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's time to organize my notes. I need to digest what I've just learned.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion medal? For me? My-my sincerest gratitude!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm here to help everyone!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Me, the leader? Are you sure about that?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'll work even harder.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I will not bring shame to Blacksteel!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your words are my command.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Okay!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You shall not pass!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This hellebarde isn't just for show!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Battles aren't always won by the most experienced!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Take that!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Whew, perfect victory!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A very successful operation.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: If we worked a bit harder, we could have done better.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I... I'm still not strong enough...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: At your service.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, would you like to dine with me tonight?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! There's so much good food, plus the party tonight; this is bliss... Back home, our evening supper depended on how much we could catch that day. So we'd be out hunting before sunrise, just to celebrate the New Year. It really wore you out...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, I heard it was your birthday. I have some beast jerky from home, please, help yourself to some if you don't mind. The people back home loved it, which is what made them all so strong! Happy birthday, and I wish you another year of good health!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It's been a while since I came to Rhodes Island, and I'm so grateful to everyone for helping me get settled in with life here. I don't freak out whenever an automatic door opens anymo—ah! Doctor, I think a burdenbeast-looking robot just passed by...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: So... I have to just stand here and not do anything? Laaaame.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: These gauntlets aren't that heavy. See? Even a dainty little girl like me can carry 'em around real easy.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You remember fighting by my side before? Can't say I remember fighting by yours, sorry... I just fight for what's right, that's all.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hah. That boxer, Beehunter? She's really something! I enjoyed sparring with her so much, I had to throw out some serious moves. And she's got an amazing honey collection too. Wanna visit her with me next time? You gotta learn some kung fu first, though.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Reading a movie magazine...? Well, guess what? The 'hot kung-fu actress' mentioned in this article is ME! What? You don't believe me? Come on, look! This is me, can't you tell? C'mon, that's definitely me!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Do I regret forgoing my previous life? Well, sometimes, of course. But the world ain't kind to us Infected. Lots of places I'm not allowed to go. It blows.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There's a street full of food stalls in the neighboring city. And... a candy shop over there? And a theme park? Aww, Doctor, can I get a day off? I wanna check out these places!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Am I satisfied with life at Rhodes Island, you ask? Hm, to be honest... It's even sweeter than what they show in the movies! I got cool opponents to practice with, top-notch food, and by working here, I'm doing something good for the world! What could be better!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, look! What do you think about this script? Oh, who's gonna act in it, you wonder? You and I are gonna be the main characters! There's this scene where we leap from the roof of a thirty-story building and slide all the way down. Isn't that cool? Hey! Come back! Wait!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You're catching some z's, eh? Guess I'll slack off for a bit too. Man, this couch is so fluffy!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You swear you've seen my face before? Probably saw it in a movie I was in! Call me FEater, and what I do from here is your call!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's over? Come on, let's watch just a while longer. We're almost at the fun part!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Oooh! A promotion! Thanks so much, Doctor!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This here's the perfect opportunity to show you some REAL kung fu!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: All right, it's show time!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Huh? I'm the leader? Not sure how it'll go, but...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: This is gonna be exciting!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'm FEater. Pleased to beat you!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Un-huh.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Here we go!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: All right!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Show time!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: HI-YAH!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This is straight out of one of my movies!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: From flexibility comes power!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Who says a movie star couldn't be a real kung-fu master!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Wow, it's over?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: It's over already? I was just starting to get warmed up.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hey, it's no biggie. Just a few scratches and bruises.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Aw... I just wanna go home and sleep...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Now that's stylin'!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Stop that, I'm getting dizzy!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, want my autograph? I'll take a pic with you if you want, too!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! Hehe, back in the old days, theaters would screen my movies this time every year, all playing to a full house!  Still, can't live in the past forever. I gotta punch ahead, and people gotta move on forward. Let's forget all our grievances for today!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Did you have breakfast yet, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! There's this saying that 'life's a movie you can't reshoot,' so when it comes to a key scene, you've gotta live life like you're on fire! Any birthday wishes, Doctor? Gimme a wish as cool as the lead of an action movie, and I'll help you make it come true!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: After I became an Infected, I thought for a bit that my career and my life were both over. Rhodes didn't just rein in my illness, but also gave me a fresh start. Standing up again in dire straits is exactly what the hero does, right? Doctor, Let's climb back to the top, together!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Structural design, industrial R&D, scientific research. You name it, and I can do it, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The Engineering Department never approve my proposals. Do they have any bias toward me? What should I do... Oh! Actually, Doctor, would you please submit this suggestion on improvement for me? It's a deal then!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: There are many workshops like mine in Rhine Lab, but what takes others six weeks to finish, I can have it done in one. I'm not boasting!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: DO NOT interrupt me when I'm doing my research, or I'll have my Meeboos bite you! And I will bite you too!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: At night I'm always full of inspiration... and the… urgency to sleep! No, I can't bear it... Where's the pillow... I need to rest...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Hm? Why are these cuties called Meeboos? That's because they go 'meeee-boooo' when they boot up. So I named them after that. Fitting, don't you think? Just listen and you'll get it. You press this switch to... NONONONO, That's the self-destruct button! Ahhhhhh run！

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: That girl who just passed by... that was Silence, right? If only back then... Oh, sorry, the non-disclosure agreement is still in effect. I should keep my mouth shut.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I feel kinda empty when I've got nothing to do... I guess that's just how engineers are. I bet even you have to idle your time away on occasion, Doctor. Huh? You don't?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, may I request... No! Not 10 square meters! I asked for too much last time, so this time... all I need is 3! W-Wait! Don't leave yet! 1 square meter, just 1 more for my research will do! Please, Doctor, I'm begging you...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Geez... where's the coffeemaker... Oh, there it is... You want some too, Doctor?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Lutra Workshop of Rhine Lab, at your service. Yup, I run the workshop on my own. No assistance needed. Amazing, right?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This structure... Interesting. I'll look into it.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This raise came just in time! I can afford to upgrade my equipment now.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I promised that you'd not be disappointed. Now look what I have! Surely kept my end of the bargain, didn't I?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Time to go, Meeboos!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Commanding both Operators and my Meeboos at the same time is a bit much even for me...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Hopefully we can get some useful experiment data!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Come on, Meeboo, show them what Rhine Lab's technology can do!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Careful! Be gentle with it!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Handle with care!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Precision equipment isn't cheap!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Get 'em, Meeboo #3!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Bite 'em, Meeboo!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: If anything breaks, just make another one!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: My Meeboos are more than just machines!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Come on, Meeboo! Show everyone your victory dance!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Nice! We practically rolled over them!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The device is slightly damaged. I'll fix it in no time.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Oh no! My Meeboo...! I'll need to make more...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Now I want a new workshop!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whuah?! Hey, I'm working here!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, let me touch your head! Inspiration can strike, you know!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! I love New Year's, there's always so much to eat when you go out, even if you miss the canteen's dinner time! I wish every day could be like that... Ouch! Alright, fine Meeboo, I'll eat on time, you're hurting me!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Heya, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Your birthday present? A literal piece of cake! Here's a cake sample, complete with blueprint, recipe, and a mass-production line ready for full rollout! How's that?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: What is research for, Doctor? My former coworkers say I can be surprisingly shallow, but if I were only in it for the money or fame, there are better ways. I just want to help advance technology, even by a little bit. And here, I can do that.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, where are you going? Shouldn't you be working? Lunch? Well then, I'm coming along. There's a few things I want to buy, and I can also keep a lookout for you.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Sorry, Doctor, Rhodes Island is just a part-time job for me. I have to study hard to make sure I have a nice, normal future ahead of me. If you plan to have me aboard and on 24-hour call… Well, I'll have to ask you reconsider that.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I color coded all the documents to be sent out, the backups have already been delivered, your schedule is right here. I bought your late night snack and put it in the refrigerator. Don't forget to heat it up. And last, oh, do you need me to change the light bulb in your office for you?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Did I ever tell you about my other job? No? Well, I won't. Don't look at me like that, Doctor. There's just not much to say. If my other office worked a tenth as hard as Rhodes Island does, they'd probably have become the only detective agency in Lungmen.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: You wonder where I learned martial arts? Well, I have my old codger and his weird education to thank for that. Not that I resent kung fu. Martial arts should always be a part of me if I hope to uphold justice.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Just like how people value morality, martial arts have yin and yang, right and wrong. To right those wrongs, to defeat evil, to counter bad kung fu, these are all second nature to me. The world is dark, and someone must stand for justice.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You think you just saw me? In downtown Lungmen? That may have been me. I just finished class. Hm? You saw me beat down some thugs who were harassing a passerby? And then slipped away before the police arrived? Must have been someone else. Heh heh. Definitely. You were just seeing things, that's it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My rotten dad said he had to go find the true meaning of kung fu before he went off, and I still don't know where he is. Please! What year does he think it is? Find some common sense and learn some responsibility before you get yourself killed. But at least I haven't forgotten what he taught me: 'Martial arts have martial virtue, humans have human kindness.'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, did any mail come for me? It did? Great. These are my grades... my very important grades! It's been straight A's for me, so far. If I don't work hard enough, I'll end up regretting all the things I wasn't strong enough to do.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Falling asleep at a time like this... Oh well, I'll just finish your work for you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Is this Rhodes Island? Nice to meet you. I'm Waai Fu, your new part-timer. Please don't go easy on me. I can handle anything you ask of me. Yes, just give me the word.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: If I can fight like this here, I can definitely knock them out.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you very much, Doctor. You placed your trust in me, and I won't let you down.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I often witness injustices in my life. If I ever find myself unable to stop them, I reflect on the moment, and force myself to get stronger. So, if ever you need me, don't hesitate to say so. I'll be there, with all my strength!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: More evil to fight against?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I have much to learn, but I won't turn down the responsibility.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Fight evil with the fist of justice!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Like cutting weeds and pulling roots!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Go ahead!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: A last resort.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: All right!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You have crossed the line too far!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Pick on someone your own size!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Don't blink! Song Do Bart Cham style!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: The mind directs, the fist executes!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Foul intentions lead a foul life. Repent now. There is still time.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A strong will conquers all.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: That was not enough. I need to train more.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Father... I'm still... not strong enough.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: At least it's better than some old, messy detective agency.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: An ambush...?! ...Doctor, don't you ever sneak up on me like that again. Now let's get you to Medical first.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You want to go for a walk? Sure, let's get going. It's safer to have me with you.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, happy holidays. I—I was just taking a walk. I haven't had Hung's food in forever, so the moment I slip up... It really does take a strong will to resist temptation, I still need more training... Doctor, it's not too late yet. Let's go train together!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Care for some tea, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday to you! Please, take this present. It's a wooden dummy. 'When seeking the way, the greatest fear is to have no master nor opponent,' so to us who wish to be martial artists, it's both an opponent and a master. Alright, let me teach you how to train with it!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Working for Rhodes Island has been valuable practical experience for me. I've learned a great deal. But I think I need more experience still, before I can decide whether or not I should stay. Whatever the future brings, I believe you and I are fighting for justice.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: What kind of ambience do you prefer when you're working? Of course, my music can't directly alleviate the busy state you're in, but I'd feel terrible if it couldn't make you more comfortable…  or content.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This next concert is for Amiya. I really am curious... what would she see in me if I were allowed to touch her emotions? Oh, that look on your face... are you worried? Then, why not come along... and confine me to your side?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: 'Music is the order you dig out of chaos.' That's what my Leithanian teachers taught me, but they've all since died in silence or lunacy. If it were me... I would tell my students, 'Music is a flowing will, a language of self-expression.'

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I can tell your fingers are still stiff. It seems you're not yet used to learning this way. Don't be nervous, I'll guide you... Oh? What's the matter, Fede? Are you going to greet me with a mine or an electric fence this time? If you'd like a music lesson, the Doctor and I will oblige.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'll never stop performing, even if you, Doctor, are the one who asks me. Trauma is one thing, but freedom is another. My life is the same as the others, it will simply come to an end if I stop in my tracks.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: No matter how powerful one's spirit may be, there is no way to vanquish the inevitability of death. If there is meaning in life, if there is really something out there that can fight against chaos and nothingness... it has to be every emotion that I'm feeling right here and now, and the melodies they'll turn into.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I'm watching... the clouds. Water accumulates above and in excess before turning to rain. Mother made just as natural a choice when she decided to leave. But father still refuses to accept it, even now. What about you, Doctor? Will you also refuse to listen to the truest self... that lies within you?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Working with you is actually quite dull to me. Yes, because I don't want to, and can't play your music. So I've curbed my expectations of you, for I fear that when this emotion bursts in resonance along with my strings, you will turn to a grotesque collection of variegated fragments in my arms.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Let me be your personal musician. Let me... feel my way around your mind. How elaborate are your ideas, and how terrifying is your rising willpower? I will of course be captivated by your music when it blooms into its ultimate form; and at that moment, what I will perform for you... shall be myself.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Rest well… I don't need to mix any 'illusion' into this lullaby. Your dreams... are already colorful enough.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I should have introduced myself by playing some music for you. Unfortunately, I've been forbidden from doing so for the moment. Let's start with a codename, then. You may call me... 'Virtuosa.'

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I've no interest in these means of inflicting harm. Do you mind if I wander about for a bit?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You've come to understand me more and more, even without the sound of an instrument to connect us. And yet... just how am I supposed to share this joy in my heart with you?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Whenever I touch the strings, the surrounding emotions all flow into me, through my fingertips, surging up into the sky and down into the ground. Did you hear it too? The cry of life in its truest form... How astonishing, how beautiful.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: What audience have you picked for me today?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I don't often play with accompaniment, but I can try to match the others' voices.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Notes fall into memory, and a melody resonates in the mind.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: What tones are your souls in?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: The concert may begin at any time.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What would you like to hear?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: A solo, to you.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: An improv, from us.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ecstasy as bright as gold.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Suffering will come to rest.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Liberty and sunlight all around us.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Feel your own self, to your heart's content.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: War itself is unworthy of a performance. But I will listen to every voice on the battlefield, from hero to refugee.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Over already? Your victory doesn't need to be embellished by my music. I'd much rather... perform for you a piece inspired by that cloud passing overhead.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Guilt, doubt, fear... this surge of emotion rising from the battlefield will follow them, accompanying them to their graves.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The performance ends, and the audience scatters. After such a conclusion, how long can the strings continue to vibrate?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What a beautiful sunset. It would be even more romantic if there were music swirling around the deck.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: These strings are vibrating... for you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hmm? Have I been lurking in this corner for a long while? There's a tune lingering in my head, and I refuse to go to sleep before I can express it.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The New Year's concert is about to begin. No, I'm not a part of the performance, this is a gift the children have prepared for you. I'd much rather be on the sidelines, recording the joy blooming across your face and the children's when the music begins.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Sometimes, I too prefer to avoid the crowd, far away from all the sounds, just to feel my own self... and to feel you as well.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: What is it echoing through your mind at this special time of year? Is it pains and joys of bygone days...? Tell me, and let me transform the blotches of your mind into reality through music... as long as you allow me, of course.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The end is approaching us. If you too believe that the emotional bonds between people help resist despair… then the symphony I scored with Rhodes Island will certainly play.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'll stay with you until my next expedition, Doctor. Don't be afraid to send me out anywhere you need me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I actually heard about you a long time ago, Doctor! Yeah, Mayer and MuMu told me all about you. I just had to come to Rhodes Island to see what you're like in person. Oh, I also got a little present for you! Here!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This one? It's an Emperor strap! Who...? The Emperor of Penguin Logistics! I visited that company a whole bunch, so I've met him lots of times. He's so cute! I give him plenty of pets every time I go! You ever pet him before, Doctor? You don't dare? Why?!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Is Iffy doing better these days? Last time I left Rhine Lab, she was in pretty bad shape. I've been worried about her…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Has Mayer made anything new? I haven't worked on any new equipment for a long time, so I wanna do some research with her. Oh right, Doctor, I'll let you in on a little secret. If you bother Mayer while she's working... What? She already bit you?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Unlike Meeboo, Sisyphus or Kirkika, my drones are operated differently. There is a limit to how many I can run at once, and it's just the way it goes. But I have a new system in development. I think you'll be surprised before long.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The Polar North? The dreams that are buried there are cold and cruel, but... in order to make my dreams a reality, I am willing to do anything it takes.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: 'The tiny gardner, and the tiny flower, growing under the tile with no one to care for it...' It was Iffy's favorite storybook, maybe because it resonated with her. But, well... It seems like she doesn't remember it. Hmm… that's odd.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The North... it's both mysterious and beautiful. The towering cliffs, the lonely, snow-covered trees, the glowing, prismatic Originum crystals… And the vast snowland, stretching to the ends of the earth. Doctor, you should come see it with me. We'll go together, okay?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Stay awake Doctor! If you fall asleep, you'll freeze to death!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Rhine Lab Specialist Magallan just discovered a mysterous research vessel! And you are…? Oh my goodness, you're that doctor from Rhodes Island! Uh, W-Would you like to join my expedition!? Adventuring together would be really interesting!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Efficiency improved!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Update complete! Now my devices respond twice as fast.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, if you're curious about the results of my research, then I'll have to show you my stuff! Hehe, just so you know, I'll be showing you true power, so brace youself!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave the exploration and support to me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everyone, maintain communication, beep-beep!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Hold on, calibrating my equipment… Done!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Preflight testing complete. Drones standing by.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Sure!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I bet you need my skills.

lines.title: Deployment 1
