lines.text: Time to work!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: All my equipment's good to go!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Is the target marked? Ok, launching drone!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Now! Let 'em go snow blind!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Three… two… one! Take flight!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'Bloom, my flowers!'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Watch out, there's a blind spot in my scan—What, it's already over? All thanks to you, Doctor, you're reliable as ever.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No more hostiles detected!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: There's still some enemies around. Are we going after them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: They're flanking us? My bad, sorry…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hm...? You even have heated floors?! Ahh, this is bliss.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Mhm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Come on, Doctor. Ice skating isn't so scary. I'm here with you.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! My work's kept me too busy to take any time off to spend with my parents. But I sent them a letter, and a few samples I gathered in the North, heheh. Oh, Doctor, my parents know about you too. I told them about all the friends I made at work.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Um? Anything I can help with?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Phew! It took me a bit, but I finally made it in time! Happy birthday, Doctor! Here's a snowflake sample, it's from the furthest north anyone's ever been! I messed up a bit, but this one's the best sample I could get. It's my gift to you!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I lead an incredible life, Doctor. I've got the know-how to do my scientific research, I've got parents and friends who support me, and my dreams in the North to keep me going. But I still have one, tiny little wish. If somebody ever writes a history of the North, I want my name in it.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: So you're saying I have the right to decide your schedule and itinerary?  Which means, whatever I write in this memo book, Doctor, you've gotta do. Wowie! Too late for regrets now, heehee.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Ecology's about filling some dirt, putting some plants and animals on it, then making a profound study about the cyclic relationships between individuals, species, and biocommunities. With the help of innovative research, we can improve the ecosphere or even forge a brand-new... Well, someone clearly knows it all, because that's an unadorable look you're giving me. Alrighty, let's change topics.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I want you to come with me next time I go clothes shopping. The thing is, I don't really understand fashion stuff so much, and I wanna hear your ideas. What, you don't either? Sure! If you've got opinions, and I've got opinions, then we can do swapsies. Plus, I get to see you wearing something else for once.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Are your lips kind of dry there...? Yeah, they look a little chapped. You need more water on the regular. Alright, you can have my chapstick, and then we're even again once you buy me a new stick. This is the only brand I use, and it's gotta be peppermint flavor. Don't get the wrong one. Okay?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Looking back on it, it's like Rhine was just founded yesterday. The stuff we fought over at that time is a total one-eighty compared to now. Heheh, good memories… Doctor, Do you still remember when Rhodes Island was new on its feet? No? That's fine, you'll remember with enough time.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Here I am, dewdrop landed on a leaf, but we'll be baked away in the sun soon enough. Oh, don't let it end here. We could melt together, dew filling leaf's veins, and make our grand return to the land... um, that's about dew, okay? Like, it's just dew that wants to—um... Mmm...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Has Magallan been good recently? Oh, still out exploring? Hasn't said when she gets back yet? Aw, okay... I've still got the crystals she sent me last time, out in cold storage. Any interest in this stuff? Well, well, I see you have a good hobby. Come on, let's crack open your horizons.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: If Kristen didn't have the talent and leadership, Rhine Lab would've never been founded. But maybe it was her power that got her to bare her true self to everyone in the end. People change. I wonder what I'll become?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My people have no future. We've only been able to pray for answers from the past. You're from the past, Doctor. You're the hope of my people, and me. But even if that wasn't the case, you're still the one who pulled me from the bubbles, and you're still gripping my hand. How could I ever let go now, right?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Getting distracted on the job? Terrible habit.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Muelsyse, Director of the Ecological Section at Rhine Lab. Not that I think we need any formal how-do-you-dos, Doctor. After all, we've been friends forever now.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: There really isn't a single fresh thing anywhere across the lands.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A present from you? I'll keep it nice and safe, that's a guarantee. How about in return, let's go to the movies?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Dew gets turned to vapor, and everything in it vanishes without a trace. Will I ever see showers of blessing? Will I ever meet my people again and know them anew?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Sunlight's a little spicy. Just let me take five.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Okay, maybe I should assign roles first?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The way seems kind of rough. Careful, you don't want to trip.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Annoying people, annoying business. Let's deal with them ASAP.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hiya.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Want a candy?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Okay, serious face.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Easy-peasy.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Shape like water.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Now's not the time for hellos.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Let animosity be gone with the flow.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Oh wishes, I beg you coalesce.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Good work. Need to get under this umbrella?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Job's done, be sure to rest up now.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I told you to be careful... any ouchies?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I got my mirages to lead them off. We'll go this way.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Let's really decorate this place. It'll be cozy in no time, promise.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: If anything's bothering you, put it to one side for now. Here, try this out, 'Orange Storm'.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Office hours on a holiday, really? Even the most hardcore researchers at Rhine wouldn't be in the lab today. If you're so sure about going through that door, then I'm gonna... *sigh* I'll go get you some coffee...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hiya! How about a little chat before you get to work?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Hm? Mm... nothing, I'm just imagining what you might've been like when you were born. Speaking of which, you decided what you're eating tonight? It's not like the canteen instantly churns out your order, so can we hurry it up?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: If Kristen was here, she'd be far away from the crowd, out on that balcony staring up at the starry sky... Nobody understood her, just like nobody fully understands my own sorrows. You, Doctor? What kind of person are you, and what unspeakable aches live in your heart?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: No need to look for me. I've always been here.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Those in the dark cannot show you the way, nor can they see where you point. Don't tarry here, it's time for you to leave...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Under this mask, even I do not recognize myself.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: This is Miss.Christine. I don't know where she came from, nor do I know when she will leave. If she likes you, she will approach you on her own... Yes, just as she's doing right now.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: In the past, I was not lonely. I once had several friends, and we traveled all over as a theatre troupe. But when Oripathy broke out, everything drew to a close, and everything began...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: This darkness is a refuge, a throne, and Paradise above all. The spirits of the dead have never left, and I've cursed the world from atop their bones... You see me as I am now. Do you still wish to hear my song? Do you still dare... to stand before me?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: This device embedded above my throat presses against my neck, but it is exactly what I need. Like a mask does, it conceals my sins and my voice. You'd like to hear my real voice? No, you can't. It isn't something you ought to bear...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My song ended all of their lives. It came, that endless night, the song that would not stop, the quivering falsetto and organ fragments that expelled from a throat—it horrified them, suffocated them, but it was so... miraculous. Doctor, tell me. What in the world is it... that I do?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I can end many lives for you, but I first need you to confirm that I am awake. Something is trying to influence me. It doesn't want me to leave the stage. It wants my song to echo forever... and it wants me to kill you. Before I play the role of your assassin once more, I must discover the truth.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: The shadows have never left your side, even without the night. Do be careful of your untimely somnolence, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Code name, Phantom. The Phantom Behind the Curtain, Treasurer of the Night. Tell me, who are your enemies, and where do they hide?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Killing is not an end, but a means.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: As you wish. You are the one who sets Rhodes Island's tune, and you require neither guide nor guardian... Yes, I know all too well, you are your own master.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: There is no looking back after this step, no turning back. What I am about to share with you is not as wonderful as you may believe... Come, come here, and allow me to show you what lies beneath the veil of night.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Is it time for me to take the stage?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I am no stranger to giving guidance.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'll do as you say...

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let us raise the curtains on this play.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm with you.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: So, let us sink into the night.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I come from the shadows.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hear my voice. Hear my song.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Do you see your own face in the mirror?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The actors are all puppets of the script.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The guilty... will be punished.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Yes, lift your voices! Sing for me! Sing for me!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Is this the victory your leadership has brought about...?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: It is over. Victory is not sweet, as conflict always leaves an aftertaste.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They escaped. Fortunate for them... and perhaps for me as well.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Fall back... You've already lost your way.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hm? Behind this mirror, there seems...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What is it?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: The sound of these footsteps... It's you, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Is time's passage so worthy of celebration? Is it truly within our power to bid adieu to the past? It may be all too ironic that one like I, draped in misfortune, should wish you well... but as the New Year beckons, the shadows shall continue to keep to your back.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: The shadow behind you looks heavier than it was yesterday, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. If this desolate throat of mine could still sing, I would gladly devote a ballad to you for the occasion. It is my regret, then, that the opportunity is no more. Ah, Miss.Christine offers us a rose—it seems she, too, wishes you well on this special day.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A role who deviates from the script cannot exist, nor may a shadow hide forever in the night. Rhodes Island—are you to be the stage I next take...? I only hope that this time, it is by your hands the curtains are brought down.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I don't need to go outside today? Th-thank goodness... Infected people like me have no right to wear these clothes. How strange it is that I cannot wear the clothes I make with my own hands... Eh? Rhodes Island doesn't care about stuff like that? Really?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Um... my outfit? O-Oh, I designed this one myself. The skirt incorporates some traditional motifs, though it can't compare to my papa's work... Still, this is my attempt at a vintage style.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Good afternoon, Doctor. I'm trying to clean up my room... Sorry, my room often ends up being a mess... I used to never have to organize my room, and now that I'm starting to learn, it's actually rather fun... although I often break things in the process...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I've always had trouble adjusting after being pulled away from my old life. In the very beginning, I felt like I couldn't continue living after becoming an Infected, and I was just so scared... But I'm not like that anymore. There's so much I want to learn, and I want to do more for those just like me here at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Since I was young, my father insisted I study swordsmanship. I didn't enjoy it at the time. But after the incident, I've found holding the sword more reassuring... than holding the spinning thread.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I used to be afraid to go outside. As an Infected, I felt like everything scorned me... But now I understand that one's self-esteem has nothing to do with whether or not she is Infected. After all, that is the most beautiful adornment.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, um... If, if it's possible, can I make some clothes for you...? I think you'd be just right for bringing out some of my ideas. Um, I sometimes ask the other Operators in the same way...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The people who stoned me with Originium... Of course I hated them, but now... If I continued to harbor that contempt and despair, it would have driven me to do terrible things. I have no regrets about running away from home, even if it holds many warm memories of my past.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I want to incorporate the many things I've learned from everyone into something we can all wear...Hehe, even with that in mind, the elements are a bit complicated. But this reflects my emotions, whether I'm brandishing my sword or flourishing my needle.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'll use this time to craft something small.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: H-hello, Doctor... My codename is Bibeak... Excuse me, but is there a facility with a loom and a knitting machine here?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The way they fight... I've never even considered it before…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A p-promotion? Are you sure? I'm actually not very good at fighting... Thank you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: All the Operators of Rhodes Island, and you, Doctor… stand at my side. I know, even with my limited lifespan, I'm still able to live as a normal woman… Or even, a life most people would never dream possible.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Ah! I understand!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Hm? I-I'm the captain?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Just like a textile, there is only one way to weave.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Is fighting unavoidable after all...?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Oh! Understood!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Our combat uniforms are all ready!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Is wielding the sword the same as wielding the needle?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I can also fight! Believe in me!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I won't hold back!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Save the talk for after the battle! There are people I must protect!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Like threading a needle... Strike!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Can the thread of life also be cut?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Great work, Doctor! Um, what did you think about my performance?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I-it's finally over! If your uniform is damaged, I can help repair it…

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Oh, someone got away... But, that's a better outcome... than the cruelty of death.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I, I'm still... so useless...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hmm... Where is the textiles room?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh, Doctor, could you grab those textiles for me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: At New Year's, I used to make a new item of clothing for each member of the family. We would all sit around the fireplace, to greet the New Year together. It's the most blessed memory I have... But now, while clothes are renewed year after year, the people who've left us will never return.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: D-Doctor, um, happy... happy… Happy birthday! I've never seen you wear any other clothes, so I made you an outfit exactly like your current one, but with lighter and suppler material used. It... it should be more comfortable... Would you like to try it on?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Time is like the thread on a loom, forming into a person's life bit by bit… These moments I've experienced at Rhodes Island have surely made me stronger. With my sword in hand, and companions at my side, I'm given the courage to withstand the bitterness.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hi, Doctor. If you need anything, please tell me...  Um, I assume you still remember my code name...?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doc-Doctor, hi... Um, I just checked the Medical Department's power grid, and taking some files around while I'm at it... No, nobody's forcing me! I mean, they take such good care of me, it's the least I can do for them...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I decided to learn electric Arts just so my friends back in the slums could have some light, just so the nights would be a little less miserable... That pitch black, it's really scary. And the kinds of people who live in the dark, they can be scary too...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: These Originium generators here at Rhodes Island are amazing... You know, if we had anything like them back home, we wouldn't need to live in the dark all the time, like life without light is normal.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My mother taught me the basics of Arts. She told me I use Arts just like she did when she was younger, but I'm also as sickly as she was... If she were still alive, I'd hope she could come with me to Rhodes Island...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, before I got the training from you, all I could do with my Arts was light up one little room. But now that little spark has turned into something that can help lots of people...! Thank you so much!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Huh? A current anomaly in Miss Mayer's storeroom? W-why is it her again... What? Dr. Kal'tsit wants more cables for her lab? And another outage in Ifrit's room? Waahhhh... Doctor, help meee...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Zzz... Wha? Doctor...? Ah! Sorry! I wasn't napping! I, um, I was... Oh, is this Medical?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, are you going out again...? Okay, I know. I'll wait here for you... Um, Doctor, please hurry back...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Whoa...! Aaaugh... Static electricity. Gave me a jolt...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: H-Hi. My name is Greyy. I'm kind of an electrician... Erm, th-thanks for taking me on...!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: C-could you pause it for a minute? I-I'm taking notes…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Okay, I'll take it to... Huh? It's, it's for me...? Really?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Hehe. Doctor, I shall light the way for you!... Um, sorry, just got too full of myself...  But I actually mean it...!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Everyone, I'm here to help...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm the Captain...? O-Okay! If that's your wish, Doctor!...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let me handle the logistical support...!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Doctor, I see the enemies rallying...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'll try my best…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I should be able to do it...!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Slowly, and carefully...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Can't tiwst my ankle now!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Stop being evil!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I won't let you hurt my friends...!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: T-Take that!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: An electric shock c-can really hurt...!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, we've done a wonderful job...! Cou-Could we go home now?...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We-We won, Doctor!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, the ones who ran off... We won't see them again, will we?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Err... Doctor...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What am I doing today?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whoa…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you're really tall... I-I wonder when I'll get to be that tall...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Well, er... there's a fireworks show coming up, and I was wondering if we could watch it together. Yes, I like fireworks. They're so small, yet so bright and colorful, shining over the land...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, you're back!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here's my birthday present for you, Doctor... Um, I didn't have the money to buy anything nice, so I made something myself... a candle that won't be blown out. May it light a corner of your room and never go out.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor... I've been studying electrical engineering in depth lately. It's a little tough... but I'll work hard! I want to illuminate more places for Rhodes Island, and for everyone... I, I'm sorry, I'm getting ahead of myself, aren't I?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: There are no evil spirits around you, so can I go now?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Memories are the vessels of fate, and your fate once came to an abrupt end. That's why the spirits have stopped haunting you, for now. But I can still see their traces, very clearly... Doctor, you should take me seriously... For your own good.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You can talk to Morte about your troubles. It's okay, Morte will help. Once you fall asleep, all your problems will be solved.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The feelings that make people cry are just food for Morte, so I don't cry much. Is that a bad thing?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The true face of the curse? You want to see what's inside Morte's tummy? No... at least not now... That would hurt Morte too. Right. Anyone who hurts Morte will writhe in pain. For real.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The checklist is still missing a few items: balls of yarn, used buttons, fresh apples, soil from Laterano, crushed CRTs... Doctor, help me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Here, this apple's for you. It's just a leftover reagent, and I don't like letting things go to waste... Why are you thanking me? I just said it wasn't specifically for you... Hey, why are you patting my head, stop it... Fine.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Because I have Morte, I don't need emotions. But when people tell me I'm doing good, I feel strange inside... And Morte doesn't want to take those emotions away, which makes me...feel off... It's totally normal? Really? In that case... I guess it's fine.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, here. This is Morte's puppet, make sure to keep it with you at all times... A curse? N-No, Doctor... If you take it, it'll be like I'm always by your side... You can't?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sweet slumber~♪ Sweet slumber~♪ Be devoured by your dreams~♪

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: My new name is Shamare... and this is Morte... As for the other things... it's best you don't find out. Like Morte said, it's for everyone's sake…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: These things won't help with the ritual…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Stuff the cotton, sew the mouth shut, plug the ears, and cover the eyes...There, a new doll is done.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Morte doesn't need a ritual like this, but…I… I'm happy. We'll both do our best.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Work? Got it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: If only they could be as well-behaved as Morte, that'd be nice.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Morte, it's time to go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Today's fortune is… Oh, that's really bad news for you guys.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What's up?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Everyone's ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: It's time to play, Morte.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Your hate, I'll take it all.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Go forth, Morte.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Rest in peace, and let the land embrace all.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You won't be going home.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The evil spirits, they're all gone now.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A predestined victory, just as they whispered.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Some may have gotten away, but it doesn't matter. Morte has already sealed their fates.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Curse... you...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place... reeks of evil spirits... Not bad.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What is it?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Join in my needlework? Okay. Morte's also very happy…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, I saw you leave the office. There's a lot of people outside today... New Year's? It's so noisy, what are they all doing? Morte doesn't like these holidays. Could you make a talisman with me? If you put an apple stem inside, it'll help you avoid curses.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor, and, uh...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Give me your hand. Place your fingers here, and make a sign like this… Got it, Doctor? This is a curse. When someone's mean to you, you can fill their whole body with pain. Me? Mm, I don't abuse it, I'm just teaching it to you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Fur, shiny pebbles, candies, spices, and most importantly, drawing on a smile… Doctor, this is a new doll-making method I've learned. Cute, isn't it? Uhm…

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm… Hmm… Hmmm… Oh, Doctor, is your day going well?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This is a floral tea that I made myself, Doctor. Come try a cup, I promise you'll feel cozy all day.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The sunlight in the greenhouse is so comfy. Even if I'm in charge here, it sometimes makes me want to sit down and relax for a bit.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Use the fruits of your labor to make everyone forget their sorrows and worries. That's probably a gardener's primary objective, don't you think?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I much prefer gardening to fighting. But as long as I think about how I'm helping everyone, I can muster up the courage to go into combat.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: These bottles? They're the pollen and seeds I've been collecting. I usually put on a gas mask and gloves before handling them, to protect me from poison.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Hm, everyone seems a bit weary these days. But, when they see the flowers I've planted, I'm sure they'll cheer right up.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, Doctor! Are you coming to the greenhouse today? Everyone's been awfully busy the last few days… If nobody comes by the greenhouse, they're going to miss the blooming season. And wouldn't that be a terrible shame?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Tending the greenhouse is really hard. But, as long as the flowers I grow can make people smile, all my hard work will be worth it!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Oh, you're asleep… May the flowery fragrance waft over your dreams.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, it's Podenco, here to say hi! If you have time, I'd love for you to come by the greenhouse!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oh… I was expecting a video about gardening.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Artist? N-N-No, I'm not that talented. I'm just a normal gardener.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Look, Doctor! These are the new varieties I've been tending for so long. They've finally started to bloom! Aren't they gorgeous?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Hm? Am I going too?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Um, I've only ever tended a greenhouse. Can I really help with this…?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I see the enemy! Let's go!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Everybody, look after yourselves!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Where are we going?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll do it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Careful, this pollen is allergenic.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Okay, I'll handle this.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I've seen weeds like these before.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Let me protect everyone!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew, are we safe already? Good job, everyone!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Achieving a flawless victory is like cultivating a beautiful flower. Both require a lot of hard work.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, everyone is waiting for your next orders.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ah… I never thought it would turn out like this…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Should we plant some flowers over here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor! Would you like to decorate your office with some flowers?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Back home, most flowers would already have withered by now. But just thinking about how spring will be here soon… fills my heart with hope. Doctor, let's find the first flower that blooms in the greenhouse together!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Please, try this floral tea! I made it the way Miss Lena taught me, and if you really savor it, you can taste a hint of cake flavor! Eh? You can't? Let me try… Oh… Sorry, Doctor. I… I think I forgot the honey…

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I've been all over with Rhodes Island. Does that mean I've spread flowery fragrance to just as many places? Hehe… I may still have lots of room for improvement, compared to Miss Lena, but I'll do my best to make Rhodes Island an even warmer place!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Aw, c'mon, get someone more literate for this job. I'm a soldier, all I know is following orders. Paperwork's beyond me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Life is tough enough already. Let's relax with some butter, frosting and jam.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If Frostleaf wasn't still lugging that big axe around, there's no way I would've recognized her. We fought together before, probably as enemies. Anyway, I'm relieved to see her living the good life at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Watch it, Doctor, you can't go touching my weapon. I just replaced the Originium on that thing. It's dangerous when you hold it wrong... Look out! I, I'll take you to Medical...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Defensive ability is what matters to a Defender. I don't care if it's organic fiber or ceramic padding, as long as it's the state-of-the-art, just buy it!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Stories from my past? Umm… Don't have much to say. I mean, what kind of story could a bad tempered soldier have? All those merits and medals... Hmph, they're nothing in the face of the lives lost.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The greenies we got in the reserves are pretty good. But they suck at securing amenities. Back in my day, the rookies were way smarter about hiding cookies.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I talked to Logistics. From now on, they're putting 'Industrial Material' on all our snack packaging. Then, all we need is you to sign off on them for us, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor? Oh, sorry. I was all caught up in reminiscing. I still can't get past certain things. If my old commander was anything like you, maybe... We wouldn't have had to go through that.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Psst, Psst! Want some pop rocks? I got all kinds. I know I got one you'll love.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hard as rock and lethal as lightning! That's me, Dur-nar. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ah, shoot, I'm out of popcorn.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Good, good, do I get paid more too? Awesome!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The old me only knew how to charge on ahead and fight without stopping. Now, I fight for everybody. Just give your orders, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Ready to deploy. Where am I needed?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I only have one request: Safety first and don't ever forget it.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We're off! Remember to stay frosty and keep an eye out.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I never did get used to the stench of war.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes sir!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: In position!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll leave the support to you.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Cover me!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hold the line!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't be an idiot!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Ya ain't gettin' through me!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Stay down!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ever heard of the Medal of Glory? I feel that's tailor-made for you.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No need to clean up the battlefield? Okay, then we're done here.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The enemy still hasn't gone far. Should we chase them down?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Take it easy, Doctor. It's not your fault...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Whoa, I bet a fancy interior like this cost a bundle!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmph, Who the--

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You must be drunk to want to hear me sing war songs. Okay, don't you regret it.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! I can finally lay my snacks out for everyone to eat with pride! Medical won't be so cruel on today of all days, right? I've been looking forward to this cake forever, *homp*—oooh, it's amazing! Doctor, move that fork quick or all you get is crumbs~

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: As thanks for always getting us off the hook, here's a present I brought in for you. But first, sign here. I guarantee it's all above board—signed? Great! I'll take this down to Dobermann! A permit for building a snack cupboard, signed by the Doctor!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Huh? It's not often I see you at the bar, Doctor. What's wrong, trouble at work? You're a great commander, I don't want you taking any wrong turns any time soon. Come on, I'll order you an 'Iceflame,' and we'll talk over drinks?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, here is the paperwork. Is it strange to see me on clerical errands? The truth is, compared to battle, I much prefer... writing...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, look outside the window. The night is quiet... and peaceful. Up until now, every night has been filled with the red light of fire, and the stench of burning. I only feel easier... on nights like tonight.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: There's been a—red-haired Vouivre girl, who never stops staring at me... Does she suspect my identity? But... she wouldn't have any evidence... Hm. I'm not going to let her find me out.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Is it time for my regular medical examination? Un... Understood. But... I don't trust those other doctors. If I have to be examined, I want... you to help me with it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: You all have a lot of questions, but I can't answer any of them. This is for your own sakes, and I encourage you ... not to overestimate yourselves.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: ...I am strong. I know the terrifying power I hold, though I... have no love for it. But if you desire it—then yes, I will fight...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: This spear... I am not able to fully use its power. Despite that, I've had it take so many lives. Guilt? ...No, I have no guilt. After all, our lives are all equally worthless

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I do not mind my Oripathy... Without it, I would never have spent my days here. It will take my life? I—still do not mind it... So many other things across this land could kill just the same, why then... would you be fixated on this particular one?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I am a shadow, but I do not spurn that. I am only able to stay here, incognito, because I am a shadow... However... however... if someone with the same face as me ever finds you, do not fight her! You will die. I don't... I don't want you dead...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I will stand vigil for you, so... please rest at ease. Good night.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You were the ones... who saved me? You want my name? ...Just 'Reed' is fine... like the reeds by a pond. A nondescript existence...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Your battles are—very bitter... but, this way, many more may continue to live.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Forward, soldiers of Dublinn! ...I was constantly forced to give these words, but in reality—I hated them...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You have a dream that calms my soul... and I want to help you accomplish it. So long as I rouse the fires of Dublinn, they may come to light your way in the dark of night.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The fires of war will char the wilderness...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just as you have exhorted me, I will no longer neglect the lives of others...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: And so, we go to harvest...

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Why do you burn as easily as stalks of wheat...?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My flames, they scorch...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: No one else will see I am here, will they...?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Ah...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Only ashes will remain...

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The living blaze will purify your tainted souls.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I am Dublinn.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I... am Dublinn!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Sister...

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Endless battles, flames that never cease to smolder... This isn't what you truly desire, is it?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Should this fight be for the sake of our shared future, I will bear anything...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: What else can we hope to gain from the battlefield? Let's go. Hurry, let's go home...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No. I won't let anyone hurt you... I swear it.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Can I have a separate room? I don't mind how small it may be...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor... won't my body temperature burn you?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Ah, you found me. Why am I not at the party? Well, if you could... sit by my side. Truthfully, watching the smiles on others' faces during the holidays still hurts my heart. It seems—this snow won't lift any time soon...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor...? Um... it's nothing.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday to you. Ah, please wait a moment. You can't blow this candle out. Just let it burn like this for a little while... I hope that this flame—can bring you some warmth.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: By now, I've said all my thanks. I just hope that, when danger ultimately approaches, Rhodes Island won't be drawn in, or at the very least, it'll be in my power to protect you...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I advise you to keep at least two meters away from me, for your own good. And of course you shouldn't speak to me either... I don't want you to be the next victim of what's after me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You've read my file? Terrible, isn't it? If I'm allowed to stay by your side, the same misfortune will befall you, and that's trouble for me too.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My long hair looks good? Oh… Well, thank you. Would you like to feel it? It should have a soft touch. I'm confident of that.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Could that be...? The one over there, you guys call her Specter now, right? Why is she dressed as a nun? Amnesia? That's a problem… Dr. {@nickname}, you have to help her. She can't be allowed to forget her true function.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: You just don't know when to give up, do you? I suppose I have no choice but to defend you with all my might.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Down beneath the vast blue sea, below the white waves that lap endlessly at the earth, lies all that I once held dear. I fear that one day misfortune will once again take away someone important from me. That is why I fled. I don't want anyone I care about... to suffer on my account.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Good, another easy day. No giant tentacles coiling up my teammates, no fanatics lurking in the shadows with their hands coated in blood... Yes, just some straight fights on the battlefield. An easy day for me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: According to legend, my people have fought against those calamities for aeons. Perhaps we kept them from making landfall and terrorizing you city folk as well... So, how about buying me a drink, as a thank you?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When you've finally made the long journey through the dark up to the water's surface—your eyes dazzled by the sparkling stars all over the sky, your cheek soothed by the cradling waves, your tears seep into your mouth. They have the same salty taste of your home—compared to all that, the bathtub at Rhodes Island is so tiny and puny... I'll have to show you my home someday.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, you fell asleep…? Rest well then, and may you never see your dream eroded by sea waves.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Skadi, a bounty hunter. Are you really hiring me? I cannot say what calamities I may bring with me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: So this is how you fight. Rush in with a 'woosh,' knock them down with a 'pow,' and finish them with a 'thud.' Very good. I'll keep it in mind.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: So this is the promotion you Rhodes Island folks are always going on about? Not bad. Feels like I've become stronger. Just by a bit, maybe.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Your thirst for my power really troubles me... But if nothing can really stop you, then brace yourself, for the infinite darkness we will stand against together.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I am quite skilled at teamwork, but...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You're placing everyone's life in my hands?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: It's hardly a sport when all the enemies are human.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Compared to the calamities I fought against, you are barely a threat.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: By your command.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm used to fighting alone.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Let's share a dance.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Better safe than sorry.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Who knows what lurks within the kelp forest?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This sword has a terrifying past. Care to find out?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Sing me a song, my torturous nightmare.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't blink, for you may miss the misery of your death.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: We survived somehow.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The words and thoughts of our enemies mean nothing to me. All I care about is how to defeat them.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Feeling a little rusty? Hope you won't mind having part of your share taken away.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Such simple misfortunes are only the beginning.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Put me in a room by myself please.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oops... My hat.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Y-You should watch your distance... I really can't guarantee your safety this close…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's is a day of relief and enjoyment, isn't it? I've seen how the bounty hunters celebrate. They drink, they sing, and they don't sleep until the first light of dawn shines on their faces... What are you all going to do here? Eat a great feast, and then ignite some blossoming explosives? I see...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Never let down your guard, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Birthday...? I never considered giving you any gifts before. Are cakes and candles how you convey such sentiments on the land? You must want very much to receive a gift from me, correct? In that case, here is a song. Lie by my side, and I'll sing to you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I am a lurking danger to Rhodes Island. If anyone more is hurt because of me, I-I... We will bear our trials together? That's how a family should be? ...What you've just said is something very opinionated. But I don't hate it. Thank you, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's wise to care for your safety, Doctor. But you can work without worry now, I'll keep you protected.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I've met plenty who claim to practice martial arts. Most are posers who lack substance, not Waai Fu. She's an interesting one... although her training is not yet complete. I look forward to sparring with her, once she's ready.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island doesn't have a cellar, you say? Hmm… Now that won't do. Alcohol is indispensable. It's meant to be savored, enjoyed, and sometimes used to numb the pain. Trust me, Doctor, build a cellar. I know exactly what you'll need to stock it.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I built a library back in Mansfield. Most of the books I could get my hands on were Columbian, and thus, my extensive reading eventually brought a sense of monotony. It is most pleasing that Rhodes Island has such a diverse collection of books.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Schemes and ploys meant nothing in the face of absolute power... Or so I thought, until I realized that no power is truly absolute, at least not mine. Now, I never underestimate anything or anyone, no matter how insignificant they seem.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I used to think that Rhodes Island was just another Mansfield, a 'free' prison. And you, just another me—a convict unchained, a king behind bars. But now I see that I was mistaken. This is not a prison, and you, Doctor, are a friend to all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Are the ones over there from Rhine Lab? Don't worry. I bear no grudge against Rhine Lab itself, and I won't harm them in anyway. Farce like that will only complicate things for you, Doctor. However, one of these days, I might need to ask them about one thing.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, are you free later? Let me take you out for a drink. Nothing important. I merely have a few secrets that I'd like to get off my chest. You are the first new friend I've made in a long time.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You are a very good friend, Doctor. If I manage to survive after sorting everything out, do come visit me at Mansfield. That's my kingdom, and what is mine there is also yours.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Falling asleep so trustingly in the company of others... Is that really trust, or have you slipped up?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I owe Rhodes Island my life, and so my candor must befit the weight of my debt, Doctor. I am going after a certain department within Rhine Lab. If you don't want your relationship with them ruined, now is the time to turn me away.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Battlefield experience... Indeed, that's something that I lack. Much obliged, Doctor.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, do not be afraid. The fury of my fist will not fall upon the undeserving.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Look well, Doctor. My composure, politeness, and grace are but a mask. Peel that off, and you'll find me at my truest, bloodthirsty, violent, and destructive. See me, know me... only then be my friend.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Perfect time to get a pump.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Listen to your leader, me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Never underestimate the enemy.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: At your call.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Where to?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll remember to dial it back.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I won't let them go any further.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Face me!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Is that all? Strike me like your lives depend on it!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Come on, bring it on!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Warm-up's over!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: True grit must be tested in adversity, but we must be careful not to punch above our weight.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Good boxers never show all their tricks unless needed. Operations are the same, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Violence without just cause is but mindless abuse. I've learnt to rein in my urges long ago.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: As long as we're still alive, we're not defeated.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Pardon me, but the ceiling in Rhodes Island is a little low…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, have you read any good books recently? I have a few to recommend.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's hasn't meant much to me for a long, long time. You see, prisoners don't usually hope much for tomorrow, or the future. But now that I'm a part of Rhodes Island, I suppose I should try to change that. Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Stay vigilant, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. It shames me to admit that if I were still in Mansfield, or earlier in Columbia, I would have arranged a far grander celebration for you. Now, the best I can offer is a well-prepared drink. Would you do me the honor?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: What a lively day. You could say that Oripathy is like a shackle on life itself, depriving people of their freedom and their futures. Yet even in the confined space of Rhodes Island, I still see hope in the eyes of many. This has given me no small revelation on my own future.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Some burdenbeasts won't drag themselves to work until they're whipped. But you're different, Doctor, you're way smarter than a beast, isn't that true?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor. Just to put any little misunderstandings to rest, let me say this now. Maria might call me her aunt, but that's only because I'm higher in the family. I'm still young. I'm not much older than her. And, I'm still not married. Clear?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: A spat between me and Dobermann...? Oh, don't worry, she's a top-of-the-top instructor, I know that. We've just had a bit of a… bit of a difference on how we like to train our people, that's all.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: There's plenty at Rhodes Island who pack personality AND strength. You could pick anyone, turn them into competition knights, and have every eye in the room on them... Well, maybe let's not stir that pot.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, can I borrow you? I just want you to help me carry some things. What things, you ask? Well... Hmm... all sorts of random things I buy when the mood strikes me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My injury...? Well, I'm not setting foot in that arena ever again, and I've long since learned to get along with my right hand. So let's not worry yourself, okay? Or maybe... you're just being polite, Doctor? Tiptoeing around saying I can't fight at operator standards, huh?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: My little Maria, she just runs away to the Engineering Department any time she's free. Such a headstrong girl she is, I never know what to say. Where did I go wrong that she ended up like this...? Well, whatever. Compared to forcing herself to arm up and do what she doesn't want to, life is better this way.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hm…? Oh, Hello, Doctor. No, I've just been feeling a little empty. Margaret never needs my fussing, Maria's found what she wants to do here, but... what about me...? Oh, gosh, what am I saying? Don't you worry about me, Doctor. I'm fine.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, we don't get along half bad, but you don't just lie there and leave it all up to me, not in your wildest dreams. I hate danger plenty, but layabouts leave a bad taste in my mouth. Though, when your back's against the wall... Well, we can talk about it then!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Someone's easygoing, eh? Alright then, I'll let you nap for ten minutes.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ahh, this is Rhodes Island, is it? I'm Whislash Zofia. As a former competition knight of Kazimierz, trust me when I say I'll whip your operators into shape.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I've never even heard of fighting like this before!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: So this is a Rhodes Island promotion, then...? Good. I don't pay much attention to my wages, but getting paid for my effort feels nice. Thank you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Hmm, thinking about it carefully, the pay here is not bad, life is good enough, and I get to see Maria and Margaret all the time. Staying here as an instructor sounds like a great choice.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Let's see who you've got on this one.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Alright, I'll lead the team.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Get ready, everyone! We're moving out!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You all know your job? Alright.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My time to shine.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: About time, Doctor.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Assess the situation first.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Whislash Zofia, attacking!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Do not underestimate me!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Perfect chance!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You won't be able to withstand the whip!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You're finished!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Honestly, I was going to have a word with you about taking such a dangerous mission, but since you tied things up so beautifully, I'll just let it slide…

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I can tell you're a perfectionist... Well, nothing wrong with that.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We won, and that's enough, no? Let's not obsess over it.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, don't just stand there! Follow me!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Well, this interior's got taste!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you've got to focus on your work.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Since Margaret left Kazimierz, we haven't had a chance to spend New Year's together. So, I'll have to go all-out for today's banquet… Oh, Doctor, would you like to join the Nearl family feast? You're cordially invited.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How do you do, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I got you a little gift. Sign right here. It's not a big plot, but I picked the location with care. The scenery is gorgeous. You could build a villa, or garden or something… What? Why are you looking at me like that? Is land not an appropriate birthday present for a friend?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I've met all sorts of fascinating little guys at Rhodes Island. The light in their eyes when they train is the same as I see in Maria's. I'm eager to see them transform into capable fighters. And until that day, I'll keep whipping them into shape. Oh, make no mistake, this is my duty, not a hobby.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: The files are in order. Is that all we have to do today? Good, then why don't we talk about the operation the other day, Professor?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Try not to come too close when I use Arts, okay? ... You won't? Whatever suits you then.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why am I calling you 'Professor'? Because I'm actually learning quite a lot from you: where to assign personnel on the battlefield, how to command, among many other things… What more reason do we need?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Here, you can have this. Some sort of candy, I think. No need to thank me. I got it from someone else anyway. Couldn't care less.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Sankta using staves is a rare sight to see, you say? Those fanatics on a non-stop shooting spree must have left you with a bad impression with their 'pews' and 'bangs.' Not all Sankta use guns as their weapons. At the very least, I don't like them.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Rather than sharing a single secret, we should exchange our secrets with each other. That's how you build a strong, equal relationship. So if you want to learn any of my secrets, you better come up with something just as saucy for me, Professor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There are no Infected in Laterano. Once a Sankta contracts Oripathy, he is immediately exiled. But even if you become Infected, no matter where you are, you still enjoy all kinds of privilege as a Laterano... You just don't get to set foot in your homeland again, that's all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My parents' will left me with quite a bit of trouble, and it was really a hassle to get it taken care of. If it wasn't for that uptight executor making things difficult for me, it all could've been much easier... Oh, whatever, it still went according to my plan.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I want to capture a few people to try out some new Arts in our next operation. I can't...? Alright, fine. It's a shame, but if that's what you say, Professor, maybe some other time, then. Eh? Not this time, and not ever? Geez, don't be so uptight.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you asleep? People who fall asleep at work get their faces drawn on, you know...? Just kidding, I know you're awake.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Codename Arene, officially joining today, it seems. So you are the Doctor... I hope we'll get along, Professor {@nickname}.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Studying tactics? Sounds kinda interesting.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This doesn't seem all that different than before. Or are you going to teach me some tricks of the trade, Professor?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, you aren't testing me, are you? Alright then, I'm just getting in the mood. Okay, starting right now, whatever happens is going to be our own little secret.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Okay, I'll follow your orders.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: So actual combat for my next assignment? Okay, let me think about the deployment...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: As long as we achieve our goals, it doesn't matter if the process is a little rough, huh?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Welcome. I've been waiting.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My turn?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: No need to rush.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Not a bad position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I can do whatever I want, right?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I've given my warning.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Does it hurt?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Tell me. How are you feeling right now?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: That's not a bad scream at all.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That went far better than I expected. I shouldn't have thought so little of you, Professor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was just as expected. No surprises, even a little boring.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A few slipped past. Should I go after them? Strategically speaking, I don't recommend it.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: This is quite the bad situation... You know what the appropriate course of action is now, right?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Isn't there a closer room to the Professor's?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: We have some time to spare. Why don't we review our last mission, Professor?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Professor, I've learned a new trick. You can come closer this time. It's not dangerous. Put this piece of metal on your hand, then just very lightly... Look, it turned into a small firework. How about that? It's just as good as the noisy ones outside, right?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You look tired. It's okay if you sleep a little longer, Professor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Prof. {@nickname}. As you can see, I'm not too fond of overly complicated ceremonies. I hope you're not so into loud parties, either, since I'm planning to celebrate in more meaningful ways with you. Right, I mean just the two of us.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Professor, when you steer Rhodes Island, what do you weigh and consider? Enemies, friends, what we need to do, what we mustn't do... There has to be a line that we cannot cross so that we don't lose ourselves. Am I right? I see...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Need me to make you some midnight snacks, Boss?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Here you go, Boss. And this. You mentioned it before... Everyone says I have a good memory, but I don't know.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: When I'm off… I practice cooking. Not just seafood. What do you like to eat, Boss?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Errr… Boss, is it usually on me to find something to talk about?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Boss, if you ever want to see a Lungmen night market, I can take you. It's fun... but not exactly safe.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Boss Lady Kal'tsit gave me special permission to use Rhodes Island's supply channels. Now I can try some new stuff. Any requests, Boss?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I had Officer Hoshiguma on me for a while, for a couple of reasons... But I know she was just looking out for me, same as the neighborhood aunties and uncles.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I've been told that with my looks, my good memory and knife skills, I was born to be a villain. I don't like that, and I've struggled to find a proper way to change myself. But after coming to Rhodes Island, I realized I should just live my own life.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Boss, do you think there's any way to put my memory to good use...? I never thought about it before, but it would be nice if I could help.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Bo... Oh, you're asleep. I'll just keep reading then.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hey, Boss. I'm Jaye. Officer Hoshiguma said I'd be better off working here, so here I am. I know seafood, I can cook, and I'm pretty good with a knife. I think I can help.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oh... so cooking and warfare are pretty alike…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Boss, does this mean I can expand my stall a bit more?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Boss, I figured it out. If you just treat the enemy like fish, then fighting is a lot easier.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I forgot to close up…

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I know how to lead a fishing crew.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Hm? We're going?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: That's a lot.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Right here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll try.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Ughh...

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Scale.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Gut.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Clean.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Slice.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Boss, did we just do something special?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Boss, is it... is it over?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Boss, should we go after them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Boss, I think we should probably run.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I don't know if there's a suitable place to set up my stall…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Boss, I wonder if you have any food preferences...?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I used to always have to close up the stall late, but now all of a sudden it's a holiday. Can't say I'm used to it... Boss, you want some late-night chow? I'm a little hungry myself. I can cook something for us both.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey Boss, you're looking good today.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: It's your birthday today, Boss. Big day. I always remember it, but I'm no good at presents... How about I make you something to eat? Whatever you want, I'll whip it up.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When Officer Hoshiguma said I should come to Rhodes Island, I was ready to work my hands to the bone. Then I realized, I may not get paid as much as I thought I would, but the work's also easier than I thought, so I guess it balances out... I'll keep doing my best, Boss.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I drew up the work schedule for you. Please kindly follow.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: How to make a celestial globe is a secret, but as we know, anything can be on the table for a fair price. I'd be happy to reveal my trick of the trade as long as your price is right.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Observing the stars everyday makes my neck sore. Wonder if the medics would have any suggestions for that... What, Miss. Warfarin is the physician on duty today? Um... I'll check again another day.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Astrology is learning about the present and the future from celestial alignments. It's not quite divination, but with the same result. So, would you like to give it a try, Doctor? It's free of charge!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: 'Similar genes, among blood relatives, causes, uh, reverberations of Originium...' I can barely understand a word in this work of an occultist. Doctor, Can you interpret the medical report for me?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Ever since my Oripathic infection, the stars have diminished their responses to me. I must find a way to reverse it before I lose all my power. Otherwise I'l… Could you help me, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You want to know more about the organization I'm with? Sorry, I took an oath not to divulge anything, and it's not for public knowledge, anyway. If you're curious, just think of it as a completely neutral community.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Sometimes, I envy Astgenne...  Ah, guess I should call her Elena now. She has everything I'm missing... But like you said, Doctor, we relied on each other because we complement each other, that's why we're sisters.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: As the nights bid us farewell, so do the starlights fade and quell. If this is the end that awaits us ahead, I should be picking up something more meaningful to do. Such as? Umm... Doctor, do you mind me waking you up every morning?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: The tea's ready, Doctor. Time for a little break.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Astesia, astrologer, reporting for guard duty. I'm yours to command, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: No report after viewing?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion medal? How exquisite. I'll treasure it well.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Stars shine bright, bearing witness of our past nights.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm over here, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Let me be the guiding star for all.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: There's no turning back now.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The stars will light our way.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready for action.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Is it my turn, Doctor?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Don't panic, Astesia. Do it like you usually do.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Time to prove myself.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Defend with me, steadfast Taurus.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Lend me your wings, avians among the stars!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The serpent has brought about your end.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: The light of stars shall be my blade!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: So this is 'our' power, a power even the stars failed to foresee...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Fantastic results, Doctor. But don't overwork yourself, be sure to rest up well.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: If I put in more effort, maybe the outcome could be better…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm dead on my feet... but it's not time to quit yet

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Let me see... Yes, the layout's good. The furniture won't attract any unwanted spirits this way.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: W-Wait!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: W-What's that... something on my face?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: A year's outset, and the start of another cycle. Before the stars fade in their response, would you like to try making a wish to them through me?  Today is the day wishes most easily come true, you know. Come, take a look at my celestial globe...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. Your present is in the box before you. Whatever delights you will surely delight me too. Now, close your eyes, say the name of something you like, and then open it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I appreciate Rhodes Island for being there for me and my sister. The pain Oripathy exacts on my body, is far from surpassing the doubt I have in my own life of study... but the Medical Department is still helping me to find out why I'm losing my power. So there's still hope for everything, isn't there?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'll gladly offer my help if you need it. Just remember to return the favor someday.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Vina... Err, I mean, Miss Siege—always gives me this feeling I can't describe. I wonder why...?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My dad? Oh my, you know I ran away from home and you're still going to ask me that? Doctor, are you perhaps not the best at conversation?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}! Do have a try of my cooking... You taste medicine? Oh, gosh... Well, I do have some knowledge in herbs, but you know I wouldn't be experimenting on you, would I? Eheheh...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I used to think my parents were so stuffy and numb to it all, so I ran away from home to find a new life. But after having traveled so far and been through so much, I've come to realize why my parents felt how they did now. Ahahah, c'est la vie, as the saying goes.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, see that lone cloud over there, off from the rest? That's the way my hometown lies.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Faith' is an interesting topic. I never had the chance to go to Laterano, but how funny I should hear all about its feats on Rhodes Island? Although I've mostly heard about, er... one very overly active girl. Has Laterano always been such a lively place?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The boats of Toron need a lighthouse to make their way back to port, and Rhodes Island has served as the safe haven at the end of my trip. Dr. {@nickname}, your light might not illuminate the whole harbor, but go on... Do what I couldn't. It's my honest request.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Right here, right now, is where I, Grace Arizona, place my faith. Dr. {@nickname}, you hold my hopes in your hands, forever more.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: ...That's the face of someone lost in their dreams. I wonder if you're feeling uneasy, Doctor?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Breeze, a traveling scholar from Toron County. It is a pleasure to meet you, Doctor. Phew, I've had enough of formal etiquette, so this will be the last of it.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: ...Stunning medical skills. There's Rhodes Island for you...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I bestow my heartfelt blessings on you for your gift, Doctor. Hmm? What a shoddy reaction—this is a hand-kiss, you know, we're being serious here. Hurry up, come on!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Well, this time won't be as mannerful as the last, not that I'd think you were hoping for that? So here goes. I will dedicate everything to Rhodes Island, a pledge that transcends my consciousness.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave the medical work to me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Thank you for your trust. I will make sure to prioritize the safety of the Operators.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: It's getting windy...

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Those who seek to inflict harm on others have no right to ask for forgiveness.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Awaiting orders.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Let's get this done quickly.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Make sure to look after yourself.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Rings through winds the Eulogy…

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Sings the breeze an elegy!

lines.title: In Battle 3
