lines.text: We have the will!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Everyone, victory is ours.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Every victory creates a kindling that will flourish into an everlasting fire.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Keep your senses alert. The wind is still restless.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Why are they so fixated on hurting others...?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What a... unique place this is.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wait, wait!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, would you like to hear the story of my hometown?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Seems a whole year's flown by. How long does that make it since I left home, then... wait, don't give me that look, or the head-patting! I'm not homesick!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good day, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Here's three slices of Victorian cake. One of—excuse me, what's the rush? I didn't even finish yet. Lucky you to pick the spicy one. Come on, wash that down with a spot of tea.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I wonder from time to time what my parents would think of me now, working at Rhodes Island. Would they be proud of me? Or maybe they still wouldn't forgive me... Either way, saving more lives is an ideal I'll never be swayed from.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Awaitingorders, readywhenyouare, Chief!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Intheinterestsofsafety, Iaminspectingescaperoutesandfirefightingequipment. Onemomentplease.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Pleasebeaware, itisagainstregulationtolightfiresorsmokecigarettesinthecorridors. Thankyouforyourcooperation, Operators.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Ensuringawarenessoffiresafetyandfirefightingprotocolsisakeypartofmyduties. Allowmetobeginwithyou, Chief.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Iamverysmall, butthatmeansIcandoworknooneelsecan.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Um, Chief, I'mverynervous… Actually, I'mnotgoodatexpressingmyself… Thankyou, foryourconcern.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: WhenIstartspeakingsometimesIcan'tstop. Ihopeyouforgiveme, Chief... *sob*...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Chief, canyoupleasehelpchangethislightbulb... I... can'treachit... Oh, it'sworkingnow. Thankyou.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Chief... Theythey'rebarbecuinginthedormagain. Canyoupleasestopthemforme! Aaaah! SomeoneswappedmyfireextinguisherwithIfrit'sflamethrower! Areyouokay, Chief?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Breaktimeendsinafewminutes. Justtoletyouknow, Chief.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Pleasuretomeetyou, Chief{@nickname}. IamShawoftheLungmenFireDepartment, reportingforduty!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Exercisevideosarepartofthetraining?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thankyouforyourtrust, Chief!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thisis... anelitemedal?Thankyou, Chief... Iwillcontinuetodomybestforeveryone, andfortheChief.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Allready.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Followmyorders.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Deploying!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Thefireisspreadingthisway. Getready!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Understood!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Uhuh.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hum.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Haah!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Outtatheway! Outtatheway!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Extinguishingflames!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Youhaveviolatedthefireregulation!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: AfireofthisscalecouldnotbeextinguishedwithoutthehelpoftheChiefandtheothers.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Thefireisextinguished. Readytoreturntobase.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Thefireisbasiclyundercontrol. ShouldIbeginthedamagecontrolprocess?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: O-ohno! Thefireisspreadinginthisdirection!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Iwillstayherefromnowonthen?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Um...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Aablublublu!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year Chief, I hope you'll continue to cooperate with my work over the following year! Hold on, I think I smell fireworks I don't know if I inspected that batch or noooooOoOoOo! No lighting fires, no setting off—

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Needsomething, Chief?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Chief, this is a... a Pinenut egg waffle that I made myself. I, I, I hope you have a happy birthday! Uwbwlhbh please stop pinching my cheeks!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Reporting in Chief, all meat roasting for tonight's dinner party that was to be done over a charcoal flame has now had induction stovetops substituted, celebrations can begin at any time! In future I'll be even surer to make every operator aware of how terrifying a fire can be!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'll make the arrangements. Just leave it to me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, I certainly hope my teammates won't cause any trouble while I'm here working for you... Aagh, the more I think of it the worse this headache gets...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: An ordinary job, a peaceful life. That's all I ever wanted.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Yeah, it's not that I don't get along with the other A6 members... I just get a little headache whenever I see them...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My group members just bump into new troubles every day. There is the anti-social one, the never listening one, the awfully stubborn one… Just when will they ever settle down and work?...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I don't know how I ended up on this team either. All I wanted was an ordinary life. Why did I end up in charge of these... problem children?! Wait a minute, Midnight is a grown man!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Popukar... gotta pat her on the head. Catapult... gotta tie her up. Spot... never make him mad. As for Midnight, just knock him out. There, Doctor, now you know the proper protocol for dealing with Team A6.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I made a cake for my teammates. Wanna take a slice, Doctor? Everyone in A6 just love fruitcakes. They really are a bunch of kids, aren't they?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Not much time left. Done with your work for the day, Doctor?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Captain of Reserve Op Team A6, Orchid, reporting in. Are you the Dr. {@nickname}? I look forward to working with you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I learned a lot from this video. I'll keep it in mind for sure.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you so much. I'll work hard to improve my skills from now on and strive for better results for you!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll complete my mission to the best of my ability.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Please follow the tactical combat manual closely, everyone. Thank you for your cooperation.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The battle has begun! Be careful, everyone!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Please make sure you follow every detail on the plan. Alright, everyone, now spread out!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Orchid, ready to move.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Just as planned.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Target locked!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Stop them now!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Out of my way!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Oh come on, I already have enough work to deal with!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Well done, Doctor! Impeccable leadership even against such a tough opponent.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A perfect job! Looks like we can have a good rest today.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We need to work harder next time.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Is everyone okay? Let's get out of here!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Oh, What a noisy place...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What do you want...?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Huh?! Overtime again?! Ugh, I knew it...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Popukar, listen, I want you to sit still on the couch... Catapult, what are you doing—they just hung the streamers from that window! Midnight, for heaven's sakes, get down from the fireworks pile! Ugh, all of you! Stop messing around, NOW! Or nobody's getting a New Year's present! NOBODY!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Greetings, Doctor. Let's start today's work just as planned.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Present time. I picked out a color-changing lipstick, one that goes from transparent to light pink. Even if you aren't in any makeup, it'll give you some complexion. I wasn't sure what kind you'd like, so I went the one I use, a fruit flavor. How about you give it a try...? No, no, Doctor, no licking once it's on.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I've been so busy with work, I wouldn't even have noticed another year vanish in a blink. Forget anything else, I have far more patience than I used to, honestly. Have they grown up? No, they're still the same loud brats as ever. But at least they're doing much better now. Look at this—they made me tea after hearing I had overtime.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Fragmentation mines deployed. None may interfere with your work or rest, Doctor. You can focus on your duty.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I am well aware that Rhodes Island has its own specialists in countering infiltration, sabotage and assassination. I know not who is behind these, but they are operating covertly in every corner of this landship. My mind is just playing tricks on me? Negative, Doctor. My mind does not play tricks.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I serve the Laterano Notarial Hall, so I rarely live in Laterano. But even if a Laterano citizen lives in other city-states, most of their rights and privileges still depend on the support of the Hall. In my case, for example, my work has less to do with the living, but more with those at death's door.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The control system is denying you access? Please allow me to check it. Mm, it appears to be a front-end crash caused by inputting an erroneous command. It has nothing to do with the framework and can be easily solved. Doctor, please feel free to ask me if you have any similar issues in the future. I understand machines better than I do people.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: There are many Sankta at Rhodes Island who also use a gun. They will not fire at one other in the face of the law, but I am different. If necessary, I will not hesitate to fire upon my fraters. Of course, there is hardly a need for that, because my fists are sufficient to deal with most of them.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Do not worry about the Notarial Hall. They are all reasonable people, and the agreement I signed with Rhodes Island is also in line with their protocols, so they won't make things difficult for you. As a matter of fact, Doctor, I think you are well suited for notarial work yourself. They always welcome foreign employees.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I have a distant relative who had great musical talent ever since she was a child. Contrary to what others expected, her gift led her onto a tumultuous path. Fortunately, she seems to hate me very much, because I cannot see the illusion she creates, nor understand what emotion means to people.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Private disputes are more frequent than public conflicts, as chaos is the norm over order. I have seen much more people who fired upon me at first glance than those who opened their doors to welcome me. But it matters not, for I can complete any commission, whether it is to kill a living person on behalf of the dead, or to create a dead person on  behalf of the living.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Being treated as an aberration is normal to me, because I cannot understand other people, nor do I have any desire to deal with them. On the contrary, talking to you is quite interesting to me, Doctor. Neither you nor the Notarial Hall has denied me because of the way I live. You make me feel at ease. Thank you.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Rest is necessary, Doctor. Take your time and rest well.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Well met, Doctor of Rhodes Island. I am a Laterano citizen who signed a clean-up agreement with your company. Here is my certificate. You require to know my name? You may call me Executor, if you insist.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: There is value in referencing these battles.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you. I have already prepared all the ammunition I need for the next battle. If the situation worsens, please allow me to use heavier firepower. Promotion? I have already thanked you for that.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Another promotion? I understand, there must be an infiltration operation that requires me at the heart of the enemy. If that's your wish, then I have no objections. You have no such a need? You are just promoting me? Why's that?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The law won't enforce itself. It needs executors.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I am not good at working with others.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Departing.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Objective: eliminate all enemies.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Let's begin.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your request has been confirmed.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Victory is an illusion.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Only the law is the truth.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: My bullets always find their targets.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I carry out the wills of the dead and the living.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Maximizing firepower.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: All is permitted when called by necessity.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Mission completed. All contracts successfully fulfilled.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission completed.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission completed. Defects in the result.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Mission failed.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Do not worry about me. I have no need for stable residence.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I am confused.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: How can I help you, Doctor?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, a pile of fireworks is amassed on the deck. There would be severe consequences if someone decides to use them for vadalism. For your safety, I will return to inspect— No? Roger that, I respect your decision. Just for the record, such tactics as raised may be applicable in our next operation.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, please exercise caution.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Like others, I have prepared a gift for you. However, given I do not grasp the associated connotations, I am unsure whether my imitation of this formality may displease you. I may need to rephrase as follows. Would I be allowed to do something that makes you happy today?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I execute every assignment from Rhodes Island stringently, as I do with instructions from the Notarial Hall. However, when contrasted, your assignments better reflect my efficiency. No, I have no intent of comparing partner organizations. I simply mean to say that you are a truly outstanding commander.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Ummm... Nice to see you again, Doctor. It makes me happy... hehe...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, do you need a break? I made you some tea, and Miss Orchid made cookies. Here, hope you like them… And, umm... Cheer up!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why is everyone in Team A6 always fighting with each other...? If things keep going like this, we can't be a team anymore... Fighting is bad. I must make them understand!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The gear on my chainsaw is kinda loose, the one that makes the 'vrrrr' sound ... But I don't remember using it lately. Weird...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, is Team A6 getting along well...? That's really some good news. Peace is the best... As long as they don't fight, nothing will bother me while I stay with you…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I don't know why, but I sometimes get these gaps in my memory. Then when I ask my teammates in A6, they just smile and tell me nothing happened at all...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Um, Doc-Doctor, did I just pass out...? Um, why is everyone lying on the floor? Miss Catapult? Mr. Midnight? Mr. Spot? Why do you all have bruises on your face? And Miss Orchid too...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I'm actually super strong? You say I lost control over my power, when I wanted to stop my friends from fighting each other? That's why I don't remember anything...? Okay, I think I get it! Umm... right, I will put my power to good use!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Aaaah! The cup! I didn't control my grip... Errmm... I'm in trouble when the Doctor wakes up...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Popukar from Operation Reserve Team A6, reporting in. Um, my teammates in A6 are always arguing. I'm sure you worry about them, Doctor... But I know what to do...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Umm, Doctor, is the girl in the video... me?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm so happy I don't even know what to say...! Thank you, Doctor...! Thank you so much!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: My name is Popukar... Nice to meet you...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: B-But... I really don't know anything about tactics or strategies or anything…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Miss Catapult, um, it's time to deploy!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Miss Orchid, don't worry... I'll be fine.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Errrmm...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm right here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I want to stop this fight.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Please stop arguiiing!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Be good and don't move.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Chainsaw got mad…

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Mr. Midnight, come back here... Miss Orchid is staring at you…

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Can everyone have a good peaceful talk, now...?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor… Doctor…? Here, I made some tea. You must be tired.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: **A painful groan** I'm… injured…? It hurts…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Please don't leave me here alone...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Aaaugh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, headpats…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I made some soft and chewy New Year's cakes at the cafeteria... They say my cakes are great. I'm strong, so I always pound the dough well! Hehe...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, are you getting along with everyone today...?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I never really celebrated birthdays before, but now that I'm at Rhodes Island, Orchid always lets me have extra snacks on them... Do you want any? I'll sneak some out for you. Others won't notice!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Will we all stay together if I'm a good kid, if I'm a little smarter? I want A6 to stay together like a family... Will you help me, Doctor?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: We got a lot to do today, Doctor. So how about we play some games first? Isn't getting nice and relaxed the best way to prepare for a hard day of work?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Aw, I feel so lazy today for some reason! Maybe because Midnight isn't around? I love watching him chat up girls with that flashy smile of his. It's especially fun when the girls turn him down! Totally makes my day.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, you know who's the most reliable in our group? Oh, you can't guess? It's Spot! He might be quiet, but he's very reliable. So why don't we get him here to offer a hand? After all there's so much work for only two of us, don't you think?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Aw... Ms. Orchid yelled at me again today. She's such a nag! Must be work getting into her head and stressing her out. She should learn from me—I have the perfect balance between working hard and playing hard!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Hey, where's Dobermann? She's out on business today? Yay, finally! I can slack off all day now, wonderful! I'm gonna go get some snacks first. Doctor, you want some chips or popcorn? I'll grab a bag for you!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Uh, Popukar, sweetie, please listen to me, I'll do anything you say, okay? J-just put down the chainsaw! Oh no, she's out of control! This is the worst! Doctor, run! Run! We gotta jump out the window! Yeah, the window! Follow me!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The town I came from... the mayor was a tyrant, a fat cat with no heart, no sympathy. Drove the townspeople nuts. I hated him too, so I blasted open his vault and handed out all the money I found to the townies. Now that was a good time!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I don't care what anybody thinks of me—it's more important that I just enjoy every day doing what I like. My life belongs to me, so I alone decide what I do. Isn't that right?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor's asleep? Well, can't interrupt a beauty nap. Guess I'll go out and have some fun.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Reserve OP Team A6, Catapult, reporting in! Hey, I can tell you're hella different from that stuffy old bit—I mean, that esteemed, honorable instructor Ms. Dobermann. Right? Like it's obvious!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: ...Ahhh, that was a nice nap.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Hehe, I finally finished basic training. Wait, what? Dobermann will keep overseeing the newbies, even AFTER their promotions? You gotta be kidding me! No—

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: It's not time to head out yet, right? Let me hang out for a bit longer...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm the captain? Haha~I've been waiting forever to hear those words!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Aw man, where did I leave my ammunition belt?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ugh, I hate fighting. But what else can I do?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What's up?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Whatever you say.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Safe landing!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Time for business.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Watch how I get them with one shot!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You're all gonna fly!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: What an awesome formation! You got some great tactics, Doctor. And it all went down perfect!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I love commanders that lead us to victory! Just like you, Doctor!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Relax, I set a whole bunch of traps right where the enemy's gonna be running. What? They didn't step in any of them? No way!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Oh shoot! Hurry up, Doctor. We gotta move!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Psst, care to take a peek and tell me if Dobermann's in there?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You can't catch me! ...Oh, you can.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you're an awesome leader!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor! Quick! Stop what you're doing! We don't get to take time off for new year's everyday, and you're just commiting a crime letting your works trouble you. Get out of your room, and let's have some fun!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor! I'm right here!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I guess getting old isn't something you should feel optimistic about, but it's still worth commemorating the day a new life was born. Gimme a minute, let's celebrate with something from my secret snack cache.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I don't like working, but Rhodes Island isn't so bad. Instead of evil landlords, you have comrades you can trust to have your back, and that's enough for me. Say, if today's special, does that mean I get the day off?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Thank you for choosing me, Darling. Now, what kind of secret are you going to share with me under this velvet of the night?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Fiend of the Night? Ah, I can't hide anything from you. But past glory is nothing to me. After all, I have an even brighter future waiting.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I may work in a different place now, but my job is still the same—to put a smile on everyone's face.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I bet Ms. Orchid must have been born with a negative number on her happiness scale. Why else would she always look so stern whenever I'm there to light her up? If you know anything about her, please tell me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: People say my swordsmanship is top notch. All due credit, I have to say. Practicing swordsmanship helps me maintain my figure and cultivate my elegance. It'd be a crime for me to slack off on the pratice. After all, you either keep the momentum and hold the lead or end up getting overwhelmed. Please keep that in mind.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: People used to say that I sold feelings as commodities, that I treated 'happiness' as a product. Fools, all of them. How can I expect my customers to open their hearts to me if I don't open mine to them first?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I believe happiness can be contagious. It's a tangible atmosphere that truly exists. I feel the joy when others treat me with sincerity, and I will make sure my happiness reaches right into their hearts.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My colleagues in team A6... they may be a bit weird, but they're truly kind souls. They're a gift from destiny, a gift that continues to remind me to cherish those important to me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Now that I have some free time, I should read.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Show me your brightest smile, my esteemed customer! Happiness is at arm's reach when you're by my side. Midnight, at your service.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's important to never stop learning!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Whoa, so my hard work really paid off! Let's set up a champagne tower to celebrate. My treat.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: With me on your side, success is guaranteed!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Follow this handsome me!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Show me your spirit, everyone!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Behold, here comes my flamboyant moves!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What's up?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I've arrived.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: OK.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: O sword, pierce the moonlight that veils the night!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Bathe in fresh blood!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Impressive, Dr. {@nickname}, truly impressive. Your blazing brilliance almost stole my show today.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: There's only one thing that's impossible for me: being imperfect.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Not too shabby. Such a heart-warming result calls for a little celebration.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No need to look back. We'll greet each other with a smile next time.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: A wonderful place. Let's have a drinking party tonight.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: There now, would you please leave my collar as it is?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Thanks for taking care of me.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Sometimes, it doesn't take flowery tricks to capture a customer's heart. See the fireworks here? The sight of them going off, even just for an instant, will be enough to focus all the customers' attention solely on me, their souls scorched by my gaze... Orchid? Why are you dragging me away?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good evening, Dr. {@nickname}.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. You should set your work aside for today. We can chat until dawn, and I'll stick by your side if you want to watch the sun rise. But {@nickname}, I trust that you know what to say if Orchid asks why I didn't work overtime tonight.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: What you see today is the fruit of all your hard work, {@nickname}. Nothing makes me happier than accompanying someone in admiring their own marvelous achievements. I do hope you'll still choose me to stay by your side this time next year.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Work's kinda like a trap, and you just fling yourself into it.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I don't talk much 'cause I don't want to. Not 'cause I'm looking down on anyone.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What did Midnight do this time? Did he finally end up in Medical after hitting on one too many ladies in the hallway? No? Too bad.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Got something, Doctor? I could probably lend a hand. But I'd rather not eat up too much of my time. I got a lot of comics to read.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I know I speak a little too bluntly sometimes, but I always get my work done. It's not like I got professional pride or anything, I just can't respect somebody who doesn't finish his work.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a strange place. The people here just say whatever they're thinking, and somebody's always there to help when someone needs it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Reserve Op Team A6 is a real diverse crowd. We have Lady Stinky-face, Miss Lacking-self-confrol, Narcissist Kun, and a little walking time bomb. But still, I do think I can trust them. They work hard, even if they don't show it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I used to live free and easy like everyone else at Rhodes Island, but my family thought I was a freak. This place may be a freakshow, but at least everyone's happy, and that's pretty good.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Can I go back to my room now?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hi, I'm Spot from Operation Reserve Team A6. My job is to protect the other troublemakers on my team, I guess.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I've seen this battle before. Bad guys got their asses kicked.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm gonna work twice as hard. I'll bump it up from a 0.1 to a 0.2, I think.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I won't ask about the meaning of this mission then.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I wanna get back to my dorm.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Save us a lot of time if you just surrender.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Whatever you say.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doesn't matter to me.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Alright then.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, fine.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hey, catch.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't see any harm in this.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: So many weaknesses.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Holding this shield is tiring, pal.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Been through an easy battle, you say? Then better do it all over again.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: With hard work, even an idiot can get the job done.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Perfection is for suckers, you know.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Relax, you're doing fine.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Yeah sure.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ah.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: If you keep petting me like that, my hair's gonna get tangled.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's the start of a new year. If you were expecting anything to change on its own with time, then stop dreaming. Really changing yourself takes way more effort than that. If you can manage it, do it.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey Doctor...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. I don't have anything decent, but you can have this old set of limited-edition comics. I always dreamed of becoming a hero when I was little, but I learned the hard way that it takes all my effort just to stay alive. Don't worry, the comics are still good.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Someone like me can't exactly say I fully embrace Rhodes Island's ideals from the bottom of my heart. I only raise my shield to protect the troublemakers of A6, that's all. Doctor, let's try and survive this troublesome land together.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Do you require medical assistance, Doctor? But, you look quite well…?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, you have been working far too late these days. Please get adequate rest, or Dr. Kal'tsit may give you an earful again…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Are you feeling unwell? I could give you a medical examination, if you wish.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You've worked hard, Doctor. How would you like a cup of coffee? Actually, I've always wanted to try coffee... but... I can't drink… Anyway, I am also satisfied watching you enjoy yours.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I've printed out the results of the routine blood test you just did. All indicators are normal. But Doctor, your blood appears to be very unique…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: What do I like? I like 'lovely Ms. Closure.' Why, you ask? Uh... I'm not sure either... It's been my default setting ever since the first time Ms. Closure switched me on…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I am only useful when healing the sick or injured. But as long as you're healthy, as long as I get to be by your side, I'm okay with being totally useless. I'll still feel calm and satisfied.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, unbeknownst to you, I recorded your snoring just now. Your sleep quality is normal. The length of your REM sleep cycle is—

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hi, nice to meet you, Doctor. I understand that you want me to say something more interesting, but I'm afraid I cannot do so. Because I'm just a medical robot…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Firmware upgrade complete. Restart required. Please click anywhere to restart.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Medical supplies: confirmed. Battery charge: confirmed. Ready for deployment.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Doctor, I'm pretty cumbersome. There's not much I can do besides providing emergency treatment and healing... Are you sure you still want me to be the captain?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Moving out. Everyone, please be safe.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Be careful, everyone. Leave the first aid to me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Do you need medical attention?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready to operate.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Affirmative.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Roger that.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Commencing treatment.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Initiating first aid.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Analgesic deployed.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Equipment sterilized. Ready for treatment.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: With every battle, we suffer even more casualties. When will humans finally stop hurting each other?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Well done, Doctor. That was a tough battle. Um, the enemies do not look well. Can I treat them too?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Is everyone okay? Please hold still, I'll perform first aid.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't worry, we've successfully retreated. I will clean your wounds now. It might hurt, please be brave.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Lovely Ms. Closure' told me that you need help here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ahhh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I asked 'lovely Ms. Closure' to change 'what I like the most' to you, Doctor. But she refused to do it...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year. I've noticed an increase in inorganic operation platforms aboard Rhodes Island over the past year. It would be lovely to keep working with you this year too, Doctor... Assuming I'm not phased out for a newer model...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Welcome back, Doctor. You are in good condition. Please keep it up.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I'm so happy I can share this celebration with you. But my database's statistics suggest that human life expectancy far exceeds the lifetime usage of smart operation platforms. I don't know how many more birthdays... I will be able to spend with you...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, everyone seems very happy today. I'd like to join them, but as a medical operation platform, my appearance at a dinner party would put everyone on edge. I'll be content staying in this corner... I hope everyone remains as healthy and high-spirited as they are now.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Thank you for choosing Castle-3! I am honored to serve as your assistant, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, please do not be intimidated by my appearance. My sturdy metal shell, modified by Master Closure herself, will make you invincible on the battlefield.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Warning: Do not strike this unit. It may cause hardware damage.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The topography in the wild may be treacherous, but Castle-3 is fitted with an engine with outstanding performance and a 4WD mode to whisk you away from danger.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, if your life is ever in danger, just summon Castle-3! Castle-3 was created specifically for combat purposes. I am a top-class defensive warfighting robot.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Castle-3 is honored to be at your side. Doctor, should you require me to strike down your foes, I shall go through heaven and hell to see it done!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Castle-3's official manager is 'Master Closure,' but please understand that you are even more important to Castle-3 than Master is, in most cases. I am your devoted, trustworthy battle companion!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Entering sleep mode. Press any button to wake.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Thank you for choosing Castle-3. Tap anywhere to initialize startup options.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Firmware upgrade complete. Restart required. Please click anywhere to restart your reliable robot guard.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Device scan complete. All communications working as normal. Castle-3 is on standby, awaiting your orders.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Understood. Castle-3 is your best choice, Doctor, to lead a squad against enemy formations!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Now, Castle-3 will show you its true power as an industrial battle platform!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy unit located. Ready for attack.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Castle-3, awaiting orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Castle-3, ready and waiting.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Order received.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Acknowledged.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Show me what you've got!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Foul enemies, you are forbidden to advance.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Count up your sins!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Doctor, that was at last a worthy opponent!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Well done, Doctor. Castle-3 is your best choice on the path of justice!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What an exciting battle! Let's fight together again next time.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Is everyone all right? Castle-3 hopes its performance has exceeded your expectations.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I will hold up the rear. Everyone, retreat!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is there anything Castle-3 can help with?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Please be gentle when putting me down, Doctor!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, would you like to grab a drink together? I might not be able to actually have a drink, but I can still treat you to one. It is fine, Master Closure will pay.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New—Launching scheduled plugin. Switching to holiday mode—Whoohoo! New Year's Megarush Bonanza underway at Closure's Store! Some products up to a whole 10% off! Check out our new service: get an advance on your wages, at a monthly interest rate of only—Sorry Doctor, Happy New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Lovely weather today, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Let me sing a birthday song for you. I have birthday songs from 31 different regions saved to memory. Which one should I play? Or should I loop a playlist? Or maybe you could use an exclusive discount on a birthday cake from Closure's Store!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, I have a question. What exactly separates me and Rhodes Island as a landship? Is it functionality, or size? If I linked my smart module to Rhodes Island, then would I be 'me', or Rhodes Island?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, you gotta be hungry! Try some of my onigiri. They're great!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I've got a lotta hobbies: martial art sparring, soccer… Oh! And Ikebana! Some took me as a warrior with more brawn than brains, and I'd say they're the ones who's got a fat head!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My race eats other races? That's some old crap! Who told you that? Tch, those cowards, cooking up this nonsense behind my back. When I find'em, I'll give'em a lesson they'll never forget!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm born with this self-healing body. Even if I take a few cuts in the fight, the wounds will close back up in no time.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, Rhodes Island's got a soccer tournament! C'mon, let's sign up together! No need to think twice! Just put me in your team, and it's in the bag. You'd better work your brain elsewhere, like a cool victory pose!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You don't even recognize me on the battlefield? I just start cutting through enemies with a face as cold as my blade? Wow! Sounds hella badass! Wish I could watch myself out there.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I got this problem where I kinda end up breaking stuff, so I'm working with my Ikebana teacher to control my strength. Besides, getting surrounded by all those pretty flowers makes me real happy!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Strategy? Ehh, not really my forte. That's why I keep hopping right into the enemy's plans. But you, Doctor, you always stop me right before I lose my mind. Real nice to have you by my side.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Actually, I've always been a gullible dummy. Got duped so bad in the past that I almost got myself killed a few times. But now I, Matoimaru, swear loyalty to you, Doctor! Because I know you'll never betray me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Grr... Hey, no falling asleep, Doctor! I need a listener or I'm gonna die of boredom!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Matoimaru, here to join Rhodes Island! My blade is at your command, Doctor!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: More fancy skills to beat those bad guys with!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, put my strength to good work. That'll be the respect I deserve.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, please stand back a bit. I don't want to hurt you when swinging my naginata. But I, Matoimaru, will bring us every victory in your name.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Hah hah! You all look pretty tough. How about a warm-up with me?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Ugh, you want me to play captain? Then how am I suppose to throw myself into the battle!?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: You guys ready to rumble? Then what are we waiting for!?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, bad guys!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm over here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Just how long until it's my turn?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Love that battlefield smell.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Make 'em shake in their boots!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Standing up to me? Haha, Ballsy!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Ready to meet your demise?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: My blade shall rip you and your toy to ribbons!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You end here!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: A sea of fire and a mountain of blades... Now that's what I call a fight. This is the battlefield I've always dreamed of.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, I got 'em all! Huh? what happened here? Everything's busted… Um, wait a second, did I do it...?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'll get 'em before they escape! Can't call the battle over unless we got every last of 'em!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Retreat! I'll cover your escape. Make sure you don't get hit!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Agh! Ow! My horn...!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What's with that smile on your face? Anything to share with me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, how does Rhodes Island celebrate the New Year? Oh, anything is welcome? Haha, alright then, I'll put together a soccer match with Matterhorn and the others! Make sure you come to watch!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Uh huh, I'm listening.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I wanted to fill your office with flowers, but my teacher said restraint is the first rule of Ikebana. So I made you this! And it should fit just fine on your desk!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: This blade brings nothing but trouble when I'm holding it. Good thing I can trust you to tell me where to swing it. That way, nothing can go wrong!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hey, hey! I'm watching a rock concert, Doctor! Stop blocking the TV! Just missed the best part thanks to you!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You get people who say things like 'fight the power' and 'be yourself.' But for us Sarkaz, that's just life.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I like bands... no, I LOVE bands! As a guitarist myself, I know every beat, every chord is important. I gotta practice on and on, day and night. That's the only way to give the audience the ultimate face-melting solo!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm going exceptionally harsh on you, given I've been so nice to everyone else you say? Well, isn't it only natural? Those who shoulder the responsibility of management like you need more than their self-discipline to do their job, Doctor. I have high standards for myself, and I think it's only right for these standards to be applied to you as well.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Hmm, this smell... is this the lunchbox Hibiscus brought you? You want me to eat it for you? No way! This... this wasn't in my job description!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: If there's something you want out of life, you gotta work hard for it. Like, I want to become stronger, so I train. I want a sharper weapon, so I customize this one myself. People can judge as they want, but I'll stick to my belief until I get what I want!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Wha?! It's pouring outside? I-I don't... believe it has anything to do with my outdoor concert! Now get aside if you hear me 'cause I'm setting off right NOW! I won't let this sprinkle dampen my passion by one bit!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You got an important mission you want me to handle? Hehee, you can count on me! Let's see here... 'You are to acquire the following products for Rhodes Island during a time-limited mega-sale...?' Th-that's impossible!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Even if the crowd starts booing, the show must go on. You can't quit in the middle of a performance just because you messed something up. Same is true for the Sarkaz and infected. We won't have anything left with us if we just call it quits.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hey, you can't sleep over here! Ugh... you're too heavy for me to carry...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Excuse me, is this the office of the Doctor? I've been looking for the place quite a while and it'd be really appreciated if—what? YOU'RE the Doctor? Hmpf, I see. Operator Vigna, reporting in!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: You gotta be willing to sweat a lot to keep up the battle tempo!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Am I wearing my elite medal right? Great! In that case, it's time to get a picture for this remarkable moment!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Pure strength might not be my forte, but my spear and unparalleled skills shall always leave them with a deep impression!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll learn from others' battle techniques.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I may be the team captain, but you can all let me know where and how I might improve.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Everyone, prepare to deploy. And please keep in mind that coordinated actions bring victory.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Eyes on me—it's showtime!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Oh!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Mhmm.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Here I go!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Battle stance ready!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Say no more!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: My blood is boiling!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Victory shall be mine!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Now! Tear them to shreds!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No matter how tough the bad guys are, I won't stop strumming! Oh… 'fighting' might be the better word here!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You all deserve a commendation from me, oh, but not you, Doctor, not yet! Your job's not finished until I see everyone back home safe and sound.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We're not out of trouble yet! Hold formation!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ugh... This can't be it. We have to fight harder!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is there a soundproof room here? My fingers are itching for guitar strings so BAD!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey! That just gave me a chill!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: D-Don't pat me on the head! It might make me shorter!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy new year, Doctor! I can see you're hyped for the new year concert tonight just like me! Here's an inside scoop for you: my guitar solo will close the concert at its climax! Hehe! Now that we have more and more operators with talents for music on Rhodes Island, who can say our future concert won't be a hit like that Obsidian Festival in Siesta!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How can I help?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! A perfect time for everyone to get hyped-up, don't you think? How about we take the meeting room and hold a live concert there! Huh? Still a no, even on your birthday? Aargh… Well, but my song request service is still at your disposal. Oh, but guitar solo only, mind you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Life at Rhodes Island is like a piece of rock music. Surely there're low drum beats that keep us in suspense here and there, but the theme always catches us with our blood seething and souls resonating. Which kinda reminds me, that it's high time for me to wipe all the craps out with this guitar!... Er, I mean a more creative, musical way, not really wiping the board with it...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I made a really strong brew with our new coffee machine. Wanna try? You can only have one cup a day, though. Don't want you up all night!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Being a Messenger isn't easy. Both the sender and the receiver might have some big ideas, and who knows if some shady secrets get inside your bag. If you're too absorbed in getting yourself moving, you could still end up in a pit for what you get yourself into.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My mother was from Higashi, so my name doesn't sound very Siracusan. A lot of people ask me if it's even my real name, so I decided to use Angelina as a codename too.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Good morning, Dr. {@nickname}! Yeah, I'm off to send out some documents. Dr. Kal'tsit says my skills could come in super useful in battle... but compared to fighting, I kinda prefer taking letters where they belong!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I actually don't know if I'm a good fit for Rhodes Island... I mean, a lot of really heavy stuff happens here, I'm not sure I can handle it. Croissant's always comforting me, but I am still not sure about myself. Do I really have what it takes?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I don't feel lost anymore. At the end of the day, it's more than a simple identification with you or Rhodes Island. If I can leap across the gaps between skyscrapers as a Messenger, then I know I could  bridge the gap between the Infected and Uninfected as an Operator!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Memories are precious. I always remember that the Infected, just like us, look forward to a better tomorrow. I don't know anything about your past, Dr. {@nickname}, but I promise to help you recall.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, don't be shy, come closer! That's right! Three, two, one, sorridi! See? It's a photo sticker of you and me. The perfect souvenir, right? I guess it's also a token of… some of my feelings, haha.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The view from the deck is great. Especially for stargazing! See that lone star over there? People say that one day, its companion star will appear, and then they'll embrace and dance together. Still... how long does it have to wait for the other one to show up? And how long do I have to wait... for the star to wink back at me?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Umm hmm~♪ Mmm, maybe the coral lipstick suits me more.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ciao! I'm Angelina Ajimu, a Messenger from Siracusa. Just call me Angelina. Am I cool to call you Dr. {@nickname}?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The battlefield is a cruel place... but I'll try not to let you down.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Since you trust me, Dr. {@nickname}, I'll have to work much, much harder than I usually do! Like, Siracusan Messengers always say: 'A slow Messenger gets caught by the wind.'

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I've made my decision. As long as you're still working to help the Infected, Dr. {@nickname}, I'll follow you. You've come so far, done so much... now it's my turn to do something for you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: In work or in battle, I'll give it all I've got!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I might not be the best, but I'll still do what I can.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Everybody, please be careful!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: When will all these conflicts ever come to an end…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Okay~

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hm?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Gently lan~ding.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Ehee~

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Feeling you're gaining some weight?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: We will overcome what confronts us.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I've got a magic touch on this.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Ever wondered how it feels to float in the air?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: We only grow stronger after getting into a wolf's mouth, right?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We all worked hard for this. You'll cherish this victory, won't you Dr. {@nickname}?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Well, even I lose a letter sometimes...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The more difficult the situation, the harder we have to try!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place is like home to me!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Woah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: My hair looks nice? Heheh, I've got a secret for that.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: {@nickname}, Happy New Year! The first letter I'm delivering this year is a New Year's card for {@nickname}. I hope my feelings of joy make their way to {@nickname}, heheh.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Morning, Dr. {@nickname}!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: {@nickname}, close your eyes... Keep this a secret just between the two of us, okay? Hold my hand tight now... Do you feel floaty? Look, {@nickname}! Don't the stars seem closer?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When I left home and came to Rhodes Island, I left behind my old friends and the life I knew too. I've grown up a little now, but... I'd be fooling myself if I said it wasn't hard. Doctor, I still believe it's all worth it. Because right here, I've found a star to call my own.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Drink this, before you start working. Good. That medication will keep you up as long as it's in your system. I trust you'll stay focused, won't you?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Separation and analysis of the extract almost complete; next step, purification; Further testing needed to determine actual effect... Hm? Why are you staring at my hair, Doctor...? It's frazzled? Don't worry about it. Wouldn't be the first time my experiment has failed, or the second.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The concoctions I carry with me? They're not lethal, though I do advise against physical contact.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Always keep your mind running. To cease thinking is to expose your weaknesses to your enemies. This I've been taught many times and committed to memory.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My people once looked entirely different. Our skin was as hard as a carapace, and our hair flowed smoothly like water. However, the relentless sun and arid conditions have turned us into what we are now. You believed that? Sorry, I was just making things up.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: If you are not a follower of the Laterano religion, it is best not to go to Iberia. Their so-called 'purest faith' is rooted in that land. The people there are so pious, even the Laterans feel ashamed among them. As for me? None of that concerns me in the slightest.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, have you learned any of the history of the Iberian Penal Battalion? If you've heard even anything remotely relevant, you should know that the inhabitants of that land are far crazier than their cold, plain gray buildings suggest.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The angle of attack, the path of evasion, and the posture of defense. Every action is calculated, and no effort is wasted. This is what they call 'La Destreza.' Don't you think this is similar to your command style, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I need to unwind a bit more when I'm resting, you say...? Empty your thoughts and just enjoy the sun and the breeze… I suppose it is nice to give it a try every now and then. Come, Doc. The breeze up here reminds me of my hometown…

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Zzz... zzz... Huh? ...What happened? Did I fall asleep too?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: So you're the Doctor? I'll keep this brief then. Code name: Thorns. Starting today, I'll be assuming my post. Yes? My trouser leg is rolled up...? Pay it no mind; this happens a lot.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm... These recordings do seem useful.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? I trust your judgment on matters like these. Now, can I be excused?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Neutralize the opponent's actions swiftly and efficiently, then secure victory at minimal cost... I think I fully understand your orders. In that case, I'll use this paralytic neurotoxin in tandem with my attacks. I take it that you have no issue with this?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Let me see how Rhodes Island fights.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Captain? You shouldn't expect much. Leadership is not my forte.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's make this quick. My time is valuable.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Be careful. Don't get overconfident.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Awaiting orders.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This won't take long.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Incapacitating them is enough, right?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Stand still. It'll spare all of us the effort.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Your attacks are all within my calculations.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Futile.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't blink, this is the Destreza of Iberia!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: An excellent outcome. Was this also a part of your calculations?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete. Very precise and efficient command, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: There was an oversight in your command, exacerbated by my improper execution. We should both reflect upon this after we return.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Considering the losses of our squad, there is no better option than to retreat immediately.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: How are the protective measures here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Shoot, the potion's going to spill.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: My hair? Oh... I just combed it, why's it all ruffled up again?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New things for the new year…? I suppose I have no need for any new clothes. My outfit here holds up against explosions pretty well and it's comfortable enough. But you do make a good point, though. It's about time to add some new moves to my exercise routine.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You seem tired. Would you like a pick-me-up, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy Birthday, Doctor. Good timing. I have a gift for you. I put in extra effort to wrap it up so you will like it. Looks good, doesn't it? But I suggest you wear gloves when you open it. Just in case.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, I know Rhodes Island has always been curious about Iberia, but no two Iberians can give the same recount, just as no two swordsmen will perform the same la Destreza. While the move may seem simple, one can only observe its form, and not learn its essence.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Before you leave, I'm responsible for protecting you.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, I'd like to quickly increase the charge my body can carry. An operator who uses electricity? I'll give it a crack.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Ore identification? Try Leonhardt. Not my wheelhouse, I'm afraid.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The boss at Rhine Lab frowned every time she saw me, like I was a pest. What a bother. When did I do anything to her?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My ears perked up? No worries. Just a zap. Not too bad, honestly. It'll settle down soon enough.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: This beauty cost me two years of scraping by and a load of debt, but worth every coin. Without it, those Cautus black market profiteers would've dumped me on some mining ship. Living the good life now is all thanks to my sparky friend here.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Oh, there you are. Got these fresh, ice-cold salted edamame, fancy a nibble? Not even a bite? You've gotta appreciate food like this. Just give it a go.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Leonhardt's a noisy drama magnet. Much calmer here with you. What? He's gotten himself cornered by Medical over some dodgy jokes? That guy never learns. Guess I gotta defuse this mess. Doctor, want to come along?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I look out for Leon because we've been like that since we were kids. If he's in a bind, I sort it out, and he does the same for me. But the two of us, we don't know each other like that. Just because you bandage my wounds doesn't mean we're close, got it? ...I said the same thing last time? Tsk, damn it.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Huh?! Oh, it's you. I'm good, just… catching my breath for a bit. If you wanna join me, I can shift over.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Catastrophe Messenger bodyguard, Ayerscarpe. Good to meet you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Impressive. Professional. I'll take note.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I think I've been overpaid recently. A promotion? Got it. Thanks.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Being a bodyguard isn't a matter of defense. It's about control. Controlling the space around your target and neutralizing threats. Want me to demonstrate?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Squad assembled, awaiting deployment.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Begin the operation at your own pace.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: No anomalies detected. Squad good to go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Target located. Move out.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Righto.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Awaiting your command.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Device, activate.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's get to work.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: It's over.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Your life is mine!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The best defense is a good offense.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: This isn't win or lose. This is life and death.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You handled that impressively. Hmph. Congratulations.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Perfect timing. We should get going.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'm willing to believe those escapees were on purpose.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't worry about me. Just make sure you get back okay.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'll leave the arrangements to you. I have no demands.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Don't touch my ears.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Is something bothering you? You can tell me.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I can think of a flashy Cautus who'll go out today to sing and dance, then pass out somewhere. Yeah… about time he crashed out. I'll go pick him up and then head off to sleep. See you around, Doctor. Happy New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Is there something you need?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here, salted edamame. What are you staring at? You think I shelled them just for you? I eat pre-shelled ones sometimes too, it's a different texture… Why am I still eating whole pods? Just force of habit. Eat yours. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I've saved up quite a bit of money this year. Since coming to Rhodes Island, Leon and I have more stable incomes. He hasn't mentioned it, but it's been a while since I got him anything. No point letting the money sit there. What should I buy? Doctor, do you have any suggestions?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: If you didn't have the time to get to all these files, why didn't you come ask me for help? I would've been more than glad.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Don't worry, there wouldn't be anything in it for me if I left Rhodes Island, at this point. You're free to get up to whatever it is you usually do, never mind the fact I'm here. And as recompense for your trust, I won't leak a single detail of your work. Now come on, chop-chop. I'm deathly concerned for you, what with that doorstopper of a document.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: 'Darling Rita.' I assume you're curious, if you bring it up? You know those certain few students who always leave their mark on you in your school years? I took quite a fancy to one of them—such an excellent soldier she turned out to be. Still, we have the space to keep out of each other's ways here, and that suits my fancy just as well.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Anything you'd like of me, Doctor of Rhodes Island? If it's in my power to deepen our bilateral trust, then I would be willing to stop gazing out at the window scenery, and focus a little instead on whatever it is that's vexing you.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Shame you're short on people with a shrewd eye for Londinium affairs—I was quite curious what they'd think of me. After all, a medical organization like Rhodes Island, unaffiliated with any nation, opting to work with us? Either you did it out of sheer idiocy, or if not, then you must've known a little too much.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: So what's your next step? Keep throwing yourself into the maelstrom of Victoria, or continue to build the peaceful paradise that Rhodes Island hopes for? The Leader once gave me a display of land torched to ash by her fires, and I'm ever so curious. If you had flames, what color would they be?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: 'Reed.' Such a darling codename—I can practically guess what was on her mind when she came up with it. Still, I'd be more the fool for claiming the prospect of a book club partner drove me here. She just happens to be somebody very useful, hence my need to protect her.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Just making a little bookside conversation, but... how do you regard the act of dancing? You know, when hands rest on collars, and gazes lock, and involuntary reactions let slip the true intentions of you or I—my my, your heart's hardly fluttering at all. No wonder The Leader's so interested in you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I've gone through the files on my desk. Not at all surprised Rhodes Island would be going after my true reasons for coming here. That said, you were kind enough to drop the papers off with me? You must not be planning to boot me out any time soon, let alone hand me off to a duke. So, what is it you want me to do for Rhodes Island, or perhaps, for you?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hm-hmm, time to paint my nails. What pattern shall we go with?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Pleased to meet you, and my codename is Harmonie. Here's a dossier on Victoria for Rhodes Island's perusal, as a gesture of goodwill. Don't umm and ahh about it, now—that's basic etiquette for when someone thanks you. May we get along smashingly in the days to come, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oh, what a splendid war command.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Ah, well, thank you very much. It's my honor to receive your endorsement.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: What you're doing here has me startlingly curious. What could you be up to, placing me in this position?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: What would you have me do for Rhodes Island?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I thank Rhodes Island for its trust.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I do hope none of you turn on the waterworks anytime soon.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Get yourselves ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Present.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Received.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Operation commencing.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: On your command.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Take a breath, go on. It's not as if I'm crushing your throat.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Stop flailing about, and do as I tell you.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Now now, close your eyes.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: This'll all be over before you're bored of it.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: If I hadn't seen the battle for myself, I just might have been shocked by your command style.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I'm sure if The Leader saw you now, she'd be delighted.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Oh, there's a rare sight. Maybe you have other things on your mind?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Right, what else can I do here?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Minimalistic, but not at all design-deficient. I have to laud your tastes.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Tut...! Ah. Was something the matter, Doctor? Do tell.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: If you're free, we could always chat about your bookshelf.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's a day worthy of celebration, and I'm here on a certain noble's behalf to gift you this. I will say, though, I've been watching this entire scene unfold, and it makes me think back to my student days, dancing with my classmates at whatever functions the school put on. Those were indeed times...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Dr. {@nickname}. Cup of tea?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I'm not here unprepared, let me say that. It'd be incredibly rude of me to have forgotten the date. I'm sure the typical gift-giving fare wouldn't have piqued your interest, so I have some choice pieces of intel I assume you'll like—if, of course, you're willing to believe me.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You really do seem to have the utmost confidence in the future you're cooking up. A paradise, is it? You starry-eyed people and I may only be together so long, but make no mistake, the way your endgame will pan out makes me very curious.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Time for a break, Doctor. Just how long have you been sitting at a table like that? Get up and go stretch out a little. Yes, I mean now.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: It is my duty to perform regular check-ups on Oripathy patients. Some are personable enough, but a few are hard to communicate with. It's not the first time, though, so worry not, they will understand how vital a doctor is to them.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You know what an amnesia patient should pay attention to, Doctor? Don't work yourself into the ground. Work and relaxation are equally important!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You always have patients who ignore the doctor's orders, but in battle, you don't see a doctor who'd miss a single cry for help.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The advancement of medicine is a lesson taught by none other than the cruelty of war and disasters, a lesson we medical workers learn through pain and suffering... But... It's a fact I figured out long ago. As long as I can help my patients get their lives back, I'm ready to face the fact.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Together we've spent some... uh, I mean, some most memorable moments! Come on, you know I'm not good at this, Doctor. And next time I see you put up that teasing face, I'd be real mad!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Here's a pen. How did I know you wanted it? Well, I've been working with you for a while now, isn't it natural I picked up on it?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm still far below the level of Silence and Shining, but that doesn't mean I can't overcome an obstacle when I see one before me. Otherwise, how can I measure up to your confidence in me?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The sun's good on the deck, and the wind's just fine… Mm? No, I'm not slacking off. It's just... I'm feeling swamped right now, like you occasionally do, Doctor. So, anything bothering you? Mm-hm, keep it as a whisper if it's easier for you this way. I'm listening.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Who came up with this meal plan? I'm having spasms in my stomach just by looking at the list!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Sussurro, Medic, reporting in with a little reminder for the Doctor. Now, I understand you have a lot on your plate, and even if they say a 'doctor' makes the worst patient, you need to follow our advice.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
