lines.text: I must make more copies of these battle notes for Myrrh and company.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion ceremony, while everyone stares at me? I don't have to make any embarrassing speeches, do I? No, no, I'm not nervous at all, really...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: For this promotion, I have the entire Medical Department to thank, who's been supporting me all the time with their hard work. And of course, thank you too, Doctor, for your guidance. I'm very, very grateful to you all!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Don't worry, I'll watch over them.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Hold everything! You must complete all pre-battle physical exams to deploy!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Attention, medics, make sure to follow all standard procedures in battle. Now, to your positions.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Safety first, and do not touch anything that may be suspicious or infected!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm over here!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Speak louder! It's hard to hear over the battle!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Medic's here! Here!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Anybody hurt?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't worry, you'll be okay in no time!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't concern yourself with fighting, you're still wounded!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Listen to the doctor!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Scream if you're in pain, don't hold it in!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Finally, the battle's over. You should take a break too. I imagine commanding the mission would take a toll on your body.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No casualty on our side. The Doctor's leadership is indeed unparalleled.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Will the enemy return? There are still wounded unable to move here.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Make way, make way! Stop crowding! Wounded coming through!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Promise you'll rest when it's time to, okay?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Um…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Phew. I need a drink after work! Mind handing me a juice, Doctor? Thanks!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. New Year's is a time for proper relaxation, and you can't overstress yourself. I know you'll be at the dining table soon, though, and you can't let yourself go too much. I remember how bad your indigestion was after you overate last year. I'll keep an eye on you this time!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How do you do, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I made you a cylinder cake—they seem popular lately. You don't need to hide it, I figured you'd be rolling in cakes today long beforehand... Anyway, don't eat too much, whatever you do! Watch your sugar intake!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I don't know how much longer life will carry on like this. Sometimes I even feel like I can't make out the future ahead, but if it even gets to us medics, how much worse must it be for our patients, waiting for us to treat them? I'm sure we'll see the light of dawn one day, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Stay sharp. Focus, finish your work. If everyone could just get their own work done, it might as well not help at all, but it's not going to make anything worse either. Lecturing? Who am I to lecture you, I'm just... reminding myself.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Whatever it is you want, it can wait until I get my hands on Mostima! It has to be that damn idiot who spiked my finballs with chili! Get to the side and make sure you stay there, this day's not done until I put a bolt in her—

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I tried using guns before, but it didn't pan out, so I gave up. What, are you surprised? Guns aren't some huge mystery, but they need practice... and maybe you practice until you're smooth, or you blow yourself up in a burst.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: If it's deemed necessary, taking measures to block intel leakage is part of my work. ...Hey, stop staring at my back! Those idiots at the Notarial stuck those wing stickers there, they're not coming off! *cough* Anyway, don't count on me telling you anything. Keeping secrets is my job.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Too much curiosity's never good. That goes for Lemuen's sister, and it goes for you too, Doctor. Am I worried about you? ...Hardly. I'm just tasked with making sure *someone* doesn't leak secrets or make trouble, and anything else is beyond my care.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've been to plenty of nations before. It's not like nowhere moves me more than Laterano, but I'm all too clear about what I have to do right now. I've got no intent of letting anybody harm this city of Laterano. There's no more answers I need to seek from anyone.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: ...Don't call me 'Suffering.' And don't call me 'Chosen Overseer' or 'Flaming Envoy' either! That's it, no matter what that Mostima-on-low told you, I want you to forget all of it right now! Immediately! On the double!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Thanks to a certain *someone*, I couldn't be more familiar with all the food streets around. I seriously don't know what's so good about this place. See the shooting gallery at the entrance? I could hit their targets from the roof of the skyscraper opposite. You want me to bring you along next time? ...I'll consider it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Can people really cut everything loose without looking back, even shatter the order that was there, all to chase ideals? That's a dedication that... I can comprehend, but can't identify with. I know you all have your own beliefs at Rhodes Island, too. Here's hoping we don't come into direct conflict one day, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Beats me how you sleep while standing up... and you even look pretty normal. It's a cut above everyone back then who sneaked naps in class.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: My duty's to monitor Mostima, so I'll be acting alongside her here, if you don't mind. You need a codename? ...Just call me Fiammetta. I've had enough of those codenames my bosses keep giving me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Keeping battle records is a pretty good habit.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Let me get this out of the way—this is my chance to use my own name, and you *cannot* give me any more weird job titles.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Laterano code says whoever breaks it, pays for it, but reasonable loss of property in missions can be expensed. You order my actions, thus compensation fees naturally land with you too... what? You can't be regretting it now.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Less dawdling, come on.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Fine. But I'm not waiting for anyone who falls behind.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We're heading up. It'll be faster by rooftop.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't make too big of a show.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Sights locked.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Boring.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I only do what I need to.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: What, you've got time to take in the sights?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Anyone in front of me who still feels like blinking?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Sorry, forgot to hold that back.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I don't like damage—unless it's necessary.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: There's no fluking between success and failure.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You did a better job than I imagined. The feeling of fighting in a squad... it's been a long time.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete. Look, this much is granted—don't make a fuss over nothing.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: If you're fine, we're fine. If something happened to you while I was on the job, I know *someone* would be laughing at me.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Sorry, I was careless this time. I'll remedy it somehow.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Ventilation's fine, visibility's excellent. Good, that's conducive to getting my work done.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Don't touch that. It'll explode.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor... is that your job title? How normal. How nice.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Ever since I took on the task of monitoring Mostima, I've hardly gotten the chance to stop anywhere for long. I adapted to the runabout lifestyle a while ago, but having somewhere I can just take a breather on a day like this, it's nice. Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Same old, then?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: About that food street I mentioned. You wanna go check it out? I've never seen you use a firearm before, so we can just play by the rules at that shooting gallery. You want to see me hit their targets from the roof of a skyscraper? Ugh, I shouldn't have told you that... Fine, today's your birthday. Special exception!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: 'Fluffy Top Buns?' Mostima you little... There was this Sankta kid who didn't know Liberi have ear plumage, so he thought my hair was— you know, buns. And thanks to another superior of mine playing eavesdropper, I got saddled with the name for a full month! No, you're NOT allowed to laugh!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hello, Doctor, I'm on duty today... Oh, sorry, my blade got stuck in the doorframe…

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Back home, the soil goes more and more barren every day, and we don't harvest enough to feed ourselves. Most people can't make a living, so they have to become mercenaries to survive. They'll do anything, as long as it pays.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: They said my blade was too dangerous and wouldn't let me into the kitchen. I just wanted to help, but as soon as I tapped that cutting board with my blade, it split in two... Umm... should I pay for it?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Every time I bask in the sun, I can't help but get a bit sleepy. But don't worry, I'm on guard... Keeping you safe... I won't fall... asleep... ZZZzzzzz…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I have standards in my line of work: Don't harm the innocent, don't get bystandars involved… To be honest, it's hard to stick to them…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm lending you this necklace, take good care of it. It's a protective charm. No, I can't give you my blade. Just remember to keep the charm with you when I'm not around.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, I need you to look me in the eye, and don't move. Come on, hold still... Hmm… Good, you're not the type to use people for evil. I can tell.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Honestly, I don't remember much from when I was little. My teacher raised me, and taught me to use a blade. He told me my parents got mixed up in a fight that got them killed. When he found me, I was clutching this blade and wouldn't let it go, even as it dug into me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: She who wields a blade will always look to duel, and she who takes a life will eventually become a notch on the blade of another. Maybe one day, I'll meet an end like that... When that happens, Doctor, I hope you'll be there to witness it.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'll stand guard. You can rest easy.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Cutter. Just an ordinary mercenary. I have Oripathy, so I'm looking to trade my skills for treatment. Hope this blade's good enough to get things done for you... Yeah, that's about it.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Nice moves! Didn't know you could use a blade like that.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Freedom's the only treasure I have, besides my blade. If you're willing to protect it, I'll listen to you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: A mercenary's blade isn't a toy that never sees bloodshed, it feeds on it. Maybe one day, I won't be able to control it anymore. But don't worry, at least for now... it works for you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got it. Joining the team.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Understood. Can I select my own teammates?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Be ready. And make sure you don't get any innocents involved.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Your blades all sharp?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I can wait.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: The battlefield is a graveyard.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: All I need to do is wield my blade.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Quiet.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't look back.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Look me in the eye.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You're too slow.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Maybe one day, there'll be something my blade can't cut. But that day isn't today, and it certainly isn't these guys.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew... All done, just as specified in the contract. Need to take a look?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They've lost their will to fight. Not my targets anymore.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Go, Doctor, go as far as you can! I'll... hold them back.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: My sunny spot… Ahh, so warm…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Uhh, don't pull on my ears.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Wanna go sunbathing together?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: To a happy and healthy New Year. Mm, gotta live your best life every day, and get plenty of sunshine. Basically, I'll try to keep looking out for you, within my means anyway. Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, you're here, Doctor. Got any work today?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I got this cake while I was out on a field mission a week ago. I did really wanna make it myself, but I don't have the right to use the kitchen just yet... I'll keep fighting hard, so I can treat you to a cake I made myself next year.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I want to be a principled merc, but it's actually hard to do it alone. Just like a ship without a point of reference, you get lost real easy. But here at Rhodes Island, I can rest easy. I can trust I'm doing the right thing.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Any work today? If it's nothing urgent, let's put it off till later.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: My Arts detect nearby creatures, and this auxiliary device even amplifies the ability. Sounds great, right? That's why the Garrison Team sent me to patrol the city, in case any students were trying to climb the walls and skip school. I gotta admit, they sure know how to put people to work.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Just for the record, the so-called secret of Laterano or whatever? I don't know a single thing about it. I'm just after the easy life. The less I know, the better off I'll be, don't you think?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hmm? Isn't that guy over there from the Notarial Hall...? What? He wants to make sure I'm 'fulfilling my obligations?' Dear Lord! I pay my taxes on time every month, okay? Anyway, just give me a whisper if he's looking for me. I need time to run and hide.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I was really bored, so I went down to the bridge to chill out… Err, I mean, I wanted to enjoy the scenery. But everybody was looking at me like I was there to assassinate somebody. Man, they really take me for a killer? As if I'd ever want a job like that. Way too much trouble.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My old brass would always drone on about 'defending the glory of Laterano with your life' and blah blah blah. But that kind of stuff is so boring. I hated how dead-end my life was back then. Working with Rhodes Island is way better. You give me something more practical.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: My hair's a little messy? Meh, I forgot to deal with my bed head. It's not like I have a mission today... Aww, this sucks... Can you tell me if my braid is crooked? It feels kinda weird. You really oughta have a mirror in your office, you know.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Here, I got you a cake. So, what do you usually do during your breaks? You really should take a lap around the city, get yourself some fresh air, don't you think? If you're worried about your safety, just grab an operator who can go 'pow pow' on any baddies who pop up, and you're set.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Wanna watch a movie? We're almost done with work anyway. How about... this romance about a princess and a wanderer from afar? Wait, I need to hang up my do-not-disturb sign. Wouldn't want someone walking in with a pile of documents.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Break time. Now, what should I do...?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ambriel, sniper, from Laterano… Alright, that's introductions out of the way before they give me a headache. Here, I just opened this pack of chocolate pretzel sticks. Want one?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Man, how long is this video…? Is there no option to play all of them at once?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Much obliged. Oh, speaking of which, do these promotions come with a salary increase? There's something I've been looking at…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you very much. I've been with Rhodes Island for a while now, right? Before I knew it, I'd gotten a whole lot out of this, and made some good memories too.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Woah, my teammates look pretty capable this time.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just a heads-up for you, my tactics are a little unorthodox.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Ready? Let's get going.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I hope we can wrap this mission up before dinner.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Let me finish this choco stick first.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Sniper platform, deploying~

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Auto-calibration in progress.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: There you are.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Well, well, well, somebody's no good at hiding.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Wide-open spaces are dangerous, y'know.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'll send you home.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You always win big like this, Doctor. You're really something!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Not a single shot wasted - perfect.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Not the prettiest victory, but a win's a win, right?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The number of targets is still increasing, and they're about to launch an attack. Doctor, let's get out of here...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Doctor! Time to restock the pretzel sticks in the vending machine!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I hear some new clothes came into the store? Doctor, come check 'em out with me!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Huh? You're goofing off here too? Alright then, come take a seat. I feel kinda peaceful, sitting on the bridge, watching the busy people run all over the deck. But why is it so empty today? Kinda straaange... Wait a second! Today is New Year's?!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Yo.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, got this for you. 'Cheez-Pack'd Butter Flavor Cheese Snaps.' It's a limited-edition, definitely not my extras—okay, I admit it. I bought a little too much. Soooo my savings are dry. Anyway, why don't we hit the streets together next time? I'll make it up to you with something good when we do.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You want to know what I've found at Rhodes Island that's so 'practical'? Um, obviously, seeing a different sunset on the bridge every day, and the feeling of using this gun to do something good. Pretty cool, yeah? Just kidding. Alright, let's forget all this complicated stuff. I'm gonna nab some pudding from the canteen!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Yes, I'll protect the Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I can sit down? No... I'm a bodyguard. As a bodyguard, I have to stay vigilant and keep close to my principal... Am I... perhaps being a bother, standing here?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Spot? I've met him before... No, actually, when my unit passed through the city he was stationed in, he gave me a hand. He probably doesn't remember. It's fine.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: (I'm not sure what the Doctor is doing, but it looks incredible...) Eh? Uh... I-I didn't say anything. Must've been the wind, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, you mentioned these just a second ago, so I went and fetched them for you. Umm... I hope I didn't overstep?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, I'm so sorry. I rushed in alone again on that last mission... I saw someone was wounded, and it felt like the blood surged straight to my head. I forgot your orders and charged on in. I didn't do it on purpose. P-Please don't hate me..

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Umm, Doctor, were you looking for me...? No, I'm not avoiding you, and I definitely don't hate you... It's just that... Sorry, I'm not sure how to put it into words…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When I was serving in the Sargonian army, everyone hated me, except for one woman. She was kind to me, and we became best friends. But... in the end... she betrayed me. Doctor, I'm lost. How can I bring myself to trust anyone ever again?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: (The Doctor is so kind, speaking so nicely to me, even though I'm such an unlikable whelp. I should be able to trust the Doctor, right?) Oh, Doctor, I'm listening. Yes, you're still my ever-dependable Doctor. The Doctor's enemies are my enemies!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: (I think I'd like to sneak a peek… at the Doctor's sleeping face.)

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: (This one looks kind enough, but will this Doctor be as easy to get along with as Amiya says...?) Ah, excuse me, I'm sorry, I-I was spacing out. Operator, codename Heavyrain, reporting in.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Yes, I should be able to reach this level too.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: (Amiya is here too. Am I getting fired...?) Eh? I'm getting promoted?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, is it okay if I don't get promoted...? No, everyone is being so kind... I'm a little scared...

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: By your command.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll do my best.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: (I mustn't betray the Doctor's high hopes...)

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Incoming!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor, your orders, please?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Okay.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Right here will do.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Die.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Out of the way!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You're in the way!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hmph!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, did I do okay?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, I can still fight.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, let me go after them.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, I'll cover you from the rear!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rhodes Island is so big...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ehhh?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor?! Please don't scare me...!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New Year. Since I came to Rhodes Island, you have cared much for me, but you've never expressed gratitude to me. So today, at the very least, I want to sincerely thank you. (Th-There, I said it! I… I didn't mess up, did I?)

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, can I assist you in any way?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: (The Doctor is so popular. Would someone of such stature really need a gift from a girl like me…? But I really do want to give one…) Oh, what am I holding? Well, um, it's a gift. Please, accept it! Happy birthday!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: (They're all surrounding the Doctor. That is to be expected, considering the Doctor's popularity… Oh, the Doctor is waving at me. Is there something behind me? Huh, the Doctor is coming over…) Oh, should I join in the festivities…? Alright.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Look carefully. Sort the files by type, then deadline and prioritization. Put urgent ones on top, others behind. That's the most efficient organization method. Wait... I seem to have inadvertently done all the paperwork. This was supposed to be your job, right?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I've checked all files related to the elite operator, Blaze. There are no records of her real name, or place and date of birth. Don't tell me you don't know. Aren't you supposed to be one of the leaders here? You really have no idea? How...? What am I supposed to do here...? Ahem, I apologize for the inconvenience and distress, Doctor. I shouldn't have accused you.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You don't need to be so cautious around me. Other than the case at hand, I'll treat everything else on the ship as if it never happened. But if there is another explosion in the corridor outside my room, I'll make the perpetrator's hair stand on end for two straight weeks!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: 'Assume the responsibilities for the post to which you are assigned.' Doctor, as one of the leaders of Rhodes Island, it is not your duty to... Huh? My hair's standing up again? Hold on! G-Give me a moment to fix my look first! Strange, I thought I had discharged all the static electricity this morning...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Even today, I can vaguely recall the first time I saw you in Lungmen. You, Blaze, and Ch'en... are all holding onto countless secrets... and I will uncover them one by one. It's only fair to exchange secrets? Wha-What? You... No! It's t-too early for that...!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Ask me anything. Only when you speak up can I decide what is just and unjust, and whether I wish to take action. I need to take my position into consideration? This has nothing to do with that. The Censorate, Judicial Review Office, Department of Discipline and Supervision... They are nothing but institutions. Law is only proven just when enforced by man.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island's ideals conflict with my beliefs. However, I do recognize the necessity of agreeing to disagree while seeking common ground... So goes the necessity of providing assistance in exchange for information.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: No matter where I am, the electricity flowing through my body never ceases. The thunderlight is a symbol of justice. It drives me forward, sometimes even waking me up at night... Hm? There's another complaint that I've damaged an AC unit? Nonsense! Lies and slander! I don't even need to use a remote to turn on the AC, let alone touch it!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Blaze was implicated in a major case. All evidence has been deliberately destroyed. However, there remain a few 'coincidences' surrounding persons and times. Not many, but enough to raise doubts, and enough for me to suspect connections between several different cases. This has nothing to do with you, but you should take adequate precaution. All I can do is offer you a fair warning.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You can't even properly manage your physical condition. How lax and irresponsible! Sprawling on desk like this, were you expecting me to put a blanket over you? There won't be a next time.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I've signed and obtained an investigation authorization with your company. Don't worry, this is me acting solely as an individual. You may call me Leizi, if you wish. Who am I? Have we met before? Are you serious?!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I see, this is a completely different principle from military training.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? I suppose this is how you handle career advancement? The promotion process at Rhodes Island seems to differ from that of common private companies…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I, Leizi, am the bearer of the thunderlight and the law, the vision and reach of Great Yan. My philosophy does not align with that of Rhodes Island, and I have no intention of bridging the gap between the Infected and non-Infected. However, we may now fight side by side against our enemies!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: With my own eyes, I shall judge what power Rhodes Island possesses.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I can do that, yes, albeit at a price.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Heed my orders!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I have no interest in the identity of my enemy.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: In place.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: It may be done.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: As you command.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hark! The thunder rumbles!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: O great thunderlight, strike!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: No mercy for transgression! Lightning shall judge!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Pure thunder calls down justice! Shatter all falsehoods in all realms!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: The essence of Lei Fa... is my will becoming one with this great land.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Well done. As my standards are quite high, you should be proud of yourself.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Not enough. You can do even better. Do not rest upon your laurels—you have the ability to strive for greater heights.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Impossible... what happened? How can this be?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Such humiliation...! Begone, you! Return and reflect! I will hold back the enemies, leave!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Where's the power socket?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: How rude!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh... did that hurt? Please be mindful of the static electricity around me.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: A year's planning is done in the spring—and though it may not be spring yet, do you simply plan to idly loaf around at a new year's outset? You should still sharpen yourself on holiday. As the saying goes, the man who catches fins for one day then rests for two, will find himself slothful with dust on his shoe. Hm...? Two, four, six, eight... Hey! If you keep slacking I'll have finished annotating these documents myself!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Work dutifully, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Ahem. Judicial Review Office Censor Leizi expresses good wishes on the Dr.{@nickname}'s birthday. May your life be ever warm as spring, and of peace and prosperity... Heeeey, I'm being serious here! Don't laugh!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: With the mystery I'm investigating still an open question, I cannot unreservedly trust Rhodes Island. However, in my days lodging here, I've witnessed physicians benevolent and adroit, warriors heroic and unyielding. Even if our beliefs differ, I still have considerable respect for your investments and efforts.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, we can't waste even one single precious minute! One minute could mean a loss of millions on the account with extra casualties on the field! Huh? Coffee? I take it with a sachet of sugar and heavy on the milk foam, thanks!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: They say Rhodes Island is a criminal organization, full of Infected people dirtying up the corridors. But that couldn't be further from the truth. Rhodes Island's Operators are giving their lives to make things better for everyone, just like the police force of Lungmen!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hear me out, do you think we could redesign the instructors' office? At least add a bit of flavor to it, maybe a handmade rug or some atomistic art whatnot. It's just so bland now. Dobermann might say she doesn't care, but it really kills my enthusiasm...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Ahhh, that awful Ch'en isn't here, is she? Back when we were in the L.G.D. together, she shot me this dirty look every time we bumped into each other. It made me wonder if I've done anything bad! I just... kinda want to take over the L.G.D. myself. That couldn't be bad, right?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Exercise, study, training, researching my competitors and market shifts... Gotta keep them up!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've been allowed to set aside the family business for a while. But it's clear to me that the future of Lungmen needs both a stable public sector and security apparatus, as well as a healthy business and financial system. In both respects, I'm ready to be of service to Lungmen!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Lungmen bureaucracy is complicated, even for us. Keeping the peace, protecting the people, directing traffic, negotiating trade... Agh, it's absolutely backbreaking. But as long as what we do is good for Lungmen, I'll be—hehe—very pleased.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, why is Rhodes Island's training course so short...? Insufficient capital? Unacceptable, I'm requesting an immediate transfer to the business division! It's-it's not as if I like business, but if you need me to do it, I'm... more than capable!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You know, Doctor, Lungmen could use someone as talented as you. So, well... If you're not enjoying this line of work, there's plenty of opportunities in the banking and management sectors! I-I can get you a job! Oh? You'd rather we work with Rhodes Island? ...Fine!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Uughh... I'm exhausted... Two shifts in a row really does... zzz... zzz...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Swire, Senior Superintendent of the L.G.D.. I'll be joining Rhodes Island as a training consultant. Dr. {@nickname}, I'm looking forward to working together with you for the future of Lungmen!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm, as far as tactical theory goes, this is a decent application!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Hmm? But it doesn't do anything for me back in Lungmen, does it? Well, if you insist, I suppose I will accept it!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Maybe it's that you want me to improve your relationship with Lungmen. Or, possibly, you truly need my talents. I suppose it could be something else you want, too... I'm not sure exactly what, and I can't promise it'll be on offer. But I'll be a stalwart with you to the end.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Aha~! You finally need my wisdom!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everyone, follow my orders to the letter!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Wipe them out in one fell swoop! It's cheaper that way!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let's finish this quickly. My time is far too precious!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I've seen through the enemy's strategies!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This is far from my only battlefield!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Business competitor or not, you will get a lesson from me!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Time is money!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hurry it up, let's move!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Lungmen has its own pride!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Time to liquidate!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Fantastic! In battle as in business: high risk, high return!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Capital is all mergers and acquisitions! Victory is like investigation and arrest!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: ...Bad... just bad... You can do better, can't you? We'll work it out together. Don't give up!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: How could this have happened? How could I... How could I have blundered so badly?!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Not bad... No, I think this room could use some more renovation!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ah! How rude of you!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: How... How about we go for dinner together? M-my treat!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! Look at this crowd! So many people here! I brought some Lungmen street food with me... I-I didn't bring it for you guys! I wanted to have some myself! Right, if Ch'en has any, make sure she pays for her share. Call it a handling fee.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, roar!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Look at you always wearing that outfit. You gotta at least change your shoes sometimes. Here, look what I've brought for you. Dark, flat, no design sensibility whatsoever. The brand I usually wear just got a bunch of new styles, and I picked out a few pairs for you based on your tastes. But looking like that, nobody will be able to tell they're luxury branded! What a waste!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I went against my grandfather's wishes by becoming a cop, but I believe it was the right choice for me, not that it's easy. This isn't just to take control of my own life. More than that, it's for Lungmen's future. Hey, don't think Ch'en's the only one who thinks about this stuff. Just like her, I have much to do in the future.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm? Ah, this handful of soil... it can murmur. It can dance. It is my friend.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Closure told me I shouldn't walk about Rhodes Island 'fully equipped'... but I'm not used to... revealing... myself. Sorry...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Thank-you letters? Ah, from the Sarkaz workers yesterday? My equipment and type of Arts are a good match for physical work. Besides, their materials and fuel are heavy. And they rely on flesh and blood power to ensure Rhodes Island sails smooth... it's incredible.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: That elite operator... I thought the Arts I saw in Leithanien were already really fantastical. And yet, when I saw him just brush aside the mist, I realized, as a Sarkaz, he was young, but also ancient.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I often think of the fighters, the friends who have left us. Sometimes, I get lost in the idea that even now, I'm still fleeing... Doctor, have you been to Kazdel? That place... was the start of my journey, and once, I thought it would be my... end.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, huh...? I'm surprised, but she's very reassuring... One thing, though. Rhodes Island seems to have some involvement with another mercenary group. Could you tell me about them, Doctor? It's best I don't know? I see... then I think I can guess who we're talking about.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I became a Rhodes Island Operator to see my people treated well, to see them live on, and to give my fighters' deaths... real meaning. But... since coming to Rhodes Island, I've seen clearly what I, myself, am truly fighting for. That was a first for me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Me... talking to a clay doll... all alone...? Y-You... you saw me? That was just a little ritual… huh? So everyone already knew? R-Really? Then I'll be more careful next time, do it late when no one's around... um, I shouldn't?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: From Kazdel to Leithanien, so many marks carved into suffering. The moment they had no choice but to fight, and realized they had nothing at all. How do you see me, Doctor? You trust me? Will that trust... let me live on?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: ...The one in the hood napping there is the Doctor. Remember that well. Our road together is sure to be a long one.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Sarkaz mercenary, Mudrock... You're the Doctor, then. Rhodes Island has saved me many times, and now, I'd like you to let me return the favor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I've had a taste of how Rhodes Island fights before, but, well, this still makes a great reference...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: They used to call me Reunion, and then the Mudrock Squad, and now... I've been promoted by my former enemy. Is this what they meant by 'life is a highway'?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Hm? A nice change of pace? I never take my helmet off in battle, after all... There's a lot of reasons why, but things have changed now. K... Keep it off? If I have to…

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm a Rhodes Island Operator, now. I'll obey your commands.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm captain…? I don't like to lead, but… I'm used to it.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: It's time to fight.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The enemy…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: The soil answers my will.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Orders please. The rocks are listening.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: War… war never changes.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Fight for yourself.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The land is as my friend.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Rise into mountains.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Heed my call.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Arise, great boulder.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Running is pointless... Resist, even if you lost the will. This is the only way I've learned to face suffering.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: My friends are quietly celebrating. They're cheering for our victory, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Chase them... I'll watch over the battlefield with my friends' eyes.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: This isn't the first time I've turned and run from an enemy. If this is how we save lives... I'll cover your backs.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The ceiling's... a little lower than I imagined.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: ...Mm? Did you touch me just now?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor? Could you stay with me for a bit? I'd like... to ask you a little about Kazdel. Ah, and my friends have missed you, too.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The New Year? I see. Another year has passed. I... never liked days like this before, the whole idea of 'out with the old, in with the new.' What we lost has always left a much deeper impression than what we gained, but maybe things are slightly different now. Mm—may I join in on the dinner party? Doctor?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. This is for you. Ah, it's a stone sculpture of my making, not a 'friend'. 'Friends' can't be given away as presents. You like it? I could teach you, sometime, to talk to my friends. Are you interested?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: In the beginning, all I wanted was to survive. But before I knew it, I'd shouldered the responsibility for leading my people. I want to find myself, and my people, a home. Doctor, should I keep walking with Rhodes Island, will I be able to?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Sorting files? Whoa, I've suddenly gotten this headache. I can't take it, I need a break. Well, keep at it, Doctor. Such little paperwork should be a walk in the park for you, right?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: A job? Of course, I'm all ears. Or maybe you'd like something a little spicier than detective work? Some wet work? Haha, just pulling your leg. We don't do that sort of thing. We're fine, upstanding citizens running a legitimate business.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Having Waai Fu and Hung around to keep an eye on that Aak boy really saves me a broken back. I'll admit, it's shameful, but I started out babysitting these kids, and now they're all taking care of me. Kids these days do more than we did when I was young, and that's great.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It's thanks to your patronage that the agency is still running smoothly, give or take. Lungmen's a place with the human touch—live there long enough, and sooner or later you'll know a crowd, find the right connections. We don't like spilling blood in our line of work—always best to solve things friendly.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: How do you like it, Dr. {@nickname}? Jaye makes mean finballs, doesn't he? Old Tung taught that boy his trade and his way of treating people. It all combines for a flavor unique to Lungmen. Come on, have a try. It'll warm you up.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Under this heading, you had the third row on the left here wrong, so I patched that up, no need for thanks. Oh, do I come off very fluent? Not at all, this is still my first time accounting on a scale so small outside of the agency. Things used to be very—ah, I'm getting distracted, don't you mind.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Why are the lights all on at this hour... oh? Ah, Dr. {@nickname}. Are you still processing battle records? Well, I never thought you were such a workaholic. I'm impressed. But! You'd better turn in sooner. It's not worth it to break your body doing it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Everyone's chasing fame and profit. But after so many winning and losing, how many people get to end up as what they like? Living a decent little life of your own is sometimes a lot to ask for. Ah, what are we all doom and gloom for? I'll go stir-fry something up, so you wait for me, Dr. {@nickname}. A drink together would be even better, don't you think?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My hexagram says to avoid going out, so I'll pass on this mission today... what, I can't? I have to go, no two ways about it? Hah, I see. Then this is a special exception, once only! I'm lending you a hand, so dinner's on you tonight! Look, I'm all decided! This is the joint!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Why a busy life when you can have a leisurely cup of tea. *gulp* Dr. {@nickname}, you do keep some good tea leaves here.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, hello there, you must be the Dr. {@nickname}? You've been looking after my employees for me. They haven't made trouble for you, have they? Oh, that reminds me, here's a card for my agency. Take it, go ahead.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: How about a quick scrap? No, no, I'm just joking. I'm no good in a fight.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion...? There's a first for me. Feels quite fresh, too. I think times like these call for some magic words—thank you very much, boss?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Life goes by in a flash. If you're always jostling for the lead, when do you stop to smell the roses? Don't think too hard about things. Enjoy the moment. No matter how paranoid you are, it'll happen if it's going to happen. And you've dealt with it, all's right with the world.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Do I have to come along too? *Sigh*... fine, fine. Let's get going.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Good. Follow my instructions closely, then. Alright, everyone, dismissed—wait, hold it, don't head off for real! I was joking! Joking!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: It's like we're on a school trip here, eh?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Fortune favors the bold, but you still need a few tricks up your sleeves to win the battle.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm sure you can sort them... wait, hold it. Am I up now?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: There, there. Put your worries to rest. I'm right here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Hello, friends, what are we talking about?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Time for a little telling off. But not too harshly.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Come on, man. Friendliness is good for business.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hey, buddy! Calm it down! You nearly spilled my tea!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: My friends, I implore you to reconsider-- Is there REALLY no room for negotiation here?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: *Grumble* I told you. Don't get so worked up.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: My thanks. It couldn't have happened without you, Dr. {@nickname}... I owe you for this one. I won't forget.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Well done, Dr. {@nickname}. What, where was I just now? Well, given your capability, it was better for me to be your moral support. Cheered the whole time, you see.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Now, now, hold it! Do not press an enemy at bay. Let them run free.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Risky, risky. There's a terrifying fortune to get. Thank goodness we run fast.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}? Here, take this. Decorate your room with it. Ah, but not at the head of your bed. What does it do? Haha, now that would be telling.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I'm sure we can talk this out, nice and easy. No need for physical contact, right?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: No smoking here? But this isn't a cigarette, it's white stick candy. You don't believe me? Go on, try some.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I'm getting old here—I nearly forgot it was a holiday today. So, how about an auspicious word or two from your partner? Here's to Rhodes Island business thriving and—erm, no, that's not right for the occasion. One more try. Ahem, 'May our health be rude, and our pillboxes grow dusty,' there we go, stay safe and all's well, Doctor. Hope your New Year is hale and hearty.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Welcome to Lee's Detective Agency, do you have any work... Well if it isn't Dr. {@nickname}!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Eh? How did I know it was today? Haha, how could I forget? You're one of my biggest clients, a little human touch is the least I could... Okay, okay, no more jokes, Dr.{@nickname}. Go ahead, please, accept this meager token. Friendship is friendship, and we're past all that other stuff.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: 'Boiled cactus', 'Over the Lung Gate', and 'Boat of a Reed'. It's hard to make these dishes any other time of year, but I present them to you today. You know, Doctor, people can't strain their minds all the time, and it's necessary to let go every now and then. You've been working for all of us, and for that, you deserve some real praise, Doctor. Thank you for what you have done.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, do you need my help transporting anything?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This noisy metal music… Exusiai must be throwing another party. Doctor, should I go nudge her?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm quite good with manual labor. I also know a bit about company management. So, Doctor, is there anywhere I can be of use?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My parents were the first generation to settle in Lungmen, so I'm actually a Lungmen native… Doctor, if there's anything you'd like to know about the place, I wouldn't mind helping you out.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, if you want to know how a real logistics company operates, it'd be best to just ask me directly. Penguin Logistics is more of an exception than the rule, and though I don't mean this in a bad way, they won't make for a good reference at all.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: What do I like to do outside of work? Besides just resting, I'll sometimes go with Croissant on her shopping trips, help her carry stuff, and make sure she doesn't waste too much money… Want to join us, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I used to believe that for any company to survive in the long run, standardization and efficiency were critically important. That's why at first, I couldn't fathom how a company like Penguin Logistics could stay afloat.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: After getting to know more about the people at Penguin Logistics and talking to them, I began to understand that the world is much broader than I had thought. There's nothing wrong with structure and rules, but they don't necessarily apply to everyone.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, perhaps you haven't realized this yourself, but to unite such a diverse group of people under your banner, that's no simple feat… It'd be great if I could become more like you one day.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor… Oh, it's your nap time. Guess I'll tidy up this place for now.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Pleased to meet you, Doctor. My name is Bison. According to the terms of our contract, I'm now also an employee of Rhodes Island. I look forward to working with you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you very much. I will make sure to learn from this.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you very much, Doctor. I believe that as long as I put my best foot forward, my hard work will be rewarded.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: With Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, I've seen a more expansive world than I knew… Doctor, one day, I will also find my place in this world.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: A mission? Understood.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: On-site command… I have some experience with that.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Yes, I've noted the mission location and objectives.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Phew… I'll get my job done.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What would you like me to do?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Is it my turn, Doctor?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll do my best.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'll hold my ground.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hang in there a bit longer? Understood.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Don't worry, my shield still holds firm.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Way to go, Doctor! You're the kind of leader any company would want to hire.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Wow, Doctor! You really are amazing.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The basic objectives of the mission have been accomplished. This should be good enough, right?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't feel down, Doctor. We'll have another chance.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: So this is the inside of Rhodes Island… It sure is big.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Where should I go?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Sora's new album is really good.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's New Year's, so on behalf of MountainDash Logistics, I'm sending formal greetings to Rhodes Island. May everything go well for Rhodes Island's employees, and may you be safe and sound in the coming year. Also, here's a personal card from me to you, Doctor, to wish you a Happy New Year. To another great year working together.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. Please try this bowl of long life noodles. All ingredients have been chosen with care. It has wheat from Yan, steak from Ursus, and the broth is Iberian ham. It took me months to put together, and it was still a rush to get everything in on time. I hope you like it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: My father says the most precious thing to a business is pulling everyone together under the same ideal. At Penguin Logistics and Rhodes Island, I've seen that cohesion for myself. I have to learn from yours and Emperor's examples, in that regard.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'll be quietly modifying the Raythean Franker over here. You can focus on your work. I won't disturb you.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Why does everyone always keep their distance from Blue Poison? I don't get it... She and I are both special? Umm, alright.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Anything you want to say, Doctor? No? Okay. I'll be here. You can chat with me anytime.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I always lose my appetite when the dorm is too hot... Oh, don't worry about it. It's a family thing, I'm not actually complaining.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Why did I come to Rhodes Island? If I could run as I pleased on these legs, I wouldn't have left my homeland.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Vulcan and I have a similar distaste for 'old things,' but I still think we have fundamentally different philosophies.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: So, Doctor, Blue Poison says I always seem to be hiding something. Do I really give people that impression? Sometimes? How…?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: It's not that I don't want to talk, it's just that I never got my way much before. So I'm not used to speaking up. Hope you won't take it the wrong way, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Two memories stand out to me. One is the first time I ran with this exoskeleton. My eyes went wide and all was right with the world. As for the other... That would have to be right here, right now at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Umm? When did the Doctor fall asleep...?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Operator Glaucus reporting for onboarding. So… may I go back to my room now?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm… Okay, I see. I got it now.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I named the weapon, actually. Maybe it represents what I really want in life... Huh? Did they just announce my name for promotion?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Trust in others… Well, I don't know what to do to make them feel trusted, but I'll keep trying.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Everyone, remember your grounding measures.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What? I'm the captain? Did I sign up without realizing it?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I wonder what interesting things we'll find this time…

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: EMP, ready to fire.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hm? You call for me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Fully charged and ready to go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: The feeling of standing on dry land…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Landed, safe and sound.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Maximum output!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Can't worry about accidents now…!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Amplifying microwave frequency!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Time to fall!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No hostile movement detected. Please check your status, team.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No active enemy signals. EMP disabled. Nice work, team.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Some enemies have escaped. Should we give chase?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: EMP disabled. We'd better call for backup quick.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: No problem, just need to find that screw first…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh… sorry, my mind was wandering.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Mind taking a walk with me, Doctor?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New Year. Present? I haven't thought about it... Oh, actually, I've been hoping to get a fair allowance for battle damage... but I've never had the guts to raise it with Dr. Kal'tsit.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I have a compass here from my collection. It's for you. Technology keeps marching on, but some stuff still keeps a classic form factor. Isn't that wonderful...? Oh, sorry, I got a little off-track. Anyway, may you never lose your way, on your forward course.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Being able to run again is such a blessing—I'll never forget what Rhodes Island has done for me. Now I want to help everyone by my own power too, but it still seems like I get in the way more than anything... I'll keep on trying, though. So that someday, I really can be of help to you all.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's just document sorting, right? Please, I do this stuff all the time, piece o' cake.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, come on, check out my new video. You're gonna love it.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Yeah, that's the icon. Mind giving it a click? Oh, and if it's not too much trouble, maybe the one right beside it too? Hehe, thanks a bunch.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Content! Ideas! Memes! My brain's completely blank! I'm gonna lose subs…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm just an amateur explorer, you know. I just plan to take a few shots and then come right back, so I won't be gone for long. Besides, nothing beats chilling at home sweet home.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Medical must've put some weird ideas in your head again, right? Ahhh… I admit, I get these little impulses every now and then, but I promise, I'll never cause you any real trouble.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Video editing is totally my specialty! So, Doctor, you want a Rhodes Island promo? Got a plan for me? All righty, lemme take a look. Hmm… Rhodes Island precautions, Nutrition PSAs, fire safety tutorials…What in the terra are these?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I have a bad feeling; there must be a terrifying Feline lurking nearby. Doctor, stay alert! They'll catch you off-guard, leap out from some shadowy corners, and smack you to the ground with a single swipe. Eh? It won't happen?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Living together with everyone and discovering new things to film—all the good things in life are compounding! Figuring all that out led me to become an operator, so now I can share my happiness with you.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Let me sneak a quick pic. Yeah, just one shot.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: 'Sup everyone, welcome to the Click Channel! Eh? No filming in the Doctor's office? Fine, I guess…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Let me do the filming next time.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Awesome! Doctor, bring it in, let's get a commemorative photo!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Re…lax… Doctor. This happens every time I get excited, but it's nothing to worry about.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: 'Sup, everyone!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Leave it to me!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Doctor, don't forget to take everything you need.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let's see what interesting footage I'll get this time.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Over here!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Tell me what to do.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Fly, my drone!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's get to work!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Fire!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Move aside!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I see you!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hey, smile for the camera!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I just got a killer clip! Make sure you come by and check it out after you get back to the landship.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: This is awesome! It's basically a ready–made battle record.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I was so caught up in filming that somebody slipped by me.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: My lens is shattered…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Time to open my stream studio!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey Doctor, I got something cool to show you!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Oh! I just got a new idea. Hold on, where's my camera? And anywhere I can set up a tripod? Alright. Doctor, help me test this out. When the fireworks go off, just look out the window. I'll take a picture of your eyes—

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hiii—

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, have you heard of fancams? It's when you mix a whole bunch of clips together. I sometimes catch you commanding when I'm filming battle records. Ta-dah! Doctor's Command Scene High-Energy Beat Fancam in Ultra HD! It's your birthday present!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor! I came to Rhodes Island just to earn some travel money, but there's no way I would ever leave a company that repairs my drones for free! Even with such big Felines running around, I'm not gonna— Ahhhhh! Is that… Blaze?!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, have you ever considered some more... practical ornamentation for Rhodes Island? Such as monastery brewing casks, perhaps…?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Landen Monastery's clerics form no normal clergy, you know? Rather than prayer, we're much more about taking up arms to defend Laterano... That's how it goes, but our finances have been in a sorry state these past few years. The justice of guarding others with the faith we harbor—surely the Lord permits us that.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, do you have any interest in beer or bread? Landen Monastery Fermented Goods Contest CCCLXXVII first-place winner, at your service! No need? Ah, alright... Truly, I want our soft, springy bread and fragrant beer to be known across all of Terra. That would do wonders for our revenues!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: E—Exusiai? The legend who blew up her alma mater seventeen times in three years? I never thought she'd be here at Rhodes Island... She does seem to have some learned business experts at her side, but the risk of an explosion while rebuilding the Monastery... best not for now.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Different kinds of arrows entail different uses. There may be plenty of capable archers amongst my sisters, but I don't boast when I proclaim that I'm the only one able to adapt multiple combat modes at once! Heheh! At least, out of my year I am!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: It was only once I left the Monastery that I realized my arrows may do more than defend the Curia. They can aid so many Infected, beset by injustice... I'm very proud, but occasionally I'll remember the days gone past, where I simply drew my bow, and loosed. Now, every arrow has become so much more weighty.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: So as to rebuild the Monastery, my sisters have left to seek cooperation across all of Terra. Landen Monastery, age-old guardian of Laterano, is now a dispatch agency... If only those old men would grant a little more funding. What kind of an excuse is 'better to have a nun trained than a fund gained!?'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a far cry from Laterano, mingling the breadth of diversity in vision and ambition together. It's truly remarkable. Doctor, you must consider coming to the Monastery to teach after you retire. Issues of faith? That'll be no problem! None of us will mind.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: At the start of spring, we'll prune the overgrown vines, and then open up the cellar come evening and retrieve the wine. The moment the setting sun catches through our glasses, we'll down them in one gulp. Ceremony? No, it's just a custom of ours. Life and faith became one long ago, and we don't want to lose it, that's all.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I feel like I heard bells... mm, just my imagination.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Cleric of Landen Monastery, Operator Archetto. Today on, I'll be in formal cooperation with you, for the rebuilding of the Landen Monastery famed far and wide! Doctor, if you would, please look over these contract terms!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I see, so this is how Rhodes Island's operators fight! Truly, they're exemplary!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? My greatest thanks. Hm? I seem at peace? Of course. When you spend five years partaking in commendation ceremonies for outstanding clerics where all peers are absent due to hangovers, these things don't get to you much.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Another promotion? Hmm... all the companies outside seem to strongly emphasize a hierarchical structure. Well, seeing as my excellence has been commended, might Rhodes Island be interested in establishing a long-term cooperation agreement with our Monastery?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Rhodes Island may see for itself the distinguished tactical prowess of Landen Monastery.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Cooperating with my Sisters, everyone always drowned each other out... but under my command, things may be a little terser. I'll do my utmost.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Arrow nocked.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy sighted.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Your orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What arrow should I use?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I've found our prey.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: May the Lord bless us.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Draw. Aim. Loose.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Feel the bowstring tremble…

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Gospel, gather at my fingertips...

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: My bow has three choices, and the enemy three hardships.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: 'Long may the Monastery's bells sound.' This is a prayer for victory. Though we've already won!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Now that I joined in this battle, nobody will think Landen Monastery's just an ornament of Laterano, will they?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Errrr… Please allow me the chance to remedy this! This is my mistake, and in no way represents the Monastery!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Were battles beyond the walls... always so cruel?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's too stifling in here. There's near to none of the Monastery's sunshine!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh—is something wrong?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ah, Doctor, I've been thinking whether I should invite you with me to come see Laterano. Perhaps you'd have more interest in the Monastery then…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hm, there may be plenty of Lateran citizens here, but everyone's natures and backgrounds are so at odds with each other. I just want to find a fellow countryman I can calmly pray and toast to the New Year with, but... they're all so…

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: May the Lord bless you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. This is a special day of great importance, and I offer you my most heartfelt prayers. May the bell sound to hold sickness and misfortune at bay, and may faith light your way. Also, I'd like you to accept this gift from me—an exquisite copy of a business contract, with all to gain and naught to lose!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A good business partner is one thing, but a companion with whom you can uphold your faith is far more valuable. The weight of drawing one's bow for justice... I am sure all people of Rhodes Island can understand it. Long may the bells sound, that we continue to fight side by side, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: There are no security risks in your room, and you can work with peace of mind. I'll stand guard at the door to help you turn down any unnecessary busywork.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The automatic door here is broken? Let me have a look. Hm… Haaaaah! Alright, Doctor, you're clear to go ahead and carry on with your work. I'll contact the maintenance staff.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You want to learn more about Minoan culture? I see, I'll put together a report for you. No, that's not information I can cover in just a few words. I must report it to you in detail.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Mercenaries must always update their pool of knowledge. If you can't keep up with the newest information, you could end up falling into the hands of enemies using the new methods, so there's absolutely no room to slack. I hope you understand this, Doctor. Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: What did that Minoan girl in the garden do...? My head feels strangely empty, it's like I'm completely relaxed… This doesn't... seem normal to me. Doctor, I need to rest. I'm sorry, I'm out of service as your bodyguard for the time being…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Hoooooo, HAH! Looks like I'm in pretty good shape today, maybe it'll feel even better to exercise a bit with the reserve operators. Oh, it's Hell Week? Alright then, I'll have to bug Dobermann again and get her to find a place for me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Corinia was built on the scales of merchants. Everyone there wants to squeeze as much as they can out of everyone else. But, people in the other city-states are a lot more interesting. I had all kinds of fun back when I was guarding them. The feeling was a lot like what I get with you, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You need to train properly, Doctor. Not exactly, stretching and walks are light exercise. What I'm talking about is real training. It requires a full range of intense exercises, as well as a healthy diet to burn fat and build muscle. Oh, you're fine with that? Good, let me see your results then. Don't be like last time—Hey! I'm not done talking yet, get back here!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Finished that one too? Want one more bowl? No problem. This is the first time I've made a complete meal. Usually I just fill my belly with some rations and don't cook much. Here's the last portion. When you're done, you'll exercise just like we agreed. That's the whole reason I learned to do this.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Relaxing with a nap? Hehehe, this is a real luxury.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, my new employer. I am Sideroca, a Corinian mercenary. My paperwork is all done. You can count on me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: These clips are only good for reference. Keep your eyes open in a real battle.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Each badge is a symbol of trust. I'll accept this.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I'll use my sword to cut down all threats to you. You have my word.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: At your service.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll pass on your orders.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't worry, I'll keep an eye on the team.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: We're starting.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Approaching the destination.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Let's see what you all can do.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: This is where you stop.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Let's turn this around!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: And stay down!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Hooaahh!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'll show you how a Minoan fights!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Seeing how you command, I feel like my protection might be a little redundant.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What matters is you're alright. Let's get ready to head back.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You had to suffer through that because I was careless. I'm so, so sorry.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No matter what happens... I have to get the Doctor safely back to base…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's too messy here. I'm going to have to give it a good cleaning.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What's the matter?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor! This training was your idea! Why are you running off? Get back here!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy the New Year. We can put your workout regimen on hold for today, but you still have to do some basic exercise. Also, I may have prepared a meal for you, but that's not an excuse to sit here eating the whole time—are you listening to me, Doctor? Doctor?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Nothing out of the ordinary!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I had this sapling brought all the way from Minos to celebrate your birthday. Find somewhere to plant it. I hope the joy of growth and new life will reach you in your thoughts.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The more I see of you, the more you unsettle me. Instructors Dur-nar and Dobermann are sharp, no doubt. They're no mercenaries, but still show such attentiveness to their employer. Doctor, I have a few questions I'd like to ask you, in order to better complete the missions you assign me...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: 'Lens will be happy to take care of any tasks meant for Miss Scene!'

lines.title: Talk 1
