lines.text: 'Miss Scene has won both Nature and Still-Life categories in major photography competitions. With a patient enough subject, her chances of winning the Portrait category are likely to skyrocket as well. Doctor, would you pose for Miss Scene?'

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: 'Evaluating patience: Doctor's levels declining. Initiating comfort protocol—Miss Scene will finish shooting in less than 30 minutes. Hold on just a bit longer, please.'

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: 'The Zalak next door is visiting Miss Scene again. She might not be laughing yet, but I can tell she's very happy.'

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: 'Truthfully, Miss Scene was originally set to work as a full-time photographer for a photographic equipment giant in Columbia, but somehow ended up here as an operator. Lens assesses that she likely chose to leave because they wanted her to photograph subjects she did not appreciate. Yes, indeed, Miss Scene is that picky.'

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: W h e n   y o u   s e e   s o m e t h i n g   y o u   l i k e ,   t a k e   a   p h o t o   a n d   s a v e   i t.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: 'Doctor, are you attempting to make Miss Scene laugh again? She's actually already laughing, though seeing her smile requires patience. You wait, and wait, and wait some more, until the arc of her mouth reaches absolute perfection. This process might take… TBD minutes, it all depends on Miss Scene's mood today.'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: 'Lens has long been waiting for someone who understands Miss Scene. Now, many at Rhodes Island are willing to approach her, and this brings Lens joy. I hope that one day, Miss Scene will find a biological entity that can perfectly replace Lens.'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: T h i s   c a m e r a.   F o r   y o u.   T h a n k  y o u.   D o c t o r.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: 'Now Playing: D.D.D. Smash Hits'.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: 'Photographer, Scene, and Robotic Photography Assistant, Lens. We are pleased to make your acquaintance.'  H e l l o.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: 'Replay requested. Repeat: replay requested.'

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: 'Accessory upgrade complete. Miss Scene thanks you.'

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I s   t h e r e   s c e n e r y   y o u   w a n t   t o   s e e?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: 'Teammates' data acquired.'

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: 'Sub-data acquired.'

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: 'Green-light, confirmed.'

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: 'Cruise program initiated.'

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: 'Lens is here to serve you.'

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: H e r e.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: 'Camera rolling.'

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: M h m m.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: 'Shooting—'

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: 'Exposure—'

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: 'Panorama—'

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'Time lapse—'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: C o n g r a t s.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: 'Mission complete! Escorting Miss Scene back to base.'

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: 'The route back to the base seems bumpy.'

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: 'Evacuate immediately. Repeat: Evacuate immediately.'

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: 'Please arrange a hammock for Miss Scene. Thank you.'

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Y e a h?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: W a n t   a   p h o t o?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I  n e e d  t o  w i s h  y o u  a  h a p p y  n e w  y e a r  m y s e l f.  H a p p y  n e w  y e a r.  'Me too! Doctor, Happy New Year! Happy New Year!'

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: H  e  l  l  o. 'Hello! Hi!'

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: H a p p y  b i r t h d a y.  T h a n k  y o u  f o r  a l w a y s  l i s t e n i n g  s o  p a t i e n t l y  t o  m e.  T h i s  i s  m y  f a v o r i t e  p i c t u r e  t h i s  y e a r.  Y o u  c a n  h a v e  i t.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: 'Miss Scene isn't suited to such a lively party. She would be overwhelmed. So, Lens will accompany her with a drink. Doctor, what would you like Lens to do? Lens's music library has been updated with three songs. Please press here to make a selection!'

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, are you ready to work? I won't take no for an answer. C'mon. 3, 2, 1, start.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Nails are part of a girl's appeal. Gotta take good care of them.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why do I call myself Utage? Well, it's not that complicated. It means 'Party' in Higashinese, and I just wanna live my life like it's a party every night. If I'm in a good mood, everything else is gonna be okay.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You already saw it, Doctor? Well, that's too bad. Now the only way out is for you… is to come with me and use this two-for-one coupon.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: When I got Oripathy and started talking about coming here, my mom was worried about bullying. So she gave me the family heirloom, Shishiou, to defend myself. Didn't find any bullies, but I did manage to cut up some pretty bad guys. Doctor, you really know how to treat a girl.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The people here turn all scary when they get serious. I'm as scary as six of them put together? Really…? Am I that terrifying?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doc. Help me pick up ten boxes of limited-edition cookie sticks tomorrow? Just give me an advance on my pay. What? I've advanced the whole thing already? Aww c'mon, there's gotta be something you can do. Please, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, you're razor-sharp some of the time and dull as a block at others. I don't get why. Oh, I see, right out of that 'How to Talk to Girls' book, huh? I'd expect nothing less from you, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: It's not good to rely too much on any one person, but maybe the Doctor is an... Eek, Doctor! Oh it's nothing, I was just rambling to myself! D-D-Did you need something from me?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: If you're tired, just go to bed. Not that complicated.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hey, Doctor. I'm your new operator, Utage. My hobbies are... Oh, I don't need to go into the details? Alright then, I look forward to working with you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Is it over?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Do I get work less after I get promoted? No dice? Oh well…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I guess it's time for me to get serious. Alright, let's crush the bad guys!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Alright, everyone, I'll be counting on your orders!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Hmm, team captain… Eh? Me? Captain?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Time to go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: C'mon, c'mon! I can't wait any longer.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yeees?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Need me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Moving out!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Who should I cut?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: It won't hurt if I don't miss.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'll take what you don't need.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You look kinda cute when you cry.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ahh, it felt good to blow off all that steam. Exciting stuff. Let's go for crepes, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was so much fun. Thanks for all the enemies!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You're saving the stragglers for me? Well, I'll dig right in.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: C'mon, Doctor, stop spacing out and start running.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: As long as I can get my magazines, it doesn't really matter where I stay.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Wanna go sing karaoke?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Oh, hey, Doctor. Happy New Year! As you can see, I'm trapped under this kotatsu... Hang with me for a bit maybe? It's waaarm. C'mon, just try it, you won't regret it!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Morning, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. Did you know? There's a real trick to birthday parties. I could share some hacks with you, like, on the down-low, to really up your popularity at dinnertime. Number one—wait, are these all your presents?! This whole room?!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The dinner party today was, like, killer. That's the kind of thing you should really do every day. Otherwise, you start overthinking things and get all hung up on it. Then stuff gets worse and lose all your optimism for life, which is tough to hold onto. Meh, that's just me babbling to myself, don't worry about it. Anyway, enjoy the happiness you've got in the moment, that's what matters most!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: What? You think this work is going to do itself? Hmph! There's no 'Does Your Job While You Sleep' Fairy, Doctor. Now lay your silly ideas to rest and get your nose to the grindstone.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: My companions and I are proud to receive any children that visit the castle. And grown-ups, on occasion—we host the good and honest kind. It's a shame they're so few and far between.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm looking for a girl named Mabel. Er, not a girl, that was twenty years ago, she's a grown woman now… Codename? Of course I don't know her codename! But I know for certain she's here, without a doubt!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: If there's nothing to keep us, then let me take my leave—I'm quite busy, you know. I have an appointment with the children you're treating here, and we shan't be missing storytime.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Compared to adults, children have the right of it. They're much more innocent, filled with upstanding character. They are the most precious, cherishable things in all this great land.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Beloved rag dolls, pretty flowers, storybooks with pages worn away… Children leave much to the castle while they're in Wonderland. Whatever they cherish that they've no power to safekeep, they can place in our care.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Now come wisplight and lamplight, come light up the way♪ Come to our little tea party to stay♪ Here come the guards, and they dance and sing for us, carrying scissors to chop-chop away♪ I sang this song about my friends to entertain the children with me. Learned the words? I shan't sing them to you again.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I know. Mabel's no longer with us. You knew her as Bluishsilver, didn't you? I've seen the records… asked her captain about her. Her captain was so sad… Oh… How strange. This was the very time we agreed on, yet I can't help but feel I was too late…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Wonderland, Slumberland, the Cradle… you've never heard of these names before? Oh, you poor soul. Did no one ever tell you any bedtime stories? …Oh, I suppose. Close your eyes now. I'd rather not, but let's have you see for yourself, just this once.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh, really! How do you fall asleep somewhere like this? And you can't call this paperwork presentable! …Fine. Seeing as you always work so hard, I'll help you just this once…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Iris, Master of the Castle of Dreams, Keeper of the Cradle. As per an agreement, I've come to return something a guest once left to the castle… How strange. Why can I not find her?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: How barbarous, though it does have its merits.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm the master of a castle. If we're to talk promotions, I ought to be giving one to you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Right, then! Be privy to the full power of the Master of the Castle! It is for their protectors' strength that fairytales can persevere with such purity, such beauty. And isn't that just like Rhodes Island?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Oh, fine, I suppose.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Listen to me carefully, now. What we agree here will be our promise, and promises must never be broken.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I will lead you all to the proper place.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: And those are the people we're driving off, then?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes, yes.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Could you not push me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: The air is so thick here.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hmph! I'll help you just this once.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Would you all like a bedtime story too?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You shan't pass!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Impertinent!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Off to dreamland, now?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: How's that? I've driven every one of them away!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: So this is the taste of victory. Yet… I wonder why I can't feel happy about it…

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmph. They've run off by themselves. I suppose that'll be all, then?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Goodness, did you fall asleep?! Quick, with me, out of here!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What a strange place. Is there no larger bed anywhere?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ah—my fan! Please, give that back!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Careful, there, don't ruffle the headdress… yes, quite, comb just like that…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Another year has gone by. As time passes like this, I can't help but feel a little frightened. The children will grow up year by year, but I have to wonder: is that a good thing? Doctor, is growing up… a good thing?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good day to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Are you awake? Do you remember what you dreamt of? An unending sea of iris flowers, a dance at the castle, fireworks under a starry sky. Didn't you feel as though you'd rather not wake up? Those scenes are meant to be reserved for the children, but I can make an exception for you, just this once. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: By all rights, children are meant to be the hope of our land, yet Oripathy spells such early ends to their lives. Lives I can never even save… I can only hope to protect their fledgling dreams as best I can. That is my ideal, and why I must walk with Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I've noted down your schedule. You can confirm with me anytime.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: If it's about making someone bleed, do not send Lady Ceylon to the task. Let those who live amongst the shadow take it over, like me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I won't tell you anything more about Lady Ceylon. And of course, others won't learn anything more about you from me.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm your bodyguard, Doctor. My duty is to protect you, not chat with you. If you want to talk, please stop turning to me like Lady Ceylon does and find someone else.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My expertise? Killing targets, guarding people, and... making tea. Don't be so shocked. After all, the tea Lady Ceylon makes is… Anyway, I'm good at that.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, based on the danger involved in the missions to date, I believe you need to learn self-defense in addition to my protection. Otherwise, even I can't guarantee your safety.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Once you've got blood on your hands, there's no turning back… Doctor, I do not wish you to go down the same road as mine. So leave the dirty works to me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You want to hear my revenge story? You won't be able to sleep at night, Doctor. But… somehow I do have this strange urge to tell you. Well then, let's hit the bar. This story will take a while.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Sinners always get what they deserve, I know that. But I do wonder sometimes that... if I could have met Lady Ceylon and you sooner, maybe I'd be more than just a killer. It's still not too late for me? Do you really mean that, Doctor?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Falls asleep just like that? Can't keep a guard up at all, just like her.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Schwarz, Lady Ceylon's personal bodyguard, here to join Rhodes Island with her. If at all possible, please assign me to accompany her.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I see that Rhodes Island is teeming with war monsters. I can only try to learn their way of battle.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Now I understand why Rhodes Island wanted me. Your vision is a hundred times crazier than anything I ever did.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Reawaken my memories? I'm fine with it. Maybe you can tame the evil inside us when on battlefields. Please, tame it for us.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: A mission? Got it

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Follow my orders.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: None will escape.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Where am I needed?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: A solid position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: They won't get away.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I've got you in my sight.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Way too obvious.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Unworthy of my shots.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Lady Ceylon may have mercy. I do not.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, in a dangerous mission like this,  you'd better give you command from as far as possible.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We got everyone, per your order.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The perimeter is secured. What's next?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Come, Doctor, I'll ensure your safety.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Patrol? Got it.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: ...?! Please, Doctor, I don't want you to hurt yourself.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, I suppose everything's fine?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's? I only looked forward to New Year's when I was very young, then I lost interest, but... Lady Ceylon enjoys it. I used to escort her home from Victoria at the tail end of the year, and she'd tell me what she'd been up to while away at university. Right, Doctor, you can come have a cup of tea with us later if you are interested.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Don't let your guard down even on base, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here, it's a birthday present. I was there while Lady Ceylon picked out her present, so I chose some fine dishes for afternoon tea to go with the tea set. When you brew your relaxing tea, you can enjoy some snacks along with it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Master Doykos helped me to get my revenge, and gave me a new life, while Lady Ceylon taught me to see a warmer, gentler world. I'm also greatly thankful to you all. Rhodes Island lets Lady Ceylon be firm in her goal, and I can be more confidently clear in knowing where my fight is headed.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I... can take care of some basic tasks, but your assistant should be able to take on a large share of your work. That may be… beyond my abilities.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Prejudice is common between peoples. Before I came to Rhodes Island, I actually thought people outside of Sami left the womb with weapons in their hands... That's not a joke, Doctor. I really did.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You're still bothered by the cold? Hmm... Sometimes, I feel like you're needier than a newborn. Hold your hands out then... Haah... Feel better? You're welcome. Give me a moment, I'll fetch you another blanket.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Yes, I know this is a general education course meant for children. But a shaman's calling is to master all forms of knowledge, whether metal or wood. And my knowledge of the South probably isn't much greater than a local child. So a course like this suits me just fine.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Fighting is not in Sami nature. But, if you do not become the hunter, then you can only be the hunted. This is true whether facing the elements, the demons... or the people of Ursus. It's the law of nature.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I respect you, and so I give you my word. As long as I am aboard this iron ship, I will not trouble the people of Ursus. But when in Sami, I hope you'll turn a blind eye to... some of my actions. There is always a price to be paid, even if it falls to Ursus rather than a particular individual.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: My friends here at Rhodes Island made this outfit not long after I arrived. I was still a stubborn rockhorn back then, unwilling to accept even the slightest bit of kindness. Now... I'm probably not so inflexible. Even the coldest ice melts in the spring sun.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Tribe cannot go on without a shaman. It was painful to part with the branches of my family tree, and let go of the responsibility of protecting my tribesmen. It used to be my only wish to remain in my ancestral home, accompanying the long-withered tree. But now, that is not possible anymore...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: One crystallized eye is enough to turn a woman into a monster. The Southerners use Originium to command metal to move, yet fear that it will grow upon their bodies. Alas, what deadly weapons indifference and fear have become. Though they leave no wounds on the body, they instead bleed the spirit dry.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I wave a twig… for a fresh and healthy year...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: She was born under the tribe's santalla tree, so it became her identity, her codename, and a part of her life. Now the outcast returns to the tribe, regaining the right to use her name. She will commit herself to her new leader.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: They do not yet comprehend the enemy's cruelty…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: May the generosity you've afforded me plant the seedlings of joy within your heart.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The curse cannot extinguish the pain in my heart. Since it is conquest that Ursus craves, then let them be conquered by nature.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: What do you wish for the battlefield to become?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Protect our teammates, and victory will be ours.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Look into the distance, and be mindful of your feet. Nature has already warned you of the changes.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The hunter... and the hunted…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Did you have need of me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your orders?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: As you wish.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: We shall begin.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The withered tree demands sacrifices.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The wild wind plunders your warmth.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The deadly cold sends its regards.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: The eyes of Sami witness your end.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Perhaps in your eyes, nature is just another tool.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You are the true hunter.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: War is like nature, full of variables.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The blizzard approaches. We should go.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: My room, my domain…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Is there anything I can do for you?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: In Sami, there is no food sweeter than honey. Is this... candy? Hmm... Oh, so sweet!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Flames represent destruction, but also contain vitality and warmth. The wither and decay has been burned away, and a red light spreads across this land. Regardless of what difficulties you may face in the future, please do not forget today's vision of passion.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I am here, by your side.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Congratulations on completing another annual cycle of your life, Doctor. This should be the day when your strength is most abundant, so if there's anything you'd like to achieve, now is the time to start.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Many tribes prepare to leave their homeland behind and go south, whereas many warriors bade farewell to their loved ones and are making their way north. The Sami people seem to be splitting in two, never to see each other again. I cannot change this, but all I hope... is for everyone to be safe and sound.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You should take a little break. It's good for you. Of course that is true, aren't you glad to hear that?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Those who chase Catastrophes are called 'Yakumeguri', or as they say here, 'Catastrophe Messengers.' The job is bitter and tiring, and we are often ridiculed by ordinary civilians and bureaucrats alike. Will my lot improve as an operator? No? Hehe, such is life.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Tomorrow's weather... hmm, I see... My dear boss, remember to bring an umbrella with you when you leave tomorrow.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: If I could have stayed in Higashi, I would not have come all the way here. But with these stones on my flesh… there's simply nowhere to call home.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I would rather offer my salary to those in need than stash it away in my lodgings. Considering how little there is, it serves a better purpose in the hands of the needy. Besides, their smiles and words of thanks really warm my heart.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I often wonder if the strange words that occasionally spill from my mouth are born of my own consciousness, or if they are bestowed upon me by the Kami-sama I have never met. The ritual verses of my relatives are all drawn from age-old scriptures, but I've always blurted mine out. It is quite confusing, to be honest.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Again and again we prance, posture, sing, and pray, with no tolerance for the slightest discrepancies. Some people find joy in filling their lives with these things, and tell others that it will bring joy to the high heavens. How truly sinful.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My clan and I lived in the mountains, not far from a Shinto shrine. At the foot of the mountain was a Buddhist temple, where the monks would return at night. Now for the question, Doctor. What do you think would happen? Hehe, I shall leave the answer on your table, feel free to take a look when you have time.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Up so late, Doctor? Do you still have something on your mind? Thoughtful eloquence is your strong suit, but don't let it get in the way of your sleep. Here, I have some incense from Higashi for you. Just one sniff, and you'll... Oh my, I didn't expect it to be this effective. Well, I suppose I shall stand guard for you tonight.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Close your eyes, and calm your mind. Good~

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Pleased to meet you. It simply would not do if I was to forget my introduction, yes? I am Tsukinogi, formerly part of a small Yakumeguri group in Higashi. It is an honor to work under you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Different communication methods? Interesting...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Oh, a reward? Now, now, how should I use this?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The white night is a raging fire, through which a dark haze lingers. I asketh thee, where dost thy steps cease? Take things one step at a time, and do not stray off the path.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I will not fall short of your expectations.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Great is the responsibility of leading others.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The time has come. Let us go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: There are more important things to do than pray.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Very well.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Impurity be purged.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Soul be cleansed.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Dark flame rising, devouring existence.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Drown in the gloaming, lost in silence.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Land unending, we walk in ignorance.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Back down, before this exalted brilliance!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I was not able to help at all, but that is a cause for celebration.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Congratulations! A perfect conclusion to this mission.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The small issues that besmirch our results can be left to me. You may take your leave.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Reckless moves often bring bad results. Let us reflect upon our plan once more.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I have no demands of my accommodations, so please assign me as you will.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm？

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: If there is anything displeasing to you, please let me know. Yes, anything at all.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: What was the first word you said this year? Hmm... I do believe that is a fortuitous omen. Rhodes Island will be blessed by good fortune this year. Congratulations.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Have you been well, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here, give me your hand. Don't be nervous. Just follow my steps... Look, our hair flutters in the breeze risen by the movement of my arms, and our clothes sway in an elegant arc. Sharing a dance together is a beautiful thing, wouldn't you agree?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Oh my... It has been quite some time since we were able to have fun like this. Sure enough, many things become enjoyable once you discard the formalities. {@nickname}, sit here. You are not allowed to go anywhere until this bottle of wine is empty.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, you'll be working hard today? Then, I'll stay with you. If you slack off, then I'll use this staff... Like this... and give you a smack on the head. Bonk, bonk.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Beeswax, Beeswax, Beeswax... Mm, okay. I should get used to it after reading it a few more times. Oh, Doctor, do you need something? I'm just trying to get used to hearing my code name... so I don't fail to react and get made fun of when others call me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This bug... Midnight seemed very scared of it and jumped up into the air as soon as he saw it, so I helped him catch it. But, where should we put it now... Um, Doctor, why are you backing away?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My clothes are a bit big, so I feel at ease when they drape over my body. I like that sensation. But, sometimes, I'll accidentally step on them—Uu, uwah, ahh...! ...Fweh, I tripped again... Ow…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The new piece the Folk Song Association put out this month is my new favorite song. Oh, you've never heard of them before, Doctor? The full name is the Folk Song and Originium Arts Research Association... Still haven't heard about it? What about the Electro-music Arts Alliance? How about the Rap and Folk Joint Vantage? Haven't heard of any of them?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The mark on my head? Ah... this is a ceremonial emblem passed down from generation to generation in my tribe, and it is a symbol of our Golden Gods' blessings on our tribe and our people. The faceless gods will protect us, no matter where we go, whether or not we remember them...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Leaving the tribe and traveling to other cities and countries is a rite of passage for all our tribespeople. Only by completing it can one become a fully-fledged adult like my sister. Um, Doctor, you believe I can handle it, don't you?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Hehe, my horns are big and pretty, right? There aren't many people in the tribe who can boast horns like mine! The secret to maintaining them is to apply essential oils once a day, gently massage them with a soft brush—W-Wait, Doctor, I haven't finished today's routine yet, even you can't just touch them like that!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, please come here. Mm, okay, close your eyes, and let me touch your forehead. The scorching sun, the raging storm, and waves of golden sand washing across the desert. The gods set foot upon the land where we were nurtured, and bestowed our tribe with their blessings. Now, I will share this blessing with you, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Zz... zzz... Sister... you dummy... zzz... mm... H-Huh, Doctor? I fell asleep...? Sleeptalking? Did I say something?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hmm... Wah, excuse me, I let my mind wander. Hello, Doctor, I am, my code name is... Umm... Ah, I remember! It's Beeswax. Do you like it? My tribe helped pick it for me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hm...? I have to watch all of this?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? Mm... I don't quite understand.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, perhaps the path that lies ahead for Rhodes Island is destined to be long and treacherous, but please remember, the gods' decrees and my blessings... will always be with you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Umm... where are we going this time?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm the leader...? Even though I'm not sure how you select your team leaders, I'll try my best.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Well then, let's go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Someone's over there. Everyone, please be careful.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes, I'm here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: How can I help?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Over here? Leave it to me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: The land beneath my feet is the domain of the gods.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Devour them.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Crush them.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Sleep beneath the golden sands.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: This is the blessing of the gods.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: May they also receive the blessing of the gods…

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew... It's over. Doctor, was I able to be of use?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Ooh, they got away! Mm... but I guess that's fine?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We can't do this anymore, Doctor. I'll hold the enemies back, so please escape!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What a spotless room... It'd be troublesome if I accidentally spilled sand over it, right?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: W-Woah... I stepped on my clothes again…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ah, Doctor, please look at this! I caught another bug!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Wepet renpet neferet, Doctor. It's an important day, so the first thing I did was a little horn care. Now my friends can come touch them... Oh, touching my horns, you can't feel how well I've kept them? Hm, that's okay. You don't have horns. I don't blame you.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, I've been waiting.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: It's your birthday today, Doctor? Okay. Let me give you my blessing. Please close your eyes and imagine an endless desert. In the desert, a priest knocks the staff on the ground. The sound signifies the gods' blessings are drawing near, and each step kicks up a sandstorm... Huh? Why did you start coughing?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Even now, I still haven't figured out what my sister is up to. But having traveled with Rhodes Island for so long, I've seen lots of sights like the ones in the magazines, but with my own eyes. When I go back to my people, I'll probably see more clearly the blessings of the gods.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Tabletop, 60 points. Floor, 63 points. Air quality...... 56 points. There's room for improvement, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Have you experienced any bodily discomfort recently? Umm, dry skin, stiff shoulders... dry eyeballs, hair loss, fatigue? ...Very good, just old problems then, nothing serious. As long as you start exercising, these problems should go away in no time.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Life in the Medical Department is just daily meetings, visits around the Island, learning the operators' physical conditions, and developing new drugs. Nothing really fresh or exciting.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Mother, no matter where you are, please watch over me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Thanks for always taking care of us medics. I feel so much less anxiety while working, and I'm very happy. Of course, there are troublesome things to deal with as well, for example, when Blaze comes back, her body is always covered in blood, each and every time! Does she know how hard it is to clean up those bodily fluids?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: How many times have I told you, don't stay up late, and don't overeat! You just won't listen, right? How are you going to take care of your health then? You might as well spend the rest of your life in that chair!! ...... I'm sorry, I need to go calm down first.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I never quite know what Dr. Kal'tsit is thinking. Has she always been that... unique? I hope I can catch up to her one day, even if it's in just one area.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: As long as the wicked can be punished, what's a little bit of criticism? I don't mind spilling these poisons on my enemies. They deserve it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The word 'Ursus' only gives me pain. I don't want to hear it, not again for the rest of my life. But it's giant, its voice deafening, and I'm the only one it's going to drive mad.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You also know that your previous environmental cleanliness evaluation scores weren't very high, right? If you don't turn things around, Doctor, you'll be on the business end of the Rhodes Island sanitation crane. ... I'll help you take care of these for now, so make sure you clean up the rest in your free time.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Folinic from the Medical Department, and I am now participating in field medic missions. Meanwhile, per Dr. Kal'tsit's request, I will also help you manage your health. I look forward to working with you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It seems that the volume of drug input was insufficient last time, and it should be able to achieve its intended effect next time at triple the dosage.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for your acknowledgment. I am simply doing what I should.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: One day, I will become as capable a physician as Dr. Kal'tsit. Just you wait and see.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Medical support ready. I'll protect everyone's life.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Medical support has covered the whole squad. The rest is up to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: No problem, I can handle some psychological burden.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy engaged. Prepare for counterattack and treatment.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Haven't decided yet?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: The clock's ticking.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Medical support has arrived.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Permission to attack has been granted.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Start medication.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't worry, the effects will kick in soon.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Three, two, one!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Overdose decoction prepared, begin use!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I was able to be of some help, right?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Saving medical supplies is a good thing, but there's no need for that on the battlefield, is there?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Luckily, it's just a scratch. Just apply a bandage after cleansing the wound.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Transfer the wounded! Get ready for emergency operation! Prepare for intraosseous infusion!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Inspection complete. This area is habitable.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Sometimes the things I say to you can be a bit... excessive, but you should also recognize that you have your shortcomings, all right?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Why don't we take this chance to look back on your health over the last year? Let's see... Forget it. I have to admit my management of your health still has room for improvement. I will work extra hard on that this year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You've been working hard.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I prepared a gift for you. This is a neck massager developed by the Medical Department. Why don't you give it a try now? It might hurt a little, but it's good for your health. Hey, don't try to escape. I will manage your health one way or another.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Ever since my mother went missing, I haven't had a place to call home. Rhodes Island is the closest I have. Dr. Kal'tsit invested her ideals in this company, and so have I. Doctor, bear witness to my determination.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I can be your assistant, but is it okay if I do some craft work here?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, if you like excitement, you should probably stay in Siracusa for a while. You won't enjoy it so much after that.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Considering his personality, sometimes even I wonder why no one's beaten Chiave to death yet.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, are you interested in DIY? See, the three of us actually design and make our own weapons and outfits. You could join us sometime, if you want.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: After cleaning up Chiave’s messes so many times, I’ve realized something: If you want real power, you’ll need to rely on more than just violence.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: In Siracusa, most people my age just want to join a famiglia, but there are plenty more who would rather live an honest life instead. Sometimes, I think those are the strongest of us all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: (Yawn) …Oh, sorry, Doctor, I didn't get much sleep last night. Rhodes Island is way too safe. It's taking some time to get used to.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Chiave, Broca, and me. The three of us are like brothers, and we've done all kinds of things together. But, sometimes, I really wonder if this really is the life for us.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: To tell you the truth, I wanted to be a public servant when I was a kid. Up until my dad made me pick up a weapon for the first time, that is. I don't mind drifting around with the other two, but I always felt like I was missing something, and I know what it is now. I wanted to become as strong-willed as you are, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor... you're asleep? You sure live a comfy life, heh? I'm pretty jealous.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Aosta. It's thanks to you that the three of us are still alive. If you don't mind, please let us work here for the time being.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Maybe we're still alive only because of a stroke of luck…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, is Rhodes Island really a pharmaceutical company? I've got the feeling that we might just be able to take over a Siracusan city if everyone here put themselves to it.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I think I might just be able to live the life I've always wanted at Rhodes Island... Doctor, could I apply to open a DIY shop here?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I hope this isn't going to be too much trouble.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll give it my best shot.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's avoid any unnecessary fights.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Guess we don't have a choice. Let's get this taken care of.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'll go.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Yes?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Take them all down?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let me give it a shot.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hello.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Farewell.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Time to put an end to this.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Tsk.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, do you enjoy challenging yourself so much?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I got all of them. I just hope they're worth it.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A few of them got through, but I think we'll be fine.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, you go on ahead. I'll clean up the mess here. It's my speciality, after all.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'll just walk around, then.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I can walk, Doctor.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: How are things going, Doctor?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's used to be the three of us hiding in a small room, scraping together a table of assorted dishes to, at the very least, eat something together. And that's all. I never imagined having such a lavish New Year's celebration as this… Don't worry, Doctor, I'll keep an eye on Chiave and make sure he stays out of trouble.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've never given a gift before, so I'm not sure what you might like… Is there anything in particular you want? Just give me an hour, I may DIY it for you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Oh, Doctor, I got a lot of orders for props tonight. Did you notice? A whole lot of the decorations hanging around are my creations… Ah, don't worry, I enjoy this festive atmosphere well enough. Would you like me to make you some too? Free of charge, and I'm sure you'll be pleased with the results.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, let me help!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor! You've been glued to that chair forever, and that's totally not good for you. Time for a quick workout session with me—stretch those muscles, replenish your energy. Trust me, you'll be able to work even better!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hey, hey, Doctor! She's here at Rhodes Island! Ah, her codename should be Dur-nar now. Anyway, she's incredible! I've literally only seen her in recruitment ads before! And she's such a nice lady! She gave me so many snacks, ehehe.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, I'm way more athletic than most people my age, you know. Let me show you a standing backflip! Watch closely! Hu-ya!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: This gun? Oh, it's a gun-type Arts… Uh… What's that term again? Hmm… Right, Arts Unit! I applied for it out of habit after coming here, but honestly? I still prefer my fists over Arts.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've always known I'm lucky, but seeing the struggles of other Infected here at Rhodes Island… It's really opened my eyes. Doctor, tell me how I can help. I want to be useful.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Huh…? Oh, Doctor! I'm working on a letter to my dad. I've never told you about him? Then let me introduce him! He's the most incredible policeman ever! You've gotta hear all about his awesome stories!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Truth is, my dad's the one who recommended Rhodes Island. When he learned you could treat Oripathy, he was determined to get me here. Being apart from him is tough… I miss him so much. But I understand what matters most to him is seeing me healthy and safe.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You're almost as reliable as my dad, almost! In my book, you're the second most trustworthy person around, hehe! By the way, I've been telling my dad all about you in my letters, and now he's curious to meet you!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doc—! Ah, Doctor's asleep. Gotta be quiet…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor! I'm a new operator, codename Jackie! I used to be an auxiliary police officer in Columbia. Here's hoping we work well together!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Wow… This is even more awesome than what my dad could do!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Eh, am I getting promoted? Wow, that's awesome!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island's opened my eyes to so much… Maybe one day, I'll be just as amazing as my dad! Doctor, I promise I'll keep working hard, and I'm counting on your guidance!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm here!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll work hard!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's do our best!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Mission start!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Doctor, is it my turn?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Warm-up complete.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Time to show my skills!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Try a knuckle sandwich!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: No trespassing!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Don't underestimate me!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Push it to the limit!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I thought they had us a few times there, but we did it! You're amazing, Doctor!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, Doctor, did you see how hard I worked!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, want me to chase after them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Sorry, Doctor. If only I'd put in more effort…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Oh… It's so big inside!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ahhhh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hi, Doctor!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! This New Year, I'll be celebrating right here at Rhodes Island. Hehe, I've already written to dad, explaining how I'm learning to stand on my own, and how Rhodes Island is a place he can trust. Um, I do feel a bit lonely sometimes. But celebrating with my fellow operators makes up for it!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ah, it's Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor! Happy birthday! My dad always taught me birthdays are best spent doing something kind for others. So I'm thinking, how about we head to the kitchen? We can help the logistics operators with today's grocery delivery. Hehehe, who knows? We might just stumble upon some exciting surprises!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: 'Walk a mile in someone else's shoes before extending a helping hand.' Now I get why the Infected I met before didn't want to accept help or even talk much. I've learned a lot at Rhodes Island. When I return to Columbia, all this will help me become a better police officer.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I'll be writing reports or reading nearby, just call when you need me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I believe you reap what you sow, and have always followed that principle.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Wow, I never imagined Oripathy would have such a trait! This requires immediate testing… Um, Doctor, I'm sorry, but I need to leave now. Hmm, I wonder if there's a suitable subject on base…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The day is not complete without tea. Would you like a cup too, Doctor? I have the finest Victorian leaves here.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've been with Schwarz since childhood. I know everything about her, including her past from before we met. Oh, but I won't give that up so easily, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: If I could find a cure for Schwarz, wouldn't that mean I could cure other Infected too...? Relax, Doctor, I'm not that selfish. But please also know that Schwarz is dearest to my heart.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Originium research is still a vastly unexplored territory, Doctor. But I just want to find a cure for Schwarz, which is why I longed to join Rhodes Island since I first heard of it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Do you know, Doctor, that I despise those who discriminate against Schwarz on account of her infection alone? But here, she is accepted, and I can learn more about medicine. Coming to Rhodes Island was truly the right decision.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: No matter how good a leader is, there's still a chance to be blinded by selfish interest, so you must watch out for that, Doctor. Hehe, but still, you don't need to worry that much. As long as I'm around, I'll put you back on the right path anytime you stray.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Falling asleep in a sitting position is a nasty habit, Doctor. Let me get you a blanket, at least.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Ceylon, graduate of Victoria National University, with a major in Originium research. I start my internship at Rhodes Island today, with Dr. Kal'tsit's approval. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: An excellent application of Originium. Rhodes Island sure lives up to its reputation.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: So I'm officially recognized by Rhodes Island? Thank you, Doctor, I'll work even harder.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island does boast terrific Originium research. If I keep working here, I'm sure I will cure Schwarz one day. Doctor, please help me on this path.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: A mission? A perfect opportunity to test my Originium Arts.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Relax, I'm a confident commander.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I wonder if we'll find rare materials along the way?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't panic, handle it with composure.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Where are the wounded?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave the support work to me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: If you're wounded, don't move.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You're all free to focus on the mission.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Concentrate on the enemy ahead!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This one should be better for the present situation.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew... I feel like I just wrapped up a difficult experiment. It's tiring, but very fulfilling too.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The enemy should be gone now...  Alright then, I'm going to look around the perimeter.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: If I were as good as Schwarz, they wouldn't have gotten away…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't just stand there, Doctor, give me a hand with the wounded!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hm, maybe I could talk to the other doctors on base.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wait, my hair is getting messed up!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Did the Doctor fall asleep in that chair again?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Yes, I'll go and chat with my Medical Department colleagues for a while, and then meet up with Schwarz later on. New Year's could never be more interesting at home than at Rhodes Island, and I've sent my father a card in any case.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How are you, Doctor? Care for some tea with me?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here's your birthday present, Doctor. I know what it's like. You bury yourself in books or research, and you just can't help forgetting to take breaks. But with a tea set this beautiful by your side, I'm sure you'll be more minded to pause and brew a cup... hm? Oh, don't worry, it wasn't... terribly expensive.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I might have gained new knowledge from my predecessors' writings at university. However, only after sailing such a long course with Rhodes Island, have I truly touched on the breadth of this land, and gained all kinds of experience the books never held. Ah, and on top of that, Schwarz is doing wonderfully here. Thank you all for looking after her.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Ehi, Doctor, got anything fun to do?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Tsk, goddamn peppers... I gotta find a way to make them disappear from the canteen forever.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I heard Yanese got some old sayings similar to 'Catch the moment'. Heh, the line I like. Don't you think it suits me very well? The future? Meh, I'll let Aosta chew on those sorts of things.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Oi, Doctor, don't just sit there all day. Why don't we have some fun, like… remodeling your whole office?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Aosta once said I wouldn't live long like this. At the time, I told him, what's the point of long life if I can't do what I want?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Fight for what you want, snatch what you like. I don't know the meaning of the word 'Surrender'!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I think up what to do, Aosta thinks up how to do it, and Broca makes sure we get it done together. That's how we've always gotten by, and it's how we ended up here.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, what are you doing all frowny-faced over there? If there's anything weighing on you, just lay it on me. I'm good at that sort of stuff.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Say, Doctor, if someday you decide to quit running Rhodes Island, why not come along with us? Chiave doesn't take orders from anyone, but in your case, I'll make an exception.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Ehi, Doctor... You fell asleep? Whatever, I'll be back later.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Yo, are you the Doctor? Hello, and well met. The name's Chiave. Starting today, I'm your goon!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Whoa-ho-ho... Hey Aosta, check this out! Give me a moment and I'll be even stronger than these guys!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Huh? Promotion? What do you mean?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Incredible. There are just too many interesting people here at Rhodes Island. How am I supposed to just stay in my seat? I've gotta get stronger and stronger!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Ha, here we go!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Listen up, everyone, I have a plan!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Haha, let's go make some noise!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Just gotta knock 'em all down, right?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Still not my turn yet?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: C'mon, don't make me yawn.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I can't wait any longer!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Haha, I'm gonna end you all!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Take this!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hey! Why are you running?!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, you've all done a great JOB!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'm on FIRE!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Hah, now this is the fun stuff!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Ah. Where's the challenge in that, Doctor?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Huh? I left a few? Never even saw 'em.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Shit, for real?!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: ello, bruthas and sistahs!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What is it?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Yo, Doctor, you're in a pretty good mood.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor! Aosta, Broca, and I have a new New Year's plan. Heh heh, once I tell you, you're in on the game. We're going to swap out all the chocolate sauce in the canteen for Siracusan meat sauce, then— Huh? Doctor, where are you going?! Don't you tell Dr. Kal'tsit!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ehi Doc, did you have a good meal?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Ehi, Doctor, Happy birthday! Ta-dah— Check out this model car. I made it myself. It's yours now. Truth be told, if the conditions were right, I would've built you an actual car. Well, I guess that's a promise. Doctor, come visit me in Siracusa sometime and I'll trade this for a real car.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island's got all these heavies, plus smart people like you. One day, someday, I'm gonna do something big that'll rock the whole world! At the very least, I'll do it before I die! Uh, I should try to stay alive...? I guess you're right, haha…

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You couldn't even finish the work you're supposed to do, so you're asking me for help?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Stop sending me to teach people Originium Arts. I have no interest in wasting time with common people.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm not here because I have to be. Just because I want to be.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The people I hate most are the ones who ask too many questions. I hope you are not one of them.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Looks like you understand my Arts now, to some degree. I hope you're aware of the danger as well.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Before I realized it, these Arts and this staff became my most loyal friends. I don't remember when I gained this power. And of course, I don't actually care.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I have all kinds of memories. I don't know where they came from, and I don't know which ones are really mine. I've been traveling back and forth, from country to country trying to find the source. And now, here I am at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When I'm all caught up in chaotic memories, there's nothing better than an ice cream to calm me down. I relied a lot on ice cream, when I was alone.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The memories from after I came to Rhodes Island are completely different from the ones before. There's a sense of realism to them. For the first time, I feel like I'm really myself. That's all thanks to you, and the rest of Rhodes Island… What? I am capable of giving thanks where it's deserved, alright?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmph… what a waste of time.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Surtr. Are you the Doctor they mentioned? I'll be working at Rhodes Island, starting today. I hope you won't bore me too much.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: That's it?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What? You're starting to value me now that you know my power?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: So it's not my power, but me myself? Hmph, you leave me no choice but to pay it back with hard work.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Am I needed?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I alone am enough.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Time to go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Are they the ones I'm eliminating?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Don't order me around.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Enough, I get it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Not a bad position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'm on it!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Die!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You can run but you can't hide!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Laevatain!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Foolish morons!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Hmph. Piece of cake.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Naturally.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Can you not even do such a simple thing?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: If you can't help, just run! I'll handle this.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room is clean enough, I guess.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I can find my own way.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Quiet, please.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: This day has always irritated me a little. Time goes by one year after another, and my memories also drift further and further away... Hmph, forget it. Hey you, come take a stroll with me on the deck. Maybe some cold wind will help calm me down.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, here you are.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. You remember your birthday, even though you're amnesiac. That has to mean that something really important must've happened on this day… Um, I have your birthday memorized now, and I won't forget it this time.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: For now, I still don't have a way to find my past self, but the process has also shaped who I am today. My days here at Rhodes Island are an important part of that. Doctor, we still have a lot of time together ahead of us. Keep your faith in my sword.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Yo, Doctor! Is it time for my shift? Hmm? I suddenly popped up out of nowhere? Nope, just got here.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: C'mon, man, I worked with you on my background check. And I told you a million times: My last job was with Reunion, sure. But I wasn't mixed up in any of the criminal stuff. No guilt here!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If there's one thing I really hated about Reunion, it was the food! If you can even call it food… My team mostly got by on rock-hard black bread. I had to throw it in a pot and simmer it into stew every time. Those people were just brutal on their stomachs.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You must've run into Reunion's 'Wraith' guys a whole bunch of times, right? I was one of those. They sent me to scout stuff, never did any fighting. I used to place bets on who would or wouldn't get seen as a way to deal with the boredom. Thinking back, I guess that was kind of rough on the other guys.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: What did I do before I joined Reunion? I was playing hide n' seek with the Infected hunters, duh. With my sneaky little power here, they went home empty-handed every time, haha… But all I could do was hide. And that wasn't gonna help change things for the Infected.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I joined up with the underground because I wanted to help other Infected. But over time, I got jaded, then I stopped being a good guy... Well, at least my hands are 'clean' again. What do I mean by that? Hehe, that's enough questions, friend. Never you mind.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Look, camouflage Arts are really complicated! First, you gotta actually know the compisition and texture of your surroundings. Then, you memorize the shape of every crack in the wall, and all the colors of all the soil and every tree. If you don't have those down, even your nerves will get you popping out, and then it's only a matter of time until you're made.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You were the only one in the office, and your snacks disappeared as soon as you turned your head? Wow, that's weird. Why don't you leave it to me? I'll solve this mystery and bring the thief right to you. Yep.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: So this is a map of the operating area? Let's see… Wow, you're really something. Your strategies are so clever, no wonder Reunion always got their asses handed to them. Okay, I'm moving out!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hm? The door isn't locked?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Where am I? Right in front of you! You can call me Ethan. How did I get in here? Haha! Can't answer that one yet.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Where was I? C'mon! Right over there! Look at the top left of screen. Top left corner!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Haha, I told you before right? You won't regret putting work into my hands.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Yo, Doctor. Make sure you remember the little guys like me. I could die in some battle somewhere and nobody would even know I was gone. So please, remember where I am!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The wall moved, right before your eyes? Naw, you're exaggerating, definitely.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Eyyy! I'm the captain now, so you'd all better listen up!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't panic if you suddenly notice a missing squadmate.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Time to fight? I gotta hide first!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hey, over here!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What's the plan?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Let's dance.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Good spot here.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Get 'em! Get 'em good!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Violence can't solve all your problems, but it can solve you!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Haha, you can't see me!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Feel like you're gonna faint?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Are we done fighting? Ahh, I'm beat!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I worked pretty hard. You saw me, right? Right?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: So what if they got away. Just let 'em go.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: You should go first, at least I can grab their legs.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Nice room you got here. Let's see what sticks out the most.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, you found me.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey, wanna go for a stroll?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Bluh, this weather's so nasty my blood's freezing up! That's what gets Savra like us the worst, the cold! Yo, Doctor, turn up the heat a little. C'mon, I'm here to say Happy New Year, don't get mad! Ooh-hoo-hoo, lemme get a nice, hot bowl of soup ready. Gotta fill it with mushrooms and meat...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, somebody looks happy. Did something good happen?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: You're saying you got a present but never saw from who? Huh, that's crazy, must be some paranormal stuff going on here. Why don't we go check the monitors... Hey, wait a sec, you know I'm not for real, right?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Ahh. You know, being an Infected, it's cool to get stable work here. I can even get some little hobbies too. I must've been pretty great in my past life to deserve all this—nah, wouldn't be Infected now, if I was. Man! Forget it, I'm gonna help out with the decorations!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Stand guard? How annoying... Fine.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: That Amiya girl is one of this place's leaders? What a black-hearted company Rhodes Island is.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm not about to freeload here. Just let me know if you need some elbow grease.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I have nothing against taking orders, but I don't like fighting without knowing why I'm doing it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My hobbies? Why should I tell you? Ugh... Alright, alright, I'll tell you. Just stop making that face... I like tinkering.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Without Chiave and Aosta, I'd be a corpse in an alley. I owe them my life. So no matter what they want, I'll help them without a second thought.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I don't hate you, but... I find it difficult to fully trust you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Do what you're told, keep the wolf from the door, live life. They all seemed like simple ideas once to me... But Aosta was right. In a country like Siracusa, things like those aren't ideas, they're dreams.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I gotta say, your leadership skills are decent... But Aosta once said that an organization turns rotten when people let their guard down. So, I'll be keeping a close eye on you.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Asleep? What a carefree Doctor... Gah, where'd the blanket go…?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Since Chiave decided I'm joining you, I don't have much else to say. You can call me Broca. I'll follow your orders, but don't count on me doing anything extra. I have no love for big organizations like yours.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A raise...? Don't particularly need one.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Maybe Aosta was right, maybe Rhodes Island is actually trustworthy. And if so…

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Alright.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: ...I'm not good at leading.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Time to fight.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Don't try to micromanage me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Tch... Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Are those the enemies?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I can handle it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: This won't hurt for long.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Let's get this over with.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Die, you moron!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Shaddap you face.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Alright… You've got a few tricks.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: They've all been taken care of.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Need me to go after them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Relax. You did what you could. Even Aosta makes mistakes.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'll take a look around.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey…!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You're pretty annoying, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor... What? I have to pay for my freeloading. Besides, occasions like these are incredible to me. Comparing to my time in Siracusa, Rhodes Island is decent.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Morning.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've never given anyone a present before, so I'm not too good at picking. Aosta said I should make one myself. Here, it's a block of carving wood, anti-mold treated by me. Tung oil, stops it rotting. When I'm not around, you can move it in front of your desk, and treat it like I'm supervising you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I didn't think I'd run into you here. I just finished cleaning up my workbench— there's been a lot of orders in for weapons lately. Why haven't I been supervising you lately? Because you don't seem like you're about to turn rotten these days. And I approve of your goals. Let's work hard together, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Do you need any help, Doctor? OK, I'll do my homework later then.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Are you curious about my tails? Actually... after I came to Rhodes Island, I realized that I have more tails than the other Vulpo senpais. I don't really know who to talk to about this... But, my dad's colleagues all had a lot of tails... How strange.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Upset? No, no, Doctor. Thank you for asking, but everyone treats me well. I musn't be too needy... Um... Doctor, actually... I feel the bed here is a bit small. It can't hold all my tails. Also, someone's been watering my bonsai. I really want to thank that person, and tell them it doesn't need that much watering...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Amiya Onēsan is really amazing. She always has so many ideas that I never thought of, and she's a great role model. But... She's not an adult yet. She's like me, she'll sometimes feel lost and upset. Doctor, please spend more time with her, okay?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: That first time I took a really long ride from Higashi to Siracusa, I was so surprised! I never knew that other places could look so different. Right now, I mostly stay behind my senpais, and not everything that happens is good... But I really cherish my life here. Mhm!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The flame that my dad creates is so pretty, shining like a crystal even though it is fire. After I came to Rhodes Island, I realized that it is the power dad uses to protect others. That means… I can use what he taught me to help my senpais here! Yoshi! I'll continue to do my best!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
