lines.text: Since my arm was hurt, my mom almost never lets me go out. I don't blame her. In fact, I'm worried about her. She's always fighting bad people... I mustn't cause her more trouble and let her worry. If I behave myself on Rhodes Island, she won't worry, right? Mom is super strong when she's focused!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, what we're doing is very hard, right? I haven't been an operator for very long, and even though my senpais are always chatting and laughing, I can feel they are hiding their worries and feelings... If I can become a bit stronger, do you think I can help them share their troubles?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, you... you lost your memories? Is that true? Dr. Kal'tsit just told me about this today... Um, Doctor, please rest for the day! Even the Doctor needs time to think about life and not work, yes? Just leave the rest to me and, um, Amiya Onēsan! Hehe!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: The Doctor will catch a cold like this. I'll need to find a blanket…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Rhodes Island Operator, Lisa... Ah, I mean, Suzuran! Operator Suzuran! It's the codename I chose for myself. Starting today, I'm officially an operator, I will do my best!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: So this is how my senpais fight... Sugoi...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, earlier today, Dr. Kal'tsit praised me... Eh? A promotion? Not just praise? Ehh…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Look, Doctor! This is my Originium Arts! I've been working hard on this! Now, will I be able to go to more places with my senpais, see more things, and help more people?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Field missions are rare for me. I will do my very best!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Eh? I'll be leading my senpais? Okay, leave it to me! As the captain, I mustn't show weakness!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Operation, start.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Visual on hostile! Uhh… can't we persuade them to give up?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ah, understood!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor, orders please!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Relax, relax.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: We can do this! Yeah!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Be careful!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Is everybody okay? Anyone need help?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Hang in there!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Please hold on!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: So this is the actual battlefield that my senpais faced... Doctor, I think we can do even better. I can do even better.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, did I do a good job? I didn't hold the others back, right? Really? That's great…

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, are you okay? There are friendlies injured? I, I'm on it!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Sorry, if only I were stronger…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I've lived here for a long time, so I won't get lost.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor! Oh, would you like some cupcakes? I was planning to take these to everyone in the Medical Department, but you also work very hard. So please, help yourself!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Ah, Happy New Year, Doctor. Here, have some snacks I just baked. I'll be helping the kitchen make lots of tasty treats today. Please remember to take a good rest today, Doctor! It's not often we have a day off, so let's enjoy it with our friends.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ah, Doctor. Remember to take enough rest, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, could you bend down a bit for me? Yep, thanks. Now open your hands. Oh, and keep your fingers together... Now then... Hmm... Yoshi! Here, Doctor. Dad taught me how to draw a blessing talisman. I have written it on your palm. It'll give you good luck for the next year. Hehe, Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: ...Hm? Oh, hi, Doctor. Everyone's busy today, and I'm going to help Amiya Onēsan— Mm? What was I thinking about? I... I was wondering how mom and dad are doing. Do you think I'll have a chance to visit them, Doctor?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I am come! Doctor, so long as I am here, thou mayst be at ease in thy work!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I grew up in a monastery in Higashi. Though I could recite the scriptures by heart, I never could understand their true meanings. The great masters, among whom my old head priest, offered explanations I could comprehend even less. Doctor, you seem learned, mayst thou be able to teach me?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island truly lacks none for novel machinery… Hm? Doctor, underestimate me not. I may begin clueless, but I flow on with the times and learn what I know not. Even now, my music player plays the songs of the good Miss Sora.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: To avoid Catastrophe, Head Priest led us on a long journey over mountains and valleys. He said that Catastrophes are the wrath of the devas. I am somewhat curious, as I have yet to witness them with my own eyes.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I am not a true monk, merely raised by the monastery. At my departure, Saga was the name that Head Priest gave to me. It means high mountains and rugged roads. Only when I left the monastery, did I realize that the world was no straightforward thing.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I fear neither hardships nor trials, but there is one thing I do not understand. Head Priest says that all lives are equal. If so, then why must the Infected suffer like no other?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Hoho. I may have accidentally joined the line for Rhodes Island recruitment, but the food and beds here are exceptional! And even a monk like me finds the pay appealing! This truly is a wonderful place.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When I left the monastery, I had imagined no difficulty in entering society. It would merely have me set some rogues right, rid it of a few villains. Yet I found the ways of these lands are so unpredictable and complex. At times, I do not even know why I wield my naginata. Doctor… I am lost.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I still have many unanswered questions, but I now know that some answers and revelations can only be discovered by myself. Until everything becomes clear, please allow me to continue my training by your side!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor… your skill of sleeping while sitting is most impressive. In that case, I shall meditate for a while.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You are the Doctor? Hi… No, I mean it is an honor to be in your presence. My name is Saga, a wandering monk from Higashi. Should there be any place thou mayst need me, refrain not in sending me!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hoho, to think such strategy does exist in the world. My horizons have broadened.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A raise? Splendid! My mouth has long been watering for the deluxe set at the cafeteria. Yet my pocket has been embarrassingly dry… Today, I am finally able to feast!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Dear Head Priest. My mind still rages with confusion. The ways of this land remain obscured, and its troubles unsevered. Fortunately, I have come under the guidance of another great mentor. With all that I learn, one day I shall slash a way out of the troubles, and bring the dawn to all who suffer!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I come forth!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I am to be the captain? Very well!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I go forth!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: My blade cuts only evil!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Pickled daikon radish… Hah! I am right here!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Leave this to me!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: The monk is here!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Evil will not be tolerated!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Sever all desires!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Cleanse the six senses!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Rice with nattou!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Fried tofu!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Twas truly an arduous trial. I have gained much from it.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: As expected of the Doctor! Alone, I would surely have let quite a few through.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Head Priest said that one must have a merciful heart. I believe we may relent.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, go quickly! I shall take up the rear!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Something smells good?!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh!?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Call, and I shall surely come running.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Ah, Doctor. Happy New Year. I am writing a letter. My travels have kept me away from the monastery for some years, and I have grown used to my current life. Yet at days like this, I can't help but miss Head Priest and the other disciples. Perhaps it is time for a visit.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, hast thou eaten? An unfilled stomach will surely leave thee powerless at work.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Today is the day of your birth. One's birth has two meanings: to be delivered into this realm, and to transcend from it. Head priest once told me to transcend from this realm is to realize sunyata, that all things are empty. However, I believe it calls for seeking not a realm bare and void, but a self at ease and free.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Head Priest once said, 'For that which must be done, act despite the impossibility.' I used to think it was a simple statement. After all, there were no tasks that could not be done, only those that should and should not be done. But as my travels continued, I realized it was a profound truth, worthy of acting upon for my entire life.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Let's just burn 'em. You weren't gonna give those papers a second look anyway.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: If you wanted me to lay defenses in here, I'd break up the floor for starters. Not that I mind, it's for you to think about.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Got twps from Royal Guard knocking about, have you? Heh, ain't that interesting.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Calibrate the sight? Nah, materials I ordered last should be here almost, I'll make the arrows first... Oh, push off, out my way.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Most who leave Vouivre don't agree with the mercenary life in Sargon. Move to Victoria, end up doing something else instead, they do. Like... factory-working, farming, you know. Having their own little touch of land.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You could probably tell, but I didn't use to be artillery. Mainly studied recon, infiltration, CQC, all that. Did not bloody take to it, and the instructors wouldn't let me switch courses, so I dropped out, simple as. What's the point in learning things you hate?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Oh, you're helpless! How am I going to the workshop wearing this?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: It's meant for attacking nomadic cities, this weapon. Using it to help you lot cope with skirmishers? It's like a hatchet to a cupcake. Let me try hitting a city or two sometime for practice, won't you?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Don't you think these crystals on my shoulder here match well with my hair color? I like my off-the-shoulder clothes too, so it's perfect. Shame, though, it would've been nice if they covered the whole way like that Siracusan Messenger girl.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'll be heading back to sort stuff out, then. No point wasting time on this rotter.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Arianrot, codename Toddifons. I don't like working for ordinary people, so I've got my fingers crossed you show me something unusual.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Boring. Off we go.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What goes on in those Logistics' minds? Oh, look what Arianrot made, let's just grab it and... For me? Tch, fine. I accept. Your feelings are loud and clear. Thanks, see you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You've seen a Draco's flames before, I bet you anything. You ever imagined, the sight of them raining down on your enemy? I can make that your reality!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm listening.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Work's on. Focus.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: You lot go ahead. I've got things to prepare.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Visibility clear. Awaiting orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Still not done?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Iawn?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Mounting complete.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: In position.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I don't need visuals. Give me the map.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This area is cleared. Next!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Nothing remains once the arrows rain!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Ha! Fire wouldn't go out while there's something left to burn!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: There's only so many who can make this thing shine—guess you're one of them.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Out without too much ash on me. Gwych.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Ammo's more precious than that little lot. Deal with 'em yourself.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Still good to move? We're heading home. Grab on.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Like this titchy bit of space is enough? Let's break this wall down and I'll have the whole area behind, Diolch.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Think it through before you put your hand out.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Go on if you need something. Don't wait for me to change my contacts, I can hear you whatever color they are.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Yeah, New Year's, there's a party, the whole song and dance, I get it. And that's why I'm sitting right here, having a drink with my magazines, while you carry on moaning and whinging. Trust me, that's my happy times.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: So it's you. If you need something, out with it.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Oh? Birthday, then, today. How about we head deckside to celebrate? I'll give you my little siege ballista, can set off some massive fireworks? Oh, too dangerous? Tch, you sopping wet blanket. Whatever, off to the shops then, pick you out a proper present. Well? Get changed already, we're off.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Oripathy comes second, I've said that. If I'm not able to do what I like, that's not life no matter how long it drags out. And you know, being here, Rhodes Island, I always get a crack at something interesting. I half like it working with you lot. So don't you ever go letting me down.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, anything I can help with?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Ahhh... A hot shower every day is a blessing... After I got infected and had to move all over the place, it was hard for me to take a hot shower. Besides, the food here is decent. Oh, I just love Rhodes Island!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: 'April'? 'April' is a song about spring. The lyrics describe the feeling of lying on the grass on a warm spring day, looking up at the sky and letting your mind wander. Wanna hear it, Doctor? I'm sure you'll love it.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Strange, where's my lip gloss...? Oh, right. I lent it to Rope. Nah yeah, I was gonna teach her to do makeup. She's a fine looking girl. I bet she'll be even cuter after a little sprucing up.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Back in Rim Billiton, the companies promise a pension for the Infected, but you only get scraps in the end. And it's hard to find a job... Good thing I decided to try Rhodes Island as soon as I saw the ad. I feel appreciated around here.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: After I got infected, people started asking me things like 'what's an Infected wearing such bright colors for' and 'what's an Infected listening to music for'... And my answer's always the same: 'It's what I like.'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Back in Rim Billiton, I was a professional hunter. I had to keep the beasts away from the city and sometimes escort company people. But… after I got Oripathy, I lost my job and had to hunt on my own for a living. It was real rough…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My parents died in a mining accident when I was little, and I grew up on a company pension, so I was always real grateful to the company. I figured getting Oripathy was my own dumb fault... But there's more to it than that, isn't there, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doing something for the Infected... I never thought about it before. I mean, it's hard enough to keep yourself alive. But after coming to Rhodes Island, I decided I wanted to try to do something not just for myself, but for everyone who suffers like me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, if you wanna nap, I can lend you my earplugs.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Gosh, Rhodes Island has great pay and benefits… Oh, sorry, Doctor, I'm just a little shocked. My codename is April. Nah yeah, it's the name of my favorite song.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Wow, the professionals here are really something.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Wha? A raise...? Oh, it's not that I'm disappointed, I'm stoked! It's just been a long, long time since anyone told me I was doing a good job.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Back in Rim Billiton, I liked to sit on the roof and listen to my music while I watched the whole city go by. Now, I can see even more from the bridge of Rhodes Island. I'd call that a silver lining after getting infected, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: All righty!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Follow close now, everyone!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Here we go!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Earphones on, let's get started!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My bow is ready!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Who's the target?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Nice visibility.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Let's put on some Billy Bounce.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Now this is a good rhythm!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I've got a lock on you.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: This one won't miss!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Such a tough battle! Doctor, need some slow music to calm your nerves?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Didn't miss a single one.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, a few got away, should we chase them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, go, I'll cover you!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: No matter how much I wander around Rhodes Island, it still feels so big.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hmm, the Doctor should be in the office right now...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Around this time of the year, I was usually in the wilderness all by myself, trying to get warm by the campfire, watching the fireworks in the cities far away. That's usually how I found out it was New Year's. Exciting enough, but I'd rather be counting down with everyone else. Happy New Year, Doctor. Keep looking after me this year, yeah?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, wanna hear some tunes?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I'm here to hang out! What do you want to do today? Karaoke? Shopping? Oh, I know a place where you can try archery. They even give out prizes for their contests. I'll shoot a few arrows, and whatever I win with my pro skills, it's going to be your birthday present!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Getting infected didn't make my hunting any worse. But the company still fired me for catching Oripathy. I'd say it's their loss, but to be honest, joining Rhodes Island was a stroke of luck for me. I only hope other Infected out there can be just as happy.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: No problem, Doctor. I've got your back.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: How do I aim while I'm skatin'? It's a piece'a cake, no sweat. Wanna see? C'mere, put your hand on mine.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Back in the day, me and my friends thought it was sick as hell to be different. But once I got infected, I found out that wasn't cool at all. You don't let a little Originium dust run your life, you gotta grab the wheel n' steer.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: An old cop taught me how to shoot a crossbow, n' his daughter threw in skateboardin' lessons. How'd I put 'em together? Pure street genius—straight up self-taught.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Don't get it twisted, skateboardin's just one of my jams... It's the first way I ever really found myself. But the good stuff comes after that. Wanna hear the whole story?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Why'd I wanna be a combat operator...? Doc, lemme ask you: what's the one thing us rowdy street kids really live for? Freedom, straight up. I'm cool to throw down for freedom, an' that's why I'm with Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I'm real broken up about bein' Infected, y'know? Like that park mural I was sprayin'—left that one half-done. And I'm never gonna get those secret-recipe onion rings from that old cop again. Huh? That's all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I came to Rhodes Island to get some help with this disease. Thought it'd be some sterile place that reeked of disinfectant, everyone all shut up in their rooms... But man was I surprised. Even though you don't allow tagging inside the cabins, that Ethan guy... Y'know what, never mind.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I figured out how to express myself with donut hamburger combos, skateboarding, and rap battles. What's your deal, Doctor? If you're feelin' burnt out, come kick it with me and Vigna. We'll... hang out. Hanging out is in our DNA. Gotta respect that.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: If you're tired, just go rest. I'll be here.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Aciddrop, Operator. This skateboard's a registered piece of equipment, got it? Any issues, just hit me up.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Damn, that's cool.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion, huh? Thanks. Tryin' to remember the last time somethin' like this went down. Gotta be after I won the Crab Cup…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The old man taught me to use a crossbow just so I could protect myself from the streets. Who woulda thought I'd end up usin' it to defend the freedom of the Infected.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: You got it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Teamwork's an important part of scoring too.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's roll.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy sighted.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm right here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: C'mon, how should I deal with these guys?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Now I'm all pumped up.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Some sweet terrain to ride.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ollie!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Time to show off a bit.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'm over here.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Kickflip, then kick ass.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Good work out there, Doctor... Oh, could you help me swap a couple of bolts when we get back?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That moment you clear a challenge always gets me all hyped up.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Should we chase after 'em? If you ask me, I can still catch up.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ugh... Can't believe this amateur wipeout...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This looks perfect for a throw… Uh, I didn't say nothin'.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wahh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Wanna head to the canteen together? If I nail this trip without any wipeouts, promise you'll treat me to some juice.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Oh, Doctor, Happy New Year! We've got a block party in a bit. Why don't you come show off your moves? You could give breakdancin' a shot? It ain't that hard, I'll teach ya!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: You're still working? Let's go get some exercise outside. Wait, you volunteered for overtime? Doctor, ain't no point in workin' this much. Life only begins once you clock out! C'mon, what do you wanna eat? It's on me.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I used to skate to ditch class n' get away from the adults. Then, it was to lose the cops when I was out tagging. I said I did it in the name of freedom, but thinkin' back, I guess that was kinda selfish. We fight harder for other people's freedom than our own, don'tcha think? Like what we're doin' here.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Fine. At least I can get a break from the dusty air outside, if I stay here with you.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I don't shy away from sensitive discussions about the Infected? That's true. They're obviously different from us. But they also have the right to seize hope, just like us. So they don't need me to do anything special for them. That's equality, isn't it?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Blaze is too reckless sometimes. I know she's strong, but… What? You know how to handle her?  Forget it, I'll ask Amiya what I should do to get along with her after we get back.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I was just speaking objectively. If you don't want to be discriminated against, then you shouldn't expect special treatment... What, she went back to her room crying? Look, I feel a little bad about it, but is someone that fragile really operator material?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island is changing, Doctor. Maybe you don't feel it, since you're the reason it's changing, and not everyone is so annoyingly outspoken as I am. Anyway, I do appreciate the direction Rhodes Island is moving.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I used to prefer long-distance missions, like I was running away from Rhodes Island. I'll admit that was a little ungrateful, considering Rhodes Island adopted me. But now? Hehe, if you still have operators who like splattering blood all over the place, maybe I'll apply to serve in some faraway place again.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, would you sometimes feel afraid? Catastrophes, Originium, Oripathy, and the Infected? Hm, I'm still plagued by nightmares even now. But these days, I have Amiya, and idiots like that Blaze. I guess I'm not as afraid as I used to be.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Why are you called 'Doctor?' No, I'm not trying to get you to remember anything, it's just that title makes me very... wistful. Looking at all the Infected around you... Brings to mind a little bit of the past.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I've known the whole time. When my mother brought me to Rhodes Island, she'd already lost her mind. I didn't feel the pain her inner conflicts caused her, but I can relate to it, because I relied on that obsession to get me to where I am today. Only now, I've found a new direction... I want to find her, and I want to save her.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You shoulder the future of Rhodes Island. And with the burden of that responsibility, you can't be so lackadaisical.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: So you're the Doctor? Amiya told me about you. I'm GreyThroat. Please don't disappoint me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: For efficiency's sake, speed up the playback. I'll still be able to see it all clearly.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Even now, I'm still on bad terms with a handful of operators. My promotion might spark controversy, just a reminder.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Whether Infected or not, we all choose to walk upon this land of our own free will. And so we must all work hard to survive, right?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I prefer working alone.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Whether or not they'll listen to my orders is another matter.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: A panoramic view of the battlefield.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I just have to rout them, right?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Too slow.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll get going then.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Can the others keep up?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Such slow movements.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I see them. Too bad they don't see me.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'm skilled enough to resolve this.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't worry, their sights are totally empty.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: We won't see many victories like this, since our power is limited.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I have no talent to speak of. So as a crossbowman, I can't let an enemy within three meters. Not even a corpse.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The medics should stay behind to tend the wounded. I will chase after them, considering I'm used to working alone anyway.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Watch your flanks. I'll cover our retreat.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I've been here for years, but I rarely wander around inside…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Aren't you afraid of upsetting the Infected operators if they see you with me all the time?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Dr.{@nickname}. Where's Amiya? She's setting up the party tonight with the others? Then I'll just wait here. Blaze is looking for me? Did she already see the gift I left on her desk? I—I'm worried she's going to say something cheesy again. I'm leaving.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Dr.{@nickname}, this is my birthday present for you. Unfortunately, it's a little rough, since I used a little gap in time when the kitchen was free to make it. Though, a few operators did help me, and I think I rescued one of them before...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You still have a lot to do, don't you? Blaze understands me because we fight together, but it's not as if any two people, or groups, who disagree will have a similar chance. I'm very lucky... which is why I need to be more responsible—until the day when we can all sleep soundly.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Do you think me Lady of the Office? This is work for grown-ups.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Don't take Iris's songs so literally. They're meant for the young ones, you know. What? Yes, I'm the guard with the scissors—what about it? Chop-chop? That's the sound of me making clothes—what did YOU think it was? Huh... adults, honestly. So eager to assume the worst.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Preservation techniques? Huh, fat chance. Even Iris hasn't the faintest clue about how I safekeep things. Why should I let YOU know?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Let me introduce Annie to you. She's my very best friend, and another 'me.'

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Don't ask me. I don't know why the Castle takes deposits from everywhere, just to send them back out. Granny wants me doing it, so I do. Don't you know? I hear adults call that work. It's when someone has to do it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Annie's just the quiet sort, nothing at all like me. C-Controlling her? What are you talking about? She's a whole person, she goes where she wants to! She's only by my side because she likes being with me. That's what best friends do. Isn't it, Annie? 'Mm.'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: With all the children here, it's no wonder Iris doesn't want to leave. Hrmm... if this carries on, we'd be better off plonking the whole Castle of Dreams here onto Rhodes Island. That'd save so much time and effort.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Good girl this and good girl that, are you saying that I'm not good?—Well, I suppose sometimes you can't just do as you please. You have to 'act' a little, Granny says. Act how? Well... 'My greetings to you. I come from the County of Linton. Bena is my name.' Something like that, you know!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Granny brought me into the Castle when I was young, and I grew up there, and once she retired, I took over her whole job. What could I have in common with Iris, Little Miss Heir-to-the-Castle? What, you think I'm jealous? Dream on! Iris has to watch her figure, but me? I can eat all I want without putting on a pound!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: 'Rest soundly. Doctor.' Who cares about that Doctor? Come on, let's go out and play! 'Alright.'

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Bena, and I was here to fetch an idiot who went out and forgot to come home. But I hear she still has things to do, so I'll just stay a while and keep her company.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oh, you can't show something this violent to Annie and me.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Ah-hah! See, you do know how to play by children's rules!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Annie, are you ready? We're going to show this hooded hoodlum what our Arts are made of! 'Alright, Bena.'

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Two people for a single job. This won't be tricky.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Attention, please! Annie's told me of some brilliant ideas.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's just take it like a walk in the forest.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: So you want to pull these toys apart too?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hehehee.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Don't you rush me!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Annie, don't go too far.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Have to be careful, now.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: It's trimming time!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Chop-chop!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Whatever breaks needs a fixing.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: If there's no fixing it, smash it to pieces.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: What did you expect? I'm a dab hand at doing bad things to bad people!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No one else in need of a trim?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Leave the rest to the adults, then. We're going home.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Annie, where are you?!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hang on, this room's a little small. We're two people here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wagh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Annie's off on an adventure. Want to come along?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Well, happy New Year to you. Annie and I are taking our crack at the Yanese lantern tradition. This one's for Granny, may she live a long and healthy life. And this one's for you, may you... err... you know what, make your own wish...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, no hiding things! What's that you're playing with?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: It just baffles me! How can you all be so happy to have your birthdays? One year older is one year further from your childhood innocence. Honestly... here, a new pillow for you. Take it and dream sweet dreams. I wish that you keep that child at heart of yours alive... forever and ever.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It's all over the shop today, isn't it! Let me take some photos for you. One, two... Good, these merry moments are safe and sound now. If you ever want to relive the memories of today, just come see me at the Castle.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hey Doctor, what can I help you with today? Have a chat to stave off the boredom? Or, did you have something interesting to tell me?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Was that Savage who just passed by in the hallway? Back when the autonomous county was established, and later when it reached a cooperation agreement with Rim Billiton, her exploits were no less impressive than mine, you know?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You know, some places have really problematic stereotypes about us Cautus. Why do they call me timid when I'm just good at avoiding danger? As a matter of fact, isn't it more accurate to say that only those who've delved deep into danger can become masters of avoiding it?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: C'mon, I've been a good boy. I'm getting all my regular checkups, taking my medicine, doing everything I'm supposed to. It's just the Medical lass is so uptight when she's recording my details. I can't help but play a prank or two, just so she'll loosen up a bit. Hehe. Oh, but don't tell that to the other medics.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, my buddy, Rhodes Island doesn't have a mandatory dress code, so there's no need for you to wear the same old rags all the time. Look at what I'm wearing - this store's got some pretty tasteful stuff, so how about I help you pick out a new look?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm actually pretty fond of Rhodes Island. Unlike those bigwigs who can't stop preaching about their greatness, everyone here's just trying to achieve their goals and working together to keep this ship sailing. Just like the folks in Rim Billiton.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The one in my hand? It's a standard-issue Billy blaster that I modified. Before I got my hands on it, it also used to be an Originium-powered focus for Casters. Hmm... Doctor, you're not thinking that smashing rocks with brute force would be efficient, are you?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Ah, so you're also interested in the Eureka Incident, Doctor? It's not like there's any secrets left untold, since any of the books or documentaries worth their salt tell pretty much the whole story. But... I wish they had some more details on how I rescued those hostages. Nah yeah, I dismantled a lot of those cages after all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: It's common for mining teams to hire Catastrophe Messengers. Since I was born on a mining ship and was always interested in technical books, being a Catastrophe Messenger means basically applying what I already knew. But Doctor, where'd you get your knowledge from? I don't see any relevant literature here...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Wanted to take a little nap? No worries, I'll wake you up unceremoniously in the event of emergency!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Leonhardt, Catastrophe Messenger. Doctor, you may have heard of me... No? Ah well~ it's better that way. Seems I won't have to tell the whole story again, like I did when that HR lady cornered me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Looks like my skills are better suited for positional warfare.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? Haha, great! Wait a second. It doesn't come with some sort of exclusive, blinged-out elite uniform? C'mon, even a small ornament would be nice. No? Aww…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The road that Rhodes Island's chosen is much bumpier than that of us Catastrophe Messengers, but you don't seem to have any intent on stopping. Well, I suppose I'll have to sacrifice some of my leisure time to help you clear the road then?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Mission time~! Let's see… Oh, it's a fight today!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You want me to lead the team? Mmmm… Alright. Leave it to me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: So this is the route to the objective... Can I take a shortcut?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let's see if our enemies have anything to offer besides numbers.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hm? Which direction? Where?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor, you'll save a nice spot for me right?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Woo~ It's finally my turn!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Lure some more enemies into the ring, then leave the rest to me!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Who says a spear is only good for stabbing people?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Relying on your armor will only leave you vulnerable.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Strength in numbers, huh? Is that what you were banking on?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Let's see whether you're gold or manure!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Bam! Another mighty enemy laid low. Alright, Doctor, let's have you treat yourself like we agreed before. You and me, we're gonna visit a market at our next stop.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Enemies of this caliber pose no threat to us, right?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Cleaning up stragglers isn't really my strong suit. You oughta find someone to send after them right away, before you lose points off your combat evaluation.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Whoops, looks like we messed up. Doctor, go ahead and withdraw first. Don't worry, as long as I'm here, there's no chance of the enemy catching up.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Maybe I should go to Procurement to check out the new outfits? Or maybe not?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm? Need me for something?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What's the matter, you wanna take me out for a walk?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's New Year's again. When I was a boy, this day meant one thing: the adults on the ship were coming to pat the heads of the children and ask 'Have you grown taller?' I didn't much care for… Hey! Stop it! Doctor, no patting my head!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Yo, Doctor, done with work for the day?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Look! I chose this outfit just for you. Trust me, you'll turn heads all around Rhodes Island in this getup! The top is too short? The pants are too flashy? Hey, c'mon, that's fashion!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The old miners on the ship used to say, 'Every ship hides a story,' and so does Rhodes Island... Haha, just kidding, I'm not here for corporate espionage! But even if you have some secrets, I'm willing to trust you, Doctor. When the time comes for me to know, I'm sure you'll trust me too, right?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Thermal-EX, ready to commence thermal shock! What, the designated combat time has not been reached yet? Then, I shall postpone it. Commencing thermal shock after a delay of 10 seconds!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I have heard an expression from the East: 'No martial art is infallible, except for heat.'

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, it's great to be with you! My burning heart won't calm down! —I'm talking about the Raythean Industries custom-made full-thermal Arts impact generator on my body!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: In the beginning, God said, 'Let there be light,' and there was light. God said, 'Let there be power,' and there was the high-performance variant of Raythean's Challenger Hellcat.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: As a perfect industrial-grade mass-produced combat platform, I am very happy now! Not only do I get regular performance optimizations from Mayer, but I even get to work with passionate partners like Blaze! Life is so good!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Even though I'm already this dazzling, only you, the peerless Doctor, are worthy of becoming the brightest sun!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I know that the heat and light I emit is so very short-lived... But all that matters is that I can illuminate the path before you, Doctor!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Even when you're asleep, I can continue to work as your heater! I'm incredible!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Born from Raythean Industries, improved by the hands of the great Mayer. I, Thermal-EX, the throbbing heart of hotness, am here to help!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ohhhhh! This power blazing within me... It's… It's… It's a hotfix!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Now, it's my turn to show off!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What's the situation?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All units, move out!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Rock and roll!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready to launch!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Charging up!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm here to help!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Detonation imminent!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Sonic boom—!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Deploying thermal shock!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Watch this!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Praise the heat!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Aren't I awesome? I knew your command would be a perfect match for me, Doctor!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: BRAVO~ BRAVO~!!!! Doctor!!!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: My retreat was just a fluke. Nothing must be allowed through our net on the battlefield.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Contact! Contact! Enemy ambush! Dropping smoke! Doctor, I'll cover your retreat!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rest? Haha, it's too early for me! I just swapped to the newest energy storage device, so we have fifty more hours until the end of the workday!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: A-ha! My thermal sensor feels your burning heart!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Your burning enthusiasm has melted my processor!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! There's too much excess and zero majesty to playing songs on Monster Siren hi-fis and related devices! Allow me to use a hotter, more direct method to boost the vigor of this fireworks show! BANG!! Pewwwwww... BANG!!!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Welcome back, Doctor! I see that you're also full of light and heat today!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I hear the others are expressing their feelings of fondness for you by way of gifts, but you and I have no need for such tedious things to express our emotions! Our hearts have long been connected through heat and impact! Doctor! Happy birthday!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor!! Even I'm dazzled by the liveliness of this spectacle! Hesitate no more, come with me! Let us celebrate with the others!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Am I really going to be helpful? Um... alright, if you say so...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hmm... your hair is close to coming out of your hood. If you've got the time, remember to give it a trim.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I can't use anything like a compass. No matter what I do, they all end up pointing at me. *Sigh*... I had no clue as a child, so I tried to use them to find my way home... Now that I think about it, I'm lucky I have a sense of direction.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You wanna touch my ears? Of course, touch them however you want... but people usually only do it a tiny bit. Why? Heheh, you'll find out if you try, won't you?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My Arts are... how do I put it? They affect a lot of things, but because they don't have a form, it's hard to grasp them properly... if I can get a handle on their nature some day, I might be able to live a normal life.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Static electric pulse theory says... okay, okay, I see. I just need to apply my Arts Unit, and start the antistatic equipment up, and that should... Yagh! That's not working at all. Where did I mess it up...? Here? Alright, once more.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Welcome~! Oh, Doctor! You finally decided to get your hair sorted, then? Good, sit down. Today, I'll be your... That's right, it's a salon in here, you're not imagining things. Um, don't go! This is my speciality, trust me, please! You won't regret this, I guarantee!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My dad told me I should pick up another craft in addition to Originium Arts, so this is what I went with. It turns out the only hair I can't fix is my own... Okay! How's that? Are there any bits you want fixed? None? Heheh, I thought as much. Alright, I'm finished for the day, then.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Before I got Infected, I was actually in really good shape. I got second place in a cross-country race! Once my Oripathy's a bit better, I want to start training again, and carry the gold medal back. Can I ask you to present it to me, Doctor? Heheh, then it's a promise.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: The circuit's grounded... okay, now my hair shouldn't poof out. I'll have a break while the Doctor's asleep.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Finally made it here... nice to meet you, Doctor. I'm a new Operator onboard, Goldenglow. I look forward to working under you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Mmgh... it still doesn't really make sense. Maybe I should visit my Instructor and see if she can help.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: There's no tingling feeling, is there? If not, we should be fine. Okay! I'll accept this medal from you graciously, Doctor. Thank you!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor! Stay away from here! I just need a—a-are you alright?! Are you hurt anywhere? I took all the protective measures, didn't I? Why...

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Is there really a use for me on the front?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Doctor, are you sure I should be the captain?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I've got this, I've got this. I can do this!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: There's enemies?!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm so tense...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Can I really do it?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Now's the time to help everyone out.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll do my best!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Get away from me, please!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Stay back!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Yaah!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Keep a good distance—there!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Huh? Oh—no, it's nothing! Let's get going!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I managed to help a little, didn't I? Heheh.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew, we're finally saved. Are you hurt?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We were so, so close...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I need to keep away from the electronics...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hwah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Could you help me comb my hair down? Thank you so much, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! My family sent me all of this stuff. This is bread my mum baked, these biscuits are from my oldest brother, and my sister cured this meat—she's eighth-oldest. I think that's mostly it. Don't be shy, let's tuck in together! ...Eep! Did I accidentally shock you again, Doctor?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hope you have another good day today.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: If today was my birthday, I'd be on a sofa at home with my brothers and sisters. We'd be eating and drinking and playing until all end up falling asleep and waking up the next day. But never mind that, you're the star for today, Doctor. Do you want a new look? Well, how about I trim a new hairstyle for you? Mm-hm! Great, let's do it!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, look, I can control my static away from my staff now! Maybe with a bit more time, I'll be able to master my Arts. Then I can hug my mum all I want, without having to worry about shocking her! Mm-hm, I need to keep at it!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: If you've got something to say, spit it out. I ain't got all day, you know?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Eep! You idiot, touch my tail again and I'll smack ya into next week! And you best forget whatever sound you just heard, or I'll make ya forget, the hard way.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This ol' door I have here? Can't you tell? I made it myself, it's multifunctional. Hands off if you know what's good for ya, or you might get yourself killed.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Gotta say, scabbin' a lift on this big ol' ship gets me to places faster than my own two legs. Besides, you lot are headin' all over the shop anyway. Mm, yeah, I guess I've changed my view towards you guys a little.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Don't lump me in with Magallan. I ain't no pro explorer, just someone trampin' it around the lands chasin' thrills. Trailblazin' for the benefit of others? Ha, do I look that noble?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: What am I doin' this for? The danger and the thrill, mate. What's life without a little craziness, eh?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Magallan? I met her at the Black Flow. That tiny, overzealous videographer girl made that adventure the noisiest one yet. But I gotta admit, the li'l ripper's got some real chops.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Friend? Pfft, who needs that? I'd much rather be a complete jerk and keep things simple: you don't like me, and I don't like you. On second thought, I could use a drinking mate tonight... Oi, you in or what?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My Oripathy? Yeah yeah, I know it's bad, but as long as I ain't bothering no one, how I deal with it is my business. To me, it's real simple: dying on a journey seems like an alright way to go. You can try to save me, if you think you're all that. Do your worst, Doctor. Bet you couldn't if you tried.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sleeping, huh? Good time to make some noise. Ahaha!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Alright, so here's the deal. I'll be out exploring for most of the year, but you still need to pay me full wage, and keep a dorm room for me. Think you can accept—Wait, you agree? Ha! You must be off your rocker.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Whatever. Guess I learned some self-defense.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Me? 'Honorary Captain of the Rhodes Island Expedition Team?' The hell?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I can't promise I'll do any good for Rhodes Island, that's not my style. But I can promise you this: if there are any mysteries on this land you want uncovered, then I'm your gal.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Teamwork? Give me a break…

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Ugh, Doctor, If you wanna make my life hard, just say it to my face.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: If you can't keep up, just find something to keep yourself busy.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ugh... What a pain in the proverbial.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yeah, yeah.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Fine, fine.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Sure, sure.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Righto, mate.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Suck it, loser!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Here's a door for ya!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You're pathetic as hell!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Piss off already!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I've braved savage winds and waves. This is nothin' but smooth sailing.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: This sucks. I was hopin' for an adventure.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Enough, mate. Let's call it a day.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ugh... Am I supposed to say 'there there' now...?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Time to head back to the dorms for a kip.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh right, gotta take a trip to the Doctor's office first…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Ahh crap, I forgot it's New Year's. Shouldn't have come back. I hate huge crowds like this... Even those Archosauria we came across in Sargon weren't this rowdy… Huh? Wait, wait! What're you grabbing my hand for? Let go! I'm going back to my room!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Got nothin' better to do again, eh?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Fine, fine, whatever! Take this and get out of my face! What kind of person are you, asking people to give you a present? Gah… Alright, mate, you got your gift. Now shut up, and get out!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Damn. And I thought New Year's would be the only special holiday here. Didn't know you got another one. Guess I picked just the right bloody time to come back. Shh-sh-sh, hold it right there. You want to talk, fine, but we'll talk over drinks. Otherwise, keep your trap shut.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hmm, is this the Doctor's room? Painfully sterile. Reminds me of Sargon's monotonous hilly terrain. Wouldn't hurt to install a game console, would it?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Dr.{@nickname}, I feel something resonating between us. Weird, right? Is it because we both have so much untapped potential? But you've forgotten your past. Feels like freedom to you? Or just another level of pain?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I take greater pride in natural wisdom than indoctrinated knowledge, Dr.{@nickname}! With Rhodes Island on my side, both you and I will grow ever-closer to the Great Truth. Hey, don't avert your gaze. Oh, are you feeling a touch... embarrassed?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: 'I wish to bridge the gap to the other side.' That was once a code phrase used to contact me. The bridge connects two lands, transferring wisdom and imbuing power... Hey, let me finish. Turning away mid-sentence? How terribly discourteous!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island is home to some folk devoid of aesthetic sensibility. A disguise isn't just a superficial layer, but an art of meticulous refinement. Without careful cultivation, one merely appears... disheveled. You think my clothing looks tattered? Ha! You simply fail to comprehend my nuanced style...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Do you believe weapons have souls? The things they've experienced, the hands that have wielded them, and the reasons they've been swung... No! These aren't souls. For a weapon, any belief or meaning is externally imposed. Tell me, are we the weapons, or are we the ones imposing souls onto others?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: A genius? Do such beings truly exist...? In Sargon, most craftsmen appear to me as mere apprentices still learning to walk, tinkering with metal. Yet, walk long enough, and even they may traverse the entire path.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Do you need my help refining a weapon? My skills are best kept hidden under a bushel. 'Enabling universal weapon access is tantamount to creating war'—this self-imposed shackle I must bear. Or... do you seek the key to unlock chaos across the land?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You know who I am? And my past? No, you don't, and you shouldn't. I maintain anonymity precisely to bury the past behind me. Forget it all, and let this skin I've shed sink into the depths of the deserts.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I don't mind this kind of peace and quiet.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I know precisely what you seek, Doctor of Rhodes Island! Your thirst for truth and power is palpable. And I, Sesa, am willing to bestow that very strength upon you... Woah, hold on! Don't throw me out! I'm here to apply for a position!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This weapon's output... I see…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: ...You wish for greater power? Don't draw any unnecessary attention before the time is right. Otherwise, it'll be waaay too dangerous.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: 'The bridge connects, the ammunition embodies wisdom, the weapon expresses will, and harmony manifests equality.' Do you wish to shatter the misty veil obscuring the Truth? Perhaps I can lend you a touch of power... just a little bit.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The 'bridge' yearns… for those weapons in your hands... May I take a closer look?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Let me guide you... Just apply this oil to the bolt slot of your crossbow. Make sure you apply it evenly.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Cohorts, it's time to show the results of our efforts. Just remember, handle the weapons with the utmost care.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The battlefield destroys both weapon and wielder.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My arm is trembling...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Set me free! I'm supposed to yell that now, right?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: At long last...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Doom, shall descend!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Free the weapon from its shell...

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Souls! Resonate as one!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I shall be your doom! I'm allowed to say stuff like that, right?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: How can you ever understand the suffering of the victims?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Such agony inevitably accompanies a fierce battle, but the weapon in hand never lies. It sings of victory!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You are a bit too dependent upon my powers. Speak no more, same deal: a cup of black tea with two sugar cubes.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: To escape the malediction of a weapon is, for both sides, perhaps a blessing.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No matter how far we run, the weapons will lie in wait, until the day they eradicate us.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The Great Truth demands an equally great space to house it! Wait, no, I don't need a room this big...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Watch out! I... I'm still not able to fully control my powers!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Wanna hear a story? I know many old tales.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: A brand new year already. When will the day finally arrive that we brush with the truth... My tone's off? Right, I'm still rehearsing. Stop it, I know, I'll see you at the party soon.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Since today is your birthday, I shall share a secret incantation. Speak it, and you may unchain my true power... Actually, never mind. Dr.{@nickname}, you already know what I'm capable of, don't you?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I understand your craving, on this day of retrospection, for ancient tales from the golden sands of Sargon, and truths that belong to the future... Hey now, don't go. I truly wished to share these stories, even if I failed... Never mind. Care for some tea?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Let's see what goodies the Doctor hides in this drawer.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I'm probably only about as big as one of Papa's legs right now. But one day, I'm gonna be as big as him, and then I'll trample all over the bad guys! Graaagh!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm really, really sorry! I won't run in the hallways ever again!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Fighting is super easy. I point my shield one way, and nobody can beat me. Huh? What if they get behind me? Ohyeaah... I never thought of that!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Gavial? Never heard of her. She's tough? She's famous in Sargon? Okay, whatever. I'll see for myself how tough she is.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Oh, you're talking about Gavial? I'm Gavial's number one fan. See, she even signed my shield for me. That's her autograph! I think pretty much nobody could take down Gavial, besides Papa.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, shhh, tell me the truth. Kay says Vulcan can hammer straight through the floor, can she? No? Phew... Hehe. I knew it. That means my Papa is definitely stronger. He could bust down a Rhodes smoke stack with one punch.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Do I really have to write it in the notebook...? Fine... 'I knocked over Lancet-2 today. I won't do it again.'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: This is my shield. It'll be one of my greaves someday, or maybe a pauldron. Then as long as I'm standing behind you, hehe, nobody'll ever bully you.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, wake up! Someone's here to see you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You're the boss of this training camp? And they call you the Doctor? Hrmmmm... But you don't look strong... Whatever. I'm Bubble. I may be the weakest in my tribe right now, but you're gonna train me until I'm the second strongest.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Fight! Fight! Fiiiiiight! What, why'd they stop. Is it over?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A reward for my training? Great! I can't eat it? Grrr...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I think I got a good chance of beating Kay now! Okay, lemme at her. Doctor, you can come watch!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Be good? I'll try.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll count down and we charge on one, okay?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Chaaarge!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Waaar!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I got this.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Haha!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Get the bad guys!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Shield up!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Traaaaaample!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Baaaaash!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Spike striiiike!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Bam!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, if you got your body as strong as your brain, you could be an awesome warrior like my Papa!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What did I tell you? I'm super strong.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Huh? Some of them got away? Did I let them through?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We can't beat them! Whatdowedo?! Whatdowedo?!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I need a way, waaay bigger room. How can anyone live in a little place like this?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey, that tickles.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, let's play hide-and-seek!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's New Year's! We got the day off! No homework! That means it's time to challenge Kay! Doctor, you can't just sit there all day. Why don't you come wrestle with us? It'll be fun!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Oh, this means you've grown a whole extra year! When am I gonna get as big as you?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I have to train hard at Rhodes Island! First, I'm gonna get tougher than Kay, then I'll beat Gavial, until I finally outdo Vulcan! Then I can go back home and be a warrior as great as Papa...! Doctor, are you gonna miss me when I'm gone?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: D-Doctor! Excuse me, but could you please move a little? You're stepping on a coin...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: My dream is for all Terra to know… Okay, maybe just Lungmen… Umm, well, maybe I'll just start with Rhodes Island, or even just you! Yes, my dream is for you to know my skill…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Aaaugh… I forgot to turn out the lights when I left the office yesterday… Hm? Rhodes Island has power generation facilities so we don't have to pay for electricity? R-Really? Does that mean I can start eating dinner every day?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: So this is the Originium ammunition that Jessica ordered... Uh, D-Doctor, the amount on the bill, is it right? Or maybe it's in the currency of some small, remote country? It's not? It's Lungmen Dollars? I-I-I-I see... Nonono, I-I'm just a-a-a little surprised, hehehe...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Oripathy... Hm, even though it's a bit outside my field of study, it might be worth looking into... But if I add another research project, I'll go from two meals a day to two days a meal... Aww…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Frugality is a virtue, but for me, it's more like a habit... E-Even so, if you or my friends ever have money troubles, I'll gladly help out! I'm serious!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You'd like to take a look at my clawhook? That's probably fine... B-But whatever you do, don't push this button. And watch your thumb when you're holding the grip... W-Wait, you're not winding the rope correctly, and... Oh, I-I'm sorry, don't mind me, you can keep looking at it...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: After I become a great, world-famous scientist with lots of money, I swear I'll have three meals a day and dessert too, just like Jessica... And then, with the money I can't even spend, I'll invest it into making Lungmen a better place. Um... if a day like that ever comes.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Money is very important. Before I went back to Lungmen, I turned down a big retention fee from the research institute, so my self-funded research project went under... But, it's more important to be home. I can always save up again, and now I won't go dizzy looking at all those big numbers!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: …Doctor fell asleep? Then I'll handle the rest of the work, though I am a bit hungry.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Oww... my head! Sorry... Oh, a-are you the Doctor? It's a pleasure to meet you! My name is Snowsant. Sorry, I shouldn't be walking with my head down…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Woah... This isn't something you can learn with more effort...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Wha-what? A promotion? I… feel a bit more pressure, but I'll be okay. This is proof that I'm one step closer to making something of myself!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: 'Heaven rewards the hard-working.' Wouldn't you agree, Doctor?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: It'll be all right. I just need to remember my training and work hard…

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You want m-me to be the squad leader? But I really don't know anything about battle…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Clawhook checked and ready! Take a deep breath... I can do this!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I see the enemy!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: M-Me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'll do my best!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I hope my clawhook won't malfunction…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: This is my first time being so close to a battlefield...

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Clawhook standing by!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Please hold still, don't make it hard on you!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: So… heavy…

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Claw's all good for a catch!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: As long as we work together, there's no obstacle we can't overcome! R-Right, Doctor?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Not a single resource wasted, a flawless victory!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Some enemies got away, sh-should we chase after them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I, I'll go salvage some damaged parts, to at least reduce our losses…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Wooooah, so this is what it's like inside Rhodes Island... I'm so jealous…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Eeh-eeh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Yes, Doctor?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: So today's a holiday? No wonder the canteen has such an amazing spread. I can finally enjoy a proper meal, heheh. Speaking of which, Rhodes Island sure has a lot of holidays. If I take another job in the downtime, maybe I can make a little more money...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good day, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Thank you for always looking out for me, I got you a present. Here's an ergonomic chair to correct your posture, and an automatic document sorter, I made them both myself. I-I know they're made of really cheap materials, but I can promise they're great quality!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island maybe can't offer me a super comfortable life... No, I get enough food and warm clothes here, that's already pretty comfy... A-Anyway, I'm extremely grateful to have a work environment that supports my R&D like this. I will double up my efforts, and get results worth the experimental funding.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Smiling can help you feel revitalized. Why don't you try smiling, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island shouldn't be like those black-hearted corporations, right? Lungmen Industrial Waste Disposal License, Lungmen City Sewage Permit... Well, it seems like there are no problems with your certification, and the sewage treatment seems good enough... It's good that you're a law-abiding organization!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Woah, this water tastes amazing~! It's cool and sweet, just like the springs back in my hometown... Where's the water source? How is it filtered? What are you using to filter it? Please tell me quickly, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: There are signs of excessive wastewater discharge this mon-- Huh? Did I take too many baths again? ...Oh no, I must reflect upon my behavior!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I love my hometown! Although it's not as lively in the country as it is in the city, and daily life isn't as comfortable, the water there is cool and delicious, and the air is always fresh. Hehe, these are sometimes hard to come by in the city!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The pollution near the city is getting worse and worse. Earlier, we even had problems with the water supply in my hometown, and resolving that situation required a lot of effort. While Catastrophes pose a very clear threat to us, pollution will also erode away at our habitable spaces! Therefore, protecting our environment is also of great importance!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Heave, ho! That should be the last shoe... Got it! Phew, now, this waterway will be much cleaner, and my daily efforts here won't go to waste! Thank you for accompanying me, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: There is a legend among my people that we came from a place far, far away. Now that there are fewer and fewer of us, nobody seems to know where we came from, or where we are going...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Back in my hometown during harvest season, each family will make lots and lots of delicious food! Braised, sweet and sour, steamed, fried, marinated, anything you can imagine! Doctor, why don't we go visit together? The people there are very hospitable~

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Ugh... So dry... I want to soak in a bath...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I am the municipal waterway cleaner, codename Purestream! From now on, I will handle the water treatment and sanitation of this ship, so please rest assured! Oh, these are pickled vegetables from my hometown. Everyone is welcome to try some—I assure you, they're delicious!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: If the purpose is to gain experience, wouldn't it be faster to put everything into practice?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Am I getting a raise? With this promotion and salary increase, I'm well on my way to the top! Hehe, I'll have to tell everyone back home the good news~

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: While there is a difference in urgency between visible threats and less evident threats, they are both dangerous to us! I'm glad you understand, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: No problem, just leave it to me!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Such an important task... I'll do my best!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Rhodes Island Water Treatment Team, heading out!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Surprise inspection! That punk just poured paint down the sink! Get him!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: A fight? Alright! Lemme Roll up my sleeves… Oh, I don't have sleeves.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Woah, they're really fighting!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Cleaning work is my specialty!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Water delivery!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Breach and flip!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: That's unauthorized discharge of sewage!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Water works to the benefit of all.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Did that splash of cool water wake you up?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No more contaminants! Very good, this mission was a great success~

lines.title: 3-star Result
