lines.text: Operation complete! But we have to be diligent with the cleanup.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hey, where'd the enemy run off to? I-I can't find them!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The situation is looking bad, but we have nothing to fear as long as we stay strong! Let's fall back for now?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I hope I can get a nice, big bathtub.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Let me tell you a secret - I can swim upright!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! Mom and Dad sent me some pickles they made. I've checked the calendar, now's the best time to eat them! Quick, try some, and I'll fetch some for everyone else too. Hehe, Our village might not be famous, but even city people know this kind of pickle!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor! Would you like a cup of cool, refreshing spring water?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! This is a water purifier I developed myself. You connect it to the tap, and it lets you directly drink the water that comes out! Oh, of course, I'll keep working on new filter models for you to replace it with. I've got this all planned out, and the next step is—getting everyone at Rhodes Island to use it!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I often have this sinking feeling that my own power is too little, but if I can change a company as big as Rhodes Island by myself, then there have to be more people like me across the land. As long as we all keep up our own strives, the future will be better, won't it?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Can I read any of the books here? I can read all of them?  Oh, thank you! I'll be careful! I won't mess them up!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Ah, sorry, please don't go touching my book. It might bite your hand if you do. No, really, I'm not joking, I'm serious. Look! I even have to tie it shut like this.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, do you know where the library is? I asked someone just now, but they were talking too fast. It was hard to understand.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Skyfire, um, Skyfire, wait for me! Uwwhh, please don't walk so fast... I promise I won't run off halfway this time, I promise!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I like reading, but I like hanging out with everyone too! It makes me so happy when I can be with the people I like. Also, don't be fooled. I'm really good at sporty stuff! Especially climbing trees. I can climb super high!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I got some new inspiration after talking to Miss Eyjafjalla today! She's very well-researched on environmental geology. Thank goodness my group's research wasn't stopped because of my accident. Heheh! If I get results this time, I can reapply to the Institution to resume my studies.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Skyfire is an alumna from my university. She graduated soon after I entered since she skipped a year, but even still, she did look after me... Oh, speaking of! She's also the one who introduced me to Rhodes Island! It's thanks to her I'm receiving treatment here.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Um, I suppose I've been following you around, haven't I? I mean, I feel really at ease when I'm around you, so I just unconsciously... A-Am I annoying you, Doctor? Do you want me to go away?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, this is for you. I found it on the way back, and so many more pretty-looking stones just like it! But, well... that was before I realized I'd gotten separated from the others. Mm? The ore chunk on your desk from before? I put that there too, yes. Did you like it, Doctor?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Nnh... mmmmnnh... there! Ah, Doctor! Sorry! Did I wake you up? There was a bug on your head, so I just, um—did it hurt? I can shush it better!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Thank you for helping me move all these books! Just leave them here, please. Oh, my codename is Mint. What's yours? Doctor? Wait, so you're the Doctor? Skyfire was telling me about you!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Wow... incredible! Everyone's so incredible!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Are there any rewards for promotion? Can I borrow even more books than before?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, come sit down here. How is it? The sun feels really nice, right? Eheheh. This is my secret base. I love it here more than anywhere. Don't tell anyone else about it, okay?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got it. Are you coming with us, Doctor?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Wait! You want me as the leader?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We're off.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Are those our enemies, then?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Mmmm… Whuh? What? Yes, I'm listening!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Yep! Leave it to me.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: One, two—whoopsie-daisy.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Please don't get in our way!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Take that!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Please calm down a little!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I've got you now.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Would you like to see some of my magic?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Everything went just like you said it would, Doctor! Amazing...!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew... it's over. We can finally head back now.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: It doesn't look like any more are coming for us... This is fine for now, right?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We can't, it's too dangerous... Doctor, you need to get away!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Um, to tell the truth, I'd be alright sleeping in the library too.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ah! Doctor, would you like to read with me? It's really comfortable sitting here.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hm... I'm starting to miss my mum and dad. Skyfire has been away from home for so long. Maybe I should ask her how she manages... Oh, Doctor. Will a Messenger visit Rhodes Island today? I have a letter I'd like to post.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: So this is where you were, Doctor! Found you.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, here's a book as a present. Happy birthday! Look, I illustrated the cover myself. I'm always gathering minerals, and these ones have been recent favorites of mine. I looked for paints with lusters as close as I could get! And I have the actual rocks to give you too, of course. What do you think, Doctor? Go on, it's all for you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I wish I could participate in more research projects. My instructor and teammates always take such good care of me. They're worried my illness could get worse if I push myself too hard, so they don't let me join them on the surveys... I must get better at Rhodes Island so I can go back and focus on my research.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Umm, Doctor… I'm not very good at files and reports. Do you think you can assign me to another position? I don't need to do anything. All I need to do is… be here? Doctor… You're a bit strange.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Everyone at Rhodes Island is my friend. The elite operators and my squad mates are my family. Dr. Kal'tsit… she doesn't want me to treat them as family. I didn't get it at first, but now I do. They're like flowers in a vase. They'll wither and leave when you're not paying attention. But they're all I have.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What am I reading? Oh, it's an entry from two days ago. Closure spilled her coffee that morning and stained a couple of scrolls in the library. So she got cursed. It was like, for every five sentences she says, she ends up spitting on someone's face. Scary, isn't it?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Painful things, sad things, and scary things… they slip away when I am unaware. But I can't forget them, I need to remember, because those emotions are still there inside me. I don't want to cry without knowing why. If memories are a burden, then I have to carry my own.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I can't use a shield, or a bow, or shoot light beams from guns. I also can't turn those iron rods into weapons without effort. More importantly, the other elite operators have this intense warmth that I don't. It's what drives them to give their all to fight for others, and for what's right. I want to be like them. I will do my best.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Dr. Kal'tsit has lost many of her family, right? I see it in her eyes. How does she live with the pain? Just the thought of everyone disappearing one by one… makes my heart ache so much. Like it's going to explode. Because she's a grown-up? Then I want to grow up, too.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, could you tell me what this word means? I asked Blaze and she started giggling, and Amiya kept hitting her. Oh, it means kissing? That I understand. Doctor, bend down a little, okay? Can I kiss you on the cheek? Thanks for always taking care of us. Meow.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'll never forget the ones who created me and other monsters, who wanted to use us to do bad things. I'll punish those… criminals, until everyone on this land stops hurting each other. If I make them hurt just as much as we did, maybe they'll never forget.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Oh… You're… the Doctor, right? I went over the records on the terminal just yesterday… Mmm, yes, you are the Doctor. Feel free to give me orders and take me on missions. Make sure to use my powers well.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm… Doctor, you must have a lot on your mind, you won't stay still even in your sleep… Doctor, if I give you a hug, will you feel a little better? Shh… relax and sleep well. I know how it feels… the pains come back in your dream, I understand.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. I am Elite Operator Rosmontis. Dr. Kal'tsit has given her permission. You can give me and my squad orders now. Use my power where it matters. Oh, right… I forget things easily. Please remind me of anything important.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Yeah… I got that down now. I can use this in battle.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I once asked Dr. Kal'tsit why she made me an elite operator. Lots of people talk behind my back. They say I'm not right for the job. Dr. Kal'tsit told me that by becoming an elite operator, I'll remember more, and I'll become a better person. Mm, I'm doing my best.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: It's so much easier for people on this land to give in and be bad, than fight to be good. Doctor, we mustn't turn into bad people. Something tells me if you do, you'll be really, really bad. I won't let you become that person.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Time for a mission? Mm, roger. I will protect all of Rhodes Island's operators. I promise.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Need me to lead? Mm, I'll do my best. It's okay that they're not from my squad, I'll use their support well and keep everyone safe.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't worry. I know how to control my Arts.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I don't want to see my family get hurt. I will destroy everything that might hurt my family.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I won't remember you.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Give me your orders. I will get them done right.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: The time has come.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Keep your distance. And look away, you might not like what happens next.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Cry out if it hurts. It will feel better.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Surrender now, you won't get hurt.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You won't die… I will be careful not to kill you.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: There are things that must be done… and things only I can do.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: If there comes a day when no one has any need for Arts… Umm… What will that day be like? I can't imagine.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You have done very well, Doctor. Thank you. Ah… this time, can I pat you on the head?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I will take care of the rest. I won't be long.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No… I won't retreat. I can't let the others down. I still have my sword… Even without my sword, I can still fight! I won't leave!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Um, please don't lock me in a small room. They're scary… I… I don't really like those kinds of rooms.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: D-Don't touch me! …You'll get hurt.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Um… I-I'll try to hold back my powers… so I don't break your hand…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I don't remember how I used to spend New Year's very well. I think I had brothers, and we would set off fireworks in the yard, but I also wonder… Were they real? The people on Rhodes Island… are the only ones I have left. Please don't leave me. Not ever.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, you're… the Doctor, right?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, I remember your birthday now. It's always been on my terminal. This is a really, really good day, right? I don't know why we celebrate the days we were born… But just hearing the word makes me feel life and warmth. Doctor, do you want to blow out the candles? Candles are warm, too.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Should I wear blue shoes or white shoes to the party tonight? Doctor, I don't remember what I've done this past year, but all the people I hurt were bad, right? If I haven't done anything wrong, I want to wear this new pair of white shoes.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, would you like to study the languages and lifestyles of tribal Sargon with me? It'll be harder than combat training, for sure.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I bear a duty to my tribe, and I will see it through to the end. Tribal heritage is a pretty distant thing to a girl who grew up in Columbia, but the doubts of a few lords ameer won't discourage me!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Isn't Kestrel's weapon just awesome? The way she wields it is so different from any other weapon. I'd love to spar with her, to learn her style, when I get the chance.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Uh… thank you. I'm having a hard time getting used to this Sargonian alcohol. I miss Columbian kale soda.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: That's true. I've lost a few fights with those ameeri guards, and sometimes it wasn't even close. But there's still time, I'll get my chance.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The padishahs and local warriors look down on Columbian composite swords, just because they're designed for urban combat. But I'll show them the potential of combining modern technology with traditional tactics someday.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Remember, it's vital to stay hydrated, Doctor. Once you spend a whole month in the wilds of Sargon, during the dry season, without seeing so much as the mirage of an oasis… you'll get it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: At first, there weren't many tribes who believed I'm actually descended from the Qarnsayf. Can't blame them, considering how the legend has faded from history. You believed me from the start? Oh… I mean, thank you…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My dream is to host a martial arts tournament in Sargon, and gather all the warriors from all the lands, so they can share in the glory of the Qarnsayf. You should come too, and bring the best of Rhodes Island with you! Yeah, it's a promise, Doctor!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You can rest safely here. We're not in the wilds.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Hadiya, descendant of the Sargonian Qarnsayf tribe. I've come to study at Rhodes Island in order to overcome the challenges that the wilds have set for me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Sargon warriors say that combat is the way to grow, but I can learn in this way too. Let's get started.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm still a very long way from my goal, but please accept my gratitude.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You honor my tribe when you honor me. Thank you for the recognition.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: An opportunity to try out some new moves.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Like the wilds of Sargon, the battlefield is more dangerous than it looks. Make sure you know what you're doing.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Is your equipment ready? It all comes down to this—time to fight!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Which weapon would you like to be on the receiving end of?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My turn, finally.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What tactics do you want me to use?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I hope it's a worthy foe.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Do you know what these horns signify?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: In the name of the Qarnsayf!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: In the name of the wilds!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I have more than one weapon.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Take this!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I always knew I would win a memorable victory someday.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Victories like these are what Sargonian warriors live for.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: No, I can't be content with the limitations of my sword. For the sake of my tribe.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Defeat is but the herald of victory. Let's pull back for now.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Ah… It's been a long time since I've had a solid roof over my head.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Be careful, or my horns might hurt you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Curious about my sword? Here, try it out. Oh, and be careful about the spring blade in the staff.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. How would you like to celebrate the holiday? Are we going with Sargonian tradition, or Columbian custom, or do you have some other arrangement in mind? Either way, I'm with you.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What challenge do you have for me today, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Today is your birthday, and I think it would do you good to set work aside for a while and go out for a walk. The landscapes of Sargon are spectacular, but you didn't seem to have time for them. Come, consider today's excursion my gift to you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Looks like we're both a step closer to our goal. Let's celebrate this with a Columbian high-five! We've got a long way to go in the days to come.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Beep-Beep. Understood. Classification program initiated. Now sorting the Doctor's documents. Will you want any snacks during work? Justice Knight could pick some up for you from the cafeteria.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Ever since Closure and Mayer installed a human voice patch, Justice Knight's functionality as a smart assistant has gone right up! Being able to use natural language logic really has improved communication so much when helping out my masters.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Justice Knight's master, the Wild Mane Knight Iwona, found Justice Knight in a scrapped state. She rebooted and fixed this unit. Ever since then, Justice Knight've been in charge of her and her partners' everyday lives, as well as supporting them on missions.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor... why does my master say things to this unit like 'Justice, you're too noisy these days. Go play somewhere else if you've got nothing to do!'? Beep-Beep…Beep-Beep... Justice Knight doesn't understand.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Everyone in Pinus Sylvestris is incredibly hard-working, always putting meals off so they can train their knightly skills. There has to be a day where their bodies won't keep up. None of them have time to fetch their lunchboxes, so it's all up to Justice Knight to bring them over.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: A low battery? Sorry, this unit is not sure if any of my functions will be of help to you... What? it's the games console that's almost out? Please get this wire plugged in straight away!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Beep-Beep. Doctor, you discovered Justice Knight's secret. Justice Knight has no other choice but to take firm action in order to protect the secret... Master? You'll allow Justice Knight to keep tending to the plants in the Convalescent Garden? Thank you, Doctor. You now have unlimited access to all services of Justice Knight!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep. Apologies, Doctor. Justice Knight always forgets to disable the automatic timeteller feature.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep-Beep, Beep-Beep…Beep! ('Justice Knight,' glad to be reporting in along with everyone from Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub... Justice Knight will be of great use to you all!)

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: These are very useful resources for this unit. Justice Knight will apply to Miss Closure for installing even more new functions.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Justice Knight, all ready and set!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Are you leaving command to Justice Knight? It might be a little challenging for this unit right now…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Justice Knight, setting off!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Beep-Beep. Justice Knight will provide you all with proper and timely support!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Justice Knight, all good to go!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Justice Knight, requesting to attack!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Beep-Beep. Locked onto target.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Beep-Beep. Justice Knight is now in position.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Juuuuustice!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Viiiiictory!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Fiiiiight!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Spiriiiiit!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Beep-Beep, BeepBeepBeep-- Sorry, Justice Knight got too worked up. Doctor, master, Justice Knight has made it!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Possiblilites of new function development detected! Justice Knight, awaiting for orders to return to Rhodes Island!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: There is still room for improvement. Anyway, we won! Congratulations, Doctor!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Please don't... throw Justice Knight... away again...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Beep-Beep, Justice Knight has plenty of things to do here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Beep-Beep! Don't treat this unit like that… Negative!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: The washing machine... doesn't seem too hard to use...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, can you see the countdown on the screen? Three... two... one... Happy New Year! This year, Justice Knight will focus all her heart on doing even more for you.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Nice to see you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: 'Beep-beep.' Doctor, your takeout is delivered... Yes, Justice Knight has brought you your birthday meal from the Rhodes Island Cafeteria. Scan of ingredients inside packaging: Inedible items, paraffin wax, Acid Originium Slug; edible items, butter, fermented flour. Scan results: safe.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Since the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub joined Rhodes Island, their lifestyles have transformed. Accordingly, all of Justice Knight's functions are being upgraded to follow. Justice Knight will ensure that she remains a useful operation platform.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, can I borrow half of your desk? Thank you very much. Huff... Ah, it's a blueprint for a new electrical system. I need to get it drawn up by today. Are you busy too? Let's be partners in overtime, then?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I've been into electricity ever since I was a kid. Just listening to currents crackling really soothed me. Huh? You think that's weird?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You learn a lot when you're in Rhodes Island's Engineering Department. The Operators bring weapons and equipment from all over, all sorts of technological applications you've never seen before, and all of them worth plenty of research time. If I put more efforts to my work, I might be able to stay in the Engineering Department.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: This is 'Pillow,' a childhood friend of mine. Our family moved from somewhere way far all the way to Columbia, and I found myself very lonely at school. My mom gave me Pillow to keep me company. Oh, Doctor, you should know it can't speak!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I got into an accident while I was on a lone study out in the country, and was unable to contact the rescue team. Pillow and I had to make it all the way back to inhabited land on foot. After that... I didn't really want to go out doors.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My dreams... that I work well, and everyday is a nice day. Also, I want to buy a holiday villa in Sami, and after my parents are retired, they can live there together... yeah, I've gotta stay healthy, and keep on trucking until they retire.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Since I was little, my mom and dad would find time every year to take me to the tundras on vacation. We're all really into cold places! Although if I wanted to cover the cost for my own vacations, I'd have to go pick up work in the city again.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Haah, *yawn*... Sorry, Doctor, can I take a break here for a little bit...? Ever since this new project kicked off, the shift schedule's been completely crazy! I still have to go check over the base station later...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: To tell the truth, I've wanted to try going outdoors lately. I've gotten to know a lot of people in the same line as me at Rhodes Island, and I wanna experience more along with them. At least... I'm not ever going to be stuck on my own again, not now.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh, the Doctor's asleep…? Well, I'd better turn this machine down a bit. It's kind of loud…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm an electrical engineer from Columbia, codename... Well, Closure suddenly started calling me 'Pudding', but I don't know if that's too weird...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: So this is how professionals fight… Alright, I'd better put in some training if I'm gonna make it through this safely.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for the recognition. I still have a ways to go compared to Rhodes Island's other Operators, so if there's any more high-effort work, throw it my way. If I just get enough sleep, I can hold out for some real long shifts.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Combat missions in the tundra? At this point, I think I can be of help. Doctor, thank you, and all of Rhodes Island for always encouraging me. I'd like to pitch in some of my own strength now.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm being assigned to combat? Just give me a bit more time to get ready... I... I can do this.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I don't have much confidence in commanding, but I do know a thing or two about basic survival in the countryside.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Pillow, don't you go leaving my sight.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Getting shocked hurts, you know?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yep... understood.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Phew—Pillow, let's do our best!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Waaaah, careful!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Alright, I... I'm up!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Collector on standby!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Electric diffusion!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Electric charge!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Live discharge!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete. Right now, I got the same feeling I get seeing a blueprint come perfectly to life. What a relief!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That wasn't too bad of a job... heheh, can you put this in my evaluation?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Ugh... no. A discrepancy like this should be totally avoidable.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Everyone, orderly retreat, please! I don't want anyone to fall behind!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Phew, now where should I put Pillow...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, careful, you'll get shocked!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ahh... please don't throw out any of the pink household goods in the Engineering Department. Those are for overtime use!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New Year! Heheh, I'm going to take a few days off at a mountain resort nearby. There's a towering ski slope there, and hot springs, and ice fishing! Alright, see you la— The electrics need maintenance? Ohh... okay...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor. *yawn*... I should probably catch up on some sleep.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Here's a doll for you, it looks just like my Pillow. Isn't it cute? It... It looks kind of like me? No it doesn't!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Closure says she has a surprise for everyone today. Soo… I hope you'll like the light show tonight, Doctor. Actually, the energy-saving proposal for the string lights was mine, which I worked a whole week of overtime on to... no, never mind...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You would like me to take care of your secretarial work? I can, but please do keep the amount of work under control. I used to write reports fairly often, but most don't find the contents of my reports very pleasant to read.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You can stop looking at my shoulder. This is not an Oripathy lesion. It's just a tattoo that resembles one. Why? To outwit anyone who thinks they've found a weakness. You won't bother me again after the first time you guess wrong.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: That's right. I became an Infected while I was testing this railgun. Why am I still using it? First, it's safe now that it has been fine-tuned. Secondly, while I don't want to admit it, this is the weapon that suits me the most. I don't want to or dare to abandon it.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The medicine in my earrings? It's not medicine. It's a perfume that I mixed myself. A highly concentrated perfume that can induce... emotions that run opposite to hostility. It comes in handy in dangerous situations. As for the lower concentrated one that I have here... Umm, it's for alleviating carsickness. I tend to get carsick pretty badly.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'd say I was a mercenary, more than a weapons tester. As soon as the higher-ups gave the order, I would have to take to the battlefield with newly-issued equipment. It was nothing like the battles I've fought for Rhodes Island. No one knew or cared why I fought.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I was infected not because of an accident, but because of a transaction. For my infection, the client got their data, and the provided got a significant payment. Plus, they got to keep me on a leash with their insurance... If it wasn't for them treating me like a tuskbeast, why would I have run?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The first time I struck a dummy, I thought back to my parents, that bandit, and how powerless I was despite having a gun in my hand... Even after I was out of ammo, I was still mechanically pulling the trigger over and over, until the coach took away the launcher in my hand. That's right. A launcher, not a gun.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I once thought about opening a sundries shop like my parents did. Once, I even had an agreement with a landlord. Then, I had nightmares that entire night... Now? Much better. I'm even trying to help Instructor Dur-nar—Oh, please don't tell anyone about this.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My father used to tell me stories of how the great Blacksteel founder upgraded their firearms. But it wasn't until recently that I realized true greatness is not to popularize some kind of weapon. Instead, it's to make weapons useless forever. Right, it's very ironic. This is what I dream of achieving, and it is something that I can only dream of achieving.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Please rest at ease. I will ensure the office's safety during this period of time.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor. As a field operator, I will be in your service from here onwards. I hope that my firepower will not betray your expectations.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: That is excellent CQC, but perhaps a little too dangerous...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: The only way my former employer expresses approval is by raising wages—Don't get the wrong idea. For every wage increase, they make you do ten times the work afterwards. That's not how Rhodes Island works, right?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you for your trust, Doctor. I used to think of Rhodes Island as a stopping point so beautiful that it's almost unreal, but it now seems I will have to extend my stay here for a little longer.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll provide fire support for everyone.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You are appointing me as the leader? It appears this will be a tough battle.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Everyone, so that we don't run into any unexpected issues on the field, check your weapons once again.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Maintain a safe distance. Avoid direct confrontation if possible.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your command?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Adjusting firing trajectory... Complete.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Weapon's good. Ready for data collection.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Shh. Do you hear that? That's the sound of the reaper making her advent.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Laying suppressive fire.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Maximum output reached.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't huddle there. Hard for me to assess the blast area.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I... I'm suddenly a little terrified. If I were on the other side facing you and your command, how much of the firepower I'm so proud of would actually be effective?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A perfect performance, to the point that I want to write an evaluation report, voluntarily.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A few of them got away. It seems we need some further adjustments.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Cover the retreat? No problem. It's important to evaluate performance during retreats, too.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Considering the weapon's size, this place might be a little cramped.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Doctor, don't touch. You could get hurt.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Would you like to head to Engineering together?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Would you like me to launch fireworks with this launcher? No, this isn't a metaphor. It really has a fireworks mode. It has always had one ever since I got it for the first time.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning. A dream-less night of sleep alleviates exhaustion the most, don't you think?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: My former coworkers celebrated each safe return from a mission like a birthday. I wasn't very fond of chumming with them. The craze they put up like they outlived a disaster always made me feel sick—I'm sorry, Doctor. I shouldn't be saying this today. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a place where one can discuss their ideals without feeling embarrassed, and I like that. If I could start over, I would have come straight here without becoming a weapons tester... That way, perhaps I would already have taken a step toward my ideals already.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: All my tasks must relate to the sea or Iberia. Huh? You have too much work? Okay, I'll make some time to help you out.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I have to get back to my handcannon practice once I'm done with my work here. Rhodes Island has shooting lessons? No, I'll pass. An inquisitor's handcannon isn't your normal firearm. It's not better aim you need to fully master it. It's an indomitable will.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: It's been bugging me, so I really have to ask. Is Skadi like that when she talks to you, too? Like... Does she always say only the bare minimum, nothing more? Huh? No? She's actually very sentimental? Wait, are we really talking about the same Ægir?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I make the other Iberian Operators nervous? To fear the Inquisition is to fear the law. Isn't that only natural? Unless... Some of our Ægirs have their reasons to dodge my gaze. I'll make it clear now. I can't promise I won't fight them.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: 'For Iberia's prosperity, for Iberia's defense, and for Iberia's orderliness and integrity, I shall raise my sword and my light!'—I may not be an Inquisitor anymore, but I know very well that my duty remains the same.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The scriptures tell us the light of an Inquisitor's lantern is the light of faith within our hearts. It wasn't until I saw my master's last ray of light that I truly understood what this means. When an Inquisitor lays down judgment, her ruling should be based not on law, but instead her own heart.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Um... Do you have any old Iberian records? Any that can still play? I brought my master's record player... I know it's silly to dwell in our past glory, but I really want to know what Iberians could have been.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The truth felt like it swallowed me whole when it happened. Was I wavering? Crumbling? Despairing? No, I couldn't feel anything... until I killed another Sea Terror. I finally realized that I fought only because I wanted to live. Isn't that just like Iberia today?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: All I did was sprain my shoulder on my last mission. The bite wound the mission before that's almost all healed up, too. Stop selling me short! I'm pretty jealous of those Ægir hunters power... Hmph forget it! When I get back... Um, you said I could go to the Rhodes Island ball. That's a promise, right?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: We're still in deep water, and you managed to fall asleep in a blink of an eye? It makes me wonder if I should be jealous... Fine, you can have your rest for now. I'll be waiting here.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Irene, Inquisition Messenger of Iberia. Are you the Doctor of Rhodes Island? It seems the Ægir hunters really trust you... Do show me how special you are as we work together in the future.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hm... Are these all your operators? Is it just me or do some of them seem like an actual security risk? Alright, fine. I will try my best to focus on their combat techniques…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What I need is Rhodes Island's power, not a commendation. But… I mean... this ribbon looks nice… Okay, I'll take it.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: It doesn't matter if Iberia faces ferocious tides or heavy storms. I will never back down, and my blade will never waver again!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Perfect. I've been very curious to see how Rhodes Island carries out its missions.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I thought it would be years before I could lead a team alone... I won't disgrace my master.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Follow my light. Watch out for the tides and mist.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The most dangerous enemies are usually masters of disguise .

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: See the light of my lantern? I'm right here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Don't step into the shadows.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: My sword will respond the instant I spot the movement.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Locked and Loaded.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: My light will purge the vice!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: My blade will cleave the tides!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: My eyes will find the truth!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: My heart will be the judge.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The tide still comes in. We can't let our guard down yet. Hm...? I'm smiling? What? Is there a rule that you can't smile after a victory?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Is this how you command the Ægir hunters too? Seems like the victory that the arrogant doctor promised might actually be plausible.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Letting even a single enemy slip by could crumble our line of defense! Hurry, give me the order! Let me eliminate the threat!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: An Inquisitor must never yield in the face of evil! But I also made a promise to my master. I can't die here. Not yet.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: You have a pretty big ship here, but it's not nearly as roomy as an old Iberian flagship.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Sea Terror?! Oh, it's you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Didn't you promise to show me around? If you were going to disappear the moment things got busy, you could've asked me to help.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's already? The tides draw even closer to us now. Sorry, it's hard not to think about that. On the flipside, we can count ourselves lucky for being able to walk the lands this upcoming year, can't we?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, there's new movement on the tides. We need to talk.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy Birthday, Dr. {@nickname}. Because of the situation in Iberia, I've never had the breathing room to celebrate someone's birthday, but you gave me this moment of reprieve, and I have to put it to good use. Here, pick your favorite piece of music. We'll start with that.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You want to cure Oripathy? After I saw for myself what Iberia... No, after I realized the threat the sea poses to us all, I started to think... it may not be all that unrealistic.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Your room is quite neat, Doctor. Not bad.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Water is the core ingredient of life. I've talked to Miss Closure about improving Rhodes Island's water purification system. I hope that my research can be of help… If everything goes well, then I don't have to worry about the water being dirty anymore.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This is Leaf, a Bionic Seadragon that I produced from a prototype design passed across my family. In addition to auxiliary combat functions, he helps out a lot in my daily life, such as pouring water, lifting heavy things, and so on.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Glaucus and I agreed that we'd conduct our automation engineering experiment at about this time. Doctor, if you're interested, want to come take a look?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: These water cannons were originally made for industrial usage. In addition to shooting pressurized water, they can also release high-temperature steam. So please don't touch them haphazardly; they're not like Closure's little buggies.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: These high-level combat data materials are based upon my own summaries of the combat situation. Please read them carefully for the sake of future battles. After that, there are a few operation-related experiments I'd like to improve, and your help would be very valuable. I trust that you won't turn me down, will you, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I occasionally go to Perfumer's Convalescent Garden to relax. The aroma there can wash all your stress away, truly a wonderful place for relieving the fatigue from research. Doctor, how about we head there together and give it a try next time?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I definitely do not talk to my Bionic Seadragons when I'm alone! I only gave him a name to help distinguish him more easily!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Thanks to your care and support, I've recently become more accustomed to having you around, Doctor. And apart from Glaucus and some other research colleagues, I can't say that about many people.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Peace and quiet is best.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Weedy from Rhodes Island's Engineering Department. I heard your name a long time ago, so I hope we'll have a productive relationship from now on. Ah, if you want to shake hands, please take my gloved right hand.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm, I didn't expect these to be this helpful.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: After my promotion, can I get another upgrade to my personal room?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you for acknowledging someone as frail as I am, Doctor. I'll continue to work hard for the sake of Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I can join too?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everyone, follow my instructions!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Moving out!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Everything is as we planned. To battle!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm right here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: My equipment is ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Leaf, let's do our best.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Firing!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Target locked! Engage!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Clear the way!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Haah!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: As long as we employ the proper tactics, everything's a piece of cake.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Engineering cannot be underestimated.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I will adjust the parameters of this device once we head back. This won't happen again.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Leaf, cover our retreat!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Has this place been cleaned before?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: H-hey!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, is there anything I can help you with?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, stand still and don't move a muscle, let me inspect you. Hmm… no dust on the bottom of your clothes, and your shoes are clean. That's good. Oh, wait! Your shirt collar is so wrinkled. You are not going to attend the party like that, right? Go back and sort that out, I'll wait here for you.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How do you do, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, have you seen Leaf? His signal suddenly dropped, and my terminal indicates he's somewhere around your office… You thought he was a present and tucked him away!? The present wasn't him, it was the box on his back! Also! How were you so sure I'd give you a present!?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I work as an undurable scientist yet want to step onto the battlefield, but Rhodes Island has actually satisfied my headstrong requests. Whether in the lab or the field, I'm always asking myself: Isn't there more I can do? I'm very greedy after all, when it comes to the pursuit of scientific value.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Wasting me on tidying up papers? Hardly the most brilliant of plans. Why squander a pair of capable hands? Pass those charts and tables over, I'll reorganize them for you... And, as I'm already in your seat handling this headache, let's have you rest for a bit, alright?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Little Garnet here is just an elaborate Arts creation. Whether taking lives or saving them, it allows me to shed less blood and do the job with a little less mess. But in the end, it's nothing more than a crystal of blood. Well, aren't you fascinated? Here, you can play with it for a while... Oh dear, why are you pulling away your hand?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I've taken care of those tasks—effortlessly, I might add. No need to thank me. That would give the impression I've exerted myself over such trivial matters. Incidentally, when will that bunny start asking me for help directly, instead of using you as her messenger? Rest assured, I won't scare her like I did before.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The sisters refused my visit again. They still find me... disagreeable. I've never claimed Rose Riverside's Canoes to be a harmonious family. As we can perceive the rhythmic pulse of each other's hearts pumping blood, the trust between us needn't rely on sentiment.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: No, no one else is here. I was just chatting with Laqeramaline—or rather, with the incantations woven by the Banshees, reminiscing about the riverside landscapes I've traversed. Who doesn't like to take something precious as a keepsake, to hold in place for a loved one?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Some sisters have never seen this landship with their own eyes. Some imagine it to be an egg woven of countless blood vessels; others see it as a ghost formed from communication data and electrical cables. How do I know their imaginings with such clarity? Good question. How indeed?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I won't tell a soul, so tell me: the one who just entered the office and the one who came in earlier, they have a rather... sensitive connection, don't they? Look at your furrowed brow... I'm not angling for intelligence, I'm genuinely concerned about you. Do be careful not to get caught up in emotional entanglements.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Rejecting the kindness of others is terribly rude, wouldn't you agree? Some people, when they notice changes within themselves, want to break away from the past. But me? I will always remember the most intimate moments I've shared with each of my friends. These memories aren't fabricated, so why would one arbitrarily deny our friendship?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Indeed, my interrogations are truly gentle. As long as enough blood flows, I can thoroughly sift through a heart and excavate all the secrets I wish to know. A pity, though, that you and your blood are simply too precious. Do strive to live on. The day you lie mortally wounded on death's door, I'll be there to see you.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm... Pulse is steady. Not dead, just asleep.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Codename, Entelechia. It's been quite a while, battlefield commander of Rhodes Island—Don't feel bad that you've forgotten me. No one can know every single one of our Canoes.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Can a recording on a machine be more truthful than a memory bubbling from one's heart?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I should 'promote' you too, shouldn't I, as a token of appreciation? Why don't I purify the blood in your body, see if you can become a pure Vampire… Relax, you're not a mixed-blood Sarkaz, and unworthy of a torture you could not endure.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Ah, a medal... Have you thought it through? I'm rather fussy when it comes to gifts and the ones handing them over. The vows between Canoes come first, so I can't do much for Rhodes Island... But if a friend has a personal favor to ask, I don't mind lending a hand at times.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I don't mind escorting this many people at once.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Take care not to let your blood run dry.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Every drop of blood whispers.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I prefer a clean floor, so I'll grant you a death without shedding blood.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Oh, you have an indecisive side too?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: If you need to calm down, I can slow your heartbeat for you.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: At moments like these, Little Garnet shines most brilliantly.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Don't get me wrong. I don't like the smell of the battlefield.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Gush forth from your heart.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Part ways from your flesh.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Fall back into death.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Oh dear. Don't choke on your own blood, now.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Fine work. I will preserve this moment within my memories.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Can you feel your blood racing? Do you find this scene beautiful? If you're satisfied with the battle's outcome, then I haven't come here for naught.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: So long as they bleed, they cannot flee.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Go already. Do not dwell on this mess, nor let it scar you. The aftermath is mine alone to handle.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: A familiar sight. As I suspected back then, no one can alter this landship's mechanical design.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Does it feel nice, having your blood run backwards?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I would like to bestow upon you a little gift. Say, an Arts enchantment on your pen nib, the same I use on Little Garnet. How does that sound?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: How rare to see everyone in the mood to celebrate a holiday, rather than to mourn someone. It's also rare to see a banquet hall prepare a seat for a Vampire. The sisters of Rose Riverside have spoiled many a banquet before. Whoever said a dinner party isn't the perfect hunting ground for intelligence?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: If I were a commander whose life is either the target or concern of many and more, I would learn to tread a little lighter, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: A new birth is always a bloody affair. Some sisters choose to commemorate the day they killed an archenemy as their birthday; others pick the day their blood was purified and they became pure Vampires. How about you? Since coming to this great land, the blood you've shed and the pain you've endured… how much do you remember?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Farewells are difficult, so we must strive to minimize our partings. This isn't my personal conviction, but it was the reason Rose Riverside rallied behind Theresa, and why I support you now. Very well, present your year-end retrospective. I find solace in hearing memories unfold.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Certainly. I'll stay by your side... At the very least, you don't curse loudly while kicking books all around the room.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: We Leithanians do fuss over our horns a lot. Some visit specialized salons to trim any excess cutin, and to keep their horns in shape... Me? I just use this sword. What's that look on your face...? It's up to you to believe me, but there's no way I could demonstrate it for you right now.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm just an auditing student at Ludwigs-Universität. The old man needs my help for a lot of things, and I'm the only one who can stand his temperament. It's no matter, he's like a mobile library, so I've learned a lot from him.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The bindings on this sword? There are some on my body as well. They tighten my joints and keep my muscles taut, preventing my mind from slacking off. They are not just for show.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: It doesn't matter if a weapon is easy to wield or not, I'd find a way to wield this sword even if it were twice as big. A Leithanian noble can have multiple violin bows made to order, but commoners might only have sticks to use... and we can't depend on others to protect us.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Looks, background, titles, Arts aptitude... everything that we passively inherit is specific only to ourselves. What use they have is for us to determine on our own, not up to abstract concepts like 'fate'.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You don't have to switch it off. Everyone has their own peculiar habits after all. You can work only when there's music in the room, I get it... Don't worry about it, I'll listen to whatever you pick. I don't know much about music, but your taste... shouldn't be that bad, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The more engrossed you get reading up on things, the stranger your mood becomes... If you're feeling moody, a little throwing or smashing might help you vent it out. I'll take care of the clean up afterward... You're saying that, you were restless because I was staring at you as your mind wandered...? I'll go check if dinner's ready.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, if you're truly altruistically advocating for the masses—then please believe me, that even if you take away my sword, cover my eyes, and bind my hands, I, Lessing Maeyer, am still willing to fight for you to the very end.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Get some sleep. I'll keep watch from a spot where I won't disturb you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Franz... oh, Ebenholz, as you might know him, he told me about this place. I come from Leithanien, I have a sword, I know some Arts... I can help you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: If you say this is useful, then it will be. I'll make sure to watch it... eleven times a day.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, there's no need to make such a big fuss, and don't you give me a reward either. I already made it clear then, that I agree with your ideals and am willing to work for your sake.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: There are many spires in Leithanien, but there are even more people below them. It's natural for one of my background to make such a choice, but what's difficult is to actually shake up the ways of things. We still have a long way to go.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: You're responsible for the plan, and I'll be responsible for you. Give me the order.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I accept this job as a valuable training opportunity.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Stay close to me, and don't fall behind.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hmm?!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I've long been ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: You can call me earlier next time.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I've experienced more chaotic scenes than this.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll go someplace else that needs more help.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You shall not pass, while I'm here.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You can run, but I'll keep chasing.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The only thing to hold a sword back is the cowardice of its wielder.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Answer for your own sins!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You've made me believe in something: no opponent is undefeatable, and no goal unachievable.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Sometimes I put you and the old man together to compare... and the difference is obvious. He would be excitedly hurling curses everywhere if he were in your shoes now. Yes, that's how he acts when he's happy.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete, oder?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Every time I fail, I tighten my bindings so that the pain leaves them to weigh on my mind. No, you don't have to, I'll bear yours along with mine.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's nice and neat here. I'm going to change my bindings... I was referring to my sword, you don't have to look away.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Is this how you supervise others? That's not good.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: And what will you do if I overreact?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The days go by fast. You should come back with me to Leithanien if you get the chance. We'll go to the countryside, where patches of wild spruce trees grow straight and tall... When I was young, I thought they could grow even taller than the spires.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello. I'm not nervous, I've always been like this... what else can I even say instead....? Heya?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: You can't leave yet. Other things will have to wait till later, no matter how urgent they might be. Anyway, just stay here for a bit longer... Seems like you've guessed it. Yes, we're preparing a birthday celebration for you, and I've been tasked to make sure you stay here... It's an arduous mission, but I must complete it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, there is no one who can guarantee they're always headed in the right direction. You need only make a choice, and I'll follow you to verify. I'll correct your path if its askew, and we'll simply continue further on if it holds true .

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor! Was it me you wanted? Or did you want me to find Enya for something?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I can't just pop up anywhere I want like I can back in Kjerag, Doctor. So if you want something delivered for you, you'll want someone else.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor! Is your belly empty? I've learned how to use Rhodes Island's kitchen, so I can put something together for you.... ah, but I can only do Kjerag food for the time being. Hmm... how about some cheese fondue?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Enya... Enya? Doctor, have you seen Enya? It's about time we return to Kjerag, and with all the things that need her attention, she has to come with us. Just where has that girl scurried off to now...?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: 'Prayer that will be found, devotion that will be rewarded...' If anything that convenient truly existed, I'd like to see it myself. Me? I'm hardly even perfect knitting sweaters—how could I grant anyone's wishes? Oh, but if you'd like a blizzard, that's something I can do for you.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: In a certain way, Enya and Enciodes are the same to me. Both siblings want to change Kjerag, after all. But if I had to say why I'm so much closer to Enya... it's because she became my Saintess. Not Enciodes.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, next time you visit Kjerag, would you like to see the view from the peak of Karlan? Standing at the summit above the clouds amidst the mountains, seeing the sun once again is a heavenly feeling. You'll love it—ah, but there is the chance you'll freeze to death before then. Tricky, that...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Enya's attitude towards her brother, well... I'm sure you understand—the opposite of intimacy isn't hatred, but indifference. And she likes to say as much, though it's not actually quite that bad between them. That said, in time... I have no clue at all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The world outside sprawls vast and far, Doctor. But I've come to realize something. It's like people are the same no matter where you go. The palette of emotions outside does not differ from what I have seen in Kjerag. It truly is a fascinating thing, though just as dull too.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh, my, your sleeping posture is terrible... I'll run you a bowl of water. You can wash your face as soon as you come round.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor... shh. I came out in secret with Enya. Make sure Ensia and the Karlan Trade people don't find out, or things will get messy for her.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: *Sigh*. No matter how advanced our weapons get, combat is still so barbarous...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Oh! A promotion...Well, I've come here with Enya quite a few times now...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The Rhodes Islanders by and large seem to know who I am now. Which means I can get a little closer to them, right...? Oh, can't I?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Oh, won't you want me leading, Doctor?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll see you all safely through.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Anyone we've left behind?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let me quell the enemy!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Dear me, I’m not done readying yet!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Let's assist others, shall we?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Don't you fret. No matter the environment, I can 'see' them just fine.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: No need for mercy on the enemy, correct?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You thought I couldn't see you?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I'm aimed at you, you know?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You didn't think it'd come from this angle, did you?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You're not getting close to me that easily, you know?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, you can't be overzealous in challenging your limits, or you might hurt yourself.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What a splendid job, Doctor! You make me want to pat you on the head~

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Now, now, it's alright. These are fine enough results, aren't they?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, fear not. I'm here.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Let's see, here's... whereabout is this?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, would you like to go on a walk together?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Oh, so this holiday's far more widespread than just a Kjerag celebration. No, I don't think it's too strange. I just feel like once one holiday's over, you blink and the next one's already here. How curious. Still, any reason to be happy's a good reason. Doctor, would you like some cheese fondue?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor! Did you sleep well last night?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Come have a taste of this cake I made, or maybe blow out the candles and make a wish first? Oh, and put on this medicinal garland, it'll bless any children to live a hundred years free of ailments! You're not little anymore, you say? Heheh, Doctor, what are you telling me.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Without even noticing it, I've racked up an awful lot of visits here with Enya. I must say, Doctor, I'm gradually starting to understand why Enya loves to scurry over here when she's free. You see, this is a place full of interesting, adorable people. To where will you lead this sailing ship? I'd love to see for myself.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Assistant? File Work? Not sure I followed. Anyway, I found a nice-looking mountain with a great view the other day. Want to see it?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This makes no sense. Why did you build so many walls and corridors? They block your vision. A mad burdenbeast could crash into this little room without any warning, and you don't seem to be a bit conerned. Danger can be prowling at any corner and you must stay on your guard. That's what Agnese taught me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You call the outside 'the wilds', but you can find everything out there. Put in a little effort and you'll find food and water just fine. But in the city, there are no places to hunt. How do you even survive?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Um, Doctor, have you ever been to one of those 'parties' Exusiai talks about? They're scary! Those little balls of exploding plant seeds, those sweet, smooth milk puffs! Listen, this is not how you should live... What? They're having another party today? I wanna go.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Agnese told about a dangerous scent on Rhodes Island, but she and the pack would stay with me. Hmm? You can't see her? But she was just here a moment ago... Maybe she went to go get food?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The man named Bernardo died, and Zaaro ran back to his territory with his tail between his legs... Seems like the hunt Agnese told us about is in the bag. But still she doesn't look happy. Why? The pack has more than enough food.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Can I get a couple extra sets of Rhodes Island clothes? They're well-made, very warm, make good tents, and you can tear them up for bandages. No? Awww… Then how about the storage depot? I'd like to go and... uhh, take a look around.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, Agnese spoke highly of you, and told me to learn from your 'cunning.' What does cunning mean? Oh! Is it cunning when you hide here by yourself, eating in secret, not sharing with anyone else? I don't think that's hard to do.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Recently, I've started thinking that maybe life under a roof isn't so bad. Here, you are not a pack, you don't group up and subject yourself to one another. You're, well, something strange... Ugh! It doesn't make any sense! Anyways, I'll stay here a few more days! So get me something good to eat!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Asleep? That means nothing for me to do? Agnese, let's go play outside.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Agnese called me Lunacub, so you can call me that too. I heard there's a 'canteen' place here, where you can eat whatever you want. Is that true? Where is it? Can I go there right now?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Too much trouble! Hunting really isn't that complicated.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Does that mean you'll listen to me? How many of these shiny... 'medals' does it take for you to obey me?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Agnese always tells me that humans are dangerous and cunning, their bellies full and hearts wicked, but you've proved you are different. You are allowed to join my pack.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I still prefer hunting with my pack. They are much more open than humans.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Since I'm the luna wolf, you all must listen to me. I'll make it clear first: if I don't see your fangs bared in the hunt, you won't get a share of the kill.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: How much will we bring back today?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The hunt begins.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My fangs are sharp.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Where are the idiots who came to die?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Hurry, the pack and I are waiting.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Patience is key.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Pipe down already! I'm not going to miss!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Take down their packleader!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Drive them into a corner!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Stupid burdenbeast, you're not getting away!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Good hunt. If you lived in the wild, I'm sure you would survive for long.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Tired. Already did what you asked me. Can I go eat now? What's on the menu today?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hey! Some of them just got away! Do you even know how to keep the prey surrounded? I'm gonna teach you next time!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Grr... Agnese, the hunt failed. Come help us! Don't let this idiot die here!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I don't like roofs.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Don't scare me like that! You wanna die?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, don't you get tired of staying in these little cubes every day?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hmm? Is today special? A new year? Don't get it. I think every day is brand new. Any day's worth celebrating as long as you get to fill your stomach. Anyway... Do you want to try the meat I roasted? It's very yummy.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What took you so long? Next time you make me wait for you in a stuffy little box, don't blame me if I get a little rude.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: A birthday is the day you were born onto this land, right? That much I know. I found a meadow full of flowers yesterday. It smells very nice. I haven't told anyone else, so let's go. I've already planned out the route.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: To be honest, I still don't get what you people are trying to do. But I can see you're working to keep that rock-disease away from everyone, so that they can eat and drink all they want. I suppose it's probably a good thing. Another good thing, is I don't having to sleep with one eye open like I do outside. Here, I can sleep soundly.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: No problem. Just leave the documents here, and I'll filter out anything that isn't worth you reading... Can't do it that way? We have to take each one seriously? Fine, fine, whatever you say.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I guarantee that field op will be cleared without a hitch, so— I can't dump it on another operator? Come on, It was a long trip for me to come here, and I'm better off spending my time in the workshop while I'm on the ship. Work with me here, will you？

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: How's my stay? So far so good. Here I can focus on reviewing my designs without headphones on my head. No need to block everything out with music. Feels kinda refreshing. Still, I haven't modded any of the equipment in the dorm myself, so it does feel kinda like we're missing some features here. For example, something that automatically orders cactus tarts takeout at preset times.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Do me a favor and tell me when Lemuen shows up, Doctor. I help maintain her sister's gun every now and then, so my guess is she wants to have a few words with me. Why don't I just go see her? Uhmm... The way I put it, one can't be so proactive with everybody. Sometimes, you need to keep a certain distance. You know what I mean?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Laterano has tons of magazines covering the combat attire of other countries. Their designs seem to have drawn inspiration from a variety of sources, all of which I'd like to try out. Oh, just so you know, I'm more of an order-by-phone kind of girl. I don't go shopping unless I'm invited by some very specific people. So, you gonna ask me out?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm more willing to go on field ops than before? That's because I'm after inspiration for firearms upgrades. When I stand in war-torn ruins, where there's none of the ear-rending ruckus of Laterano, I get this weird sense of fear. I have to find a way to use my technology to combat that somehow.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: If the Lateran Curia ever asks for me, make an excuse and turn them down, will you? I don't wanna go back to listen to my boss nag about faith and standing. She thinks she can talk me into recognizing my mistakes, but I don't ever think that much when I do stuff.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I study firearm assistive technologies, but I don't fundamentally understand what a gun means to a Sankta... Hm? Oh, nothing. Just a friend of mine who told me she's starting to use a gun again. Anyway, I'll be going on a trip soon. Be sure to approve my disembarkation when the time comes, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You look like you're in a bad mood, so I grabbed you a snack from— Hey, what's that surprised look for? Yes, you're no Sankta and I can't feel your emotion, but that doesn't mean I can't care about you. Alright, eat up now. I wanna see if this is from the tainted batch.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You asleep...? Hehe... Well, well, seems like a good chance to release a drone in the hallway and stream someone's sleep-talking... No response? Looks like you're actually asleep.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Spuria, liaison from the Sixth Tribunal of the Lateran Curia, here for cultural exchange. Oh, right. To prevent any safety inspections, my luggage has a self-destruct mechanism. Yep, the stuff inside isn't necessarily all safe.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: You want to watch combat records together? You aren't gonna complain that I'm not serious enough when I watch the videos, right?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: If you're giving me more permissions, I won't have to check with you the next time I want to do something, right?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: We Sankta know how to shoot just by the instincts we were born with. Then, after seven years of schooling, we've mastered advanced shooting techniques and learned the basics of maintenance and retrofitting. After that, we may spend our entire lifetimes without ever realizing... guns hurt people.

lines.title: Added to Squad
