lines.text: Yep, no problem. I've got the objectives all memorized.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Relax, just leave it to me. What kind of havoc can I wreak?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Aww, I prefer combat strategies without so many twists and turns.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Perfect opportunity to observe the battlefield.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Comms online and stable.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Go ahead. Tell me your plan.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Hello, on-site service.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: It's about time we switched to a frontal assault, no?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Come on, don't be such a drag.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Just a smaaaall test.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Take a guess. Am I holding my gun to pray?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Uh-oh, you got it wrong.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: What a surprise. It's been a while since I had so many casings at my feet. You really know how to put on a show.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Just as promised, the mission's a success. What was I doing? Whoa, whoa, whoa, that's hurting. Nobody likes a Doctor who pries too much, yes?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: No worries, it's not a big deal. Just act like you're all remorseful, and nobody will press it too hard. But I still saw every mistake you made with my own eyes, better keep that in mind.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Uh, you're not gonna fix the part of the perimeter that got blown up? That wouldn't fly in Laterano.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Woo, I love this icy, modern feel.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Careful. My gun might go off.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: How much do you know about Sankta guns? There's no way you'd ever be able to fire one, but I don't mind explaining things to you.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: If this was Laterano, I would probably be helping maintain order right about now. The communications center gets affected by explosions pretty easily, and they need my tech repair to mend things... Was it tough? Come on, when everyone else's partying hard, would you really be such a killjoy?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, you're finally here. While you were gone, absolutely nothing happened.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Today's your birthday? Whaaa— you never told me. How'd I know? You didn't bring this up because you want a present, right? Haha... I really like that look on your face right now. Here, this instant camera's your gift. That first photo I just took is mine now, though.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: At first, I came to Rhodes Island just to check the place out and learn some new skills. I never expected to stay here and run so many field operations for you. You really know how to order people around, Doctor. Hehe, that said, I've seen lots of sights I would never have seen in Laterano, so I guess it was all worth it.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Please don't take all that artistic license for reality. Putting a doppelganger to use takes a lot of energy, and it won't happen for odd jobs like this.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I imagine the few Higashi professionals here at Rhodes Island hid their backgrounds from you. If needs be, I can investigate for you—I guarantee any information you get will be the absolute truth.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I've worked for Rhodes Island for ages now; I know the ins and outs of everything. If you have any questions, I can always help—hm? What is today's special at the cafeteria? I... have no idea... I'll go investigate.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: When you're out gathering info, the right clothes can avoid you a lot of hassle. For example, these—once they're all coordinated, you can seem just like a Victorian student taking their first steps into society. In another outfit... I'll demonstrate sometime else if we get the chance.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Zzz... zzz... what a peaceful day... no bothersome cases, no quarrels in the street, and nobody to disturb you even if you sleep in... it's a shame moments of rest are always so short. Come on, Doctor, what do you need me to do?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Since birth, I was meant as a hidden blade in the hands of others. Infiltration, tracking, luring, they became as natural as breathing to me. Being able to use these abilities on the way of right... ha, I never did imagine that. Thank you, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: After the lord passed away, the young master set up a company with the family property. He tore up his oath too, signing contracts with us instead, and just like that, the famed ninjas were completely made over as white-collar workers. As for why I quit... I think I didn't take to sitting in an office, haha.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Dietary habits in Victoria are surprisingly close to those at home. I realized, ever since then, that maybe one day the people of Terra could lay down their prejudices and work hand in hand. But considering the... emm, unique ways they have of cooking locally, I still have some reservations.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When I was young, my father drilled 'that which you should, you must' into me, and I always thought he meant I should do everything for myself. But after going from Higashi to Rhodes Island to Victoria, I came to see it anew. Distinguishing what I should and what I must, what to give and what to take—that's the true meaning of it.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You're thinking about something, aren't you... carry on, I won't disturb you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor. Rhodes Island Branch Operator, Kazemaru, aboard from today on.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I see... There's still more progress I can make on myself.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Watch, just take the corner of this origami and ever so lightly—pull! And now it's just like a real beast cub. I just wanted to show off a little something to you, and I hope it turned out nice.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Ever was my family's forte to be protean, and by this piece of paper, all that lives is imitable. Watch now, Doctor—Mimesis!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll see to the role I should.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Am I going to be leading? Oh, wow... I'll value this chance, you can be sure!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Off we go!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Target visible. Beginning pursuit.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: All ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Danger? As if I should fear it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Beginning assignment.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Success is inevitable. No need to leave it to chance.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Wind, rise!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Fall!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Elusion!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Shadow!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Under your command, I've been far too spoiled.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete. Good, no tracks left behind.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You've noticed how serious I was during the fight? Well—they weren't very friendly, after all.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Flee Doctor... ahead of me...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Nmm, I'd love to relax~

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What is it?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ah, Doctor, this is for you! I just finished folding it.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: In the New Year's passage, may I offer my sincere blessings to you, Doctor. Um, no, I was just pondering a little. My time's finally become my own. The old me wouldn't have had the faintest idea how to allocate it. Now, though, I know just what I'm putting my efforts towards.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello to you, Doctor~

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. For you, Doctor. Put this paper flower under your pillow, and it'll turn into a real flower the next morning. Just like our first meeting, it's both real and fake, it all lies in your hands.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: First shinobi, then salarywoman, and now an intelligence reconnaissance officer in disguise, I wonder what my next job will turn out to be. Ah, Doctor, I don't mean I'm leaving Rhodes Island! I'm just thinking, with all the curveballs life will throw at us, we should all tackle the now as best as we can.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Sorting files, serving tea, and transcribing meetings? Of course, I'm at your disposal... Come to think of it, in my first mission, I also approached the target under the guise of a secretary. One week later, I'd hollowed them of all valuable intel, and torn their influence down to rubble.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: If you don't trust me, you have permission to search my briefcase, and ascertain whether any data inside is critical to Rhodes Island. The Curio Collector's Guide to Antique Appraisal? Learning material for skills required under certain guises—nothing more, certainly not a personal interest. Pardon me if you wanted specifics, but no comment.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The Dublinn Feline, name of Harmonie. Her plan had a lot of moving parts, and almost went off without a hitch—shame she still left an opening. Even your smallest mistake can have irredeemable consequences, such is the cutthroat nature of intelligence work. Yes? Do I consider her an enemy? Hardly; there is no value in a spy whose identity is exposed.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm working on a puzzle... Sorry, please be quiet for a while; your voice is disturbing the pieces. A puzzle's answer is unique; do you solve it through incessant trial-and-error, or through calm analysis and a hold of every detail? Only morons would elect for the former... Well then, did you need me for something?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Inside the aristocrat's ballroom, you need to mind every gaze, to pry into or guard against one another. That is the battlefield the spy roams. It demands of us the proficiency to cruise through it, but I highly doubt anyone truly enjoys it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I rarely make decisions based on emotion, but my saving a completely unrelated civilian was out of fear, it's true. It didn't amount to a mistake, Doctor, and it won't impact anything... War only showed me some of its spiny thorns, but I know It will crush every emotion we feel and every concept we hold

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island's doctors constantly limit my usage of Originium Arts. Aside from ensuring my condition doesn't worsen, they must be concerned that I'll cause some sort of uncontrollable accident... You can put your worries to rest, I know my limits. But nevertheless, thank you for caring.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: It was on a mission that an unanticipated explosion infected me with Oripathy. Of course, that mission was still a success... Why didn't I take cover? Doctor, a variable like that could impact the entire operation. But we could also accept it, and implement it as part of the plan.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Thanks to work reasons, I've met quite a few people as unique and interesting as you. And for those same work reasons, the 'me' they got to know has vanished. Is it a shame? No, it's just the piecing of a new puzzle. All that said, I don't plan to ditch my current codename, for the time being.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: No pending intelligence work for the moment... What a rare break.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You'll have received personal correspondence from the Duke. I'll be stationed and active aboard under the codename Puzzle. No need to bother investigating me; I've handed you all personal information that's been made public.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This deployment is somewhat sloppy... or does it speak to your confidence in their individual abilities?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, you need caution when promoting intelligence workers. It may well add danger to your situation... But I'll let this one pass, seeing as you're affirming my work ability with it.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The last promotion wasn't that long ago... I appreciate your trust. Of course, if Rhodes Island is wishing to work on closer terms with any nobility I serve, I'd be willing to pass on the message.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Doctor, my public activity with Rhodes Island is better kept on the minimal end.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: An intelligence worker in this position is barely a good fit... I have no reason to decline, naturally, if you have your own considerations.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Do you need me to tell you all, you seem like a pack of children at a holiday camp?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Within expectations.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Let's establish a code.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: The intel work began long beforehand.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Probing the enemy's weak points, posthaste.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Be ready at a moment's notice for the info I send back.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't leave it written across your face.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Every look you take has value.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Every expression you make is an opening.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I can read you like an open book.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Such adaptability and command proficiency... I'm all too glad you're not my target.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Intelligence is the invisible scaffold, each battle merely following whatever course it lays out. With the boon of our preceding work, this victory should come as little surprise, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Check for lost weaponry, cover all tracks, don't let anyone in the future discover what happened here.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: A comprehensive plan must include a contingency for failure at every step. We're prepared, so evacuate ASAP... wait, destroy this intel before we leave.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: If certain Victorian nobles decorated their residences the way you do, my work would be more than twice as difficult.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: That's extremely rude.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I was out of practice with a few skills—it seems I can revise here.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I've never joined in with noisy parties like this before. Everyone's completely open about prying into each other's freshly sworn resolutions, writing what info they're sending to their recipients on postcards. To a degree, it's stupid... Are these every year? These kinds of parties, I mean.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, I see it's you again, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: If the intel I've collected isn't mistaken, then nobody has ascertained your true preferences as of yet. So provisionally, I'm choosing to give you a puzzle as a gift. You want a race? No, it wouldn't be much contest.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Puzzle.' It's the identity I've both kept the longest, and had the least motive to work under. Rhodes Island really is a strange place. What is it that makes you all gather here...? Doctor, I've already handed in my on-board continuance application to our superiors.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: The files that needed sorting have all been put away. I hope it'll help reduce some of your pressure, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The atmosphere in here is duly soothing, much like my mountain forest. Doctor, you're free to come play when you're not busy.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I've talked a lot with the Medical Department's operators, and now I can understand what everyone's goal is. Doctor, allow me to rescue this land together with you.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: This herbal pill... it's fine work. Myrrh's combined the properties of the medicinals and processed them in a special way. Hmm... I've never attempted such a manner of processing myself. In a little while, I'll see about learning from Myrrh.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Aid and sanctuary are unalike. The former cures the body, the latter saves the soul.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: To live is an endless cycle, reaping what one sows, all beings beholden to this. I imagine you can understand, having been through so much. Leaving your own memories behind in a different incarnation, constructing your own view of the outside world; that is the purpose of this life.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: These pills have not just the aroma of tea, but all sorts of flowers too. Many patients consider herbal pills bitter, so I've put my mind to diminishing that bitterness. I hope... the people of Rhodes Island won't dislike this flavor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I very much agree with the tea here, its aroma calm, its true flavor apparent. As with tea, so with man. In this dwelling, those irrelevant rumors can be kept away; it's a rare place of respite.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, the operators can have the dishes labelled with my name to eat, as well as some bottles of drinks I made myself. Everyone's been to truly tiresome lengths as of recent, and I wanted to do a thing or two to help alleviate their fatigue...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you tired? Rest well for a while. Don't worry; I'll protect you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: It's nice to meet you; I'm Nine-Colored Deer. Hm? Are these motifs so beautiful? Th-Thank you... please, observe them as you like.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: May I go with you next time? I want to ensure everyone's safety.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You've endorsed me? So I have been of help to you, then. Wonderful...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The things I've learned may save many, but there remain yet more in need of aid. Doctor, can I still be more powerful than I am now?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Worry not, I won't betray your trust.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Am I taking command? No problem.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't worry, I'll bring everyone home safely.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't separate. We meet the battlefield now.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I see them... an unknown enemy.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Are these new orders? Mm, acknowledged.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This... is the chill of the battlefield.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The mind is as truth, a mirror reflecting all ways.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: A thought leaving reality, delusion in all cases.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Heaven and earth come alike, all beings come together.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Everything has its way, per flame and per current.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Mm... this battle was very smooth.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Life is sincerely precious, but base and wicked life is punished in the end.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You needn't be sad. Though there were slight faults, with a little more of a try, you will always succeed.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: If it has no power, no one should be shown that mercy.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What a strange place. So much I've never seen before.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: 'Kindness' is something not to be exploited, Doctor.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, here's a scented tea for you. It'll perk you up.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: All in the past is like dream, like fire, like moons, like smoke. Like the reflection in a mirror, like the abyss of the void. But all things bloom and blossom in the wonderful years of life. Good work in the past year, Doctor, and may all things in the next one be auspicious and prosperous.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You seem very energetic, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: See the way of all beings, and all takes on the true aspect. The aspect without self, the aspect without all life, and so all life's aspect is found in one, and one becomes with heaven and earth from the day they are born. What does your birthday symbolize, Doctor?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Blessed are those who give to the world. The blessings you give to the world will come back to you. May you continue to lead Rhodes Island forward, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Feel free to assign any work to me. I have a lot of experience as a second-in-command.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This communicator transmits signals over long distances, it's a powerful tool for keeping teams in touch. My Arts even amplify the signal, ensuring that communication between teams goes unimpeded. Honestly, battlefield communication is a job that was practically made for me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Lost? No worries, tell me where you wanna go. Um, to get there, first go up the stairs on the left until you reach the fourth floor. Then turn right, and after passing the third fork, make a left. Go down a floor, then proceed to your left. It's directly across from Closure's #3 Engineering Room. How's that? Aren't my instructions clear and concise?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Thorns and I have reached an agreement: Next time, neither of us will hold back, and a victor will be crowned. I'll be sure to defeat him by a landside... What? Rhodes Island has an explicit ban on personal fights? You misunderstand, I'm only talking about chess. Loser has to shave his head, what say you to this bet?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: To be honest, I'm not used to being someone else's assistant. But since my captain relies solely on me to deliver her orders, I have to stay on the squad to support her. Oh, that's just between you and me, by the way. For both our sakes, don't ever tell her what I just told you, okay?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: There's no overstating the importance of communication on the battlefield. And of course, the one facilitating it is the first to get targeted. But don't worry, as long as I'm here, I'll make sure your orders are smoothly transmitted to all combat personnel.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, you came right on time. Actually, there's something bothering me. Why does everyone prefer looking at a map over asking me for directions? The captain says my glib tone gets on people's nerves. But that can't be, I always treat everyone with perfect kindness, wouldn't you agree?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: On the battlefield, few things are more important than morale. Do you see this banner? As a vanguard, just lifting it is enough to fill everyone with courage. Wait, Doctor, you didn't seriously believe that, did you? I was just joking, this thing's actually a communication device.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, you've earned my trust. There's no need to be so humble. I know I'm a good judge of character. How about I call you my comrade-in-arms from now on? My captain and I used to be like oil and water, but look at us now. I believe that, much like her, you will eventually be moved by my sincerity. No? The captain sent you a letter complaining about me? What?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, the files over here are... Hm? Already asleep? Well, even if it's just me, you really shouldn't let your guard down like that.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: 3rd Combat Squad, vanguard and communications specialist, Elysium, reporting in. We've always communicated through electronic means, I do believe this is our first time speaking face-to-face, Doctor?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I'm seeing myself in a lot of these battle records. Talk about weird.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you very much. I won't end up ranked higher than my captain if I get promoted again, will I?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I've always trusted my own judgment, Doctor. But if you're the one giving me orders, I won't question them for a second. After all, isn't that what it means to be a comrade-in-arms?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Of course, I'd love to.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't worry, I'm just a stand-in. The captain's not here right now, after all.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go then. Everyone, follow the route I drafted.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Check your headsets, people.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: No problem.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Signal stable. Ready for action.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I wonder who their target will be.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Gather under this banner in the name of the Lord— Heh, I've always wanted to try saying that.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Sorry, but I'm really not religious.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Who would! Use a flag! As a weapon on the battlefield!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Now we'll see them!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Let's get this done quick!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: This just confirms it. We really do make the best partners.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Great teamwork. Give me five!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: If they've lost their fighting spirit, they're not our enemies anymore. Let's stop here.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's too dangerous! I'll be the last line of defense! Doctor, please give the order to retreat!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hm... Has this room been renovated?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What's up?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I've heard that if this tuft of red hair on my head falls out, it won't ever grow back. This is a very serious problem, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hello, hello? Can you hear me...? Signal's fine, connection to the landship's all clear. Doctor, try to guess which comms station I'm calling from...? Doc's distracted! Now! Set off the fireworks! Heh-heh, what do you think, Doctor? Now that's a passionate New Year's celebration, isn't it?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor! Got any missions for me today?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've meticulously prepared this year's gift, taking into consideration everything I've learned. This time, you'll be blown away by... W-Wait, hold on, Doctor, don't leave! I swear, it's not a prank this time!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island's a lot busier now than when I first arrived. We keep finding more and more trustworthy companions, and I think I'm not the only one drawing complaints anymore. I'm deeply moved, so I painstakingly edited up an audio reel of everyone being drunk at last year's party! I hope it gets some enthusiastic reactions!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Here are the documents. If that's all, I'll be going... The stain on that sheet? Oh, that's, uh... I guess I did spill something when I was having a couple of drinks last night. Haha... Damn, I put it in the middle of the stack, how'd you catch it...?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Do cultured folks like you even drink? Come, come, let's take a swig together, okay? Climb the hills in the dark, cross the desert in a storm. Now we gather in the oasis, drinking all the finest booze… Hehehe, oh, my friend, let's return to our homeland…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why are you all wrapped up like that on such a warm day? You'll be drenched in sweat. Hey you! Yes, you! Why don't you take off that jacket? A true warrior isn't afraid to show the results of hard training!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: 'Operator'? No, I'm a warrior of Rhodes Island. Don't worry, it's not because I can't let go of the past, but because I want to defend the present. I'll train new warriors for you... same as I was taken in and raised back on the sands.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I once took in some war orphans. They begged me to teach them how to use a sword to get revenge. I agreed, and they succeeded, but at the cost of their lives… Many years ago, the chief taught me that the sword is only for protection.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The war took the lives of everyone in my tribe. My friends blocked blows with their bodies, and the chief's blood dripped onto my head... Me and the other children set out on a path of revenge. I'm the only one left. No one and nothing else. Only me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The mark I'm drawing on your forearm? It's a 'bite mark'. Look, I have one too. The chief carved it into my skin herself. She said that those who have undergone the trial of blood and pain become the bravest warriors. The mark brings us strength.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I've taken plenty of hits both in battle and in the mines, but not many left marks. I used to think I was lucky, but now I wish I wasn't. I want the scars to help me remember certain people and things. Death brings back nothing, you know. I have to stay alive, and carry them myself.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Is it snowing on that peak...? Ohh... Guess what, Doctor? I had a dream last night about sleeping in the chief's arms when I was first taken in. She stroked my forehead gently, and her palm was like the sun-scorched sand, warm and rough. They've never seen the snow. Now I see it for them.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: It's a beautiful day out there. I had a good nap, and a good dream, for once.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I choose to stand here, and so the land beneath my feet is my home.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: No need, I'll grab my weapon and shield and head to the training grounds.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: It's a warrior's duty, no need to thank me... Wha? Blushing? Of course I'm not blushing. How could you even tell I'm blushing through my tan?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thanks, Doctor... I'll take this medal back to my homeland. The spring there has dried up, but it will continue to bless me, and they will know that I'm still fighting.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Love, friends, hearth. That's what a warrior lives for.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Warriors! Your courage will bring glory.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't eat too much before a battle, unless you want to throw it all up.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Now we fight!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm well prepared!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: My sword is honed.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: You're not getting past me!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I see them.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Victory or death!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: We will defend our home!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The enemy will never see our backs!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Raise your weapons and shields! Not one step back!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: This is the home that we defend. This is where they die.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The invaders' swords cut their own throats. An end they deserve.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Haha, it is an honor to die defending my home.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: My homeland, my friends, my love... they're all waiting for me.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The heck? No alcohol here...? Huh? What's that in my mug? It's just some b… umm... bubbly barley juice.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey! Hands off.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hahaha! Oh, I hate being tickled…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The strongest liquor for the bravest warrior. This one is mine, Doctor. If you really want it... devour this whole roasted game, and you'll be our hero for the day!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Yo, Doctor, you sure you don't need to sun a bit?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I made this horn out of the sands of my tribal homeland. A new warrior blows her victory horn after her first battle. It's like the cry of a newborn, celebrating her arrival into the world.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I first saw Rhodes Island sailing in the distance when I was at the branch office. The rumbling of the ship and the tremor of the sands... it's like my chief was whispering in my ear: You've found another place worth fighting for.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, might these be the books and documents you were looking for? No, no need to thank me, I'm simply glad to be of help. How would I have known what you needed? Heheh. That would be... secret.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Phantom and I certainly have... our similarities, in what we've been through. Though now he pursues the truth, I only wish to be far removed from it.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor. About that lady who came to borrow your books... was her name Mint? She seems to be curious about a great many things. Curiosity in excess usually invites disaster, you see, and I have my reservations.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It is quite the relief you were with us last mission, Doctor. I find myself dazed by the sight of you when you command. As if something crosses past the curtain of night and the stirring stars, leading your way...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Dance, music. Both soothe the soul, twin arts calling on us to focus and follow. But at times, too great a fixation can be our undoing. Such stories were already far too plenty where I formerly lived. Even I... am no exception to the rule.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor? What are you standing there for...? I see... you overheard me talking with someone...? Cease with the jests, please. There is no one here... but me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You wish to learn of the Crimson Troupe's affairs? Of course, I know of them all. But take caution, Doctor, for should you stray like they from the proper path... or come near to too many of them, you may be taken hold of. And that is not, whatsoever, desirable.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Here you are once more. Please, sit. Be reassured that I will not drive you out. So, what's the matter this time? Could Hibiscus have made another healthy meal? Or is Sideroca bound to whisk you away for training again?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My stories are hackneyed, bereft of novelty. Likely, not as engaging as you imagine. You would like to hear them nonetheless? Very well. Then I will tell you tales... but in exchange, Doctor, would you grant me a request?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor. Doctor? Beg pardon, I know I should not disturb your rest... but it is far too still here for me to fully be at ease.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I envisaged the scene in which we would formally meet, Doctor, and this very moment brings it to life. Operator Shalem, pleased to make your acquaintance.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: At times, I do feel the battlefield and the stage resemble one another, in ways.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion, did you say...? Ah, I'm sorry, it just startled me. Thank you for your acknowledgement, Doctor.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Unlike him, still wreathed in his struggle, I had long since fled the past, never to concern me again... yes, Doctor, so I once hoped.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Worry not, coordinating with others is a strength of mine. So long as nothing untoward happens...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I may lack for power, but I will do all that I can.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Everyone, follow me, please.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: See those on the stage... knowing nothing of their fates.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Fret not.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Their future is clear to see.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I hope we may resolve this peacefully.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: To kill and to be killed, to do battle. Far too many plays are penned on these themes.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: And may this end as swiftly as can be.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The path you all now walk bears not one hope.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Surely, your skulls... would be mesmerizing to see, right?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hahahaha... haha, hahahahahahaha...

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: This is far beyond my wildest dreams. The best outcome, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: It is done. Be at ease, for no danger remains. Well done, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Our mission is complete, Doctor. As for those who escaped... they have their own fates to meet.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Haste not; ponder leisurely. We still have opportunities.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Shall we rest here a while? How about some music?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ah... I'm sorry, I was lost in thought.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, could you hold my coat for me briefly? I'll be done in a moment. My thanks.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Some dance and song is all it takes—days like these never fail to tempt art into showing a hint of its beauty, such that more would bow to it. A grand performance is about to begin, Doctor, and when the time has come, will you be able to recognize the true me beneath the limelight?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Welcome, Doctor. Indeed, I knew you would surely come.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Excellent, you are here just as I expected. Though some young operators express their affection in far too ardent ways, you'll nevertheless break their hearts should you hide away like this. And one more hint before you open the door, try to place your feet back, and find something to brace against. Yes. This way, you won't be thrown to the floor when they joyfully tackle you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I have to wear this...? Are you sure, Doctor? I don't recall this sort of adornment being called for on the stage... Very well... And dance with you? That would be a little... Oh my. Excuse me, Doctor. The steps here should go like this... Here, let me show you.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Have someone else handle the paperwork and filing. But if you need anyone dealt with, or protected, just give me the list of names. I'll take care of them.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: These are clothes and snacks for Lisa, along with gifts for her friends. As for this box of old books her papa insisted I bring, I'm not sure what they're for. I'll just let Lisa decide what to do with them.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Uniform? No, thanks. I don't know why you people need so many pockets. Just as I can't grasp why the Higashinese stuff planks and pillows in their waistbands, making it so terribly hard to move around… Anyway, I'm fine with this outfit, and it has nothing to do with me being Siracusan.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Some of the operators here have unsteady breathing. Perhaps they could try reciting a tanka or two to adjust their breaths as they strike, like: 'Solitude seeps not from autumn shade, but from the mountain pines in red sun's fall.' Or 'I bear no off'ring branch unto the hills, for rich brocades of maple sate the gods.' You think these lines evoke a particular image? Hm. Probably.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: No need to hide the Wolumonde story from me. Hm, you look nervous, but I'm not here to cast blame, my daughter knows the meaning of her work. Suzuran is no fragile flower, and I am no hidebound gardener.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My return trip to Siracusa? The perpetrator is dead, so there is little else to say. The man who, in his lust for power, deprived so many of a decent life, did not deserve a decent death.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Lost in thought? Is something wrong? Hm, some business less suited to a so-called pharmaceutical company, is it? If you need my help, do speak clearly now. You see, Doctor, I have only the patience to manage this single braid.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The wine tasting is already finished? I went to freshen up and hurried back as quickly as I could... Ah, sorry, but my work demands it. You see, precision is everything. I must be meticulous about which bastard die at which moment, not a second sooner. Hehe, but we don't need to pick a time for whiskey. Care to stay a while longer?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: So much snow on the deck, and yet the corridors are not cold. I detest inconsistent weather, so the landship has been a blessing. I only just realized how long I've been here. You're right, an assassin's vacation is a good thing, for herself, and others.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'll stay here, just call me if you need something. Hard to believe? Sometimes, I can be very patient, Doctor. Have you ever tried combing nineteen tails in one go?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello. You must be 'the incredible Doctor' Lisa always mentions in her letters. Hmm, I've been curious to know what you looked like, and here you are. Which reminds me, could you update me on Lisa's studies, if you have the time?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's not often I see recordings of myself. I fought my battles in quiet alleyways, with no witnesses.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I appreciate the recognition. But this means those after the bounty on my head will come looking for Rhodes Island. You are not worried?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I accept your medal, Doctor. You needn't say more. I do know the difference between this medal, and the emblems of the Siracusan family.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave the toughest one for me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just keep yourselves safe, ladies and gentlemen.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: My ears are sharp, so when I stop, you stop.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Need to parley with them? But I rarely do such things, whether I'm in Siracusa or Higashi.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm all ears.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: So much negotiation and we end up talking with our blades.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Splendid day today.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Beautiful place.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hate and resentment have no place, but in a burst of autumn red.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Flowers imbibed, the lady in suit and tie dance with her blade.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: At least make me lose the coat.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Why the rush? The road to the afterlife is crowded enough.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Higashinese shoji screens often run a common theme. The kami created life and land to propagate themselves… A pity they didn't care for what came after. Sorting out this mess is hard work.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: There's nothing to clean up. Let's go.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Crawling out of the swamp is hard enough, never mind doing it gracefully.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Leave the rest to me... it's clear why we failed, and I know how to make it even.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The soundproofing of this place is excellent. Was it done for professional reasons?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hehe, even Lisa has grown out of this by now.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: The scar on my face? I wasn't born with it... Let's just leave it at that.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year. What a wonderful gathering. Dancing, chatting, making noise just for fun, instead of drowning out a struggle. Hmm… Lisa's making her way here, Doctor. That was sake in my cup and not a double whiskey shot, understand?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor... Hehe, I can hear your footsteps even with my ears folded.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy Birthday, Doctor. Lisa's papa asked me to give you this omamori. He hopes to visit you in person, if given the chance. As for me, I offer a promise: my blade is yours whenever you need it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I first contacted Rhodes Island because it was the best place to treat Lisa. But now, I would send her here to learn, even if she were perfectly healthy. Do not let this landship ever stop, Doctor, not after it has been sailing for so long.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Here, two Minoan Mists, freshly brewed... I'll have to behave myself, Doctor, since I'm your assistant now. The next time you choke on my strangling tail after getting me mad, I'll make sure you can at least find some solace in my feathers.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Immoral scientist, disloyal mercenary, double-crossing spy... Yes, that's all me. Rules are what bar you from working to your full efficiency, darling, and you must learn to break them. That being said, I'm sure you have more to share with me for what little time we have alone together, other than the rules of Rhodes Island, I suppose?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: As senior consultant to Rhodes Island, I'd love to have more time to study the archives and collections of this ship. Meet my coworkers? You see the flow of history and soundless order in those objects. Tell me, what's worth seeing in people?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: 'Reflect the truth and glimpse the future'? Most astrologers got started just to steal a peek at their own doom. But when Kristen tore open the skies over Trimounts, she debunked astrology as the silly fabrication it is. And that's more interesting than the practice itself.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The foolish build walls, the wise topple them... or vice versa. History is a database that holds more than it seems, full of hints about the future. After all, history itself was the future for countless generations... that's what really grips me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Our story? Feathers wet by dew from the trees, tails sweeping past decrepit pillars. Thus, knowledge was passed on through generations. We embrace the ever-expanding unknown, and walk toward madness... I don't want to lose my mind, of course. But if that's what it takes to change this ridiculous fate, then I'll do it gladly.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, were you… avoiding me? I just wanted to show you a newly-excavated ruin I found. What's that? Why do I keep bothering you? Oh my, shouldn't you do some soul-searching and ask why you are the only one I'm bothering?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I saw you with Muelsyse at the mall in Trimounts. That elf surely knows how to work her charm, doesn't she? I could use some assistance from you as well, but my 'approaches' are different. Look down now, my tail will gladly learn the way through your heart, unless you accept my offer.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Tell me, Doctor, how does it feel to lose your memory? I couldn't bear to see a great library reduced to ashes in a fire. But a librarian fool enough to only brush the dust off the shelves pains me even more. Who's sadder, you or me?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Your ears are red. Sensitive, aren't they? Puff... oh, they're getting redder! Now don't you move. You're still at work, you know.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm not here representing Maylander or Rhine Lab. I'm here because I, Ho'olheyak, want some further contact with Rhodes Island... Now, now, why are you trying to shake off my hand? I haven't finished introducing myself yet.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are we done yet?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Congratulations. You've earned yourself a promotion from me too. This time, I brewed four Minoan Mists... do they really punch you that hard? Stay sober now, if you know what's good for you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Another promotion? Does that mean more permissions at Rhodes Island? There are secrets in this ship that even you don't know about, I can sense that. Just what fun we'll have!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: My job is to innovate on these missions. Your job is to be impressed.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: There's no plan. Plans change anyway. As long as it helps the mission, you can break the rules at any time.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'd rather operate solo.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Oh? What a surprise.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I thought I was just here as a consultant.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: My, my... Are you sure you want to treat me as a mercenary?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Such ruthlessness! I said I don't like getting my feathers wet.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: How rude~ Didn't I tell you not to get dust on my tail?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Leaving so soon?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Could you even leave?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Oh, your Arts aren't working. How can that be?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Did I say I was going to have mercy? I lied.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, your performance reminds me of a bunch of unfounded legends. But now, I believe in them. Legends no more.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Are you… waiting for a compliment?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Nothing is 100% true. Similarly, nothing is 100% false. Doctor, what we've done is already enough to bring all kinds of change.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Leave the rest to me. I'm used to picking up other people's messes. Use the time to think about how you'll thank me.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Excuse me, are we accommodating a mercenary here, or is this how Rhodes Island welcomes their senior consultant...? Heh, Just kidding.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What, here to challenge Siestan Iced Tea? Or, Minoan Mist?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Careful! These are rare documents. How did I get them? Relax, not by following procedure, I assure you. What, you wanna interrogate me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Historical society awards ceremony? An annual party for the astrology association? Not interested. Don't you dare think about all that boring stuff when you're with me. C'mon, it's New Year's Day. Aren't you going to ask me to dance? Don't worry, I'll keep my tail from you this time.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Well, if it isn't the Doctor… What a coincidence, us bumping into each other.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Me? Ha, It's not like the short lifespan of my people will allow me to have too many birthdays anyway. I just didn't want to pass on this cursed knowledge. Do I still have time to change things…? Ha, look at me, it's your birthday, and I'm the drunk one.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The skies of Trimounts have been restored, Dr.{@nickname}, but no one will forget what they saw when they were torn open. What do you see in the future of this land? What can Rhodes Island do? What can I do for you, and for myself? I want your answers.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You want me to do something so boring...? Fine, fine. I'll tag along, just because you're somewhat amusing.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Don't count on me to move stuff. I'm not that brand of Forte.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This is some insanely precise instrumentation... Wait, haven't I seen these before? Oh, right. If that Mayer girl shows up, don't tell her where I am.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Never seen the equipment on my back before? Right, come over, put your hand here... keh-ka-hahahahahah! Look at your pathetic face! Guess what just sprayed out? It's water!—With a few... extras. Don't bother asking what!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My interest in helping others is zip. But boosting efficiency benefits everybody.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Battles finish up faster now. Good to know, I guess.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Cake? Soft and squishy—not my speed. But. Mmp, mmnm... the umeboshi on top's not bad, sure.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: No rain inside the landship? Duh, obviously I know that. But you never know how it might go outside. Hmph, next time there's a storm, stick close to me. You'll be glad I'm holding this.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Hey. Fancy a desert day trip? I can guide you around there. Or anywhere else you like, as long as I have my multi-function jetpack, following the scent of the wind... heh, you're incredibly lucky to have a guide like me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You out cold? Hehe, then I've got a trick to try. Higher pressure, wider spray... And you're past the statute of limitations for a complaint.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You the Doctor? They all say you're the one here who knows more than the rest. You're gonna let me figure that out.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Combat's just like crossing the desert, where experience means nothing. Your only need is survival instincts.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doesn't this elite medal do anything at all? No fun to be had here.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Medical professional? Funny thing to call me that. Anyway, it's all about getting my job done, either way, right?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Out for field work again? Fine. You're helping me test new equipment when we get back.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Leading a team in combat is close enough to being a guide.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Route, okay. Equipment, check. Let's go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Boring... Worse than running into a sandstorm.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Speak up.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm thinking...

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Good. Efficiency up seventeen percent.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Need to move faster.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Even faster.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Time to test my upgraded equipment.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: How's the new nutritional paste taste?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Scent of the wind's changed...

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ugh. The sandstorms I've seen beat this any day.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Scraped by, huh. Wasn't a waste of time after all.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Efficiency lacking. Gotta head back and adjust my equipment, or switch reagents, maybe.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: At least you figured a good retreat route…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: You have a lot of rooms, huh…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You gotta stop with the boring crap already.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Wanna try touching my bag again? Won't hit you in the face this time. Promise.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Wishing you a Happy New Year! I look forward to your kind guidance in the coming year. Okay, done. Without a hitch, right? Happy now?—a bonus? For me? Really? Hmm... thank you. Happy New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Rain again. Nice weather, huh, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. Here's this umbrella's for you. I bought it from a trustworthy merchant in Sargon—It's top-notch. You'll be traveling all over the place, so it'll come in handy. Oh, and if you feel like jumping off the ship's bridge with it, I won't stop you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I've checked Rhodes Island's navigation log. You've been down some awfully treacherous routes. But why don't I see even a hint of fear in anybody? What talent do you have, as the one who guides the ship, to bring out such deep, unshakable trust? I'm... curious.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: That's everything that needs doing done! Anything else you need me to handle, like your schedule, your finances… What do you mean, you can't let me touch those?! Why not? I'm good with those too!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I saw that, Doctor. What's that you're hiding behind your back? Is it a soft drink? You shouldn't drink so much of that stuff, it'll rot your teeth. I'm confiscating it.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I ran into the Saluzzo Vino bigshot in the corridor just now. If I ever have the chance, I'd like to have a meal with him, and if I get really lucky, I'd like to talk business with him. Of course I'm not scared of him. He's like me. Everything we do, we do for our families—'Family comes first, after all'. I think he should get where I'm coming from.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: If you keep putting things off, it'll only get worse. That's why I'm not a fan of the words 'we will talk about this later'. If you can get things done, best get them done right away. I cut this fruit for you like half an hour ago, Doctor, so why haven't you eaten it yet? You're in the middle of a teleconference? Tell them to wait, and finish your fruit. Now.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Don't worry about me. Some problems, you can't fix right away. So long as you can get through today, you'll find a way tomorrow. So long as tomorrow comes, it means things aren't over yet. That's what I told myself after Paola's accident. Every day, many times.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm starting to understand why Paola started the orchestra. Where you're born, what blood runs through your veins. They're obvious ties that bring a family together. But there are other bonds too. People keeping each other warm, people sharing the same dream. They can become a family as well. I really hope she can see all this.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Sometimes, the members of the orchestra feel like I'm overbearing, but I can't help it. I believe that if you actually care, you can't just ignore things. I am taking my time to learn 'boundaries' from Hibiscus, though. So, if I ever cross the line, Doctor, tell me right away.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I started off helping Paola with things at home. Errands, scheduling, accounts, you know. But before I knew it, I ended up taking care of the entire orchestra, and I had to get a lot better at remembering everyone's habits. But when it comes to you, Doctor, I don't think I'll have any problems remembering, even if there were a hundred of you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Where's your hometown, Doctor? Were you always 'the Doctor of Rhodes Island'? Sometimes I'm not too sure if I'm a Siracusan, or a Leithanian of Siracusa. Where will I ultimately end up? Well, for now, let me be Ripresa of Rhodes Island, just for a little while.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Doctor~ Dooooc—toooor—*sigh* It's not the same as in the concert hall. You get reverberation there.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Are you our orchestra's new partner? You've got a good eye, because we're not just 'an orchestra of Leithanians'. Oh, nearly forgot to introduce myself. I'm the orchestra's manager, codename 'Ripresa'.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Bringing out everyone's unique timbre at the perfect moment… That's not a simple chord to strike.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Does this mean I can apply to start an orchestra on Rhodes Island, Doctor?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Since you have such high expectations of me, Doctor, would you consider being my patron and sponsoring my college studies? I'd like to push my managerial skills further so I don't disappoint you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: What part do you need me to cover? Just tell me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Need me to lead a big group to go negotiate? Good thing I've got plenty of experience doing that.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Wait, let me check the plan again before we head off… Okay, let's go.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Uh, those guys don't look like they're here to negotiate.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Nice pick.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: No problem!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: It'll be easy.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I can adapt.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'll solve it right away!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I'm a pro, you know!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: In for a measure, in for a movement!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: This flame is my heart unyielding.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Y-You were amazing, Doctor! Come, teach me! I want to be able to lead everyone like you next time.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I did it! All my planning paid off. Good work, me.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Making it to the end is already pretty good! Don't worry, I'll do better next time. Make sure to keep up with me, Doctor!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I won't call it quits here. I will get everyone through this. C'mon, let's check on the wounded first. Is everyone still okay?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I've got it! Let me see how to operate this thing first.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whoa! Seriously, Doctor, can you stick to getting your work done? I'm tied up, too.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I did pretty well, right? A little praise would be nice—

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! When I lived with Paola, she would always say you need to do something lucky on the first day of the year. I was thinking, we should start with some new year blessings. We can slowly gather up all that good luck over the year, no rush—

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I've already gotten today's work organized. Where would you like to start, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! You've got enough on your mind most days, so today, don't think about all that stuff and let me handle everything. First, come and listen to our performance. We'll treat you to a super-luxurious Siracusan feast afterwards—Wait, Doctor, no need to change into formalwear…

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: *sigh* How long has it been since we first met, Doctor? So much has happened this year, and I'm struggling to remember it all. But it doesn't matter. I'm used to looking ahead, and this time, I know who's on my side. The future's looking nice and easy.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: These documents won't take me long to take care of. Why don't you show me Rhodes Island's old business contracts? You never know what kind of restitutions there might be hidden in a contract's terms.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, when you work out your business plans, feel free to put off the legal ramifications till the very end. I've never lost a case as a defense attorney.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Huh? Even that ice-cold Młynar is here? And here I thought he'd want a breather after leaving his job behind in the Grand Knight Territory. Well, Rhodes Island isn't a bad place. At least they don't expect you to wine-and-dine clients here. Otherwise, considering his alcohol tolerance...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Is that a Kazimierzian newspaper you're reading, Doctor? 'Despite Conclusive Evidence, Knight Sports Match Fixers Found Innocent'—Oh, I was in charge of that case. What does that mean? Hehe, if they walked away scot-free, then obviously the evidence wasn't conclusive enough.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've never actually worked for a multinational corporation before, so I've been reading up on other countries' laws, too. But no matter where you are, the lawbooks make it clear as day who benefits under their rules.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The courtroom is a place of victory and defeat. Both sides submit their evidence, and their disputes are arbitrated within the confines of the law. I never expected to find any justice in that process, but when the law can be freely trampled on by capitalism, being a lawyer gets real boring, don't you think?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Ugh, my back hurts. I kind of want a massage chair, but money's tight with my current salary. But considering Rhodes Island's revenue, I suppose the pay isn't completely unreasonable—Speaking of which, what do you think of my plan to demand compensation from companies we've worked with? What? How can it be extortion when we're asking for pocket change?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, I think there are a lot of problems with the medical malpractice liability clauses in Rhodes Island's contracts. In most countries, we as a medical company wouldn't be liable for a lot of the scenarios listed in there—You don't want to fix it? Alright, I'll give it some more thought.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I'm slowly starting to understand that expecting the law be able to judge all disputes fairly isn't just naive, it's intellectually lazy. The law is not perfect, and it will always be riddled with holes that we need to fill with humanity.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: So even the Doctor likes to sleep at the desk, just like me. I'll be worried about your spine if this keeps up, though…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, my name is Deszcz. I'm your new legal consultant. If you need to call me by a codename, then use Proviso. Let me get this out of the way first, though. The general practice of obfuscating all your employees' identities isn't going to fly with me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: If you're putting me in charge, I can make sure the enemies will be liable for all damages.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Let me take a look at the new contract... Alright, everything checks out. My salary did go up. Thanks!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: If you're letting me read these high clearance level materials, this is going way beyond a normal partnership, isn't it...? Thanks for your trust, Doctor. I hope I'll be able to accomplish with law what I never could before I came here.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm glad to help, but before we get started, can we be more explicit with regards to the terms of compensation?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everyone, please be sure to handle the work you're assigned. Do not give our opponents any loopholes.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The court is now in session!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I've gathered enough materials on our opponents. They will lose this case.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I never prepare drafts.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ahem. Allow me to present my argument.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: If you are not party to this suit, please leave at once.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Order! The court will soon reach a verdict.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hold it! The evidence submitted by the opposing party is suspect.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Objection! The witness's testimony is self-contradictory.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Anything you say can and will be used against you. I suggest you exercise your right to remain silent.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Based on the above, you are found guilty.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No surprise there. As long as you understand how to use the system, the results follow naturally.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I take it I met your expectations, Doctor? Now, per our contract, let's discuss legal fees.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Don't worry, we'll get this case thrown out and win the retrial.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Something must've gone wrong somewhere... I won't let this kind of failure happen again.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Can I apply for a more comfortable chair?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, I took a photo of what you just did as evidence.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I wanted to treat myself to a gift at the end of the year, only to find myself completely broke. This would've been unthinkable at my old job... Oh, whatever. It's a new year. Better not dwell on the past. Happy New Year, Doctor!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm happy to report that Rhodes Island is not currently involved in any legal disputes, for now.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. These scales of justice are a graduation gift I got from my law school. Take them. Not that I don't want them anymore, but I just thought it would be more meaningful for you to keep them in your room.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Taking in patients with a incurable disease feels just like taking on an unwinnable case... That said, I also believe that the value of doing something isn't determined entirely by the results. Keep it up, Doctor, and let me deal with all those pesky corporate rivals.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, do all these files need to be filled out by today? It's just, with this much left... so be it, I'll help you out. If we sort this out together, it shouldn't eat into our break hours.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: When I decided to violate orders and act independently, I was expecting a severe reprimand. What I never predicted was that Mr. Executor would recommend me here…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, do you know if there's anywhere to borrow storybooks here? Operators at the Medical Department have asked me to care for the children under treatment, and I'd like to read them a tale or two.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The Notarial Hall employs more than just field executors; there's plenty of civil service posts. I actually aspired for one in the first place, but when it came to the evaluation, I accidentally... um, collapsed a few rooms in the examination venue, which got me put in my current position.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I don't rue leaving Laterano; it was my own choice. There's so many places I'm still not familiar with, but I feel that being able to see the breadth of Terra like I am now is more than worth it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The Sankta ability to perceive each other's states of mind is common sense to us, not something that needs real elaboration. But I'm sad to say, at some point, I suddenly realized I lost that reciprocation with my own people. It wasn't any physical disease, I just... began to think.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Stop, Doctor! Phew. You took the wrong cup—that's the espresso I brewed for myself, with no sugar. Yours was the one next to it. Sorry, I assume it was too bitter? ...It's fine, it tastes great? A—Alright, I'm glad you like it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, could you lend me your comms device for a moment? I usually turn my comms off after work, and don't get any messages. ...There we go, I've granted you emergency contact privileges. You can get in touch with me whenever for whatever, this way.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You seem to be having plenty of fun. Yes, I can tell. Joy, sorrow, anger... emotions can propagate between all of us, regardless of what city or race we come from. When you're happy, it's no wonder I can sense it too.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, are you still awake? It's just a little longer now. We can be on break once this work's done. Here, I have your coffee.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm a dispatch at Rhodes Island via a transfer agreement with the Notarial Hall. A codename? Let's think... You can call me Enforcer. Here's the files pertaining to the agreement. I'll be counting on you to show me the ropes.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Brilliant. It'll be quick for me to adapt to this combat style.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion... Is this going to impact my specific working hours?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Maybe it's immature of me to approach things this way, but every step I've taken up to today is of my own choosing, and I'm satisfied with that. Doctor, thank you so much for watching over me all this time.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: A new mission? Understood.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: If we run into any contingency situations, I will independently judge how to proceed.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The sooner we're out, the sooner we're on break.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Do we have to compensate for damages incurred in combat?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: By your order.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Enforcing.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This battle is by no means out of animosity.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: We all simply have differing viewpoints, no more.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: This is as far as you go.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: A struggle with an ideal to support it is far from meaningless.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I will hear you all out afterwards.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Be careful not to fall from here, everyone.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: They have what they uphold, and we have ours. Thank you for the willingness to realize, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete. Good work, Doctor. Let's take a good break once we're back.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The ones who ran—did they give up? Or, maybe...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No need to be so dejected. We can still try again.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: So these are the renowned Rhodes Island dormitories? Very... well, frugal.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Careful! You could've spilled the coffee.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I wear eyemasks while I'm on break, so I can only tell you all apart by your footsteps. Was that just now... the Doctor?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: This is my first time welcoming in the New Year somewhere beyond Laterano. There's still plenty of places I'm not used to, but I've tried so many things I never tried before, and that... feels pretty good. Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Want some coffee, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. It seems you've already gotten plenty of cakes today. So, here's my present—a mug of premium coffee. It is totally devoid of sugar, but if you taste carefully, you can pick out a fruity, caramel sweetness... Doctor, is something wrong? Doctor?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: There are so many fellow Sankta aboard Rhodes Island. The sympathy might be missing, but I can see the joy and blessing on their faces as plain as day. Is it because they've all found a goal worth devoting themselves to here? If so, Doctor, I'll appreciate any future guidance you have for me.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Sort these files? Fine, but before we begin your trivial task, you might have a look at these plans I've mapped out for you.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: There are no famiglie in Nuova Volsinii, not a single one. A famiglia must flip into a corporation before it can enter the city, and that's hardly a bother. Indeed… and there's not much difference between a mafia and a corporation, whether Siracusan or foreign.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The Bellones took me in when I was five, and trained me to become Leon's consigliere. With this bulky suitcase in tow, I went to many places and met many faces as I ran errands and collected intelligence. Even now, I still do many things myself.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You want to learn to knuckle-roll a lighter as fast as I do? It's easy, here. Don't worry, just try again. I practice these tricks to keep my hands nimble—after all, there are times when you can't just draw a blade, even in Siracusa.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: At first, the famiglie were just packs of runts keeping each other alive, while the dons used them as tools to grab power. But in Nuova Volsinii, under Leon's rules, a famiglia does imply a real family now—at least, that's how it is for the Bellones.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You think the Bellone name is important? No, what's important is our people and our bond. As for Rhodes Island… we have an excellent working relationship, but if you hope to advance our working relationship even further… you'll have to prove a familial bond exists between us first, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
