lines.text: You were told that enjoying authentic Siracusan cuisine is a proper show of respect to a Siracusan? No, I differ on this. You come to my home, and I make sure you're sated. Finishing the food on your plate is a show of respect to me, è così semplice.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Of course, you may overlook my concern and kindness, as many do when they first meet me. But soon, you will meet something you can't manage on your own, and then, well… Someday, and that day may never come, I will call upon you to do a service for me. And you will say sì.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Passively carrying out orders isn't my style. Taking control, eliminating all obstacles when the opportunity strikes, and achieving my objective, by any means—That's how I do things, so you'll want to get used to it, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You're looking a little sluggish… it's time to rest. Here's a cocktail. Salute.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: So Leon's codename is 'Vigil'? Abandoning both his family and his name… I see. Well then, Operator Bellone, reporting in.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Violence is only the means, and not the end. But these pups are too inefficient at it.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion… It's been a long time since someone's used this word with me. Feels fresh.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Titles and tokens don't necessarily equate to trust, but at least they show how you see me. È un onore.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Let's go. It's time we witness the fruition of our plans.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Do as I say, and ask no questions.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I don't need so many hands with me. Those on standby, just watch us work.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Stay silent and wait.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: You're asking me? I say it's time to move.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Don't hesitate.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll handle it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The Bellones say hello.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: It's time to repay your debt.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This is the price you pay for offending the famiglia.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll take care of your family when you're gone.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Meticulous plans, finely executed. You'll get used to these splendid triumphs with me around, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Not all donuts come out with a hole. I'll review it when we get back.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Stragglers will return for revenge, so we'll have to devise a plan to eradicate all possible threats.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's see… how can we flip the situation to our advantage?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: You have a big famiglia of your own. That's no easy feat, making sure they're all cared for.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Did I miss something important?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Let's go for a walk and inspect our territory.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The new year is a time for family gatherings. I should go eat with my famiglia. An unshakable tradition. We'll have dinner together after that. It might be a late one, but I'll make it back before the clock turns over.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Demetri Certaldo Bellone, happy to serve.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Birthdays only come once a year. So, what would you like to eat? Anything you fancy. Yes, even a pineapple pizza, if you dare—though I'm sure you know you'll pay for it someday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Your eyes… remind me of a friend. Idealistic eyes, shining bright. Don't worry, I'll help you out—by my rules.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'll sort out your battlefield reports for you. My officialese isn't too shabby. I'll stand guard during your rest hours. Anything else required...? I'd prefer you don't keep me idle.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Has Bagpipe kept up her habit of humming around you? Me? I'm more the type to appreciate music in peace. The only thing a horn can play is the order to charge—I'm joking of course, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The name 'White Wolf' goes as far back in history as the Aslan monarchy. Why are you interested, though? ...Ah. You saw... my fangs? I'm sorry, I lost control of myself then. I won't let it happen again.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I have beautiful handwriting? Thank you. It just comes with the facade when you're raised noble, which I've never been keen on. But sometime these days, I'm grateful for it—whenever I pick up a pen, everything else leaves my mind, and my focus is only on how I write every letter in the proper way.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: As that city spat great black crystals from its gaping wounds, I thought there could be no hope left for it... Is this place familiar with those made Infected not by Catastrophe, but by human hands, Doctor of Rhodes Island?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island Operator Misery managed to rescue me twice, and I'm sincerely grateful for it. I won't ask why I was the one he rescued. Those who live on are to carry forth the wishes of those who didn't make it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I always feel stifled by gloomy indoor atmospheres. Do you want to go out and take a walk, Doctor? It might be overcast, but at least there'll be a breeze. There are times you can hear singing on the wind too, not just the echo of your own words.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I can vaguely remember the portraits of my ancestors decorated with medals in the hall. I also recall the épée carved with the Lion King's orders, and the maples my father planted in the front courtyard... but that's all that comes to me. I haven't returned home in a long, long while. In Her chaotic theater, Victoria's soldiers have no time to file for leave.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, does a commander as outstanding as you ever feel sorrow? Or anger? Or... hate? I try as hard as I can not to let personal emotions sway me, but I can't forget. I promised them I would never forget.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: How do you sleep, after having witnessed so much cruelty...? If I could do the same as you, with a simple shut of my eyes, would I feel any better?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Tempest Platoon Leader Horn reporting in, Doctor of Rhodes Island. I've already borne witness to your own tactics, and the fighting spirit of Rhodes Island's operators. Under our ensuing cooperation, I and my troops will heed your orders.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: No amount of training can ever suffice.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you. I'll regard this as a commendation of my performance, and not a reflection of my status.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Confer your emblems of rank on me. I'm willing... No. I must bear the hopes of more. Of those past, now, and to come.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Victoria's servicemen should take pride in their own discipline.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I trust in my platoonmates at any and all times. I'd like you to put that same trust in me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We have no time to hesitate. There are souls waiting for us, behind the firing line.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'll put up my shield. Don't stand in front of me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Allow me to study your command style in this battle, Doctor.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: At attention. Ready to fall in.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Orders received.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I will complete my assignment.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The Tempest must wipe out all that blocks the way.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Come! Best me if you can!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'll impart on you all the cries I've heard.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You want to topple me? By what?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: One victory may not be enough to impact a whole war, but it can at least give more people a chance to see the open sky.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Target has been suppressed.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Any mercy on the enemy is a potential disaster. Let me lead my troops to settle this.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Not a worry, Doctor. Until you've gotten everyone away, I will not fall.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It doesn't resemble Victoria here, but... it reminds me of when I studied at the Royal Guard Academy.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Sorry, I'm not used to setting down my weapons. Did I bruise you?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hm...? I'm just reading an ordinary novel. I've gone an awfully long time without reading something new. All the written word went up in the fires of war.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: When Misery rescued me, he told me the New Year had already come and gone. That was the first one I ever missed. Ever since, I've begun to pay less attention to these holidays at all.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Have you rested well?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: What rite should I be celebrating your birthday by? I don't believe you to be fond of drinking parties, so I'll sing for you, then. This is a small little ceremonial from back in the Tempest Platoon.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Periodic summations and celebrations both can't be dispensed with. When Amiya's speech wound up, the instant the people around me started laughing and bellowing, I relaxed. That surprised me. I see what's past is past now.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You want me to be your assistant? I can't, I barely know how to read. It'll just be a waste of your time. But if you need something fixed, then I can help.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I'm too frugal? I don't think so, I just live the way I want. Machinery is good, but I don't need it to do anything fancy. Same goes for my clothes, only the stuff I make myself suits me best. If you have fewer needs, then of course you spend less money.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: When my dad was killed, I honestly thought there wasn't a single good man among the Sarkaz. But now that I think about it, I was too naive at the time. How can stuff like race or appearance decide if someone's good or bad? No matter what your race is, as long as you look out for one another, you're family.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: This outfit? Made it myself—it's gotta be as cool as possible since it gets really hot in the boiler room. It... doesn't look like work attire? What d'ya mean? There's all sorts of different workers, and each has her own needs.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Neighbors who take care of each other, simple but comfortable furniture, an ever-growin' pile of spare parts, and machinery that clanks together like the growl of thunder. Now, that's the good life. I thought my dad'd grow old with his factory, and I'd grow old with the next-generation factory, but...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doesn't matter what it is - as long as you make it yourself, it feels like home. Same goes for Londinium. Every brick and tile was laid down by Londiniers. We know what Londinium is thinkin', and we're gonna take it back with our own hands.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Sometimes the commander reads books that are really hard to understand... I remember a line went somethin' like this, 'People built cities, but refused to adapt to them.' Not sure I agree with that though. As long as you find your own way to live, it doesn't make a difference whether you're in the city or in the middle o' nowhere.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My dad and my old friends always used to say I was stubborn, stroppy, and foul-tempered. Don't think there's anything wrong with being stubborn, you need a bit of that to protect people around you. But, I failed... Cause... Where are they now...?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Here, Dr. {@nickname}. Why am I givin' money to you? 'Cause I can't spend it all, there's no point keepin' it around, and you happened to pass by. No need to be polite, I always used to give money to my friends, so they all got used to it. Huh, you don't need it? Damn it, gotta find someone else then...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, Dr. {@nickname}... Oh, havin' a sleep? Let me find a blanket for ya... Hmm, if I made a new blanket, the Doctor would probably find that helpful…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps Caster, Rockrock, reporting in. Dr. {@nickname}, we've had a few misunderstandings in the past, but I'm not blinded by those old prejudices anymore. I hope we can have a good working relationship.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: That's crazy... I gotta ask again, are you sure you're a drug company?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I don't care about my rank. As long as I'm with friends... I'm always ready for the next battle.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I fight to reclaim my home, and to put an end to the war. I hope that one day, we'll be able to put down our weapons and pick up the tools to rebuild Londinium. Just like... in the past.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Of course, it's my job to protect my family.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Be careful. Your safety is more important than victory.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: My drones are ready, Doctor. Should I scout ahead?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Found 'em. They're not gettin' away!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm here, Doctor. I can see the enemy's tracks.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Standing by. Doctor, where do you need me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Ready to deploy my drones.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Activating Rock-18 attack module.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Rock-18, track the enemy!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: It's up to us to protect our homes!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'm not watching my friends die again!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Rock-18, maximum power!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I know my drone better than anyone else. It can't do that on its own. The fact that you've used it so effectively just shows how great a commander you are, Dr. {@nickname}.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A total victory with no casualties. Dr. {@nickname}, if you were around back then, would things have... turned out differently?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The enemies are gettin' away, after them... Wait, no, scrap that. They might be leadin' us into a trap... Safety's gotta come first.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Run, Doctor, I'll hold them off! ...It's alright, there's no need to worry... When I joined the Self-Salvation Corps, I was prepared for this moment.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place... isn't the same as my home, but it's just as warm. I really like it here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Aw!... Is something wrong? I'm just lookin' at this exhaust fan. Closure said this model's five years old, but it's the first time I've seen it... So ingenious.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh, Dr. {@nickname}? I'm makin' a wooden carving for you. The things I make are usually only good for me, but it should be fine givin' away simple stuff like decorations, right?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Dr. {@nickname}. Do you have any wishes? Mine? Umm... I wish that we'll be able to spend every New Year in peace, up until the day we die.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good mornin', Dr. {@nickname}. Time for another day of hard work.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I heard it's your birthday today, so happy birthday! Here's a present from me to you. Um, that's you and Amiya carved on there. It's my first go with this sort of ornamental thing, so it didn't turn out too well... You like it? Oh, that's brilliant, then!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, enjoying yourself? Me? Mm-hm, of course I'm happy. Everyone's having a proper lively get-together, there's nothing better than that. Oh, that reminds me, I just drew this prize and I'm not really in need of it. You want it?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Ummm... Doctor, the documents on the shelves are a bit messy. Back home, I had a tabletop assistant device that automatically organized our files. All you had to do was stick the files in, then it would package and seal them. I think you should get something like that too.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Wanting to see new places is a pretty common reason for leaving home, isn't it? To be honest, every time I climb a tall mountain or dive into a deep lake, I feel like I've made the right choice.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, are you a fan of wide-open landscapes? For example, imagine yourself next to a lake, watching the surface of the water rise and fall, the clouds gathering and dispersing, the sun slowly drooping behind the horizon, painting the lake a dazzling gold... That's the kind of scenery I love.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: A Catastrophe? Are we really going to cruise past a Catastrophe?! I didn't get to see the last one up close, so I can't let this opportunity slip by! I'm going out right–– What? The door to the bridge is locked?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My staff turns minerals into healing agents, sometimes with other special effects depending on the type of material used. You don't believe me...? I'm being serious here, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've helped more and more people, which gives me a sense of accomplishment. But as a physician, I still wish there were fewer and fewer casualties from people fighting each other.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, have you seen fluorescent mushrooms before? There used to be a bunch of them growing by the rocks near the waterfall I played at as a kid. Some of them grew taller than the tallest person in the clan, serving as lamps to bring light to places where the city could not reach.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My original reason for coming above ground was simple: I wanted to survey the geography around my homeland, and soak up the sights and sounds along the way. Now I travel further and further not only for the sights I haven't seen, but also for the people who need my help.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, why do people bloody themselves fighting each other? I can treat a wound or two, maybe even a lot more than that, but what can I do as a physician if the people don't change their minds?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Your desk is still a bit messy. Let me clean things up for you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Pleased to meet you, Dr.{@nickname}. This is for you. It's a specimen box made from gemstones I collected – lapis lazuli, turquoise, plum tourmaline, chalcedony…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The lens doesn't move, Doctor. Do you think if we gave this to a Durin operator, they'd be able to upgrade it to automatically follow the subject? If it's my idea, it's my responsibility? Ughh…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I... never expected to be promoted so soon! I'll carry on my research into the curative properties of gemstones!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I left home so I could realize my dreams, I gained recognition here, and found a place where I could learn even more from my peers in the Medical Department. I've truly found a good job.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Whenever I think of my squadmates getting hurt in battle, I start to feel uneasy.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I don't like war, but that's my personal feelings. As a squad leader, I vow to uphold my responsibility.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Be careful, everyone! Nothing's more important than your own safety!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Is this really the only way to settle our problems?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Waiting for your command.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I trust the Doctor will lead us to victory.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll heal your wounds and dull your pain.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Don't worry, I've got your back.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: If you feel unwell, report it right away!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't push yourself too hard in battle!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Feel any better?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Relax, tense muscles will only make your treatment more difficult.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The more prep work we do, the better the outcome we'll see. This is all thanks to everyone's hard work.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Now's a great time to watch the sunset. Let's head over there and sit down for a spell.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We fight now for a peaceful future…? If only our enemies wanted the same.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Run, I'll cover you!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The decor here is really different from back home.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm? Who is it? Oh, it's you, Doctor.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm putting together a new specimen box, Doctor. Want to see it?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Woah, it's nice to see everyone coming together to celebrate! But, I suddenly realized, it's a darned shame this occasion only comes once a year!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, wanna head up to the deck for some fresh air?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: This crystal here can soothe your mind. Try putting it on when you're feeling bad. Oh, and when you're feeling good too, sure! I took it when I left home, and it's yours now. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I've been here at Rhodes Island a while now, done a lotta work with you and the folks in Medical, helped a bunch of people. Sitting here mulling it over now, I've gained a ton of precious experience I never picked up on before. I'll remember this, keep it all with me, right in here.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm? Am I able to be of help to you? I can't contribute anything towards your meticulous plans or lofty ideals, but if you wish me to attend you... that happens to be my specialty.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Sitting for extended periods of time will cause muscular atrophy, and that's not going to help, Doctor. Come, I'll walk with you around the deck. I've also been wanting to hear about some of Rhodes Island's legends. No, sifting through the archives isn't as interesting as hearing it from you.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My grandfather was involved in the construction of that great lighthouse. But now, haha, all I do is stay behind in the church, tending to the sick and elderly... No, I'm not complaining about my job as a caregiver; seeing their smiles brings me great joy! It's just that...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Skadi, Gladiia, and Specter... I never thought a day would come when I would stand on the same side as those Ægir greats; I mean, I barely know anything about the Ægir... Huh? You're putting me on the same team as them? Please, have mercy on me...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: That Inquisitor fought to the last breath for our sake. When I saw the light of his lantern pierce the darkness, I suddenly realized: they are all fighting for our future. And though I might not be as strong as them, I don't wish to remain a bystander. I want to stand with them.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Achieving great things is not easy for me, but even facing life itself is not a trivial task. Doctor, don't worry, I won't give up. I will try my best to catch up with everybody on Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: For us Iberians, our relationship with the 'sea' is a complicated one. The sea symbolizes terror and danger, while also holding nostalgia for a bygone era. But even as the great vessels of Iberia sink before our eyes, we... we require a bit of change.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Caregivers have to respond to all sorts of different situations. Some people are difficult to deal with, but the gratitude we receive makes it worth it. Doctor, all that you do, day in and day out, must be for a very similar pursuit, right? You know the joy of being able to make a difference.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Working in the Inquisition is difficult, and not everyone is as fair as Lady Irene... But, had I not experienced it, I never would've gotten to work with amazing people like you, right?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, Doctor? You're going to catch a cold if you fall asleep like this... Let me fetch you a blanket. Is it alright if I dim the lights for you a bit?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: So you're... the Doctor? Pleased to meet you. My codename is 'Lumen,' and I will now be serving as a Rhodes Island Operator. Even if I can only bring you a thin filament of light, I will give all my strength.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Do we... really have to face such terrifying things?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: No, I can't accept this. I've just been doing my job, nothing worthy of a promotion. Please, you don't need to look so dejected. Fine, I'll take it!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm just an ordinary person, and it takes a huge amount of effort to even keep up with the others. However, if you really need what little I can offer... then I will be there for you at any time.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Don't worry, Doctor. I'll catch up to the others.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Me, squad leader? Umm... Can you give me a few minutes to sort things out in my head?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Looks like it's too late for second thoughts. Time to move out.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'll do my best to keep everyone safe!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: At your disposal.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: As long as I can help.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I can handle this!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: It's fine, as long as I can muster up the courage!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't worry, I'm here with you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You can do this. Here, the first step is a deep breath.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Hang in there, the treatment will be done in no time!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Please stay calm. It's a bit tricky, but as long as you give me some time...

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, that you've shown me such a great project, let me become a part of it, and even had me stand by your side, means the world to me.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We did it, Doctor! Even though this was a small victory, the day will come when these small rays of light will grow numerous enough to dispel the darkness.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Enough frowning, Doctor, it's bad for your health. If everything always went according to plan, what would motivate us to work harder and better ourselves?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, please evacuate! If I can hold the line and buy you a future, then I...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a beautiful ship, but sadly... I cannot feel the breath of the sea breeze.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Do you need a hand?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: The thing I enjoy most is looking out the window at the surrounding scenery, relaxing away my afternoon. Want to join me, Doctor?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Back when I was a caregiver, at the turn of every year, everyone would exchange presents and offer New Year's blessings. Even though I'm working in a different environment now, I hope to keep this little custom alive. Doctor, I wish you... a peaceful and prosperous new year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, need me to give you a shoulder massage? I'm pretty well-known for my PT skills.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Kal'tsit mentioned that today is your birthday, Doctor. I don't have the means to gift you anything precious... but please take this. It's an audio recording of the waves in my hometown. If you ever find yourself in a bad spot, please give it a listen. Of course, you're more than welcome to come to me directly.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Now that I'm saying it out loud, it's a bit embarrassing... Doctor, if I could become like you one day... Err, never mind. Just being allowed to join Rhodes Island, and stand by your side, is already like a dream come true.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You want me to be your accompanist? Sure thing.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Whether in harpistry or archery, my skill is second to none in all of Minos. Look, this is the medal I won in Hymnic archery. Beautiful, isn't it? Proof of my skills as a harpist? Several troupes have asked me to accompany them, and that tells a story, don't you agree?... What!? You! You... Ahem... You may as well be seated, then. I will have my harp do the talking.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Minos is a land of Romance. Day in and day out, you can see philosophers debating, warriors competing, and actors rehearsing grand epics. I will say though, our food and drinks are exquisite. They're enough to elicit an abundance of joy and make one act unreasonably if indulged too liberally... How do I know? As if I'd tell you!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Tragedies are the most dazzling gems among our grand epics... or so I'd like to say, but Pallas's story deserves the most compassion. There is no greater humiliation than for a hero to remain unsung. 'There must be no flaws in a hero's mythos?' She said that? I simply cannot agree.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: From Minos to Bolívar, from Columbia to Leithanien, each place has its own scenery and its own romance. The same uniqueness, however, cultivated endless enmity and conflict across the world. But just as roses do not lose their beauty simply because they have thorns, this great land is equally worthy of love.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Even the mightiest hero cannot win a war alone. Just as an epic must be passed down to be meaningful, a hero must stand with others to even become a hero. In the past, I always felt as if something was missing from my journey. That 'something' has been found since I came here.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The Supreme One spread an incurable disease across the land, and the Healer was banished for opposing Him. The Healer, stripped of the power of divinity, descended to alleviate humankind's suffering through knowledge... Oh, this isn't Minos mythology or anything, it's just a story I made up.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Is this instrument a bow or a harp? Both. The techniques behind the two are similar, both requiring discipline and elegance. Like this, gently place your fingertips on the strings, and thoughtfully acquaint yourself with the vibration from your fingertips. Want to give it a try? No, no, not like that. Give me your hand, I'll teach you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: What am I reading? A volume of Victorian love poems. Shall I read some aloud for you? Come on, there's no need to be bashful. Love and courage are one and the same. They're the blazing flames that burn through our souls, a light true that one should not shy from. Come on, Doctor, let's read some poetry together.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, Doctor? Oh... A pity that I came with a little song for you, aww…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: So this is Rhodes Island? At last, at the very end of this trudge... No, All of this was ordained by fate, so I should be saying, it's about time! You can call me Erato. Is Pallas here, may I ask?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: A shock that I still have so much more to learn about team combat...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Rankings? Promotions? No, no, these trivial things have no place in the full picture when heroes cast their eyes over the rising horizon. But, I will accept this accolade as proof of our mutual trust.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Should I celebrate this occasion by playing a song, or no? In fact, let me take a moment to think about what to say... Ahem... In the name of the Twelve Heroes of Minos, I, Erato, dedicate my bowstring to thee, and my harp shall accompany thee into the ages.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Witness the crown jewel of Minoan archery.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Leave everything to me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: My arrow points toward victory.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I shall witness your end.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: As you wish.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I will not disappoint.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: What wonderful scenery. A fine place for a battle.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Fate guides me here.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: One shot, one kill.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: By harp mine put to peace thy weary mind, for death and slumber both are of one kind.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Listen well to the requiem I play for thee.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Be gone with the wind!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Life must eventually end, but legends live on forever. We've done it, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A victory worth celebrating. Let us sing! Doctor, did you witness my performance?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Chasing stragglers is scarcely fit for heroes of legend. Let them be.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Hurry, run! Our story mustn't end here!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Can I play some music here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You seem to be in a good mood today, Doctor. How about a dance with me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Another year, huh...? Though I am still unfamiliar with Rhodes Island's customs, the importance of ceremony cannot be understated. If there is no ceremoniousness to counterbalance the atmosphere of levity, the occasion is forgotten easily. Anyway, Happy New Year, Doctor. As a present, I'll play a song for you. What would you like to hear?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, wanna hear a song?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: In mythology, every hero's birth is accompanied by a strange phenomenon. For example, the once-in-a-century blooming of a flower, or a falling star... Just what happened on this day, years ago? It must've been a spectacular sight. Happy birthday, Doctor. Go ahead and make a wish.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a place right out of mythology, a hall of champions where people from all over the world come together to fight for a common cause. I wish to continue to witness the story of Rhodes Island as it unfolds. Surely, we shall compose the most grand of epics together.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You need an assistant too...? Ah, I just heard a little about you from Kal'tsit. Don't mind that. Is there any work I can help with?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: What a surprise, Doctor. Where did you pick up my novel? It only got praise from a few fellow writers thanks to some friendly connections; it's not worth spending your time with.  Unfortunately, it's the only sort of thing I can write, given the state of Victoria. I'm sorry about that.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I have a fair insight into coordinating formalwear and jewelry, you know. Right now, though? Treat this sort of dress-up as an actor's costume. The gentry and aristocracy are all at their drinking parties trembling for dear life, putting on a play of peace, watching for an explosion without knowing when it'll come.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It's a pity you chose a bad place and time to arrive, or else I would've invited all you Rhodes Islanders to visit the theater as the Victorians do. The epic of the Aslan King owes its celebration to bards, after all, not letters on paper. Besides, my theater friends always leave me a seat.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Kal'tsit's always called herself a doctor, but before I actually came to Rhodes Island, I couldn't understand why she'd fixated on Oripathy treatment. After all, there were so many tricky issues she could solve.I mean... Really... She could have solved anything. Anything except Oripathy... But I see now. You're bringing hope.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Teaching a group of barehanded commoners to stand off against Sarkaz warriors—hard to believe, even for them. Some advised me not to even waste time trying... But when I met Kal'tsit, I was still very tender myself. The small and weak have their own strength, by all rights.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Without even looking, I know how Golding would evaluate that book. After all, we once wrote for the same newspaper and inked practically the same sentences between two articles—no, it wasn't a rapport, just that there's few words Victoria will allow you to pronounce loudly these days.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Has Amiya been sleeping well...? She really is just like Clovisia. Though their hearts have grown to the point they can bear everyone's hopes, their bodies are still so easily overwhelmed. I'll be off in a while, to see how I can help them.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ever since I was very young, I sat by my father's desk, watching him read and write. Even when writing letters to Kal'tsit, he never pushed me away. Just like he said, sooner or later I'd understand this all, and I'd have to at that.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh, you fell asleep... I wonder what you dream of, Doctor? The past, perhaps?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I've been wanting to meet all you Rhodes Islanders since a good long time ago. Very glad to make your acquaintance again, Doctor. Just call me Heidi.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oh my... This is all a lot harder to learn than what Kal'tsit taught me...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Do you need me taking on greater responsibilities? Of course I'd be glad to; I appreciate your faith in me. But as her Messenger, it's crucial I don't draw too much attention.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: What sort of clothes should I wear to match with this 'jewelry' Rhodes Island confers on me, Doctor?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: And by this, I will protect my home.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll see your orders relayed to every last one.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I have the intel for what lies ahead all sorted. Go forth with aplomb.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let's go by the plan.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Let me witness this with my own eyes.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Is there anything you need me delivering?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Dust, and the scent of rust...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Give me your orders.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: 'The young prince saw the other reach for the crown, and he raised his sword.'

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: 'We sing our elegy at full strain, in rivers of blood formed by fear.'

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: 'The girl, expelled from the city, still returns to rescue it.'

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'He lifted his slaughterer's blade, not believing that he could earn the love of a different line.'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I venture no one could have envisaged a victory so marvelous. Doctor, it seems the intel on you needs another update.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: There will surely be an end to suffering.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: There's nowhere nearby for them to hide. I know where they're likely headed.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: This is the risk we must face for the sake of ultimate victory. There are times we must bear the cost of defeat too, am I wrong?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I really wish Londinium's workers could have an environment as fine as this.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh? I'm here if you need me.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: That's odd, I wonder where my bookmark fell.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I've brought you my father's well-wishes too. Don't open those now. Leave the stuffy letters until the fireworks are over, hm?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Have you rested well, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Do you look forward to birthdays? Even with how long ago I crossed into adulthood, birthdays for me still are a commemoration of growth and progress.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: *cough*... I'm only dropping back in here to find Kal'tsit, I certainly wasn't ready to perform in any sort of program. Poetry recitals wouldn't be too in the spirit of this party now, would they? How about I go and help fix up the cake? ...Take care not to let other operators steal a bite? Jolly good.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'll be your assistant today, Doctor... I will disclaim. I have absolutely no secretarial experience. Thus, so I'm not hindering you, I will be doing nothing at all.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You'd like to see Leithanien, you say? Heh, it's a fine place. The Empresses regard their subjects like their own children, the healthy regard the Infected as brethren, the faces of the people brim with blessing—lies? That's true, they are lies. Contemplate visiting Leithanien again once you can sit through the whole game with a straight face.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Routine health inspections? Allow me a moment to ready my—hold on, isn't Hibiscus the one on duty today? I'd rather avoid her if I can. I'm sure I needn't explain why... I'm not frightened of her! I'm just not quite prepared for—could you amend my timeslot? Thank you!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Please relay to the Medical Department that my headaches and physical condition are no matter, and no cause for such alarm. There's nothing to examine—what? They're already expecting me? They've even made the consultation room available? I... You tell them that my headache has flared up and I'm not going anywhere—ugh.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Social etiquette of Leithanian nobles? Hah, it's an endless subject. Shaking off commoners, spreading rumors of other nobles behind their backs—not to go on, but it all demands a cheek I find slightly hard to conjure myself. You'd best consult an expert, not me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: There'll always be a cohort eager to associate me with the previous Graf Urtica. I can't blame them though, I simply wish to live as a regular Infected. Abhorring inequality ... You say I'm faking to be common? Whatever you say. Even if I am faking, I prefer to keep it that way till the very end.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You noticed as much, Doctor? Indeed, I like to repeat what others have said in times of stress... it's the safest method I—no—Graf Urtica has of buying time to think. So long as he doesn't speak his own mind, he won't bear blame for what he says.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: It's Hibiscus on duty again—should I reschedule my examination? Nein, never mind. I'm deeply grateful for your help in avoiding her days, but I can't hide forever. Even after so long, I still close my eyes and see the wretched misery of that concert... perhaps it's time I face it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Evening on the deck reminds me of the spiretop in Urtica—it had just as fine a breeze. I used to fantasize there how happy life must be, down on the ground. I only understood later that up there, freedom was the one thing stripped from me, while so many in the land had, save for freedom, nothing at all.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: No issue dozing off in this sort of place? Hmph, I suppose it's times like these when the assistant does the work. Pain in the neck—agh, I'm misspelling. Never mind, never mind. Let's find out what music's on the Doctor's headphones...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I extend my sincere gratitude to you, Doctor of Rhodes Island. Thank you for sheltering an insignificant down-and-outer. If such mediocrity as even mine can benefit Rhodes Island's cause, then I couldn't be more relieved.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: A very fascinating recording. Hm? I don't say that with irony. Nobody ever thought to buy video tapes for Graf Urtica save for himself, and he couldn't leave the spire.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? Allow me to decline. No, not for lack of necessity, but of knowledge of who is being recognized. Is it myself... or the Witch King's remnants lodging within me?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Graf Urtica fears his ego's engulfment by the Witch King, yet has to employ powers inherited from the tyrant. But now, he is dead. Now, I am first and foremost an operator of Rhodes Island, and only after that am I the Witch King's botched replica. That suffices for me—that suffices.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: This power is not mine. However, Rhodes Island has need of it, so I will employ it to its fullest.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I hate it when I'm ordered around without rhyme or reason, but ordering others sits just as badly with me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Prolonged casting makes my headaches flare up, and I even hallucinate if I'm unlucky. Let's make it a Blitzkrieg, shall we?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I am at your command.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Stronger dynamics?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Faster tempo?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Careful of music on the battlefield, especially when you face a Leithanian.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: The performance will begin soon, but it seems our audience can't contain themselves?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: As graceful as three-four.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: As startling as a tritone.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: As doleful as a clarinet.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Gah! Get out of my head!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: If you're lacking an appreciator to applaud and call for encore, then allow me to fill the role. Congratulations, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Is it over? Very well, I need somewhere to rest for a moment before my headache gets any worse.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: An unsatisfactory performance'... No, it's fine, it's just something I often heard not so long ago. You can ignore it.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We can hardly call this ending good. Are you the one who just got a headache, not me?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place might be far from a Leithanian spire, but I still prefer the feeling of standing on solid ground.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Agh, here it is aga—huh? It's you, Doctor? That wasn't the headache?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, if you want to learn an instrument, I'd say ask someone else. A lot of my understanding has little to do with myself.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I'm not omitting myself from the New Year celebrations for any special reason. I'm just not accustomed to that sort of harmonious atmosphere... You'd like to invite me to perform a song? Forget it, my music would be a horrible match for this mood.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How did you rest, Doctor? I used to love staying up myself, until one time I went a full night without closing my eyes, and had splitting headaches for a week after... It was a horrifying experience.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Would you like to listen to a dark, terrifying, head-splitting Birthday Variation?—I'm joking. Happy birthday, Doctor. Sheesh, there's no need to be *that* surprised. Can't I joke every once in a while?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Every day passed at a crawl in Urtica, but now a year's silently flown by since coming to Rhodes Island... It feels like time's sped up. I imagine that's just proof life is more blessed now.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I've never been an assistant before. It's a novel experience, but rest assured that I will not be remiss, even if this work is not my forte.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: If any children aboard Rhodes Island wish to learn piano, you may send them to me, but I am a strict teacher. I am not one to release a student partway once he begins his studies.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I hear a musical school known as 'jazz' is currently popular in Columbia. I've had the fortune to hear a few records. The free, unweighted playing style greatly amuses me, but sadly, I seem to lack the temperament for performing in such a swing.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Are you curious about my hands? Indeed, they're broader than others' at a glance. Please, they're no freakish things. I have them to thank that I can rain every melodie that swims in my head down onto the keys.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The Infected are only comparatively freer in Leithanien, and not that free. Outside of the Afterglow, there was hardly anywhere I could live, or eat... there was almost nowhere to turn.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My near-death experience unleashed a sudden, completely new melodie upon my mind. Compared to it, the musical forms I'd once learnt seemed like shackles. Just what tremendous feeling brought about its birth? Perhaps in the face of Death, I was nowhere near as fearless as I imagined.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Thank you for your concern. I'm not feeling ill—my writing is merely bottlenecked, and I haven't slept in several days. My hair, well... I often unconsciously grab at it while composing, if that explains its current unruliness.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, would you like to exercise with me? You seem surprised. Fräulein Hibiscus requested it. Most artists are the frail sort, but my recitals often exceed two hours in length. How could I handle it without a sturdy physique to support me?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You flatter me. So many voices have been snuffed out in the rapids of history. Their owners were hardly without talent; they simply left too soon, before anyone could stop and listen to their masterpieces fine as nature's song. And I was but slightly luckier, enough so to escape with my life.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Asleep? I hardly expected the lullabies I wrote to have an actual effect on you...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Greetings, Doctor, my name is Czerny. Any charm or taste I may have had has been poured entirely into my compositions. And as for myself, I am no more than a run-of-the-mill performer. That's all the introduction you need.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I will commit to watching these as you require, but this is hardly how I prefer to study. I have always approached others' second-hand experiences with skepticism.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm extremely grateful for your sponsorship, Doctor; I am currently struggling financially. The annals of Leithanian art will commemorate your giving.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I thank you for your approval. I had never seriously pursued Originium Arts before, and I hope henceforth that my Arts may be cast as freely as my melodien.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Through my creations, both pain and joy become immortal.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Compared to my piano, my ability with a baton actually fares quite well.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I've finished tuning. I may perform now.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Please be seated.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Shall I open?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Shall I close?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: To tremble in my music is your honor.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Extraordinary melodies can only be played by the soul that quakes.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Silence, immediately!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Listen or leave!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Shut up or else!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Get out! Right now!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Huff... I may be—exceptionally tired in both body and mind, but I do not want the music to end here.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Drawing the final barline here is perfect. I hardly want any movement of mine to approach tedium.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: There are times when stubborn pursuit of a technique hinders more than helps. Allowing your emotion to follow the music's natural flow can take you further.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Please, don't be disheartened. Not every composition is smooth from start to finish. There'll always be a few rounds of polish before you land where you want to.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The deck of this ship is very spacious. Have you ever considered holding a concert there?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Watch that the noten in my pocket don't spill out.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Perhaps you like to try learning an instrument? I could teach you; I'm qualified to tutor for the majority of them.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Forgive me for turning down your invitation to perform. Even the most assiduous musician wouldn't want to work on this day, and besides, the fineness of it needs no musical dressing. The laughs of passersby and the clinking of table glasses have answered well enough, no?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I've written a new song. Would you like to hear?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've reserved some tickets to a performance of a symphony, all fine VIP seats. If you're free on the day, you must attend. Ah, yes, I wish you a happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: To dance to music is a rare moment of liberty for the Infected. Doctor, would there be more dancing, more free souls, if I were to write more myself?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I was an assistant for other researchers before I got my own lab... That being said, shall I begin your day with a cup of coffee?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor... Doctor who? Oh, it's your codename? Sorry. At Rhine Lab, calling for a 'Doctor' usually gets a response from everyone in earshot. You must be very special to Rhodes Island, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The rumbling grapevine says Saria is at odds with Control. But I get the feeling they're both idealists, and those with a strong will tend to have an edge to them. I... am I any different? I hope you'll never see my edge.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You think scientists are weird? Yes, obsession may drive us to ignore certain other things, including social and ethical norms. Our jobs aside, though, we're all normal people at heart.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Research is like exploration; the further you go, the more dangerous it gets. But every step we take has a chance to change lives, which is why we keep going, even if death or public scorn await. We're kindred spirits, Doctor… And that is a fact.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I made lots of friends in the world of science. They often discuss their dreams with me; some are not so good at expressing themselves, but I can guess. You say I've guessed wrong sometimes? Hm... perhaps. Maybe I should reflect...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: It's getting cool outside. Remember to dress warm when you go into the field... *sneeze* I, er, forgot to do so myself. I often forget these things if Elena isn't there to remind me. *Sneeze* Oh, thanks for the coat. That's so kind of you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I never thought of myself as a genius. I'm just fortunate. My father and other people in the Pioneer team saved the money to send me to school, while the government sponsorship also allowed me to pursue scientific research. I'm here today thanks to the help of many people. That's why I want to do my best to help others too.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Sometimes, I wake up in the middle of the night in the labs and feel... scared. Scared that people will end up abandoning me, even after all I've done, and even... with hatred in their hearts. What should I do? All I want is to bring them happiness. Can you help me, Doctor?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: All work and no play makes it a sleepy day... We have so much in common, don't we... Let me turn up the temperature. Noise-canceling mode... Oh, seems your cabin isn't equipped with that…?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Dorothy, head of the Originium Art Section at Rhine Lab. Dr. Silence already introduced me? Then it saves both of us the formalities. Please, just call me Dorothy.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are these simulations or... hm, Rhodes Island feels different from how I imagined, but I understand.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: As a matter of fact, I was worried about not spending enough time on the Rhodes Island Landship... maybe I should apply to Kristen for another long-term cooperation project.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, how do you like my lab? I'm thinking about what equipment I should bring over. Mechanist says my command of resonance might come in handy in obstacle removal and weapon development.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: What sights will the Doctor show us this time?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't worry, I'll take care of the others.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The battlefield is an extension of the laboratory.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Strayed, aren't you?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Security systems online. Monitoring intruders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Initiating environmental scan.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Do you need the traps activated?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Terrain data collection complete.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The sand will reshape the land.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The slightest vibration can change the result.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Stay down, and you won't get hurt any worse.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: No, I won't let you take another step… I promised them.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Whether it's by your calculation or instinct… All I could say is, marvelous.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Your decisions were on the mark. Were you kissed by the goddess of truth? Can I touch your forehead? For good luck, you know, while I tackle my next experiment.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: 70% of my experiments don't turn out the way I want them to. The answer lies in the next attempt, Doctor.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I won't let anyone hurt you! I'll take care of things here. Go, and never turn back...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rhodes Island is always so lively.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, it was you tugging at me? Thank goodness, I thought I skipped too many meals and was hallucinating...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What is it that keeps you staring at me, Doctor? Did you find an interesting problem to tackle?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I just sent some gifts to my Pioneer friends. I wonder when they'll get them... Thinking of their hardships makes me worry and glad at the same time. Oh, I have a gift for you too. You're always moving forward, just like them.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, I was thinking about going out for a walk. Would you like to join me?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Humm, did those young operators just give you something? Wait... what day is it? Oh dear, I lost track of the days again! Dr. {@nickname}, could you make a stop by my lab? Thankfully I've got the entire year's presents all lined up!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I hope everyone will have the chance to find themselves, regardless of whether they're Infected or not, regardless of their talent for Arts. Many think this is just a pipe dream, but Doctor, I know... you and Rhodes Island will understand.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Umm… Leave it to me. I'm used to observing the traces left behind by other people's work, and experiencing the persistence, joy and excitement therein. I can see the commitment in your to-do list, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Are you looking for the source of the music? It's the musical enchantment on this cup. Most music in Leithanian cities are created with Arts. From statues to fountains to murals, virtually anything can become a device for playing music. Would you care for a drink? I recommend this song to pair with anything alcoholic.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Sorry. Criticism of music is best left to listeners and creators. I'm simply a tuner with perfect pitch, and I know my place. They say one only understands the importance of talent once one has worked hard. Well, I know I have no talent, so there's no need for me to work that hard.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I come from a small town where tourism is the main industry. I designed the music of every nook and cranny in the marketplace, so the melody will follow you with every step you take. Oh, there is even a famous blindfolded musical pathfinding competition with a decent prize pool. You should have a go, Doctor. Me? No, I'm one of the judges.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Can you take a look at this proposal? Basically, I'll set Arts to play different background music in different areas, which will improve everyone's experience at leisure and work. I've left this area empty, because I thought you should set your own playlist for sleepless nights.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: 'Turning the marketplace into a splendid bastion of culture'? That's just the copywriter spinning words around. All I am is a humble tuner. But you can find so many examples of remarkable creativity cast aside in a forgotten corner, unnoticed by others. I do my little part in gathering them up and playing them for children to appreciate.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: This group photo…? I… was troubled by my lack of talent at the time. I hung it in my room to remind myself to live without regret. Oh, I didn't explain why I'm not in the photo, did I? Well... I never graduated.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Shh! Can you hear my flowers? I added musical Arts to the flowers sent to Medical, and I'm one piece away from completing the suite. I don't want the patients to suffer any regret, because in their eyes, I'm a healer too. It's not always recovery that makes patients happy, if I am not wrong.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Medical says they want to help me find the reason I can't sing in tune. I know it's not an illness, but the result of being scorned by those who live atop the spires. I don't like the feeling of expectations placed on me. Fortunately, it is possible to tune out the noise, and tuners never have regrets.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sorry, I didn't mean it. Perhaps the duet was a little too hypnotizing?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Don't worry, I've entrusted my work in Leithanien to my colleagues there. I'm afraid you're mistaken, they're inveterate workaholics, just like me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's very complex, like a passionate fugue.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm being recognized? Simply for doing my job? Okay. I have quite a few colleagues in Leithanien. I think they will be very interested in joining Rhodes Island. Care to consider it, Doctor?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The journey helped me see clearly and understand it. The wonderful music of the cities comes not from god-given talent, but the concerted effort of tireless tuners. That's what I aspire to be—one whose work is ordinary, unremarkable, but indispensable.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll be in tune with you.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Do you need me… to give the cue?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The horn sounds. Now, beat the drums.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: It's time to cut the noise.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here. I'm listening.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Eh? What did you say?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Oh, it's my turn.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll give it a try.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ready, four-four time.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Too low. From the top.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Let the arpeggio cascade.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: This is my range.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: They gave up before we got to the cadence. Looks like the program doesn't need to be too long.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: This is an elegy for them to mourn themselves.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: It's not such a bad thing to rush through a passage that's out-of-tune.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ugh! I need to wash my ears out.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Quiet, like a sheet of paper without notes or staff lines. I'll set it up.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I can hear you, you know.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: My horns are not a percussion instrument, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The celebration can wait. I'm maintaining the musical order of the festival; those who work behind the scenes only get to enjoy the celebrations after the curtain falls. It's not that I don't like a lively scene; my blessings are with everyone, in each and every note. The tuner does not leave until the music has ended.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Here's a special suite of music for you to play on deck. A little applause would make it even more pleasing.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. My gift is imbued with musical Arts, playing back a song cover I performed myself. I'm sure the original is much better and… actually in tune. But I guarantee this song is more memorable than any other.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It used to be hard for me to ignore regret. I tried, only to realize it wasn't really necessary. A rousing melody can stay in the climax, and a settled note is no longer noise, just as everyone on Rhodes Island has found their home.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: No problem. Leave it to me. While most of my work may be outdoors, I still need to handle thick stacks of paperwork. Once it's done, I'm hoping for a little reward... perhaaaaps, a short vacation?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, did you receive the report I submitted? Oh, this hair is a strand from the tip of my ear. I deliberately slipped it into the report to test whether you'd read it thoroughly. I'm glad you noticed.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Watch out! You didn't cut your hand, did you? I forgot to warn you that the wire is extremely sharp. You must be very careful when touching it. Though dangerous, it's incredibly versatile in the wild—perfect for climbing, tying things down, towing, and... dealing with some uninvited guests... oh... never mind.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I brought back a bag of nuts I collected on my recon mission, all pre-shelled. Don't worry, I've sampled every variety, and they're guaranteed to be crisp and delicious. Oh, except for one particular nut, which might leave your mouth temporarily numb. How might you pick out that one? Pure chance.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I was once a Youth Scout, with a camp nestled in a beautiful park. I believed that was the essence of camping, until... I ventured into the real wilderness. I learned a harsh lesson: when every choice is life or death, you don't get the luxury of maintaining appearances. Life might afford poetry, but survival demands ruthless pragmatism.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The records are wrong.I was born in the wilderness, and my adoptive parents brought me to a nomadic city to raise me there. As for my biological parents, their faces have long faded from memory. Still, occasionally... two indistinct faces appear in my dreams. Do they belong to them? I can't tell.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I just saw Jessica in the hallway. She looks much more confident now. No, she didn't recognize me. My work doesn't involve direct interaction with coworkers, which means few at Blacksteel are even aware of my existence. That's why I was surprised when you took the initiative to talk to me, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, I received the ID badge you sent me... but, I apologize, I can't keep it on me. My work demands absolute secrecy, and any form of identification is out of the question. Speaking of which, you'd be shocked at the secrets I've managed to uncover just by blending in as an unremarkable traveler!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, would you sit with me for a moment? I've always understood that my duty is to scout ahead and blaze a trail. Still, despite my meticulous planning, there are times when most of my people don't come back. It seems, no matter how hard I try, it's never quite enough.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Don't you feel cooped up staying indoors, Doctor, especially when you finally got some free time? How 'bout we go for a walk…? The sunlight out there is just perfect.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Surfer from Blacksteel Worldwide's advance recon team. My primary duties involve intelligence gathering and pre-mission reconnaissance. If you possess any pertinent information, please, don't keep it to yourself.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Mind if I take some of these with me? They'd make an excellent remedy for cabin fever on those rainy days when I'm confined to my tent.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Twice the vacation days, double the salary... Achoo—oh, hi there, Doctor! No, no, I wasn't saying anything just now.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Guess what, Doctor? Yesterday, on my way back here, I saw a brilliant red sunset. A good omen that today would be a lucky day. Sooo, have you come bearing good news?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Adding me to this wilderness mission was a wise choice. Trust me, Doctor, I'll ensure your safe return to the landship.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: The wilderness is far more complex than most imagine. If you want to accompany me, you'll have to abandon those romantic notions about camping first.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Alright. We pitched the tent. Now we have a base camp from which to go anywhere we please.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'll go solo. A large group might provoke hostility from the locals.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'll go gather some dry branches. We must have a campfire lit before nightfall.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Water's not far. Stay put, and I'll fill the canteens.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: *Sigh* I never expected to encounter so many people on this trip.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hello, I'm here for a brief survey. Don't worry, I won't overstay my welcome.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: They came just in time; our provisions are running low.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: *Sigh* They ruined the night. What a waste of this gorgeous scenery.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Forgive me, I woke up on the wrong side of the sleeping bag.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Excuse me, can we hurry this up? I really don't want my meal getting cold.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Have you burnt this scenery into your mind, Doctor? We'll head out like a shooting star, but this memory, right here, right now, will endure for you to reflect upon over and over again.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Everyone gained from this trip. And my gain is everyone's satisfaction.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The terrain ahead is not in our favor. Continuing this advance is not advisable, Doctor. We should stand down.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, though the journey may not have been entirely satisfying, we must ensure no trash is left behind.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Really? Are you going to confine me to this windowless room for so long? I must have done something to upset you, then?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm...? Oh. Want some canned soup?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Go get some rest. I'll take the night watch.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Looks like this year will be no different from last year. I'll visit some old places and some new, meet some old friends and make some new, and handle some old tasks while taking on new ones. The good news is, at least this time, I won't be alone on the journey.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: When was the last time we saw each other... a month ago? It's a joy to see you in good health, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: No, no, no, Doctor, this map isn't THE birthday gift. What you need to do is mark a location on the map, any one will do, and I'll take you camping there. I'm sure the breathtaking canyon views will help you relax.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Sometimes, the farther the destination, the fewer provisions I load. In the wilderness, packing too much means a heavy burden; a light pack is the key to success. I've carried a lot for a long time: as the weight on your shoulders grows heavier, and the road ahead remains infinitely long, how will you ultimately reach the end, Doctor?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You want me to do file collation work...? These documents of yours all look dusty. I don't want to touch them. And how was your office even planned in the first place? Did you genuinely not feel personally, utterly disgusted leaving this cabinet here?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I propose swapping for more corrosion-proof materials next time you do maintenance on the ship's core structure. Why? Because when all's said and done, it's not you or me that'll be left behind. It's this landship's skeleton. That's what's going to endure. That's what will stand for us.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You've got some planning work for me? I'll ask to review my partners' design styles first. As long as they aren't too complex about it, I might be able to accept—okay, okay, fine, I'll do it, I'll take it, it's not as if collaborations are some big deal. Besides, it's not that you have disastrous taste.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: What is it... Ah, darn it, the pencil smudged my belt again. I just got it replaced... Last time it was Gavial, saying she'd get me a new one of the same look. As if! The emblem on the clasp was straight from my designs, and obviously she didn't even give those an honest look!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I know, I'll go to the infirmary in a bit. I don't want to interrupt my thought process at the moment. And you know, Doctor, the moment is the exact thing I most value—you called Gavial in? Was she on duty at the Medical Department today? You can't fool—hello, Gavial, no no, I wasn't just working on any designs.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I used to appreicate a fan base of one, one who can truly see to the core of my designs, rather than having a crowd of followers with their superfacial admiration. For me, the latter holds absolutely no significance. But now… I suppose it's not all bad to let the masses see them. Discussion swirling around my work means I'm still alive.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Why do I tend not to greet anyone? Because once I do, I have to make small talk, and that forces me to crane my head up to speak with them, which makes me seem insignificant. We should be seeing eye-to-eye, on EQUAL footing... Are you asking if it weighs on me? As if! It just makes my neck ache.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I was genuinely full of anxiety back then. I always felt I didn't have enough time, though I'd never even accomplished a thing. But nowadays, I've gotten to the point where I can appreciate my own designs. The only thing is, it's been years since I last saw my teacher. I wonder if he'd be proud of me?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
