lines.text: A close look is all it takes to unearth the core sense of a man from his work. Just like how I used to disdain anything superfluous. I treated my own life in the same way. Doctor, an artwork is a microcosm of its creator's life. Yours, I can understand.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm. Such a counter-conventional sleeping posture, such a complex yet stable load-bearing structure... miraculous. Is this not going to give you neck arthritis?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Operator Minimalist, freshly dragged here by Gavial. So this is what a nomadic landship's like? You must have a much easier time avoiding Catastrophes than we do underground. Hmph, the only thing in those fools' heads is merrily drinking their lives away—ow, Gavial, what did you hit me for?!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: ...If it's not architecture-related, I don't want to see it.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A medal? Decently tasteful. You just give this to me, and that's it, right? I've absolutely no need for any sort of commendation ceremonies, and I imagine you don't like to waste time anyway. But I will—ahem—thank you for acknowledging me.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Everyone's experiences are different, and the significance lying behind my works will be out of sight to most... but there are some, like you, like my mentor, that I hope can understand.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: If Gavial's going, I'm not.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You want me for captain? What are you even... You're joking, aren't you? Hey!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Hm... alright, let me be clear, I don't have any prior combat experience. However, I am going to take this mission seriously.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Instrument debugging complete. I can begin any time.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I am aware. Don't push me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: If you break anything, you're paying!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Instrument is operating fine. Now scanning terrain.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: So this... is war.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Keep away!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: We're not here to be courteous.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I just don't get you people...

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: What a waste of time.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Huh. You're mightier than you let on, aren't you?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: *cough* *cough* *cough*... There's so much dust—it's filthy. Gah.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: What are you looking at me for? You want me to chase them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Snap out of it! Get running!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I don't want to open my eyes . I'm worried the interior design is going to scare the life out of me.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hold on, I'm busy.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Phew... what time is it? No, what day of the week? Er... did I eat anything yet? I don't think I did...?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Ah, this is the calendar you keep on the surface. I've heard of it. The significance in a holiday like this to commemorate a year's end—it's such an improvement over those days of pure idle indulgence... So another year's already passed. Be sure to cherish your time well, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, sitting for too long can leave you prone to neck arthritis. I suggest you watch out for yourself.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've been straining my wrist muscles over the past few days. The Medic Operators told me it'd improve a little using these wrist braces, so I bought a few spares. I was at a loss for what to give you today, so take these two as a present. Just fix them to the table and they'll work.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: My life is doomed to be as short as it is. How could I ever reconcile with that? I find it genuinely difficult to keep calm... not that you—need to console me. If I was truly that weak, then I wouldn't be standing here right now.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. I'll be acting as your assistant from here on. Please keep an appropriate distance from me; I'll be more at ease that way.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I recall my first time ordering a fountain pen from Zeruertza's artisans, where I didn't make my requirements clear. Then I ended up with this crossbow. It plagues me to have had the peace-loving Durin forge a weapon… Operator Myrtle? Calling herself Generalissimo? That's just a childish fan—Ahem, it's her own self-styling.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If you'll permit my frankness, it's my belief Rhodes Island should build work and living environments more suited to the Durin operators. At least the cafeteria menu should be decided by vote—they're all satisfied? They can't be! I'll go and ask them, lest you—lest someone be tricking them.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You require me to draft some slogans? I'd be happy to. It was routine work of mine in Zeruertza. You only need to provide me a typewriter, and that's all... Why do I not use a pen? My fountain pen is typically for more private things, more... not-so-Durin things.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I was a steadfast teetotaler back in Ursus, but to my surprise, I could keep more drink down than most in Zeruertza. Truth be told, I didn't immediately understand why they loved their drink so, but I did eventually come to realize. We only drink in excess when hope is lost, and a forever stagnant, easy life can lose us hope as well as anything.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I still hold that life in the Durin cities far surpasses that of the surface, but I have to admit, the flowerets that vie to bloom in the ruins have more of a power than all the blossoms of Durin greenhouses... Hah. All these years, and yet I'm a surface-dweller through and through.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Ursus desserts and wine? Let someone else have the pastries, please. 'Ursus-style' is an exceptional stranger to me by now. That said, do leave the liquor here. Zeruertzans love their drink, and I'm no exception—wait, this isn't mead. Is this pure spirits? Oh, my head...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Noble? Correct, I was once a noble. Until a conspiracy wrested my family away, and left me with the sole luck of escaping underground to Zeruertza. There was no avaricious nobility in the city, nor any commoners who'd take advantage for their own gain. Only kindhearted Durins... What more could I ask for?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, I'd like to talk with you of beauty and virtue, of those things I consider vanished from the surface. I've witnessed their existence aboard Rhodes Island, and you've told me that more of their sparks are alight upon this land still... I don't dare trust. I have to go and see it for myself.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, are you asleep? No? Well, no matter. If you're planning to hold the same posture for a while, perhaps I might draw a fountain pen sketch of you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I believe you're the Doctor? It's nice to meet you. Please accept my gratitude; thank you for allowing me to lodge here, a refuge on the unseemly surface.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I could never imagine. Do you show these violent, bloody tapes to the Durins as well?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for the gesture of confidence. I'll endure the urge to flee the award ceremony as best I can, so please, if you could wrap it up soon... There's no ceremony, it's just a normal presentation? Oh, that's a relief.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Another promotion, is it? Thank you. I'll accept this honor with my chest out in pride... And of course, we don't need to end this presentation as quickly as last time. Do not be afraid of those I should not fear—this is what life aboard Rhodes Island has taught me.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The day shall come for every land dweller, the day they find a cold weapon in their arms. And I learned it the hard way.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: For those of you who've spent not a second out of the fight, decades-old tactical thinking from Ursus must be far past its prime.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: May we all return safely.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy... A noun I hardly want to reunite with outside of writing. It's been so long.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Your orders, please.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: With pleasure.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Good visibility. I'm ready to fire.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll cover my allies.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Bolt pierces deeper than nib on the battlefield.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: For a life of peace...!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Abandon resistance now, or I pull the trigger!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hff... haa... Fire!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Surface civilization is no different to the ferocious vile beasts, but perhaps you can become one who loops its reins.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The battle is over. It's time to return and write, and do something more meaningful than this.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Apologies, Doctor. I'm still unaccustomed to the sensation of combat.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, evacuate everyone as fast as you can, I—I'll bring up the rear! Don't mind me, go!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Zeruertza has molded me. I'm still a little unused to moving about these narrow spaces.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hands off! ...Apologies, that wasn't intentional.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, if you insist on chatting with me, what say we talk about your favorite books?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Please, enjoy this little play written by me and jointly presented by the Durin operators of Rhodes Island—er, where's Durin? She's asleep? Oh... well, don't wake her up. I'll take up her role.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: *yawn*... Good morning, Doctor. The book you recommended was very interesting. I finished reading it overnight.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: This is for you, Doctor. I asked a Logistics Operator to formulate a special shade of ink—apparently, this one gradually changes hue once it's on paper. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Recently, I've begun to feel that if you had me recommend a lodgings for any surfacing Durin, I would suggest Rhodes Island without a doubt. It may not compare to the underground cities, but at least it's a place one can live with peace of mind.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Help you with work? Sure. Does that mean I can set Rhodes Island's course? There's a tribe nearby just about to hold an unusual ceremony, and I was thinking of going to see—I can't? Why not…? It'll barely be a detour…

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This thing on my bangs? Yes, it's a relic. Its original use was most likely as a buckle. It was just sitting there in my family's storehouse with nobody to see it, so I took a page out of the Columbians' book and stuck it in my hair like sunglasses. See, even antiques can be fashionable.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Historical relics aren't the only thing the museum puts on display. As long as an exhibit broadens the visitors' horizons, it's a good exhibit, right? You nodded! Good, because I've got this proposal for you—drumroll please: The Life of a Sarkaz Boiler Worker! If you see no problem with it, then sign here!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Psychology, architecture, artifact appraisal and restoration, exhibit design and crowd dynamics… Museum studies require me to understand these things, and I do. But I'm not a master of any of them? Well, sure, but a decent understanding is enough for my work, and I'm also always learning new things…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My family's fortunes had waned by the time my father's generation came around, so we're nowhere near as illustrious as Pepe or Anat's families. Now I see that as a blessing. I could have gone to study in Columbia, as I wanted, just as I've come to Rhodes Island. If you need me to do anything, just say it straight, no need to beat around the bush like you do with those two.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: 'In Sargon, Padishahs are as numerous as the stars in the sky; anyone who feels like it can reach out and grab one.' That's my favorite quote from the Thieving Padishah Merit—No, no, I'm not saying I want to be one, I just think her 'I want it so I'll go do it' attitude is super-cool, you know?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor! DOCTOR! Quick, there's no time to explain! Help me write a description for this artifact from the South Sargon Marshland Tribal Customs exhibit! Huh? You can't describe something you know nothing about? Whoa… So there are things you don't know… Alright, new plan, I do the writing now, and you check if what I've written makes sense.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I know Mio's no ordinary Feline Beast Steward… and you're no ordinary human either, Doctor. That's all right. You can keep hiding your identities, I'll still be friends with you both. Of course, if you ever feel like sharing your 'secrets', I'd be happy to lend you an ear.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Close your eyes, get in the car, and come with me! It's hot? Enough complaining. Okay, you can open your eyes now. Look at this desert expanse. This is where the Shah set out on his expedition. Who knows? The wind might uncover some of the footprints he left behind. Don't speak, Doctor, or you'll disturb the flow of time…

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Nothing to do… Hmm… Why not try to sleep standing up like I hear Pallas can…? Zzz… Zzz… Ow! My head! That hurts!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor, my name is rather tricky, so you may call me Titi, like all my friends do—but what you call me isn't important. I'm here to prepare my museum's new special exhibit. Are you and Rhodes Island interested in participating?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm, these are something like the artifact restoration tutorials I watched in Columbia. It looks easy when someone else does it, but the moment you try it yourself, you realize you have no idea where to even start.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This is a Rhodes Island promotion? Using ancient investiture ceremonies in modern business management… Fascinating. I could try something like this in my museum.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I feel like I could go even higher from here—Wait, what do you mean this is the peak?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: There's some new artifacts that need to go into storage, shall we go see?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Okay, everyone have a look at the plan—It's different from yesterday's? Well, I just now got a new idea. So? Any issues?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go, time to see what new stories this round of relics has to tell us.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: We're in the storeroom, so everyone tread a little lightly, okay?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Cleaning, conservation, repairing, restoration, I can do it all.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Just relax and leave it to me.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Remember, patience makes perfect.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Easy does it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Brush off the dirt, revealing the rich tones of the pottery glaze.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Remove the mold, restoring the flexibility of the fabric.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Clear away the crust, returning the marble sculpture to its full glory.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Phew! No new ceramic artifacts coming in? Not much for me to do, then.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: This is from a much older period than we thought. You sometimes find a major discovery like this when tidying up the storeroom. Let's celebrate with a big cup of tangerine sahlab!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: And that's storage sorted. If we made a themed exhibit out of these items, the tourists would be happy to queue for at least two hours.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: It's fine. I'll help you mend it with epoxy and touch up the seam. You won't even notice.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I was exhausted the moment I got out the door. Today's really not a good day for work. I'll do it tomorrow.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: You have much more… intriguing furniture than I thought. Is there some sort of theming to it all?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey, I saw that. Your itchy finger was trying to pull my straps.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You want me to go shopping with you? Alright, I'll have a mango and carob slushie, with crushed nuts on top. Oh, and a hibiscus juice too. And it's on you, right?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year. Want to try some fermented carrot cakes? All the rage in southern Rim Billiton. A Cautus patient in the infirmary gave me some, said it's how they celebrate the new year. Don't want one? It smells weird? Eh, a little I guess, but that's no reason not to try it.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, Doctor. Did you also come to this corner of the bridge for a view of the city? Come, stand right here, this angle's spectacular!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Here, I found this while tidying up the family storeroom. It used to be an ornament for a chariot, but you can take it to keep your hood buckled, no matter how hard the wind blows. The moment I saw it, I knew it was meant for you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The wear and tear on an artifact are proof that its former owner once lived. We're the same… So long as our brains are running and limbs moving, we'll leave our own marks on the land. Those who come after will bear witness.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Your desk needs tidying up? It doesn't look messy at all. Much better than my study, hehe. Don't worry, no mess is too much for me. Truth is, I can't think straight in a tidy room.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Come on! It's just midnight, too early for bedtime. In Sargon, the days are super hot, so our 'day' only really starts when the sun goes down. Staying up messes with your circadian rhythm? Pfft, big deal. It's worth it when you see the lotuses blooming at sunrise.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My younger brother and I were born into a family of court historians, the Guardian of the King’s Secret. We grew up surrounded by stacks of scrolls handed down from our ancestors. As kids, we didn't get how valuable they were and just fought over the ones with more pictures. Thinking back, the pictures weren't half as fun as our fights.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: That's a figurine of the Shah on my desk. He's basically treated like a god in Sargon. I remember trawling across the entire desert just to dig up the relics he left behind... I came back empty-handed though... But, it's okay. I still felt good about getting to bring his figurine to visit the places he'd been.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The pattern on my hood? It's my family's emblem. As the Shahanshah's personally appointed historians, our duty is to see and faithfully record everything that happens. Although... there are times when they prefer us to be silent witnesses.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, there's a Juncus pen that has been passed down for generations in my family. It has documented many extraordinary lives and left its mark on treasured scrolls and manuscripts. I'm thinking, Doctor, if I were to be handed down that pen... How about I start with the stories of all its previous owners?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Hey, Doctor! I brought back a whole bunch of souvenirs for you. A few amulets, several volumes of supernatural tales, and a golden— Hey, don't swat it! The locals consider this bug a divine emissary that keeps travelers safe on their journeys, so promise you'll take good care of it!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, excavation work isn't as exciting as everyone thinks it is. It's mostly tedious and repetitive labor. If you really want to build a career on it, the best way is to either have a kindred spirit by your side, or a good rival to push you. That’s how you achieve more, and go further.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Hey, Doctor. Wanna look around the bottom of this pit? Give me your hand. Careful! Now, this dirt might seem unimpressive, only going up to your knees, but buried under it are traces of the people who lived here centuries ago. It's difficult to explain, but the land remembers all that humanity does, and all the choices we make.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Too relaxed to say anything? Hehe, of course you are! This is the soothing incense I brought from home. One whiff is enough to… Asleep already? Did I use too much? Oops... I did... now the Doctor's gonna be out for a whole day.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Greetings, Doctor. On behalf of my exalted Padishah, I am here to negotiate with you on a collaboration project within his dominion. My name is Djerwnapekhaper Saciut Hatshepsut, but... my friends all call me Pepe.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Um, could we just hire the warrior in the recording to teach me in person? I'm not used to learning like this…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Now this is new, I was always the one giving out rewards.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: A promotion? Alright, then I'll bestow an honorary title in return. Don't underestimate its power! From now on, no one will be able to hinder you in my father's domain.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: With lightning and habūb, my hammer will rebuke the intruders and their greed.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Are you ready to join me on this journey to uncover history long-buried?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I have prayed to the gods, and They have revealed to me an auspicious omen! We'll find something good this time.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Whoa, you robbers actually dare show yourselves before me?!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Take note: you can never be too gentle when cleaning relics!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: If we run into tomb robbers, hehe... Hammer time!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Woah, woah! Let me down more slowly. There are fragile artifacts down there!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Don't rush me! Lemme get a nice, big stretch before I squeeze down this hole.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Too late to run now, nasty little thief!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Put that down. Your filthy hands desecrate it.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You've got guts, trying to steal this!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Rawr! I'm gonna stamp a lotus on your head!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, once these results are published, your name will sit alongside mine for all eternity.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Now this is a shocking discovery! Any ideas how we might celebrate this, Doctor?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: It's not much, but at least those thieves won't profane this sacred site so easily again.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: How should we piece together these fragments…? Ow, my head hurts...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: You better not leave me here on my own. I might get curious and go tapping around with my hammer, which could lead to me seeing stuff I shouldn't, you know.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey! Do NOT undo the bow on my back!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I smell nice? But I don't usually wear perfume… Oh, it's probably just this lotus.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Ssh, no talking. Let the new year's first ray of sunlight bathe your face and body, feel its cozy warmth and gentle touch… Hmm... Doctor, the previous year is now history, all that suffering and joy—The sun just carried it away.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Greetings, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Careful what you wish for, though, Sargonian legends tell of crafty gods who will grant any wish, but at an unreasonable price! Better yet, just tell me your wish and I'll try to grant it!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, if the conditions are right, some traces of us will survive long into the future. When those who come after us find the vestiges we left behind, it'll be like we're smiling at them across time! So, Doctor, let's put on our best smiles! For now, and for our friends waiting in the eons to come.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Why do I keep my weapon right here? I said it before, you need a stable working environment. Anyone who wants to bother you will have to ask my little friend first.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a nice place. Everyone follows the rules and goes about their business, like an idyllic island paradise isolated from reality.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, those students over there, are they all from Chernobog? Middle schoolers from that city...? I see, I need to observe them a bit more.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Were you the one commanding at Chernobog, Doctor? Then you also must have seen the state of things there. How are you able to sleep at night, after all that? I can't get it out of my mind… I just can't…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've done well...? No, I haven't! I've achieved nothing, I even fled my homeland. A girl like me never does good… Uh, stop that. Why are you patting my head...?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Who needs my protection? Who can I protect? I've been asking myself, since that nightmare... Back then, I saw the malice in people's hearts, it was... it was pouring out all over the place. It drowned the whole city... Under those circumstances, maybe justice no longer means anything, it no longer exists.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Something wrong with my hair? It's... a little messy? Well, it is what it is. I had to cut it myself when I fled the city... Don't give me that look. It's just hair, it'll grow back eventually. Relax, okay?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: This device belonged to my father, a police officer who dedicated himself to protecting the public each and every day. I can understand, same as my mother. We've never blamed him. It's just that... Doctor, all that my father did, was it really worth it?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Those people, the civilians, their faces were so twisted. They looked just like the murderers who destroyed our city. But they were the people my father and I were supposed to protect. Doctor, what is actually just in this world? What should I do...? I just don't know...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: So sleepy... But I can't afford to... fall asleep…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Thank you for rescuing me, I pledge my life to you. There's not a lot I can do, but if you find some way for me to be useful, please let me know. Codename...? Ummm, just call me Absinthe.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: What's the point of watching this stuff?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: There's no need for a promotion. Rhodes Island does enough for me… I-I have to take it? But, well… Okay... Thank you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I still haven't figured out what justice really is. But you told me before that my beliefs mean something... You might be right. I-I want to believe.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Understood. I'll go get ready.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Whoever the squad leader is, what's the status on the... Huh, it's me?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't get cocky. Move out!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Halt! Suspicious individuals thirty meters ahead… It's those guys again.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: This time…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Copy.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Raid drill! Hands on your head! Don't move!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: This time... I must!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: No sudden moves!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Stop right there! No tresspassing!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This is your last warning! Surrender or get shot!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Why does it always end up like this…?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: If only you were there back then, maybe things would've turned out different…

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete. Doctor, you're not injured, are you?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Do you think any of them were from Chernobog?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's a panic, we've lost control! We have to retreat now, go!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This terrace... if enough snow built up on it, you could jump off like this and have a great time. Hup!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wha-What?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh, Doctor. Are you thirsty? Come, let's find something to drink.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Papa always used to work this holiday. He wouldn't come home until very late, so my mother and I would wait for him. If I got too tired, I would sit by the window and watch the snow. By the time the sign on the other side of the street was buried, Papa would be home... Doctor, thank you. I'll be fine by myself.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Are you alright? Need something to perk you up?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I don't know how you spend your birthdays, but my mother always baked this cake for me. It's my favorite, and she taught me how to make it... Back home, I never thought a day like this would come... Do you like it, Doctor?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: People say that what's past is past, but is that really true? I feel like some things, you'll always carry with you, but even so, you have to keep moving forward.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You keep the place so messy but find what you need anyway? *sigh* Well, that's also a talent, I guess.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, am I able to file for exemption from paperwork? I have a bad case of farsightedness. It's a lot of strain to read, and fatigue strikes easily.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm a repressed sort, not talkative. If you're not entertained, you can head out for now. No, I don't mean to drive you off, I just...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I don't need to be issued a scope. In my crossbow's killing range, my naked eye sees clearly enough.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My bolt points are a custom make. They pierce armor and cause massive blood loss in a short time. They're based on what Sargon hunters specially use to hunt big beasts, then I made modifications after coming to Victoria. Now they fly lighter, and kill harder.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The merc business is tough, absolutely. Sometimes I'd be in the snow and an entire day would pass on my watch, and my feet would be frostbitten by the end. I appreciate your look of concern, but it was fine. Even lucky. My left foot hurt less when it was frozen.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Why I like snow, you wonder? Let me think... Does never seeing it in Sargon count? Heh, it's not really that deep. People always have their inexplicable fancies.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: ...If it's alright for me to ask, could you read the poem in this book to me, Doctor? I borrowed it from Istina. She says it's a fine poem, about winter in Deity Grypherburg.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Do you know what's most precious? Someone to peacefully watch the snow with. Maybe I've met one at some point before, but who knows? Once the snow descends, it covers all traces of anything, including the fading footprints.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: How about a mug of hot water? You seem a little pale.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor, I'm Totter. Long-range sniping's my specialty. You can leave any task to me as long as it's a workday.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hold on, Doctor, it's too close. Let me put on my glasses and try again.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: If you're pleased with my work, then I couldn't ask for more.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor, but your appreciation actually leaves me at a loss. Err. If I'm being honest, I don't have big dreams for my work.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Orders ASAP, please.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everyone, please coordinate. Thanks in advance.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's move. Time waits for nobody.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: They're fast on the move, but I can still read their tracks.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Foggy today. Bad luck.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Great luck. Got a tail wind today.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I see clouds rising. Probable hostiles in the snow.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I see fowl taking off. Probable ambush in the grass.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Come out. Stop hiding!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I see you.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Stop moving.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: It won't be any use.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The best kills are one-shot. Less pain for them.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Target down. Mission clear, no setbacks.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: *Tut*, not my best shot.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Sorry, Doctor, target's out of range. I can't hit them.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Nice. Luxurious compared to my safehouse.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Speak. I'm all ears.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, is that you? You're blurry, but you've got distinct footsteps. I can tell them apart.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I saw all the snow outside when I came today. One vast blanket over the deck, it's beautiful. You should go take a look. Oh, right, Happy New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I picked this out for you from my own collection. I hope you like it... Okay, stop giving me that look. Is it so strange for someone who likes snow to collect snow globes as a hobby?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Nothing complicated went into me leaving home. I just wanted to live somewhere it snows in winter. How about you, Doctor? Have you gotten what you want, on the move all these years?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm not so good at desk work, but if all you need is someone to stay by your side and help you arrange your tasks and schedule... I can give it a shot, perhaps.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This pocket watch? My father gave it to me before he left home. It's nothing fancy, but it keeps time if you keep the movement and dial maintained… Uh, Doctor, is there anyone at Rhodes Island who can fix watches?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Out in the field, you can leave the cooking to me. That's what they had me doing back in the Columbian barrenlands. I can't promise, you know that, it's gonna taste very good… But at least it won't give you a stomachache.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Back when I was with the Pioneer Team, the company left us undersupplied, and we did not take that sitting down. We ended up escaping into the barrelands. That's when I got this scar on my eye. It's not a disgrace, but it's not a badge of honor either. It's just the kind of bad luck that us regular Columbians deal with all the time. Mine's just a little more obvious than others.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Planning your time and planning your life couldn't be more different. When you're eking out a living, you've got no choice but to use every last second. Even when you space out, you have to keep an eye on the clock. On the other hand, to plan out your life, you need enough time to think and feel. Those aren't contradictory. It's just the second one's more of a luxury to most people.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Is my sword heavy? You bet it is. But I need a heavy one to protect my friends and defend our overdue freedom. The truer the weight I carry is, the mightier I can wield it... And when I'm hurt, it also comes in handy as a walking stick.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: When my mother died, I didn't even get to mourn her. I had a huge pile of medical debt waiting for me to pay off. Why did I join the Pioneer Team, and why did I become a merc? It's not like I had other options. But I came to Rhodes Island after giving it serious thought.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: A free mercenary only takes a mission she thinks is worth the time. There was this one night when I was sitting by the fire, affixing some beast teeth to my sword. My friends were sleeping, and the only sound in the air was my watch ticking away. Time is always on my mind, but that was the first time I really felt its passing.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The mercenary crew I joined was doomed to disband, sooner or later. Without a clear goal and strict discipline, you can't survive in the wilderness… Maybe only an organization like Rhodes Island can really protect what's beautiful out there. I'm thankful that I could come here.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, if you don't need anything from me, I'll just zone out here for a bit... Feel free to talk to me anytime you need me.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Quartz... I think I'm on time.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I wish our squad could've fought like this back there.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thanks for your recognition, but remember to tell me if there's anything I can improve on.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island's promotion process and standards are pretty transparent. That's not easy to do.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Hope I can help.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't worry. I think my decisions through.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I propose we begin our operation at the top of the hour. It'll be easier to keep track of time.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hide, and make sure to put out the cooking fire.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Doctor, I'm in position.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Sheathe my weapon for the time being? Then my sword…

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Perfect timing!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: A bit late, not a big problem.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Time your strike. It's more important than brute strength.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Keep your distance. I only want to strike the enemy.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You're staring at my eyepatch, it reveals a lot.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Take this!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: When every phase of the mission proceeds with watchlike precision, victory is assured.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: This is worth celebrating... When we get back to Rhodes Island, we won't have to eat my cooking anymore.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Even the most accurate of watches isn't always accurate. Don't be so fixated on perfection

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Sorry, Doctor, we had a few problems with the plan because my watch is broken. Go, and leave the rest to me.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This is much more comfortable than a tent in the wilderness... Will someone stand watch at night?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, Doctor. What's the matter?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Let's space out together, Doctor. We can chill for as long as we need... No need to watch the clock like we used to.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, Happy New Year. Hey, do me a favor and watch the length of your New Year's speech. Everyone is waiting to cut the cake.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Careful. You almost bumped into my sword.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Here's a pocket watch... Of course, it's not my own. And it's not one of those collectibles the Columbian businessmen like. You may not need something like this to show off, but you can use it to check the time.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: If I hadn't come across Rhodes Island, would I still be wandering the wilderness by myself, or would I have returned to the city to face the music...? I don't know, but I don't need the answer, either. I stand with you and Rhodes Island now.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: If you've thought it through, I have no qualms with it. Please let me know when the documents are due.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: ...Please, go ahead. It's okay. Reading the paper is just an unhelpful habit I picked up in the Grand Knight Territory, but one can learn much more from a day's trip outside the city than a hundred papers can teach... It's true that the Nearl name often shows up in the headlines, but there's no need to pay that any mind.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm afraid I can't advise Rhodes Island on its affairs in Kazimierz. I may have spent a decade in that tower, but only as an unambitious nobody. I'm in no position to express my views on the General Chamber of Commerce. The sword...? Yes, I know how to use one, and I've always used the same one.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: No need to have Maria come see me. She's not a child anymore, and ought to make her own decisions, lest she embarrass her parents. A knight should temper themselves through travel, and no matter what she does under Rhodes Island's wing, she must always be responsible for her own actions.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Leithanien's conspiracies... Nothing more than trifles that happened years ago. It doesn't change the fact that I'm an ordinary citizen, nor does it change anything else. To Kazimierzians, stars and heroes come and go. The success they enjoy is only that which they are permitted.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Seems Margaret kept the title she earned from that charade. Hmph, so she still sees her actions as a victory, after squandering the Nearls' glory in those cheap commercial performances... My Originium Arts? Alas, I can nary illuminate a thing.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: No need to teach me how to get along with the Infected...You should be aware of my time spent living among the refugees…? The Infected, the disabled, the bankrupt, the famished and poor... they're all the same in the ways that matter. The most honorable thing they can hope to achieve is climbing out of their tent in the settlement before their final moments arrive.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You, too, encourage the others to throw themselves at a cause that will yield no results. Those who attempt to walk through fire in the dark night will only find themselves immolated. That said, you don't need my advice, given the path you so obstinately walk alone.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: In the first two years after they left the Grand Knight Territory, the campaign knights would often bring me their letters. By the time the last one arrived, Maria was already old enough to understand its gist... Whether the letters were written beforehand makes no difference to me, but given the weight of their lives and deaths, they wouldn't have disappeared without so much as a peep.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: A wilderness without light…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Młynar Nearl. Per our contract's provisions, I shall assist Rhodes Island with its operations in Kazimierz. ...You already knew my name. I'm neither a knight, nor do I have a title.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: A Kazimierzian is smart after the damage is done…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I appreciate your appraisal, if you consider such ordinary performance worthy of promotion.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Titles and positions are both meaningless. The knights of the Nearl family do not require recognition to walk their paths. Even in modern Kazimierz, where every path leads to darkness.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Man has forgotten true struggle… as well as those who require it to survive.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: ...Follow me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Sand, dust, and blood. Most fail to imagine the sight of their admixture.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: To think they are unaware of their own shame...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm fully prepared.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hm.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: These so-called foes… not even worth drawing my sword.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Just like the old days?… No.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: This won't hurt your eyes.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: How very tiring.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: It rains.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: That sigh... still haunts my mind.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You still have full confidence in everything... With these people's fate in your hand, you still believe there will be a happy ending.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: If you have no other work for me, I shall take my leave.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Deserters… they always have somewhere to hide, among their like-minded brethren.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Mark my words, there will be battles you cannot win. Have you considered the consequences of those inevitable failures?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: You... accommodate quite a few people here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: ...I believe I've made a suggestion regarding this matter?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Kazimierz's knight novels... Hmph... The Grand Knight Territory no longer has room for such fantasies.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Margaret and Maria should be on board... No, no need to tell them. I find the commotions that come with the New Year unbearable. I'm just going to read the paper here.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good day... 'Doktor.'

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: If you have no time to deal with work today, then I'll take my leave. A present? I used to give Maria gifts when she was little. I even once chased after bandits who had ransacked a village, for the sake of a small child's birthday wish. That said, you are not a small child.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The future that Rhodes Island paints is impossible, but still, you attract supporters to chase it with no regard for their own safety. Your tottering ideals would never have come this far without the support of your followers. So spare me the civilities. I'm only walking this path alongside you for the time being.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's been a long time since I've felt like there was any conviction or meaning in my work. Rather than sit through show trial after show trial, I prefer to wade through these thorny, complicated files.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You don't have to tiptoe around me. I don't judge good or evil on any ironclad law. And with all the crimes staged in the name of order… Ah, pay no mind to this judge's grumble, a powerless judge waiting to be indicted for misconduct in office.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The thorns on this codex? Yes, of course the spikes hurt, but I wish for the pain to remind me: No matter how weak the statutes in Siracusa, no matter how highly I think of my calling, perversion of justice and blasphemy against the law are crimes.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: They say 'the law is the basis of morality,' but that's not a natural truth. It emerges from a consensus of the people. When the people come to see violence as order, the law is nothing but a fantasy to dream of. And I, as the keeper of that fantasy, am the most ridiculous of all.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: In Siracusa, being a city court judge is a dangerous job. Either you join 'them,' or... you disappear. I thought I could strike a balance between the two, but there's no way to stay clean when you're surrounded by mud. In the end, I was just another accomplice.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Maybe Siracusa really is that hard to change. The gangs, the famiglie... They shared a womb with Siracusa and shaped it into the country it is today. But we can't take them for granted. We must believe that a different path exists.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Oh, mi dispiace, I didn't see you there. If you're all done with work, how about joining me for a drink?… Why that look in your eyes? I'm not an alcoholic. But everyone needs some liquid assistance every now and then, whether for fatigue or for suffering. Ecco. It's on the strong side, so sip slowly.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: If you ever get a chance to visit Siracusa, please avoid the rainy season. However, if you really are that unfortunate... best thing you can do is find a little shop on the street and sit for a while. Maybe only after the rain can one enjoy the momentary illusion that the city is clean.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: In my many years as a judge, I've only handed down a few verdicts I could feel good about. I still remember the look on those two kids' faces when I broke up their little scuffle and told the aggressor to apologize. What, why are you laughing? Even the greatest justice must start from somewhere small.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You're sleeping? There's nothing more valuable than these rare moments of peace. Conserviamo questi momenti.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Lavinia Falcone, formerly a judge of Siracusa. Today, I report to you as Operator Penance. I hope that in working for Rhodes Island, I can absolve myself of my past mistakes.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: So much violence in the name of order... Doctor, I can only pray that your efforts are more than futile.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I am honored to earn your support. We can certainly work together and offer mutual assistance, but let me be frank – that doesn't mean you can influence my decisions. Sorry, no offense intended, but that's a lesson I learned the hard way.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Be it a famiglia, a society, or a country, people are often bound by mutual interest... I used to assume this was the way of the world, but Doctor, you showed me a different path. I hope we can share this mutual trust long into the future.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Sitting around in an office won't bring about justice. That's one thing I know for a fact.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Whether or not you are burdened by a criminal record is unimportant to me. All I ask is that in this coming battle, our goals might be aligned.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Contempt for the law is a crime. The words of my codex will prove their own worth.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: This time, I will hand down a fair verdict.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: No matter what I might encounter, I will not back down.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What the law does not specify, I will reveal through practice.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This gavel of justice is weighty. Spero che siate pronti.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I am fighting for more than just the law. Also the justice and virtue that extend beyond it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The law is a means, not an end.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: There is no such thing as absolute justice, but I still invoke it!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Can crimes be punished through methods outside of the law?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Your crimes are irrefutable.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Even a crime-ridden swamp is not beyond salvation. Doctor, thank you for once again reminding me of this fact.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A trial in all its vaunted glory will not bring about any substantive change. It matters more what we do after the trial. Doctor, I've seen what you've done, and find it praiseworthy.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, prepare a team to arrest the fugitives. There is no difference between a moment of mercy and a miscarriage of justice. They have not yet been read their verdict.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Naturally, they and the darkness behind them will occasionally prevail... But mark my words, even the most frustrating rainy season will pass in time. Until then, all we can do is persevere, and keep trying.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place is nothing like stagnant, old Siracusa. The breath of hope flows here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Please show proper respect.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Are you here to discuss criminal procedure with me? No? Eccellente. I hope you never need my knowledge in that regard.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Back in my homeland, even New Year's Day comes with no guarantee of peace. The conflicts of interest do not stop for a holiday. That's why I cherish my time here at Rhodes Island, spending it with all of you. Buon Anno, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, I've categorized these documents according to their importance. Let me remind you that some of your operations land in a legal gray zone. I'm not opposed to them, but you need to think things through. I'll offer my advice as well.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, is today your birthday? I'll skip the serious business for now, so just enjoy this day to yourself. If you have nothing to do, I could tell you about some of Siracusa's osterie?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, Rhodes Island has a grand vision, but we have to think carefully. After all the slogans, ideals, and aspirations have been stripped away, whether we still have pure hearts, that is far more important than any false order.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: If some work is beyond even your power, then how can I possibly take on a share?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: That nightmare still comes to mind, even now. My life denied by some grand ecology... no, not denied. It would admit everything, it was more sublime than life itself... it made me feel shame at the selfishness of life.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I don't want to belittle the Medical Department's effort, but I don't believe life can be 'cured' like a disease. Human or Sea Terror, I'm doomed to live on as half-baked, and that's the price I pay for my own foolishness.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: That special 'collaborator' of yours is just something other right now, using biological function to imitate his old form, and you should know that better than him. You're still seeking possibilities in him? I hope you aren't repeating my mistakes.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've felt at ease in my time residing aboard the landship, even come to recognize it as a feeling similar to my long-lost home... You don't need to be concerned. Even if Iberia will never be a home to the Ægir, I'd never refuse to execute my responsibilities there, such as we've agreed.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Anything that seems to be given for free will eventually demand some price of you. That's the lesson I learned. And some of what you do appears to practically overturn that... I'll have to wait and see.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You're wondering what this song is? It's just something my mother taught me when I was young. I didn't take much interest back then, only humming perfunctory notes to follow along. It was only after losing her, I realized... these melodies form one of the few things I still have to my name.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: An ignorant girl gives up her song, and gains naught but a dream snuffed as quickly as the foam in return. It sounds just like a fairytale, doesn't it? And the fact that such a stupid girl could be saved at the story's end... seems like a fairytale, too.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You've helped me recover the courage to trust in other beings, so I hope you see this responsibility through. Lead those willing to follow you, and put an end to those disasters that should never have befallen the innocent. Please, don't disappoint me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You see them in your dreams too, don't you? All those faces who've quietly left your life.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: So, you'd be the 'Doctor'. I don't have much to introduce about myself. If I'm standing here, you must have read and approved all the files about me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Maybe I shouldn't doubt the value of these records, like I did before.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: The more you seek from a power you should reject, the deeper you fall into it. Eventually, it will engulf your entire being. You understand this, don't you?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You wish to forge a space that can admit me, and hope for me to admit everything surrounding me...? An arrogant notion, truly. But maybe I could bear witness with you, until the day you give up.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Looks like we've gotten our approvals. It's time to go.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I might bring their ruin, but only you can bring our victory.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let us reap those naive delusions and immature obsessions.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I hear the sound of the flooding tide.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Do you have instructions for me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Do I still have to wait?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: As you ask.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I have no doubt.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: They have no position to evade.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: They have no power to withstand.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: They have no way to advance.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: They have no path to escape.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Sometimes, your grasp of the surrounding situation makes me instinctually fearful. Yes, I believe you could make even Sea Terrors comprehend fear. So, do you intend to feel happy about this?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The waves have subsided. If you have no other tasks, I should leave immediately to undergo a 'routine' inspection.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Were you showing mercy? Are enemies of this level worth your indulgence?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We should go. Before the next wave has us drowned.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: So this, too, is the place you promise I can belong.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Did you need me?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: This place might be more... calming than expected.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I don't expect much for the new year, nor do I want to. I just want to take a walk around and see whether anything's changed, compared to my memories of the last year. If it won't bore you, I don't mind you accompanying me.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: We still have some time, before the tide floods the soil beneath us.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Look at this mountain of gift boxes. They symbolize everyone around you who treasures you. And I add: this, my present to you. I'm so glad these petals and pearls my mother gave me didn't fade with time, just like how she taught me to string flower garlands.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Does Rhodes Island's intent to cure Oripathy stem from its mission as a healer, or its core members' self-interest as Infected? Now, under this starry sky, another threat has appeared to endanger us all. What will Rhodes Island do? You already have an answer, don't you, Doctor?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: This table's really high! I guess it's easier if I just use my old form to jump up.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: What are you doing here? There's these Medic Operators who keep chasing my tail all the time saying they wanna study me! I need to lay low! Still, why are you hiding here too? You're not slacking off, right, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My power is controlling metal, stuff like the thing on your table. I can make it turn pointy, round, or flat, and even more complicated shapes too.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The people here look a lot like the spirits in our world. So maybe, the spirits in this world look like you do, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: This place is a lot like the Hall for Spirits to me, with all the Infected staying here because they have nowhere to go. But... the Infected have it really different from spirits. They can't even escape just by staying far away from everyone.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: There's so many Catastrophes here... Is this why your cities have to keep wandering everywhere all the time?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I get it! Operators are Executors, aren't they? Executors do errands for the Hall for Spirits, and Operators do errands for Rhodes Island! Huh? No?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'll be an Executor someday, just like my master. My master's really mighty! Um... you too. Everyone on this battleship listens to you, so you've got to be somebody incredible.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, are we friends now? Then if you can, you should visit our side to play sometime!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, are you eating something secret there?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor, my name's Xiaohei, and I'm a spirit.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Doctor... if I don't understand these tapes, can I ask you about them?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? What does that mean?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I still don't really get it, but thanks, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Doctor, I'm here! Huh? Is there something on my face? Ah, I just finished eating, haha.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm gonna be the captain? Can I handle that...?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Doctor, grab onto me, I'll use my power to send us there. It's quicker that way.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Are... all of them bad guys?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Heixiu, we have to help the Doctor out.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Uh-huh, Doctor, I'm here, don't worry.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm actually pretty good at assassinating.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I won't let you hurt them!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't come near.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: If you get any closer, I'll get mean!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'm super strong! I'll show you how mighty I am!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Sshaaa!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Is everyone okay? I'm so, so glad!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: There's just mighty people everywhere.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew—lucky. You're still fine, right?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's all my fault for being so weak, Doctor...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I can't forget about the mission the Doctor gave me. But this mat's so comfortable, and the sun's so warm. I think I'm getting kinda sleepy...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Doctor, don't mess with my ears!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What are you still working for, Doctor? It's almost food time!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. This is for you. It's lou mei from Ah Gen, since he wanted to thank everyone for treating us so well the past year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: So it's your birthday, Doctor! No wonder there's so many people aboard. Sorry, I didn't get a present ready in time for this, um... you can have this scroll from the Hall for Spirits, and if you're ever in danger, it'll save your life!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, I... I'm really going to treasure all the time we've spent together. And if I ever go back one day, I'll never forget you.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm not good at this stuff either. Huh? They need it done today? Eh... Fine, I told you I'd help. I keep my word. Give it here. I'll take half, but you gotta finish the rest on your own!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Got any salt on you, Doc? Here, gimme some. I made potatoes. They taste so good when you sprinkle salt on them! We eat them like this a lot when we're out on a job! I roasted some fruit, too. Take it to W and Ines... Don't tell them it's from me! Got it?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I heard I might run into W here? Seriously? She and Ines saved me a while back, and I'm thankful for it, but she can be real annoying sometimes... Doc, I'm surprised you had the guts to hire her.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Manfred, that jackass! He actually did it! And he was serious about it, too! I totally thought I was going to die... Ugh, I know he's got his reasons... but I still can't let it slide! I've got a grudge!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: You were leading the squad then, right? Hmph, how could I forget? You gave me a real bad time! But if I had to do it again, I'd still choose to take everybody and bug out... I don't want to have to watch somebody sacrifice themselves ever again.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Is rebuilding Kazdel really a good idea? I don't know. All I know is I care more about the people around me—my squadmates, everyone from Rhodes Island... of course, that includes you, Doctor! We're buddies now, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: If Kazdel really gets rebuilt, does that really mean us Sarkaz all get to come back and reunite together? What will the Victorian rebels think of us? I can't see how this all ends... I don't know...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doc! Is the mail in? Anything for me? Thing is, I was raised by my nana in a small town in Columbia, and we still write to each other! I'm always telling everyone here to write home more often, but for some reason they get pretty upset about it. I wonder why.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: C'mere, Doc. Try this on! Hm... Looks great on you. My nana knitted it for you! It matches mine, too! How's it feel? Comfy and warm, right? I told Nana all about you, and she called you a good egg!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: So bored... Maybe I should knit something. What do you think of this little pouch? It's very practical!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hey there! Starting today, my squad and I are at your beck and call, Doctor. Call me Paprika. You seem like a solid employer, but you're still on probation! I've got my eye on you!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are these the ancient Sarkaz tricks the old folks talk about?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Awesome, I finally got promoted! Hehe, you said you'd let me lead my own squad after my promotion. You're a doctor of your word, aren't you?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor! You're a mighty fine employer! Amiya looks real dependable, too. There's no going wrong, hitching my wagon to you. If you've got any more high-paying gigs, be sure to give me a holler!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Hehe, you picked the right girl for the job!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just leave it to me! I've got some experience leading a squad.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Stay safe and keep in contact. Remember, the mission comes second. Your lives come first!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let's clear the place in one fell swoop!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Don't worry. I've been standing by here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I don't pick fights I can't win.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Not one of you is getting away!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Don't get careless just because I'm here!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Everyone hanging in there?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Get behind me, if you feel yourself slipping!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: We can't have any more casualties...

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You bastards... Scram! I'm busy here!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You're pretty amazing, coming up with a strategy like that... I gotta say, you're a lot better than W just lobbing bombs at everything.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Awesome, smooth like butter! Hehe, I didn't need any backup that time. Let's see what W and Ines have to say!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A few footmen slipped past us, but that's no big deal, right? Yep, everyone made it out of the fight alive. I call that a big win!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: N-No way... Doctor, you aren't trying to hold the line here, are you? C'mon, quit spacing out. Hurry up and run!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rhodes Island really treats us well... Oh, don't be so humble. This is much better than the dump we used to live in!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whoa! What's up?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: This poncho feels great, right? Nana knitted it for me. It's so warm.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! I didn't expect such a crowd celebrating the new year together. It's so much fun hearing all the New Year's wishes! Doc, what's your wish this year? Me, I'm wishing for Nana to stay safe... Oh no, if I tell someone, the wish won't come true, right? Forget what I just said, instantly!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doc. What kind of missions do we have today? Oh, right. Let me get this out of the way. I'm not taking anything too crazy!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Hey Doctor, guess what day it is? …You don't remember? It's your birthday! How could you forget your own birthday! Huh? You were pulling my leg? And you know I've prepared a present...? What?!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A great employer like Rhodes Island is hard to find. Our partnership has been wonderful! I never thought I'd see a day like this when you guys first beat us back in Londinium... We're gonna keep this up for a very, very long time. Right, Doc?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, do you mind me tinkering with a few things here, or would that be too much noise? Just give me a tap on the back when you want to chat, of course.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, I hear you've got a lot of books here. Could you lend me a few to read? They don't have to be on mechanical engineering, I'm plenty curious about stuff I don't know. Like this one, for instance, it's a beauty of a doorstopper... what was that? Don't touch? I-It's got a curse? Hold on, who put that on it?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The Sarkaz deserve sympathy for what they've been through, but one man can't steal another's home for the sake of his own. Peace will come to Londinium, and I hope, one day, every wanderer gets to build a homeland. It's what Rhodes Island wants too, isn't it?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: A lot of people'll say the lord nobles do nothing but cling onto the privilege and wealth they inherit, and never think to build on this land with their own hands. Me? I don't mind fighting side-by-side with nobles, just don't make me call them 'lord.'

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I didn't used to believe things could ever really be dire. Not until an almighty enemy showed up to me, and stole my pals from me, one after the other. They all trusted me, and I failed them. Granny was right. 'Being smart isn't enough to fool death.'

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm a big fan of red. It makes me think of fireplaces on freezing nights. And all the friends who've left us along the way... I'm telling you, their sacrifices meant something. Londinium will come back to us, back to our hands, and it'll be better than before.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, I find it easy to trust people, but don't take me for stupid. If you were just another lot of plotting schemers, I would've taken up arms with no hesitation. But you see, if I offer a shake when I meet someone, that's all the more likely I've got a new friend. Haha, I'm glad my bet paid off here.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When we were on break, me and my work pals liked climbing up to the workshop ceiling. Thirty, forty-odd meters. We'd step out of the window and go jumping between buildings. Wind'd blow by with the smell of the factory heat and rust, stars'd squeeze down past the buildings and smile on me. I could feel my city in its warm embrace.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: *sigh* It's a beauty of a place at Rhodes. I almost want to apply to stay aboard. Shame I've still got all those people and all that work waiting for me in Londinium... Doctor, when it's clear skies once more at home, how about you let me be your guide again? What do you say?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, you must be bored out of your mind sitting at work all day. Want me to take you out for some exercise? Don't worry, no ziplines this time.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, we've faced so much danger together. Do we still need this paperwork to stand for us being friends? Wait, you mean once I sign, I get to take any of Engineering's beauties apart? That's a promise, you hear? 'Stainless'—done.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Cor, I suppose you really do make your logistics people fight too. Not that that's much of a problem... How about a little pay bump, eh?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: 'Top Engineering Operator?' If I want to be Chief Engineer, I'm still a few steps away, aren't I? Haha, I'm just pulling your leg. I've got no plan to jockey for Closure's living.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: It's a luxury now, just having free time like this to work with my drill and spanner. Doctor, thank you. I'm all willing to take to the field for my homeland and freedom. But it's you and Rhodes Island that won back this moment of refuge for me.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Squad 11 of Self-Salvation Corp, joining up with Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm a little nervous. Still, pressure's a good motivator, right?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Remember, everyone! Not one fewer when we come back!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hello, everyone over there, you can breathe easy. What's the line? 'I'm just your average mechanic.'

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: About time for us to shine?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'll bring you back victory.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Picked a good place for me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Down to work!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Swing your hammers!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hold the barricades!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Drill through darkness!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Fight for Londinium! Victory to Londiniers!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: We'll come together, we'll fight all the way, for this city we stand on, until we fall.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, with you for company all the time, I start imagining I fight even better than the mercs. Don't you let me get too cocky. If Granny and Rockrock saw, they'd be knocking on my head with spanners.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hah... haha, made it through another battle. Hard as nails, though. Don't look so glum, Doctor. I know it's back to the Commander for a tactical meeting, but how about a bite to eat before then?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Time to scram, Doctor. The zipline's ready. Give me your hand! It's only a win once you survive.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: So it wasn't Victoria with the best construction technology.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Watch it! Drill didn't hurt you, did it?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you always show up where I wasn't looking. I bet Rhodes Island has secret passages too, doesn't it?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Want a drink, Doctor? How about some ginger ale... what, a dance? Haha, my hands might be skilled at work, but my legs are naff dancers—it all cancels out. Still, if you're okay with me, I can try. Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, I'm just back from patrol. Safe as houses all around! You can break for a bit longer. The tenser the state of things, the more you need a proper stretch now and then.

lines.title: Birthday
