lines.text: Doctor, help me figure out why this panel's on fire... You can't figure it out either? I'd hope not, I broke it on purpose... um, flip, I shouldn't have said that. Would've ruined the surprise they had for you if I just let you walk on past. Closure's not gonna kill me, is she?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, thank you. Being with my Rhodes Island companions makes me see more clearly what it is I'm resisting. Everyone should have the freedom to run about their own city, and we fight for that right. That's a future that belongs to us all, including the Infected.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Remember, you two, this purr-ticular assistant role calls for maximum vigilance. If any meownsters come knocking, we throw the Doctor on the cart and go!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Curious about our latest research? We're gnawing on 'An Investigation into Biological Discrepancies Between Us Felynes with a Y and Terran Felines with an I.' We were halfway done, but then we found out you have Aslans too, so it's back to the scratching post for us... You Terrans are meowder with your subspecies!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Your Meowjesty, never forget to eat your fill before you go on a hunt. Dive into a fight with full stamina, and you might end up doing things you didn't even think you could... mrrreow!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: *dink* *dink* No Machalite Ore left...  Could substitute with Rock Spider stones and gloompincer shells... Don't know without trying. In you go.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The mountains never fail to remind me of an old bud, built just as tall and strong. He broke his weapon once and quit the Palico life after, but if memory serves, he then went with the Research Commission to take up cheffing in the New World... You never know what turn your next life'll take.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Say, Doctor, I'll let you in on a secret trick, friend to... maybe furless friend. If you ever get hurt in battle and you need to chug a Potion, set off a Barrel Bomb behind you while you do. Why? It'll stop any baddies getting the pounce on you, that's why!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Terra has new materials. Lots of ores. Very lovely... Maybe I can make a weapon just like that Great Sword in the ice cave back home! For mew, Doctor!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Meow, meow, lots of... fascinating things in Doctor's room. Want to move them elsewhere, while Doctor's asleep... Smithy! Stay your paw!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: On Your Meowjesty's summons, we the Felyne Special Corps... cream of the crop of the Terra Research Commission's Furst Fleet, have arrived! Meowch! Get your hind paws off my head!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: What are you doing inside this box, Smithy? Im... Impawssible! It's all moving! How is it done?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Ready for departure!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: A simple task! I'm a purr-ime leader, after all!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go, 'Hunters!' Put some pep in your step!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Purr-ey spotted. Watch out, Your Meowjesty.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: By your bidding, Your Meowjesty.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Meow! Right here!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: You two! Now!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You're purr-essing too hard!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Aim fur that weak spot!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: They're wide open!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Taste the flaming soul of a hunter!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: The purr-fect slinger technique!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Are... Are we out of danger meow? Can I open my eyes yet?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Absolutely stellar command, Your Meowjesty. That's what I call great gains... mrreow.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Equipment everywhere... grabbing, all of it. Grabbing and going.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Good gravy, they're catching up! Run, run like your tail's on fire!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hauling, hauling... Smithy, why do you drag that meowntain of materials with you everywhere you go?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Mrrow~

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What are you doing? Mrrow... right there, please... Hey, save a pet or two for me!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ah, Doctor! Fine day to mew!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'll protect you, as I've promised. But...it'll take some time before I can read all the words on these documents... Don't worry, I'll get there.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You have to be prepared, out in the wastelands. Always carry flint for starting fires, a weapon for self-defense, and fabric to use as a water filter... no flammable items in the office? But, what if there's a power outage?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Shifu taught us how to fight, how to avoid Catastrophes, how to farm and store food. Now we don't have to drift around in search of water and pasture anymore... Just like you, Doctor, Shifu seemed to know everything. I can't be like you and my Shifu, but I can protect you, so you can help people.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Whenever the tribe is on the move, everyone worries whether we'll find a good place to settle down. But people in nomadic cities don't seem concerned at all... Maybe for them, they're not moving in search of a new home, but drifting with the home they have?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Oripathy is not a rare sight in my tribe. We only think the stones that grow from the skin, they look like the stones we dig out of the earth… There are already so many things that can kill you; why persecute someone for a disease?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The name 'Anasa' means 'one without roots.' My people say that if you have no attachments, there's nothing that can trouble you. But everyone I've met since I left has something that they are attached to. Me? You mean I'm the same, in how I want to repay my debt? Hmm...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: My name comes from the first Yanese poem my Shifu taught me. It tells of a cloud, 'Yun' in Yanese, that has been drifting for a thousand li, raining across the land, until it finally finds a mountain to rest upon. 'Jie' is the end of that long journey. After all, 'everyone should have a place to call home.'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: That martial arts master is here too... I thought he was cold and heartless, but now I kind of understand him... a man who has lived for so long and traveled so far can only carry so much. That must be what Shifu thought as well.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Sometimes you see the clear night sky after a Catastrophe has passed in the distance. Wind blows toward the horizon, and the stars seem so close you could touch them. A bonfire keeps the beasts away, while singing keeps you warm. The wastes are dangerous, but they are not terrible.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you retiring for the night? I'll stand watch.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: My birth name? Doctor, you understand the Anasa language...? But I would rather continue to use the name 'Jieyun.' Shifu gave me this name, and I like it.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The reasons to fight never change much.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I still have a lot to learn after leaving the wastes. I'm willing to do more, if you trust me to. As the Yanese expression goes: a promise is worth a thousand taels of gold.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I haven't thought much about what I will become, but Rhodes Island could become home to many. Thank you, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Yes, I will complete the task you gave me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Stay close. The wastelands are a dangerous place to get lost.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We're bringing everyone home, safe and sound.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The wind and sand don't cover all tracks. Something's not right here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes, I remember your instructions.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'll go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Remember those poplars, and you'll always find your way.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll pile some stones here to mark the trail.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Would you give up after a loss?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You have invaded someone else's home...

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Your families will be sad if they never see you again.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: A few more cairns on the barrens.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Will anyone remember them when all this is buried beneath the sand?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: If I could learn from you, Doctor, I could protect my people's lands.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Shifu says it isn't important whether or not you achieved what you set out to do, but whether you gave your best without running away. We've done well, Doctor.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't worry, I remember the way that we came. There's time to retreat.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'm used to the darkness... oh, there's the light.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Be careful, Doctor. You don't want to be mistaken for an attacking beast.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I recognize your footsteps, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: For us, the new year isn't a fixed date. It starts when we see the first sprout of spring. Then we drink, sing and celebrate.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Would you like to go out for some fresh air, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: This is the seed of the 'Tree of Life and Death.' Flowers appear on its branches in every state of its life cycle, from bud to bloom to decay. None of us can escape the cycle of life and death. Every day is precious. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The Anasa are used to the cycle of life and death, but here at Rhodes Island, I see many struggle to say farewell to those they love. Home is where you find someone or something you can't let go of... I think I'm beginning to understand...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Filing documents? I thought that was a job for Little Handy... Well, I can do it myself. I could do a lot worse than chatting with you.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Ten minutes until ocean current data inflow. I will take four minutes to prepare ink, five minutes to setup the equipment, forty-five seconds to doodle. The last fifteen seconds? Let you remove your hood, of course. Or, what's the difference between a faceless model and a lifeless rock?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The Ægir sleep cycle is not affected by time of day. When inspiration strikes, an artist usually stays up for 50 plus hours without a wink of sleep. As for me, I'm more like you people, except I go to bed when the sun rises. It's eight o'clock already? I'm getting sleepy... Hm, why are you yawning too?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Why do I enjoy chatting with the robot operators, when the Ægir frown upon emulating humanity with machinery? Hehe, because it's fascinating. Besides, my chats actually prompted Closure to upgrade their cognitive modules, ensuring they won't overload. I may take credit for any breakthroughs in that area.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Ever since the Waterway opened, swarms of unsightly seaborns have appeared outside the dome. Truly annoying, to say the least. In all seriousness, though, it's my job to observe, record, and accumulate the data needed to eliminate seaborns once and for all. The more brazen they are, the closer an eye I must keep on them.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: When the city was evacuated and the darkness crept in, my fear gripped me so tightly that I scribbled something on the dome without even realizing it. Recently, I went back and found that it was a smiling face. It suddenly dawned on me that I should have faced the darkness with a smile way earlier.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There used to be a bunch of seaweed outside the dome, swaying leisurely to its own pace, no matter how fierce the currents. I've long wanted to grow some myself, stirring the water and watching it linger like nothing happened... kind of like you, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I modified this communal umbrella using dome technology. Now it can adjust its shape and opacity, and also detect temperature and humidity. But the Engineering Department didn't feel there was any need for it, and wanted me to change it back, because the tentacle-shaped monitoring unit was too scary... Hmm. Say, do you have an umbrella? Do you want to trade?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: 'Eventide of the Depths', a volcanic power station that once lit the deep in a red glow... Once the war is over, how about we go see it together? Even if it has been overgrown by Seaborn creep, I'm sure you'd come with me to reawaken it without batting an eyelid, wouldn't you?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Friendly reminder! Your face will become my canvas if you doze off at work... Wait, you're really asleep? Turn the temperature up two degrees, Little Handy. It wouldn't be any fun if the Doctor caught a cold.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you. I'm from Ægir and my name is... Hmm... Why are you staring at the bottle on my belt? Did you want a sip? Certainly, but I take no responsibility for what happens after you drink this ink.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Pause, please, Doctor. Turn the image so I can see this one's back... What? This 'video' of yours only allows watching from a fixed angle?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? Have I really done so well? Or do you just really enjoy working with me?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Another promotion? What's the reason this time...? Extremely precise recommendations based on current movement... Uh-huh. What else? Leveraged her skills in maintenance and repair. Yeah yeah, I agree. C'mon, don't stop the praise, I'm all ears.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Need me for data collection, or dome repair? Neither? You're always so full of surprises.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You want me to be the captain? You'd better give me some interesting teammates.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Come with me, everyone. You'll always know me by the ink bottle I carry.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Here comes a wave!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Take it easy. Haste makes waste.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Go on, I'm listening.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm on the scene. The flow of the currents... Ah… it's a mess.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: It's time to teach these rascals a lesson.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Who's disturbing the currents?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Close your eyes, feel the undulating waves... Too bad, you've fallen into my trap.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Aww, look at you, you've got ink all over you again.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Say something. It would be sad if you sank into the depths without a sound.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Defeating a strong foe is satisfying, but don't forget to look up once in a while. See, the sights above… aren't they beautiful?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You carried out the plan without the slightest fumble. Not bad. The Institute of Facility Management would appreciate people like you.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A little deviation won't cause any serious issues. I'll stay behind to check for problems.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I know trial-and-error is a painful process. But if you keep knocking yourself like this, I may have to deal with the next job alone, imagine how dull it would be.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Turn on the lights, Little Handy. Hey Little Handy? Hello? Alright, where's the switch...?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Well, well, are you asking for a poke in the head?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You can use the ink as you wish, but the mapper? Nah-uh.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: My schedule today? Let me check... Huh? You don't work on the first day of the year? Hm, landlubbers do have some strange customs. Alright, let me plan out the day... first, help the Doctor pick a New Year's present.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You look cheerful. Up to no good?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I've recently come to appreciate the unique beauty of the patterns found on paper currency, and I've drawn a copy of this bill for you. Is it a good imitation? Don't let people see it? Counterfeit money? What does that mean?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Look who I found. While there's a vibrant party going on, we've got a lonely soul here reading... Oh, foreign languge, I can't understand it. Hmm.. how about this, Doctor? You tell me what the book is about. I'll tell you the patterns and meanings I've garnered. They're hidden in these lines and spaces between those words. Interested?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I can offer you protection, and even handle a little business for you. But you'd better prove it's worth my time.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island's work in Lungmen will remain confidential, but I know that your actions saved lives. I've spent a long time trying to gauge just how trustworthy Rhodes Island really is. As for my conclusion, I trust you had no trouble setting up your office in Lungmen?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm sure you've been working with Mr. Lee. You can trust the information you get from him, but there are limits to what a private investigator can do. If you need something outside his purview, you come to me. Don't worry, my methods won't send any trouble Rhodes Island's way.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I just saw Swire here. It surprised me how she was working so hands-on. If we'd followed the dreams we had as kids, she would've become the head of Lungmen's Chamber of Commerce, and I might be a university lecturer right now. You never know... Hm? No, I don't need to say hello. Given her status, it would be inappropriate for us to be seen in public.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The coat my father always wears is a birthday present I gave him. I'm so used to the dignified airs he puts on, sometimes I even forget that... underneath the coat is an old man growing frailer by the day. Sooner or later, someone will have to stand up and take the weight off his shoulders.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: To certain people, the slums are a problem that needs to be solved. To others, this is their home. The shift from 'Slums' to 'Downtown' could take generations to settle. I don't know how far I can carry it myself, but I'll do what I can.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I've never seen Ch'en onboard Rhodes Island. She has things to do, doesn't she? Hmph, hardly see any merit in recruiting operators like her. It's true that we don't get along very well. But I must admit, she is the one who showed me a different path.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I had nothing to do, so I trimmed the potted plant on your desk a little. No matter how busy life is, we can't forget our aesthetics. Why are you so surprised? The four arts, flower arrangement, tea ceremony... They were all part of my education. You would never have guessed? Whatever.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The nightscape here is very different from my childhood memories. Lungmen may be advancing by the day, but it still has its unlit corners... How about we go for a drink together? You can't truly know a city until you've visited its streets during the wee hours.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You can't let them see you exhausted, can you…?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You and I have probably crossed paths before, Doctor, but we finally found time for a formal introduction. There'll be much more done on the problems the Infected face in the Lungmen slums, now that we're working in direct communication.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: There are many ways to deal with trouble, and direct confrontation is usually my last choice.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I sometimes attend ceremonies like these just to make things go smoother. I don't remember how many titles I have. But in the end, I always have to return to the shadows.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I know what I'm doing, and that's all that matters. At the end of the day, not all honors need to be made public, and not all roads need to be trod together.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: You tell me your ends, just don't ask me my means.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: If any of you have any doubts about the target, this is your last chance to pull out.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I hope I won't have to explain to you what we mean by 'necessary methods.'

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: It's time to make an example. They'll see what happens when they break the rules.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Say no more.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Watch the shadow behind you.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's put them six feet under.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You didn't think. So this is what happens when you cross the line.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You want to talk? Too late for that.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Give me a reason to let you go. Don't have one? What a pity.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Shatter into pieces.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: It better remain a secret forever.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Clean, decent. No one will ever find their remains.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The situation is still salvageable. Leave the rest to me.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: There is always a way to correct a mistake. Don't let anger get the best of you.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I don't need too much room here, but this place could use some decoration.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You'll need an explanation for what you just did.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Boh loh yau, fresh out of the oven, want one?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. My dad sends out greeting cards to his foreigner friends this time of year. I'm usually the one who writes them. Here, this is for you. You've been pretty busy this year. Good work.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I hope you didn't run into any trouble, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: You think this glass ornament is pretty...? As long as you like it. It's not that hard to make, actually... Anyway, Happy birthday. If you have time tonight, how about I take you out somewhere for dinner? I'll take you to get real Lungmen food, somewhere Swire's ilk would never know.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It's been some time since Rhodes Island and Lungmen first made contact. It took a lot of effort for us to assuage the suspicion we had and build the trust we now share. Fortunately, time has proven that the effort was worth it. Right, I don't like talking about 'trust' per se, but Rhodes Island is an exception.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Coming, coming! Warmy coming in with warmth! Huh...? Sheesh, Doctor! No calling me a little potlid like Lanns!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, do you smell that? Hehe, it's the smell of my sweet pear and vegetables soup, slow cooked to perfection! I said it before, I'm gonna cook the best meals to cure everyone's Oripathy! Huff, huff—It's not so hot anymore. Give it a try, won'tcha? If you don't, everyone else will eat it right up!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island is such a big, biiiig transport, and it has a kinda different furnace than the one at the factory... Oh, I just went to the engine level. The boiler man there thought I was lost and took me back up. I was fine down there, though. I'm used to the heat.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Come, Doctor. Hurry up and eat. No need to worry about me. It cheers me right up to see people enjoying their food. Aw, you still want to share with me? Okay, I'll clean this plate! Om nom nom... Wha? You were just picking out things you don't want to eat? Well alright then.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I made this bracelet from bottle tree leaves. I can keep them fresh for a short while. Hehe, didn't think my Arts could be used like this, did you? Oh, Don't worry, it'll only be for a short while. I won't keep it going for too long, or they'll get tired, too. We should let them be. The withering will come slowly.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Dad liked to collect the carrots we had left to carve into small animals. Doctor, do you think Ray will like this carrot sandbeast? Ah! I think I carved a little too deep. I'm still not very good at this, not like Dad. If only he'd taught me a bit longer...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, look! The lady at Medical gave me a plaster with pears on it! Rhodes Island has so many Infected. It's the same back home, but we didn't live so well. And I had nowhere to go... Doctor, Is it a bad thing to be an Infected?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Deep in the pitch darkness, those warm breaths slowly got colder...' That's how Ray told her sandbeast stories. I've heard the workers saying stuff like that ever since the accident. They were kind of hard to understand at first, but I know what they mean now.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Yeah, it hurts a lot when my Oripathy flares up. And I'm worried I could go out of control, too. Huff... Hufffff... Doctor, want to try a bite of stewed pear? It doesn't cure Oripathy, but it's sweet. When life's all hard and bitter, we need something sweet! Hehe, does it taste good? Alright, I'll take this to Lanns now.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Are you feeling warmer? Have a good sleep now. I'm right here.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to see you again, Doctor. Do you miss Billy stew? I was just heading to the aft kitchen with Lanns— Hey! I'm not a little potlid. Don't call me Potlid!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Whoa... Did you command all these battles, Doctor? You're amazing…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I-I got promoted? Does that mean I can ask Closure to buy some more authentic ingredients?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thanks for your recognition, Doctor! I'll do what I can to bring even more warmth to the people! Um... Actually, what I mean is... I'm glad I can help out!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'm all set.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Huh? I'm the head chef today?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: S-Slow down... Wait for me!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: They're not part of a good breakfast!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm here to help.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Fire up the barbie.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Light and gentle…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: This place feels a little too cool…

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Sparky spark, hop n' jump!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Little flames, shake n' dance!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Roast their tummies!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Shh, it's burning quietly.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Everyone did such a great job... I'll make a big stew to reward them!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hm—Smells so good. Today was another huge success!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We spilled a lot out of the pot. What a shame...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I wasn't paying attention, it's all burnt...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room's so warm… Hm? You can adjust the temperature with this panel?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huff—huff—Didn't burn you, did I?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm not— Okay, if it's what you want to call me, Doctor, then no worries. I am a little potlid.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! Do you want to go up to the deck to watch the fireworks together? Uh... It's not Arts. It's real fireworks. Everybody at Rhodes Island pitched in to make it happen! Shh—Do you hear that?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, are you eating good today?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Lanns and I made you a carrot cake! Oh… You've already got lots of cake from the others? Okay... Yes? You could eat a few slices and share the rest with Amiya and Savage? Haha, That's great! I'll light some candles!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When I was still small, I had so, so many wishes, but Dad only ever wished for me to grow up happily... Now I understand. I need to be happy first, then I'll wait for my other wishes to slowly come true. Doctor, make sure you'll be happy too, during this new year onboard Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I may not be at your side all the time. But don't worry, when you need me, I will be there.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Logistics permits, equipment approvals, mission evaluations... Rhodes Island has too much red tape. While recklessness does tend to get you in trouble, being overcautious also gets on people's nerves. Let's keep it simple. If anything comes up, you tell me directly. I'll decide what to do from there.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I heard the Grandmaster also came to Rhodes Island? Don't worry, I won't pick a fight; but he must be curious if my skills have improved since I left Yumen... Come to think of it, after walking such a long road, he really should be taking it easy. And yet, he still pushes himself into a life of conflict. The same goes for you, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My dad hated the snow. Snow keeps the doors shut, ruining 'business' for his river fort. That's why he gave me this name. 'Qiu' for hatred, 'Bai' for the white of snow. People always find something to blame for their misfortunes: snow, storms, calamities natural or manmade. As for me, I happened to be born on a snowy day, that's all there is to it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've seen some die in vain, some turn to crime, and others drive their friends and loved ones to despair… Justice is rare upon this cruel land, and eking out a living is always difficult. But there is no excuse for evil. Never has been, never will be.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The conflicts I can resolve with my sword are actually the simple ones. Unfortunately, most are as a great river surging forth, sweeping up all the sand and silt in its path until it turns into an unstoppable murky mess. I may encounter more places like that small mountain village. And I can't say for certain that I will do better next time. But good is good, and evil is evil. One may not confuse them, and I will find my own way to distinguish the two.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You'd like me to demonstrate my swordsmanship to the operators? Doctor, it's not something you can learn by watching. I know a scribe who served as the Grandmaster's record keeper. He followed the Grandmaster for over a decade. After years of observation, he could nitpick nearly any kung fu style under Heaven. And yet, he is weak to this day. A stiff breeze could blow him over... Anyway, I do happen to have some spare time. So I'll show you all a few moves.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The sharper the blade, the easier it is to break. The same goes for hatred in one's heart... It's easy to understand. But the hard part is, you must first face that which lies in your heart before you can really let it go. I have both hatred and gratitude toward the Grandmaster. The hatred, I paid back how I saw fit; the gratitude, I will hold as close. That is all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The tumult in Yumen is done, and there's no more reason for me to be there. And the home that I came from is nothing but a river now. In short, I've become the 'one without roots.' But, being rootless is not all bad, as it's led me here to you and Rhodes Island. There will always be a place where my sword comes in handy.  The land under Heaven is vast, and my fate will mark the grave for me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: A rare bit of fine weather, a rare bit of leisure.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I am Qiubai. I can't say for certain how long I will stay at Rhodes Island, but every meeting is a stroke of fortune. I trust we'll get along just fine.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: When I was in Yumen, the Grandmaster would also review recordings of my every battle. For us practitioners of kung fu, having someone to provide feedback is always a good thing.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Why wield a sword? To combat injustice.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I've seen a certain type of fowlbeast in the Gobi to the north of Yan. Their habitat is on the verge of disappearing. So they fly in groups, wet their bodies with water from afar, then bring it back home... If even beasts can go to such an extent, there must be more we can do as people.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I just sharpened my sword.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Very well. Let's walk this path together.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't waste too much energy on the road.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't bother telling me your names.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Within sheath, the sword awaits.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Beyond substance, the spirit unchained.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: A true battlefield. This is the right place to settle things.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Dew falls heavy, grass bends low. Something's not right.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Your hostile intent is all too clear.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: No blade has mercy. Brace yourself!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: And this is your excuse for evil?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't repent to my sword.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Let's go, Doctor. Time to head back.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Even to the very end, I do not know why those people drew their blades... Perhaps, even they did not know themselves.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Let it be. No sword technique is perfect, just as no outcome is flawless. We shouldn't get too fixated on fighting.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Even a technique you have executed a thousand times can fail. Don't focus too much on winning and losing, Doctor, you did what you could.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Were you the one who decorated this room? No, nothing. I am a jianghu wanderer, and we are not picky.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I'll write this off as a little joke. But, next time...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, why don't you come practice the blade with me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: In Yan, even those who struggle the most will find ways to gift clothes to their children on this day, praying for a bountiful harvest in the coming year. No matter where you are, parting with the old and welcoming the new is a good notion. Only by letting go of bygones can we move forward.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, remember to practice your kung fu.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, I recently made a trip back to Yan, and brought this for you... It's just rice wine from the common folk of Jiangnan. It's not meant to be a keepsake. Pop open the seal, and let's share a drink or two.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, I plan to stay here a while longer. The path before Rhodes Island seems long indeed, and I'm curious as to where it will lead. But we all know this land is unpredictable, so just give it our all, and live freely as we can.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Are these the documents you need to mail? Alright, let me check them off.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: There's a letter for you from the Lungmen slums, Doctor. A former patient? Your expression tells me pretty much exactly what's in this letter.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I use this sword to fight beasts that slip into the village, as well as bandits and thieves. For beasts, it's just a matter of driving them away. But people,  it's hard to keep them from going astray.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: There are villages that don't even appear on maps, relying on Messengers to communicate. I used to follow the ones who came to my village around, and even learned my first words from the stuff written on envelopes. But I had to grow up before I learned how much those few words meant.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I once went back to the village where I grew up. All I found was a few abandoned huts and fields. The people who lived there probably found new lives in the cities. But sometimes I wonder, if I had worked harder, would they have stayed?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You know, I haven't been to that many places. I've wandered between the mountains and cities, and seen people suffering from hardship, helplessness, and stress... This is a vast land, but how many people live in its nameless corners from birth to death, with no one ever to know they existed?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The villagers didn't kick me out when they learned I had Oripathy, but still I couldn't go back to my old life. No, getting infected was my own responsibility. It'd be too full of myself to say I got Infected to help people.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm still looking for the young man's family. My words were too harsh... I didn't know his name, even at the very end of it. Superficial as it might have been, he came down for a taste of our harsh lives and recorded it. There's meaning in that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I've seen many people wait at the village entrance, hoping for a letter from their families. I've seen all sorts of emotions on their faces when they opened the letters. Messengers carry little slivers of people's lives. That's got nothing to do with me, and everything too.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: What a beautiful sunset. The weather tomorrow should be fine and clear.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hi there, Are you the Doctor that's in charge here? I heard I could get treatment for Oripathy in exchange for work here... Oh, right, just call me Wind Chimes. It's a name that represents hope.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I'd rather not get into fights while making deliveries...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: All I did was carry out my duties as a Messenger... Anyway, leave it to me if you have a job like that again. I won't let you down.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Many more people are waiting for hopeful news. Doctor, let's walk this path together.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: As long as there's a destination, there's a way.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll make sure everyone arrives safely.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The road is long. Walk slowly.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Get out of the way.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready to go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Bare mountains, dirt n' dust... all familiar sights.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: A long path through tall mountains… Stay alert.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Leave now and I'll act like I never saw you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I never wanted to point this blade at anyone.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: There are people waiting for me.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't keep pushing down the wrong path…

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No matter how far the destination, you will get there one day, as long as you keep moving forward.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I'm happy to bring news of victory, but I would rather avoid conflict like this.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The goods are still here. Let's hope those who ran away will learn and repent.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's rest and regroup. We can take back what we lost later.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's good to have a place to rest.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Careful, I just got back and I'm covered in dust…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy holidays, Doctor. I would love to invite you to villages of my homeland, if there's a chance... We open up the granaries at the end of the year, and celebrate it with spirits that we brewed in the autumn... Scenes like that are rare these days.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Letter for you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. This bowl of chang shou mian is a recipe from my hometown, just drizzle them with some scallion oil, and add some stir-fry... simple to make, but lingers on the tongue. Did you like it? I'm glad. Here's to your good health for another year.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: People who live in the distant corners of the land are often forgotten, but what Rhodes Island is doing has helped many of them. I want to thank you for that, Dr. {@nickname}.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You can keep me in the shadows. My KIA status comes in handy, so no running your mouth about me being here.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: ...I'd put down that tray, if I were you. It's one of W's 'wake-up calls' she makes for all of us. The woman's brain's like those wilds around Kazdel, taken by her overgrown madness by the year. And anyone who trusts a lunatic like her... Heh, is probably just as insane.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: There was one who hoped to flee the war, but only ended up sinking deeper and deeper into its quagmire. Heh, Pathetic, isn't it? But that's exactly how we live. We either give up and resign ourselves to death, or... we kill this very way of life.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Your eyes aren't deceiving you. Yes, it's a sewing kit. A needle drinks as much blood as a sword, in the hands of a merc. Besides… it's a tall order to look decent on battlefield, and a smart cookie like you should know that well, right?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: On the northern side of Kazdel... is a birch forest. Those gray and white trees wither in the frigid wind, then struggle to regain their vitality the following year. But when the last trees died, they had no idea that spring would never come back.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: 'For all the people to fall into peaceful slumber?' Not half bad for a fancy dream of yours. I only hope people could have a chance to struggle on in the face of war and death, and perhaps after that, some energy leftover to hold a grudge. That is why I'm signing this agreement with Babel… with you, Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Those faint lights out the window... They're campfires in the wilderness. W says I like campfires? Hehe, that's because the shadows under the fire don't lie. I see myself in them.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: A merc who lived her life staring death in the face, but chose to die for a pipe dream in the end… Sounds like a bad joke, doesn't it? But if you had to make sense of it, the merc probably hopes her death could be more than a sneaky battlefield tactic. That's all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My eyes tell me that this ship, that doctor, Her Majesty, and you... have all changed. W thinks you're too good of an actor. She doesn't want to admit it, but she's changed a lot too. It's not like there's anything we could do about it anyway. The shadows beneath our feet keep getting longer and longer.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: ...Your dreams are a lot more peaceful than I expected.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ascalon showed you my files. Messenger or mercenary, you ask? Doesn't matter. I'm not after your life for now , 'Doctor.'

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are you sure I need to watch these? Back in Kazdel, you used to lead my people.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Hmph, great. Even in the middle of a war, you people still insist on these goddamned ceremonies.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: For us mercs, life is war, and war is life. The only escape is death. Our struggle will never end, as long as we live.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Getting this crew together wasn't easy. You better make them count.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: W, on my team? Whatever, I'm just wondering what crap she's up to this time.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's see... Which insect is falling into my trap?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The shadows are trembling.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I know what to do. Don't order me around.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Don't keep me waiting.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Picked out your bait yet?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'm listening.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You can't hide your fear.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Nothing can mask the scent of despair.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Better watch your step.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I will sink your corpse into shadow. No one will find it.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You always win, just like the old days. But this time, your joy is real.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Take a breather and tally up your losses. Nothing worth celebrating here, we might be dead in a second or two.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Wow, you kept everyone alive. Congrats.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: ...An arm, an eye, or maybe something else. More than enough to trade for a few enemy heads. Or, would you rather bear the price of failure? Tch, suit yourself.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: 'Rhodes Island'... This landship sure has gotten a lot brighter.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Not the safest way to say hello.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: If you want to make small talk, Hoederer's your guy. Or... I guess you'd rather stand here in silence with me for a while.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: ...A New Year's gathering? Choosing a specific day to get together is basically begging the enemy to ambush you. I... Well, whatever. Tell Hoederer I'm going. I have to keep an eye on W, in case she decides to do something stupid again.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ascalon forced me to take this 'bodyguard' gig. Pick your jaw up off the ground, Doctor. You'll be seeing a lot more of me for a while.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: For us mercs, getting older isn't a thing to celebrate. You pick up more scars, and your value goes down. If there's anything worth celebrating, it's the fact that our victories were able to buy us another year.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You've tied so many different kinds of landmines together, and you can barely keep them from exploding. Now that's something I have to hand to you. Rhodes Island is a whole lot crazier than any band of mercs I've ever known.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Why is this history book only half-written? Because it is waiting to be filled with the wars yet to come. Those Sarkaz who march off to their deaths will be nothing but footnotes. Speak your mind, Doctor. You might just as well leave behind some unique commentary on this segment of history.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I was the one who killed Scout. We made a 'transaction,' then I jammed my sword through his heart. Mercenaries like us could put a price on anything. Hmph, the most unfair part of the deal was that I had to keep on living.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: A pathetic soul looking to crawl up out of the quagmire? Ines is right. Still, when the mire wanted to drag me under, I realized there was no escape. For most Sarkaz, they'd find only hatred-borne victories to swallow when they're hungry for revenge. But I refuse to believe it's the way it should be, and I won't stop finding for us a true path to freedom.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: When I was young, my mother taught me to read and write Sarkaz. I still remember that volume of 'Qui'lon's Expedition' she kept on her, its ink smudged with some guy's blood... She died of Oripathy. As for the book, it's gonna carry our hopes and tears, until time wears it out.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: While I was in prison, I liked to kill time by debating a scholar, an old Feline in the next cell over. Our conversations usually ended with him trying to prove that Victoria was more civilized than Kazdel. Eventually, he failed to prove it before the Sarkaz guards executed him. I should say it's not something I feel happy about.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Most of the Sarkaz history books I collected have been lost. Whether burned to ash or cast aside in action like worthless scraps, their whereabouts hardly piqued anyone else's curiosity. But... for better or for worse, we have other ways to remember history.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: No, it's nothing... Fine, 'Introduction to Accounting Practice,' borrowed it from the library. Ines says that all you need to know to open a shop is how to collect money and give change, and now I'm a little surprised to find out she's right. Well, I won't call this a waste of effort. At the very least...there's no harm in having some idle thoughts.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Can you guess who made these salted potatoes? W, Yeah. Hard to believe, huh? She actually cooks a lot more than Ines does. Try one, they're not bad. Mercenaries are good at taking lives, but there's a limit to one's energy. To hone our craft, we have to set aside everything else.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: What were you like back then? My lips are sealed, Doctor. Oftentimes, getting to forget is a gift. Make no mistake, I'm not suggesting you were a good person or some kind of bastard. People always expect things to 'return to the way they were,' whether it's about circumstances or people. However, amnesia won't give anyone a clean restart of life.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Seems like a lifetime ago...  Only that room with the swaying white curtains is long gone.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: A nostalgic place, Doctor. As for this commission of yours, I trust we can both set aside its details for the moment. I do have some other ideas on the rewards, though, beyond the bounty itself.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Is this your upgraded training regimen? Hmm, it's definitely safer for the masses, but I'd do better with something more direct.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I don't need these, Doctor. But if you insist on some sort of reward... you think I could teach a class to the children here in my free time? No, not to teach military history. I just want to share with them... some Sarkaz folk songs.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Medals and titles give people an illusion of some kind of irreplaceable responsibility. Most times, though, it begets nothing but ruination. That's true for 'elite,' 'leader,' 'king'... and even 'the Lord of Fiends.'

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: If conflict is unavoidable, a swift end is a form of mercy.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I only hope this is temporary. It's not really my thing.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Embers will hide our footsteps.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: ...War never changes.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Don't doubt your own judgment.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Seize the moment.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Order acknowledged.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Same battlefield, different day.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Eyes blind by hatred.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Sense deprived by ember.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The battlefield's all around you. Where do you think you're running?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Enough. Time to end this.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: One great victory isn't enough to tip the balance, but it can buy you a moment of respite. You may catch a breath now.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A single military victory means nothing in the face of what we're putting a stop to. This is just a nuisance we've cleared aside.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Why the long face, Doctor? Our heads are still sitting on our shoulders. As for them, don't worry, I'll take care of that for you.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Less guys on your case isn't such a bad thing, is it?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Ines and W? They're here too?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You… Anything else you want to know?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I don't have time for small talk. If you want fun and games, go look for W. Huh, so I'm not the only one who just got kicked out.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Fireworks at the New Year's party? Looks like you folks are giving W a perfect opportunity to indulge herself. I'll take care of that... and call Ines over too. She has her role to play in times like this, other than staying hidden and enjoying her peace.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Didn't see you there. I was just... thinking about the future.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Most Sarkaz... don't put much stock in the process of getting older. They may forget a lot across the span of their long lives, but if you carefully listen to the bizarre interpretations of life, you'll quickly find that the one thing never missing is the chapter in commemoration of suffering.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Babel was once the utopia of all Sarkaza, a ship sailing through the ruins. Her Highness thought she failed, but you're proof that the road hasn't reached its end. It continues to stretch on... I really hope to see what you'll show us, when all is said and done, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Can I go live in here? I'm not really comfortable having a whole crowd standing around watching me stream, so I'd feel way more at ease in your office... Besides, I'm your assistant now anyway, heehee.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, I got to thinking that the stream incident might not have been a totally bad thing. After all, I got to know so many nice people ready to lend a helping hand, and you too... Shoot! I forgot to turn off my mic–– Yes, and all of you as well! With your support, I'll break out of this funk!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I need to decompress after that stream... Games? Doctor, were you even watching my stream? Chat wouldn't stop making fun of how much I suck. I don't wanna play another game this whole week... And that's why I need to practice every day? Uhh... I guess you have a point there?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Awwgh, it's so frustrating! How come a clip of me tripping over my words gets so many more views than all my VODs combined? I really don't understand viewers these days... Look, Doctor, what's so funny about this compilation of my brain-far—you just laughed, right? You totally laughed just now!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I won an award the first time I did a solo show. Pretty lucky, huh? What, don't believe me? Look right here, 'Awarded to the employee who stayed put until the end of the show during an earthquake'! Getting hit by an earthquake hit during your debut sounds unlucky? Ah-Ahaha...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I used to work my butt off every day so I could make more money, then shop more and shop better. But you know, when I use fancy concealer to hide my eye bags, I sometimes wanna cry... Oh, uh, s-speaking of crying, getting fired from the TV station made me want to cry a lot more.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When I get up there to face my audience, the only advantage I have is the angle of my camera. But you, Doctor... You're the only one who watches my stream in person. You're my most special, and most unique audience. Ahem, it would be even nicer if you tossed a little dono my way~

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hello. You looking for the Doctor? What? No, no bother at all. The Doctor's fast asleep, and I'm just eating some dry instant noodles. Want a chunk?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello everyone, this is your omnipotent streamer, Eure—Errrr, sorry, scratch that. Rhodes Island operator, U-official! Reporting in, Doctor!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Doctor, I'm not gonna sugarcoat it. No matter how many vids like this I watch, I won't learn how to fight.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Go to war? Me?! This has to be a dream…

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: And you're giving me command of the squad to boot? This dream sure is funny, haha...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Well, since this is a dream anyway, I will mop up all the enemies for you!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Bow down before the true master! Wooooo-wata! Scared now?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Heehee, mind sending me the instructions... in a superchat?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your streamer is in perfect condition and ready to go live!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Deep breaths... stay calm…

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Just treat it like a regular stream? I'll try!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ah, ah, mic check! Can everyone hear me?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Let me know what you think in chat!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Next up, time to read the comments!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Dear viewer, for your aggressive behavior, you've been permabaned from the channel! Oh no!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The battle's over, so why haven't I woken up from my dream yet... What? This isn't a dream? Then, how come I'm not hurt at all?!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew, it's finally over... Time to get a good night's sleep. I hope I don't have any more weird dreams about war.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hey you guys running off there, don't forget to tell your friends and family about me. Thank you!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Waahhh… this is the worst ending to a stream I could've imagined…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Can I use this place as the backdrop for my next stream? No? Fine, I'll try someplace else then.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Don't jumpscare me like that! A monster just pushed me into the pit, now I have to do a 'no death run'…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm done streaming, Doctor. Wanna take a walk around the deck?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's Special: Exploring flavor across the lands! Instant noodles inspired by the delicacies of each country! First up is this pack of Kjerag red-braised–– Hey, why's my viewer count dropping?! Don't leave, guys! I was just kidding!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Thanks for letting me stream from your office, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday to you! That's it everyone, I hope all of my friends out there celebrating birthdays today have a gorgeous day! I'm gonna end stream slightly earlier this time, so see you guys tomorrow!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Back in Dossoles, the TV station would throw a year end party, but I never knew these could be so chill until I came to Rhodes Island... Huh? Are you talking to me? You want me to sing? Sure, but just for the record– my musical tastes are pretty old-fashioned.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: If I become your assistant, Closure won't be able to touch me anymore, yes? I'm aware of her extreme interest in me, but her planned modifications on my body are both ridiculous and unacceptable. They're an insult to a scientist, and I won't allow it even in my current form.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Why would humanity grow horns and tails? This stage of biological evolution is past my parameters of understanding... I know tens of thousands of years have passed— Kal'tsit has mentioned this countless times. Hmm, I will need a bit more time to formulate my deduction.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Closure wanted me to sound like a 'thirty-year-old rock band vocalist with a raspy voice,' but my original body was already twice that age... at least, that's what my final memories tell me.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Let's stop here for today, Doctor. I have to go over to Kal'tsit's office. She must be needlessly burning the midnight oil again. A soul, driven by her sheer sense of mission to trudge on for tens of thousands of years, just to stop what exactly? It would be better for her to get more sleep.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, don't look at me the same way you do Castle-3 and the others. They are very... cute. But my robot body is just like your hood, merely a sort of costume... a style. I know who I am, and thus you and I are more alike.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm not arrogant, but I am angry at your ignorance and lack of self-awareness, angry at your self-righteousness, all of you. Yes, I've lost all my knowledge, so you can take this anger as merely a 'result' of my 'calculations,' and a very clear result at that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My wife, daughter, and the rest of my people are eternally resting in those sarcophagi, and will never wake up again. I've made many decisions, I'm well aware. But all I remember is that final dinner, where everyone bid me farewell, and prayed that the subsequent odyssey would go smoothly...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, are you free? I hope you might take me out for a walk.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello there, I am Friston. That's right, just 'Friston,' not 'Friston-3' or whatever. I am not a replica, and very much less a reproduction of a replica. I hope you understand.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This is valuable research material. I shall require a copy for myself.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Doctor, which sector do you need me to take charge of?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Am I to lead everyone and find a new direction...? Very well, I won't let them down this time.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go. This is also a new journey.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Danger detected!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I will relay our combat strategies to THRM-EX and Lancet-2.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I am naturally capable of more than THRM-EX and the others. I will shield them on the front line.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: As long as I'm still standing, no one will come to harm.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I will not fall.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Are you all staring at my expression doodle?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Your behaviors have been recorded and archived.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Where's your leader? I need to talk!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: What a disgrace... these ugly creatures.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, your thinking routines and command style are very much distinct and different from the others... I guess some things never change.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I still remember the duty I bear, but I must admit, I am no longer able to fulfill it, let alone execute it as well as you do. You have my respect, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: An odyssey will always have nigh-avoidable accidents, and a plan might always go wrong. They may be painful to accept... but what else can I do except accept them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: If the worst possible outcome is turning into something like me, then there is nothing to be afraid of. Doctor, you should evacuate first, and leave the rest to me.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I would like to stack all of my borrowed ecological research materials over here. I trust there will be no issues with that?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You should have observed my expression doodle. Currently, it's 'anger'.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I've taken a photo of you, Doctor. You want to see it? Sorry, I've already saved it to my archives.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The point of festivals is to wallow in nostalgia and longing. I wish you happiness, Doctor. It's a pity that I no longer have a past to miss, and no future worth anticipating... Oh? 'Justice Knight,' THRM-EX, what you doing? Doctor, did you call them over?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How do you do, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Now, I would like to use this chance to once again declare the following: Do not celebrate my birthday on the 13th of November, that is the production date of 'Friston-3,' not the birthday of Friston.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I know that Kal'tsit keeps bringing up these 'incidents' I have no recollection of, hoping that I will gradually come to accept them. I understand my current situation, and I will stay with Rhodes Island. But for the future, I hope that I can find the answer myself... and not just through a 'calculation.'

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm, by the way, may I ask who was your previous assistant? No, I'm not snooping or anything. It's just... There's not much I can do for you here, besides offer my quiet thoughts on the occasional poem.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I see what you're hiding behind your back. Be at ease, I know very well that Leithanien needs a citizen to heighten her glory in foreign lands. Kazimierz, on the other hand, needs a scandal-plagued knight of self-professed purity. Both are as plain as day. Besides, that issue of The Red Wine is outdated. Their kinds never run short of personalities to gossip over.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The wind can get very strong up on the decks. Perhaps you should change into something warmer. Me? I'm just dressing this place up as a certain city of greenery and shade in my imagination. The one where the gentle breeze blew from lands unknown, and the blacksmith's rhythmic hammering sounded the passage of time... Those days were brief. So brief, they are worth remembering.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: 'Droste' is my mother's maiden name. It is a common name with no place in the spires. How long would you stay in an alley full of marigolds, Doktor? Very few would grace their proses and stanzas with these forbidden blossoms, but they're really beautiful... To be honest, I'm surprised you actually remembered my full name, Doktor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Poetry is charming as a respite from grammatical convention. It is a search for the most fitting of expressions in the most irrational.  The Candle Knight, who upholds virtue, and Viviana, who loves poetry... I have been a contradiction since the very beginning.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Tales about foreign lands usually end with the traveler returning home. I was always preparing to return to Leithanien, but even after having experienced so much, my truest imp ression of the place remains in the candlelit books on those dark nights. I've seen the people I wanted to see, and I've made my choice.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Look. What is it the candle lights here? Our faces? Lines of poetry that no one reads? Or the dark and mired path ahead of us? I guess you've always been able to see them, even without my candlelight. Right then, rest your eyes upon me. Don't let the light distract your gaze.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I returned to that small, dark chamber in the spire and spoke to the little girl within. I told her that she will endure a lifetime of slander, suffer regrets that cannot be undone, and be trapped in a cycle of endless pursuit and loss… Yes, farewells feel the same as a dream. Do you find me, as I am in this moment, real enough?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: 'If you and I were notes from one stanza, on which instrument are we strung? And what player has us in his hand?' Oh, I knew you would come. Have you finished reading the poems I gave you? Let me guess. I couldn't possibly share the image of your beloved, and it must lie within the most uplifting cantata.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Mein Tag war heiter, glücklich meine Nacht.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Greetings. Margaret told me about you.  It's a shame we didn't have a chance to meet in the Grand Knight Territory… They called me 'The Candle Knight' at the time. You can call me Viviana, Doktor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Watching my own fights through a screen... For a moment, I thought I was still in Kazimierz.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Are you going to grant me a title as well? There's no need for that, but it probably won't matter anyway. This place is no arena.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Can I interpret this as... your hope that I will stay?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I, Viviana Droste, shall wield candle and blade to win victories in your name.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Um, truth be told, the General Chamber of Commerce's spokesmen kept complaining that I didn't care much about my own matches.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let us move. A timely departure paves the way for an early return.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Moonlight barely laid upon the breezy parterre, yet you've witnessed the entirety of autumn?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I listen, to this passing silence.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I wait, for that belated serenity.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This is no arena. No scars will be remembered or awarded.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Leave. This is my last suggestion.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Why obsess over rhymes? Poetry is woven with the thread of ideas.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: 'Pale roses,' pale minds.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Alas, but tying your legs together won't make you fly.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Let time rest upon this unlit night.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Tired already, Doktor? Me too. The last time I had such an unforgettable bout was that match I fought in Kawalerielki.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doktor, you're right. Words that shake one's soul always come from within the storm.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Even the most uninspiring poetry may contain a few lines that tug at our hearts. Despite the regrettable techniques employed, I can't help but approve of the writer's expression.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doktor, accept this temporary lapse in creativity and remember how this moment feels. I'm still looking forward to the completion of this sonnet.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: No bathtub...? Never mind. Just a little joke.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm, who is there? Whatever. I already knew it was you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doktor, if the candle goes out, I can't say for sure what might happen next.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Every year when this day came around, my Father would celebrate the New Year with the nobles of his demesne. And even those who lived close enough would be given favors. It was my only chance to speak loudly in the room. No one paid me any attention, and I paid none to the noisy crowd outside... I was a little girl back then, but I still bear memories of those times.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hmm, Doktor, what are you muttering there? I won't force you to recite any poems. But you have read them, have you not?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Come read with me, Doktor. Ever since I came here, I've rarely found myself so agitated that I couldn't read. Oh, before I forget, If you find any books that interest you, please feel free to take them when you leave. Most of them were gifts from you anyway... Happy birthday, Doktor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: People often say that the era we live in has no need for poetry. They claim it cannot provide leisure, and it is loathed for the pretentious elegance of certain men. But someone once proved to me the value of 'reminders.' And so, I wish to walk with you to remind this era, with a candle, and a poem.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Oh, thank you so much, Doc! Why am I thanking you? Heehee, because you just signed… MY PAID LEAVE APPLICATION!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I used to be a troublemaker for hire. People PAY for my epic pranks. The coalition government, the Singas, True Bolívar. I don't care who I work for. Sometimes, I even work both sides. I take care of one job on my way to one place, and the other on the way back. Jajaja! All that ruckus, it was glorious!!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Here, some corn bugles. Want some? No, no! You can't just throw them in your mouth. Where are your manners? Give me your hand, let me show you. First, you put them on each of your fingertips like that, then—Om! Hehe! Thanks for the food!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You call this a weapon? Hahaha, that's so funny. I call it 'Twirly-twirl.' It's a toy my mama made for me. You can throw it out like this, and then it comes back. What? It's too destructive? That's the fun part.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've been pretty playful ever since I was a kid. I had enough tricks up my sleeve to turn the tables on the bullies, even pulled a few dukats out of them sometimes. I mean, come on, you need a thrill like that to really feel alive. But here you are, working your butt off all day long. Aren't you bored?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Can't hear the rain in here at all.... You know, Doctor, back when I was a kid, rainy days meant I couldn't go out to play. All I could do was stay in mama's workshop, helping her count screws, and listening to the pitter-patter of rain on the sheetmetal roof... But I don't mind days like that. You surprised?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: A Liberi dude who calls himself a hottie, a Vulpo car mechanic who does things his way, and my fellow Bolívarian with the huge appetite. Just where did you find all these fun people? I knew I made the right choice joining you guys.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Before I left home, I had a huge fight with mama, all because I caught Oripathy. I have my ways to keep from being a burden to my family, but mama… she hugged me so tight, she said she'd sell everything in the house to get me treated. I've never wanted to admit it, but I guess my life really is miserable.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You know what 'can soccer' is? It's my favorite game! Just take a can out of the ditch or whatever scrap heap, then play ball. Oye wey! What's that look on your face? We may have been poor, but there was plenty of fun to be had. Don't believe me? Come try for yourself!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: If you're that tired, how about you hand me all your top-secret documents and get some rest?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Caper, or whatever you wanna call me. Just standing here already proves I'm tough enough, right? You're my boss now, so make sure I don't get bored. And be ready for my surprises.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: You saw that move of mine? Hahaha! Their reaction was so funny.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: All the officers I know are so desperate for promotion, they do all kinds of dirty infighting. So I assumed getting promoted had to be super fun. Hmph, turns out it's no big deal.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I guess only my mama would be happy to hear I got promoted... It's all the same to me. But If I get promoted high enough to order you around… Heehee, then my head is full of ideas.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Finally giving me a real fun job?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Alright, everyone, don't overdo it! Of course, that doesn't apply to me!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Come on, come on! Let's go!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Twirly-twirl, it's time to play!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My turn now?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What you waiting for? It's gotta be me!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Think you can catch me? That's hilarious!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: What should I play with you guys?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Go home to your mama!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Watch out—Here comes Twirly-twirl!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Watch me cut your pants to scraps!

lines.title: In Battle 4
