lines.text: Watch me cut all that hair on your head!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That was such a thrill! Can we do it again?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The No.1 rule of playing a master prank—is to be a prank master first, haha!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: That's it? I haven't had enough fun.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, you go on ahead! I'm gonna play with them some more!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Doctor? Where did my luggage go? You didn't hide it, did you? Pff... Hahaha, just messing with you. I ain't got no luggage.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whoa~ Need me to keep what you just did a secret?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Try touching my ear. I promise, no surprises... Sike!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Before, I always had dinner with my mamá on this day. She always got off work earlier than usual to make me these big fat tacos filled with meat. It's only on this day of the year that I get to eat so much meat... Hey, don't just listen. Eat up.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, enough work. Let's play!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Look at you. Is today some kinda special occasion? Hehe, you look so funny when you're disappointed. Alright, here's my gift for you. You can probably figure out what it is, right?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, I'm outta here tomorrow. I really didn't expect to be here for so long, and that I wouldn't ever get tired hanging around you. Rhodes Island's such a fun place. Don't you ever let it get boring. Where am I going next? Haha... A field mission! See ya!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Pages of truth torn and lost, blood of friends spilt and chilled... Will you stop that ever-writing hand, if such scene is in you eyes...? I see. I shall assist you in your undertaking.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Oh... It's dark outside. My apologies, I must have misled you. Rather than having fallen into slumber, I was merely too immersed in reading. You need not wait by my side in such silence. Could you find your own  light? Allow me to illuminate it for you.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: We and the Sami are alike? No, we merely hide among them. Our foresight and the Sami's divination are two pathways to the future, and neither side has fully accepted the other... Worry not, Doctor. The reproach I have suffered is not important. I humbly urge you to facilitate the cooperation between us all.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You seem worried that I'll have a difficult time adapting here. But in my eyes, this metal cave is not at all dissimilar to our dwelling. You perceive the flow of fate via the shadows projected on the cave wall, while we have gazed into labyrinthine darkness since our birth. That is the only difference.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Yes, I am gazing at the Sarkaz tracks beneath your feet, but please do not let this bother you. I shall not be prying into your affairs, for the Cyclopes have long turned their attention away from Kazdel. My cooperation with Rhodes Island looks to the threat from the north, and this is my position within your fate.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Is your interest really piqued by this note? You may read it, by all means. But it cannot foretell one's fate. The shapes that prophecies take are not set in stone, therefore keeping records is forbidden to us. In spite of this, I have written these words and fragments. Please view these as... lies that I must make, no matter the means.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: No, no... Please, do not say that... Typhon's life is unrelated to any prophecies. I saved her in the heat of the moment. She is unaware of the cause, nor is she curious about her fate. And it is my wish to never lay eyes on her future.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The wind pays no heed to where each snowflake falls, as it is plenty accustomed to the sight of melting snow. On the icefileds, it sees the ravines sculped by fate... I ask you to understand us in that way. However... As I gaze at you here, I cannot help but feel a hint of sadness.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: This is all my own choices. I would do whatever it takes to fulfill the prophecy that must be fulfilled, no matter the cost. When the day comes, you may loathe me. And so, allow me to offer you my apologies in advance. Would you perhaps think that... Sorry, please, pay me no heed.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: It is still snowing.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You look the same as I saw you before... Sorry, please pay me no mind. I am a Cyclops from the caverns of the Sami mountains. With the impending darkness in my sight, I seek your cooperation. Please, call me Valarqvin.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: No matter how much you gaze into the past, there are no more possibilities to be seen there.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: My mission will never change, no matter the time. Even so, you would go through the effort to prepare a promotion ceremony for me? You have my thanks.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: A dark fate looms over the lands in silence, only for the occasional flash of lightning to tear it briefly asunder. It is in those moments when the foresighted see. Likewise, it is in those moments that warriors seek to wager their lives.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: As foretold.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: This ray of light may be dim, but I ask all of you to follow it.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Avoid becoming engulfed in snow, as were the fates of many.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I have no intention of setting my eyes on you.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Please accept my advice.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I am here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Please deliver my visions to the masses.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I have received enlightenment.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: May the lightning tear chaos apart.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: May the blizzard cleanse life and death.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: May the mountains prolong our fates.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'We gaze, from the beginning to the end.'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Fate is always heartless.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: With your axe and wit, you have left your mark on the icefield. Now, we can continue our journey forward.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Are you still concerned? Fate will bring back to you the enemies who escaped.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Please... do not stand before me... No, just allow me to take a moment of rest by myself.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I thank you for arranging for me a place of respite. Alas, I am afraid I cannot make use of it often.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh... That's awfully childish of you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: This place… is quiet.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The passage of time is vague in our eyes. To us, perhaps the most distinct unit of measurement, is the length of time between each drip of water in the caves. You think I am not one to celebrate holidays? You are mistaken. Like ice-cold frost water, these moments keep me clear-headed and rouse me from our fate.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: May you advance without hesitation, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: It would be hypocritical of me to offer you my best wishes. On a day like this, we would best take our own paths. May you follow your will and live on. I shall wait for you in the future I see.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A prophecy about Rhodes Island? Doctor, my cooperation with you has lasted for some time now, and my answer to your question remains the same. It is the reason I sought your cooperation in the first place: We see doom often, but we also see what follows in the wake of such doom.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You have to clear all these documents on your desk? Gosh, that's a lot. How about a short break, honey? Tired as you are, a refreshing drink ought to help.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: What would you like to order tonight? Some ribs, maybe fried fowlbeast? I recommend the ribs with red wine, or the fowl with a glass of sparkling water Hm? You want both? Only if you can finish it all, darlin'. I wouldn't want any to go to waste.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I met an interesting guy in Tkaronto who claimed to be the president of the Columbian Chiromancy Association. He was all about palm reading, and insisted on teaching me a thing or two. Unfortunately, I'm not a believer —Why not? Heh. Because for all the nonsense that came out of his mouth, his furry paws didn't have a single crease on them!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Davistown is a mining platform. It gets really cold in winter, but the warmth of its residents kept my diner open for more than a decade. Unfortunately, social ties alone couldn't save the iron mine, and it eventually became a Blacksteel training platform. Well, nothing I can do but wish them well. Hope they don't tip the whole thing into a ditch.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: It's in great condition, but I haven't actually used this weapon much in the past few years. A steak knife is enough to settle a dispute. How? Simple, if it's sharp enough to cut a steak, it's sharp enough to cut other things... Wanna see it in action?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've seen automated mining platforms. I know it's just a matter of time until those industrial monsters phase out Davistown. But I still can't forgive the profiteers. They never give it a second thought how they're selling more than just the platform, it comes with the lives of everyone on it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Something bothering you? Need a drink? I learned what I know out in the Columbian wilds, so my drinks aren't exactly stylish, but they pack a punch... Don't look at me like that, hon. We can just chat if you don't want to drink.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Jessica was so gloomy out on the frontier, but she still worked her hardest, day and night. Poor girl wouldn't even admit she was tired when anybody asked... I'm glad to see she looks so much better now that she's here at Rhodes Island with you by her side—Oh, hold still, hon! Your neck and shoulders are stiff as a board. Of course it's gonna hurt when I press down on them like this.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I made a bet that I could drive us from the frontier to Tkaronto in one night. Wanna come along? You ride shotgun, I'll drive. Either I win, or we'll just park the car somewhere and watch the sunrise, play it like we spent the night chasing the dawn.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, wake up. You'll get a stiff neck if you sleep at your desk. Lay down on the sofa, I already put out a blanket.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Jessica and I are here to get medical help for our infected Pioneers. She talks about you all the time, so I think we'll be good working together.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm… This looks like more trouble than breaking up a fight in the diner...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A company promotion is a wholly new experience for me... thank you, Doctor.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm not trying to protect anything, I just want to experience as much goodness as I can, leaving no regrets behind. But, if someone were here to do badness, I wouldn't hesitate to empty my magazine.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I still prefer the conflicts you can settle with a steak knife.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll assign jobs like I would in the kitchen. Everybody okay with that?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: If you feel nervous, think about what song you want to sing at the party afterwards.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I smell something unpleasant burning.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What kind of 'drink' can I fix you?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Who do you want me to target?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got a clear view here. Hope they don't got the same.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Relax, I'm almost done reloading.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Want a drink? It's on me.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Too bad, I've got you now.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Ready to surrender? No? Sorry about this, then.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Ever stick a hot knife in butter?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Well done, Doctor. This drink is to you.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete, easy peasy.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They're no threat anymore. Just let them wander off into the wilderness.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't worry about me, I'm just covering your retreat. I've seen worse.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Sometimes I miss the days I spent riding a burdenbeast out into the wilds.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Careful, you almost spilled the drink.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Want a slice of this freshly baked meat pie?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I hung up a dartboard in my diner one New Year's Eve. Anybody who beat me could get something on the house, or if they lost they'd to order an extra drink for every extra dart... Wanna guess how quick I sold out of booze that day?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. What can I get you today?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Remember the bet I told you about? That's your birthday present, if you're down for it. But in the meantime... enjoy this glass of 'Wild Sunrise'. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I've been looking around, seeking out all kinds of scenery since I left the city I was born in. There are only two places that have made me consider stopping, Davistown and Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Eh, how come work at the Engineering Department here is even more exhausting than Blacksteel? Good thing I've got some easy paperwork for a change of pace. Lemme start with this one. Umm... Hehe, sorry I bothered you, Doctor. I've got work to do, so I'm heading back to Engineering.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, you should've told me you dropped something behind this shelf. Look at you, wriggling around on the floor all day. Alright, get up. I've got specialized tools I use to carry bulky, heavy engineering equipment. We'll move it aside and grab your stuff. Do you have earplugs, though? It's probably gonna hurt your ears when I tow around this heavy-ass metal shelf...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Be brave, Laura. If you want your work to go smoothly and advance your career, you gotta take the plunge. Think about your future... Think about your dreams... Ah! What are you doing behind me?! I, I'm fine, it's just... I gotta get an injection tomorrow. I'm... I'm trying to get myself ready.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: If you ask me, the most annoying part of engineering projects and experiments is the funding! Even when you get your hands on it, you still have lots to worry about. Everything I do costs money, and every monthly account statement is red as hell, and my budget's always like toilet paper! Speaking of, how much funding can you give me next month? I gotta start planning early.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My whole family lived in a single basement room when we first moved from Bolívar to Columbia. The space under my mother's bed was my first 'engineering lab.' I made lots of weird trinkets there. But I also got smacked just as much, heheh.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The power plant is like the heart of a nomadic plate. During my years in the field with my team, I've basically been its primary physician. Either I'm giving it all I got to recover its pulse, or... I'm pronouncing it dead when there's nothing more I can do.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Hey, hey, Doctor! Down here! Look at me! I've got good news. Our engineering project just had a major breakthrough. Don't stand there like a bump on a log. Come, let's sit down, I'll show you... Oh my gosh, I'm sorry, I forgot to wash my hands. I got a handprint on your coat....

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Nah, don't worry. My kneecap's not hurt. I just have a small crystal there, so I hide it with a band-aid. I know there's no need to hide it here, but I'm used to it. You know, Doctor, sometimes I wonder, If I'd met you guys before Blacksteel... Never mind. We don't have time for what-ifs.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, you give everything you've got, even when there's nothing in it for you, just like Jessica. I'm not nearly as selfless as you guys, but I know when to be grateful. I won't let you down or squander the money and trust you two invested in me. I promise.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Falling asleep right on your desk... and your hair blocking your eyes like that. Hmm, guess I'll leave you this bone-shaped hairpin.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Pleasure to meet ya! I'm the engineer Blacksteel sent here on exchange. Just call me Almond. Are you the Doctor Jessica's always talking about? Let me get a good look at you. Hmm... You seem fine and... Normal, I guess?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Now this is interesting. I never thought you could use engineering machinery like that.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Oh, you shouldn't have. It's all a part of our contract. I'm just doing my job so… Hold on! What did you just say...? Invest · ment?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Aw, come on. you can drop the act. I've worked on so many projects with Rhodes Island's Engineering Department. You're not here just to nitpick, are you?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: You need my tech on the battlefield too? No problem!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I used to lead an engineering team, but now a combat team…? Alright, let's do this. Everyone, listen for the whistle!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Woo! I just got a new idea. Better write it down as soon as the fight's over.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Careful now, 'cause you won't escape once my little friends catch you!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Need me for something?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: You need anything, I'm your girl!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: It's all just like the blueprints. Peerrfect!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Even without a blueprint, I'm adaptable enough to work it out.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: All parameters set. Fire!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Sheesh, why are you so heavy?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Get over here!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Oh shoot, my grappling hook's stuck! Sorry for tripping you!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor! Once we're back, be sure to check my blueprints! I can't just let you go when you've got such a great mind!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Good work, Doctor! Want a cookie? Too tough to chew...? Hmm… I think it's fine…

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I would've liked a more perfect finish, but these results aren't so bad.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Laying down smoke! Doctor, we'd better fall back while the enemy can't see us!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The wiring in this room's terrible. Who did this? I'm gonna sort everything out here line by line.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wai-wai-wait! Don't push! You'll mess up all the cables in my backpack!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: No · touching · my head!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, why you suddenly have three heads...? Now I gotta make four more sets of... uh... ear plugs, for the player that's gonna be your birthday gift...Wha? I had too much to drink? Don't be silly! Franka tried to get me to drink a whole big-ass mug, but I only had a-a teeny tiny little bit!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I'm all set, Doctor. Ready to start working whenever!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! I got you a set of puzzles for your birthday. You'll find out what my present is if you manage to solve it. Sounds like fun, right? Hmm... How come you look like you've figured it out already?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Every day I've spent on Rhodes Island has been very fun, but since I started having fun, it's been hard to get absobed in my work like I did at Blacksteel. Er, how should I put it? Blacksteel feels more like a place for work, while Rhodes Island is more like... hehe, you know, home.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, if you need me for anything, just say the word! You want me to file the documents? Oof, I'm no good with paperwork... How about this, we set work aside and I take you for a spin?  Wink.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, I got the ceiling light fixed. Is it bright enough for you? If you don't need me for anything else, I'll go take care of other stuff. You think all this work is hard on me? I get to make some money, meet new friends, and seize the life I want to live with my own two hands. There's nothing better than this.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Ugh, I hit the wrong note again. Come on, don't laugh at me. Not all Siestans are natural-born musicians. Besides, the kalimba is harder than it looks! You wanna try? Here you go. Alright, Hold it a little further down, and gently pluck it with your thumb... You want me to teach you more later? Oh no, I'm no good at teaching either.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, I found the perfect spot for sunbathing on the deck. It's got a great view. We can set up a parasol there, grab some ice-cold sodas, lounge on some beach chairs, and watch the clouds. When I was a kid, I used to take naps after I was done helping out at the store. Fell asleep listening to the waves like this.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: A police officer taught me these combat techniques. She said that when you run a business, you gotta have a few tricks up your sleeve. Most important is self-defense. Oh, right, she also gave me a membership card. She said it lets me sightsee all around Lungmen. What, You have one, too? What?! And there's no expiration date?!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, look! I marked all the sightseeing destinations on the map. There's the volcano Miss Naumann talked about, and the underground forest on Chuck's postcard. When Rhodes Island passes by these places, I'll be sure to apply for... Aw, darn it, my nose is bleeding again...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Oh, I'm writing Harley back, telling her all about the places I've visited. Can't let'em think I traveled less than Chuck, you know. I used to think about the future very little, and I never thought I'd one day leave the 'White Volcano.' That said, when I made up my mind and said goodbye to the past, the future was already there before my eyes.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: This round little thing isn't a fowlbeast egg. It's a cobble found on the old Siestan beaches. My sister really treasured it, but she gave it to me right before I left. You know, Doctor, ties between people are like the beach. After the tides recede, you find only treasure. My life here at Rhodes Island has made me believe that even more.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I promised Lut and Liv that I'd keep track of all my 'journey experiences' with Rhodes Island. Our adventure team may have disbanded for now, but when I become more mature and when they grow up, I'll definitely take them on this journey of mine.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: One yawn, two yawns... Doctor, why don't I make you a glass of 'Cotton Sunset?' Trust me. You'll find yourself drifting in a fluffy, pillowy dream.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Enis, and I'm formally joining Rhodes Island today. What, a codename? Umm, let me think... How about 'Bryophyta?' I hope I'll get to leave my mark on the mountain rocks and reefs, just like the moss.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I didn't know you could work together in battle like that! Uh, I'm getting a little hungry. I'll go make some popcorn. You want some?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This counts as a promotion, right?  Nice~ I'll write a postcard back to 'White Volcano', and brag all about this to my siblings, heheh. Yeah, I'll have to use a postcard with a picture of Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Elite instructor? You aren't trying to get me to become a kindergarten teacher or a boy scout leader, right? Haha, just kidding. But I've gotten pretty used to life here at Rhodes Island now. Let me keep following you guys to even more distant lands, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Huh? I-I'm heading to the battlefield, too?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: My gosh, you want me to lead the team? It's not the pay I'm worried about. I'm worried I could mess it up!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: It's okay... Relax…

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Gotta give it 200%, better take a coffee mint…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: A capable helping hand? Me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Alright! I'll guard this place well.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Fasten your seatbelts, everyone. I'm starting the meter now.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You want me out of the way? Don't be silly. You can't get inside without tickets.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Fierce winds won't push me back.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Rough seas won't pull me under.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Wildfire won't burn me down.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Who says a logistics operator... can't fight?!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I really thought I wouldn't make it... But looks like we can overcome even the biggest waves when we're working together.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, I did well, right? I'm gonna get some ice cream. You want some, too? Alright, I can give you an extra scoop. Okay, okay, I'll give you two extra scoops.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Uh, I got careless... Hm? I did well enough already...?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Go. Don't worry about me... I've got a lifesaver license, you know.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: If only we had a surfboard here, oof…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Watch out! Phew, that was close... I almost spilled it.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: H-Hold on! Don't look! I'm not done with the lyrics yet! You... want to hear it?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! I'm here to change the water cooler's jug. Why am I still working today? This job's special, you see. I get to run into a lot of people on the first day of the year, and I can wish each of them a happy new year. It's meaningful work, don't you think?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, want to try some Siestan coffee? You can add some tonic water, too.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Be sure to make your wish out loud on this important day. It won't come true if somebody else hears it...? But back when I was still at the 'White Volcano,' it seemed like our wishes were more likely to come true if we yelled them out.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Just like Siesta, I said goodbye to that beach, and just like Rhodes Island, I'm seeking out sights I've never seen before. Doctor, the destination of my journey may still be far away, but the journey itself is already a stack of postcards thick enough for me to look back on, and treasure forever.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I'm putting the flowerpots here. The scent from these clears the mind. It'll help you sift through those documents, guaranteed.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I used to have to collect plant samples for my employer whenever he barked the order. Give me a scarcely-traveled rainforest and I'll head in happy. Thing is, once our specimens started growing in people's hydroponic pots, and then protected areas, and then test farms... Well, that's where the trouble began.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I was in the Convalescent Garden, and I saw the plant almanac Perfumer's compiling. Lots of gaps, no way to fill them in as of yet. See, a good plant hunter fills the blanks with their 'prey.' A great plant hunter not only does that, they also get the author to leave them plenty more new blanks.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I've been to Acahualla plenty. The residents there, Tiacauhs, I believe the name is. They're good people. They'll be frank with you, straight with you. It's just, two things I can't stand: one, they force me to go wrestling when they get drunk, and two, they keep judging my tail... is it really that thin, Doctor? My tail?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: This handsaw was custom-made for me by my mother while I was still in school. Never thought I'd be using it again after I got infected. Thanks to that employer of mine, hiring plant hunters. He let me continue doing what I loved... even if he's the same bloke who fired me out of paranoia in the end.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, this is the plant that got me fired. No monetary value, so you can imagine... I told my boss I forsook my assigned target for this bit of shrubbery, and he thinks I'm having him on somehow... But listen. I discovered this 'un. I gave it its name. And nothing could matter more than that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: To make a 'scarecrow,' you need a whole lot more than just straw. You also need a variety of tough, poisonous, and insect-eating plants, Originium Arts, as well as my dad's techniques to sew everything together... Tch, leaked my trade secrets again. Doctor, remember not to tell anyone.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You're right, I am in fact used to keeping a cold, stoic persona in front of strangers. After all, your average plant hunter doesn't usually get into interpersonal conflict with a standing army. It's more often absent-minded guards with fixed salaries. Overpowering your opposition by putting on airs can actually ensure your safety, funny enough.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, this is my very first time making a 'Scarecrow' for someone else. What d'you think? Uncanny resemblance, right? If danger's ever afoot, this can help—oi, slow down, don't touch those vines, else they'll—Hrm. It'll let go of your arm naturally after a short while. Trust me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You were just trying to chat with me and I wasn't responding? Ooh, um, see, I was DEFINITELY, NOT using a 'Scarecrow', tooooo skive off work. Honest.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I need a job, and being a pharmaceutical company, surely Rhodes Island won't turn down an experienced plant hunter. And the plant hunter in question is none other than... Y'what? I just need to sign here, that's it? No fibs?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hang on! I think I saw a very rare shrub. Might even be a new species! Where was this video taken?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: There's a beautiful medal... but the design's a bit dull. You considered adding some plant motifs to it?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Never mind contending with people. I prefer exploring the wilderness, delving into the rainforest, living among the plants... Want to come along with me next time, Doctor?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Can we settle disputes some other way that's not direct conflict?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: All I can assure you is everyone returns safe. I cannot guarantee victory like the others can. Are you SURE you want me as squad leader?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: If this conflict truly is necessary, I suppose there's no way around it.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Good bit of bravery in you to stand as my enemy.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Chop-chop with the orders. I'll make 'em regret showing their faces.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Chop-chop with the orders? I can see them coming...

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Dead branches and rotten leaves! I'll sweep up in no time, just you watch.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Bunch of ten-a-penny weeds. Nothing I'm interested in.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The harder on the outside, the softer on the inside.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Plant looks risky, who can tell. Plant looks safe, you're in for hell.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Never assume the simple days will last.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: ...Uh-oh. Time I dropped a 'Scarecrow'!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I never thought I'd be getting the best of that vicious an enemy... At this rate, you think we could be off somewhere more dangerous for sample-collecting?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: There we go, enemies dealt with, now we can show ourselves the door and leave.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A few of 'em got away... They're not coming back, are they?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Stay alive, Doctor. You won't have a future to count on otherwise.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: If I want to help improve Rhodes Island's plant diversity, where do I apply?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: If you can't tell the difference between me and a 'Scarecrow,' I think the vines might've poisoned you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hmm... Where should I go to collect samples next time?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: As you can see, I'm giving a Scarecrow a new change of clothes. Back in my quiet little hometown, families would all give their scarecrows a fresh bit of kit at the start of each year... Not sure what the cultural significance of that was, but the most important thing is, don't let the fowlbeasts get too used to seeing the same getup. Fowls, they're smart little buggers.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor. I watered the flowers in your office for you.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've been thinking for a long time about what to give you, and finally decided I'd let you choose yourself. Here, take a seed from my palm, any seed. Plant it, and see what kind of flowers you get blooming eventually.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When I observe plants in the wild, sometimes I'll think, what if the ones that live for hundreds or thousands of years sense the passage of time too? How long would their experience of one year be...? Whatever it is, I'm sure it's not like mine. It always feels like each year passes by in a flash.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: That's a huge stack of documents... I can lend you a hand if you're struggling to clear them, Doctor… Oh, sorry. I should be on standby waiting for your request.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hildegard doesn't care how Leithanians think of her, and I'm not some civil servant mincing words for her. It's just that we've been together for a long time now, so I'm able to stand in for her on unofficial occasions, to speak words she's not at liberty to speak, or meet people unsuitable for her to see.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: That must have been Federico earlier... He's also the type to think of normal conversation as stepping on glass. But once you know them long enough, you'll be able to understand what they're perplexed with, or what they're chasing after. My advice? Get used to awkward silence.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I just heard some people discussing my age, but I don't see the issue, really. I met a sickly fellow in Zwillingstürme. He was younger than me by a few months, but he's skating on thin ice every day due to his status as Graf... Well, at least I don't have to worry about my own safety like that.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: 'Wolfgang, everything you say and do will affect Wulfsburg's future.' That's what I told myself back then. My life is my answer sheet, which I keep neat. But the problem is... maybe not everything has to be treated as an exam... Um, I still seem tense, even now?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you for your concern, but I don't mind Hildegard's disappearance at all. She told me the enclosure of war was built so that it could be torn down in the future without any worries. She must have been somewhat aware of it that day, but she still... Anyway, my mission isn't over yet, and I remain her envoy still.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, why are fowlbeasts unable to touch the stars no matter how far they fly? Uh, no, I'm just used to breaking the silence when it gets too quiet. Please pay me no heed. I don't think the answer's that important...? It's because they can't even fly right when they're... Ahem, seeing stars.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Didn't I soundproof the room with Arts...? This castanet? It's a gift from Lieselotte, given during my first audience with her. When I was living in the Spire, I would kick it at the books in my room. Knocking them down one by one, then put them back before the sun came up. It's normal for me to be childish at my age, isn't it?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You two are so similar... Sorry for disturbing you with my sudden words, Doctor... I was just thinking about how you and Hildegard are so alike. Both of you shoulder so many responsibilities in silence, and I can't tell when to step in. Can I help you? Or... can you help me?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: My tuba? Of course I can play it... Speaking of which, can you play the piano? Can you practice with me when you're free?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, I am here at the behest of Empress Hildegard of Leithanien, and I hope to maintain friendly relations with you. I can act as a your Messenger, and perform music for you as well.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I've already seen this... Hold on, I have some old recordings of the annual Kaiserinnensfest. Would you like to watch them together with me?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Phew... Seems like I haven't disappointed you. Uh, Doctor. Should I be acting more nonchalant about this?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Mm... I'm glad to have met your expectations.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll follow your baton for the time being.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I knew you were too lazy to show up, so I went to run some errands... I'm very much used to this.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: A music score or a battle plan—you have to give me one of those at least.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hm. Dissonances.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Opening with a tuba? A rare arrangement.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Am I the only tuba in your band?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll warm up my fingers first.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll join in the performance at the right section.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Can you hear it, the restorative vigor of that fortissimo?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Can you feel it, the melodious emotions of that pianissimo?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: A shrill howl? That's what happens when you mess up while performing.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Out of my way, or I'll shove your head up this tuba.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: While the tuba is one of the most difficult instruments to play, I'm sure I'll get somewhat proficient at it in time. But you, you seem like a musician who was born proficient with all kinds of instruments... Life is so unfair.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Your ingenuity put to shame any conductor I've seen.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: How does one keep their musicality in tip-top shape? Practice. A flawed performance simply means you haven't practiced enough.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Did we fail? I don't think so. People like you usually factor failure into your plans, yes?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The soundproofing here should be decent...?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ahh... you gave me a fright.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, I'm just about to replace the bell on my tuba. Can you lend me a hand?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The new year was just a month away when I left Wulfsburg. They said we had to hurry to meet Their Majesties, so that we could make it to the annual celebration in Zwillingstürme. I was practicing the whole way, but... I really liked that piece.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Are you resting well, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Your seat is here. Yes, right here, in the center of the front row. Miss Orchid had me arrange an ensemble with the children of Rhodes Island, and, um, I'm one of the performers myself... No, this is not a birthday gift, but I'd like your opinions on the performance.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The annual Empresses' Celebration is always a stunning event. The Royal Orchestra performs for the people, and it closes with a grand ensemble with Their Majesties on the covered bridge. The main reason we hold it every year is to make everyone believe in the path beneath their feet. Rhodes Island doesn't have celebrations as grand as that, but your footsteps are still full of conviction.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Be at ease. I won't let another assassin do his work right in front of me, ever again.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: There's nothing that can derail the historical trajectory of Victoria, not even Theresis, or even the dukes. It's nothing but different people taking turns to wallow in the same puddle of mud. You want my honest opinion? Heh. Stay back, lest you get mud splashed on you.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I lived with Mum for a long time when she was stationed on the border all year round, and the towers of Londinium were never in sight... I never so much as asked her. Just what it was that made her so willing to toil away all those years, out on the border?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Say. I hear Her Royal Highness Alexandrina is continuing to gather more supporters? Very well... Sooner or later, Vina will have to face the same choice as I did. Though all told, taking off a crown invites far more obstacles than giving up a dukedom. If you get the chance, do tell her I wish her all the best.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The sword brandished and never sheathed is the sword of the weak. Even though my mum taught me swordplay from a young age, more than anything, she made me practice the art of stowing my blade. If I'm to inherit her position, then I can't be daggers drawn for most issues that greet me... And just knowing that chafes.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: 'Self-evident?' 'Just?' Great nobles in their ivory towers, engaging in nefarious deeds so that their country endures and prospers, is that self-evident? The starving Infected robbing the innocent in a desperate attempt to live another day, is that just? These are questions I won't give up on finding the answers to.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island has shown its sincerity to me, so even though she's... no longer with us, our deal still stands true. Of course, this is as long as you don't mind my currently utterly powerless status, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Did you find these... at the video shop? I actually picked these out just for Baird, but she never gave them the time of day, saying they were just so noisy... They're useless now, so you can have them. These are some of Wrankwood's must-watch comedy classics.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: There's countless scenarios I've thought of to prevent my mum from being assassinated, and always, always, the result is the same... She was so strong, she never had a need to question her own decisions. Tears? Hah, you must be mistaken, Doctor. I learned long ago to never cry.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You can rest easy, I'll be here. There aren't many chances to take a nap on the battlefield.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: We can save each other the trouble of introducing ourselves, and I'll treat this contract as a token of you approving how we cooperate. Can I get back to work now, Doctor?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This battle record is a five out of five. It's as good as the Wrankwood action blockbusters I used to watch at the video shop.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Interesting. A 'medical organization,' employing a standard military promotion system...? Hmm. I can already see certain people getting their just desserts for underestimating you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: A higher position often means taking more responsibilities, but I'm sick of people in those positions using responsibility as a shield for their own selfishness, so I hope things will be different here. In any case, our partnership has at least for now, taken another step forward.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll cooperate at all times.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll make sure everyone on the squad is safe.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Bury the habit of fighting each to your own!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Survey the terrain, and clear out those despicables in hiding.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hesitancy is forbidden on the battlefield!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: May I draw my sword now?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: A radical strategy, but I can work with it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Judge by appearance, and suffer the consequences.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Do not disregard me!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You picked the wrong foe!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: A fine opportunity.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: No need to hold back.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That was some clean commanding. We have a bit of time before our mission is estimated to end, so you should grab the chance to think about how to reward yourself.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A reasonable result. I'd doubt your ability to achieve your ambitions, if coping with this was beyond you.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: It's not for us to leave without regrets, Doctor... Let's accept reality.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Am I... still not good enough?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This style... it fits my impression of you.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: That's rude.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Want some canned food? The sugar will get you fat though.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor... Um, everyone's asking me to attend the party? I used to spend the day with just Mum, so I don't know... Never mind, I have nothing else to do today anyway, so let's go, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: It's been a while, Doctor. Ready to move out?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I took this photo from someplace high up while on a certain trip. Can you tell who these people are fighting for, when they've been reduced to dots? Perhaps you've never seen the land of Victoria from such a perspective, so who knows just what ideas you might have. No need to tell me though. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: We were all there when that happened out of the blue... Even now I still can't forget just how powerless I felt then. Such occasions will only happen even more often, as you get more and more factions watching you. Can you still persevere on, even when facing an unstoppable disaster?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Induct yourself an adjutant, one you can trust, and secretarial busywork will never hound you again. Between ourselves, that's an industry secret. Steady, Doctor, I would be loath to suggest you induct me...!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hip-hip to Rhodes Island's young generation. They can fight and they can imbibe, my goodness. But youth's folly is ignorance, you see: they don't know all's fair in love and war, they never caught me diluting my drink! Bah-hah-hah-hah-, my head... Doctor, if you'd hurry. Fetch me a sobering physic.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hah, what talent General Hellagur's girl possesses! I'd gladly have the youths here make a friend of her sometime. All the while my daughter plays the contrarian, but she at least heeds her father's wise words. Hm? To speak of which, Doctor, that letter you're holding... Excuse me? Incorrect address? Returned to sender?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Good girl, no fear, just a little more... Doctor! Yes, like that, stroke the girl on the neck there, softly, gently, let her know you're there for her, you love her... well done, girl, now push! I see the child coming! It's a stupendous little burdenbeast lad!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Will! Charles! Funny business, they've vanished. What? They're off playing drinking games again? They had the nerve not to invite me...?! So be it, let them drink. All the years they've been company to me, the old fellows, and what have they gained? A riddling of scars and chronic pains, too pernicious for me to cure. How can I blame them, now they've so little but tipple for pastime.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: War stories? No, no, no, a richness of topics I could be your partner in. Why one of such sensitive dearth? I've said my piece on it—the battlefield lingers in your Sunday lapel like a bad odor, and never comes clean even should you change your suit. No, what say we talk of something else, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I've partaken of fine foods across the land, but in my lowly opinion, only in the bosom of hometown, amidst the throng of locals, can you taste the most essential delicacy. This fondue tells such a tale. You'd like a travel guide from me? Hah-hah, very well, as you wish. To be asked for a work so dear to my passions is my honor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You have a most vorpal gaze to recognize this pipe's Gaulish make. It was seized by my father's commander in the Battle of the Four Emperors, a spoil accorded to my father, then—bless his resting soul—it was handed down to me. Some decades it's spent crossing the fields of war. You'll even note the lost segment along the shank, much as I've lost a leg.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Hush, Doctor. We shouldn't forget that I'm an officer to Victoria when all is said and done. Befriend me you may, and depend on me, but never should you drop your guard, nor tell me too much. Should the worst come to pass, it would spell the end of our continued association... and with my age, I'd fold under the regret.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Don't watch your health now, and you'll certainly curse yourself when you're old.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Here I thought they'd finally given me hard labor on the borders, and yet... I wonder if the Empire's deigning to smile on me? Oh, where are my manners? You, then, should be my commanding officer from hereon? I render you my services as a plain medical officer.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Combat that would emphasize the individual's strengths... What revelation.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Could it be? Is this in recognition of my surgeon's abilities? This means far more to me than a higher title ever could.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I feel I could return home and open a practice right this instant. In fact, I plan to be off on the morrow. Hoh-hoh, yes, I'm pulling your leg. I tell you, I could have found no greater place than here to retire.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Me? Surely I'm not about to be an accomplice in your sunbathing schemes?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Attention, good fellows. Your only obliged consideration is how you survive. Agreed?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Good fellows, let us think of happier things. If I may: how about something nice to eat after this operation?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Be a little courteous to our guests, boys and girls.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: At your service.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I trust your plans are drawn.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Great minds think alike.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: What fine scenery. A shame about the fighting.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Fall in! I hereby command!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: No soldier may cower in the field!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: All casualties, retreat! All others, cover!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I say this once, protect your own lives first! I'll bear the onus!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Outstanding peace talks! As I always say—bloodshed can spoil anything. Best we remain amicable.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I see I'm deprived of a chance to practice my surgery! A marvelous regret to have.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You say I've 'held back', do you? Hah-hah-hah, piffle! Don't you worry.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: To admit our own defeat is a form of virtue.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Mm-hrmm. Doctor, your tastes are... comparatively maverick.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh? Are you angling to swipe my cane?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh, Doctor! Would you care to take a stroll with me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Goodness, how saintly is our Doctor that you would worry I be devoid of companionship, let alone ask after me? Hah-hah-hah, but a Happy New Year. Yes, lest I forget, my family chances to trip to Rhodes Island in a couple of days, and I'd be remiss to not personally invite you to our household dinner.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Tally-ho, Doctor. Your presence suggests today will be a fine day indeed.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Every soul who celebrates a birthday reminds me of my girl's younger years. War had me miss several of her special occasions, and as is the case, she came not to care if I'd be there or not. I do apologize—with my age, I do reminisce at the drop of a hat. Now, how should we divvy up this cake?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Being of two different stations, some things I can't tell you, nor you me. But there is one point we needn't doubt—we are both fed up with war. I imagine that's more than enough reason we might sit down together, open and honest, and share a drink.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: There are some matters I could help you with. But make no mistake, I am not a go-between for you and Enciodes.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I once ran into the Saintess at the foot of the mountain, where she stuffed a book into my hands. She told me that, if I'm bored, I might as well try copying some scripture. I heeded her suggestion and copied a passage every day. At first, I did it just to pass the time, but then I realized it helps me to relax a little too. I find it intriguing.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Leithanien, Kazimierz, Kjerag. Three decades, more or less. The days I spent in Kjerag were the most dull. No opponents, no challenges, no excitement... But before I knew it, I had become accustomed to the bleats of burdenbeasts, the sensation of shoes sinking into the snow, and the weight of a little sobering medicine on me.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The first time I became champion was to prove myself. The second time was to hone myself. And the third was a wake up call I made to those who thought they could control me. The price I paid for it? Just a few Darksteel arrows. Hmph, a pity I didn't get an actual match.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I saw the Radiant Knight. No, there's no point in fighting here, so you need not arrange one for me. A proper fight needs her at her peak, at the right time, in the right place, and situation. Victory then will be a matter of life and death. Though, how or when that moment will come won't be up to me at all.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Enciodes treats me like a sword—a sword intended to reflect more than kill, a blade serving as a mirror with which to scrutinize himself. The stronger I get, the more he exercises restraint. Such a relationship will continue until the day... he no longer needs a sword.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I went back to Leithanien once, after becoming champion. From 'a defective Leithanian unable to use Arts', to 'a natural-born warrior', only to still find myself unwelcome. The locals looked at me the same as they did decades earlier. Coming to terms with that, I found my hatred for the land had cooled some.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: A few years ago in Kjerag, I was dining at a local restaurant I frequented where some foreign tourists tried to pick a fight with me. Before I could get a word in, the shop owner grabbed me by the arm and shouted to them, 'What are you punks doing?! Get away from our Kjerag lady!' I'll never forget that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: There are many who rely on you and Enciodes to provide them a meaningful way of life, and you relish it just as he does. But for me, I've just met another patron who engages in self-neglect. Right then, the meeting's about to begin. Drink this glass of water to refresh yourself. And hold still, your collar's wrinkled.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sleep. No one will bother you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Degenbrecher. A codename? You can just use that. I looked through the contract, and the scope of my work seems unchanged. I am still a bodyguard, just the employer is different.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Not bad.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Formalities like these remind me of the time when Karlan Trade was first established. Gnosis was so full of himself as he declared my position to the others. It was then that I decided to wait for a chance... to smash that cocky face of his to the ground.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: When I pinned the medals on my soldiers, the first cohort of Tschäggättä to complete my training, I saw some pretty fine expressions on them. I can see this ship has many with similar faces.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Is this a mission, or a training session?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Follow me close, no dinner for those who fall behind.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Good, I suppose you've already got a plan.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Keep your distance, or you risk getting caught up in the fighting.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Still mulling things over, Dr. Perfectionist?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: You want my opinion?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: How soon do you want them gone?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You can go do something else.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Emotion is meaningless here.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Conviction will throw you off pace.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Still soaking yourself in the past?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Use your weapon to tell me who you are.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Whenever there's an avalanche in Kjerag, I always free my schedule to test my skills there. It's a rare form of recreation for me. Apparently, Rhodes Island won't be dull in that respect, at the very least.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Your face just now... it seems the expression 'fowls of a feather flock together' is indeed true.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I let a few get away, as you bid me. What next?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Hold my hand tight, and your breath with it. What comes next might be a little disorienting, but press on.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: We have to use codenames here? That's obnoxious.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You'll need to try a little harder if you want to pick up my degenbrecher.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Here. You left this file in the meeting room. It's fine, I'm used to doing this.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a bit too warm, compared to Kjerag, be it the temperature or the extent of enthusiasm here. I'm far more used to spending the cold winter indoors, partaking of some home-cooking together with a few faces I was tired of seeing. But maybe... maybe it's time I adapted to the ambience here.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, you know how busy your schedule is today, yes?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've forgotten my birthday, just as I'll soon forget my own name. But that's not important. You can take Degenbrecher as my name, and if I can recall the day I took it, you can also call that my birthday. Now back on topic. Will you manage to open all the presents here today?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I used to have my doubts about Rhodes Island, same as I used to distrust a certain someone's nonsense when I started working for him. But as we all know, Karlan Trade built the Kjerag we see today, and Rhodes Island will keep treating Oripathy patients tomorrow. Alright, I've been watching the gates of Karlan Trade for a long time. Keeping an eye open for you Rhodes Islanders is no trouble.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: This animal almanac's a beauty. Right, from the bookshelves. I've washed my hands, so the pages'll be fine... Yeah, this is your office. Something wrong?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I hear explosions. One min, I'll head down to check. Exhaust fans sound normal, then next is... No, right. Forgot I'm riding with Rhodes Island now. You don't get Originium slugs in the pipes here. Um... Must be Engineering running weapon tests. Sorry about that, breaking your door down.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You can tell how the air's doing from a sandbeast's back, so that's why you see pitsinkers bring one down. If there's poison and it keels over... you buy a new one. But this one wasn't from the shop. I don't even own it, so I don't keep it on a leash.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Tales of the supernatural, these tapes said. Didn't really like watching them, but I do feel... Chills, from these? No. It's hot in the dark. The deeper down the pit, the hotter, harder to breathe. Always took yonks for the lift to bring us back up. I'd just stare at the lights in the ceiling, waiting.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Got shooed out of the workshop by Lanns. She wasn't pissed though, just hauled me along to a doctor, then had me on Potlid-watching duty. And watching I love my own body more... That day she asked me what life was like catching Oripathy. But all that came to mind was being down in the pit, staring at the Infected creatures and thinking, 'we're more alike now.'

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Proactive? Is this about me applying to rescue Infected...? Remember when you had me treat my wounds? So I have my cotton wads, and they're getting covered in bloodstains, and dust, and Originium shards, and sandbeast fur, and it struck me then: the pit's behind me, a million miles behind, and it's like I'm still being stabbed. Do you think I'm... still carrying the fear?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Ninety-seven, ninety-eight... Oh, first time seeing you at the training grounds. You always train at four in the morning too? That's not it? An op said I scared them target practicing here all night...?  But the light went kaput in my accommodation. I wanted to be somewhere lit-up.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I think Amiya's being nice to me. Hiding something and she won't tell me what. But it does occur to me, you know. The giant shadow I saw in a sandstorm as a kid. I might've mistook it. But it's always occurred to me... Doctor, give her these carrot pies for me, would you? She's always so busy and all, I want to be nice back, and care for her.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I've given it some thought. Hijacking Rhodes Island sounds unideal, but dragging you off might leave the whole ship out of order... Hm? Oh, it's just there's some great tales in your database. A few I wanna see with my own eyes, and it'd be nice if you come with. That's the new goal I found. What's wrong?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: No scratching, you'll wake the Doctor. C'mon, let's go walkies on the deck.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I passed the Operator tests, Doctor, so thanks for all of you inviting me. That whole chase is over with, but I'm thinking I'll find my new goal on this ship.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: That's not danger I can cope with yet.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You know, they wanted to certify me for my professional skills before. Gloompincer made off with the paper that time. Lost to the mineshaft depths... Anyway, there's a few extra things I can do. What's this ship need?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: If that tiny patch of sky opened wide... wouldn't people want to chase the sun and the moons?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Here, Sandbeast, we need to get going.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll take the very front, as always.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Sound of muddy air, tracks of animal... I'll keep a watch that way.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Fine visibility. I can see more than just danger.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Got my bolts kitted.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Point where I'm cleaning up?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Yeah, you'll hear from me as needed.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You lot stay up there if it gets risky.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Threat at my position—yeah, not anymore soon.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I'm hearing movement.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: And that's as far as you go.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'm done rambling in the dark.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Sun's out. What a beauty… Sandbeast, let's get home.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: This area's clear of danger for now. Doctor, you always been like this? Any problem, you'll solve it?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We'll have to expand the mine out... Hold the treatment for now. Got a lurking threat to handle.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: You all leg it. Comms might cut out. If things get grim, I'll leave the most discernible signs I can.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Ship's sailing on sandstone… That's strange. Like I've heard it somewhere before?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Was I not meant to dodge that? Okay, I'll stay put. You tap me again.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Sandbeasts with arcing backs like this should be living in the desert... Wonder why this bugger came with me? Here, got you new food to try.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Short-term disembarkment application. Rhodes Island stopping over here's a perfect place to hunt some sandbeast food. I'll be gone half a day. Offices are deserted—lucky I ran into you... Yeah, it is New Year's today, Happy New Year. So?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Weather's fine outside. No dust cloud, and not a Catastrophe billow in sight.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday to you, Doctor. Made you this cake. And here's that giant sandbeast print I photoed... Why didn't you think I'd come? I'm your friend. I'd make you sad forgetting your birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A 'pipe dream'... that's how I hear some people describe Rhodes Island. My destination's nothing like this ship's, night and day, to be honest. But I've gotten up close and personal with my own dream thanks to you all, and I'm sure you can make yours come true. I know it.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I've arranged the incoming documents just the way you like them, and added a few labels for categorization. Feel free to use them to find what you need. If only my master was so organized... Oh, it's nothing, just an idle musing.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Wait, there's a bug on your collar. Don't worry, it's a green lacewing, a helpful sort. They hunt the pests that eat our crops. Look at the wings on this cute little guy, the color of jade. Really beautiful... My master always jokes that if I didn't become a farmer, I could've been an entomologist.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Low clouds bring rain, high clouds bring fair skies.' See that cloud down by the horizon? That's a cumulus... The proverbs may not always be right, but they do have reference value. Using that one, you predict that tomorrow will be clear, but with strong winds and lightning? You might be a Catastrophologist, but just how did you come to that conclusion?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I've read that 'Tianshi' means 'to be a role model for the generations to come, and to search for perpetual truth.' I used to think I could never live up to that, but after seeing some of my seniors befuddled from time to time... Maybe I've been overthinking it. There may be a saying more suitable for me: 'Focus on your search, and learn for the sake of the people'.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I once challenged myself to a fast, but I ended up fainting on the fourth day. Still, my master said this was not true hunger. I didn't know what it was like to go hungry for years on end, so I could not possibly understand. I hope there comes a time when no one has to know that feeling.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've gotten tanned again, you say? No big deal, every farmer worth his salt ends up dark as a chestnut. So long as we accomplish our goal, so long as we see our  crops prosper in the contaminated soil, and the hard work of so many bears fruit, then it's all good. Me? I don't need to be there to see it. If the people keep walking the right path, that's enough for me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Oh, did you need me for something? Just a second, I need to braid my hair again. When I was younger, I grew out this 'rice stalk braid' as a prayer for peace. Now I spend a lot of time managing it every day. Back then, Grain Buds always thought I was a girl thanks to this braid...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The crops grown in Dahuang have a much better texture and taste than others. If you get a chance, I'd love to show you about the city. You wonder if they could supply Rhodes Island with food? Um, that's a little... I-I'm afraid that you'll need to discuss that with the proper authorities. It's not up to me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: These seeds occasionally fall onto the ship. Oftentimes I gather them up and wait like this on the solid ground, closing my eyes and feeling which way the wind is blowing. There, once the breeze rises, I let them go, and those seeds find someplace to take root all on their own.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: The wind rises...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Why am I called 'Wanqing'? It's one of the breeds of rice that my master cultivated in Dahuang. Others include Fanglao #3, the waterlogging-resilient one, Zaoyou #8, the quick-ripening one, and Kangdong #11, the frost-resistant one... 'Wanqing' means wide, and it sounds the most like a proper name.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Everyone looks so well-mannered around here, it's hard to imagine that they're so fierce in battle...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: The rating standards of the Tianshi Bureaus seem to stipulate that you can use evaluations from exchange visits in their assessments... Excuse me Doctor, is Rhodes Island able to provide an officially-stamped study visit certificate?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I've consulted with my master. As long as Rhodes Island agrees to sign a contract of cooperation with the Tianshi Bureaus, I'll get to offer my assistance as an advisor on experimental crop fields. We both do what we can for the sake of the many, and we'd be delighted to support your goals.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Initial environmental survey completed. Nothing abnormal. We're good to go.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I hope everyone takes my commands seriously. Let’s get this done right.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: If we cross any farmland, watch where you step.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'm a student of the Tianshi Bureaus. I won't hold you back.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here! Er, I mean I'm in position.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Tell me what you require, and I will deliver.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I've finished construction of the refinement system. Deployment point confirmed.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: We're in a complex environment. Don't go off on your own or you might get disoriented.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: With the aid of the wind, we too can soar through the skies.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Watch your step, don't hurt the crops.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The landscape here is tricky. Only step where I step.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Until we can confirm that this area is safe, I will hold this position.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ensuring the harvest isn't easy. I hope to pass on the torch of our ideals.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Just as the farms never rest, there will always be new growth from the ground, and there will always be those who wish to follow in our footsteps.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Let's try that one again. The tiniest oversight leads to different experimental outcomes, and you can't let an error cloud your conclusions.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Success is the fruit of a thousand failures. Experiments under the Tianshi Bureaus are the same. Don't be discouraged, Doctor.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Ever since I got here, there haven't been any leftovers? Of course. Waste not, want not.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Who—Ah, my braid hit you? I am truly sorry...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I reassemble my Tianshi apparatus while I wait for my experiments to finish. My record is twelve seconds. Would you like to try?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The poems I read when I was little always compared winter snow to a thick blanket. The seedlings sleep beneath the snows, ready to welcome the spring days with new life. Dahuang is always busy this time of year. People my age go to the frozen rivers and throw firecrackers at the frost while covering their ears. Grain Buds always shouts the loudest. Would you like to give it a try?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, I'm pretty sure I heard this cactus say 'I was already watered yesterday—'.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I'll make this one exception since it's your birthday, Doctor. I'll stand to the side and watch. But you'll want to keep your lower body firmly planted. For people who are unfamiliar with this Tianshi apparatus, they could very easily get pulled into the air by the kite, so keep your center of gravity low... Hey! Hey! Geez... The Doctor is flying...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: At first I didn't really understand why my master wanted me to go on a study visit to a pharmaceutical company. But after spending all this time here, I've come to realize that you're all just like the people of Dahuang. We're both fighting to help the desperate, to save lives in danger of fading away. We walk the same path, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Gavial doesn't do this kind of work, and nobody in the tribe wants to do this stuff either. So, that's why I help out a bit when I have the time.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: If there's no trainee nurse at the Medical Department, I can give it a try. I have some basic nursing knowledge.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, this pen seems to be out of ink. Oh, wait! Please don't throw that out! If it's not too much to ask... Um... could I have that?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I can't dig up the floors on Rhodes Island? There's no buried treasure? But where are all your precious things, then? Locked inside rooms? Oh, that's too bad…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My tail's gotten even bigger. If this keeps up, everyone's going to hate me for sure. Wuh... What do I do…?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Some people are born strong and cool, others, smart. For me, I've got a big tail... Since we can't choose what we're born with, let's embrace our uniqueness and make the most of it. Um, of course, if you could help me out every now and then, Doctor... that would be best.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I understand Gavial skipping work, but why would she skip a meal? Could something be bothering her so much that even she has to hide? And no one else even noticed. I'm the only one who can save her! Ah, Doctor, good thing you're here. Can you help me with something?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
