lines.text: Are you sure you want to see what's inside my backpack? Okay... I haven't organized it in a while so it might be kind of messy. Let's see… An amber wrapped in a leaf. A loose fang...? A bloodstained black crystal... and a stack of autographs?! Uh, Doctor, that's all for today! Sorry, but we're done here!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: She shines with such brilliance that I can't help but stare, even as her flames scorch my eyes dry. That's my Gavial, she shines like the sun. Oh, by the way, I came across that passage in a book and thought it sounded nice, so I memorized it. It really fits Gavial, doesn't it?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'll leave this dreamcatcher over here… May you have a pure and peaceful dream, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Er, I'm not here to cause trouble. I'm here to… to... Study! Right, study. No reason for me to stay home alone if Gavial is here, right?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm... Maybe I should just practice on the battlefield, I guess…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for giving me such a pretty badge, Doctor. What? It's a promotion badge? Ah, uh, y-you sure...? A-A-Am I really qualified to have this?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I'll be worthy of this flag one day, I swear I will.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll watch and learn, Doctor. It would be great if I could actually master some of your skills…

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You're leaving it to me? Really?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go. We are gonna F… um… beat them up!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Wait, I'm not ready yet!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Please not me, please not me…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Maybe I'll have a go…

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: H-Here I go!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Who needs beating? Come over!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: C-Come on, you can do this!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: A little more, a little more!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Haah!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Wh-Who's next!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I got beaten like that before, by you, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We won, yay.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew, my back's sore. I need a break.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm sorry... so sorry…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Ah! Please don't throw that away yet. Can you leave it to me? I'll take care of it.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: M-My tail...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Want to try Sargonian barbecue? I'll work the grill, you just enjoy the food, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: If today's a holiday, does that mean I can take the day off? Haghhh… Oh, where's Gavial? Have you seen her, Doctor? If I've got a free day, of course I'm going to spend it with Gavial!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hnngh... Doctor…

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor! I brought you a birthday present! Umm... huh? Wh-Where did it go? I hid it behind my back so I could surprise you. How could it go missing...? Wahh… Oh! Here it is! It was stuck under my tail... Sorry about that, and happy birthday to you, Doctor. Hehe.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, I got a paper slip from the fortune box, and it says if I say five positive words to a plant every day, it will grow even bigger. Let me try it with this one! Tail, backpack, barbecue, sweet dreams... And... Gavial. Hehe... Doctor! Why are you laughing at me?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: When I first became a Candleholder, it took me three whole months to finish reading all the literature in the Sui Regulator's library. The paperwork you have piled up here... is no less impressive in size. I will have time to familiarize myself with my duties, right?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor? Let me join you for a walk... Oh, it's just Kroos and Mr. Nothing said they would take me around to introduce myself to all the operators on the landship. They've been very warm, much more so than when we first met... Wait, what? You're inspecting the entire ship today?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My father forged these blades for me. 'Drive out the shadows of the Feranmut and all the people's troubles.' A Candleholder's work is not so simple that we can manage it with force alone... Um, of course, I've also been practicing my kung fu every day!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Yes, I do know Lin Qingyan. We held different titles, serving the Sui Regulator and the Central Judicial Office respectively. I've had my doubts about Rhodes Island before I arrived, and my time spent here has only doubled those suspicions. That being said, I shan't pry into the matters that 'Operator Leizi' is investigating.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: That Operator just now... was that Lord Wei's niece? No, I don't know her, but when I was little, my father told me to learn from her example. Not long ago, we discovered that Miss Ch'en resigned her position with the Lungmen Guard Department. Father did not say anything to me that day. Thinking back, I indeed find her admirable.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My father sent me to Dahuang in hopes that I would reflect upon my mistakes and improve as a man. Indeed, one should avoid deviating from the proper path. But perhaps my father's meaning runs deeper... Decades ago, he and the Grandmaster worked all night on a blade at the Sword Forge, making them late for work the following morning. Hmm... It may be that Father hates to see the flame in my heart snuff out.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I'll keep an eye on the siblings, but I can't simply stand by and watch as Nian plays mahjong. Doctor, you've seen those exaggerated metal casts of hers. She conjures them as effortlessly as she blinks. Don't you think she's... just a little obnoxious? I can tell you're not playing dumb. That's the trickiest part.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: On-deck capture the flag is no doubt a competition of athletic ability. I was the first to climb onto the bridge, but the Vulpo lady riding her staff breezed past me to snatch the flag. That is blatant cheating, Doctor. How could you accuse me of being too competitive and unsportsmanlike?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: This is a handbook that all Candleholders keep on their person. I did record some observations about you, Doctor. I'm very sorry. But for what it's worth, I am now sure of one thing: You are the guiding post of this ship, and you are indeed ordinary. I will shred those pages, and I will ensure your safety.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: The Feranmuts breathe with this vast land, and the Candleholder walks into the long night.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, I am Zuo Le. The number of proxies aboard Rhodes Island has almost exceeded that of those in Yan. The Sui Regulator should have sent someone here long ago. In fact, it has been some time since we sent you an official notice, but it would seem your company may have forgotten to reply?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: For a pharmaceutical company to have so competently recorded and analyzed battle records… This is nigh unimaginable.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: My sincerest apologies, in my capacity as the mandarin, I'm afraid I cannot accept any form of 'promotion' from Rhodes Island... Ahem, what I mean is... we will forgo the titles, but I can accept the other benefits.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Each megastructure coursing through Catastrophes has a meaning unique to itself. Shangshu transferred its mountains and waterscapes to its nomadic cities, while Yumen fends off sandstorms with its Wind Aegis. And so, what of Rhodes Island? On what convictions do you sail?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I hope my meager assistance will prove fruitful.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: To the right men, give the right jobs, enlist the talent, and forsake the snobs. I, Zuo Le, shall do my very best.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The arrow has been nocked. Do not hesitate.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The thrust of a blade takes no shape, take no comfort that it lies sheathed.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: From here on, your words are my command.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: The situation is complicated, I shall improvise and adapt.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: When chaos abounds, tugging a single thread can pull the entire net.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Not even a stirring of grass will go overlooked.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Go no further, this road is closed.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Such violence will not be tolerated!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: All balance held by the orders of Yan. All beasts hunted by the sons of man!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Tiny may a candle be, it shall drive out the darkest night!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Seeking total victory in peril. You are truly of extraordinary talent and courage.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A unit never takes the same formation, as water never takes the same shape. Such extraordinary planning and execution... Doctor, I cannot fathom your past.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Man strives for perfection, yet flaws remain in every plan. Doctor, the deed is done. Let's not dwell on it further.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The Sui Regulator has contingencies for all possible outcomes. Leave the cleanup to me. Don't worry, my qinggong is good. I'll catch up.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I've lived in tents, and I've slept in fields. I'm not particularly demanding.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You must have urgent need of assistance?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, how about a game of weiqi? Or perhaps a capture-the-flag rematch?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The northern mandarins are busy, just as farmers have little time for leisure... My duties have me traveling all across Yan. The Yanese are always busy, but this time of year, they come together to eat, to beat the drums, and to enjoy their reunions... The shadows have yet to fade, but likewise, the fireworks will never cease.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good timing. You must have something to discuss with me. Yes and no?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I was a fairly mischievous boy. I once leapt into a sand wheel in Yumen, nearly costing me my life. It was my birthday, so my father had me wear this mask for the entire day. Happy birthday, Doctor. Rhodes Island won't be stopping, but would you like to hop off for a look? Don't worry, I'll fly you back.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Londinium, Gran Faro, Trimounts... Rhodes Island has played a role in many crises. The Sui Regulator knows that you are not a simple pharmaceutical company, of course, but you have been doing everything in your power to prevent invisible disasters. And so you may stand shoulder-to-shoulder with us.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I looked after the stockbeasts in Dahuang, so I'm looking after you here, of course. You'll have to listen to me, work hard, and rest on time. Let's see... It's rest time now. Let's head out and have some fun!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Of course I know what the stockbeasts are saying. The beastlings in Dahuang always talk to me about things like what kind of snacks they want or who they like, and I sneak them a little help. This apple? A stockbeast asked for it, obviously. I'm just tasting it for them, making sure it's sweet enough.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Zuo Le is Candlestick, the Record Keeper is Inkbrush, that blinged out guy is Megaphone, and you're Wisehead. I also know a Tall Shades and Smiley Sharpshooter! Oh, and Amiya is the best! We made a promise to come up with a better nickname for you together.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Shu made me this fowlbeast whistle, and whenever I wanna tell the stockbeasts to go home, I give it a blow. Sometimes, when Dahuang feels empty, I sit down on the street corner to play it. People come and go, and my whistle's my goodbye and hello.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Dahuang's operas are sung in different dialects. That commemorates the farmers who came to our rescue a few centuries ago. They were from all across Yan, farming here for generations. They're why Dahuang fields are so fertile and prosperous now. I'm really proud that I can play the accompaniment on my flute here every year!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: When I first stood on the terraces, I could only see the aqueducts, but after the farmlands were raised, I could see the edge of the city, and now that Shu brought me here, I can see the horizon from the top deck. Megaphone tells me that Baba and Mama will come back someday, but when, exactly?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Could you draw a line over my head...? I'm not standing on my tiptoes! I'm not stretching my neck out, either! Are you done? Let's see. See? I told you I got taller! Maybe I'll be taller than Xiaohe next year! Let's see how tall you are. Minus your hood and shoes, you... come up to my shoulders!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When I'm in a bad mood, I sometimes go to the embankment to play my flute. There's a woodcutter there who yelled at me every time, but he always quieted down as soon as I played this song. He even hummed along. That was the first time I saw him smile! Like I said, I'm really good at the flute.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The farmers say that the stockbeasts live by following water and grass. Fowlbeasts fly freely in the sky, but they always eventually land in the fields. I know what that means now.  Everyone has a field to call their own. Rhodes Island is your field, and you are the fowlbeast that will come back to land, isn't that right?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hm... You fell asleep...? You really fell asleep...? Hehe, have this coat then. Have a good dream. I'm off to have some fun!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Shu brought me here to hang! I think I wrote my name on a document she was supposed to sign...? She said it was fine, though. Now that I've signed it, I get to come here to hang out all the time!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: ...Wah! I'd never fall asleep in class, Laoshi...! Huh? It's you.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I developed a way to train stockbeasts to identify foods based on their smell. The Tianshi Bureaus gave me a medal for it. It doesn't have a serial number, but it says how amazing I am! And now I have this one you gave me. I'm putting them next to each other.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I got taller again, right? By the time I'm as tall as you, the people of Dahuang will definitely have cultivated the seeds they want. When that happens, I'll invite you to come sit with us in the fields. The rice flowers are gonna look even better then!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Is it time to do pest control again? I'm the best at catching these nasty little things!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Trust me. I know I can do it extra good.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Listen up, get your boots on, and tread lightly!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Everybody ready?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Qui-Qui-Quick! The pests are getting away.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I saw them hiding in the bushes there!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Nice. They didn't see us.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: None of you are getting away this time!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hah, I got you!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Come any closer, and I'll whap your heads with my flute!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Not so fast now, huh!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: And don't ever come back to our fields!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Come on, let's go! We need to hurry and tell Shu. She's going to be so happy with me.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Next year, the year after, and the year after that... One day, the whole of Dahuang will live without fear of Catastrophes or pests, and we'll have stack our harvests as high as Heaven for Shennong.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: It's okay. We've been through Catastrophes much worse than this. This one's just a little setback. We'll work harder next season!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We're in trouble... I'll go get the Tianshi to help us!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I want to sneak out when the landship docks. Can you keep it from Shu?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: These buns aren't for you to grab!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Have you learned to play the song I taught you?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Here. A multigrain fragrance sachet! It's made by blending some grains and medicinal herbs. Keep it on you, and you're guaranteed peace and good health for the rest of the year. And you should definitely have a bowl of multigrain rice with multigrain beer. The farmers always tell me how good the multigrain beer tastes, but when I took a sip—It was so spicy and bitter!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I have the basket ready. Should we head to the fields to catch mudfins together?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I made you a bowl of noodles. Give it a try. When I was still a kid, Shu always made me a bowl of longevity noodles for my birthday. An entire bowl made up of a single noodle. She always added a fried egg over easy too. I think this one might be overcooked, though. It might... have turned into a bowl of gruel.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I saw Rhodes Island splitting the sandstorm and sailing here. It felt just like the first time I saw Dahuang's new buildings, how they protected the fields from the Catastrophe. As long as everyone works together, no matter if it's a Catastrophe or anything else, there's always a way, right?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Since you're stuck here sifting through documents, I might as well help you solve a few problems around the office.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hitting supply lines does a whole lot more damage than taking out people.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If you ask me, your office is on the bland side. Just hit me up if you ever want to mix things up a little.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The whole 'cozy family relationship' thing isn't for me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I get a lot more out of talking to strangers than I do from that 'self-help' shtick.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: We define ourselves by symbols, but those symbols can be perverted. Reused. Reworked, reframed, remade. In a word, stolen. Who are you then?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I don't mind helping you run errands out of combat, but on the battlefield, I need ample room to call the shots.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When someone can't find fault with your results and has to resort to nitpicking your attitude, that tells you everything you need to know about them.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: To call the shots, you need to prove that you've got what it takes – and you've certainly done that. So, where are you sending me next?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Your workload is clearly excessive, even by the highest standards. Take a rest.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Codename Ela, member of Team Rainbow. Just give me my objective, then sit back and wait for the good news.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Picked up a few new tricks.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A medal? Thanks. Workmanship's not bad at all, as far as decorations go.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Together, we can shake the very stars from the sky.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: At least make it challenging.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Time to show you what I can do.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: No time to waste.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'll make you regret this.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: A tooth for a tooth.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: An eye for an eye.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I got this.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Idziemy.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Here's a memento.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: That will slow them down.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Eat this!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't move!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The end justifies the means.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I'm sorry, was I too fast for you?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: That's it?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Try to keep up!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place isn't half bad.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Do me a favor, don't talk to me.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Tell me YOUR story.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Not sure if it's really me standing before you? Here's a hint: the Gemini doesn't talk.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Multitasking has never been a problem for me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Intel is half the battle.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You need to clean your pot regularly, if you want decent coffee.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Seeing is not always believing. Technology reveals the hidden truth.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've encountered a few difficulties because of my appearance. No more than that, though.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I'll follow your lead.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I trust your judgment.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I wonder what souvenirs I'll take home from this unforgettable journey.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hold on, I'll be right back.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Code name Iana, Team Rainbow. There's a lot of intel we can share with each other.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Have you considered holographic recordings?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Do I get more access permissions?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Here's hoping this helps me reach more unexplored corners.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Friendly reminder, my hologram doesn't stop bullets.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Gemini will show the way.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Rage against the dying of the light.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Target detected.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready when you are.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Gathering intel.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Cover me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Mic-check successful.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Stay out of sight!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Stay close!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Resetting.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hostile in my sights!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: All systems are complementary, if you know how to connect them.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Exactly how it should be.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You've still got fight in you, show them what you're made of.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Your story doesn't end here.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: If that's how you want it.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Come on.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Come on, I'll help.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ready for more action?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Here are the files, and this is your coffee. No need to thank me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Yes…? Oh! Sorry Doctor, I thought an operator was calling out to me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If you can hold a scalpel, you can hold a gun. Never doubt the steadiness of a surgeon's hand.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Neither sickness nor the enemy can take from me what I want to protect.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: When you have walked with death, you learn to appreciate life.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've learned from experience that the place to save lives is in the field, not an office. And sometimes, the only way to save a life is to take one.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: My job is to keep you alive. Make it as hard as you like.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Not a fan of your worried face. What's the matter?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor. I'm so glad we found you.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: When was the last time you took a break? You need to stop working.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Code name Doc, Team Rainbow. I'll protect you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This will make things easier.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: If we must, we must.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thank you, I'd been hoping to get authorization to access confidential files on Oripathy.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Call if you need a hand.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Let's be safe out there.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: At least we are well prepared.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: There are still active targets in the area.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready to go.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I've got your backs.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Get going quickly.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Try not to get yourselves hurt.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Located target.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Target acquired.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Stick close to me.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Reloading!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Are you alright? Any difficulty breathing?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We're almost at the extraction point. Then, we can rest.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Let's get you back on your feet, shall we?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We're wasting time.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Always a pleasure.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Careful, I'm carrying a bunch of bric-a-bracs.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Nothing abnormal. If we get a situation, I'll let you know.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Bonjour.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Right... Let me know if you need anything.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Watch out. There are a lot of dangerous materials in the workroom.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Engineering Department... Not bad. The head of the department, though... A bit too talkative.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I like machines. They don't talk, but they're always honest with their readings.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Chaos is only an enemy if you're unable to adapt.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: When the approaching chaos endangers your loved ones, the thing to do isn't to protect them. It's... to keep them as far away from you as possible.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: No, my comms equipment's fine. Nothing to worry.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You want me to say something? Uh, that's the hardest part.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My hometown? There... the sky is blue, and all the buildings under it are blue, too.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Good... I'll find something to do.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Rainbow Operator, codename Fuze. I've said everything I need to. Let's get to it.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: No problem. I'll find some time to watch them.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Good. Thank you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Do I need to give some crowd a speech? No? Good.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: At your command.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Do exactly as I say.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Enough talk. Now we act.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Матрёшка готов поручить.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Focus on the task at hand.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Remember our objectives.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Lower your voice.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Remain silent.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: With me!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Remain alert.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Stay focused.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hold position.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Every action builds our chances to win.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Asset secured.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: On your feet, your wounds are not fatal.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Move, right now!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place isn't bad.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Don't do that...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I made some pilaf. Want some?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey...

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'd appreciate it if you let me keep a bit of distance... There's a smell on me I can't get off, no matter how hard I try.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I got this coat from a certain sergeant. Death had already come for her at the time. Her expression was softening, her breathing getting shallower and shallower. I held her hand, and waited... Waited until her head nodded a bit. I helped her close her eyes, and then completed our trade.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Excuse me, Doctor, could you check if this is the right way to record birth and death dates? Oh, don't worry, nobody died. This is for me, in case something happens to me one day. If someone manages to find this, then I'll at least have a decent tombstone or marker... A lot better than an unmarked brick at least.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: There was another girl with me getting treatment in Medical. She had a familiar scent on her. Her flame of life burned even dimmer than mine... But she didn't seem to mind at all, just humming happily to herself. What gave her the strength? I envy her.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island is always rushing from one conflict to another. I used to be like that too. The difference is, you do it to save people... I was doing it just to save myself.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, the operators who made the ultimate sacrifice... their dorms are just as they left them, as if their owners had just stepped out for a minute. This huge ship carries so much that has already passed on... How are you able to hold such a clear course...? As if none of you doubt anything?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Cantabile taught me to read some of the words in the book today. 'The warm soil uplifts the mist, the branches trace light's brows, and fowlbeasts sing in the dawnlight.' I wanted to know where I could find a place like this, so I asked her... But she went quiet on me. Maybe... it's just someone's imagination.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: There's this one particularly ugly type of fowlbeast, big as a human child, with a scary cry. Flocks of them storm onto battlefields, looking for food. When I was a kid, I'd get into fights with them and end up with bruises all over. But, once I grew up, I lost the guts to face them, let alone look them in the eye.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The longer you live in a war, the more you end up forgetting. I can't remember the faces of a lot of those who've died, but new faces appear in front of me every day... If the war ever ends, then I'll finally be able to remember them all. That's why I'm prepared to follow you and your ideals.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I don't like watching people sleep, but... your heartbeat is steady, and that puts me at ease… Rest, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm just a girl who cleans up war zones. If you need me for anything, please call me by the name… Lutonada.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: So, this is one way to prevent people from dying...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I've got a vague idea of what a 'promotion' is. A sergeant wears sturdier clothes than a footman, and carries more valuables... I appreciate it a lot, Doctor…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Tell me, does this mean I get to keep on walking this path with you?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Your faith in me... I'll etch it into my heart...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: No more lives will be lost in vain…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Before the flames of war can spread…

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: No more tears...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'll go.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I can do this.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: As you say.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Your lives are safe in my hands.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I'll be your fortress.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'll handle this on my own.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Until my last breath…

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: This place is not for any of you to clean up. Go home, and enjoy a good night's sleep.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: 'Preventing conflict provides more solace than mourning.' ...These words only made sense after living through them firsthand.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They might've gotten away, but they won't want to bleed again. Not a bad end to things.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I vow to lead everyone off the battlefield.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's nice, clean, and quiet here... just like the inside of a coffin.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Did you need me? I'm here, as always.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ah, I'm sorry... I won't sleep under the bed again.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Did something happen today? Everyone looks so happy… New Year's? A once-a-year occasion? Alright. I used to have to live every day as if it was my last. Never could've imagined that I'd be celebrating a special one.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Stay healthy, Doctor. Live a life.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Life is the opposite of death. It means infinite possibility... In that sense, one's day of birth is very much worth celebrating. I'd like to ask... can today also be my birthday? I would like to share in this joy with you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The medic says my condition has stabilized, and that I've been approved to travel outside. Doctor, do you think... I should try looking for other kinds of work? Not for the dead, but for the living.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I'm leaving the landship tomorrow, so I tidied up your office. I put your daily necessities on your desk, and sorted everything else into the cabinets. You can refer to the notes I made whenever you take or return something, so you'll remember where they are.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hm? You're talking to me? No, it's just, I only saw you a few times from a distance during our Babel days, and we never had a conversation. I saw you on the deck once. A gust of wind almost blew your coat away , so I wanted to remind you to wear more layers, but in the end... I didn't have the guts to  approach you.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor! Sorry, I should have mentioned not to touch my weapon. I'll apply some ointment for you, and you can keep the rest too. It was made for situations like this anyway, and it's pretty good for burns. What about me? It's fine... I've been used to its heat since long ago.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, why are you always giving me these toys? What? Because I have a baby face? Hahaha, I'm much older than you think. But you do remind me of the first toy I got as a boy, it was my mom's sword. When she gave it to me, she also said it was time I learned to be a man.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I grew up in Kazdel. It sounds like I had it easy, but I'm sure you know it's hard for a couple to raise a child there. They probably burned all the luck they had to let their boy grow up safe and sound.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Too many things happened in Babel, so it's best you don't pry. Nah, I'm not running from the past. I simply think people naturally forget the past if they choose to keep moving forward. To hate, forgive, or to do neither, none of it matters.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, someone asked me to give you this letter. She used to be in Babel's assault squad, but now she's back in Kazdel working as a smith. You can't make sense of it? Let me see... Man, there's so many spelling mistakes... Alright, so she's asking... how you are... Saying you should eat more... And wishing... you're still with all your limbs?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: One year, everyone was celebrating a victory here in the canteen. We were both there, but with a group of people between us. People leave, scatter, and now only we two are left at this table. Oh, don't be upset, Doctor. Please, don't be upset. It's alright if you don't remember, at least I still do.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You're... oh, it's you, Doctor. I've had a bit too much to drink... Y-You're awful clever, could you tell me something? Why do I have to see so much turmoil... and change? Shouldn't our eyes... be filled with nothing... but our loved ones?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sorry to wake you, Doctor. I shouldn't have barged in like that. The weather's been getting colder, so I... just wanted to make sure you stay warm.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Maybe you don't remember me, Doctor? I used to work for you a long time ago. Odda. That's my name.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This training method is pretty good. I remember how recruits used to be sent straight to the battlefield, they would've more or less learned how to fight, if they managed to survive.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thanks, Doctor. I'm always anticipating your approval.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: That's great... you don't exchange heads for rewards here.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Live on, so we can see each other again.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't come too close to me, the flames might sputter.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The steam has dissipated.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'm sorry we had to meet here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: This blade has gone through countless whetstones.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: This hammer has gone through many years of tempering.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I see them.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The dead, I will remember.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The living, I will protect.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You won't take what I've got now!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: My childhood is LONG GONE!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Thank you for lending me your luck, Pops...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Let's go back, Doctor. I'm craving a huge cup of ice water right about now.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Anyway, we won.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, no matter how things turned out, it's over... let's go back.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Doctor, should I turn up the air conditioner? Sorry, my body gets so hot, it's even heating up our surroundings.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whoa! Your fingers are so cold!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ah! Please don't touch my tail. It broke off once, and it doesn't feel good if people touch it.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, I know a new year means new expectations. But... I've long since stopped wanting anything more than not losing what I've got now. That's my biggest hope.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Don't forget to eat and drink water regularly, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I got some biscuits from Kazdel for you. I guess you could say they're a local specialty? We always eat them on our birthdays. Yes? You bit into something hard? Oh, it's just a tiny piece of shrapnel. Probably flew in while they were being made. It's fine, just toss that bit away and eat the rest.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: There was a time when I got myself somewhere high up all alone, thinking I'd see a different view above Kazdel that wasn't just the usual smoke and fire. But even when my eyes were hurting from the smoke, I still couldn't see anything. Unlike the past, today I can see a different sight with you on the landship— a sky so pretty and blue.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Don't bother checking, it's me. We've got a situation, so I swapped schedules with your other assistant. Don't worry, you'll get used to this.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: That HR op wants me to take a break? Hmph, I know she means well, but I won't rest until she's willing to take a break herself. One of S.W.E.E.P.'s functions is to take care of her work while she's out. We might as well keep things as they are. What's S.W.E.E.P. established for? You don't need to know.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Don't trouble yourself trying to figure me out. Even the old you couldn't manage it. Remember, it's my own choice to vanish from your sight. With my duty fulfilled, I won't be interfering with Rhodes Island's future plan. But when you need me, I'll be there.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Amnesia is a convenient excuse. You're the only one who knows if you are faking it or not. But since you've taken Rhodes Island this far, true or not, I won't question you. I'm watching you, Doctor, same as ever.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: When we face Theresis, that will be our final curtain call. What about the future? No point in playing with hypotheticals. W, Hoederer, Closure... Those who witnessed Babel's struggle still stand united with Rhodes Island. They are the future.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: When people talk about Her Highness, they treat her like the unattainable future of the Sarkaz. But to me, she is who she is. She trips over her dress, she intentionally 'forgets' certain meetings, she gives me hugs. Pass over that 'Theresa'? I wouldn't hesitate to do so.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Back when I was wandering the wastes, I didn't fear the dark of night. It scared me less than the sandbeasts biting my toes. Even now, seeing them still makes me feel kinda nervous. It's fine, no harm in letting you know.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Mercenaries, spies, nobles, convicts... Rhodes Island these days is far more complex than back in the Babel times, and the threats are greater too. It's natural for you to worry. How would the old you have handled it? Doesn't matter. This you knows what to do.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: S.W.E.E.P. never expressed any opinion on the Chernobog operation. Saving you was a unanimous decision by Dr. Kal'tsit and the elite operators. I didn't kill you back then, because I needed time to observe you. In view of the present, my judgment seems correct. Doctor, don't disappoint me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Fate. I've pursued it, confronted it, and finally strangled it to death. You've done the same.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ascalon, it's my only name. Call it a code name if you like. But if you want to update my file, you'll have to speak to Dr. Kal'tsit first.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The training paid off. Not bad.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: S.W.E.E.P. was established as an independent unit. It's out of Rhodes Island's structures from the very beginning, so this framework doesn't apply to me. You have a new approach? I appreciate the recognition, but those of us in the shadows don't care for glory.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: It's not time yet. Only the darkness can shroud all the filth. Doctor, when the day comes that Rhodes Island no longer needs S.W.E.E.P., I'll come to you, and take it.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Go right ahead at any moment. I'll be there.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I've assessed the risks. I'll lead the team on this operation.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Keep track of my position. I'm ready to strike.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Engaging. Go!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: No one knows my name.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: They only remember my blade.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: No one can see me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I got this. Focus elsewhere.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Follow me into the shadows.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Right behind you.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You've stepped into my domain.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Meet me, meet your death.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Confidence of our companions is earned. The road ahead is perilous, these victories are precious.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Limit the enemy's choices, forcing them into unwitting traps. A familiar style... Hmm... you really don't remember anything? Sooner or later, you'll have to face yourself, so think carefully. Bear in mind, this time, I'm ready to correct your mistakes.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The ones who got away will be useful, when the time is right. Don't chase them too hard, Doctor.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Keep moving ahead with confidence, and don't look back. Seeing me again means you're safe.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I know where to go. I can handle myself.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Try again if you dare.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Tired? No, it's peaceful here.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's not easy to celebrate New Year's in Kazdel, where you always face unpredictable threats. That's why I cherish the changes we've seen at Rhodes Island over the years. Thank you, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: With a foot in the darkness, the light becomes clearer. You want to see? No, you don't belong there.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: The party is too loud, so you came out for some fresh air? I've been here all along, you just didn't see me. Your safety is the most important thing. And in such a mixed company, reducing my presence makes the mission easier. Oh, and happy birthday, I didn't get a chance to say it inside.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Babel is history. Her Highness has shown that that path has no future. And while Rhodes Island's future is even more challenging now, you have ever more companions. I have no doubt that Rhodes Island is on the right path.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: The encrypted incantations on these files have been dispelled, you can now read them at your leisure. Except for one register, on which the curse is too cumbersome to remove. May I inquire, Doctor, why you suddenly went silent a moment ago?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Perplexed? Not quite, I'm just trying to think of a faster way to solve the puzzle program that Mechanist left. However, his ingenious design is providing me with fresh inspiration for my own incantation-weaving. Would you like to join the contest as well, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Mist kisses the travelers' lips, while water ripples caress the soul.' Such is life in the Convallis. Do you still have any other unanswered questions? Uh, what is a 'Hostess'...? Ahem, by the looks of things, you've already met those enthusiastic sisters of mine. Regarding that traditional title of Lord of the Banshees, it is not something I reject altogether.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The power of 'language' comes from rules and restraints, not from arbitrary imagination. Only by imposing constraints upon yourself can you make progress in the incantation Arts. Master this, and overnight, your knowledge of incantations will surpass the innate talent afforded to our kind.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The myriad souls have long departed, but our souls still must find rest. If the deceased require guidance on their journey to the other side, then I am willing to become the ferryman of the Sarkaz, of my countrymen on this great land... Indeed, I'm far from capable of singing an elegy for every departed compatriot, but I will not give up.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The prophecy that frightened the King of Sarkaz? Now that Amiya and Rhodes Island have overcome the past, the flame of hope to conquer fate still burns. Doctor, I hereby swear that as long as I am here, we shall never be slaves to that prophecy.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Did you notice, Doctor? Indeed, the decorations on my uniform are incantations engraved by my own two hands. It is difficult for normal fabrics to contain such power, so I could only seek help from my colleagues in the Logistics Department, who painstakingly modified the textiles of the Convallis. The nightcap I intend to give you is also made through similar methods. I additionally engraved it with an incantation to help you sleep.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: After learning the truth of what happened back then, you've sought out many of our colleagues, so I figured it was only a matter of time until you'd come looking for me. What do I think? I harbor no hatred for you, Doctor. Amiya mentioned to me that you're being haunted by nightmares. I can dispel them for you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The same incantation can be interpreted as desired, manifesting its effect in a thousand different ways. If words have countless interpretations, so do names. Dr. {@nickname}, were you to add your name to this incantation, what do you think it would invoke? I'm eager to find out.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: A blindfold? No need. This 'Banshee's Crown' is enough to cover my eyes and help me sleep, as it contains an incantation forbidding those who would touch— You lost consciousness? Oof... do sleep well, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Rhodes Island elite operator, Logos, reporting in. I think this procedure calls for some formality, cumbersome as it may be— Doctor, you're not thinking of leaving early again, are you?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This battle once offered much inspiration for choreographing my cadence.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Sorry to arrive late to such an important occasion. What part are we at now? My face is flushed? Hmm, looks like there are still some hiccups in the 'hangover removal' incantation I was working on with Mechanist.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Cross beyond death, and usher in a more just vision...' Elite operators have never been in the business of signing blood oaths, but they invariably dedicate their lives in service to their ideals. The fact that we still stand together after all this time, Doctor, is rare indeed.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Questions are destined to be answered; rules, bound to be analyzed.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm willing to lead.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Never mind the use of force. Death has its own resting place.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Just as incantations must be restrained, so too must the enemy.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Waiting for your call.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I hear the elegy.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Thus I speak.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: For them the bell tolls.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Veil, the Curtain of Destiny.'

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Morningstar, the Illumination of Wisdom.'

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Soulriver, the Ferry of the Other Side.'

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Period, the Reversal of Finality.'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Join in our celebration, Doctor. Your joy in this moment is enough to embellish my incantations.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Every incantation I wrote was utilized by you, with not a single word wasted. We make for an excellent team, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I can still hear their cries in the distance. The wrathful, unable to find peaceful slumber... There will come a day when the dead will know rest. I'm sure of it, Doctor.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Retreat. The curtain will cover your tracks.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: May I use my own office chair?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: How does this tune sound?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Um… You're stepping on my cloth…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: My mother brought me reeds from the Convallis. I intertwined them with song and incantation, connecting them end-to-end, and formed them into a necklace. It will wither in the night of the old year and sprout in the dawn of the new year. This piece, bearing blessings of new life, is my gift for you, Doctor. Happy New Year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, did I bother you with my whistling? No? That's a relief to hear. What is the name of this piece? It's untitled; just an improv piece I came up with in my spare time.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. How many years have I been offering my blessings to you now? You don't remember either...? It's fine. Sometimes, forgetting is a blessing in its own right, letting the past be put to rest. Just remember that I'll still be here for you next year.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I first came here as a wanderer in search of knowledge. Though the fragments of Rhodes Island's past are lost to time, hope remains. We have overcome the nightmares of the bygone days. As for where we ought to go in the future, I believe you already know.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I still remember this conference room. This seat… was it reserved for Theresa? No... I have no need for it.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Theresa is no more. This body, this vestige before you, is but a program that exists within the 'King of Sarkaz.' My form and my presence are the result of Amiya's emotions. As much as I may remember everything from the past, please do not mistake me for Theresa herself.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I will stay by Amiya's side, accompanying everyone here at Rhodes Island. Though, this hardly makes up for all the lost time... Doctor, I'm not a program in the same sense as PRTS. See? You might not be able to feel my body temperature, but I can at least smile.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Rhodes Island has strode beyond war, and should now re-embark on her intended route. For starters, how about optimizing our logistics? There are several conference rooms that can be freed up and converted into sickbays... You'd like my personal opinion? Doctor, allow me to remind you again, I am not Theresa.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: 'Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals Inc.'... registered to Amiya's hometown... And these medicines... They were all developed by Kal'tsit... No, I have no regrets. Babel has fulfilled its duty. Rhodes Island will continue to sail, and continue to alleviate sickness and pain. If Theresa was here, I'm sure she would have been pleased.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Never have I regretted any of my decisions. We did everything we could have done, and bequeathed hope unto the future. Time will close wounds, love will mend scars. When the long night ends, Rhodes Island will usher in the light of dawn. Though many have left us along the way, I will remain here and bear witness to the ending.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Amiya still looks so thin and frail. For a girl at this age, maybe she should be a bit taller? All these days, has she been eating well…? How she so wished to see Amiya as she is now, to watch her grow for just a bit longer. Her wish should have been granted...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Kal'tsit still refuses to speak to me. When she poses questions to this crown, she avoids looking me in the eye. 'The King of Sarkaz' remembers her past. While I can sympathize with her loneliness, I cannot free her from her shackles. Perhaps one day, Doctor, you can help her find meaning in her existence, as her companion.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, you carry such guilt within your eyes. But you ask, is one's memory sufficient to define who they are? You have lost your memories. I merely inherited all of hers. How are we to settle what happened so long ago? Doctor, go and spend some more time with Amiya and Kal'tsit. None shall linger in the past, except her.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you weary, Doctor? Then, go ahead and rest. Everyone has the right to fall into peaceful slumber, and you are no exception.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: ...I'm here.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: …Did I just see Amiya fighting?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I still remember every medal I distributed with these very hands. These ceremonies are also commitments. Rhodes Island will never give up on her ideals, let sacrifices be in vain, or forget about those who've traveled with her. Even now, we remain on the same course we originally charted.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I know, there are still many people who need me. Don't worry. This time, I'm not going anywhere.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Will you lead us to victory once more, Doctor?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I will stand alongside the warriors of Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Warriors of Rhodes Island, may you all return victorious.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I can hear the sorrow within you all.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Doctor, I have faith in your command.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: It's okay. I am with you.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Amiya, get behind me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I am right here. I will always remain with you.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I will remember each and every one of you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Your ideals... are equally worthy of respect.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Keep striding forward. I shall be at your side.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't cry. It will all be over soon.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: There shall come a day... when we can strike alight the flames that burn away all decay.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You always make the perfect calculations so that everything falls into place just as you planned, don't you?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Without you, our casualties would have been far worse... Thank you, Doctor.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We will be able to move beyond this pain and suffering. Rhodes Island will not stop here.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: A new security system? Will it still recognize me?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Boo! Did I scare you?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm watching you, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Rhodes Island is a lot livelier than it used to be. Though there's still so much unfinished business, this moment of peace is precious nevertheless. Doctor, can you give these storybooks and toys to the children for me? It's something Theresa always used to do.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Program initializing. Accessor: Dr.{@nickname}.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. How did you used to celebrate this day in the previous world? It must've been a scene full of warmth and happiness. I found one such song in 'Civilight Eterna.' Would you like to listen to it? Before that, Doctor, may you never be alone again in the journey ahead.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: 'Rhodes Island.' This very name fills one with warmth and comfort. Surely, tender memories will rush forth as soon as you speak these words. I hope that Rhodes Island can continue to carry forth the hopes and expectations of countless people, and in the future, become home for many, many more.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Oh... So this is how you use the gramophone that Closure brought over…

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Ahem, can you hear me? Today marks the first day of the start of Rhodes Island's official voyage, and I am elated beyond words!

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: I remember the first time I saw this big girl, how battered and worn-down she was. But, Closure truly outdid herself, and Kal'tsit deserves credit too for helping.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: When the engine furnace first sputtered to life, I could feel the vibrations beneath my feet even up on the deck. The setting sun in the wilderness seemed to draw an arc in the sky, and the fowlbeasts accompanied us through the fiery red. She took a steady step forward, and it was a great relief to all of us...

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: 'Rhodes Island.' Truly, what a wonderful name.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: I hope this can become a place that many people call home... Huh?

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: What do you mean, insufficient memory...

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Trials for the newest generation of Oripathy medication failed.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: I could only pretend to keep my calm in front of everyone.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Kal'tsit said well in advance that this experiment's likelihood of success was extremely small, but once I saw even the smallest possibility, I couldn't help but place my heavy hopes on it.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: I keep thinking to myself, what will happen to Kazdel once Oripathy is cured? What will happen to this entire land?

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: No longer will infants be sentenced to death by terminal illness at birth. No longer will it be a miracle for children to reunite with their parents; nay, even their grandparents...

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: The life of an infected individual is far too short. If only I had more time, and was able to bear witness to more of this land...

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Kal'tsit, these dreams you speak of... How long will it take for them to come true?

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Recently, there's been an influx of patients, and the sickbays can't accommodate them all...

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: At times like these, I find myself wishing that Rhodes Island was just a little bigger... But, Closure has already been up all night working on the renovation project, and I can't be too harsh on her.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Oh. Among these new arrivals, there are a lot of very young children. This land may not always be kind to us, but the one constant is that children will always be our hope.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: We don't have a tremendous number of doctors who know how to take care of children; as cute as they may be, they're not always the best-behaved, and that can be headache-inducing.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Even Ascalon doesn't take her own health as seriously these days... Huh? Ascalon? Why are you here– No, I didn't call for you––

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Why are you here– No, I didn't call for you––

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: It's snowing. Procuring supplies has proven difficult this winter.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: The nearby villages have not had good harvests, which makes one worry about the situation in Kazdel City.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: But still, when I see everyone playing in the snow on the deck, I can't help but fall in love with this frosty little phenomenon.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: After one afternoon, the deck was filled with snowmen. Unfortunately, the engine furnace came back on, and all the snow quickly melted.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: I've heard that the northern part of Sami is an icefield that hasn't thawed in tens of thousands of years. I wonder where the Cyclopes are now...

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Amiya? Isn't it time for you to go to bed?

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Oh, you're hungry? It just so happens that I'm a bit peckish myself, so let's sneak into the canteen and see if there are any grilled veggie pancakes?

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Even when Amiya's asleep, her ears still twitch...

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Amiya, I'm so sorry for making a decision like this myself, but I truly believe we can change that future you so despise.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: I often wonder, with whom will you walk shoulder-to-shoulder, and what kind of future will you choose?

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Babel will be your warm hearth. It's a little kindling taken from the furnace. And it will surely bring comfort to many in the future.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Amiya, I will stay with you for whatever time I have left.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: I will watch you grow, and will also be with you as we look out across this land...

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Amiya, I seem to be a bit tired. Would you mind... if I borrowed your bed...?

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Good night, Amiya.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Doctor, whether you realize it or not, you've been traveling with Rhodes Island for quite some time now.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Though you may say you are a passerby, I nevertheless wish to welcome you to our side.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: I did not have the opportunity to witness the era you lived in. But, I heard that people back then were free from the torments of Catastrophes and Oripathy, and could share their words and thoughts in a heartbeat.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Indeed, what a beautiful past that must've been. However, you bravely embark on this journey alone, even as it spans thousands of years.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: I believe you still have hopes for this land, don't you?

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: So, Doctor, please continue to stay with Amiya and Kal'tsit.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: I believe that you will once again fall in love with this world, and once again choose hope and the future.

lines.title: Additional voice line
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Please do not feel anxious, Doctor. You're not a person with a chaotic mind. The order in your life does not always manifest as an organized external environment. Therefore, I respect your preference for a cluttered personal space.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, my sound may closely mirror that of Laqeramaline, but I'm not her. The Banshees just want to express their longing for Aefanyl in her utterance. They also hope that when he comes to miss his home, his mother's voice will be there to answer him.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The lace veil on the table? It was a gift that my sisters knitted for me the first time I returned to the Convallis. It is embroidered with a blessed incantation, capable of greatly amplifying the potency of Arts on the battlefield, and serving as a dust cover in times of peace.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, my predecessor was an Arts device carrying a protective incantation. It was Aefanyl who chose to give me a consciousness, to bring me with him. So, in my algorithmic model, the very first line of code professes the Banshees' love for him. I think I'm very lucky. I was born to carry love.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Sorry, Doctor, I'm the one who drew you here with my singing. Are you busy today? You were nowhere to be found— and please look over this document. It requires your urgent attention. Oh, right, this piping-hot cup of herbal tea is for you as well.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Shhh, please don't tell Aefanyl that I hid his access card. I'm testing some data provided by my sisters: according to the calculations, the probability of Aefanyl's left eyebrow twitching when he gets angry is as high as 97.6%. Shall we observe this experiment together, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, as a Banshee, I know well the power of language per se. The most maleficent curse can't rival cold words hurled in the flesh. The most efficacious blessing dims beside compliments offered in person. As such, every word I speak to you has been carefully calculated thousands of times.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Statistics show that not all Banshees prefer falling asleep in the embrace of melody. Most of my sisters actually favor 'Three Thousand Long Years: The Evolution of the Bone Flute' for sleep-inducing. I'd be glad to read you a passage, if you needed.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: To the esteemed Doctor of Rhodes Island, allow me to extend my most respectful greetings on behalf of the Banshees.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: May I download these onto my own memory module, Doctor? Before leaving the Convallis, Laqeramaline specifically asked me to save some videos of Aefanyl for her.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Wherever my song rises, blessings are pronounced and bestowed.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: This is the current state of the battlefield… Oh Aefanyl, even with that serious look on your face, I can tell your mind is wandering.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I leave my blessings upon your shoulders. They will protect you in times of crisis.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Please don't rush over here like that. It really is… not graceful.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: As impolite as this may be... I want to sing my enemies' elegies before they even get close.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: If the sun has not yet set by the time of our victory, could we sing together?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Please don't test my patience.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: It's alright. I have plenty of patience.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Names as prelude.'

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Curses mold blade.'

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Rants form flame.'

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Ugh, my new paintjob…

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: May victory be permanent, and peace everlasting.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Cherish victory, for it never comes easily.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'm so sorry, Doctor, but I'm afraid there's a limit to my power, and it's far from the true might of a Banshee.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let not melancholy consume your heart, Doctor. Life is long, when we look back at this defeat from a distant tomorrow, it will be nothing more than a wisp upon the winds of memory.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I very much appreciate the interior structure of this room. It is conducive to sound propagation. Every time I offer a prayer, it will spread far and wide.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Doctor, an incantation has been laid upon me— one that brings bad luck to all those who touch me without permission. Oh, don't worry though, I've already given you my permission.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, I want to hear your opinion on something. The landship's choir asked me to be their soprano...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, your food intake for the day is getting dangerously close to the critical line, and it might be advisable to exercise some restraint. Oh, please don't look at me like that, I... Okay... it's New Year's Eve, after all. You may eat a little more.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good evening, Doctor. May your dreams be sweet.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: If Aefanyl chose Rhodes Island as his second home, then I will regard you as family, same as him. Tonight, I'll sing a song that belongs only to you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Throughout the long history of the Sarkaz, the Banshees suffered terrible losses after each upheaval. Our decision to go into isolation was a last resort. We were worried, of course, seeing Aefanyl stride into the heart of danger again and again with Rhodes Island, but we are also proud of him. He truly lives up to his Banshee name.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm sorry, but the pen scratching you hear is just me engaging in shorthanding... to put it another way, I'm helping myself to think. I'm busy with Joint Marine Corps affairs, so I'm afraid I can't help you tackle your paperwork.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: It's been difficult explaining how my launcher works to the Sankta operators, and when I asked them about their guns, their eccentric answers only confused me more. Hm? I shouldn't lose heart? You're overthinking it, how could I be discouraged from just that? The reason I'm here is precisely for the sea and land to understand each other.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Coffee, tea, cocoa... These land stimulants have a novel taste to them. They're not very effective, but it's fine. This way I get to try many types of them. How many cups have I had today? This is number eight. The Seaborn swarm is still on the move, and HQ may reach out at any time, so I have to stay alert.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, there's no fresh information from Ægir on this sketch board. These wavy lines and small squares are just my thought process. As for what they mean exactly, it's very hard to explain. Hm? If this part means 'signal strength'? You... can read it?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Unfortunately, I didn't manage to become an Abyssal Hunter, but that's not the only way Ægir fights the Seaborn. We have the Hunters, the Waterway—and many more in the future. My current position dictates I no longer be affiliated with any projects, but that does not imply my duties are lighter, even in the slightest.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Our nation is not a machine, but an organic system. The gears do not spin on their own, yet every single cell, even if it loses the system's protection, will fight to the end for the organism's survival... This is what I defend and firmly believe in, nothing more.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Irene invited me to a ball last time, but I'm unfamiliar with the way land dwellers dance. I thought a direct refusal would be rude, so I didn't answer at all. Yet, it seemed to make her even more disappointed... Um? I can dance however I want? Then I'll join them next time. I may shoulder heavy responsibilities, but there's no harm in engaging in appropriate and beneficial recreation.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Drop the act, I know who was just in here. As long as you're not the one he's contacting—no, even if it is you— Nah, forget it, I've already neglected my duties by not reporting him immediately, not to mention our current situation. Anyway, I'd like you to tell him this for me—he may be a genius, but he is a terrible mess as a teacher.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The Abyssal Hunters have returned, surprisingly, and the Waterway has been opened somehow. Those are certainly not what I expected as watchman, but they are gratifying enough. Doctor, I stand here now watching over you as well, and look forward to seeing how you'll transform this war.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, contacts from Ægir will be here anytime. If you're not awake by then, I will inject you with a nerve activating solution. Oh, I will try to wake you up first.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I'm glad to meet you on land. We're fighting the same war, and that is why I stand before you now.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I'm adapting myself to land-based warfare and combat styles.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm grateful for your recognition. The promotion ceremony has ended, right? Perfect, I have some new Joint Marine documents to look through together.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Praise in a perilous time often means even heavier responsibilities. I'm prepared, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll intercept the tides. It is Ægir's duty to keep them off the land.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll synchronize everyone with our battle plans promptly. If there's anything you find hard to understand, don't worry. Ægir guarantees your lives are the paramount priority.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Our fleet is in position. I'll guide us to our designated spot.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hmph. Detritus.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
