lines.text: Some people on this team are as talented and impressive as Maylander's agents. I'm interested to see how this operation unfolds, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Call me Tin Man, ladies and gentlemen. For this operation, I'm expecting you to follow all my orders to the letter.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'll be finding a backup route for our operation.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: How about you take another way, good sir?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Let me stretch a little first. My joints are getting rusty.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Patience, my friend. Let me have a smoke first.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Watch out for voice; it's the best vessel for curses.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Even an old haunt has its perils.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't treat history with such a flippant attitude.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't imagine the future with such a narrow view.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Found your archive... Alright, destroyed.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Feel how your soul's imprisoned; it will be a lesson you won't forget.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: A few years ago, I heard some rumors about the Kazdel civil war. Seems time has not rusted your talents in this area, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I had a taste of it back in Trimounts, but your strategic planning and judgment here were truly impressive... Would you mind if I reported to the Foundation? They would be glad to know there's an outstanding commander behind Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They may have escaped the battle, but they can't escape the war.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's not a problem. Per our agreement, the Maylander Foundation is responsible for damage control. Leave this to me.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Pretty nice room. Maybe once I get used to it, I'll turn it into my new body... Hehe, Just kidding.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What do you think happens when a human touches scorching hot metal?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You... didn't spot me pulling smoke rings back in my body through the gaps, did you?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Kazdel doesn't have New Year's celebrations like this, but in Columbia, I always join the kids in the square for the countdown to the bell. As a Rhodes Island operator, I guess I'll have to satisfy the children's curiosity about this tin man…

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You had a light, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Me? How to decide a revenant's birthday? Umm... The day I was born? Too long ago to remember. The day I got a new body? Then I'd have too many birthdays to count. Birthdays don't mean much to me. But for you, commemorating something is a way to validate your own existence, isn't it? Happy birthday, Doctor. How about we go for a walk?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Columbia, Kazdel of the future, and even Rhodes Island share one thing in common—Youth. Youth represents everything. Doctor, you and I are from the past, but at the moment, we're defending the future. I believe Rhodes Island and Maylander's partnership will continue.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Back when I was an assistant at the shop, I filled the binders with hundreds of customers' preferences. Materials, hem lengths, even the number of buttons they wanted on the cuffs. Rhodes Island's paperwork couldn't be more complicated than––oh, w-wait, so much?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This strap buckle came from a Carnival stall, and the strap itself is an old measuring tape of mine. The hairpin was customized with a beading needle, and I embroidered this pattern here myself... It's too flamboyant? How silly, this is the pinnacle of Siracusan style. Get with the times.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The tailor shop isn't half bad. Let me tell you about two of my good friends: one went to the police academy, the other joined a famiglia. They don't speak anymore. But they're both customers here at my shop. They come to me when they need clothes made.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Nonno used to tell me all sorts of fanciful stories, so I wouldn't get bored in the shop. I've known those stories backwards and forwards my whole life now. There's no way I would believe—oh, by heaven! D-Doctor, a doll just floated by! In midair! Y-You didn't see it? No-no-no, I'm not kidding!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Once upon a time, I wanted to join the ranks of Siracusa's worthies, but Nonno only taught me how to hold a ruler and a pair of scissors. Still, with nothing but these two tools, he managed to win the respect of so many such worthies... There's still a lot for me to learn. And for now, I want to start with a new suit of clothes.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I thought the end of Carnival was just as cruel as Siracusa's old fairy tales. But when midnight came and the fireworks burst into the night sky, everyone could still truly celebrate together... I guess that's how a fairy tale should end. Ah, will future Siracusan fairy tales also be like this?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: It's alright, I can sort out these letters on my own. See, they're from our neighbors, de Montano's regulars. Even though they know that Nonno isn't around anymore, they still send their regards to the shop... Hmm, maybe this is what he meant by 'decency'.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, did you not sleep well? I can see the bags under your eyes. Why not take a page from my book and use some eyeshadow to make yourself look more energetic? Ah no, pretend I didn't say anything. I can tell that you're the type who never gets enough rest, but can always freshen up when it's time to get serious. I'll keep all the makeup stuff for myself.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Fold this corner first, go around twice like this, and finally tie it around your neck... Hmph, the scarf doesn't match your outfit. How about I just make you a complete Siracusan ensemble? It won't take anything I don't already know, so you might as well say yes.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: This thread goes here, this goes there... Ugh, it's all tangled anew. What, you think tailors never get their threads tangled?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: This is where I report in, right? Sorry, I came without getting changed first. Oh, I don't need to do that? Thank goodness, I feel more comfortable in familiar clothes.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Uhhh… can't be any harder than learning to tailor.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I appreciate the thought, but you really don't have to go out of your way to treat me like a child.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Ah, does this second promotion mean I can finally take charge on my own?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Trust me, I'm capable of handling field operations.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Formulating strategies? Phew... Okay, I can do this, nothing I can't handle. It's just like threading a needle…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Suit up, it's time to set out.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hmph. Tough customers.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Got a style in mind?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Got a fabric in mind?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Time to take measurements.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Ready with the needle.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: A waste of perfectly good fabric.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Oh, such awful tastes!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Hey! Stand still while I'm measuring!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Keep your back straight—tsk, tsk. Who told you to keel over?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Mmm, a perfect stitch!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: This tactic was tailor-made for today's battle!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Thank goodness we accomplished our mission. Hmm, why is there a loose thread...?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't worry. It's only natural to waste some material when tailoring a suit.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Any place to stash my toolkit?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: OK, OK, I'll focus!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, have you settled on the style you'd like to have made?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The mafiosi had their own secret ways of exchanging New Year's greetings. Back in the shop, we'd sew lace onto sleeves and gift leather wallets to our clients to celebrate the occasion. But none of these rituals seem appropriate for Rhodes Island. For now, I'll have to make do with a simple 'Happy New Year'.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ah, Doctor, what a spiffy ensemble you've got there today. Oh? This is what you always wear? Err... Well, that's worth complimenting too!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! Come and try this new outfit. I based it off the measurements of your coat to make sure it would fit. Huh? I made it too small? Impossible! You must've eaten too much cake! Uhh... *Ahem* No, no, that's not an issue. I have all the tools on me right now. Let me fix it for you!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When I set out, I grabbed all the spools of thread from the store, thinking I would advance beyond Nonno's level before they ran out. Now, with plenty of thread still left, I wonder, Doctor—if I might have already reached my goal long ago?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: File management? Alright, then. Teach me how. Okay... Sort them first. Like this? Then put them in order, by date… Uh. I tore the paper… S-Sorry. I didn't mean to.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Some of the people here. Don't you think they're a little too tall? No, I don't care. Not actually. How tall you are and how strong you are don't relate. I just need to bring every last one of them down.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What's my tribe gonna do now that I'm gone? That's a dumb question. See who has the bigger fists. The biggest is the new leader. Then they're done. That's it.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I heard a lot about Gavial. Like how she can crush a rock with her abs, and tear a raging beast apart with one hand. Is she actually that strong? Stronger than Chief Blaze? Warfarin said if I get treatment from Gavial, I'll know firsthand how strong she is. It's worth a try... Hm? Doctor, why are you stopping me?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I came here to get stronger, and that hasn't changed. Not just Chief Blaze and Gavial, there's a lot of people here worth challenging... What? I look happy? You're right. I sort of like being here.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The Rhodes Islanders. They all think too much. You too, Doctor. You have to think about so many things every day. You must be tired. You're not? You have to do it? Hmm, I guess that's true. There's a lot of stuff only you know how to handle. So it has to be you... Alright then, keep it up. Shout any time you need me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, I need help. The flower basket up there. Get it down for me. What? You can't reach either? This sucks... Okay. I got an idea. How about I lift you up?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Zumama's going on the same mission as me this time? Don't worry. I won't pick a fight with her. We'll have lots of chances to settle our score. Also, if we started fighting, that would make things hard for you, right? Yeah. I don't want to do that to you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: This flower. Don't you think it's pretty? I grew this one myself. Hey, why are you so surprised? I'm not so crazy about fighting that I only care about getting stronger. Having a hobby or two is completely normal, okay? You... You like it too? Then I'll give you this one. Not bad. It suits you.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, I picked a flower and... You're asleep? Aren't you lazy? I'll just put this flower on your head. Mm, looks pretty good.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: We meet again, huh. I'm the tallest, strongest warrior of my tribe, Flint. I hear you've got a lot of strong people around here? Great. I'll challenge them one by one. Oh, right. Do you know where I can find Chief Blaze?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Not bad. Very nice move. Doctor, I want to challenge this warrior! Where can I find him?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? Sure, do whatever you want, but I can keep fighting like I was already, right?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, you. You've been thinking too much. Any enemies, we can hit them away with our fists! Come. Relax a little. You need to loosen up when it's time to take a rest. Do you want to come over here and lie down with me?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got it. Shout for me when it's time to go.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: No problem. Leave it to me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We're going. Each of you, watch your cover. Don't leave any tracks.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Here comes the prey!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Let's do this.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: One round, let's go.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Will you come one by one? Or all at once?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Heh. I've been waiting!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Taste my fist!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: That look in your eyes, it disgusts me.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't look down on me!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You can find victory even without your fists? Heh. I guess that's your style...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Good job. Didn't know it, but you really are skilled.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Tch. Just some weaklings. Let them go. They're not worth chasing.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't blame yourself. It's my fault. I'm still not strong enough.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hey. Can I hang a sandbag or two in my room?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Uwah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Huh? What are you doing squatting down over here? You want me to pat your head?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: So much food and so many presents... Say, how about ringing in the New Year with a nice boxing match? It would be hard on Medical? How come? They've got Gavial.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Let's pull it together. Anything you need me to help with today?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here, a pair of boxing gloves and a bouquet of flowers. Which one do you want? Both fights and flowers can lift your mood, and I want you to be happier. It really feels like you're being too hard on yourself. Oh, know what? I'll give you both. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I used to be determined to beat anyone who looked down on me. It wasn't until I came to Rhodes Island that I found there were a lot more ways to prove myself. Say, finishing a mission, helping others... Yeah, I learned a lot of new things here.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: A little fowlie says you want me for your job supervisor? You asked for it, then. No bunking off.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: What's that? Bit of a din? Sorry about that, treacle. We work as we chat, we do. Say, did Feist ever mention? I can't sing a lullaby to save me life. We're all out building Londinium, keeping it going day and night, and meanwhile our little ones are nodding off to the clinking of our hammers.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You don't believe it, do you, when I say the kids here can't get enough of me? I talk about me metalworking, that's all, and they gawp like I'm straight out of fairyland. Got a few Sarkaz eyeing me like a ghost, too... Bet you anything they saw what we could rustle up in Londinium.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Rummaging scrap from the tip, forging a thing or two out of it, it's pretty run-of-the mill. Plenty of us did that for fun during job training, I know I did. You hammer down at first and 'BANG!', and you think to yourself, heaven almighty, what if someone hears me? But soon enough, you're going hammer and tong just to get it finished. See, now you know how we felt making the walkers.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Our Speaker's got a gorgeous name, you know, Vina Victoria. Right pain of a signature! I can see her practicing now. She asked me one time, get this, 'do you want a seat in Parliament?' But I think I'd rather stay in the factories, keep an eye on the kinds of acts she's signing in. She bloody well knows we're watching.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Treacle, I've nothing to hide. You'd find it crap too, having to shelter in your own city. The first step was working with everyone I could. Get them to safety, made more arms in secret, more munitions to fight back. Carried on until every factory was in on it. Luckily, some people did us a massive favor with their agendas. Reunion, you know plenty about them, right? I want to hear.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I need to thank you, Doctor, you did more than I ever guessed. If the airship hadn't fallen, we wouldn't be here now having tea. And while we're at it, I appreciate you not calling an old foundrywoman a 'war hero' for driving a walker. Let's be clear: us workers never wanted to be fighting the war.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Pardon me boy Feist. He's got inventions on the brain, and not much in the way of people skills. Got a bit of a ways to go. Lucky he's still alive to invent Londinium something new... That's not what really matters, though, I just thank the stars he survived at all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I'm getting on. Even without the Oripathy, my time's coming up, and I'm fine with that. Mind if I have a smoke...? Odds are, I'll be gone before I can hammer out the Londinium I remember. So be it. For each of us old bastards that kicks it, the city's frees up for a youngen.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Don't nod off here. If you want good rest, you sleep when you're meant to. Do things when you should, keep it to a rhythm, alright, treacle?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Save your hospitality, Doctor. I'm only checking in me grandson here. I'll park myself in your office for a bit, give him time to hide all his gadgets… Huh, don't constipate yourself either, just say the word if Rhodes Island wants a favor done.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Doctor, how many of you made it back safe and sound?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Now what's the point in decorating this old rust bucket? I suppose she could bang out a shinier medal for you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The war had us Londiniers all hammering away on the same line. It might be over now, but we're still thick as thieves. You've won the trust of a good lot, and I think you can imagine their power.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The old machine's getting on a bit, but she still runs as fine as ever.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Sure. I'll be watching this lot.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Keep your wits about ya. Even a factory machine can bite your finger right off.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Nothing to fear. We're here now. We're standing firm. We will win.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What do you need?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Got the ol' girl ready to work.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Here as planned.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: What? We've got secret tunnels of our own.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Brighter on the furnace!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Get that steam rising!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Cover your ears!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Victory to every Londinier!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: They say quenching makes or breaks steel, but without all the hammering first, you'll never get the good stuff. Haha, not half bad, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The grander the machinery, the tighter the little parts need to mesh. All credit to you, Doctor. You know how to make a squad tick.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The most precise tools aren't free from error, and sometimes we have to accept defects. Don't look back, Doctor. What matters is planning the next step.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: *cough*, *cough* *hack*... Did you really think it through, eh?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Whoo… Is all of this your little Closure girl's nonsense?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Need a hand with something?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doesn't smell of motor oil here. I'll have to get used to that.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's rare to hear the factories go quiet like this in Londinium. Even the snow can fall without being melted by steam. War's over now. Even if the snow's not as white, I'm sure people can feel that it's a fresh start. For those who have made it through the war, there's no better blessing than that.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Don't stretch yourself too thin, Doctor. I've spied with my little eye, Amiya worrying for you.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: What, you think I didn't bake this cake? It's a little fancy-pants, but I'll have you know, it's me who does up all of Feist's birthdays. It's like working a machine: practice makes perfect. So, happy birthday, Doctor, and thank you and your lot for looking after me boy.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Time's the most honest thing there is. Your manifesto won't prove anything. The tracks you leave on the earth, that's what matters… Not that you need me teaching you. I see that part of you, Doctor. The part that's always here to stay.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Come on, Doctor, I just got back from fieldwork. My arms ache, my legs are sore… Can't we leave this stuff for tomorrow? Pretty please? No? Tsk, stupid hood-head… My Rhodes Island pass is ready...? Ahaha! Just kidding. Right away, boss!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hey, you awake? C'mon, c'mon, snap out of it! And what's with that dopey look on your face? You said you were dead tired and didn't wanna work, so I told HR you passed out and got you some sick leave. Oh, that smell in the air? Dizzyleaf smoke. Isidro tried some before, and he slept like a log.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Who made this finshit class schedule?! Why do I have to sit in an etiquette class with those stupid little brats? And what in the saltdamned seas is this supposed to be? 'List of banned profanity: salty bastard, inquisition gilipollas…' Hmph, honestly, how is—Ow! Why'd you hit me...?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor! It's been two weeks since I applied for field missions. I was wondering if—What the hell? Three years with a clean record at Rhodes Island first?! Ahem, I mean, come on, can't you bend the rules just a little. Doing bad things in Rhodes Island's name? I would never! So... Please, my most esteemed boss. Help me, O Supreme and Invincible Commander. Oh, I beg you, the Great Doctor!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: So much stuff in my room? Not really. Only a bunch of pretty dresses, yummy snacks, and shiny gems. Hey, don't look at me like that! I paid for all this! I just wanna be surrounded by the things I've always wanted. Snuggling up to them helps me sleep at night.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've slept on beds softer than this one, as well as out in the Salt Flat, and on a ship's deck. I'll never forget how it feels, just like I'll never return to a life on the run. You know what, Doctor? One day, I'll have a nice, big, comfy bed all my own, and that's how I'll know I'm living the good life.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Listen, Doctor. Those Bastards at the Inquisition are nothing more than a school of starving saltfins. The moment they smell blood, they'll lock their dead finny eyes on you and mark you for death. Disgusting! Vermin! Stay clear at all costs! Wait, what...? The little bird I was just dancing with was an Inquisitor?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Any towns in Iberia I don't know? Pfft! I could show you where all their mayors hide their doblones. So what's this about? Ohh... You need intel but can't dig it up yourselves? And now you're... begging me for help? Hee hee hee hee. Well then, first of all… Address me properly, as Señora Pascuala.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Oye, Doctor, you think I could earn more in Columbia or Kazimierz? I hear those two places have loads of people who'll throw money at anything. The streets are a treasure trove of opportunity! Oh, don't worry, if I do get a big haul, I'll need you there to help reel it in.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: *Sigh* Imagine having a whole office to yourself… I wish I had one too…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hola, everyone, pleased to meet you! I'm your newest operator! Señores Elysium and Weedy recommended this place to me. I hope we can all get along—Hey, Pelirrojito! What's with the pretend puking? You got a problem with me?!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: See? Didn't I say I'm pretty good at this sort of thing?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A raise? Excellent! Oh Doctor, you are truly my guiding light, and Rhodes Island is the best company ever. I'll work here until the day I die! So, when's the next raise?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This is just one small step. I'll take another, then another, till one day, everything I ever wanted will be within reach.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Yahoo, I'm here and ready for another day's work!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Hello everyone, I'm your captain for today, so please listen up and listen well!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Careful out there—I'm not that good a medic.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Uwaah! My gosh… Please keep me safe, everyone!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What? Worried I'm not healing them right?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Relax, your operators have been good to me. I still have a conscience, you know.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: This here is a good spot. They can't see me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Check again, it's dizzyleaf smoke. If we can't take 'em down, this'll take 'em out…

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Remember to stand inside the smoke, okay?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The smoke won't chase you like a hungry saltfin, so stay put already!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: If anyone's severely injured, just let me know and I'll add more herbs to the censer!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Is my smoke toxic?! More herbs won't kill you, so stop whining already!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Wow, it's a privilege to be working with you all!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Not bad. If I hired one of you as a bodyguard, I'd never have to worry about danger again… What? I'm showing my true colors? Oh, you must've misunderstood. What I meant is, I couldn't bear to be apart from you all.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Frigging heartless bastards… You better remember this! I'll be back for my pound of flesh one day!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Didn't expect you to be so loyal, waiting for me like that! Now move it, or we're dying together!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hmm, this place isn't half bad.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey hey hey, ever heard of personal space?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh, it's you, Doctor. Want some water? A snack? Just call me whenever and I'll be there to help.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I don't really get what this holiday's about. What's there to celebrate about time simply passing by? If you ask me, people should celebrate when they get what they want. For me, I'll look back at all the hardships I went through, and cherish how they've become precious things I can hold in my hand.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor! If you need any help, just give me a shout!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Of course I remembered your birthday! Though I gotta admit, I only memorized it to get on your good side at first, but then... You turned out to be a real great boss, and a true friend too. Here, some rum I nabbed from the salt ship. For you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, I hope you and all the friends I made aboard the landship can live the lives you truly want. Heehee, who knows? Next time we meet, I might be rich and famous, coming to sponsor Rhodes Island!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Help you with your work? Okay, I can do street art, choreography, puppet craft... anything, really. What do you need?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: No, I don't know any Durins at Rhodes Island. Besides, I don't want to go back underground. You know why I left in the first place? When we voted on the monthly music genre, I tossed in death metal. They actually voted against me a thousand-to-one!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The graffiti in the corridor? I forgot to wipe it off. Besides, I went to fess up to Closure. And I got a gift for Aciddrop, since she took the blame. I even stepped in to clean for Purestream. You're not mad at me about anything? Hm, okay. So... Do you want to go tagging with me next time, then?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The bandages? Yeah, I was gonna use them to cover my Originium crystals, but they keep popping up all over me. A few little bandages can't get them all. It only makes the crystals even more obvious. Why keep the bandages? It's like a statement, you know? The crystals are there, whether you see them or not, and they haven't killed me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: After they destroyed the puppets my street art community made, I spent two weeks apprenticing with my electrician neighbor. Taking the new skills I learned with my Arts, my puppets became more than just artwork. Whenever I cast it, the puppets appear, and uppercut the bad guys as hard as I do.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: This looks like a coffin? Because that's what it is. Oh, could I trouble you to write a eulogy for me? Don't worry, it's for an art exhibition. Many people are 'further from death' than me, but they're still basically walking dead. I just want to give them a wake-up call.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The Society Tribune in Dossoles talks bad about our community. They called us 'sociopathic'. So I pinned a bulletin outside their office, telling them how we eat when we're hungry, sleep when we're tired, and love when we're lonely. If that's 'sociopathic', then society's pathetic.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: We beat Mateo down hard in the end, but storming the art gallery was a mess, especially when I led the charge to the balcony to save that bastard, Reynell. Some guys got hurt so bad they'll never hold a paintbrush again… This should've been my blood.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I told you NOT to pat my head! If you were anyone else, I would've thrashed you for that. Since you're not exactly tough, lower your head... lower... now close your eyes. Hmm... there! I just slapped a ticket on your head. Wanna know where? Go ahead, pat your head for it, hehe.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, I know I was wrong. I shouldn't have hidden my medicine, let alone tried to send it to Dossoles. Please don't be mad, okay? Wait... Are you snoring? Are you even listening?! Ah well, guess that means my apology is accepted.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Are you the Doctor? I'm Tecno. Ernesto sent me to Rhodes Island for treatment, so I'm here to say hi... Um...You're not calling me kiddo? Because you're a nice person, or because there are lots of Durins at Rhodes Island?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The way that guy fights, it's like some sick choreographed dance. I'm totally stealing those moves. Fighting or dancing? Wouldn't you like to know... hehe.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, ahem, well... you've always looked out for me. So I got my street art crew to make this bracelet for you. Ah? Wait, you've got something for me first? I... guess I won't argue, hehe.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, forget the medal. I got my art crew to build you a puppet—we're talking several stories high. Now I just need a hood for this monster. You got any spare outfits I can snag?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Beating up bad guys again? Count me in! My puppets and I will come in handy!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: A group fight? Leave it to me. I'll make sure everyone gets back in one piece.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I don't care how you fight. Just remember one thing: don't play the hero. Call me if things get messy.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hmph, aggressive. Looks like we'll have to settle this with force.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Out with it! I'm in the middle of stretching!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Give me an order. Me, and my puppets, are getting antsy.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm not used to being this high up. Can I go back down?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Okay, sure. My puppets should be able to handle these guys, anyway.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Box step!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Weight Shift!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Spiral Turn!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Hey, you! You're the one getting beaten! You don't have to follow my moves!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, why are you just standing there? C'mon, take my hand, let's dance!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew, another lesson for those who never learn. What a satisfying day.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Some of them got away? Let them go. You know the old saying, 'today's enemies are tomorrow's friends'.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Today you got lucky, but we'll see! Quickly, Doctor, we gotta run!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rhodes Island's facilities are impressive... I'm getting the itch to help renovate the art community. Have to pay it forward.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Puppet's right behind you. Hmmm, seriously? You're not scared at all? Boooring!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: A shoulder tap? Fine, so long as you don't pat my head.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Come! Check out our New Year's concert. Doesn't it make you want to dance? Hahaha~ Good music is supposed to make you jump out of your seat and dance! And Leithanian music totally fails at that!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Morning, Doctor. Still remember the dance moves I taught you yesterday?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Come dance with my puppet! Your feet are stuck in their joints? Don't. Move. I'll fix this... There! Now you've got yourself a mobility scooter! Happy birthday! Wondering how to get your feet out? Hehe, I'll tell you tomorrow.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, my old man just came to Rhodes Island to visit me! Who's crying? I'm not! Here, a voucher for Spicy Krysztauowa's Rhodes location. Go there! Go and eat! Don't you forget to use it!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You want me to help you sort these files? Alright... And double check the numbers too? Sure, leave it to me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Wow... There's a lot of people heading up on deck... What? Someone jumped off the bridge and they're organizing a rescue? But I didn't see anything like that when I was flying... W-Wait, they might be looking for me! Ohhh no, I've gotta clean up this mess! How am I gonna explain...?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Have you ever seen the land stars, Doctor? When I was flying over the frontier, the scattered bonfires were like stars sprinkled across the wilderness. Animals migrate to find a new place to live, but those Pioneers... I wonder if they dream of a nice, warm home?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Yes, this is a monitoring device. l'll stick it onto a fowlbeast, and then adjust the rhythm of my breathing to the data it sends over. That way, I won't disturb the flock while I'm flying. Ah, sorry, I'm babbling again... Umm... Any other questions, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: As a kid, I was really scared of the featherless monster fowls in the stories. They were always snatching up children. Even hearing the chirping of a real fowlbeast got me shaking. But after the first time I got plucked off the ground for real, after I got to see the whole land from above, I was never scared again. Um, you don't believe I got carried off by a fowlbeast? B-but it really did happen...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I learned some painful lessons on my first test flight. I lost my balance and almost flew straight into a cliff. It's all thanks to my glider that I survived. There's nothing left of it now, only these tattered strips of blue and purple. But I tie them on before every flight.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Once, I had an Originium slug pulled out of its shell and plopped down right in front of me. Can you guess who gave it to me? It was a mother fowlbeast hen. She decided I was one of her chicks, but I never saw her again once I left the forest... Well, I'll try to finish the slug soup, it's the least I can do.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I record my voice, so I can play it back to the fowlbeasts and get them to slowly see me as one of their own. 'Gah gah' means 'look at me', 'Ah-kah' is 'run away'… Hehe, it's all guesses, really, but you learned them pretty quick.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: That's the entire pre-flight checklist. Come on, Doctor, I'll be taking you up for a quick loop around. Don't worry, no need to be scared, I'll hold you tight the whole way through. Eh? Ah, uh, no, wh-what I mean is... We'll be strapped together while we're flying, so you can relax. I'm not going to drop you.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, this file... Oh, you're asleep? Go ahead and rest up, then. I'll come back later.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor, I'm Operator Contrail. Nice to meet you—you remember seeing a photo of me flying with a fowlbeast flock in the news? I-I'm glad you remember me…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: On my next flight, I'll try this super-tricky barrel roll…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thanks, Doctor... I love the medal. I'll hang it up with the pendants showcasing my successful test flights.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: 'Though it may fall a hundred thousand times, a chick still yearns for its first flight.' I've loved those words ever since I first read them. Doctor, do you think... I've grown?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Okay, I'll fly echelon.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Alright... I'll navigate then.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'm not afraid.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let me check the wind direction first.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Propulsion units and emergency ejection equipment, check. All systems go.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready for take-off.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: In the pipe, five by five.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: All units, watch for my signal.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Turbulence incoming.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: On me, stay in formation.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Brace yourselves, cumulonimbus ahead.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Is that fog...? Oh, just condensation on my glasses.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: A perfect flight record... Next time, we can try somewhere even further.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The two long white plumes up in the sky...? Yeah, those are mine.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Looks like there's still room for improvement... Maybe I should add a multi-speed pursuit module.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's okay, Doctor... Anyone could run into a storm. Let's rest up for the night and try again when the weather clears.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The setting sun, some floating feathers, a sea of clouds stretching out into the distance... No, not a painting, it's the view out the window.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, Doctor. Go right ahead…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: There's a black cloud in the corner of the test flight photo? Th-That's my tail…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: You're looking for peace and quiet on the deck too, Doctor? I'm still not too good with crowds, so I wrote all my New Year's greetings down on cards. I didn't have any other plans tonight, so I was just gonna stand here and look up at the night sky... Sure, we can look together.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I don't have any test flights planned for today, Doctor... You just wanted to chat? Alright, you've got my ear.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: This multicolored, feathered wobble doll... It means you should live life to the fullest and never give up. Huh? No, I'm not saying you should get all round and, and, and plump like this, and I'm definitely not saying you're too stingy... Ummm, I'm sorry, I'm bad at picking out gifts... Oh... You were joking? You're teasing me again, Doctor...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Starting from Columbia, twisting and turning all the way to Rim Billiton. Rhodes Island's following a long and windy course, just like a migratory fowlbeast. I'll be your wingman, but more than the destination, I'm excited for what I'll find along the way. You too, right, Doctor?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: This type of work is not my wheelhouse. I'll do my best, if you can explain it. What should I give you for teaching me? Well, my students bring me beans, grapes, and fins. Would any of those be appropriate?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Is it possible for Rhodes Island to adjust course five degrees to the west? Following this river would bring us across a floodplain. It may not affect Rhodes, but the vegetation there is fragile. The river would... no, I would thank you.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You can come out now, Doctor. The Medical people have left, but I'm sure they'll be back. Why are you avoiding them…? Me? Why bother wasting time treating Oripathy. Every day I still live is a gift.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Medjehtiqedti came looking for you. Remember to get back to her... why are you staring at me like that? I know what kind of place Rhodes Island is, and I won't do anything to the Sargonians here. But don't try telling me to 'empty the bottomless cup of hate' or whatever.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: If you ever get to visit Athenius, I could take you for a morning cruise on the Delphi Canal. The city is cool and quiet, with few people on the streets and few boats on the rivers. The sun rises over the temple and upon the canal, glimmering in the morning mist… I hope Minos never changes.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Athenius is not my home. The Sargonians destroyed my home. The Delphi Canal is wonderful, undoubtedly. But even the real Delphi River cannot replace the memory of my river back home, the night-veiled water where the fincatching lamps sway with the current… my first river.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: —Oh! …Sorry, Doctor. Did you knock the cup over? I'll clean it up. Sorry if I spooked you, it's just the sudden sound provoked me… I'm fine. Just didn't sleep well after hearing armored burdenbeast hooves in my dreams last night.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Where are you taking me, Doctor? This way leads to the Medical Department, and I don't think you're scheduled for an exam today. I came to repay my debt to Rhodes Island for saving my life, not to get treatment… Alright, if you insist.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I've seen off too many young people who deserved to live longer than me… when I think about how this sort of thing could happen again, I feel… fear. But why do I see the same fear in your eyes, Doctor?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: What burdens you so heavily?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: The Doctor, is it? Lena said I would find you here. Give me an order, if you need me to do something. Just don't put me together with any Sargonians. It's better for everyone that way.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Did you give the orders in all these battles?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You have my gratitude, but I must decline. I'm willing to fight for you, but I'm not interested in commendations—this one is for saving the pothos plant in the Doctor's office…? Thank you. I'm honored.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I don't believe in this peace you speak of. I will never give up my hatred. If the Sargonians ever invade Minos again, I will gladly trade my life for their blood. Would you still trust a man like me…? Alright, then.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Reporting.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Follow me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Understood.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: On guard.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Location secure.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Ready to move.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Death to slavers!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Down with tyrants!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I do not fear death!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Blood for blood!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: How do you do it? I don't mean your orders, strategies or even tricks. I mean how you dare to promise, even in the face of desperation.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You're responsible for victory, and the lives of those who follow your orders… it's a wonderful thing.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: No strategy is ever perfect. Don't be too hard on yourself.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The losses were acceptable. It's time for you to retreat. You're more important.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I can hear a poem being read…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What are your orders?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Sometimes you call to me without giving an order. What does it mean?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The mountains and streams on the outer plates of Athenius make me forget that it is a nomadic city sometimes. This place is different. It's an unfamiliar feeling, to welcome a new year with the scenery rushing by. Would you like to go out on deck? Maybe we'll see the first river of the year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You're early, Doctor. I saw a book of poems on your desk. Can I borrow it when you're done? I won't read it at work.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Could you close your eyes for a moment, Doctor…? Alright. Hear the sound of the Delphi River in spring, when snowmelt from Mt. Hymnoi sends a freshet down the Delphi River. For me, it's the sound of winter departing. I hope you like it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Might and mercy rarely walk together. Greed grows continuously when unchecked. But the Rhodes Island… I would not have believed that people like you could exist, before I saw it with my own eyes. I still don't believe you will succeed... but I hope so.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Anything you need help with, Boss? Good.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: We aren't allowed to sleep on the ground here? I'll put up a tent in the hallway, then… That won't do either? Why not? In my tribe, we'd just sleep wherever we were when we got tired.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, why was my application to room with Lancet-2 rejected? Because she's a robot? Uh, you're mistaken. The two of us are sisters now. She's my big sister, and I'm her little sister.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, are medics outside all like Gavial? When she gives me my Oripathy checkups, it feels like she's just trying to beat me up… That's why we always end up fighting once I can't take it anymore.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: High Priest? Right, he didn't come with me, but he did say he'd visit from time to time. Speaking of which, does he even know where Rhodes Island is...?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: It used to be my dream to build a robot as huge as the nomadic cities. Now, my dream is to build a talking robot as huge as the nomadic cities. Master Closure already promised to teach me everything she knows about machines.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Oh, I get it now. So, just like 'Great Chief', 'Doctor' is a title we use to honor the wise. Then, everyone will start calling me Dr. Zumama once I learn everything I can here, right? Oh, they won't?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, I was hoping you could come back to Sargon with me, when you have time, to teach me how to do all sorts of things there. But you look busy… In that case, can I ask Lancet-2 to go with me? Or Master Closure would be fine, too.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: People outside are always worried about things that don't matter, they even fight over them. It's so strange. You too, Doctor. You look like you're giving yourself a hard time about everything. Here, take this wrench. Let's build some machines together. I'm sure you'll like seeing a machine in the works getting bigger and better, bit by bit.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I'm starting to get a bit tired myself, watching the Doctor sleep… *yawn*…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I passed all the exams, so that means I can stay here, right? I want to learn how to build a talking robot like Lancet-2… Oh, codename? My name is Zumama. Can't I use that as my codename?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: To think there's someone who could go toe-to-toe with Gavial…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Is that something like going from a fighter to a warrior? …In that case, we have to celebrate. I think I'll enjoy a barbecue with Lancet-2 on the bridge tonight.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The High Priest told me how big and vast this great land is. He sounded kind of heartbroken when he talked about it. I didn't understand why at the time, but I'm starting to get it after spending so much time here. Vastness might not necessarily be a good thing.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Is it time to hunt?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What are we hunting?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Are you coming too, Doctor?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I just need to take care of all of them, right?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready to go anytime.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'll go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: It'd be even more efficient to take someone who can work with me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hold the fort? Easy.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You people are no match for Gavial!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I'm not all that weak either!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'll give it my all no matter the prey!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Strike! And got you!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: What a great haul!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Compared to Gavial, you've still got a ways to go.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'll go after them.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't worry about it. I've lost to Gavial too many times myself. It's nothing to be ashamed of.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Where's Lancet-2?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Y e a h ?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What do I need to do to become as learned as the Doctor?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, is there a holiday today…? New Year's? We welcome in the new year…? I don't understand, we don't have this holiday in my tribe. But everyone looks happy. Can I join in? Where is Lancet-2?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, good timing. There's something I wanted to ask you.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I think I've seen how you celebrate your birthdays. You make a wish and tell it to no one, in hopes that it will come true in the following year. Can I make a wish too? I can? Then, let's close our eyes… Hmmm… Oh, right, happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I read in a book that today is a day to show my loyalty to my boss and prove my sincerity. Doctor, I'm struggling with the concept of loyalty. This is a heart-shaped badge I designed and built myself on the Engineering lathe. Why is it heart-shaped? Doesn't that represent loyalty?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Still remember all those mineral geology facts I told you last time, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Pop quiz, Doctor! We've got three different ores here. Get their names right, and you can keep them all, how's that? Here we go... Wow, nailed it... Okay, you get this one too... Bzzt, so close! Just missed one. Better luck next time, Doc.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Come here, closer... Hold still... Don't worry, nothing weird, I'm just putting on some high SPF sunscreen on you. Our next mission's got some brutally harsh sunshine in store for us. You don't prepare, you'll regret it. Alright, come on, let's head up on deck and test it out!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hang the bag from my tail, Doctor. It's easier that way. Don't worry, my tail is way stronger than my arms. I'd say it's my proudest feature. And Grandma says people in certain parts of Sargon respect strong tail-havers. What do you think of mine?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: People ask why I don't collect gems, since they're supposedly prettier. But that's not the kind of beauty I'm after. Exactly! Gemstones have a defined beauty, but an ore's beauty is unbounded. I'm more into the whole 'irregular' thing. I knew you'd understand, Doctor!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Finding the ore isn't the end, Doctor. You take it slow, you analyze it, you understand it, and you find out that everything leading up to its discovery might be a link in its creation. And then? Then, for the first time, you truly feel the history of this great land.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Hey, why do I hear my own voice? Oh, it's you, Doctor. You're watching my old expedition videos. No, it's cool. I'm glad you've decided to unearth the beauty of minerals, or me. Of course, I'd be even happier if you just asked me straight.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I had a chance to visit a padishah's trove when I was little. There, I saw a massive piece of ore, its color as vibrant as my own hair. It was many years later before I learned its name: Wulfenite. That's what inspired me to start collecting minerals.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You saw my application, didn't you? I'm planning to start a channel here at Rhodes Island to introduce people to geology. And I want you for my inaugural guest. What do you think?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you bored, Doctor? Hee hee, let me show you my special skill: blowing just this one shock of white hair in my bangs. Watch! Huff—!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hi there, Doctor. I'm Wulfenite, and we're gonna be working together! Let's start by introducing ourselves. I'm from Columbia, and I love exploring, collecting minerals, and...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I can't believe what amazing adventurers are here at Rhodes Island! I need to work harder!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, I'd like to apply for a room to set up my own mineral showcase.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Look, Doctor! I passed my aptitude test, and now I'm qualified to lead my own expedition! There are a LOT of ore veins I want to survey. Will you come with me?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Where are we digging this time?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Leave it to me. I'm well prepared.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: No need to worry. Just stay close to me, and we'll be fine.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let's dig out some ores!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Did you find a vein, Doctor?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Wha? Another mineral trespass?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: What ores will we find today?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's drive out those troublemakers.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Leave us alone!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Ah, I've never seen this ore before!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Fire in the hole. Watch for falling rocks!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'm the hammer and you're the rock!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor... a hand, please... I'm exhausted... let me catch my breath before we continue the survey…

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Look, Doctor! I found a really rare ore! It's our lucky day!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Come on, don't give me that look, Doctor. It's low grade, but it leaches well!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's go back, Doctor. There's no ore here worthwhile.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Where's the warehouse? I need a place to keep the ore I just dug up...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wanna play tug-of-war with my tail, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey, Doctor! Good timing. Check out this ore!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: What are your goals for the new year, Doctor? Me? I set goals every year: where to explore and how many rare minerals to collect. I've met all last year's goals! We could set our goals together and motivate each other!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Let's go dig together, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here, Doctor, the mineral you wanted before. Took a lot of effort to find it, hehe. No, don't mention it! I did it because I wanted to. By the way, are you really gonna sit alone in your office all day again? That would be such a waste. Come on, let's go party!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I'm back! Phew... Hehe, Doctor, did you really think I'd spend the whole day in the mines? I rushed back for this important day. How could I miss it? Oh oh, come over here, quick! Look what I found on my trip!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Although I know this is beyond the scope of an assistant's duties, I would like to tidy up your desk for you before work. Something as simple as stacking your books into a neat pile helps manage one's inner biases and distractions. Would you like to try, Doctor? Don't worry, I'm here to help. Why don't we start with this little mountain of documents?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Why do I have all these bottles of ink on my desk? Are you an ink enthusiast too? Hehe, of course you can borrow some. I have Ceramic Gray for dignity, Feldspar Gray for simplicity and Cloud Gray for elegance. Which are you most partial to...? Oh, they all look the same to you...? Well, I do have some ink the Logistics Department gave to me. Let's get you started with that, shall we?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Baizao fare is defined by delicacy rather than dearness. The lingzhi mushrooms used in Fortune Soup need three years to mature. Tea leaves need prior removal of stems before they can be made into a bowl of tea soup rice, which imparts a light sweetness to the final dish. Whether a meal is frugal or abundant should not change the feeling with which you cook it. Whether your life is poor or rich should not change the feeling with which you live it. That is the bone and soul of Baizao.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Blaze is spreading rumors that I deal in ancient texts? Aww, this is but a collection of historical records. I simply cannot bear to see them lost in the long river of time. Ballads, proverbs, poems, even accounting ledgers. They all harbor secrets between their lines... Hmm...? Doctor, what was that you were hiding just now? Don't worry, I won't conduct any research without permission. Soooo, what is it you're hiding?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The first time I challenged my superior was over his demand to soften a satirical poem into something more pleasant. Yet to what degree is the truth distorted in the name of this pleasantness? How many narratives massaged? How many people... The chronicles of history cannot be a curated collection of comfortable tales.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The Yanese delight in leaving our mark on history, to accomplish great things worthy of record. But what did Father think? Did he ever feel regret? I cannot say. But how could one label him insignificant? A man like him is not mere marginalia or interlinear space… he is the very page upon which history is inscribed.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: You are full already, Doctor? No, you're not. Here, try a Laobing. It's a beastmeat pancake of Yang nature, and best paired with bamboo shoot and lily soup for Yin. Oh, and these seasonal apricot blossom pastries are an absolute must! Haha, I'll chronicle today thusly: 'Springtime wandering with a companion, our bellies full, bathed in apricot blossom shadows, sharing wine beneath rustling branches'. That is true refinement.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My relationship with Blaze isn't nearly as harmonious as you say. She's far less well-behaved with me than she is with you. I've apologized to her. After all, she could have led a peaceful life. What did she do? It was a forehead flick. With such force as to leave you dazed for hours. But thanks to that, I've found the courage to maintain our relationship thereafter.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Grandfather cherished his garden, though the two persimmon trees he nurtured bore fruit perpetually astringent, fit only for drying. We would wash the harvest, then spread them out to dry, finally dusting them with a sugar coating as delicate as freshly fallen snow. The sweetness would mask the bitterness, deceiving the tongue, rendering them unexpectedly palatable... Ah, what a pristine snowfall.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Perfect, what a flawless moment… each of us working quietly, our focus undisturbed. How about we go for a warm meal and a break? Say, in two hours' time?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Oh, I've already been introduced? Please, don't believe a word Blaze says. The girl still insists I'm a folk singer. I am Xingzhu, a historian of Baizao. If you happen upon any intriguing ballads or proverbs, I'd be delighted if you would share them with me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: How very educational. I've learned something new today.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This medal in my hand represents your recognition that more than casualties are worth recording on the battlefield. At times, there may also be primroses in full bloom.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: There is a saying I am fond of that goes: the unofficial history is built verse by verse, lyric by lyric. When I think about how I myself will be a verse in the mundane saga, I find it pleasing.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: A spot of field research? How wonderfu—*cough* I will keep safety in mind.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Bring forth all your prowess. My pen shall stand witness.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: It's a golden opportunity to gather folk material myself. Is there anything I should take note of?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: *Sigh* One cannot discuss ice with an insect of summer. However shall I explain this to you?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Very well. I'm on my way.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: The road ahead is bumpy. Do take care.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: A glance is all I need to comprehend.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: There is much to be recorded.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: My ink and pen may never rest, my stack of papers put to test.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: A humble scholar's duty is all I claim, the way of life that leads not to shame.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Cross mount and river, night of gale and snow, all blankets any whisper of my home.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Here, some poprice candy. Just a little while longer, okay?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I can finally breathe easy. Why don't we get something to eat, Doctor, once you're finished with work? I said after work. The hawker stalls aren't going anywhere.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmm… Let me ponder how best to commend your exceptional leadership. Yes, a Compendium of Extraordinary Talents would undoubtedly be less vivid without your story.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I've already meticulously documented the physical characteristics of the escapees. Would you prefer to handle this immediately, or take a brief respite first?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I don't think you need to be bolstered by those 'rallying' folk tales right now. Here, this should do the trick. Delightfully sweet and sour, isn't it? Feeling a bit better now?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: May I ask how to get to the archive? Oh, so it's not in the dormitories... Then could you please tell me where the library is?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh my! Please, keep the jests in moderation…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: There was a girl, with words so sweet, who stole two chops of burden-meat. She made two biscuits, oiled them neat, then gorged so much she had to bleat: 'Oh! Ouchie-Eek!'…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I used to detest the clamor of the new year, but now, I find myself with rather more complicated feelings, sitting alone in this courtyard. So I ended up writing a poem on the wall. Instead of wallowing in misery, I would rather whimsically spill my ink. Are the splashes not like silent fireworks, Doctor?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Have you eaten yet, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Oh, Doctor, I dropped my notebook at the noodle house. I need you to come along with me and—Why do we need to go together? Look, ah… erm… well… Sorry, I meant this as a birthday surprise, to offer you a Yanese longevity noodle. It's remarkably challenging for one who despises dishonesty to tell such white lies.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, we have a tradition of gifting each other books on commemoration days at the academy. I thought long and hard about what you needed before deciding on this: 'Calligraphy: From Amateur To Adept'—It sounds like homework? Nonsense. Just one page a day, and you'll learn to love the tranquility of mastering your strokes.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm a jack of all trades, master of none. If there's one skill I can say I have, it's whiling the time away.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hmm? Oh, these are test lenses, I'm sorting them by prescription strength… Indeed, glasses help us to see things clearly, but 20/20 eyesight is far from enough to truly see the land for what it is.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Reunion? I was with them for a brief moment. The bonfire that is life... You see, they still have much flame left; meanwhile, what am I but leftover ashes, cupped in the hand, waiting until I scatter to the wind.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Was I distracted again? Sorry. I was just glancing at the drizzle and mist outside. It's the bane of wanderers. The mud traps our feet and the mist blinds our vision, making every step feel like wading through a bog, and I mean that literally.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I learned Gaulish pugilism as a form of self-defense when I was an apprentice in Lingones. It hardly differed in technique from plain street brawling, and it was already lost by the time Gaul fell. Hm! I might even be the last in the land to remember it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: There's only one way to free myself, and it perfectly coincides with Rhodes Island's goal. That's why I choose to stay, to help others, in hopes that each day, little by little, I get closer to... the end.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: In my great-grandson's eyes, you know, I see his grandmother. He visited me, but I wasn't the stranger of the family this time, nor was I struck with pain to see the lines on his face. We've made great progress both. We met, and bid farewell to each other in peace. I could envision no other ending for you and me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: See? Tilt the lens just so, point it at your kindling... and poof, fire. Got the hang of it? Good. Not that I recommend it as a technique, no. All that fussing with sunlight and angles? Just grill with an electric grill instead.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: These involuntary flashbacks and déjà-vu are beginning to affect my work. The young lady from Medical suggested I carry a notebook with me, so I could jot keywords down to piece together later. Her other advice was to find someone who could help verify the content of my memories. And well... here I am.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I can prescribe a pair of glasses for you, if you can't read what's on the… Doctor?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Nowell. I've made glasses for your patients, and I know a little about medicine... I'll be spending some time here.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: That one's carrying an umbrella, but it's not raining... oh, it's an Arts Unit.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I didn't do anything worthy of this medal, but... Thank you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I still await death with a passion. It may be that I never repay Rhodes Island for its kindness. Even so, do you still insist on this... reward?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: My experience working alongside others is limited.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You don't need me in the rear?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: *Sigh* Let's go, then.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Follow me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Alright.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll take good care of them.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The light is shining at the right angle.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hang in there.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: If you're wounded, stay behind me.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I'm here. I'll help you.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Will there ever be an end to conflict like this?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We have saved some lives. That's something.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Making mistakes is a human thing.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Go! I have the rear… Go!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Any place to rest is fine.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Unfortunately for me, with age does not come heart disease, Doctor.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Being an optician doesn't mean I have any vision problems. That's to say, I can see you, Doctor. You don't need to get so close.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Once, it tortured me to see doors and courtyards dressed in festive decor, a cruel reminder of time's passage that one could never escape, a far cry from the intended joy. Thankfully, things are different now.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've heard it's your birthday. When you blow out the candles and make a wish, don't let anyone hear it, for those with cruel intent might exploit it… Just a joke. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a ship that gives sanctuary to those on a long and arduous journey. Those who find this vessel no longer need to wander, to measure their remaining lives with their feet. If only I had... no, it never could have been.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I dunno what this assistant thing's all about, sorry, but hanging around, doing our own thing? That's me all over. Run into someone, belt out a tune, share a wee bite and a pinch of cheer, then we move on. That's the way of it.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Even with an empty post bag and no Catastrophes on the horizon, I'd still be wanderin' with my burdenbeasts in tow, never stoppin' in one place for long at all. Mm... Lyin' on their backs, fallin' asleep under the blanket of a starry sky... The further I am from them, the more I miss that life.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Down below, whether I'm in or out, I can't see the sky at all, sorry, I'm happier staying on the top deck so. There's a Lupo girl's tent pitched not quite securely. I helped her peg it with some rope and stakes, heheh, now it won't go flappin' mad as the landship goes full tilt.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I went down to have a look at where you forge your weapons. The furnace is massive, and its flames get the tin red-hot! The ceiling is real low though, and there's only one lad mannin' the whole place. He the one who makes all the weapons for you? 'Boiler room'? What's that?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Hmm, there's this legend about changelings: the Dead swappin' wee ones who'd end up as wakemen, stuck guardin' ruins their whole life. But I know Nemos' not like that. Born in the ruins, she up and scarpered off; became a wakewoman and then chucked it all in. These legends? Nothin' more than tall tales, when it comes down to it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: To forge this blade, I ground some burdenbeast bone on a metal crab shell dusted with lime powder. Next, I set the blade in the polished handle, grippin' it tight, even when I slept, to knit the bone and iron together. Then I Spun the knife 'round to mark me path, and just like that, I bid me clan farewell. Once I die, this knife'll guide me home.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Got a letter back for you, Doc! Feels mighty strange saying that. When I wasn't helpin' Nemos, I'd be tearin' about warnin' folk of Catastrophe, maybe deliverin' some final letters along the way. Other Catastrophe Messengers are like bridges, but me? I'm more like a stone you hurl with all your might.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The rope I got you's all tangled up? Odd that, it's slick with beastoil... Alright, here's the trick: first, loosen the twists, find the longest strand, lift and stretch it open 'till it makes a hole, slip your wrist through, then give the rope a good tug outwards. Tada! Got you tied up tight as a drum!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I know how to use comm devices, and I keep one on me always. If I don't answer while I'm out, means I'm too busy. But Doc, if you've got need for me, or just want a look-see, stand up on deck and call my name. The wind'll carry your voice to me, faster than any device.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: No bonfires to watch here... Think I could draw a me on the wall to keep the Doc company?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm a—Err, what's the word again? Catastrophe Messenger, right. Call me Brigid. Sorry, got a letter here for the Doctor of Rhodes Island. Know anyone by that name?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Can we bring these up on deck, watch them outdoors?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I've helped deliver a few of these bits of metal before, but the recipients always cried. Emm… since it's a happy moment here, those must've been tears of joy, surely?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: If you keep pinnin' these metal trinkets on me, I'll run out of space on my shirt... But I've no mind to trade 'em away neither. Would you be willin' to keep 'em safe for me, Doc?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got me knives polished, when're we headin' off?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Like heading off into battle, yeah?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I think we ought to run there, personally.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Alright, time to focus! Can't let the quarry go!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Need me to have an ambush set?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Just tell me where to go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Just so you know, this here's a knife, not a boomerang!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Weather not looking too good? No mind, my knife'll slice clean through the fog.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'll chase you to the ends of Tara and back.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You can't hide from me.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You gotta flick your wrist, just like that!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I've been here too long. Let's wrap things up.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Men or beasts, they run all the same, eh?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmmhmm♪Hmmhmm♪Hmmhmmmmmm—hmm♪ Hmmhmm♪Hmmhmm♪Hmmhmm...♪

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Didn't it turn out grand? Let's go, I'll roast up some meat for you!
