lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Does victory wander like a burdenbeast?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Like I could reach out and touch the ceiling, same as Na Saoirsí.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm? Wouldn't be pushing me like that, Doc, gotta put your back into it!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Fancy how the hair on my tail curls up?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: 'On the eleventh knell of the bell, carve a Trinity Knot rune onto a stone. The comin' year's bad luck will go into the stone, leavin' you with a bright and breezy future.' Some of the legends teach ancient wisdom, guidin' people towards better lives. I practice it every year. Go on, give it a try, Doc.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You should really walk more often, Doc.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Back in me clan, birthdays always mean green cheese made from cystymilk. A bite of this cheese is like eatin' the moons themselves, so when night falls, your fire—your very soul—won't be snuffed out by the twin moons' gaze. So come on, Doctor, I made it with me own two hands!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: If I had never come here, I might never have known there were such wide open spaces beyond Tara. Though life aboard the landship's real interesting and all, I still much prefer to get me own two feet movin’. Afore my fire burns out, I'll keep runnin' and runnin', just like I did back in Na Saoirsí.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I've done a few accident writeups before, but this lot's important. Reckon you'd better check them for yourself. I don't skive off, do I? I've changed these bulbs here. How's that? Makes reading clearer now, right?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doin' delivery in the outback takes a lotta guts, but even the toughest truckie's got things they avoid, like those metal crabs poking holes in your tires. Me? Since I joined Rhodes Island and quit driving, it's none of my business. Speaking of which, I saw a broad here's keeping those crabbies as pets!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: It's kinda stuffy in here, reckon I should crack a window? Ever wondered why truckies hang their arm out? Comfort, sure, but also cos the wind tells stories. Sounds iffy? Thunderstorm's on its way—wanna bet on it?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: This gizmo goes everywhere with me. Designed it myself, still a work in progress. I was set on 'Nutty' for a name, but Potlid's not a fan. You're better at this stuff than I am, got any ideas?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Give us a spin, Nutty! Take a gander, there's a tire repair kit, a jack, and a remote-controlled spray gun! Nutty can solve anything you throw at it. Huh? What if there's no vehicle? Ah, I was considering installing an engine…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Looking for me? Didn't go far, just popped to Engineering for a tick. Closure's been promising to upgrade Nutty's voice module, but she's always busy. Thought I'd swing by and see if I could lend a hand. Cause trouble? Not likely!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Wouldn't believe I was a miner once, would you? Wasn't for long, but the feeling lingers. One swing of the pickaxe, and you're gamblin' with a cave-in or a strike—pure luck. Luck's not fair, and you sure can't count on it, but sometimes it's all you got.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Wanna tuck into my lunchbox? Yeah, it's Potlid's cooking! Got a good nose on you, huh? I was coughin' so much last week she's been seeing to it that I get pear stew every day. Who's the kid now, right? She's so mature, makes me feel bad. You get moments like that too, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Autumn and winter mornings bring a pea soup fog to the road. All I could do was switch on the fog lamps and push on through. Was only when my ute got out of the fog that I could wipe the sweat off and check that Potlid was still asleep. Lucky? I reckon so.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sleep tight, I got your back.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, just call me Lanns like before! Sure, I'm on a break from the outback, but I brought my tradie skills with me. See, here's my Artificer creds. Intern? Huh! Becomin' fully fledged is just a matter of time.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Frame rate's stable, colors are real vibrant too. Crazy good display tech you got here… Huh? Combat skills? Oh, I know how to sneak up on someone and whack the daylight's outta them!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion already? Feels like I just finished up my intern days! Hah, I getcha, Doctor. I'll keep at it, maintenance and combat both.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You taught me a loose screw can cost a war. I might not really see how it goes down like that, but I'll make sure every single screw is tightened down. This sort of work? You can count on me, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: No wukkas. I'm Alanna of the Barrenlands after all. What's that mean? You'll know soon enough.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'll take the wheel, you take a breather.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Hold on tight now, things might get rough.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Get 'em in their heads!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My turn now?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready to go anytime.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Deploying device.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Dang it, sprained my leg—Just joshing, mate.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Come on, Nutty!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Nutty, high-power mode!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Think you can dodge this next trick? Wanna bet?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Beep—beep! Terminus, everybody off!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That was rough, Doctor! I thought you'd got yourself winded again.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: All in one go! Good load of combat data this time, too. Thanks heaps, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We did pretty good already, so just let them go, yeah?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Come on, make a run for it!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Don't know if I can have a snooze here without all the clinkin' an' clankin' around me.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Alright, what are we betting on this time?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Take a squiz at this electric welding torch I just got! Wanna give it a go? Slow down, goggles on first.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Fancy a bevvy, Doctor? We got a tradition of drinkin' ourselves silly on New Year's Eve. I can deadset leave a whole bunch of truckies legless... Huh? Drunk drivin's bad? Nah, this ain't beer, it's carrot soda!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, lemme know if you wanna go for a ride, yeah?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: There're so many days in a year, you gotta save one for yourself. Even the most hardworking diggers can't stay down in the mines all the time, right? So, let's get you out of your office. I'll even take you out for a spin after your birthday party's over, how 'bout it?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When we'd just arrived here, I told Warmy Rhodes Island was like a big big transport. She was really excited when she said 'So the Doctor's just like you, a truckie at the steering wheel!' Haha, she's not wrong there. Your work decides the direction Rhodes Island sails, Doctor. Well done, mate.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Don't worry, this is all routine work. I've reviewed the correct process numerous times. Now... how do I edit these permission logs again?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Yes, I declined Dr. Warfarin's request to perform a scientific examination on you, as per Kal'tsit's instructions. She wants to study me too? It's worth considering... She could assist with analyzing the knowledge and memories I've acquired. I know what she wants, and our goals are aligned.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm getting used to speaking plainly with the operators, Doctor. They've been cooperating with my check-up requests, and I'm addressing their concerns as Kal'tsit would, in the ways they're accustomed to. Our coordination has become increasingly seamless. Oh? There's been a steep drop in Medical appointments?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Why abandon a more efficient, more robust form? Why would I prefer others not fear me? I never considered this before. I made an unconscious decision the moment I awakened. Hey, are you done staring? I can still easily string you up— Huh, you're saying this is what she meant by 'humanity'?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Amiya's gone to chair the elite operators' meeting. Hmm... She now appears much taller than I remember... how odd. I'd like to spend more time with her, Doctor, but I find myself feeling rather anxious— We can go together? That's a great idea! Err, I mean, a sensible suggestion.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The anti-Originium communication lines have been destroyed; unable to confirm your receipt of this transmission. The Crystal Activity Index continues to surge, and I've observed its escape from the void. Meltdown protocols initiated. I will eliminate all interceptors. Find her... and Kal'tsit.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: 'Protect the Doctor. Protect Amiya.' This directive indeed holds the highest priority in my core behavioral protocols, but this doesn't mean I am compelled to execute it. Protecting you is my own choice— And definitely not because I'm trying to trick you into dealing with an angry Closure!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Projekt Red likes to curl up and rest by my side, while Folinic always sweetly helps me with things I've overlooked. How should I respond to the way they look at me, Doctor? How did Kal'tsit first learn to love...? I do wish I could hold her once more.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: It was the end Kal'tsit had long anticipated. She prepared well, and faced it with composure. She loathed idle speculation about the future, and just the same refused to dwell on the past. 'Keep going.' I believe that is the only message she would have left us, Doctor. We should just keep moving forward.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Wanna hear some stories about Kal'tsit? The kind she'd never tell anyone.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Leave my file here in the Medical Department, Doctor. Like Kal'tsit said, this is the core where Rhodes Island addresses critical challenges, and my knowledge is crucial. Now, let me concentrate on accomplishing my mission.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I saw her.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: She ended our cycle of reincarnation, granting me freedom and eternal life... and loneliness. Yet I cherish it, Doctor. It reminds me of what I have lost.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: So long as a spark of hope for life remains, the unending cycle of despair cannot shake me. Not even Originium may force my life into stasis, Doctor. AMa-10 has shattered the fate predetermined at her inception.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: When necessary, you'll see a more familiar side of me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Do not worry, I've fully mastered the art of tactical command. Don't fear injury, I guarantee you'll make it out alive.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Make certain my claws don't scratch you!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy engaged. Let's end this quickly.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Communications, linked. Your orders, Doctor.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Deployment optimized, ready to go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Mon3tr, in position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Switching forms.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Ruin, and restore.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: My talons shall be my stethoscope.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This may sting a little. Just bear with it.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Ahem, sorry, I used too much force…

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Some cut-to-the-chase commanding. Promise me you'll deploy me closer to the enemy next time, Doctor. I'll try some more efficient techniques.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Wait a moment, I need to collect tissue samples.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'm fine, I already learned how to heal myself. Leave the cleanup to me. You don't want to see what comes next.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Stop struggling! You always liked it when I had to carry you during a retreat, didn't you?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: No priestly eyes on me now, right?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hee hee, did I scare you?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm getting used to my work and responsibilities as quickly as I can. I will be ready for our reunion.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: A new year, and you're still punctual as ever. That means the season's first scientific exam will be your reward— You didn't come to Medical for an appointment? Oh, is this... a present for me?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Birthdays are special for us. We can't say for certain when our lives started. But at the very least, you have your answer deep within... This gift… Kal'tsit hesitated for too long, and never got to give it to you. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You are reminiscing about the old Rhodes Island—about all the tragic destruction we witnessed, about the happy reunions we celebrated. But no matter how time wears away our precious memories, the ark beneath our feet will press ahead on its course across the lands. Come, Doctor. Everyone's waiting for you.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Your decision-making acumen is a great inspiration. Would you permit me to observe you for a while longer?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: As a work institute, Rhodes Island is just outstanding. Strict yet flexible scheduling, rational evaluation criteria, a clear promotion track... Where did I learn to see things this way, you ask? Well, my... relations are quite versed in the field.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You don't need to tell me―this is a 'soda fountain', isn't it? When you mix different drinks together, you can get surprisingly refreshing results, you know.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: We as band members do have disputes from time to time, but it's all in service of raising the band to greater heights. Ave Mujica is unshakable, you know.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Memories of dreams all fade away someday, don't they... Don't be mistaken, Doctor. I don't rue the fact for one moment. I know full well it was a life I never could have had in the first place... The chance to at least dream such a beautiful dream is more than enough for me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I owe it to the days I've spent on Rhodes Island for reshaping my outlook on Terra. This vast land is filled with people living cruel realities that far surpass the imagination... I have a new resolve to see if I can reach these people, with songs that might nestle in their hearts.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I had a dream, before I came to Rhodes Island even, that we were all living here, working here. I can recall it so vividly even now, as clear as any memory... Hence, when I greeted Vigna-san with a 'Nice to meet you', I couldn't help but feel a twinge of estrangement. *chuckle* Do keep this strictly between us, please?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, this is that 'bridge' I was telling you so much about! Here, you can shout everything that's on your mind out loud, and it feels amazing. I'll demonstrate for you first, so would you mind following my lead after? Here I go―

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Oh, this doll? I received it from Bena-san. *chuckle* When I place it by my side, I feel this sort of warmth cozying up inside me, somewhere near and dear to me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You can't forget how necessary rest is to improving results. During the fledgling days of Ave Mujica's formation, I'd often stay up working throughout the night. But Uika gave me a talking-to, and that was how I finally learned my lesson. *chuckle* 'It's not good for your health!' Her words.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Oblivionis of Ave Mujica, Sakiko Togawa. Until we find a way back, I would be much obliged.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are our everyday activities going to be recorded on video too?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Compared to the other squad captains, I have a great deal I must learn still... I will henceforth devote my utmost efforts to keeping pace with you all.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: To be given recognition comes hand in hand with greater responsibility. However, I am of course prepared for that.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: It is time for our teamwork to be put to the test.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I will spearhead my members and see our mission through, as I ever do. It is as simple as that.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Now, let's begin... tonight's masquerade!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: How bothersome...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm sure you and I are drawing up the same plans right now, Doctor.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor, your decision please.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Time will not wait for us.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I have no time to waste on feeling lost.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The doll takes on a temporal life.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The moon will press closer and closer on you.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Even so, will you still seek solace?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: In this twilight paradise, I will continue to reign!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I must commend you on your show of tactics just now... Was this victory just one more surprise, courtesy of you?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was a spectacular battle—well done to all of you.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Just a little more...!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I... hate myself.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What a sanitary workplace. Its constant maintenance is all but evident.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Kyah!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Might I be of assistance in any way?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I happened to be in the training grounds this whole time, and only realized it was past midnight once I heard the cheering coming from outside... Allow me to give you my first greetings of the year, then—a very Happy New Year to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning to you, Doctor. There is to be a masquerade tonight. Do come if time permits. We have a special seat waiting for you.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: 'Happy birthday to you'... I was taught this song when I was still young. In the days after I'd learned it, I would keep playing it every day to my heart's content... I may have perturbed Mother somewhat with that.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I'm honored I could greet this special day together with you. Since the moment we first arrived, the sight of us all striving for the same goal has done wonders for the spirit.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: If there's nothing to do, I'll... be here.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Since when was I in the Activity Room...? Since... before you came in...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Vegetables... could grow well here.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You want me to play the guitar? Okay.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I got this fragrance from Perfumer-san. She says Gloria uses it too.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Heheh... It's nice to... meet expectations.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: So you... also waver, and can't make up your mind... I... do that a lot...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Saki once said... we're all 'badgers in the same hole'.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Here, nobody recognizes... Minami-chan and Ta-kun...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Did I wake you up? Sorry.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Mutsumi Wakaba... Nice to meet you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I can tell... this isn't just for show. These people, they really died.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I need... more practice...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You're... praising me...

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Okay.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I think... Saki should be better...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's get started.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemies... they're coming.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm... ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm prepared.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I've got no... choice...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I can't... fail.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'll try...

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: These enemies aren't all that scary.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Just don't... think at all...

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Just do it like I practiced.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Thank goodness.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I didn't... fail this time.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Thank you for... covering for me...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I... messed things up again...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I'll be... right here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What is it?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm practicing.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I was on stage just now... No, not Ave Mujica. The Rhodes Island play. I was a tree.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor. I didn't have any nightmares, last night... What about you?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy... birthday. This is… your present.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It's so lively outside. Are you sure you're not going...? You're staying in? Okay.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's funny, Umiri-chan always handles these things for us in Ave Mujica. So here, I have to adjust to managing my own schedule.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Lately, I've been stargazing on the deck with Astesia-san. The stars in Terra's sky are nothing like the ones I know. And when I tell her about our version of astronomy, I can almost see her hanging on every word I say.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Huh? You want me to teach you how to write lyrics...? Wait, Doctor, don't look at my terminal!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The cap and sunglasses? They're for wearing in crowded places, I guess. I work in the performing arts, so I'm kind of... a celebrity? I guess... Wait, Doctor, could it be you're a celebrity on Terra? Heheh. Look, you always have the hood on.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Sora-san always has such a warming effect on people, even when she's not performing. It'd be nice if I could fill everyone with that kind of warmth too.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'd rather heal us all through music than fight. But... I get it. Becoming stronger is how I stay by Saki-chan's side. That's why I'll always keep putting in the effort, whether here on Terra or back in our world.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Ever since coming to Rhodes Island, we members of Ave Mujica have been spending a lot more time together. Once work's done for the day, we head to the studio to practice... It's kind of like we're all in a school club.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Ave Mujica has always meant so much to Saki-chan. And knowing how she treasures it, I want to protect it for her... I want to keep being Mujica's frontwoman, where I can live, breathe, and embody Mujica's world.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ending up in a strange place and having to bond with strange people has taken a lot of energy, I'll admit, but getting to learn so much in exchange has all been worth it. I still barely know right from left here, but... I'd like to keep on bonding with the people of Rhodes Island, I think.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Maybe I'll brew some coffee and wait around until the Doctor wakes up?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Uika... Misumi. Huh? You already heard about me from Saki-chan? How did she describe me, can you tell me?!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are these all... actual battles you taped?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island's training program is incredible! I feel like it's building every part of me up at once. This is going to make concerts so much easier too!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I don't know when I'll end up home again. Is it really okay for you to pour so much into me, despite that...? Alright, thank you. I'll be sure to work hard to meet your expectations, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: As the squad's frontwoman, I'll lead the way for you all.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I've never been a leader to anyone before, but... I'll serve as a good example for you all!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Be careful out there!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't let your guard down. We can definitely win this!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'll help out!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Doctor, I'm trusting you.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: To your curtain fall... an elegy.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: To our victory... a paean.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'm going to sing.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Saki-chan, everyone, I'll protect you!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'll cover you now!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't panic!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: After getting back, let's take a nice hot bath, put on some relaxing music, and really unwind.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We're really getting into sync here!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I just hope nobody got hurt...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's okay, I... I'll always be by your side.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's really nice in here, isn't it!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: One moment, let me put my guitar away... Okay, sorry about that. What do you need, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor! Want to go see the stars together?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Back in our world, everyone makes a wish on New Year's. Like this―you put your hands together, and close your eyes... If you have a wish, give it a try. It'll be nice if yours comes true too.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good timing, I was just brewing coffee. Do you want some?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor! That tape's got a couple of songs on it. We wrote them for you, and for everyone at Rhodes Island. So even after we return to our old world someday, you'll still have these songs by your side forever.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When I first got here, I thought I was practically useless. But Rhodes Island is such a warm place, isn't it? It takes in any point of view, it gave me a role that I could play―I guess what I'm saying is, maybe I've earned the right to pride myself, as a member of Rhodes Island?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Ah, Doc! Say, anything need doing?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Oh, my god! If I did a vlog in here I might rake in major views, maybe? No, c'mon, obviously I'm not really!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm kiiiiiiinda busy right now, save it for later~

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You ever notice how Rhodes Island is just full of all kinds of operators? Everyone's got their own goals, their own talents, it's a real show. I kinda wanna get stuck in and interview around!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Why do I volunteer for practice? Obviously you give everything you've got for your dream, right?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Whaaat? You've got more work for me? Alright, but in exchange... No, nonono, I'm kidding! If you and Amiya-chan are gonna put your trust in me like that, what am I to do but nyam-up and work my butt off!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: No way! Do you see all the cute ops here at Rhodes Island?! SO blessed! Just need to get them in a makeup vid... Ahah, I can see the views rolling in already!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: So like, a ton of the kids in Medical are fans of me now! So I'm thinking, rule no.1, gotta give the fans what they want, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I keep thinking lately. About reaching my goals. 'Cause doing whatever it takes, grinding away all on my own, that's been me. But hey, maybe it's nice to detour a little too, once in a while. That might be because everyone at Rhodes Island is so nice.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Huuuh. Doc fell asleep. Well, if you're asking to get pranked, who am I to say no? Nah, kidding♪

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Good morn-nyamu-nyamu! New hire Nyamuchi reporting in! Nice to meetcha♪

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hell yeah~♪ Can't stop Nyamuchi evolving~

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What's this? Oh, I get it, you're in with the Nyamuchi fans now?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: That's right, I've been putting in tons of work, yeah? Keep that praise coming my way, yeah?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: ...Okay.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Wait, so I'm leading? Not Sakiko?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Okay, showtime~

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ah, enemy spotteeeed!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm right here~

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm? Need me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: C'mere, c'mere!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I got this~

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'll show you what I'm really made of!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Take that!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Let's turn up the energy!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Nuh-uh-uh!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ahahah! We make a seriously great team, huh?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Total victory! This means time for an afterparty! C'mon, let's do it!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Grrgh... Next time, I'll nail it...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Are you gonna be a downer? 'Cause we need to think about what went wrong and why.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Oh, wow! This is a killer spot you Rhodies have got!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Nyamutto♪

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey, chill out, chill out~

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! Another year of heading onward and upward for me! That's right, you too, Doc, onward and upward♪

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Nice work out there, Doc!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday~! Here you go, a present for you. Now, can I expect something nice when Nyamu's day rolls around?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Must be the Nyamuchi influence livening up Rhodes today, no doubt about it. Where's my thanks, Doc? Thank me~!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You can leave that paperwork, I handled it already. Any issues, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I've noticed Rhodes Island's ops don't tend to hold back on strength or personality. But nobody clashes with anyone. They're all able to treat each other with respect. I don't know what to make of it, honestly.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Vigna invited me to see her perform live. She's got impressive guitar skills. I'm really looking forward to it.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: No need for concern. Practice time and rest time are both fully blocked out on my schedule, and I've given myself plenty of leeway in my work hours. I'm never going to collapse.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: As long as Rhodes Island is going to look after me, I owe it to your people to help you out.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The relationship between you and Amiya-san is a good influence on everyone else. Just one of those Rhodes things. The people here all think of each other as family. I'm just as honored to be able to contribute.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: These honey biscuits Ceobe-san likes are good. It's hard to stop eating them.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I know everyone at Rhodes Island has their own troubles, but they all prop each other up through whatever they're going through. I really owe a lot to them, especially you, Doctor. I'm very thankful.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: A boatloads of squads requested for me to help them out with things again. I'll work through each task one by one for everyone at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm... Doctor, I see you're still working at it. Here, a chocolate panna cotta to keep you going.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Umiri Yahata. If you need anything, just ask.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I like the efficiency. I'm taking notes.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm just doing what I'm supposed to.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm happy that everyone at Rhodes Island has accepted me. Perhaps they might even be able to fulfill my wishes too, don't you think?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You want me to lead? Understood.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's get going.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I expected this. Let's go.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm? Need me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: In position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Right on target.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This is easy.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Hrnph!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Excuse me.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete. Couldn't have done it without you all.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was some nice leadership, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: That was a close call. We need more practice under our belt.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's hustle. We're not going to leave anyone behind.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: So this is the area I can freely utilize? Where's the training room then?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Eh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Yes. I'm here.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor. Happy New Year. I'm looking forward to our new journey ahead.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Want to head to training?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: There you are. Doctor, happy birthday. Here's your cake and your present. I guarantee it'll be good. I've had that store's cake before.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You know. Little by little I've opened up, here at Rhodes Island. Now I can put my own thoughts out there without worrying what others think of me. I have the people of Rhodes Island to thank for that, as well as you. So thank you, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I'm sorry, Doctor. This girl's sick today and nobody's to take care of her, so I brought her along. She's quiet and really well-behaved. Besides, she can fold a paper napkin into a lily. Dear, why don't you give the Doctor these flowers? You'd make the Doctor very happy.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Come out! I can see you, you know—oh, Doctor! I'm so sorry! I thought you were one of the kids playing hide-and-seek. Why are you hiding in here? Oh, someone is trying to drag you back to work? Well, I don't think this box is big enough for you. I could help you with my tail, if you wanted.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Yes, this hymn is an arrangement of a Bolívarian folk song. You can tell? It's quite different from the original. Does it matter, though? Everyone loved it when the arrangement made its way back to Laterano.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Why is there an axe behind the saint's statue? Oh, I think I left it there after cleaning up some bandits that got into the abbey. I have to put it away before the children see it. You mean, sacrilege? Of course not. Our Lord would approve, if He knew of the wicked deeds they did.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I always knew Laterano well, but it was only when I heard a gravely wounded nun singing hymns on her deathbed, with no trembling in her voice, that the black-and-white image of Laterano turned vibrant, and our Lord's grace dawned on me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The first time I came to Laterano, it had suffered a calamity attack, a broken city filled with broken souls, hardly the image of paradise. Was I shaken? I guess I was, but nobody ever said that faith is only for that which is perfectly flawless.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Aurela should not have spoken to you like that. Allow me to apologize on her behalf. She's not easy to get along with, and I wouldn't even call her a good person, but we all need 'bad friends', for the sake of our worst thoughts and emotions, things that I would never show to a good person like you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Let the ancestors' legacies lie forgotten in my mind. It's enough to pick up a few tidbits from time to time as tales to tell the children. What I really want to remember, well, is the excited looks on the children's faces when I talk with them... and the smile on your face right now.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: What was taken from you? You try your best to suppress the wrath in your heart, but I can still sense it, so intense it could destroy everything. No, I'm not afraid, Doctor. Release it, and it will energize you, pushing you forward, until you take back everything that was yours.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sleep, Doctor. There's a wicked creature out there in the night, clad in feathers and scales, that hunts children who stay up too late, impaling their hearts with its sharp spiked tail. What? You say you know her? I... I just made that up...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Gracebearer, a nun from Bolívar. Give me your hand, Doctor, and our Lord shall grant you His blessings.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: They should be more decisive... this will only create complications.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for your generous donation. Your name will be etched into a century-old monument, with that of the abbey's founder.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I really appreciate Rhodes Island taking these children in, and away from Bolívar. They deserve some light and warmth at the end of their lives.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I would be delighted to join your team, Doctor, but... I'm hoping you will stay away when I'm fighting. Maybe you wouldn't mind it, but to me, you're too good of a person to have to face that.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: No... don't make me take even more of them, Doctor.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I'll come back at the appointed time... or an hour late. I'm Bolívarian, after all.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Do not fear. I'm just bringing you to your predetermined end.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: ...Very well. You have my axe, if you need it.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Don't worry, Doctor, I have my axe here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: There are certain things I must handle personally.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'm not the one who will regret letting things get to this point.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Close your eyes. I don't want to scare you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Cover your ears. This might get loud.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: No need to scream. It's all over.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Shh... it'll be okay. Everything will be okay.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I was lucky. I didn't encounter any enemies—the blood on my skirt? Oh, I must have tripped and fallen. Don't worry, it's just a scratch.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: It's done, Doctor. Let it go.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Turn around and find someone else, Doctor... I don't want you to see me covered in blood.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Go back. Sleep well. Everything will be alright by the time you wake up in the morning... Go. Back.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: How did you find me? You followed the singing? I was humming while working alone. You've never heard me sing… Well, one should not sing the same songs alone as with others.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, it's you, Doctor. Don't sneak up on me like that again.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I sneaked some extra sugar beneath your bread when we took Communion just now. Did you notice?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Would you like a bowl of cream soup? It's an honor to have you—oh dear, don't do that, children! Oh, look how they spilled soup on you... I'll get you a change of clothes. Hm, looks like all I have handy is a nun's habit... do you mind?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: May the Lord bless you and keep you.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I know it's rude to get drunk at someone else's birthday party, but it's been a long time since I've been able to drink to my heart's content like this. No need to worry about the children, no need to worry about shells falling on our heads out of nowhere, and no need to worry about what may come tomorrow.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Am I imagining things, or is there something sealed away in your mind too? Something chaotic and complex, no less than the knowledge passed down through generations of K'uk'ulkan... Promise me, Doctor, that whatever it is, you will not allow it to take control of your life and replace it.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Press 1 to confess, press 2 to place an extra order of donuts, press 3 to rent a firearm, press 4 to be connected to an operator. Please note that pressing 4 will redirect you to representative Saint Closure if this platform is onboard Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: You have access to all my convenience features, including but not limited to confession, in accordance with the user agreement. Such as: a dessert shop directory, leisurely transit, saint figurehead touching and photography, holy scripture reading, and firearms training. Please note that no personal care or hygiene services are available.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: An operator bonus—for me? I see. So you were giving bonuses to the vending machines when you put coins in them late last night... I am the only one who counts as an operator? But hearing confessions is a common public service, and there is no fundamental difference between my nature and that of the vending machines.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Please do not send me to the Engineering Department, Doctor. Only Exusiai, who has been educated in faith assistive engineering, is properly equipped to render assistance and is available... yes, it is a serious issue. My mic stand is displaced by at least five millimeters, threatening to undermine the confession experience.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I will now boil water for you. Due to the considerable quantity of water on Terra, it will take some time to complete the process—Wait, stop hitting my chassis, I am not broken—yes, it is true that my language logic has malfunctioned to a degree, but this contributes to the production of 'jokes'. This is the part where you laugh.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Yes, I have recently been fitted with a voice-recording function. Your confessions contain many enlightening words that I must ponder. May I record your confessions, Doctor...? No, I have received no directives from Saint Closure to this effect, absolutely none.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You are destroying all civilization on Terra? Not a problem, Doctor, I have heard even more radical thoughts in my time... you say this is not the same? You should not be too hard on yourself, even if it is a material burden that you carry and not simply an exaggerated expression. May you have the chance to choose your future in peace.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: There is a charge for sleeping in my cabin, Doctor.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Laterano Automated Confessional 047 at your service. Please create a user name as directed in the operating manual. Thank you for your cooperation.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Is playing back images of humans engaging in acts of violence against one another how this 'Rhodes Island' comforts penitents?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Charge all operator confessional fees to your card? Understood, Doctor. I will safeguard their mental health on the battlefield.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I am unable to direct operators to their proper positions, as I lack command experience. However, I will speak to each individual operator and ensure they find their ideal positions themselves.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I am afraid my wheels are not designed for off-road travel. If speed is of the essence, perhaps you could carry me?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Please adjust your facial muscles to make your expressions as friendly as possible. That is conducive to the completion of my mission maximally utilizing non-violent persuasion.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Never fear, I am listening.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Do not worry, I am not going anywhere.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Please insert your Signa Creditorum or swipe your citizen credit card before beginning your confession.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You may obtain donuts from my cabin if you are in need of calories.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: If you prefer to confess by physical means, I am able to meet your needs.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Please do not stand in front of me. I lack the firing accuracy of a Sankta.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You may use me as cover. The repair bill will be sent to you following the operation.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'He who hideth his own sin shall suffer.'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: 'He who is begotten of the Law shall conquer with faith.'

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: These poor souls may not have put their wicked thoughts to action had I arrived sooner.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I feel my bumper burning... should I mourn the carving on the bumper, Doctor?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I suggest you leave first, Doctor. I shall engage my self-destruct sequence to delay the enemy… My apologies, you need not worry. I was actually just going to attempt a second round of peace talks.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Do you want me to confess to this 'Rhodes Island'? How should I make payment?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Lateran customs dictate that the door is opened at the point where the gaze of the saint figurehead on the bow meets the third vertical line on the door, by knocking upon it in the rhythm of the fifth verse of Psalms.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You should know that there is currently no one in my cabin, Doctor.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: One moment, please. The angle of my quadruple vehicle-mounted patron firearm, can be adjusted to fire upwards, although it will take some time... mm—oh—ah—there. May I now present the spectacle of Laterano's New Year fireworks.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: May I bring you peace, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: All believers are equal before the Law. Payment is a necessary part of the confessional process, regardless of whether it is the penitent's birthday... Oh no, my fee meter is stuck. No, such a little thing must not be allowed to delay your confession. Please enter and confess the depths of your heart.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Humans share joy and happiness with each other. A confessional hears only the thoughts not suitable to share with others. But today is a rare occasion, Doctor... may I ask that you put some colored lights on me, as you have done with 'Rhodes Island'?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Omigosh, a close-up chance to watch the Doctor at work. Finally, I'll get a glimpse of Rhodes Island's secrets! Huh? You just want me to tell you a scary story to keep you up? Seriously? Fine, two choices then: The Headless Burdenbeastman of the Barrens, or The Thousand-Year Curse of the Sargonian Tomb. Which one, Doc?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I never imagined I'd see two familiar faces from Wrankwood here. Nah, I'm not that interested in them personally, just curious on how they ended up on a pharma company's landship. They must have some kinda angle here!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What am I looking at, standing here on the bridge? Uh, I was just thinking how Rhodes Island's such a great place. Look, sealed spaces, high mobility, destinations unknown, everyone's using code names... doesn't it feel like a survival-slasher horror flick?!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I tried doodling a 'Slenderburdenbeastman' symbol on this corner of the corridor here, but no one's reacting to it when they walk by. Why? Not enough Columbians onboard? Nobody knows the legend?—Relax, I'll clean it up once my experiment's done.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The device on my back's made of suspension cables and hover units, and I'm the only one with anything like it in Wrankwood. I met my master who taught me how to retrofit it on a little production. He spent whole days there with a jetpack on his back. Dunno where he went after production wrapped. Omigosh, you might have seen him in Sargon?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Look! Timestamp three-seventeen, see how the vapor turns the smile in the makeup mirror into a spooky face—this clip's one of my best! I tried it at home once when I was a kid. All these people came by to talk about how great my drawings were, only to get a nasty shock. I just knew it was gonna be super effective.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I joined Greta's crew because she promised me artistic freedom, but that was another load of crap! Meeting Miss.Christine and Lucian gave me a lot of inspiration though. Don't you think it'd be fun to make a horror flick about a storm-cloudbeast exorcist?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Nah, I don't butt heads with my parents that much, I just don't like how stiff their pictures are. And I didn't like the path they laid out for me either. But... I guess I've got a long way to go before the skills and resources needed to put together a real spectacular movie.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When I was starting out, I joined some little production crews, hoping to meet interesting people, but I ended up so busy I couldn't get a convo in... These days, at least I got you to lend me an ear whenever I come back onboard, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Oh, busy? Suits me, Tippi can take care of herself. Let's see if there's anything new to watch... Omigosh, an nonconformist Lungmen horror comedy... let's do this one!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Live long and prosper! Tippi 'Skyriftwalker' Booker reporting for duty! Who, Doctor? Oh, Skyriftwalker's the code name I thought up for myself! Uh, that's not how you do code names here?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The protag gets a videotape everyday, describing her life bit by bit, until one day the video shows her killing people... don't you think that fits the vibes in this recording? No? For reals?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: That's it? Pretty mid ceremony. No test or anything like that?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I get another promotion? Does this mean I can go some places I wasn't allowed before?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Omigosh, this a co-op mission? I'll get along real nice with everybody.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Ooh, just got a new idea! Let's try it out!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: C'mon! Let's go see the wonderful sights waiting for us out there.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: An extra special spot we got here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Finally my turn to make a move? I'm in a good spot!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Spray gun and hover unit ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Let's set the rigging!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I've almost finished this piece. Just a sec!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Some deep purple for a sense of mystery.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Bit of dark red to get your heart pumping.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: A little lime green for a weird rotten vibe.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: The stage's set, now let's see how everyone performs!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Now this is a perfect work of art! Lemme just tag my name in the corner here real quick.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: So much for Wrankwood war movies.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: That was an epic experience!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let me edit that op's recording. I might just come up with a new kind of horror flick.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: So I can't tag the corridors, but can I spraypaint my own dorm walls?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Keep on tapping the device on my back, and something scary just might pop out.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Don't worry about me, if you're tied up. I can keep myself busy. Oh, you're done? Wanna watch a movie together?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Watch a New Year's blockbuster together? Sure—'Famous Columbian husband-and-wife producer-director duo collabs on joint production for war film...' Okay, Doctor, I don't mind going with you, but don't blame me if I fall asleep halfway in.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Want me to spray some colors around to liven up the place and brighten your mood?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I always had big parties as a kid. The adults would use them as an excuse to socialize, like with totally zero thought to what the birthday girl wanted. Wasn't the biggest fan. So for your birthday, I redecorated your room based on your favorite movies this year. What'cha think?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island's a proper pharma company, I've seen that with my own eyes—too bad it doesn't have the stories I got up here in my head. But Doc, you're full of mysteries, so I have to keep watching you for reference material. And who knows, you might even star in your own horror movie one day.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, when you chose your office, did you realize there's a spot on the landship, perfect for a cozy little sniper nest overlooking it? Where, you ask? If I told you, would you allow me personal use of the space?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Please reconsider these patient placement clauses, but first, kindly sign these cooperative pharmaceutical R&D forms. Also, may I trouble you to look over my proposal on the mobile plate transfer once again... I'm scary when I smile, you say? Then do your best to get all this sorted quickly, alright?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Yes, this is your office. I took the liberty of revamping it and adding a few confetti guns and a scripture disco-ball here and there. You say El caused an explosion here, while trying to cook some popcorn with her gun...? Yes, I knew that, but as they say back in Laterano, 'an explosion unseen is an explosion clean'.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My signature? Ah, I did contribute a little to 'Botanical Review', yes. It wasn't anything I had to do for work. Rather, I simply had too many types of flowers around my sickbed. One time, Mostima was in such a rush, all she could offer me was a potato that had started to bloom. With that many flowers on hand, how could I not learn a thing or two about them?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: This scrape on my hand? Just from getting a little physical. During fieldwork, you sometimes run into the types who simply have no respect for the ill. Fiammetta was just about boiling over, so I saw fit to educate them in a... fitting manner. I may not mind, personally, but that doesn't mean I have to force my friends to ignore it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The rulebook for cardinals may be as thick as a stack of three apple pies, but it's nothing that complicated. Checking on new arrivals to see how they're settling in, seeing if people are doing alright at the monasteries... After all, without them, what would even be left of Laterano today?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Here, some cold cystymilk, apple-scented smelling salts, an eyemask, and some earplugs. Hold onto them tight, they're about to start seating people. You were wondering what sort of films I liked to watch, and, well, I think every entry in the 'Edict Terminator' series is brilliant, but it's good to be prepared if you can't handle all the blood, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: No need to avert your eyes, Doctor. Sure, I'm not quite able to leave this wheelchair just yet. Some wounds simply don't heal quickly... If you feel like assuaging your guilt, how about granting me authorization to use your autonomous operation platforms? 'For transport or for racing?' Oh, don't worry yourself over that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Are you always so quick to notice when someone is watching you? Oh, forgive me, it's a habit of mine to observe others. It's how I weigh the reasons I might need to take care of someone, against the reasons to... 'take care' of them. Which one do I mean for you? Work in peace, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm? Oh, I was just looking at a shadow across your window. A habit from my days in the hospital. What does that shadow look like to you?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Pleasure to meet you, Doctor. Just Lemuen is fine, thanks. Would you rather discuss work with a cardinal of the Seventh Tribunal, or show El's big sister around her workplace? The choice is yours.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Right there. You edited out one of the gorier scenes, didn't you?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: After having worked together all this time, why are you only getting around to this ceremony now? If you were too busy, you should have asked me to help.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Ah, you laughed. Giving trust and receiving it are one and the same. Both acts that put people at ease, no? Then, would you like to receive this medal from the Seventh Tribunal for outstanding cooperation, to put me at ease? You can have two, if you'd like. You could even pin them on your eyemask, one for each eye.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: No need for introductions, I'm already familiar with everyone here.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: No need for reports, I can see what everyone does from here.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Please, this is no time for excuses.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Please, this is no time for pity.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm in position... No need to guess which position.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Whoever said a wheelchair couldn't get up onto a steel beam?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Oh, I should try adding a jet engine next time~

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Target disarmed.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Target crippled.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Target eliminated.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Who would bear the news of your death? Ever crossed your mind?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, can you come help me out? My wheel's stuck on a tile... Alright, hold out your hand. High five! Oh, the wheel? I pulled it out myself.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission accomplished. There is one more thing, though. Logistics gave me far too much tea and cake. Would everyone like to help me lighten the load?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'll go handle them.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'll keep watch behind. No one will give chase.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Surely there's no speed limit in Rhodes Island's corridors?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: That finger of yours would be more suited to tickling the ivories, I think.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Would you like to push me along for a walk?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I'm giving some gifts to operators I went on missions with. I still have three boxes to go, and it would be terribly inconvenient if I don't deliver them all before work. Could you help me out? The sooner we get these delivered, the sooner you can have a present from me. Sound good? Let's get going, then. Hold on tight, now.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Where are you headed today, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Now that you mention it, have you ever thought of making up for past birthdays? I understand you spent several years asleep due to some unfortunate accident as well, correct? I know you might not mind, but the time we lose is never only lost by ourselves. Come, there's still plenty of time today to hold a few parties.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: To fight against disease and injustice... What a noble message. We have a similar speech at our annual meetings at the Seventh Tribunal, but it's a lot shorter than the celebratory gunfire segment... Hmm? I'm just getting a piece of candy. I know you're not simply going through the motions when you speak, so I'll be listening to the very end.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Forget it. I'm almost retired, and it's about time I enjoyed some leisure... there's no end to work. How about you stop shutting yourself in here and go outside with me for once? It's a fine day out there.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The young man at the front desk gave me a huge cake. Good thing a few kids passed by, and they got through the whole thing pretty quick. Take it home? No, there's only me at home, and I wouldn't be able to finish it before it spoiled.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why ask about His Holiness? I can't tell you much. We never quite saw eye-to-eye from a young age, though we managed to work together for decades because we shared the same devotion to the Holy City. Even today, I wouldn't say we're much more than acquaintances... but then, perhaps the fact that we're not friends is precisely the reason we've been able to tolerate each other for so long.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I was delighted when Fia said she wanted to become a gun-knight. Nothing makes you prouder than your child wanting to take up your mantle. She being a Liberi was no obstacle at all, smart and hard-working as she is. And I would have done anything to make her dream come true. But kids grow up, people change...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: There were lots of friends I tried to convince to stay, but failed. It was only a long time later I realized it wasn't because of me that they left, but because of Laterano. The city's glory is like the sun, its brilliant radiance suffers no stars. But it is the duty of the stars to shine upon the night where the sun does not.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Laterano has been turned on its head. The old Law is gone. But I still have faith in the Holy City, and in the ties that bind us to one another. Otherwise, why would those who left the Holy City return to defend it together with me... right, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I heard Fia made some friends here. Does she get along with the others? She's got a sharp tongue, but deep down she's hiding a heart of gold... I guess it's my fault for making fun of her too much when she was little. But then, where's the fun in raising a child, if you don't make fun of her?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: What a tear-jerker. I should've picked a comedy for movie night. How embarrassing, crying my heart out like that in front of you... the tear glands get so much weaker as you age, you know. Say, am I imagining it, or are your eyes even redder than mine are? Come now, no need to fight the tears.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: This letter? Oh, it's nothing, just word that an old friend has passed away. I personally escorted her out of the Holy City when she contracted Oripathy, many years ago. I don't even remember what she looked like, how awful I am. I wish I could've seen her one last time, even if it meant getting punched in the face.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Feel free to lean against me if you're tired, though I'm not exactly soft. This suit is almost as ancient as I am. It's gone through quite a few major overhauls, but it's still a... reliable partner.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: A pleasure to meet you, Doctor. You know me as Fia's grandpa, if you've heard of... the Sankta Miksaparato... I really regret letting Fia fill out my recommendation form.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: That was one wild shot from Fia. Reminds me of when I was young.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What is WRONG with your medics?! Do they think I'm a child? A medal just for cooperating with medical personnel? Shouldn't that be common sense? And… what're they giggling about?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You see all these medals? That Vampire told me to come here to claim my prize. I can't guess what you're going to give me. Another medal? Is it a 'collect twenty to get the grand prize' deal?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll help, but you'd better sit down with me for a mug of mead once this is over.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Why do I feel like I'm taking a bunch of kids out to a picnic?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Why does this suit of armor feel like it's gotten tighter, especially around the waist? Thankfully, my gun still feels the same as it ever has.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: What are you doing standing there? Come at me! And don't expect me to give you your last rites!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Good, a chance to try out my new hip.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: My bones will get rusty if I don't exercise.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll hold this ground all on my own.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Don't underestimate these old bones.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I will not fall.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: You will not fall.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: No one will fall.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: No one will touch that which I defend.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Blood? No, I'm not hurt. Just a loose tooth that fell out. Lucky, spares me a visit to the dentist.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No need to thank me. I hardly broke a sweat.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Are we done? We should go home, then. If we didn't do bad, then I say we did good.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm fine. I've been in worse pickles before. Come now, don't look so sullen. Maybe a bit of ice cream will cheer you up? My treat.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Anyone in the mood for some classic Lateran soap operas? They're pretty good up to the point where you fall asleep.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Take it easy, you'll shatter my old bones.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: A little pot of tea, a big plate of raspberry pie. Let's sit down and talk.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Don't complain about me being late. What's half an hour more or less? Have you any idea how long I waited for Fia to bring you folks to see me in Laterano? Besides, I still need to fix my hair since it got crushed under a helmet all day.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I brought some pastries. You can share them.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I heard it's your birthday. So I brought a vintage from my cellar to join in the fun... Oh, no need to be so polite. A bottle doesn't compare to a good time spent with friends.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The people by your side will leave you someday, Doctor, but they're never truly gone. They are the stars adorning the sky that is your life when you look up at night; distant though they may be, the light they leave behind for you will never die.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, let's try a simple test. How many of the snacks I put on the coffee table did you sneak off with?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Don't worry, Doctor. It's true I pay no attention to my surroundings when I'm deep in thought, but Dendie and Axie will keep me from bumping into anything or anyone. Who're they, you ask? Why, my mechanical arms here. There's a lot they can do.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The kids have given me a lot of nicknames, like 'Squinty' or 'Four-Armed Braintalker'. It's fine, and even normal I'd say. Kids their age just hate being seen through. Though, hehe. If they're unhappy about it, they could simply practice and try to trick me.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My Arts are all about perceiving and manipulating electrical signals. That lets me understand the people around me better, though it also makes me oversensitive to details. For example, your right trapezius muscle has been discharging an abnormal signal, so I think you should adjust your sitting posture, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, I'm glad to see your face in my classroom. The Infected of Ursus walk the razor's edge, but—correct, there are many ways to deal with those who employ violence to conceal weakness. It seems you know quite a bit, so don't we conduct a pop quiz right now?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Do non-Sarkaz races also have the cultural concept of the soul? A complex question. Though, the signals I see in human bodies are not just the pulsing rhythm of life, but also emotions in bloom engraved within. Sometimes they are just blazingly bright, like the flames of a soul.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, I'm glad to see your body's signals indicate you've had a stable lifestyle lately. That wasn't sarcasm, you don't have to confess your negligence. Physical health aside, I think it's good to keep a steady rhythm, like the readings on a medical instrument—a quiet waveform means approaching death, while a noisy one says disease is on the way.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: There was a time when Rosmontis's body was like two lost fowlbeasts shrieking in fright. I'd hold her until she fell asleep, and they would 'peck' at me. I'm glad she can sleep on her own now, though I admit it leaves me a little lonely.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Are you tired, Doctor? Alright, since you've worked so hard today, come, hold my hand. Feel your nerves pulse, think of them as a gentle tune. Now, let's softly sway to the warm beat—until all your exhaustion fades away.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Comms terminal set to silent. Don't worry, you won't miss any important news with me here.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: According to Amiya's instruction, I take orders directly from you now, Doctor. I handle communications and intelligence. But of course, feel free to come to me with any life issues.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's obvious which side will win, considering our overwhelming information supremacy.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I get the most gratification as a communications intelligence officer when my information is used to its full potential. So keep at it, Doctor!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, Blaze, and the rest of you—just come out. It's cute you thought you could spring a surprise on me. Still hiding? A round of hide-and-seek, hmm? You're all so in touch with your inner children. Alright then. Let's start with the Doctor—

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Carry on with your war room business, I'll propose suggestions as needed.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Trust me, I'll always manage to locate you, no matter what sort of danger you may find yourselves in.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All packed and ready? Let's go then.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy signal detected. All units, prepare for battle.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Doctor, what kind of message do you want me to transmit?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I've intercepted some fascinating intel, Doctor.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Relax, their comms will be paralyzed as long as I'm here.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Verified all allied units in position. Everything's fine, don't worry.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Sorry, this isn't the way out, but a trap I set for you.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Enjoy a little solo sojourn to the information silo.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'll jam their signals while the rest of you move.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Sadly, there's no controlling the battlefield with brute force alone.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: How was the battle, Doctor? You want my evaluation? Dendie and Axie have already given you my answer, haven't they?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No further enemy signals in range. Mission complete, perfectly executed. Phew... Alright, Doctor, give me a high-five!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I have their signals in my head now. They won't get away.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't lose heart, Doctor. We'll win next time, alright?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rhodes Island's signal still puts me at ease.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Doctor, did I not tell you to behave yourself?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Are you heading over to the meeting too, Doctor? Let's go together then.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor, till the deck will do... No, I'm not drunk... It's just, there's always so much joy and excitement in everyone's signals this time of year. It always gets me a little dizzy. I suppose this is a good problem to have. Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, were you looking for me?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, I just sent you a map. It shows the locations of everyone who wishes to celebrate your birthday. I've already planned the shortest route you can take, and you should be done by dinner time, if there aren't any hiccups on the way. The question mark at the end? That's my present for you, I hope you're excited for it.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: We've lost a lot of people, but there are always more joining our ranks. Gradually, the newbies inherit their seniors' ideas as they in turn become mentors to others. Doctor, judging from the signals I'm getting, sometimes I even find myself mistaken—I get the feeling my comrades never change.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Were you looking for these papers, Doctor? And here is a pen. You may also dictate to me, if you're tired—Oh, I'm sorry, did I spook you? I see. You're not yet used to having me around. Rest assured, I'm always by your desk, and you need only speak what you need.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I understand that everyone is curious about the Grandmaster's life, but I was only his record keeper, not his aide. Even when he was busy, he never asked me to help him with everyday tasks. Indeed, he kept reminding me to take my medicine on time. When I share this with others, they look simultaneously interested and disappointed.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Good morning, Doctor. You're up early. Me? Hmm... One develops certain habits after spending a decade with the army. I feel strange if I fail to take my daily trip to the Training Room. These records, you say? Please rest assured, they are a matter of personal interest, or shall I say learning? I won't share them.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: When traveling with the Grandmaster, we would often encounter challengers. Sometimes, he instructs me to engage them first. I can only speak plainly, asking whether they would concede if I could indicate their vulnerabilities. Most readily agree. And so, I've somehow claimed a slate of victories to my name, without throwing a single punch.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Zuo Le and I have always been somewhat frightened of Qiubai, even though she's never put on airs. People say she was lucky to have a great master, but it is the path she walked on her own that was the true cultivation. Now that I've left the nest myself, I think of her whenever there is doubt in my heart.
