lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Is there any meaning to one who is unable to practice martial arts pouring his entire heart and soul into martial studies? Or is there any meaning to martial arts at all, you ask? Life is like drifting pond weeds; one can find true anchorage only by deeply nurturing something. Why do I care? I suppose it's because I've found an anchor that is precious.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Zuo Le was not always as he is. When we were little, and my poor health shut me away in my boring room, he tried to take me outside. He could leap over Yumen's walls on the way out with his Qinggong, but could not get back in. After we got scolded together, he slipped me some buckthorn fruits from his pocket. They were green and very sour.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The Grandmaster had many students. He took them in from all walks of life, teaching what he knew to anyone who would learn the martial arts. Sometimes, I wonder if I might have become his greatest student, were it not for my poor health... keep this between you and I, won't you?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Want to hear a story from the Jianghu? There was a generous and altruistic family that fell victim to villainy. The only survivor was a boy, saved by a wandering hero. The hero asked the boy whether he wanted revenge, but the boy said all he wanted was to prevent such tragedies from ever happening again... just a story. Of course.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Am I bothering you? This is a breathing exercise that the Grandmaster taught me, which concentrates your qi to strengthen the body. I perform it whenever I have free time. I'll try to be quiet and avoid disturbing you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am Yun Qingping, here to assist with the Sui Regulator's work. I'm not a Candleholder, merely accompanying Zuo Le to broaden my horizons. Wherever I might be of assistance, I shall certainly do my utmost.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Advance or retreat, offence or defense; there exists a rhythm of ebb and flow much like with kung fu.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? I never thought of such things when I served as record keeper. Same goes for my predecessors, who usually stayed in the role for their entire careers. The greatest reward is for our records to help refine the martial skills of our soldiers.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The Grandmaster often says that the most precious relationships are the ones built on the brink of life and death. I suppose that makes us the best of friends.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: When to perceive with the eyes; when to see with the mind's eye—

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Observations of live combat are invaluable. I'll do my best.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Is violence the only option?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Rest assured, their fear is as easy to read as their moves.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: This report is ready for your comment.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I only record... it is not my place to give suggestions.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: We've reached the observation point.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Ahh... So this is what the soldiers see.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: That which is overly hard becomes brittle. Stay still; I have medicine.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Impressive. You are like the cloudbeast darting from tree to tree, disturbing neither branch nor leaf.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Amazing. You are like the evergreen pine by the bottomless lake, eternally steadfast against the storm.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Thought precedes form. Do not let yourself be bound to specific moves.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: With enough patience, even dripping water can bore through a rock; with subtle strength, a minute force can shred steel. You have reached a new level of understanding in the art of war, Doctor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: To derive trend from trivia; to foresee consequence from causation. Ah... No wonder the Grandmaster asked me to study your methods.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: You see the forest rather than just the trees. I have much to learn from you.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: There is no such thing as a move that cannot be countered. Perhaps we could review the battle, for the possibility of victory must lie within.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Allow me to pay respect to the Grandmaster first.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Repeating the same move dooms one to predictability, Doctor. Of course, it would suffice against me.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: The war drums are quiet. There is only the sound of the wind. The wormwood upon the sand is green again.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I looked forward to those few days of celebration during my Yumen days too. The people would bring wine and food to camp for the soldiers, and everyone partook in competitions of kung fu and drinking. It's a time to, shall we say, 'let our hair down'. Whatever you plan on doing today, I won't tell Amiya.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Forgive me, Doctor! Just can't shake the habit of writing as I walk.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: My first taste of alcohol was on a birthday. I just couldn't turn the soldiers down... I know they were worried that I would be lonely, with no family to join in celebration. We all got a good talking-to from the Grandmaster afterwards. In any case, nothing warms the heart like good spirits, and I just happen to have some Yumen Liedaozi here. Would you like a quaff?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Kazimierzian knightsports, Leithanian Originium Arts... I've seen many new things here at Rhodes Island. I hope you'll bear with me and provide your kind instruction going forward. Ravioli? They're like Siracusan dumplings? Well, that sounds a bit... you say the Grandmaster likes them? I suppose I should try some, then.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's fine enough in this office, but it's not much of a dalliance if we're stuck with work for days on end, you know... Unless, say, you'd let me lap at your emotions a bit?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I hear you calling for me, I'm just not obliged to heed. Oh, don't startle the little pink ones, I worked ever so hard to train them as cushions. They were cajoling me into lava surfing before that. So uncouth—you might as well subject me to rap or put me in one of those smoking mechs.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Listen to that. The little operators are rehearsing? I met Lucian when he was around their age. So vexed by all the emotions he had to portray—such a tasty little snack. I chose him. He sates my appetite. He's been fun to spend time with... Mm? Odd. When did he go and grow so big?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Of all the places to run into this menagerie. Mine? Don't lump me in with these debased louts—Zaaro, stay. You there, little silver wolf, are you their pack leader? Make Zaaro shush, and by the way, you have special permission to scritch my chin.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The femme fatale of Wrankwood? The Durin clockwork curiosity? The shadowy priest of Sargon? Those were little pastimes of mine. Put on a different look, and people shower you in fresh delights. Little games like that are never more fun than when they've just begun.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Why stop playing? Because after long enough, no one shows me anything I haven't seen before. Emotions and words on repeat, it bores me like nothing else, and I hate boredom. Hm? Insolence! You haven't earned the right to scratch my belly yet, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, over here one moment? I'm off to try that multimedia escape room. Tell me, which one looks better on me, the ruby lavallière, or the sapphire? —*HISS*!!! ...Excuse me, my true form was meant to frighten you just as it does everyone else. Typical, I didn't even get a taste...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: What a fine lavallière, this scrumptious mix of bashfulness and timidity... did your operators make this? I do quite love them... I'd love a taste of each of them. Pft, don't fret, only the special kind of emotion interests me. For example, that nervousness you just flashed in front of me, at long last. Oh, I like that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Here, let me have a look under your hood—don't hide, do you think that stops me seeing? You know, you swallow up your operators' emotions too, don't you, Doctor? How your presence puts them at ease. *yawn* Move over, I'll have a catnap here myself.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: ...Mrm... prrr... mrrow...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Eyes down here, Doctor. Cat got your tongue? You can hear my voice now. Long time no see. You can pet me more than last time, I permit it.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: *yawn*

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, I can trouble you to set this in that red lavallière for me, yes? It'll look better on me that way.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Are you done with the photoshoot? Let me see... Hm? You'll have this framed and put up in the middle of the dormitories? Very well, I do like these shots. I'll allow it.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Let me see. Are you in trouble of some sort?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Be good. Stay put.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Any moods out here to pique my interest?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let emotion engulf this place.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm here, in the shadows.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Petting a cat on the battlefield? That'll be one petting voucher.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: (The lady looks around, elegantly swishing her two tails.)

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: (The lady stretches out, seemingly very at ease.)

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Emotion-deprived puppets. Bland little spirits.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Despair, excitement, yearning... the emotions here are delectable.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: What other knotty emotions could there be?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Mrow?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Flavors fit for a gastronome. Thank you for entertaining me.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A fine snack. I'm satisfied. When's the next?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Oh my, there goes the afternoon tea.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Stay on my tail, Doctor, don't let emotion's whirl suck you in.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Do I get a room?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Insolence.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: ...Hrmm... prrr...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Ah-choo! Not even you're free of all these... sickly sweet emotions... oh, I almost feel dizzy... Doctor, come, we're finding Lucian. I want to see how these feelings look on his face.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I smell a note of delight, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: (The lady has left a dew-slicked rose on your desk. You look down, only to find that unbeknownst to you, a warm fuzzball with its four paws tucked in has nestled within your lap.)

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Your operators really want to see me do this, do they? ...Oh, fine, special permission just for today. You can rest me on your shoulder while you go round the landship.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: All these documents need now is consolidation. I've put the references on the table, listed out the specifics, and also left some notes. Phew, the work for today and tomorrow is almost wrapped up… If you don't mind, I think I'll have a little nap…

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Yes, I lost my sight in that one during the Bank of Mitsukue robbery. Indeed, there were two or three thousand who took part. Verily, it was an absolute bloodbath. There I was, protecting my little food cart, and with a single bamboo skewer, I killed a thousand men... Don't sweat the details. Enough about me, I'm here to hear your stories, Doctor. C'mon, out with them already.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Today, a student working part-time asked me about information science. I'm not much of an expert, so I shared a few stories showing how I wheedle information out of the clients at my various jobs. He did say it'd be difficult for him to include them in his university summer report, but he still looked pretty satisfied.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Special report! I suggest heading to the canteen early today, Doctor, something nice awaits. And remember to go to your physical later, or you'll suffer for it. Also, watch your head when passing through the upper deck. Alright, I'll take one thousand for my troubles. When did I learn divination? Why, I just happened to overhear some chatter is all.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Every year, I would make the same wish at that shrine, but I'm not too sure what to wish for this year. I really envy that priest. Walking alongside the kami-sama should make life easier, right? Then again, every kami-sama's got a different personality, so if you run into one that's a real pain to work with...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The whole time I was mirage-chasing, I thought I was simply experiencing another story to tell, but I ended up tying threads of fate that connected us together. With the proprietors and customers of Mitsukue, with Hoshiguma, and with you... Ahem. Anyway, I won't dismiss our friendship just because we met during a bank robbery!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Tsk, back then, numbers like these were so monumentally oppressive, you'd throw yourself off a high-rise just to catch your breath. But in today's economy, they're gained and lost in a matter of seconds. Alright, I've decided. Doctor, I'm going to set up an education fund, to help out people like me who never finished school—Hey, wait, don't go!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When I first set foot in the underworld, I upset some people I really shouldn't have, over some nearly worthless clues, and lost an eye for my indiscretions. Hardly a tale of fantasy and adventure, just the story of an idiot. It's ridiculous how that sort of thing turned my life around. Heh, what, you interested? Alright then. It all began one rainy night...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I've had too many chats today. Heard too many stories, said too many words, so I'm a little tired. Oh, don't mind me. Getting to stand with you under a vermilion sky, lost in our thoughts, is rest enough for me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Where is everyone? So busy they forgot what time it is? Hmm, what should I sample from the liquor cabinet next...?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Irrashaimase, okyaku-sama. Codename Matsukiri, at your service. I am but a humble barkeep and proprietor of a wandering food cart, and perhaps also an individual skilled in the finding of things. So, what is it you need from me right now, Doctor?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Hmm, an exquisite arrangement. I should be able to put it to use in my side hustles.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Such kindness and magnanimity! It is my pleasure to be able to help you. Seems my part-time travails were not suffered in vain.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Oh...? Another promotion? For me? D-Doctor, there's nobody else here, so be honest with me. What do you actually want me to do? Let me make one thing clear, I won't be able to sniff out the Northern Court's secrets for you!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Alright, alright, I'll take care of everyone. I will say, I'm not much of a fighter. If it's discreet inquiries you want, then you've got the right man.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You want me to command? Command these mighty warriors who could all level me in a fight? C'mon, give me a break here...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I specialize in information gathering, I am no generalist. When it comes to fighting... *sigh* Well, since you asked so nicely, watch me kill another thousand on my own.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Nrmph—Alright, let's get serious. There's work to do.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What can I get you, okyaku-sama?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: No need to be so pushy, boss.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Is it my turn? Don't rush me, this hand needs to be dealt slowly.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Err, is this place safe? Why do I feel like there's people watching us from the shadows?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Your private room. Please, enter.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Koi-koi!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Why must someone always kill the mood when we're enjoying our game?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: These gatecrashers are no customers. I'll invite them to leave.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, you... rest up first. To get us out of that situation in one piece, and win, even... Burning yourself out like this can't be how you normally do things. It's all thanks to your efforts.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Tonight, we've got chikuwa, radish, burdenbeast tendon and boiled fowlbeast eggs. Have as much as you want, on the house! Here's to a job well done, everyone! Drinks, though, those'll be going on your tab.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: It's fine, a few ran away is all. Don't worry, I let some fake news slip out. We won't be looking over our shoulders.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Heads up! Don't chase them. Safety first. I do still have a little shop in Mitsukue. If things don't work out, Doctor…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Wow, this place is incredible. It's like you made it the perfect spot for me to set up a few food stalls.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Don't bother me, I'm still on the clock.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Bored? How about some hanafuda?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Oh, you're here too? Happy New Year! I normally take this day off, but old habits made me an early riser. Habit has me walking down a long road and climbing some tall stairs, all to see if that little one's returned... But that's a story for later, haha. Since you're here, Doctor, how about climbing those stairs with me?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Irrashaimase, Doctor. Here, your usual, at your usual seat.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy Birthday, Doctor. Here, a coupon for 90% off at my bar/restaurant/convenience store/food-cart, today only... Just my little joke. Look on the back. Voucher of Wish-granting. Rather generous, isn't it? Feel free to wish away. Considering how wide my network in Mitsukue is, I'll be able to find someone to make it come true.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Finally tracked you down, Doctor! I've composed a haiku commemorating the year we've shared, understanding and supporting each other... Hah, glib? Certainly not. What about my new tanka? A recited one you say? Tsk Tsk, I bet something's troubling you. Don't worry, I'm here. I'll hear you out.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Wow, you've got it worse than me, and I'm an idol. Here I thought my schedule was rough... Alright, cross this out, and this out... Don't thank me, you've gotta rest hard to work hard!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Back in my debut days, I had to print my own posters, alter my own outfits, do everything myself to save money. But I mean, that taught me a bunch of practical skills, so... Hehe, look here, I embroidered a little finbeast into my own work sleeve. Isn't it super cute?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This pudding looks so good... My agency never used to let me eat pudding, but no one can stop me now—no, think healthy, Haruka, you've had enough sugar already—Doc, that's not an invite to eat it for me!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: When I was growing up, adults loved to feed me ghost stories, so that stuff has always terrified me. And now ever since my debut, horror movies keep casting me 'cause they like how real my screams are... Mattaku-mou, that's the one thing I don't need validation for!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island is really good at coverups. It's been days and the gossip rags still haven't hunted me down... Wait. I haven't faded away, have I? There's no way I'm old news already! Oh, this is bad, I'm gonna head back tomorrow!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: This photo's from after we wrapped my first movie, I'm posing here with all the locals. Yeah, in Kajimachi... Maybe once I've hit up enough cities, held enough performances, then I'll catch sight of them again one day, somewhere in my sea of cheering fans. That's what I believe.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Finbeasts are so cute, seriously. I love the gold glittering ornamental ones. Putting them in those little bags of water, holding them up to the sun, watching them blow out bubbles. Like this, *pop*, *pop*—blah, I can't talk and pout at the same time!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Last night, I dreamt I was on a cushion of bubbles lifting me into the sky, and I could see home fall further away with every gust. And it was like, I know I'm gonna fall eventually, but it's so pretty up here in the sky, so I had to keep on flying and flying, as hard as I could, even if at some point I was just blowing the bubbles myself... 'cause I wanna keep flying.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My memory's never been that good, but the nerves I get from being in front of my bosses make my head go white. But technically, you're my boss too, right? So I wonder why you don't make me... um! I mean, what I mean to say is, don't start intimidating me or anything, 'cause I'll... I'll, uh—I might, um... sorry, what I was gonna, uh... *groan*...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: C'mon, fall asleep already... I won't feel hungry while I'm asleep... This is so unfair, how come the Doc conks out so easily?!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Wait, okay, so a friend recommended me here, but before I sign anything, just let me read these contracts—okay, no crazy long-terms, no outrageous penalty fees... Doesn't look like a black company to me. Great, I'm ready to sign!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Maybe we could mix a few of my concert tapes into this... Hey, wait, at least think about it!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I can't believe how fast the promotion track here is! I took forever to go from training to debut, and I had to pay the agency for my classes the whole time… Ugh... When can Rhodes Island get into the idol biz?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Now I can finally work alongside Hoshiguma! She helped me out so much back in Mitsukue, and I'm gonna make sure I don't drag her down anymore!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Huh?! But idols need years of training just to go onstage! I don't have nearly enough combat hours to... A—Are you really sending me in?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I dunno about commanding people, I think I'm more of a morale booster...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Doctor, what do I do if my legs are shaking...?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Doctor, there's, there's enemies!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Last step of battlefield prep—deep breaths, in, in, in!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Do we have time to go over combat techniques again...?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I—I'll try and keep my eyes open!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: If I make it back in one piece, I win...

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Iai-giri! Wait, that's not a sword—aw, whatever, take this!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: If I'm dead anyway, I'm taking you with me!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: My idol image? Who gives a crap about that right now!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I've been in plenty of events, but this is the most chaotic venue ever!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, gimme a copy of the combat log for this, I'm gonna clip it for my personal promo! Heheh, Battle Diva Momoka, isn't that so cool!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Look, I know this was our hard-earned collective victory and everything, but, um, Doctor, did I take out any enemies by myself? Just show me which ones!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I guess I can't just shut my eyes and flail my weapon around... I didn't hit anyone I wasn't supposed to, right?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ngh... screw it, I'm going for broke! D—Doctor, I'm gonna—hold the rear!!!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room is spacious! Look how high my bubbles go!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wah! Don't sneak up on me like that!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Is the bow on my back straight?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year's is usually my busiest period, but I figured this year I'd break the mold to come see you and Hoshiguma. Feels weird to wish blessings on people and stuff when you're not face to face—hey, I'm kidding, I turned down a lot of good work opportunities to visit Rhodes Island! Couldn't you act a little happier?!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hi, Doctor! I just had the cuuuuuutest encounter, you wanna hear?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here's some accessories I made myself, and omiyage from my tour stops, and then there's a letter at the bottom... Why do I know your birthday? Well, I—I only just found out yesterday, that's why all of this is so on-the-fly... You know I have a bad memory.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: On this day of Rhodes Island celebration, I bring some news from Higashi—everything's fine in Mitsukue, and other cities have been sending me offers to perform lately, including you. Doctor, do you think we'll be sharing the good times like this at next year's party?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: How long are you gonna sit there, Doctor? Don't you want to go out and play? Work? Where's the fun in that? Come on, put this stuff down and let's go have some fun!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Mitsukue is a special place! There's plenty of good food and fun to be had, handsome boys and beautiful girls everywhere you look. And the best part? Anything you want, you can find it there—as long as you're not concerned about authenticity!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This one, and this... that should be enough... oh, hi, Doctor! I'm putting new stickers on my gun, and I've got some left over. Anything you want to sticker up? I can spare a few.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Final lap! Come on, come on! Faster, faster—argh, allllmost... Hm? No, I didn't bet. Spent all my money at the beginning of the month. I'm just watching the stream for the thrill of it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: This place is just the right length and width, and hardly anyone ever comes by... Get yelled at? A tongue-lashing is no big deal! Okay. One phone call, and we'll have a pachinko machine here tomorrow!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My gran's first lesson for me was that the truth doesn't matter, and the means don't matter either. The fake gems she appraised would end up on fancy ladies, bought for eye-popping money. And our fake guns protect the Lucky Star just fine.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: One Lucky Star's enough trouble; I can't imagine what it takes to run a whole Rhodes Island... Huh? The people I picked up? They... weren't any trouble; just gave them some medicine and let them lie down…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Oh no, look at this! There's another new idol in Mitsukue! Momoka's fan club has already lost a bunch of members... Me? Of course I'm staying true! I'm her most loyal fan, even if I don't have the money to buy any merch. My love for Momoka is true!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Towers built from bubbles teeter, and everyone goes grasping for a star in their final moments... my star appeared when I was on the verge of freezing to death, the night I was abandoned by my parents as an infant. She gave me a home.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Huh? The Dr.{@nickname}'s not in the office today… Guess I'll have to find somebody else... who should I pick? Can't be a complainer, a miser, or sane enough to keep clear…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Kichisei the Unerring, reporting in! Come to the Lucky Star in Mitsukue for all your needs, whether you need a gem appraiser, a fence, or an information broker. I am always at your service during business hours.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Real guns... they use them differently from gran…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Wow, working for you lot pays so much better than the yakuza.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Rest assured. You're always VIPs at the Lucky Star.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Breaktime's…. over, I guess.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm the leader? Alright, better to work for you than to stick my neck out for someone else.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Come with me, I know a secret passage.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Mm, just as I thought.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hm? What's that?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, heard you the first time...

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Loaded... check.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Something suspicious up ahead, two hundred meters.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The gun may be fake, but yeah, that's all it takes.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I don't need to aim!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Hope you enjoy this!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Unerring!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: *laughter* Well done! Did anyone get a pic of that? I want to print it out and put it up on the door of the Lucky Star!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Good job! Dismissed. Go do whatever you want, and see you next time!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I guess we're done. Can I hit the pachi… Err, can I take a game break now?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, we pissed off the wrong guy! Run! Move those legs! Let's get out of here!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This is a nice little space. Maybe I can get a few arcade cabinets set up... no, you didn't hear me say anything.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey! Take it easy... I'm not a broken vending machine you can fix with a smack, you know!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Wooo... Good timing. I was about to sneak out for a drink... wanna join me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The Lucky Star's open all night today! Not that there are many guests at this hour, but it's one of grandma's old sayings. When the Lucky Star stays open, good fortune comes often.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Irrashaimase... oops, I guess I let the old habits slip in. What brings you here, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, wanna know the plan for your birthday party? For this low, low price, I'll tell you what surprise Amiya has in store for you, and what 'surprise' Elysium has…

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: After today is tomorrow. After tomorrow another tomorrow—come find me again tomorrow, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I won't abuse your authorization. From now on, I will listen in.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I've always 'filtered' the mental burden of using my Originium Arts just as Amiya does. You may visualize the process as looking for something stable to grasp while falling endlessly through a void. You've noticed her doing it? It was you who gave her the courage to fall in the first place, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: These marks on my hand? They are remnants of my past, a senseless attempt to turn a human body into an Arts Unit. I grew weary of Sargon before these mystic Arts could cover my entire body. As they receded like the tide, so did my memories, with only these fragments to remind me of the place I once called home.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I can tell when perception fails to match words. Similar to how Raidian works, it's more detecting lies than reading minds. The difference is that I am a certified psychological counselor, while she is innately gifted in the comprehension and evocation of emotion.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: A pair of wizened hands, comforting farmers, traders, soldiers, even lords ameer and padishahs. All those seeking answers only to fall into chaos without exception, suffering ceaseless fear or ecstasy, and descent into disorder. I know, the line separating me from the Yurodstvo used to be indistinguishable.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The departed connect our past to present. Only with this, can we have a future. Someone once said, 'this is the meaning of sacrifice', but I disagree. Do not leave your names behind in such a pragmatic fashion, do not turn your actual life to abstraction, and do not deify suffering and death.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: 'Beware the Caster who can make you writhe in pain, puking your guts out, without lifting even a finger.' This is true to some extent, but my squad members ardently objected and rushed to refute it. Elysium says it is very important to tell the truth about me… ah, the youth.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor. I'm not angry, just emptying my mind to recover some energy. I've come to the age where I have to gasp for breath every few words, after all. Alright, the last one was a joke. It was Dr. Kal'tsit who recommended this method, even if she didn't practice it herself. She always had too much on her mind.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Blaze and Rosmontis both keep mementos from those around them. When they came to me, I gave Blaze a signal receiver, while Rosmontis got a transmission disc. Me? I don't keep anything. I don't commit to saving a memory I never intend to forget.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. I did not mean to disturb your rest, but Amiya wants to remind you there is still work that needs doing.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Before the authorizations were modified, I would take orders from you directly. Don't worry, my communications support equipment may have been upgraded, but I won't intrude into your consciousness without prior approval.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: If Outcast were there, we would've routed the enemy much quicker… You want to see older battle records? I know where to find them.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Elysium offered to simulate the promotion process for me, claiming to be more experienced than me in this field. But now I suspect he may have been buying time to avoid training. Once this is over, I'll have a little 'chat' with him.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The promotion process for Elite Operators is still the same, the only change being our reviewer. It was the Speaker, then Dr. Kal'tsit, and now you. It may not be the best time to say this, but welcome back, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: If you must.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Elysium.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: A clear battle plan.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let me know how far I should probe.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm listening.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: If we must be covert.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I will pass it on.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: A carefully deliberated dispatch.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Follow my voice.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: There is no rejecting my intrusion.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Resistance is futile.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Target detected.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The enemy has nowhere to hide. An inevitable result, with perfect command.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: (Nods in approval)

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I've sent their remaining units' positions to our cleanup squad's terminal. It's over, Doctor.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I've jammed their tracers. Leave, now!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's time to rest.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Need something?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Try again. This time I'll pretend I didn't notice you beforehand.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Bootlegging of pigment from Laterano, witnessing gold bars growing legs and vanishing into Kazdel… we Elite Operators are used to sharing stories from the past year's field missions on this night. I'm sure you've missed some of the stories, so I'll try my best to patch any holes along the way, Doctor. Have a seat, if you'd like.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: (After nodding to each other, the two of you enjoy a cozy moment of silence)

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've booked the white noise room for you today. If you'd like to try a new relaxation method once the noise has died down over here, you may go over to take a look. The reservation log is already reflected on your terminal, and the frequencies have been adjusted to your liking as well. Enjoy your day, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I would not have stayed this long, if I only intended to repay Dr. Kal'tsit for what she did. Sargon's golden sands brought me up, while the icy Ursine snow tempered me, but it is Rhodes Island's sturdy deck that molded me into who I am today. And so I have decided to stay here to watch over the place.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I-I can read these… let me help you.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: S-Sorry… I speak so slow. D-Doctor Warfarin said it can be, cured, but it will take… very long. It's okay, I'm already… used to it. Um, I just hope you're not… annoyed.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Wh-What's in my hand? No, not herbs, a, a kind of moss. The miners, they use it to light fires, and also, make tea. It looks pretty? Da. On the tundra, it's really easy to see, so everyone picked all of them long ago. This is… the last bunch I have, and I… want to keep it.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: S-Sound, the alarm? You want me to, show you how we work in the mines…? Okay. Actually, it's not really a bell we ring, but it's… really loud. No, you have to, cover your ears. You must.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: In the mines, it's very easy to, lose track of time. So I stay outside, helping them to count. They can't stay there too long, or they'll… die. One hundred and eleven, one hundred and twelve, one hundred and thirteen… like that. I count my numbers really, smoothly? Ah—whuh?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: When you, speak into a cave, there's always a strange response. When I laugh, it laughs. When I'm mad at it, it's mad at me. Actually, some people are like the caves—Rankin, he saw too many… complicated things, and in the end… he became complicated too.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: This letter, and the wheat ear inside it, they sent it to me, from the border. Happy? Da. I thought, everyone would separate, and never see each other again. Strange, whenever I think about their smiles, my eyes... well up with tears. Huh? That's... not weird?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: H-Have you heard this story? Parents go out to shovel snow, but soon, someone knocks on the door. The child goes to open the door, and sees a manglerbeast standing, just as we do— I will never— no, it's not just because of Babushka Nadia. Y-You're right. Real family, wouldn't force me to, open the door.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: N-No, I wasn't spacing out! I was counting… down until the sun sets. I don't want to… see it go away. In the north, the sun is, precious, and I'm scared it won't come back one day—it will, tomorrow? And y-you're, willing to stay with me… until it comes back up? Really?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You've been working for, so long… Do you need to rest for a bit…? I will remember… to wake you up.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: H-How do you do, Doctor! Everyone calls me… Vetochki, um—oh, yes! It means twig in Ursine!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I just… need to k-keep everyone safe… and that's all, right?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm not scared of… hardship, or pain, either! I'll work hard… and train even more, you can… trust me on this.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This badge is for—me? But I haven't done enough. There's still so many Infected… I will help… many more people! Um, yes. You're right, we're… all in this together.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Oh, okay.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Sound… the alarm!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Please, be careful and… stay safe.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Watch out.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I… can do it!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I… got it!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Don't be scared!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: D-Don't come any… closer.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Seven hundred and twenty-three, Seven hundred and twenty-two, Seven hundred and twenty-one… live on…

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Fifty-nine, sixty. One, two… deep breaths…

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Just, just hold on for a while longer…

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I-It's time!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: We… did it?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: C-Can we take a break now?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Everyone… stay close to me.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: W-We have to go back, some of our comrades are still… out there!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This place is… so warm.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Could you… l-let go, please!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Once upon a time, there was a… snowman who got, lost… have you, heard this story before?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Towards, the left, da… ah, it's crooked again. Higher on the right… just a little—yes, perfect! Thank you, for helping me, put up these festival, decorations, Doctor! We'll get to, ring in the new year, soon, so… would you like to, give it a try?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: D-Doctor, you're right on time… oh, I, ah, just arrived too.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: There are so many, presents on the table… ah, Doctor! When did you get back? Th-This necklace? It's an amulet I made, with colorful stones. I wanted to—here, for you. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Since I was small, I always thought—I thought, pain wasn't so bad. Maybe I, deserve the pain. But—what about others? What about the people in places I've, never been? They shouldn't have to suffer. Rhodes Island… has given me a lot of 'painkillers', and I want to, share them with more people.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: The data from Experiment 36? Second cabinet from the left, in the blue folder. The error report? The document at the very top of the pile behind you. As for the mathematical formulae, they are in the left drawer of your desk. Are there any other files you need? Please, feel free to ask for my help.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Please don't mind me, Rhodes Island's laboratories are excellent, and there have been zero issues with the equipment. I keep rearranging it because… Ahem, I never thought I would have a workbench of my own again.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Oh! My apologies for bumping into you, my glasses fogged up suddenly… I thought I could walk back to my workbench like this, but I was carrying so many things, I had no free hand to wipe my glasses. I'll just stand here until they clear up…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Do I need help? No, I am fine, I know how to key data into the terminal. It's just that… Once this data is in the terminal's system, others can delete it or classify it with a press of a button. Writing it down on paper allows me to feel a little more relaxed.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The polar nights of Ursus are near-endless, to the degree that even if I were to light every lamp, I would still find myself yearning desperately for the tiniest sliver of daylight, the faintest glimmer of hope. Perhaps I followed you here thinking only of proving myself more than a failure in life.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Back in the Far North, I thought that by following you, I would escape that endless expanse of ice and snow. Even if I were to leave a suicide note, it would have only made for kindling. I had to go with you. You people are mad for doing what you did in Ursus. But perhaps I, too, have long fallen to madness.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Back in Chernobog, Professor Ilia would try to cram knowledge into my brain as quickly as possible, Director Kal'tsit and the others would perform their calculations without rest, while every day I lived in fear of the punishments I would suffer for any mistake… Who would have thought those would be the best days of my life?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: 'The youngest of the genius researchers'. I once held such a title with pride, but if you were to swing a pick anywhere in the Far North and break the frozen earth, you would find the Originium dust the corpses of those geniuses have become. At times, I am glad I managed to escape that place... but have I truly escaped?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Alcohol is a fine thing. It warms the body and dulls the mind, and you need not think about whatever is happening outside... It is too warm here, and I do not rely on it to get through the day now. What should I rely on next, Doctor? Can you tell me?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I am simply transcribing some data, and you have fallen asleep. Is the sound of my writing really so soothing?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I thank all of Rhodes Island, Doctor, for taking me in, and I also thank you for… giving me a laboratory where I will not be disturbed.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It seems I am not the only one giving everything to survive. Everyone does the same.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Receiving such a formal memo scared me half to death, but thankfully, it was not a directive to cease my experiments… You have my deepest gratitude, Doctor. I shall continue with my research.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I have been looking for you all day, Doctor. Look, my paper was published in a Columbian journal. My research is heading in the right direction! Huh? I am smiling, am I…? It seems I truly am happy now.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The materials are ready.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I am to oversee this project? Understood.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Readings are coming through… Beginning recording and graphing.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Remember, sample the data every twenty minutes.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What is your hypothesis?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Do you have a new conjecture?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Control group ready.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Initiating data collection.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Removing outliers.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Calculating standard deviation.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Marking significant trends.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Performing data derivation.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: L-Look, Doctor! We succeeded! Has… Has the day finally come?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The hypothesis holds. The report will be on your desk shortly.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I will begin investigating the error at once. You may put your faith in me.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: A failure? No, no, no, how could this be? Please, a little more time! I promise no more problems next time!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Such a warm room…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh?! Sorry, I thought you were someone else. Forgive me for hitting you with that file…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Would you care for a warm cup of tea?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: We never celebrated this holiday when I was at the research institute. The passage of time held no special meaning to us, aside from the little headway we were making on our projects. But now… I wish to believe it means the day I see results is all the more closer.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. The experiment is proceeding smoothly. Here. I used hot tea to keep my mind clear and warm myself back in Ursus.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: While I do think preparing a birthday present for my superior is somewhat odd, it is still something I would like to do. It was you who gave me the hope I needed to continue with my research, starting when you chose to enter that mine in search of remaining specimens… I have been grateful to you ever since.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Here at Rhodes Island, my research enjoys success after success, and the sick benefit from better medicines developed on my results. The fact that these things actually happen here has swept me off my feet countless times… Seeing my work come to fruition, and how it makes this place a better one, has left me greatly satisfied.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm? Need a hand, Doctor? Or you got something interesting for me?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Do you know how wild it is, as a Kazimierz Knight, to see a 'company' actually trying so hard to treat Infected? It's a mind-melter, trust me. Yeah, seriously. Justyna still keeps wondering how Rhodes Island turns a profit.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, question? Can I take a look at Operator Nearl's battle records? Uh, no, I'm just a little curious—yeah? Thanks, Doctor! Let's see, uh... oh, man. Maybe I oughta tell Iwona to push back her sparring with Nearl…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Ashley and me? We met through the Major. I just got a feeling we could get along. So I took it upon myself to talk to her after the match. Jeez, thinking about it, I've got a talent for scouting, don't I?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Platinum,' huh. I know what happened with her after, but still, no plans to be her friend. Y'know, before, we said the Armorless Union, and the General Chamber of Commerce, were our greatest enemies. But to be real... ha, it's the whole age we live in we're dissenting against.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The titans we call cities rumble forth. As people live on their backs, neon outshines the moonlight, and car engine silences bug chirps with its deafening rumbles. Too much gets tossed away, flattened undertread. Those people, they all deserve a different life... a better one. Infected or not, Doctor, we all oughta be searching for a new way forward.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor! Heard from Gravel and Amiya, you faced off with the Armorless Union during the Major? And you're the one who sniffed out the Area 0 plot? How'd you—wait, hold on, lemme bring a chair over and get some snacks while I'm at it. Alright, Teach! Take it away!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Before I met Ashley, I honestly figured I'd be fine if I just kept living. But now, with Justyna, Iwona, Maria—and the Radiant Knight... I'm prepared to fight alongside them. Throw that life of mine out there for them. It's why I fight on.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Maybe one day, when everyone figures out what 'Knight' deep inside their hearts really holds for them , and knights truly retire from the stage, Kazimierz can be peaceful in the truest sense. The Radiant Knight, she told me these words, and they spurred me into seeing more and further with my eyes. Maybe there's more I should be doing, you know.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Take a rest, Doctor. Man, I wonder what Ashley and the others are up to right now.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Leader, Flametail Knight, Sona! You're the Doctor? Mmm, well, you're kinda not like I imagined, but hey. I'm under your wing from here on out, Doctor!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Huh. The stuff you watch for real combat's pretty crazy different from the Major.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: It's a first for me to get promoted without commercials or camera flashes. Well, Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub Leader, Flametail Knight, Sona! Continuing the stride!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I used to worry how an ever-heartless fight would lead us all down a messed-up way, but now... heheh, I guess ideals are something you oughta have. Aren't they, Doctor?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Ashley not gonna come with?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Flametail' Sona, spearheading and rolling out!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Live up to duty!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Enemy spotted. It'll be nice if they entered single file like the Knights do, though.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Any instructions for me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Feels fresh every time when someone gives me orders.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Can your eyes keep up?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: A new challenge!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: C'mon, let's pick up the pace.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Haha, losing sight?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Feels bad to lose your target, doesn't it?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'Tail like a shooting star,' that's what they say.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Maybe our life and times will make its own choice for us. But right now, we can only choose to fight to the last. Because we're Knights, because we're Infected. Because we're alive.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We've won a lot of times before, Doctor. Here and now, though, we're struggling for our own destiny, our own future. That's the real fight, isn't it?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: This sure as hell isn't a competition, Doctor. Letting them off easy's not gonna win the crowd over, y'know?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Everyone, retreat! Let me hold the rear! Don't worry, I'm an expert in escaping the pursuits.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Wow, this sure beats the Grand Knight Territory sewers. Guesstimating a couple hundred times better?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hyah!? What?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You're wondering how I usually dress? Mm, uhh... ahaha...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Never woulda expected I'd be spending New Year's at Rhodes Island... nah, not like I miss my days in the Grand Knight Territory. Who's gonna go and miss getting hunted, right? I'm just closing my eyes, seeing the broke and Infected celebrating the New Year, under that skyscraper's shadow. The looks on their faces. I still remember it even now.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Morning to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, please take this emblem of Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub handmade by myself! From now on, you are an honorary member of us. Thank you for all the things you've done for the Infected. And happy birthday to you!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: What a bustling day. Ashley's been busy signing her autographs for the fans, Justyna's playing her grass whistle, and Iwona and Justice Knight are also having fun with other buggies. It's been a while since the last time I saw such smiles on their faces. Good to see they enjoy themselves again, and it's all thanks to you, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You want me to watch over your work, like I keep an eye on my siblings while they do their homework? Sure. I'll make you run ten laps in the snow if you don't finish on time.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Whoa! Head up, chest out, swing your tail—good! Treating my disease is something that deserves the greatest gratitude a hunter can give. Look how this leporibeast snorts and kicks! It's the strongest that I've hunted. I'm not sure why the medics won't accept it…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Apology Letter: I'm sorry, instructor. A hunter takes only what she needs. If she fails to kill with one single shot, it is not hunting, only meaningless killing. This is the rule that Kjeragandr set for the snowy mountains… and the reason I put a hole in the training target, I guess…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Legends tell of a creature that points the way for hunters lost in the blizzards. It is mysterious and beautiful—no, not this one on my shoulder. It got lost while following me, hoping to pick up scraps from my hunt. I call it the Rift Cloudbeast. Cool, isn't it? Wait, no, no, no, not the Doctor's hood! You can't eat that!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The craftsmen know that Kjeragandr's eyes must be deep, for She sees a thousand miles. Her hands must be delicate, for She heals whatever wounds She touches. But these ideas were formed from our sculpting, one chisel at a time. At the end of the day, tomorrow depends on our own eyes and hands.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: When I go back, I'll tell my siblings that Oripathy isn't something to be feared. Their big sister is strong as ever and still carries her heavy crossbow around. Oripathy isn't a punishment from Kjeragandr. She guides and does not punish…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, help me put the strand from the left side on top of the one in the middle, then do the same with the hair on the right side and weave them together—no, it's all wrong again! This is completely different from how the Saintess did it… do you actually know how to braid hair, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You get punished when you do something bad. The Rift Cloudbeast stole your snacks because I didn't keep a good eye on it. We'll banish ourselves, according to the rules of my house. Don't try to stop me—huh? You're saying the rule here for cloudbeasts is just three days of petting time with you? You're the master of this house, and you wouldn't lie to me. Here you go!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: You want to go hunting with me? Alright, let me first step up my training… why? There's no way you can track anything in the snowy mountains on your own. I'll need to get strong enough to carry you on my back the whole way.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Kjeragandr on high, hear my prayer… keep them safe, keep them healthy.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I came because the Saintess says you can treat my disease. Do you need a hunter? I can take out a beast three times the height of a grown man with a single shot!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Everyone's really good!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What's this badge for? Oh… I get paid more when I have it? I see! Thank you!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I don't quite understand what the health exam report says, but I know I haven't gotten worse. You saved my life, and Kjeragandr's blessings will be with you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Do you need help hunting game?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Stay close. The snowy mountains can be dangerous to newcomers.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Shh. Don't disturb the beasts.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Look at the tracks they left in the snow…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Do you see the game?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Do you hear footsteps?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I have bait.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hide your smell.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Broken icicles… we've got a big one.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Fresh dung, not yet covered in snow… it was here not long ago.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Set the trap, and wait…

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: One shot, one kill.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I've never seen a quarry this big… did we really catch it?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: By Kjeragandr, we have our game. Let's go home!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Rift Cloudbeast, go find some herbs that can stop bleeding!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's go, Doctor! The smell of blood will draw more beasts!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Mm… it's warm here. Almost too warm!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whoa! Careful, I strike back on reflex!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh no, the Rift Cloudbeast is chewing on your hood again…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Thank you for letting me bring my siblings here to celebrate the new year! They don't get to leave Kjerag very often and they're really enjoying their time here. I'm taking them to try the special dishes that the other Operators have prepared. Thank you so much!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, have you seen the Rift Cloudbeast anywhere? I've been looking for it since morning. It ate my breakfast.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I don't know what a working adult like you might want for your birthday, but I gave a chain like this to my parents before, made from the tooth of the first quarry I hunted. They were very happy. This bead chain will keep you safe. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: This was the walking stick that I used on my pilgrimage to Mount Karlan with the Saintess. I took it to bathe in the purest lake water, and in the first ray of dawn atop the peak. May it keep you safe on your path towards the future you seek.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Here, construction project plans and data reconciliation sheet. Why the face? I share the same twenty four hours a day that you do, so there's no reason I should work for you alone.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Please grab these 'branches'… good. I've obtained your height, weight, and bone density. In ten minutes, a robot will deliver safety equipment tailored to you. Why the surprise? Were you not planning to follow me to the construction site?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Ho'olheyak? A K'uk'ulkan not even trying to hide her probes and provocations. She has a talent for making trouble. She calls herself my friend… Yes, I'm aware of such rumors. I will temper my hate for her as long as she doesn't interfere with my work, and the same goes for you, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I won't join Rhodes Island's engineering optimization efforts—no, you wouldn't manage to steal Rhine Lab's tech either way, but as a fellow engineer, I know the look on that Vampire's face when she stays up all night drawing blueprints. This is no prime-time Trimounts home renovation show, and I have no interest in commentating on someone else's home.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The so-called 'Rhine Lab Ten' seldom came together, even when Kristen was still around, so the few empty seats at the round table now do not imply much of a crisis. As Director of Engineering, I know how much longer this machine we call 'Rhine Lab' can operate.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Correct. Countless Columbians bore witness to the fall, and the spectacle left them disheartened. Was there a need to cool their fervor? I have no interest in discussing this, Doctor… Fowlbeasts learn to fly by falling, and one day Kazdel will float in the sky.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I invited you to dance on the sky bridge yesterday? *sigh* I see Muelsyse has taken to this impersonation game. Doctor, I will, for now, take it you failed to recognize that was a water clone, so—who is it you do not know well enough—Muelsyse or myself?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You must have misheard, I was not singing—if you take the Logos you know as a reference, I am no qualified Banshee, nor do I belong to the Convallis any longer. Though elegies still mean the same to me. You're tired? If you're unused to falling asleep to the rumbling of construction noise, I can write you a curse.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Look at the barrier above our heads. Do you think it's out of our reach? Or perhaps I should be asking if you know how it was formed, how to break it down? Kristen absolutely believed her choice held meaning, while I will see it through. Where do you stand on this, Doctor?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: At last, the muddled dream is about to settle…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: So we meet. Nasti Lunorey, Director of Engineering at Rhine Lab. I've heard a lot about you from some of my colleagues. Pleased to make your acquaintance.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Rewind three seconds. The terminal on the left was displaying incorrect data… Alright, problem solved.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Are you expecting a speech…? Sorry, abstract topics only leave me feeling hollow.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I'd like to thank Rhodes Island and you for the recognition, Doctor. Our cooperative efforts have been reassuring.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Rhodes Island's many Operators working multiple jobs is a common sight at Rhine Lab as well.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Saria. She will break through the enemy's encirclement; and Muelsyse will manage any mediation efforts as necessary. Both are indispensable.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Silent words work all the same.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ensure the construction site is safe before we begin.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: If the plan is too vague, I will revise it.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: An error message? Nothing out of the norm.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: You don't have to reiterate the project goals. Work has already begun.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Don't trip on my tape.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Listen again. Did you think it was just construction noise?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: A confession? All I hear is the babbling of souls.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: 'Elegies are no final respite.'

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: 'The realm has naught for your perch.'

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Project done. Good work, everyone.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Do another round of checks… 'Perfect' to us is but a standard to reach.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: 'Expectations' met. Expand on that? We always leave room for improvement.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Angry? Why? Would you like to guess how many Rhine Lab blueprints I've had to revise before they were officially greenlit?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The elevator bulb was loose, so I changed it.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: 'Stasis'—I consider this legitimate self-defense.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Don't pull on the mechanical leaf… Fine, I'll teach you to whistle Mother's melody.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: One last cable, and three, two, one, go… Times like these, the researchers would excitedly scramble over to the cable sparks and call them 'fireworks', but you seem quite calm still—Happy New Year, Doctor. We won't make it to the celebrations back on the island.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You bumped into my 'branches'.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: You're still alive, so leaves are more suitable than bone for the whistle. A melody I know…? No, the Mama John's jingle wouldn't fit… Once upon a time, a group of Pioneers lying on a scaffold hummed a tune to the setting sun to welcome a Banshee into their group. Would you like to hear it?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A Banshee does not forget the Convallis that nurtured her, while a Pioneer will not forget the barrens she trekked through—it was how I joined Rhine Lab, and the antecedent to my future. Doctor, what does Rhodes Island mean to you, and how will you guide it? Our cooperation will continue.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: We're filing project papers? You're kidding me. Why sit here sifting through the stuff we've already done…? There're denied proposals too? Then what the heck are we sitting here looking at dead trees for?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Let me guess. No, don't spoil it for me. Is this a smart head massager, or an autonomic pressure regulator cap, or a holographic environmental monitoring device…? It's just a normal hood? Well, dream bigger! Spot me some funding, and I'll do you a full suit worthy of the Head of Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Yeah, I deal in contraband, but think—what am I 'violating'? They'd outlaw toothpaste if you paid 'em enough to make it Schedule 1. What kind of system is that? I'm trying to rescue the nice stuff from a contraband warehouse, you're trying to sell good drugs on the open market. You and me, we work the same.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Get a load of this, Doc! I rustled up an RGB frill-wig ahead of the summit on Originium goods regulations! Look, this thing changes color on its own, it… what? The summit started half an hour ago? Pfff. That's fine, I still gotta dip into the toybox. I'll deal with the summit later.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: It's not all eggheads at Propeller Paradise. Look at me, I learned all my physics from teaching toys. If I can make it in there, pretty much anyone with a brain can. I'm just out to match people with little fellas that work for them. Can you imagine anything better than that?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Check that out. The stars. Glittering like a blanket over the sky. Make fun of me if you want, but when I was a kid, I'd hold this blanket full of holes over my head, stand under a light, look up to pretend I was stargazing. It was dumb. But life's about feeling out one dumb idea after another until you hit on something and feel like you've got your future. Right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: What am I doing hanging upside-down from the ceiling? Ha! Well, you looked hot enough to boil in that suit, and my propeller here pulls double-duty as a fan, doesn't it? Y'know, excuse me in advance for this, but it's geniuses like you that stump me the most. How come you've got the brains to study a terminal disease, but you don't think to install yourself a better air conditioner?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Back in Tkaronto, when I saw you squatting in the corner of your detention cell, chilling out studying the mushrooms, I knew the ATAO didn't get you, you were just playing the ATAO. And now here I am, business partner with a whiz like you. Goes to show I'm the real deal. And that I didn't put extra meat in your prison meals for nothing.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Wait, what did you just call me? 'Friend'? Nooo no no no, I've used that word on a lot of people before, but not between us, you understand? I don't want to sully my most dependable associate with the kind of relationship that breaks down when you don't like the same food.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: One of these days, I've gotta figure out a way to suck out all the wasted nutrients from the morons who can't use their brains, and then redirect them into you, so you can stop spending all this time sleeping.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Want one, Doc? Here, I got a light. It's just an Originium firework, but you ain't seen nothing yet. Cut a deal today, and I'll get it to you tomorrow. Gordon Tannen, Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Arts Units, and Originium, at your service.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I got some bodycam footage from the gangs we busted back in my frontier days. Want it?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: This is a real deal promotion medal, and not my consolation prize for playing patsy, right? Hey, then this IS my first one ever. You wanna pop the champagne?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I tell you what, this Rhodes Island joint's got potential to become the next Propeller Paradise! A few more of those promotions and I'll bring you along to make it happen… *burp*!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: You guys on the transport crew for my little fellas? Then I'll bring a few extra crates.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You guys remember one thing: When you kick the door down, kick like you mean it! I'll handle the rest.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Oh, high-explosive Originite grenade, my beloved, you'll waste away in the warehouse no longer. I'll blow you up so good the whole continent's gonna hear you scream.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Get on your knees, now! What, never seen an ATAO agent lay down the law before?!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Don't sweat it, I catch your drift.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What, got a report for me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Keep it simple. Doesn't matter where you put me, I'm still headed for the skies.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Stand a little further in, Doc. I can see your hood from here.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't touch me! You gonna fix my hazmat suit too? It's called sense.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: No more hollering! What if I fill my data wrong? It's called courtesy.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Get up! How do I test-fire if you're lying down? It's called responsibility.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Quit playing dead! One more round, new weapon! It's called a control!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Oh, high-explosive Originite grenade, my beloved, did you see that smoke, that fragmentation? You're a success, you're magnificent, you're a hundred KG yield!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: So I put the cuffs on you and now you say you got duped? What, did you forget you had a brain at the time?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Forget those runaways, tape, where's the duct tape? This is supercooled Originium condensate rustled from Sami! Every drop we lose, we lose forever!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Book it, guys! I'm Gordon Tannen and I don't fear a damn thing! I'll give my life before I give my tail!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Wow… What a beauty of a base. It's gotta be either an earth-digger or a sky-flier, right?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Feels good, right? Pure stress relief in your hand. It's designer. I'm always touching it myself.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Yeah? Wanna come fly with me?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Here's a toast to… eugh. Look at me, dredging up my old bootlicking ATAO habits. I'm throwing off our whole collaboration as equals. Okay, here's what we'll do. You serve as a tester for my new gear later, and then we're even again. Sound good?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What's on your mind, Doc? Penny for your thoughts.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: C'mon, Doc, got a few hundred li'l fellas still waiting to meet you. Just you wait, they're gonna give you history's greatest firework show… What do you mean 'too much'? Too much my ass. Frankly, you should have your birthday every day, 'cause hunting for an excuse to do this is a pain in my tail.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Propeller Paradise, Rhodes Island, we're all relegated to roaming the barrens alone. But someday, there'll be a hundred Propeller Paradises and a hundred Rhodes Islands sailing all over the place. We'll be the great land then, and it'll be Max D.C.'s turn to be the languid lonely little dinghy.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You're not seriously expecting me to give you a tour of your own office! C'mon, I'm getting you out of this place! I'll cart you out, if I have to!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: It's more than just cannibals banished from Rusthammer over there, we got Catastrophe cultists infesting the place, all in the name of the living Originium forest… Guh, most of my clients would be asking me to take them there by this point. Where's your sense of curiosity?! You wait here, I'll get us some water before I tell you more!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Eh, no biggie even if you didn't bail me out, that prison wasn't so bad. I accidentally ruined the reputations of enough travel agencies, I had plenty of companies trying to get me thrown in jail, but thanks to them, my Terran Travels 'Free Lodgings' Guidebook has a few new entries.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doesn't matter how much money you've got or how hard the job is, I'm not gonna charge you an arm and a leg if you're feeling something like the Bleached Wasteland. If your idea's good enough, the only consideration I'll need is you bringing yourself along, buuut if you just wanna go into the restricted areas to snap pics with the warning signs, then that'll cost ya!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Look, I might be a rulebreaker, but even I've got standards! Standards like, 'make sure the client comes out without a scratch'! If I didn't keep to that sort of ironclad rule, I'd never have thought to fight off a whole manglerbeast by myself, haha…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: It doesn't have to be a restricted area, y'know. It's not like I'm into getting shocked by electric fences.
