lines.text: 博士，生日快乐。这个——不是小飞虫，是外形经过改良的信号发射器。希望能在您外出工作的时候帮得上……呃呃啊啊等等，被羽兽叼走了——对不起对不起，我马上给您重做一个！

lines.title: 周年庆典
lines.text: 从我出生以来，好像人生中每一次向前迈步，不是形势所迫，就是因为倒霉。但我也差不多该长大了，对吗？下一步，无论如何选择，我都会从容地、坚定地、像大人一样地向前走。

lines.title: 任命助理
lines.text: 博士，红茶和点心都已经准备好了，还有什么需要我做的吗？

lines.title: 交谈1
lines.text: 罗德岛想拓展和太阳谷的合作？联系这个地址可能有用。也准备增加雷姆必拓的矿石采购？这个号码也许帮得上忙。还想更新药物产线？这……这我好像没有什么渠道，我自己现学来得及吗？

lines.title: 交谈2
lines.text: 母亲一直教导我作为一名优雅的淑女，要时时注重衣着的整洁，仪态的端庄——我脸上的泥？还有袖子上的草屑？咳，我们为了躲天灾钻进了沙地兽的洞穴里，那经历实在是太有趣了！您要听听吗？

lines.title: 交谈3
lines.text: 呼，博士要来一起跑步吗？虽然圈数完成了，但我还不想停下来——跑起来的时候，我觉得时间都慢了下来，我像是跑在它的前面一样！

lines.title: 晋升后交谈1
lines.text: 咳咳，早上的训练已经做完了，吃完午餐下午去学习攀岩的技巧。安洁莉娜答应我说，要是我的身体能好一点，她就带我去萨尔贡的雨林。我得再快一点，再努力一点，还有很多想做的事呢！

lines.title: 晋升后交谈2
lines.text: 这本日历之前很薄，但它现在越来越厚啦——这页是我学源石技艺的笔记，这页是我送信的照片——它原本只是用来记录一个可怜病人仅剩的时间，不过它现在会记录我拥有一段何等精彩的人生。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈1
lines.text: 您觉得医疗部的叮嘱很多？以前只要我出门，父亲就会在路上装满空气净化装置，说怕路上不安全，母亲还吓得要吃降压药。噗，比起家里面，医疗部的大家已经很善解人意啦。

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈2
lines.text: 塔妮急着向我们展示她的开车技术，阿梅利亚设计了新的车载通讯台，安洁莉娜说她现在可以让整辆载具都飞上半空，我们打算再去旅行一趟。博士要一起来吗？载具上正好还有一个空位呢！

lines.title: 信赖提升后交谈3
lines.text: 您是说我们沿途搭建的通讯塔传递了消息，成功预警了一场天灾？博士，这真的是我听到的最好的消息——我不仅自己长了很多见识，甚至现在我还能帮到别人，这、这就是我想要的生活！

lines.title: 闲置
lines.text: 呼，就说整理文件这种工作没有很复杂嘛，父亲母亲还总是不让我做，才不会累到我呢。

lines.title: 干员报到
lines.text: 嘉辛塔·坎贝尔，向您问好，博士。初次见面，这是我从雷姆必拓为您带来的甜胡萝卜风味红茶，希望您品尝过后，能享受心情愉悦的一天。

lines.title: 观看作战记录
lines.text: 欸！博士您看，就是那只有袋鼷兽，就是它偷走了我们的东西！

lines.title: 精英化晋升1
lines.text: 我会把这枚徽章也夹进我的日历里面去的，它的厚度在我的努力下又增加了呢！

lines.title: 精英化晋升2
lines.text: 博士，我现在每一天都过得无比充实、幸福。能学习、实践，还能用自己的力量去帮助别人——要我帮您喝掉今天的健康果蔬汁？那不行那不行，我受不了的。

lines.title: 编入队伍
lines.text: 终于有机会和大家一起在雷姆必拓旅行了，我会尽力帮助大家的！

lines.title: 任命队长
lines.text: 感谢大家的信任，我会成为一名合格的领队。

lines.title: 行动出发
lines.text: 我们出发吧！

lines.title: 行动开始
lines.text: 注意检查背包，会有有袋鼷兽偷东西的哦。

lines.title: 选中干员1
lines.text: 咳咳……没事，只是呛了一下，我跟得上的！

lines.title: 选中干员2
lines.text: 呼、呼……还好出发前做了体能训练……

lines.title: 部署1
lines.text: 要不要试一试他们说的间歇泉冲浪？

lines.title: 部署2
lines.text: 据说有的瓶树里面还可以游泳呢！

lines.title: 作战中1
lines.text: 嘘，博士，那是只两米高的大钳兽，快别动了躲起来……

lines.title: 作战中2
lines.text: 嘘——博士，那头牙兽有五米长，别让它发现我们……

lines.title: 作战中3
lines.text: 嘘————博士，那群针蚤靠近我们了，安静屏住呼吸……

lines.title: 作战中4
lines.text: 啊啊啊请！离我！远一点！一位淑女需要她的个人空间——

lines.title: 完成高难行动
lines.text: 看嘛，我就说如果是大家一起的话，肯定能行的！

lines.title: 3星结束行动
lines.text: 博士，能帮我拍一张照片吗？我要纪念我又来到了一个之前没来过的地方！

lines.title: 非3星结束行动
lines.text: 噗，我们像是被扔进泥地里滚了一圈一样，不过还挺有趣的，哈哈哈……！

lines.title: 行动失败
lines.text: 我们的背包真的被有袋鼷兽偷得干干净净呢……

lines.title: 进驻设施
lines.text: 我以为太阳谷的移动舰船就已经足够大了，原来罗德岛是一个移动地块啊。

lines.title: 戳一下
lines.text: 欸，这是罗德岛的打招呼方式吗？原来是这样，我记下了。

lines.title: 信赖触摸
lines.text: 嗯，请您放心，我有在好好吃药、定期接受治疗的。

lines.title: 标题
lines.text: 明日方舟。

lines.title: 新年祝福
lines.text: （写字声）新年快乐博士，您收到这封信的时候，应该正在和罗德岛的大家聚在一起庆祝吧？大铁屯正在举办新年的黄金萝卜节，我找来了最漂亮的一根随信寄来，希望您会喜欢它的味道！

lines.title: 问候
lines.text: 祝您拥有愉快的一天，博士。

lines.title: 生日
lines.text: 请您跟我来，博士，外面的花园里已经准备好了生日主题的下午茶。噗，不用担心，这次有袋鼷兽不会来偷走甜品的，因为我给它们也准备了一份~

lines.title: 周年庆典
lines.text: 大家都会为自己定周年目标呢，我听到塔妮偷偷地加了一句想再长高一点点。我？我的心愿就是，希望能有更多的时间，每一年这个时候都能和大家聚在一起，开开心心地庆祝我们又一起努力了一年。

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I wouldn't dare boast of my prowess with a sword or Arts, but if you have any problems with equipment maintenance, you can come talk to me!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Zofia is my distant aunt, as well as my swordsmanship instructor. It's thanks to her that I can survive in the knight sports scene, but my aunt sometimes— Oh! I mean, my sister! Um, Doctor! Please don't tell her I let that slip, she's actually super sensitive about it!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, to be honest, I'm a much better craftsman than I am a knight! Whether it's repairing an alarm clock or forging armor, I can help! So, Doctor... Can you please take me to see Vulcan's and Closure's workshops? Pleeeeease.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Those two Sarkaz ladies seem hard to talk to... But if my sister trusts them so much, they must be very good people. The Radiant Knight fighting alongside the Sarkaz for the sake of the Infected... Unbelievable! That sounds even more exciting than a breaking news headline!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Actually, I never got an official title like my sister's 'Radiant Knight.' 'Blemishine' is just the codename I chose for myself... But if I was to continue down the path of knighthood, maybe Blemishine wouldn't be a bad name.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Kazimierz's knight sports are nothing more than a huge commercial game, and we all eat out of its palm. I didn't realize it until after I came to Rhodes Island. But the trouble with Kazimierz may run deeper than its betrayal of the knightly traditions... much, much deeper.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Compared to competition knights, Rhodes Island operators are way more like the traditional knights in the novels. In fact, I've been pretty obsessed with these knight novels for a long time. Knights, enemies, adventures, and treasures... But I guess everyone can get that stuff from knight sports, so the novels aren't as big as they used to be.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When I first saw my sister after all this time, it was like she was a totally different person. Instead of that dazzling, blinding light she used to give off, she was more like the gentle sun, warm and stalwart. Did she change for Rhodes Island? Then I want to see for myself what my sister found here!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I couldn't become a real knight, but maybe that's why I was able to get a better view of the lands. I might have more insight now because of it. 'To be a knight is to be the noble light that illuminates the land.' {@nickname}, you will bear witness to my resolve.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Oh, you fell asleep. I wonder if you also have dreams.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Kazimierz knight, codename 'Blemishine.' I've heard all about you from my sister, Doctor. You can just call me Maria if you want.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Wait, hold on... Gosh, you can do it like that?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion...? Hehe, for the glory of the Nearl family, I'll continue to give it my all!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I just realized it's all older folks around me, and I don't really have any friends around to ask... So, Doctor? What do you think about this equipment I made for myself? Pretty cool, yeah? Does it look good on me?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Blemishine will not disappoint!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Captain? Me? B-B-But I don't have any experience with team battles…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Leave the front to me!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Our family motto is, 'fear neither hardship nor darkness!'

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: All ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Pray for the coming battle.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Forward! Into the battle!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: The light holds resolute here!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Light, heed me!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I am here for you!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Don't worry!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You will repent!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Small as it may be... our light persisted until the end!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Each victory will become a light that illuminates the path forward. Doctor, you've done well!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: This... this isn't over yet!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'll protect the wounded. Take the others and retreat, quickly!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: So this is the inside of Rhodes Island... Aw, I'd really love to see the schematics…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Woah! Don't scare me like that...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor! Shh! I snuck over here to hide from Auntie Zofia. Hehe, let me take the day off!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Kazimierz will have already auctioned off the 'firework rights' by now. But rather than a flashy fireworks show, thank-you letters to my grandfather made a deeper impression on me. The kid he saved from the war grew up, started a family, and came to Kazimierz to see him. Margaret was also really happy that day.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Oh, hey there, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've made you all sorts of gifts, Doctor. Metal mask, swords, other things… But I guess you don't have much use for them. Why don't you choose something you'd like to display in your office? Ahahah... Sorry... I really only know how to craft knight stuff, I haven't figured out what to do for Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: What exactly should the Golden Pegasus coat of arms symbolize? I'm not nearly as clear on that as my sister. I never got the chance to learn much from our ailing grandfather. But I still think... people can recognize a sublime spirit, and naturally look up to it, even outside Kazimierz.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You pulled an all-nighter, and you're still not done? Sheesh, what should I do with you...? How much do you have left? I'll help. You should get some rest. And work on your time management.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I can confirm we've received this shipment of medicine without issues. The quantities are right. As for the payment, could you please let Kal'tsit know I'll take care of that pain-in-the-neck mission for her.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Count Hohenlohe, some call him the Hyacinth Count. The way I see it, he's quite a handful with that personality of his. I'm serving as huscarl to this Leithanian noble, on account of some trouble. What trouble, you ask? Hm... Let's keep this a secret for the time being.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: That little one... Her codename here is uh... Beeswax? Looks like she tripped in the hallway again this morning. Can she really cut it? She sure knows how to keep her sister worrying.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island provides what the count and I need. In return, I take care of Rhodes Island's troubles in Leithanien. This is what you call a win-win situation, isn't it? Come, shake my hand. This is the beginning of a beautiful friendship, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The Leithanians' research on Arts has far exceeded my expectations, and their architecture, music, and education... All are worthy of study. One day, I will bring all this back home. Yeah, and I might bring something else along, though.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The longer we acclimate to an environment and the different people there, the harder it will get for us to free ourselves, and eventually we'll be made to fit its mold... Don't you agree, Doctor? Well, that's not going to get me tied down here. Not unless I allow it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm sure the nobles think of me as an odd thorn in their side. No matter. I don't mind. Though I'd rather keep all this trouble a secret from Beeswax. It's too dangerous... Now that I mention it, I can't quite stop worrying about you, either.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: If it's at all possible, I'd rather stay out of the nobles' bickering. Do you know how much I have to worry about each and every day with all the chaperone work and missions on my plate? Maybe I should talk the count into letting me hop over here full time. I'm relying on you to keep me under your wing when the time comes, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: My little sister sometimes talks in her sleep. This one time, I even caught her talking bad about me. Heheh, Doctor, do you know what you said in your sleep the other day?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, you must be the Doctor? I'm Carnelian, huscarl to Count Hohenlohe... Oh, I'm just a normal operator here at Rhodes Island. Kindly refrain from frivolous conversation with my little sister, won't you?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I see. These are tactics worth studying.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: There is no need, but I appreciate your kind gesture. Thank you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You see, I find myself worrying about a vast number of people and things, and that number is growing by the day. It's been a while since I was able to do as I pleased, but since you're up for it... Let's put on a show.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: This is not part of our agreement, but fine. I'm happy to help.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll bring everyone back, safe and sound.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Follow the plan, everyone!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Elegance and etiquette are the way of nobility. Not mine.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: As you wish.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Between a refined combat style or something more direct, which do you prefer?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: It's been a long time since my blood boiled like this.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Greetings... Let's forgo the bothersome formalities and get this thing started.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Gnaw them to shreds and drink their blood!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Crush them, beat them to a pulp!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Careful! Don't get torn to shreds so quickly!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: My oh my, what a pitiful sight. Why are you covered in blood?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Nothing to worry about then. That was easy enough for you.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Okay, mission complete, and right on time, too... Are you hurt, Doctor?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Calm down. Just leave the rest to me. They won't get away.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Fall back, now! Don't panic. As long as I'm still standing, no one will touch you!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Just as I thought. I can relax better in a room without much decoration.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh... Watch out. My horns could get you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: What's wrong? Are you tired? Get some rest. You've worked hard enough already.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: My horns look especially good today? Thank you. It was my little sister who insisted on giving me a cornicure. I might as well assume that such things bring good luck for the new year. Having experienced a variety of customs, people's feelings when praying for new beginnings are always similar.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: More work today? Don't spend the whole day sitting, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I am not one to play the sycophant on such occasions, but I'm willing to offer you a gift as a friend. This gramophone is for you, and when next I travel between Rhodes Island and Leithanien, I'll be sure to bring back some records.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a partner that keeps its promises, but true partners need connections deeper than contracts. No, Beeswax has grown up, and her relationship with Rhodes Island is her own business. What we are discussing now is between you and me.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Organizing documents? Doctor, we have much more important things to do. Bene, I'll give you a hand, if you insist. But do remember, I expect you to come up with a plan that's worth my while. Do not disappoint me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: What do you want to know? Secrets of the Siracusan famiglie? There's hardly anything worth mentioning there. The things we do are no different from the wolves fighting in the wilderness thousands of years ago. Only, time has taught us some new tricks. Heh, you see 'order' could be the official name for 'tearing your prey to pieces.'

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: For many years, I couldn't really understand my father. He paid the ultimate price, only to betray almost everything in the end... But I still remember the question my father posed to me many years ago, when we were sitting together in a park: 'Siracusa, sara un posto migliore senza le famiglie?'

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Judge Lavinia never realized what she was getting herself into. The game with Signora Sicilia won't be won through courage or resourcefulness alone... She's looking for me? To discuss my unbalanced diet…? Tell her I'm not here.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The old ways make it impossible to find a new path. If the new Siracusa is built on violence, it will fall back into the same well. The destruction of a few individual famiglie is far, far from enough. We must kick the entire 'habit.'

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The disputes among the famiglie were petty and stupid. The dons clung on to whatever authority they had, thinking they were the masters of Siracusa. But I invite you, Doctor, to join me in shaping a new era.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: If you want to show respect to the Siracusans, then hire a proper Siracusan chef. The next time I see any 'innovative Siracusan cuisine' out of your minions... Beh, let's just say somebody knows about your little office naps, and it'd be a shame if the beans got spilled on your beauty sleep.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Something on your mind? If it calls for blackmail, bribery, or something worse... none of that would be much trouble for me. Underhanded business is pretty much all I inherited from my famiglia. As for how to use my knowledge, that's your call.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Zaaro, il Signore dei Lupi... the shadow lurking behind me and my father. Don't be fooled by his pretentious words. A wild beast's hunt won't slow the progress of humanity. If he appears before you one day, I will drive him away.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hey. Is our 'cooperation' just me watching you sleep?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Buongiorno, Doctor. I am Famiglia Bellone's... Lasci perdere. My famiglia doesn't exist anymore, but that was the price we paid to buy change in Siracusa. As for what comes next... Operator Vigil is at your service, Doctor. I hope our partnership will be productive.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I am no stranger to violence. As long as I'm on the scene, things should be a little more efficient.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? There's no need to test me like that, Doctor. I've played this game too... winning people over with small rewards. But if you're just trying to show your faith in me... Va bene, grazie.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Our partnership has been productive, Doctor. A made man would sell out anybody for his ambitions, but I can promise you one thing: you've bought my loyalty with yours.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Va bene. Let's see if your plan is worthy of my work.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: The process is just as important as the end result. Don't go dying on me, ragazzi.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Remember, our purpose is not violence itself, but rather the victory it brings.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Chi morirà qui oggi?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ready to move.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: They'll be sleeping with the fins in no time.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Don't make this harder than it needs to be.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Anything outside the plan, I'll judge for myself.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Let's put an end to this show, pronto.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: And what purpose do you think your sacrifice will serve?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This hunt has dragged on for too long.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: A valiant struggle, but you won't get away.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: They have no idea who they're messing with. Bravo, Doctor. I was right to partner with you. I hope you'll find even more challenges for me in the next battle.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Are we done yet? What are you looking all smug for? These stronzi have already wasted too much of our time.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They're getting away. Do you need me to walk you through this? Ma dai! Whack them already.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'll take care of the evacuation. You get moving, fast. I hope this won't happen again, Doctor.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Careful with the moisture-proofing. I hate the smell of rotting wood.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Are you having fun? Because I'm not.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ah... Mi mancano le osterie di Siracusa. Doctor, is the kitchen available right now? I can make something myself.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's a brand new year. A toast to our goals, alla nostra salute. Oh, don't worry, this is just apple juice. I can't handle wine that's too strong. Why are you laughing? Whoever said that mafiosi have to drink?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: None of these documents matter at all, Doctor. The only thing that matters is how you act.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Your birthday? Doctor, do you seriously celebrate things like that at your age? Alright then. We're partners, so I have to go along with this. Happy birthday. You want me to sing it? Don't push your luck.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, the two of us are actually pretty similar. I believe that even a swamp like Siracusa can change. And your ambitions, hah, they are even bigger than mine. We both have what it takes to make this happen. I'll keep working on myself. I hope you'll do the same.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: It's done. The battle plans, reports, and mission schedules have all been sorted... Eh... Is this not the right way? Sorry, I'm not used to this yet...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Iwona and Ashlock can make quite a ruckus together. I can't hear the wind when they do that. It's a pain.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hm? Who's that in the training grounds...? The Radiant Knight? Doctor, is it okay if I go check it out up close?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It's really close. When I sit here and look outside, I can see the crops in the distant ripening as the farmers harvest their fields. It's just like my hometown.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: It's actually not very hard to become a knight in Kazimierz if you're healthy. All you have to do is sign up at the arena. But to become a real 'knight' is difficult. Real difficult, even for those who are healthy.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I agree with Sona's ideas, and I'm willing to fight for them... Though, I guess I might just be afraid of losing the one place where I belong. Doctor, do you also see Rhodes Island as a place you will protect no matter what it takes?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Thank you for treating us. Sona, Iwona, and Ashlock asked me to bring you these as thanks. And here's one that I picked. It's a small token of my appreciation.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I used to dream of becoming a knight, but on the way to the Grand Knight Territory, I got infected in an accident. I still remember how it felt. The numbness spread from my palm to my fingertips... That was the first time I couldn't hold my sword.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Here's a grass whistle... Want to listen to me use it? I used to whistle with it whenever I had some free time back home. The wind back then is not like it is now. It was clear as crystal, and it wasn't dangerous at all... It was calming.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Finally awake? Here, the files are sorted... Should be right this time, I think?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: 'Fartooth' Justyna, Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub. You can call me Fartooth. I've heard about Rhodes Island and you in particular, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: They're going to lose. If they don't take a proper defense stance, they won't be able to block this one. You've got them.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Is that something like advancing to the next round?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: There's not much that I want, and I don't have much either. That's why... as long as I'm still standing here, nobody can hope to take anything from me!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: ...I'll do as you say. You are my commander, and I'll follow your orders.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: A team battle? Understood.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Ready. Line up... Sortie!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Wait, the winds have shifted... Everyone, stay alert!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yeah, I'm ready whenever.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: One-on-one, or one-on-many?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I hope we can win this match fair and square.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I, 'Fartooth' Justyna, will be your opponent.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The winds are stirring. I can tell.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I've locked onto you.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: There's no need to talk in battle.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Let's put an end to this... You can't beat me; accept your defeat.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You've done well, Doctor. This is a glorious victory.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I fended them off just as you instructed... I'm being too solemn? Really...?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I won't attack those who leave the arena.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Go on ahead...! I'll hold them here, Doctor! Lead the others away!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Not bad. The airflow here feels refreshing... Thank you.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm? What is it? Want an autograph?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor...? Yeah, I can tell it's you without listening to your footsteps. The winds around you aren't like the others.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: There are so many noises mixed in on the wind here. Fireworks, dishes and glasses, the voices of people as they celebrate. My neighbors would be just as noisy every holiday back home, but I've never minded it, because that's how this day should be. Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Don't move... Your hair's sticking out. That's right. Stay still. I'll fix it for you.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here, Doctor. This is your present from me. It's a chime. Hang it on your window, and it'll sing whenever the breeze stirs. Very soothing. Happy birthday, Doctor. I gift you the sound of the wind.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I brought this flute from home, and the only songs I play are ones my neighbors taught me. I know you can never return to the past, but that's not so bad, is it? Just like how the wind never blows back to where it came from. It carries itself on its own momentum, flying further and further away, to a loftier place.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: So, just like the big corporations' office workers, even you have a bunch of deskwork to do. That's quite a lot, too. Do you need any help?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I never imagined the Radiant Knight would take up employment anywhere. Rhodes Island is a mysterious company.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Knights may be able to climb back up after they fall, but the Infected don't have such kindhearted options available to them.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: *Cough*... My weapon seems to be acting up, *cough*... Which way is the workshop? That way? Thank you. *Cough*.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: If the knight nobles were able to fulfill their vows and responsibilities, the Infected wouldn't have found themselves so oppressed. But... those nobles... the Kazimierz people would rather sign contracts with those big security companies than trust those knight nobles to protect them from crime and violence.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: They tell me my family met its downfall because I got infected, that I am to blame for everything. Hmph, just what you'd expect from the knight nobles. They're all good-for-nothings who know only to bully the weak.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Justyna likes to use titles when she talks to me... Why is that? Is the word 'Ashlock' that special to her?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Sona and I met each other during a team melee match. That was a tough battle, but we reached an understanding and worked with each other as soon as we met. At the very end, she took all my points with her sword, but then apologized to me right away... That's how we started working together.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: If I can't go back home anymore, then all I can do is find the way forward with Sona and the gang. Heh... Becoming an Infected knight hasn't been kind to me, but at least we have the chance to fight. It doesn't matter what miseries the future has in store for us; I'm sure it'll still be a much brighter place.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Be sure to get enough rest. The break after a match is just as important as your daily training.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm 'Ashlock' Greynuty of Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub. Thank you for taking us in.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: A coordinated assault? Yeah, they work well with each other.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Is this a medal to prove my qualifications? Oh... Sorry, I still don't have all of Rhodes Island's rules down. Thank you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: 'When the cannon fire rings through the air, victory is already within sight.'

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I will follow your orders.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You need me to take charge? Okay.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Good hunting, everyone.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Get ready. The enemy's coming!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your orders.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: It's not like the knight competitions. You can't pause a battle when someone gets injured.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: The match's starting now.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Reload!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Cannon fire is just the first step.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Strengthen your defense! Forward!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I will win this match!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Wonderful. So this is the art of command. You've opened my eyes.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Looks like you're good at commanding team battles.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The more points you lose in the arena, the less likely you are to win.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: *Cough*... Is this... my fault...?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Good thing my equipment doesn't take up too much space.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: A present from a fan? It was sent to you? Sorry for the trouble.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Sona should still be asleep, Iwona's at the training grounds, and Justyna's standing guard up on the watchtower. As for me... I haven't figured it out yet. Doctor, what would a normal Rhodes Island operator do on this day?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Do we have any missions today?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday. Here's... no, actually, forget it. Giving you an autographed postcard as a gift just feels too arrogant, my apolo— You don't mind? Oh... thanks for that...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I used to believe that, in looking for a better way to help the infected, we need to cast our sights beyond the border of Kazimierz, but the situation there turns out to be... even more complicated. And we won't get to the bottom of it unless we learn firsthand ourselves. Still, I'm ready to face all of it. Send me out on missions, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I get oil on me real easy, so I don't clean my apron often... There's some on my face too? Uhh, I'll go get it off.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, I don't know if this is offensive to ask, but... say you start things out with a mindset that gets people to live in peace with the Infected. Do you ever feel like your effort is in vain? What do you do, in times like that?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I consulted with my profs and sent a lot of resumes out close to graduation, but got no reply. I was told later how a lot of spots and big companies  are fixed in advance, and not for students with no background like me. So the day I got Rhodes Island's hiring invitation, I thought it was some employment scam.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor! I ever tell you about my club at college? We used the funds from the school to buy new machines on the market, tear 'em down and reassemble 'em. Learnt a lot of new stuff that way. Is Rhodes Island about that too? Check this one out! It's smoking right now, sure, but it's got new functionality.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I helped out at my parents' factory when I was a kid. Lots of stuff you've just gotta count on pure manual labor for. I've gone over all the notes the vets at Engineering lent me. If we can pass all this new tech down to my parents, we can save 'em a lot of effort.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My parents saved hard for a good school when I was a kid. I had classmates clowning on us for being poor, so I was dead set on learning something, showing them who's boss. They might still be living a cushier life than me, but nowadays, I just focus on myself.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, Rhodes Island is all real passionate folks. Saying they wanna make me clothes, they wanna gimme a haircut, and then they drag me off to show me around their own stalls. What do I do...? H—Hug 'em? Got it. I'll go try right now.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, I've never had a boss like you before. Ones I met before were all money-grubbing owner types, so... y'know hugs have really worked out. Can I hug you? C'mon, here we go!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I used to feel like this world was unfair, no matter where you went, and no one could do a thing to change it. But here, poverty or infection, none of that discrimination exists, and everyone gets rewarded equal to what they put in. Doctor, pulling this whole thing off...it's incredible.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You out? Real quiet... Woof! —Ooh, awake now, Doctor?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice meeting you, Doctor, I'm Windflit, new Operator at Engineering. You said you saw ability in me? Real thankful for that.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Effort is the root of progress. Regular review lets me realize a lotta issues I overlooked before.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I really love Rhodes Island's standards for promotion. No unfairness about 'em.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Getting to this level of endorsement makes all my previous effort really kinda pay off. Doctor, Rhodes Island truly is a company worth sticking with for a long time.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I've got no combat experience, but I'll give it my best shot.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm not circling you all because I wanna. You're all too scattered apart. It'll be dangerous.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Can't let 'em bully us. Let's go!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I wonder if these guys have their own problems too...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: All ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: When do we get going?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: No need to worry.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I can do this.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Woof!!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Device set!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: What is it you guys fight for?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Still coming closer?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew... Each new battle teaches me a lotta new things. Maybe one day, I can finally get my own issues figured out.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, how was my equipment this time? Real useful, right?!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Let's forget chasing 'em, maybe they've got their own problems. They chose to run, so no need to corner 'em now.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ugh... how did this happen...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Real spacious room. And real clean.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh? Was that my ears?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I welded together this little metal doll kinda thing to look like you, hahaha...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Never got to really celebrate when I was a kid. Have the right conditions now, but it's not with my family. Just need to make a bit more cash, and then I can ask for a couple days off and go see 'em again without worrying about my salary. That's my New Year's resolution.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, wanna play Ultimate?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor~ I'm not all that good at picking, is this kind of cake your thing? C'mon, let's have another hug.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: This really sells Rhodes Island as a loaded place. Is everyone gonna be able to finish all this food off? Not gonna be nice to waste it. Ooh—is that Kay over there? Not—Not gonna hold her back?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Please, leave all these reports to me. I take great delight in indulging myself in records and documents.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: That Suzuran girl I turned down just now, I wonder if I've been too harsh on her... She was kind enough to invite me to her tea party, but socializing isn't really my forte…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My body is frail, frailer than most others'. To die a young death, to forsake all my pasts, then to be born anew… 'Rejuvenation'… such is the cruel fate of mine…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Memories dissipate as spumes on shore. The pains, the joys, the pasts I don't want to let go… nothing will be there as I look back.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Though my memory fails to serve me, I can still sense the unspeakable flowing within my blood. Stay away from the sea, Doctor. It'll be a nightmare devouring us all. It is… fear itself.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I do wonder sometimes what 'mortality' is to those with true longevity, like Dr. Warfarin and her people. For them to shed not a tear when bidding farewell to the departed, is it only because theirs have long run dry?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, could you take these flowers to the children in the ward, for me? Yes, just like always, place them by their bedsides… Thank you, for helping keep this secret.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, come quickly, we need to find Closure! It seems Thorns and his companions have burst a water pipe open in the corridor, and Weedy is furious now! I'm soaked to the skin... Um, I seem—like I'm enjoying myself? Wh-What do you mean?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Every time I watch a film, I keep the ticket stub afterward. These leftover vestiges always serve to me as a reminder, even if the contents would be lost to me... Doctor, could you come watch a film with me? I'd like to preserve the time I've passed with you, too.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sleep sound, Doctor... By the time you wake, will you have forgotten about me?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Code name… Whisperain. A roving doctor, nothing more. If possible, please take me as a traveler lodging under the eaves in rain. You needn't pay me much mind…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: In the face of such fierce combat, I worry... I wouldn't be able to survive.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you very much. But I hope you treat me the same as always...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Those sorrows I could not wash away with one death—I always feel like they're strands, wisps, winding about my skin... Doctor, you've come to forget the past too—could you maybe understand this feeling?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Please leave the assistive work to me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm the leader...? That's a little…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Please keep with me. Don't go too far.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Please be careful, everyone. Protect yourselves and stay safe.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Very well.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Injections are ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Come to me if you get wounded.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let me dispel the pain.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Disinfection comes first.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Do not be afraid.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: My treatment will not hurt.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I know this scent of death well.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Sleep tight... May the rainfall shelter all dreams.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: This is how their story ends. Tragedies, one following another...

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Leave the pursuit for later. I'd like to see everyone treated first.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm sorry, I could have fulfilled my role better…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Such a peaceful place this is. I can hear the patter of rainfall.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: You startled me…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: D-Don't move, please! Something got my hair…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Elysium, Thorns, please stop blowing your noisemakers, quite a few operators are already staring at you... Ah, Happy New Year, Doctor. The New Year at Rhodes Island truly is so vigorous... Was I ever this happy to celebrate in the past? I'm afraid I no longer remember.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What will we be doing today, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Amnesiac as you are, you still haven't forgotten the meaning of this day, which tells me a lot. In that case, would you like to keep the stub of a movie ticket with your birthday on it?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Please, allow me to sit out here on my own. It doesn't feel quite right being a part of this ship's commemoration day, given that I don't know when I might depart... That being said, I will always remember the sound of rain pattering on the deck. There's little else like it.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Dr. Kal'tsit told me if you ever chose to place me at your side, it means you've decided to protect me. But maybe you're just as clueless as I am with her riddle, Doctor. Still, I'm sure she must've said it for a reason.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Tasty food, manga, and video games… I see them all as poetry scattered under the starry sky. I intend to relish them all on my journey... and eliminate anything that threatens their existence.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Ah, Doctor! Perfect timing! Please try this special sashimi I made. With my secret technique, the nutrients and vitality of the ingredients are best preserved.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Oh, this? It's a classic arcade game that used to be popular in Higashi. Want to have a go, Doctor? Here, just move that yellow mouth to eat and grow. However… until you've absorbed enough nutrients to grow strong, you'll only be prey to others.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: A sense of justice? No, You got me wrong, Doctor. I don't really care much about bad guys. It's just… for some reason, good people always let them get away with bad things. What if... someone came along and got rid of them? No one would feel bad for them, right? Everyone would just be happy.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Hmm… I still don't get your point, Doctor, but I just need to take out the ones you say are bad, yes? After all, I know the Doctor is a good person. What if you're the bad guy? Don't ask me that! I would be crushed. Even if you are, I really, really don't wanna…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There's something on this ship that's both familiar and strange... gentle, yet hostile. It's making me uneasy, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, what does it feel like to hold the lives of others in your hands? If it were me, their warmth would make me tremble with excitement. Hm? Oh, I was talking about you as a commander, holding everyone's lifeline.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The food and nutrients we take in sustain and shape us. So sometimes I wonder... if we ate the same food and did the same things, would we gradually become the same? Doctor, would we?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: It's time to take a little break, Doctor. Come here, lie down. I'll go grab a blanket.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ah, hello there, Doctor. Dr. Kal'tsit tells me you're my commander from today on! It's too bad I don't count as an official operator, but as long as you need my help, I'll do whatever I can.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I need to digest and absorb all this, right? I'll do my best.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I've earned your approval? Does that mean I can go to more places with you and get rid of more bad guys?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: On one rainy day, I received an unexpected gift that changed me, but I was not taught how to face the future… Doctor, if it were you, would you have shown me the path yourself?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I should stay hidden, even from my teammates? Understood, I'll do as you say, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I will protect you from the shadows, Doctor, as well as everyone else in our squad.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The deployment plan and secret missions for this operation... Mhm, all confirmed.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Are they the enemies? They don't look half bad.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Your orders are my beacon.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready whenever.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: You always help me find my place.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Be bold, Doctor, trust what the mind says.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Looks like a piece of cake.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Thanks for the treat.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: These tentacles are illusions? Why delude yourself?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Evildoers need to be culled. They always will be culled.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: What a tough nut to crack. It'll take some time to digest this battle.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: There are fewer bad guys out there now, and it's all thanks to you, Doctor!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Huh? Doctor, why'd you let some bad guys through? I'll go clean them up for you.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: If it's only to cover everyone's retreat, I can do that… No, just saving everyone is not enough, the bad guys still need to be eliminated…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Shall I whip up something tasty to help everyone unwind?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm? What's up?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Achoo! Ugh... Why does it feel like someone's looking right through me...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! We've all grown by another year, and I've absorbed plenty of nutrients. I really hope everyone can keep evolving and become even better.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Did you miss me, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I dunno where it came from… But they say if you mix a little of yourself into a cake, then whoever eats it will go crazy for you. Sounds… sick, right? Wait, Doctor, don't run away! I didn't put anything weird in this birthday cake, I swear!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, when you look at me now, what do you see? Am I still just a kid, or have I grown strong enough… maybe even stronger than you? If that were true… Then shouldn't I protect you instead?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor? No, I wasn't taking a nap! I was... I was just spacing out!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Is it raining outside? I used to really hate rainy days... Mud gets everywhere, and construction grinds to a halt. Dad would always come home late when it rained. But I always felt cozy when the rain let up and I'd stay inside, just like this.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Back when I worked construction in Columbia, life was a real grind. I had to get up early every morning and go to bed late every night. Sometimes I'd be working overtime and suddenly realize I hadn't slept at all…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Oh, Doctor, would you like to go for a walk together? Hm? Ahh...! Wh-Where's my tool bag...? Did I leave it at the construction site again? I-I'm sorry, wait a sec while I fetch it!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: What I want to do...? Hmm... A steady job and an honest life would be enough for me. So why sign on to be an operator here? Well... The pay is a bit better, and the work isn't all that different... so I figured, why not give it a shot? I guess?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The Infected... There were plenty of Infected workers back in Columbia. Everyone warned me to keep my distance. But watching them work, I realized they're no different from the rest of us.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Oh... what the job Closure put me on again...? If I go back and ask her, I'll probably get an earful... Say, Doctor? Do you think you could help me out...?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My dad always says, studying hard is the key to a better life. Doctor, you know lots of stuff, right? Could you teach me something? I promise I won't zone out. Well, I'll try really hard, anyway.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I never used to think much about the future. I figured I'd just drift between odd jobs with the Pioneers, spending my life as a craftsman. But now... I really need to thank our friend—the big guy. I wouldn't have met you, if it wasn't for him... Uh... A-Anyway, I really appreciate what he did for me.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Fwahh... I'm so tired... Maybe I'll take a little nap, just like the Doctor...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Codename Pinecone... I'm starting at Rhodes Island today... Um... Have you seen my portable battery?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Um... Umm... I don't get it...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor... But what should I do now? Oh... Do I just kinda do what the others do? Okey-dokey…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Hm...? Another promotion? Ehehe, you're awfully forgetful yourself, Doctor. Didn't you already give me a promot—This is a new one? Um... Okay. I'll follow your lead. So, when are we heading out?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Time for work.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I guess it's like being a foreman at a construction site?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Um... Where are we going again...?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: It's the enemy! Don't hold back!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes, I'm listening!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What's the job, Doctor!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Here, right?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll stay right here like a nail.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hyah!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I still have lots of batteries on me!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Pulling the trigger!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Just like shooting nails at work!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew... That was a lot harder than building a house. Doctor, it makes us kinda impressive, don't you think?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was perfect... Doctor, are you happy with how we did?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hmm... Maybe I messed up the process...? I'm sorry. It didn't go as well as I'd hoped.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Eh? Why are there sparks... S-Sorry... It's all my fault...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Okay, is there anything that needs maintenance?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, want to watch the rain together? There's not much to see, though...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Uh, since it's New Year's, I figured I'd give your office a little touch-up, Doctor... Yes, I cleaned up some wear marks and remade the wall decorations. Err, if—if you don't like it, I can take everything down right away...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Hope you have another year of steady employment as a doctor... Err, is that not your job? Okay, I hear you. So, uh... hope you have a year with less overtime. Mm-hm.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, after listening to everyone's stories over dinner, I've been wondering... I feel like we're doing something epic, aren't we? So, would it be... inappropriate someways if I brought my parents to work at Rhodes Island?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Thirty-two, then thirty... three? Oh, Doctor? Wait, where was I? Hmm, I've been away half an hour? No worries, almost done. The fiftieth document from the left... one, two... don't worry, I'm the best counter at my escort association.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: In this line of work, encountering odd clients comes with the territory. There was this one time when I was hired to escort a gentleman, he insisted I carry him on my back down a muddy road. I agreed, but said only after terminating our escort contract, because I couldn't defend him while carrying someone on my back.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Doctor, take some of these. My family came by during their escort job and brought me some treats from back home. What? We're under attack? Wait, you mean... them? Uh, hey, don't smoke on the landship. Put your shoes on and mind your manners! Don't glare at people like that! Ahem, Doctor... let me introduce you to my family.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'll ask the local bandit boss about the situation here. No, we're not exactly friends, but we sort of pay this toll of theirs. Does that sound like we're in cahoots with the bandits? Hahah, it's just a way we can both make a living. Nobody wants unnecessary bloodshed, if we can help it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I got the crystals on my hand from a highwayman. His legs were shaking and I thought I could talk him out of it, but his mind was made up. When I discarded his Originium explosive, we both got caught in the blast. In the end, I left him some money for his sick child's treatment. As for my own condition, I got used to it long ago.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Not every bandit manages to make the move to an honest escort life. Some have walked the way of the bandit for too long to change, many of them were aunts and uncles who watched me grow up. I couldn't look them in the eye when I had to show them out, but people must keep moving forward, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: What are you eating? Give me a bite; I haven't eaten yet. Ran into a righteous volunteer on the way, he was collecting relief funds for his hometown that got hit by a Catastrophe, so I gave him all my money. A scam? Maybe, but I don't need more money than I can spend, and I can always sock him if it turns out he was lying. It's not like I'll ever starve with you around.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My swords? This one was given by my adoptive mother. The other was hers—she threw it in my face the day she left. The blood was everywhere. I had tried to convince her to retire from banditry and join the escort business, but she saw it as a betrayal. People... when goals differ, they are quick to call it treachery. She raised me, after all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Once I no longer have to worry about the escort association, I want to go wander the jianghu, to see what's out there. Want to come along, Doctor? Where to? Haven't thought about it yet. What matters is wandering free like a fowlbeast, traveling only with my two swords, drawing them at the first sign of injustice, and drinking and singing to my heart's delight.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Want some dried plums, Doctor? I always eat one when I get sleepy on the night shift. A piece of green plum with no sugar added works better than pinching my thigh. Haha, look at your face! You look like the plum just bit you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You're the Doctor of Rhodes Island? I've heard so much about you. I sign this, and you'll be an official friend of Windscoot. Any help you might need, just— er... no, I know how to write my name. It's—where do I sign?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: My eyelids, they're stuck... Doc, just step on my tail. It's fine, just stomp!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Just like when I wore my escort association's badge for the first time. Gotta keep my head bowed and tail tucked. I won't let you lose face, Doc!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: There was this time I picked up a cloudbeast on a solo escort mission. We traveled together for a while. But just before entering the city, I set it free, afraid customers might see it and think I was soft. Now, I suppose I wouldn't be afraid to keep such a companion.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Three bulkies, twelve mid-sized… all set. Huh, why is there one more here? Did I count wrong?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everyone, keep an eye open, your sword at hand and uniform on. Safety first.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The fortune stick reads 'very lucky'! Only took one, two... five draws to get it. What a good sign! Let's go!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: They've got guts, coming at us like this. Don't they recognize our banner? Guess we're in for a fight.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Just tell me which one to cleave.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Just tell me where to go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: In position. Awaiting your command.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Give the signal and I'll do it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't pick a fight if you're not prepared to get punched.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: A few broken bones would be a good lesson for you.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Want my goods, none; else my life, one. Come and take it if you dare!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I've already drawn my swords. You can beg for your life after we've fought.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: We're friends for life from this day on, Doctor. One word from you and I'll rush to your aid, even if I'm on the other side of Terra—that's a promise.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The goods are intact, and everyone's unhurt! Ahhh, damn it!—I've dreamed of having such a reliable escort leader as you, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Look at him run! He even lost his shoes, hahaha! As long as the goods are safe, that's all that matters. Bandits never forget an ass-kicking. Next time they hear our association's escort chant, they'll stay far away.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'll keep them at bay while you go get backup. Want my goods? Over my dead body!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing, just a habit. Always make sure a room's safe before going in. Well, the facilities are secure, but the personnel are a bit... mixed. However, if you trust them, I'll consider it safe.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Come on, come on—argh! Almost caught that Burderupt! Oh, er, yes, this terminal is normally used for taking inventory, but there's always a way to install games. Keep it a secret, will you?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Haha... you're allowed just this once. Ears are my weakness, after all.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! Yeah, I'm preparing to set out. This is the peak season in my line of work. It's nothing. On the contrary, it's a good omen to get busy on the first day of the New Year. Hope we both have a prosperous year, Doctor!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor. Yeah, I just finished training. I'll help out once I've cleaned up.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Cut the crap, just stew it. The Doctor and I are friends for life, we'll have nothing but the finest birthday food! Stew the entire cystybeast! Hey, our usual bowls aren't fit for the Doctor. Find a smaller one, just enough for one catty of rice!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: We developed several new routes last year to deliver goods for Rhodes Island. Those rascals were so busy they had no time to cause mischief, but they looked much more spirited and energetic. Better life to chase, more glow on face, as it's said. Hahaha... All that's to say, we look forward to your continued support for our business this year, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: The neat little circles on that page? I didn't draw them. I wouldn't doodle on your documents.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: W-Wait, Doctor! Don't open that lid! That's a device I use to make bubbles... Sorry, I'm not laughing at you for getting all bubbled up. I-I just like seeing a bunch of bubbles together! Really! I'm not lying!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Sorry, Doctor. I didn't have the detergent-to-aroma formula under control. Um… I made some changes to it, and the aroma might linger in your nose for a very, very long time. You might smell it every now and then for the next two weeks...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I put on a bubble show for the young patients at Medical today. What kind of show? It's like this... There’s a big, big, big bubble with a big, big bubble inside. And then the big, big bubble’s got a big bubble. And Bubble’s inside the big bubble. Oh, that last one is my partner, Bubble, not a normal bubble.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, my family's formulators aren't quite like the others in our industry. Our peers try to create aromas that remind users of a certain beautiful moment in their memories. But my family, we work to suppress the worst, most terrible smells in their memories.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: All this time, I've thought that aromas by themselves couldn’t eradicate stenches. The most important thing is to open the windows and let the foul air out. Otherwise, the aroma and stench blend together, and that would just be a different, disgusting smell.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I'm cleaning the room right now, and you came at just the right time, Doctor. Would you help me wipe the light tubes up top? They're a bit too high, and I can't reach them, even on a ladder. Yeah, there's a small black spot just a little to the left... Ah! W-Why is that black spot flying?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, I brought some shampoo my family made onto the landship. It's from a small workshop, but we source all the essential oils we use from plants in nature. Like this lemon-scented one. We used lemons taken from my family's backyard, where my grandmother planted a lemon tree the year I was born.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: There was a chaotic time where murders were a daily occurrence in Siracusa, and my family served as 'cleaners' charged with clearing out the aftermath. We left that line of work a long time ago, but every now and then, we still remember the thick stench of blood that seemed to overpower everything else.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh no. A bubble floated into the room and landed on the Doctor's nose... If somebody goes in there and thinks the Doctor's got a snot bubble, that wouldn't be good…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. I'm Logistics Operator Aroma. Would you open your hands like this? Don't worry... I just thought that with how nice and bright the sun is today, it would be perfect to put a bubble reflecting a rainbow onto your palm.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This will make a very useful reference. I never knew detergent could be used like that.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, I will pass on your encouragement and feedback to my family. I'm pleased that you like our products so much.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, I'm humbled that my family's products are so well-liked by the operators here... Huh...? A manufacturing cooperation with Rhodes Island? Can we really?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: How convenient. I want to test out my new bubbling formula.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Remember to cover your noses. The aroma this time might be a little intense. Don't let the smell get you sneezing.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I put a sign here— Wet floor. Be extra careful.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The smell here reminds me of something really scary.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Detergent formula tuning complete!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Bubbling equipment ready to go!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: These bubbles won't burst so easily.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Remember to give your honest feedback on our products.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Bubble richness, up to standard!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Bubble dissipation speed, perfect!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Bubble expanding power, excellent!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Stain removal efficiency, impeccable!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Hm... smells a lot more refreshing now.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I like this new ingredient. It's effective, and it doesn't harm your skin.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Looks like we'll need a stronger stain removing formula next time.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: What a stubborn stain...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Doctor, n-no, I know it's polite to look at the person you're talking to... I-I'm not looking out the window. It's just... the water stains on the glass are making me really uncomfortable. I really want to wipe it.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ah! Please don't do that. I almost splashed some of the soap I'm holding on you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Watch out, Doctor! There's soapy water all over the floor. You could slip if you aren't careful.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The New Year calls for new vibes, Doctor, so I put a small plant on your windowsill. I collected a bunch of lemon seeds from my family's kitchen and planted them. This is the one that grew the best.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You should go take a walk, Doctor. It's not good to stay in your office all day.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Perfume? Why would I give you perfume? Hehe, your scent shouldn't be covered by any other smell, Doctor. It’s natural and pleasing, much more so than any perfume I could mix.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Every time a patient at Medical passes away, the clothing they wore gets sent to me to be washed and stored until their family comes to retrieve it one day. Some are picked up soon after, but others... still haven't been picked up even after a long, long time.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Do we work so hard every day? Hohh... this is rough... Doctor, if the stress ever gets to you, please don't bottle it up. I'll chat with you anytime.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Here, Doctor, this is for you. I sent an application to Dr. Kal'tsit, and remodeled an unused cabin into a conversation room. This is the leaflet I made myself!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I've heard there's a mysterious snackseller here who can dodge the Medical Department's controls, and shows up when anyone needs them... Doctor, is this all true?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: As long as you take daily precautions, Oripathy is hardly that easy to catch! The sick aren't that dangerous, let alone their healthy relatives... Why do people always let ignorance scare them about this or that, and they're never even willing to look into it some more?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, look at this! Ehehe, it's a notice that I'm qualified and approved for psychological counseling. I've been preparing forever, and I finally passed the test!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My dad passed away when I was very little, because of Oripathy. The villagers were scared of getting infected, and they shunted us deep into the forest, far from the settlement. Life might've been very tough, but my mum still carried on as she took me through... Now I'm grown up, and it'll be my turn to look after her!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: My old home was in the woodlands in west Rim Billiton. I grew up in the forest all my life, so I'm a bit familiar with all kinds of herbals. That said, herbals can treat your surface injuries, but invisible wounds on your spirit just aren't that easily cured...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, can I stay here? Would I be able to chat with you? I promise I won't interrupt your work! Everyone in the Medical Department has missions today, Mint's studying and she's not coming out for any fun, and there's no patients who need tending to. It's just me left now... I don't want to be alone...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I believe that getting good sleep, eating good food, and sharing the glad and the sad times with friends can make people happy. There's times when enduring too much does more harm... Doctor, just to let you know if you've got any worries, share them with me. Don't forget about it, okay?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, did you fall asleep...? Hmm, no reaction, gotta be asleep. Okay, good chance! Let's find where the Doctor's been hiding all those snacks...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you, I'm the new Medical Department intern, Honeyberry. I'm assuming you're the Doctor...? Hmm, it's just like Dr. Kal'tsit said. You're different enough from everyone else that I can tell you at a glance!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: So you can do emergency treatment like this too...!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? So that means, I've cleared my internship without any problems?! That's brilliant!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I've learned and gained so much at Rhodes Island. It's all the experiences that build up, and all the beautiful memories, that give me the drive to keep going, to strive together with all of you!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: After our mission's over, why don't we all celebrate together?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Please don't worry, leave your health to me...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: It's time. We should be departing any moment now.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Before checking what methods the other side might use, each of you please watch yourselves!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: No problem!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Do I have to jump down? I've got a real penchant for that!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Arrived at designated position, treatment targets sighted!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Everyone, focus on fighting! Just leave treatment to me!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Get a hold of your breathing, and relax.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Everyone... hang in there!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I've got a way to treat you here!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: No matter what trouble we're in, I'll face it together with all of you...!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete! Now it's time for a celebration party... why don't you join us, Doctor?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: It's finally over... you all worked so hard.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We're not done yet, we need to treat the wounded as soon as possible...

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't get discouraged, we still have a chance!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What do you think about building a treehouse?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm? What's the matter?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, do you want some snacks?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy new year! It's such a major day. I wonder if everyone's celebrating with their families? Um, me? My mum's waiting for me to go see the fireworks with her... hehe, Rhodes Island is like a second home for me now, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Wow! D—Doctor, I'll jump down right now! Catch me, please!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Here's a dried berry mix as a present! I've divided it into little pouches according to your intake each day, so eating one a day will supplement all the nutrients you need. Um, Doctor, Why are you hiding them? You don't want Hibiscus to see them? Hehe, Don't worry, she's already gotten some herself!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I used to dream of being an executive, and my mum still frets over that sometimes. But one day, I'll cheer her up for real, and she'll see that her daughter's doing great. More than that, I'm doing amazing. One day, when we help people overcome prejudice towards Oripathy, I know she'll be proud of me.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Would you care to try some sweets? I could prepare a selection for you. Wine to pair with? I have some too.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: My servants relish in manipulating the fates of others. Some imagine themselves cunning conspirators, others mere wavering dreamers. Yet they remain equally cold when consuming lives not their own. And me? Heheh. It matters not whether I am puppet or puppetmaster… for the end of life lies with me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: That Dr. Kal'tsit has a frightening glare. Whenever her eyes fall on me, I feel as if she plans to nail me to the landship deck. Fret not... during my brief stay here, I am but your Operator Necrass, and nothing more.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: An ice-cold body, a dulled sense of touch; a pain inside that never rests, as if my own freezing flames pierce me through... But it is the pain I find so fascinating, for without it, I might forget I've already tamed death.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island is a beautiful place, where anyone can write their story, no matter who they may be. It's something of a utopia, built at the theoretical cost of countless lives. Illusions are ephemeral, however, so do try your best to keep it alive.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I permit your silence—or perhaps, your evasiveness—toward my invitation, but this does not mean you can escape me. Once I grasp you, your soul will be mine. Time, life, and joy are all yours to squander, but remember this well: your end, too, lies with me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: What brings me here, you ask? You do. Or should I say, your willingness to explain the glimpse I saw... of a future where even death is gone? Whether you choose to serve me before that future comes matters little... I'll gladly keep on waiting.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Loughshinny? Were she still the girl shivering under that snowy night, I would have simply gifted her a peaceful life until death reunited us both. A pity she ultimately learned to dance between blades and lies, and you surely understand how rare a truly endearing dance partner can be.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: What must I do to have you submit to me? Must I plead, or yell? Show you a side of me no one has ever seen, or grant you my dominion over death? All that you desire, I... refuse. First you must submit, and then we can discuss further.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: ...A deep sleep is akin to death. I hope you manage to wake as usual, Erudite.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Allowing me on board at last? Then, hand me the register. 'Necrass'—how about this codename, Erudite? Hm? Rhodes Island requires I go by a codename, so I've decided to fashion an appropriate one for you as well.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: How delightful. Another momentary escape from their predestined end.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion. Does this imply I now have a formal position in your organization? Do you deem this appropriate, Erudite?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This medal symbolizes your trust, yet death is an eternal betrayal of life. If you've thought it through, perhaps set me a deadline—I'll strive to live up to your expectations until then.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Do you require me to conceal my face? No? A judicious judgment. The dead shall remember, while the living will forget.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Your operators might fail to keep up with my harsh demands.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let us be off, to create many more corpses.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Mortals grieve over death, but death has never mourned.
