lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: My flame holds no warmth.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I see it.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I accept your invitation.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: So this is your judgment?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: A touch of my finger shall crumble your wills.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Life withers and dissipates, remnants left to hesitate.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Bathed in fire, departed souls dance in a frenzy of fear.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: The clamor of the dead peters out into oblivion.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You and your tactics are equally lethal, Erudite.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Why repress yourself? I see a desire for destruction in you, and you should let it all out... with no reservations.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Life is inherently flawed, so let's not grieve too much over it.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Should I take them all away? Good, you need only pay a tiny price... I'm sure you can afford it.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Ah. A warm place.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What do you want?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You may hold my hand, if you can bear the icy burn.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: A new year ought to be welcomed with fire; burn away the past to build again upon the remains, and the cycle continues anew. That being said, I do quite fancy this tiny flame before me as well. Roast something for me, accomplish what my flames cannot.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Are you happy to see me, Erudite?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Should I prepare a bouquet of flowers for you? For what reason, you ask? I simply want to receive one in return, and watch your flowers crumble into ashes between my fingers, that's all.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Loughshinny aside, Rhodes Island still bears scant traces of Dublinn... don't be nervous. The dream has been realized, so Dublinn should die, but death does not mean to vanish without reason. I shall allow it—let this gravestone of Dublinn remain at Rhodes Island as-is.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, anything I should help with?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, you're always so busy with work. Don't you have any hobbies? Me, I like watching obscure old movies.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Truth is, I learned how to fight because of this movie I saw when I was little. Main character fought with knives and homemade traps. I thought it was really cool, so I started learning myself. My knives here, they're actually the same kind as the ones in that movie.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: In Columbia, anything can be bought with money. It sounds great, until you turn it around: Without money, nothing's yours at all.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island feels like a company out of a movie. Medical corp on the outside, actually a private army underneath. Operating to save more and more people… feels pretty cool.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, do you think I come off gloomy? Dammit… I didn't used to be like this. It was ever since my pop got the way he did, and I had to start worrying about keeping the family afloat. Hmm…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I don't hate Anthony. If we have to talk about the past, I think my pop's to blame too. And honestly, I thank Anthony. If he wasn't in the right place at the right time, I might've done something... I could never take back.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Pop never understood. Mom didn't leave because we had no money. It was 'cause his temper got worse every day. I've thought about if I went with Mom instead, but Pop used to be... so nice to me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, there's times I'm with you and I ease up so much I forget my own issues. I have the money to treat my pop's illness now, but I don't have a cure for his emotional troubles… Doctor, could you help me?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: So you get tired and drop right where you are, just like me…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor. I'm a new Operator. Robin's the name. I've got money troubles, so if it's all the same to you, just send me to do whatever.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Intense. Feels just like I'm watching an action movie...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What? I got a raise so quick...? That's great. Thank you, Doctor!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I never stuck with my old jobs for very long. The company itself had problems, or it was something with my pop... This time, it feels like I'll be able to stick with Rhodes Island for a long time.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm not too good at teamwork…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Wonder what kind of place we're going to this time.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Let's take a look around first…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Am I up?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready. Just say the word.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I see the enemy.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Mm.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I've got a temper too!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Hmph.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Where are you looking?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I've got more than just knives!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, can we cut this sort of mission down a little? Bad for the heart…

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I bet everybody dreams of having a boss like you, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, need me to chase them?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, you go! I'll cover you!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I better get to know this place…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Um?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor. Taking a walk?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: 'The happiest thing about today is we say goodbye to the past; the hardest thing about today is we say goodbye to the memories.' It's, uh, a line from a movie... Umm, Happy New Year, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor. Need me to guard you today?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I got a necklace for you. It's from my movie tie-in collection. Comes from a real classic romance flick. But now I'm, uh, remembering what happens to the ship and the lead couple, and it sends kind of a crappy message... Umm, please forget what I said. Just treat it like a normal necklace, okay?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: My pop's sickness eased up a little. I'm thankful—really, truly, I am... I gotta be honest though, I know with my abilities I don't deserve this contract. The most I can do is repay Rhodes Island for helping us, however I can. Just, I can start by protecting you, Doctor. That's experience I've got under my belt, as a bodyguard.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You're after my help? Hehe, if you're nice enough to offer up three days of premium feed for my little buddies, I might just think about it! How's that sound? Pretty sweet deal, huh…? Hey, wait—I'm just kidding! Don't go!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Outta the way, outta the way! Beanstalk Breeding Center's out for a walk. Mind y'all's step, no trampling the little ones.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Holy moly! Click's here at Rhodes Island? Doctor, why didn't you tell me! I'm a huge fan of her outdoorsy videos! She's even talked about how cute Pea is and brought up taking Pea along for her next shoot!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It's everyone yapping about going mining. I might could forget their digging random holes all over the wilderness like total idiots, but messing up our living space? If I catch those numbskulls AGAIN—see my crossbow? My bolts'll put new holes in their asses!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, I done finished my breeding proposal. Take a look, will ya? Huh? The budget doesn't add up...? Ugh, busted. Ohhh, my mistake! Probably got the numbers mixed up somewhere! I'll get it fixed right away.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Before coming to Rhodes Island, I sent out lots of resumes to different companies, but there weren't no takers. Now look at my little buddies, Doc, they're all-rounders—they can fight, haul, and everything in between! Those bosses just wouldn't know talent if it bit 'em on the behind. Their loss!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Pea here is the smallest and sharpest of my Metal Crabs. Definitely gonna be something special! Unlike those ordinary ones, my little buddies are super clever. No way they'd let just anyone push them around!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: One-two! One-two! Line up! Defense position, and block! Good job, fellers! Y'all come get a treat now! Alright, let's switch to attack—Mercy me! Doctor, how long've you been here? How come you walk so quiet?!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My pa never liked me raising these little ones, keeps saying they're worthless, how burdenbeasts rake in the real cash. Hmph, I'll make a name for me and my little buddies, we'll prove him wrong! Say, Doctor, might wanna throw some money my way? Profit guaranteed!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hey, you with me, Doctor? Stay focused at work. Be a good kid like Pea, won'tcha?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Howdy, Doctor. Name's Beanstalk. Starting today, I'm signin'... Eh? What's in my carrier? Oh, this here's my little buddy, Peacake. C'mon, Pea, say hi to the Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Well, I'll be! That's awesome! You see that, Pea? Watch and learn some!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Ehe, we're getting promoted because of how well we did in the last operation, ain't that right?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, thanks for giving me and my little buddies a chance to prove ourselves! Let's skip the fancy talk. Pea and the gang are gonna turn out even more awesome! You just wait and see!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Let's show 'em what we're made of.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Alright, y'all! Follow my lead!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Team Beanstalk, move out!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Huh? Is this what we're up against?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here I am.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: All ready to go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Go! Show them what we've got!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hehe, you can't hit me.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Block'em!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I won't let you get past us!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You bastards! I won't let you hurt my buddies!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Hehe, y'all ain't no match for us!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete! How's that? My buddies did great, huh?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Oh, some of them got through! Wait here, Doctor. I'll go after them!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's okay, y'all. Don't cry. I'll give those jerks what for next time!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I can sleep anywhere. Where's the breedin' room, though?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Why'd you pull my ribbon? Stop it!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hm? What's up? Wanna pet Pea?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! My New Year's wish is to get the Beanstalk Breeding Company up and running this year! If you might could just lend me a tiny bit of help, I promise I'll work twice as hard!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, what's up, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, Happy Birthday! Considering our special friendship, I've got a rare gift for you. Ta-da—a top-quality, healthy Metal Crab hatchling from the Beanstalk Breeding Company! Ain't it just adorable? Shh! Keep this between us, or everyone's gonna be begging me for one!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Rhodes Island parties are always a riot! But when are we gonna have a pet fair? We could decide once and for all whose pets are more capable, or just crown the most popular. Pet fights? Doctor! That's way too brutal!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm. So this is the place you work, Doctor? Marvelous, truly marvelous. Allow me, then, for a brief moment, so that I can consult my feng shui crash-course guidebook…

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I might sound like a braggart, but beyond a little kickboxing in a scuffle, I can rustle up meals, practice acupuncture, and divine with feng shui. And the list goes on: working masonry, farming, fishing—I'm a maestro of all kinds! Just give the order, and I'll see everything through.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: D-Doctor, I was a little idle, and went to make myself useful at HR, and by carelessness glimpsed at a few operator files, and by chance… Er, by no means do I intend to pry into a fellow operator's privacy, Doctor, but could that FEater be the very star of 'Fiends of the Gods Reincarnated Immortal' herself? Truly? Could I go get an autograph?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Who was my master? Hmm, a question as complex as a showdown of Yanese cuisines. Normally I'd refrain from answering that, as slipping up would get me beaten sideways. That said... you need only know, Doctor, I'm the last descendant of the Lien line. Ah, but my family name's not Lien. It's Ch'u.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Heavens be praised... Miss Dusk really did come to Rhodes Island with us, then? Truth be told, my recollection's quite fuzzy now, yet I have the vague impression that within her painted dreams, I had a peek into my own miserable future... Ah, look at me, carried away by my emotions again. I say it's high time we set aside the nonsense and look forward. Now, You be careful too, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Now, now, Doctor, don't worry about me. I and the Infected do get along well. Back at my old place, a Catastrophe once struck not too far away. It frightened all of us, seeing the world go pitch black. My master remarked then that Catastrophes were Heaven's false charge against the human realm. Ah, truly a bitter thing.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Benefactor Lava? Yes, I call her my benefactor. She once saved me, and as time went on, it became second nature. Throughout my life I've been saved thrice, and every time, I engrave it upon my soul. The gloompincer incident, you mean? No, not that. She showed to me a path, and that was true grace beyond all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Say, Doctor, are people able to leave their past behind like water under the bridge? Certainly not, right? But if the bonds you once left behind still hold fast, what ought you do? You've no idea either? Well, then. It seems we're companions in our misery. Here, what say we crack some sunflower seeds?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Countless, they were, the ancient parasol trees about Kou-wu City. Oh, just reminiscing all of a sudden. I remember the leaves scattered across the ground come fall, when my parents would visit me from the country. Only then would my strict master speak nothing but good, and I would be spared of my seniors' bully for a moment. No, no, just reminiscing.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm. I've been pondering a fan for you too, but what ought we write on it?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: My codename? It's 'nothing' worth mentioning here. And you, fine soul, are the Doctor? That is to say, my new boss? Ah. Pleasure to meet you. How can I be of service? Perhaps you would like a back massage? Or some chiropractic maybe?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ho. what a hundredfold bouquet of martial prowess. You've got my eyes wide open now!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion and a raise?! Ohh, ohh, I thank you, Doctor, in all respects possible! Be it for you, I would brave hell and high waters... That said, how much might my wages be growing by?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Sooner or later, I plan to return to Kou-wu City and set that last unsettled debt in my book straight. My only worry is I may invite trouble and sweep others up in its path. You know this, dear Doctor, and yet you still wish to bestow such partiality on me...? Your kindness toward me is a grace, and I will never, in eternity, forget it.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Very well! Doctor, I'll see to it that you have nothing at all to worry about.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Me, the captain? Hold one moment, just let me find my secret tomes for the art of war…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: As they say, all have their own methods, whether arms against a force or earth to a waterspout. There'll be a way!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'm witnessing fiends, one and all! Quite frightening!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Might you need me?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Here! Right here!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Alright! Leave this to me!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: The Doctor, you are! What a sagacious decision!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Mind at ease, thoughts at peace.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: A perfect technique makes freedom to act!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The moon waxes and wanes. The fan opens and shuts!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Now, if I may have the honor to see your move first…

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: More hands bring more fuel for the fire. When we concert our efforts together, yes, we truly can burn the sky a red to rival sunsets. Now that's what I call a feat!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: As they say, those of just ways have much support, and those of lost ways find little. Seen as such, it was a victory preordained.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Pursue not the desperate. Suppose anything troublesome should happen, we'll just bear it together.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Go on ahead, everyone. No worries. My runaway act is first in class. I'll be just fine.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Oh-hoh, Rhodes Island truly is a wondrous land. I feel quite dizzy just looking.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hoh? What's this for exactly, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, what say I teach you a move or two?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Come one, come all! Ah, hello, Doctor! Nice to see you here on such a holiday. The rest area's full of people, so I thought I'd issue some secret little tomes to life, at low prices to boot! Good tidings to all, won't you agree? Oh, speaking of which, Have you been sleeping well recently? I just so happen to have a copy of 'Winter Sleep-Aiding Breathing and Respiration Techniques'. What say you have a look?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Well, if it isn't the Doctor! What a happy coincidence!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Ah, Doctor, I've rustled up a divination for you, the grams are written here on this fan. They signify this fresh year ahead of you will be a smooth sail, with waves and winds both on your side... You don't believe me? Not unless I give you a performance with this fan? I'd be put at a loss, you know, given my mere modest speck of kickboxing artistry. But you are the boss, your word is the law.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: My master did tell me I was suited to martial arts, but she never taught of any place where you could use it, only that we shouldn't let down the conscience... Ah, I'm just thinking. If I'd not come to Rhodes Island, I'd probably be in Lungmen running a gym, I suppose? But all moneymaking aside, I fear I'd never have used this fan again.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Brace yourselves.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The most important thing my safta taught me was that life shouldn't have too many taboos.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Focus on the work at hand and don't jump to any conclusions.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Tachanka's taught me a thing or two about how to build defenses.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I have some questions, Doctor. I hope you can answer them for me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Overcoming obstacles and breaking down barriers makes a lot of things easier.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I'm willing to try, as long as the reward is commensurate to the risk.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You think I'm strict, huh? I'll take that as a compliment.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Do me a favor. You worry about the strategy and let me worry about the tactics.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Time's up, Doc.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Rainbow Operator, codename Ash. I have my authorization and I'm ready for assignment.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The more we can learn about their attack patterns, the better off we'll be.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You have my respect, Doc.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: You can't really understand a conflict until you've been on both sides.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: It's ready.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Let's get our heads in the game.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's show them what we can do.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Targets detected.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm all stocked up.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready to go!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Move!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Watch for the blast.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Stay clear of the blast.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Get clear!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Target spotted!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That worked out better than I expected.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No more than usual.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We knew the risks. We still have to see this through.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: We have to go.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This is the place.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Well?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: We need to talk.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I'm with you.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Instead of sitting here, why don't we walk out together?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I'm in the starting lineup for next week's football match. Come watch the game!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If you know how we can improve my G52 Tactical Shield, please submit a test application. I'll be there anytime.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Ease up, there's nothing to be nervous about. Should I invite Tachanka to dance a little ballet for you?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The doctors don't test me because I'm sick. They test me because I'm too healthy. Good thing I'm not afraid of needles!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Flash! Bash! Kapow! That's all you need to know.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Not only am I sweet, but I've got a great sense of humor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: If you find something interesting to play with, count me in.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: We have a responsibility to look after one another. I take that very seriously.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: This is really interesting, but not to me.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: RAINBOW Operator, codename Blitz. Give the order and I'll bash 'em in the face with my shield!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This is pretty good. The popcorn, I mean. Want some?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Medals, awards, promotions. They go really well with my shield, don't you think?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I don't like photos of myself. The lighting is always wrong.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Should we go get the bad guys maybe? Just a suggestion.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Remember: point your guns at the bad guys.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's look alive out here.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Bad guys in our way!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Do think I have time to use the bathroom?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: If anyone needs to sneeze, do it now.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Move, quickly!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Kapow!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Boom!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Surprise!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Do you like it!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Are we good? Can we go home now?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Everything will be fine, I'm here after all.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Am I going to need to save all your asses again?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Dammit, did anyone remember to bring the ammo?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Let's go say hello to our neighbors first.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wow!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You should invite me over for dinner. We are friends, after all.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Is it time to go?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Here's the schedule. You'll also need to review the weekly reports, expense records, and meeting agendas. Which do you want to do first?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: We'll overcome any obstacle as long as we work together.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Excuse me, sir, but do you mind if I tidy up the bookshelf?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Sometimes humans behave exactly like wild animals. Understanding this makes me a more efficient operator.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: To see the really interesting things, you have to get out of the city. That's why I'm always so far away.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Putting out the Welcome Mat is the first step. Luring the prey takes a bit more doing.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: No, no. This is all wrong. Let me reconsider for a bit.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Is there anything I can help with?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Who's the hunter? Who's the hunted? That's up to Mother Nature and the battlefield in question.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Simply pull this string and there's the Welcome Mat...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: RAINBOW Operator, codename Frost. At your service, sir.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I've got a good idea.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for your trust, sir.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: There are two things we absolutely need in a survival situation: water and hope.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Let's work together.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't forget, we're a team and we have a plan.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Time for all the planning to pay off.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I've got eyes on the hostiles.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: We're ready for company.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Setting barricade.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Don't let them get the drop on you.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Stay alert.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Laying out the Welcome Mat.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Setting up.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Welcome Mat set.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Deployed.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Stay two steps ahead of the enemy at all times.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Always think ahead.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Maintain a perimeter.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Administering aid. Friendly injured.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This isn't so bad.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey! Be careful!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Come along, join our hunt.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Would you like a bonfire?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: If you invited me, you must not be looking for a tactician.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I love my country, for better or for worse.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Have you met my sister? She's the one in the white coat in the photo, and those are her children.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Survive. Be a leader. You don't want your loved ones crying over your grave, do you?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I don't want my kids to follow in my footsteps. Being a soldier is too dangerous.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: In my country, focusing firepower on a target is considered a simple and effective way to achieve victory.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I like the way you think.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Personally, I prefer the enemies come to us in search of death. How about you?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Relax, baby. When this is all over, I'll buy you some vodka.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Are you bored? Why not clean your weapon?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: RAINBOW Operator, codename Tachanka. I'm ready. Where do you want me?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: First, we learn about them. Then we outsmart them.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Good.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: They told me I'd died. They were wrong. I was reborn.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Yes, yes. I know.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just don't play hero, it never works.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Stay right with me!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Hostiles in sight.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Oh, yes. Baby.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Let's get to work.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Guys, you are all lucky I was there.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Don't worry! Tachanka is here!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Come to Tachanka, baby.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Time to get serious.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Killing zone deployed.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Let them come!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That was unexpected.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I've seen it all.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We're not out of the woods, bratan.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Protect the doctor!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Not a problem.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Be careful, comrade.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Call me in for support if you need it.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Don't stay cooped up in your office all the time, Doki. Why don't you come down to the mines with me one of these days?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Something smells moldy. Should be in the bottom left drawer. My nose is never wrong... Well, Doki, You should really deal with those documents before they pile up. If you just leave them like that, they're gonna get damp.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My drills are all souped up. They've got twice the impact, improved stability, and they pretty much can't jam. Anyway, I'm a pro when it comes to boring, tunneling, and laying concrete. If you've got any construction jobs like that, I'm your girl!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: First, you check construction blueprints ahead of time. Second, you don't disrupt our work without a good reason. Third: You never, ever fall behind on your payments. That's the three principles Shana's Construction Crew uses to decide on projects. No exceptions, Doki, not even for Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Rim Billiton has more prospecting operation platforms than you can count, with tons of workers running around. You gotta know what you're doing to get anybody to listen to ya. I work hard to refine my skills, and I teach what I know to the gang. That's the way I do things... Yeah.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: We don't compromise on safety, even in barren mines with low output. Infected or not, so long as you work the mines, your rights oughta be guaranteed. I hope we never see another Billy mine accident. At the very least, I always make sure my projects stand up to inspection.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, want a lolly? It's just a regular mint one. I always keep some in my pocket. Don't underestimate the power of a lolly, though. When there's dusty air all around you, a little sweetness can really calm you down.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My dad always said that Columbia's Great Expansion marked the start of a new age. Now, the big corps pull in all different countries on big projects. Rim Billiton's ores really shine out there. But you know how things go, the taller the building, the more solid the foundations have to be. That's why the work we do is always meaningful, no matter the task.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: 'A Billy worker never sees the sun.' That's what my friends in the mines always say. The darkness down there swallows everything, work and life, past and future... I want to give people hope for the future, Doki, give them better lives. Easy enough to say, but there's lots of work to do. You'll lend a hand, won't you, Doki?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Alright, lads, day's done. Rest up now.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Oh, so you're the Doctor everyone's talking about! I'm new in Engineering; foreman of Shana's Construction Crew out of Rim Billiton! Here's my business card.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Nah yeah… If the mines just provided workers with recorders, it would save us so much hassle.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I thought it was a joke when I got a new contract from HR. Not only did my pay go up, I get even more benefits... Thanks, Doki!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: If I ever get the chance, I want to go check out Columbia, see the Great Expansion with my own eyes and how their workers are different from ours in Rim Billiton... Doki, Rhodes Island works with a lot of big companies, right?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Work, work! Hop to it now!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You all got your helmets on? Check again!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: This shaft's got a complicated layout. Follow me.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ah! Why is my drill stuck?!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Hm…? What's that smell?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Relax, Doki, just show up at completion time.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: The blueprints check out. Let the construction work begin!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Remember, max deviation for each drill hole is two centimeters!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Oi! Stay focused when you're running that boring machine!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: A triple bright miner's lamp could make ya go blind!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Move, or this cement's going right on your heads!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Dig! Diiig! Diiiiiiig!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doki! We… We just wrapped up a huge project!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: When worker safety's on the line, you can't slip up for even a single second.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: If you spot anything after construction's done, that's already too late. We need to find as many problems as we can in the design stage.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't be glum, chum. Follow-up work is part of construction, too. Just leave it to me to take care of the reinforcement. Cheer up, Doki.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Let's say Rhodes Island needs some dorms rebuilt, think you might hire Shana's Construction Crew? Hehe…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Eeek! Oh, it's you, Doki. Sorry, didn't notice you over the sound of the drill.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doki, can you hold this shield for me? Careful now, it's heavy. The inside there? That's concrete, baby.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's this time of year that workers with no way to get home gather in the open parts of the mine to screen movies. Watching the shiny, happy people up there, we all forget our worries for a while. Then a new day comes, and a new year begins.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doki! Here, a mint for ya.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doki! Are you free today? The construction team just took on a new mining project, and the groundbreaking ceremony's today. Everyone will be so happy to see you there... What do ya say? I'll buy you lunch afterwards.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I know even a small project can call for a lot of workers. But I've never seen a place like Rhodes Island, with so many amazing people gathered together. What are you all trying to accomplish, Doki? Whatever it is, I can't wait to see it for myself, 'cause now I'm part of it too!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor! Do you want these files here? A Liberi lady just taught me how to use a printer! Look, I even learned how to print on both sides! This needs to be single-sided? Uh-oh, sorry! I'll print it again!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: My mother has gotten a lot better. That time, even divination showed a dark future. If not for the medical equipment we got from the explorers, she might have left us... Since then, I decided to go out into the world. I hope to bring more equipment like that back to the village.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I'm really grateful to Magallan. We've only met a few times during search and rescue operations, but she put me in touch with Rhodes Island after hearing my situation. And she's an incredible lady. Not many people dare to explore the ice fields like her. Even people in our tribe seldom set foot there. It's a place that's feared and revered.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I'm part of my tribe's rescue team, helping people who accidentally wander into the bog, or get lost in the snowstorms. That's how I met a lot of explorers from Columbia. Woah, Doctor, how did you know they always compliment my tail?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I never thought I would leave the tribe and come here. I was never interested in things from the outside world. But that shiny medical equipment blew me away. They went against our divination. That's a miracle to me.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The explorers told me things I've never heard before, about 'corporations', 'timetables', 'entrepot'... we don't even have these words because we've never had a use for them. But I learned them quickly, thanks to my conversations with the explorers.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Can I see the future like Gitano? I suppose I could divine your future, but I'm not great at it. If you really want me to tell your fortune for the day, let's see... Okay, it says... the stars will fall from the sky, and eggplant must go on top of rice.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, Accounting says my 'reimbursement claim' has been delayed. What does 'reimbursement claim' mean? Sorry, but there's still so much I don't understand about paperwork…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor! I'm back from my field mission! We delivered some equipment to my tribe and taught them how to use it. Turns out aunt's leg pains were caused by bone spurs. Now that we know how to treat it, she won't have to rely on my cousin's Arts to relieve the pain.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh, the phone is ringing! What did the Doctor say I should do in this situation… Okay... He-hello? Um, nice to hear you. This is the Doctor's office.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I forgot to ask the Perro man what I should call you. I only learned the word 'company' from the Columbians. Do you have a name? Oh, just 'Doctor'? I can do that!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Is this one of your technologies? How do you manage to record everything like that?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, is this what you call a 'contract'? It's very difficult to understand. Do I have to sign it? You say if I don't sign it, I'll be forced to work day and night by a cruel boss? But Doctor, you are not cruel… What? What do you mean don't be so sure?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I won't make a fool of myself like before, Doctor! You've helped me so much. My mother's getting better, and my tribe is learning to use Rhodes Island medical equipment. I hope I can do even more for them in the future.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Don't worry, I've been on a lot of rescue operations.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everyone, follow my orders and don't run off on your own.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Begin rescue operation!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Make sure you're well-prepared. That's the foundation of a successful rescue.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: A new rescue objective?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I have the map here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Don't worry, help is on the way.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Please save your strength, we will get you out!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Rescue targets identified.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Rescue location confirmed.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Formulating a rescue plan.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Don't worry. You're going to be fine!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I was nervous, but my experience really came in handy!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A well-planned and well-executed rescue operation, our target has been brought to safety.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The victim was injured… Don't worry, I'll ease the pain for you.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Over here! We need backup!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Oh, so this is where I'm supposed to use this 'access card.'

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you don't really want me to divine your future, do you?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor! My mother divined Rhodes Island's future to thank you. She'll tell you the results herself. She also asked me to give you this, a feather that's only given to the strongest warrior or wisest sage among our people.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Boo! Did I scare you? Not at all? Aw, I used to spook lots of people in the snow.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I've been practicing divination with my mother. How about you let me tell your fortune again, Doctor? Maybe we start with easy questions, like how big you'll grow this year. I just tried it on myself, it says I'm going to grow a lot!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I used to be scared of contracts and paperwork, but I can handle those without a hitch now. Even my tribe has started calling me the 'wonderful little messenger'. Oh, I also heard Magallan set a new record. Turns out that people with dreams just don't stop, right Doctor?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Mhmmmm... Hm? Did you say something? No, I'm not ignoring you. I'm just... thinking of something else.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I... I've always been alone, so I'm not good at making conversation. It did cause much trouble when my travels began. Some people feared me, one even conned me out of my luggage. Things were difficult, but not entirely hopeless. As long as I have my staff, I can work, so I won't go hungry for too long.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Life in the lighthouse was hardly dull. The seas are always changing. However, my teacher said that only by seeing more of this land, could I guard a small corner of the seaside. She then drove me out of the lighthouse. That's how I made my way here.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Blue Poison gave me a new pair of gloves. Pretty, aren't they? She also said the material is modified. Now it can better prevent poisoning from accidental touches. Actually, It happens so often when I'm around my poison-wielding friends... I feel that I may have built up an immunity.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I used to gaze into the sea every night. No one in town knew what we were seeking or guarding, and my teacher never told me. All I know is that, where there is darkness, there must be a lighthouse. I will stay watching, until that day comes.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The light you just saw… Some call it Originium Arts, but my teacher says it's the power from our hearts. With light to guide them, even those who sail in the foggiest nights will brave the raging tides and find their way to shore. That is why I will do my best to protect this light.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: My tail has a beautiful color? Mhm, thank you very much. You may touch it if you want. Despite the color, it's not poisonous.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Could you hold my staff for me, Doctor? My hair's getting too long. I want to arrange it before it gets tangled up. It might take a while, but I'll be able to better support you on the battlefield.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I'm starting to realize that people can be like lighthouses… Some can even shine farther and brighter than any of them... like you, Doctor. Would it be okay if I stay beside you for a little longer before I go back?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You don't need me to keep watch while you sleep? Yes? You want me to take a nap, too? I-I'll try...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. My name is Aria… Uh, sorry, I mean Indigo. I used to be a lighthouse keeper... Um, apprentice. Now my position is a Caster, but... also an apprentice. I really look forward to learning from you.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Are these techniques for fending off enemies? My teacher taught me a little, but I didn't know you could do this.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What…? A promotion? A lighthouse needs only one keeper. Is that... not the case here?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I can do even more…? Indeed… my light shines even farther now... Thank you, Doctor. I will keep doing all I can.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Indigo at the ready.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Very well... I'll keep this light up. Please be careful not to wander off.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Follow the light, please.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: If you insist on stopping us, then we have no choice but to defeat all of you.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm all ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: The seas are roaring.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: My staff's getting warmer.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: The light grows.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: These enemies do not compare to the seas' ferocity.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I shall stand guard, until daybreak.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: The fear for light, comes only from the evil within.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: If you wish to flee, then follow this light.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: With such power, perhaps we won't need to fear the arrival of that day…?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Thank goodness. Another night of calm sea.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: S-Some enemies got away? I see. We must alert everyone.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, this way... Don't be afraid. It doesn't matter how dark the path up ahead is, I'll light it for you.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's okay. I'll be fine by myself.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh... Doctor, you're tangled in my hair. Please be careful; tripping and falling can be painful.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Would you like to stay here with me...? You know... The night watch won't be as dull with company.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: To the ocean, every day is the same with its ebbs and flows. As its watcher, I feel the same. I read that the ocean used to be gorgeous at night, with moonlit waves that danced as if wearing silvery capes. It's a pity we can't see that anymore. If we could go back in time, Doctor, I would love to see it with you.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, would you like the light to be brighter?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here… a cake for you. Blue Poison taught me how to bake it. I've practiced plenty of times, so it's sure to taste great despite its looks. The gloves? They're for food hygiene, Doctor, not because the cake's poisonous, trust me.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: When my teacher sent me away, I couldn't see why. She had taught me everything she knew, yet she still said I wasn't ready. It only became clear after I came to Rhodes Island. Anyone can guard the lighthouse, but to face all that follows once the light is lit requires great knowledge of this land.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: To be of assistance to you would be my great honor.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The Originium crystal on my forehead is often regarded as an adornment. A very convenient mistake, saving me the effort of concealing my Infected status. However, every time pain crosses my brows, I am deeply struck by my own folly. I've always yearned to leave Sargon, yet where lies the path that truly belongs to me?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Sesa is still quite young. Indeed, I am but a few years his senior. Yet, his grasp on patience is somewhat awkward, and his resentment lacks solidity. Should he seek a spark of truth to ignite his thirst for vengeance, I would be more than willing to oblige... Ah, should you forbid it, I would not act out of turn.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I abhor the black market. It is a cesspool of petty, hollow schemes. Everyone there fancies themselves a seasoned player, yet all meet a dismal end. Sometimes, a meticulous mind is all it takes to send someone to their demise. Even... a padishah's very own appointed lord ameer. Might you be curious, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: That great fire, you say? Do you look to blame me? Indeed, I shall not contest it. But know this: not a single innocent suffered in that fire, nor did any perpetrator survive. In the black market of Sargon, the good only comes in one form... They are the ones who've endured. And I have endured.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Kal'tsit... Dr. Kal'tsit and I, are indeed old acquaintances. To be precise, she was my rescuer and savior, but be at ease; I am yours now. Oh, was that not your concern? How remarkable, that as a coworker of our 'Kal'tsit,' you could still be so unwary?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: 'Were I to return to Columbia'... I cannot say I've never entertained the possibility over the years, but such supposition would only serve to shake me. Doctor, I hope you will use me to the utmost. If such mild civilian technologies have become a stranger to me, I would now much rather renounce them.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Elliot? How do you... Hm. Elliot. His parents gone before their time, his one beloved, esteemed teacher dead in Sargon. The work which bore his faith but a stepping stone in someone else's conspiracy. To this day, he is bereft of anything. Elliot Glover is merely a laughable life lived.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I know a scientist—a star so bright, a soul so graceful, a leader so natural. I admire him, rely on him, and regard him as my elder brother. However, his end is not a good one, considerably not. So you must protect yourself well, Doctor. After all, we do get along quite pleasantly.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: How long it has been—since such clear skies.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Your Operator, Passenger. I have long wished to work alongside you, Doctor. I'm sure we will both find this journey most enjoyable.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Marvelous tactics, owing to your command, no doubt.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I shall refine my services even further for you and Rhodes Island. Trust that the Sand Soldier of Reefsteep Black Market has more tricks up his sleeve.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I truly hope that my amusing Operator codename will remind you—Doctor, there is no need to trust others, and you are capable of doing everything yourself. Oh? It seems you have other views. I shall duly accede, then.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Allow me to demonstrate how a truly exceptional weapon of war operates.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I am quite familiar with strategy and planning. Of course, should you have other ideas, I defer to you.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let us depart.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Now then, we have everything in place.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I heed your command.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: As you wish.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Should this be your intent...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I am prepared.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Now go.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Punish these people.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: All as you desire.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Begone with the wind.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You must pardon me; it seems my lowly weapons have barely served to accomplish this mission. Should you assent to my adopting more... extreme methods, we may thus have an easier time.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Thunder and lightning are but a form of punishment. They have paid the price for their ill deeds. How good it is, do you not think?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I cannot permit the punished to leave my sight in peace. Doctor, I plead you permit me to perform this aftercare.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: A rather harsh defeat. But worry not, Doctor. Those who have snatched victory from your hands... will be privileged to experience suffering in full.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What a captivating landship. Doctor, Sargon has never accorded me such treatment.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh. Might something be the matter?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, care for some coffee? I grew these beans myself. Back in Sargon, it was my sole form of recreation.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: The New Year... what an unfamiliar concept. The golden sands of Sargon remain unchanged year after year. Making resolutions for a new start on an artificial calendar is nothing but empty self-consolation. That said, here at Rhodes Island, perhaps a day when everyone has a common cause for celebration is indeed special.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: My greetings, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: A birthday should be no cause for celebration. It is, instead, a countdown to one's death. Each time such an occasion arises, I reflect on what remains unaccomplished. The terminus of ideals and hatred lies far beyond sight, much like the unpredictable end of one's life. These ravings are perhaps not suitable for this occasion. I should congratulate you instead. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Having lived such an absurd life, I am but a husk of a man. Yet, from this ship that Kal'tsit has placed great hope in, I caught a glimpse of light in this boundless, dull realm. Doctor, I look forward to the sights you will show me, after we traverse the immeasurable hatred and battles ahead.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I'll leave the files I sorted here. Oh, you don't have to thank me. I am used to it, and it's nothing difficult... Um, are you thirsty perhaps? Should I make you some tea?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I'm not very good at speaking any languages other than Yanese. That's why I was a little scared at first and didn't talk much. But everyone's very friendly, and there are a lot of people from Yan here. Phew... it really puts my mind at ease.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Sorry to disturb you, Doctor, but would you happen to know where Provence and everyone else went? My family sent me some goodies from back home, and I thought I'd share some with them since they've been taking care of me... Oh, there are some for you too, Doctor. Please have a taste!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, could you help me look for my little dumpling? It's the small black-and-white doll. I thought I'd left it here, but I can't find it... *Whimpers*, please, I can't sleep at night without it.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The rescue team has to deal with the Catastrophes a lot, so it's only a matter of time for us before we become infected. None of us reject anyone because of that. The crystallization on my body isn't very conspicuous, and it doesn't hurt even if you press down on it... Sometimes, I even forget that I have this on my body.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: When I first joined the rescue team, I wasn't very used to the climate or the food there. I'd get too homesick to fall asleep at night, and I cried to myself many, many times, but whenever I see the people we rescued, I start to think that maybe I can keep at it...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, sorry to bother you... I've been studying Oripathy prevention techniques during Catastrophe relief, and Tsukinogi suggested that I come ask for your advice... Um... Sorry, am I being a bother?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Uhh! Doctor, why would you sneak up on me like that? Huh? What am I holding? Oh, this is a letter I got from home. When I made the decision to leave, my parents were so angry that they said they would disown me, but there's a saying where I come from: Blood is thicker than water...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When I got infected with Oripathy, I knew I probably wouldn't be able to live the peaceful life my parents wanted for me. I don't regret it, though... Besides, if I hadn't made my decision, I would never have met you or anyone else from Rhodes Island here and now, hehe.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Doctor? Sorry to bother you. Please lift your head up a little and sleep with the cushion. If you fall asleep like this, the letters from the report will get all over your face...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm a member of the Yan disaster relief organization 'Chun-qian,' dispatched here as an intern. My name is... Oh, I-I'm sorry. We need to use our codenames here, right? I'm terribly, terribly sorry. Please call me Mulberry.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Uhh..The mountain collapsed, and the ground crumbled...! They're not special effects from an action movie, are they?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Huh? A promotion? Really? I get a salary from Rhodes Island as well as Chun-qian?! I... I'm so happy...!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This time, I'm not doing this to help someone else, I'm doing it for myself... Doctor, thanks for always being there to cheer me on. Now, I'm sure that everything that I've done is truly meaningful.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll do my best to support everyone!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Huh? Me as team captain? Ah... Are you sure?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Okay, we'll head out right away... Everyone, please stay safe. We'll meet again once this is over.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Watch out, everyone! There's movement up ahead!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Safety goggles... Okay, I have mine on. Let's go!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Phew... Haah! Oh, I'm here! I-I'm not nervous!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Preparing rescue...!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Rescue team Mulberry in position!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Everyone, please be careful!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I... I can do it too!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Where are you looking? It's dangerous to get distracted!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: It's my job to ensure everyone's safety!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Report! All rescue operations in the area have been completed. Evacuation and escort proceeding without issue! Phew, thank goodness nobody's hurt...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew, that wraps up the operation. Doctor, was I helpful?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Wait! It's not safe that way... We have to do something. I'll go fetch them right away!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's not safe here! Everyone, please evacuate! Doctor, follow me!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Whoa, this is the staff dormitory... Um, will I need to pay rent?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh? Ah! I'm sorry! I'm sorry!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor! I really appreciate it, but please stop trying to sneak any more amulets onto me... I have way too many already!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I didn't expect to spend the New Year here at Rhodes Island. It feels...fresh. Actually, it's been a few years since I've been home for the New Years because of work. I really want to go back, even if I can only see my home from far away...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Do you have work today too?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday... I'd like to ask, ever since I gave you that amulet, did any of your wishes happen to come true...? N—No? Then... do you have any wishes for your birthday, that I can make real?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: So many doctors aboard Rhodes Island are Infected themselves. Rescue workers who can't protect themselves properly... they're not a rare sight to see. But these rescuers still choose to walk towards disaster, realizing the risk and taking it in. Their conviction is most precious. I hope that our effort can help more people live in peace.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Please leave for now. Any disruption during my work hours is not permitted. Should there be any offense, I appreciate your understanding.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: To stop people from conducting foolish and meaningless deeds... At least you and I have that goal in common. Given your rich experience, I am certain you are well aware of how fervently most humans court their own destruction. That said, until the time the others are fully prepared, it would be all futile, no matter how much you rack your brains about the sea.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Please inform your operators to avoid any physical contact with me or my weapon after a battle. Intense exercise raises my surface temperature. If someone were to complain about being scalded, I would hate to feel guilty.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The language I use is overly polite...? Hm, I'm still getting acquainted with the language used on the land. But, besides, in my humble opinion, it would not be in your best interest to see me being impolite.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: As Abyssal Hunters, we must fulfill our responsibilities. To abandon the sacrifices of the past would be an unforgivable act of betrayal.  That being said, how many Hunters can I still save other than Specter and Skadi? Even if I were to rescue another Hunter who survived by sheer luck, the fear may have crushed them whole long ago. Their future will be fraught with nothing but agony.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Do you like to sing? What about dancing? Would you like to dance with me? It doesn't matter if you don't know the steps. I will teach you. Poetry, art, music... You must never forget these things. They are proof that all humans once lived beneath the starry night sky. Through these arts, and upheld by us, humans become eternal. Come, let's dance.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Kal'tsit encouraged me to seek your help, though I still remain skeptical of its utility. The technology of land dwellers is primitive compared to that of Ægir, yet the average mental state is even more problematic. Fear and cowardice seem to pervade most of you. Honestly, I cannot imagine how you people would face 'that.'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The air here is dry. Fighting on land sometimes feels sweltering. Uncomfortable as it is, this is still better than being surrounded by the dead bodies of my comrades... I remember how the sea was littered with shreds of corpses. Their deaths etched onto your brain, and the stench lingers on your tongue whenever you open your mouth. Yet you cannot hang your head.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Do you think we can form an alliance? We may not even be counted as the same species. Kal'tsit is far older than me. The burden she carries is beyond anyone's imagination, but it is also a burden you must face one day... You must get stronger, strong enough to fear no loss. I will watch you by your side.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmph...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}. I am Gladiia, the officer in charge of Rhodes Island's Ægir affairs. We will have many opportunities to collaborate in the future, but please see me as an outsider. I am not worthy of your trust yet.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I see. Your tactics and equipment match your kind's development progress.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A new contract? While I appreciate your recognition, I already have many important missions demanding my attention. The matters you assigned will have to wait. I apologize, for the inconvenience..

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: War. The concept of victory doesn't exist in a war that revolves around the continuance of a species. The only conclusion it can lead to is the destruction of the opposing side under the night sky. We Abyssal Hunters put our lives on the line to fend off and delay this fate. Unwavering, unrelenting, and without any regrets.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll join this training as your squadron's aide.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: This seems to be a low-intensity battle. Allow me to use it as hunting practice for your operators.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: You are slow like you're caught in an undertow. I will slow down and wait, try to catch up.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Considering the level of this battle, allow me to save my strength.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Speak your mind.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: As you wish.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Who's the prey?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll manage them right away.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Watch out. The currents will pull the weak into the abyss.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Have I granted you the permission to run away, my prey?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Just a second, then this lance will pierce your heart.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Playtime is over.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Survive. That's the only rule you must follow.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: An archetypical victory. One day, you will be able to defeat all feeble creatures that come your way.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Better hope that the fleeing prey won't share information, so you still have a chance to savor the rest of your life at ease.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: How mediocre.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I appreciate the sentiment, but I'm perhaps more comfortable staying in my own little cramped dwelling.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Please respect the land's etiquette, Doctor, or perhaps discourtesy is more your thing?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Best be careful. By nature, my kind are all monsters.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: And so another year has come and passed. How far has our plan come? Has the sea engulfed more land from the coastlines without us even realizing? Rhodes Island's operators celebrate the New Year. Let them. As for us, the more we know, the more we must judge our own actions.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Greetings, Dr. {@nickname}.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: If we are to suppose the birth of a life is worth celebrating, said life must first possess notable value. Take my hand. This dance will be a special one. You may well consider it my endorsement of you. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A species faces many threats in its survival. Under my assessment of dry land, I might equate Rhodes Island's intrinsic work to that of my Hunters. Dr. {@nickname}. It is yours to gather the weight of your decisions.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You need me for something? Hah... Look at all these papers on the desk, each one filled with words. Just the sight of them makes me want to cut them up!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hfph—haah... Leave me alone. I'm trying to feel my new technique. Aren't techniques meant to be conceived, you say? Hmph, not for me. I just need to quiet down and feel it with my heart. When the time comes, my technique will naturally unfold on my blade.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: That ninja... She may evade your eyes, but she cannot fool my senses. I know not what she schemes, but I can promise you I shall not engage her here and now. However, if I find her trying to harm my master... You won't be able to stop my blade.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Who says my eye sight is poor? Heh! This medical report is utter nonsense. If you doubt me, send your strongest, swiftest warriors, and as many as you want. Have them attack me from any direction all at once. If they can make it anywhere close to my body, I'll accept defeat.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: It hurts my head to hear righteous principles. Especially when those hypocrites go on and on like preaching scriptures. Hmph, the principles in their mouths are just fancy garbage. For benefit, they will stab even their family in the back. These shameless cowards, my katana will slice them apart!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I've seen winters like that many times. The snow would turn red the moment it hit the ground. My enemies were everywhere. Lying, sitting... I never saw their faces, nor did I care to. My face and chest felt cold, but my hands gripping my blade were warm. Tsk, why am I even telling you all this? Just forget what I said.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Um? How many times have I told you? Don't stand in front of me all of a sudden! What? You wanted me to see you better? You're a strange fellow. I don't need to look at you to know it's you. You think I would just let anybody come this close to me?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Dr.{@nickname}, you remind me of my master when you get serious. I suppose it's because… both you and her compel yourselves to go forward in chase of a grand, ambitious goal.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My master had me come to Rhodes Island for some peace and quiet. Yet how can I find peace, when the flames of war still rage in my homeland? Nonetheless, as a general, you have my respect. Dr.{@nickname}, while under your command, I shall fight by your side and slay all that stands in your way!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm… The air here is nice and cool. Hey you, move over a bit. Let me lie down for a while too.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Akafuyu, samurai, the strongest you'll find. Worrying about my katana? Haha, unlucky for you, I carry it with me wherever I go. You better keep your distance if you are scared.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oi oi, I'm already strong enough. Stop wasting my time!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I don't need anyone's approval. However, I appreciate your gesture, and will repay the favor with my katana.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Heh, if those guys were here, we'd be out drinking and celebrating. How about this, Dr.{@nickname}. YOU come with me! We'll drink till we drop tonight!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Let's get going already. My katana is starting to rust.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Now we're talking! All of you, with me!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Now! To battle!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: No matter who, I shall slay them by my katana!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I've been waiting to slay.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Off to the front!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: You will feel my blade!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Now… I strike!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Come one, slay one! Come a thousand, slay all!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Not only your head, I will cut your will to fight!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: My katana knows its targets.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Where are the foes actually worth fighting?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Hardly a challenge. I barely broke a sweat.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Some enemies got through? Impossible. There's no way I didn't see them.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I won't run away. My blade has not failed me, I can still fight!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What a small room! Don't keep me waiting in here for too long! I might just draw my katana!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmph... You see, if you were my enemy, I would already have sliced you in half.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Come on, let's get ourselves all the ale and meat!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, and why so late to rise? I'm already back from my training. Let me tell you, think of a wish. On the first day of the new year, make 1,000 sword swings. Then that wish will come true. Do not ask whether it's true! It's real, as long as you believe it.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Yo, Doctor, how about some katana training together?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Oh? Today's your birthday, Dr.{@nickname}? Haha! Come, I'll take you for ale and meat! Honestly, why stay quiet about a day so important? Hm? You wonder what I would've gotten you if I knew? Well, need you ask? Better ale and even more meat!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Never have I asked you what we fight for, yes? Stop, no need for an answer. Words are the least reliable of all. I only care that you've considered the question, and considered it well. Lead us forth on a just path, Doctor, and I assure you my katana will be sharp enough to cut through all.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Your files are all fully sorted. Hm? Was that fast? I wasn't dozing off on your last shift, after all. I have your whole workflow noted right inside my head.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Stop! You're triggering one of my traps. Move any further, and a bolt will blow your brains out. How could I fall asleep surrounded by traps? That's a strange question. I couldn't sleep at all without these little trinkets around me.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What we stole from the Leithanian nobles, they plundered from the land before that. We're the children of the wilds, but we are not unreasonable. Lungmen traders do good to others, and Siracusans keep to the rules, so I told my team not to lay a finger on them.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Is that Lee guy here too? He got me when I was careless, and now I want a rematch. No, no need to worry, none of the trinkets he carries interest me. You go tell him as much.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Infected? Only city people would call themselves that. In the endless and cutthroat wilds, whether beast or human, survival means you can call yourself the strongest.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: There's plenty who think the wilds are a frightening place, but to me, they were my home. I made a mistake once. It torn my family apart,  and these slumberfoots are the only ones left to roam with me. I'll never make a mistake like it again.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The name Blacknight was given to me by a Yan storyteller. I always used to do my work at night, pulling the floor from under them when those merchants were drowsy. Me and my slumberfoots would take away their wealth, and 'devour' their dreams too.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Don't act so nice to me... you never know when my crossbow will be aimed at your head. You don't believe I'm like that? Up to you, then. I've got no interest in dealing with a penniless good guy.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: They called me their boss. So I protected them, gave them food and a place to rest. But now, for as long as I haven't beaten you, you're my boss. I'll protect you, and I'll follow your orders.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: ...Fell asleep hugging Helmet? Light, bring a blanket over. Keep your movements low.
