lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You're the best tactician on Rhodes Island? I'm Blacknight, and excuse me but we're going to need a showdown. If I lose, you'll be my boss from then on, and I ask to be trained properly.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Mm, all memorized. Anything else?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You're not worried I'll take the bonus and run? I'm joking. For that matter, a badge like this won't fetch any real money anyway.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Work and earn a living. I wonder if my parents lived a life like this in Rim Billiton? It's fine, but I'm not letting my crossbow rust.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Good timing. I need something to do.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You want me leading? Then you'll want to watch how I do it.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Listen up, darlings. Once we're on the battlefield, you need to listen to the Doctor too.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You want to run? Before you do, remember to leave your valuables behind.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm right by you. Don't make a sound.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Understood. Just as planned, then.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'm heading that way.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's clear this path up first.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Helmet, lure the enemy left!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Light, harass the closest enemy!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Cart, set mines in the bushes!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Drill, open a hole!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: How'd me and the darlings do? No compliments for us?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Not bad! I've learned some more moves.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'll take a few to the next crossing. We need to get this cleaned up.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: No, you have to get out of here! Do as I said, or the enemy will have you trapped. We'll retreat for now and think of a better way to fight back.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Roaming under the night sky is just one hundred times better than getting shut in here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Who was that?!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Tired? You can have Helmet to hug for a little bit, then. At least until tomorrow.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Well, New Year's today. Once winter passes, the caravans start coming again. If things were usual, we'd pull off a big job, and have a feast on the nobles' dime, celebrating all around. It's comfy times here, though, and I have no need for my old job. I wonder when I'll finally get the chance to bring those kids in.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Helmet, no running about in the corridor! Don't think I can't see you just because you're hiding in someone's arms... oh, fine, I'll let you off, for {@nickname}'s sake.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: To the children of the wild, having food in your belly and a safe place to shelter's all the lucky blessings you'll ever count—no one has birthdays on their mind, and I have no idea what I should even give you. How about this? Ten favors I'll do you. Not missions from the Doctor of Rhodes Island, but things you want me to do.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I still remember some of my toddler days. The fireplace at home. Mum holding me. The little handicraft beastling from my dad. That was my first home. Then I left the wilds, and lost my home again. I know there's no protecting who I want to protect yet, not before I get stronger. So, you're not going to stop me in my step. No one will.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: All done now. Um… do you mind if I read my manga here?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: A-ah. I'm just not cut out for real life relationships… On SNS, all I gotta do is send a request to make friends. Reality is such a nightmare.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Utage was my classmate in middle school, and the one who introduced me here. We're… friends, I guess, but Doctor, be warned, riajuus are terrifying!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Eh? Why send messages when we're face to face? Uh, cuz, you know, it's easier that way…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Back in Higashi, I saw Koga election vans on the street a bunch. Their representative is kinda hot... Um, but I don't understand much about that whole side of things, so usually I just voted whatever.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: My family says that we all came out of the sea onto dry land forever ago, and that's how we settled down. Would I wanna go back into the sea? Mmnn... honestly, I don't really care.  As long as they don't get Oripathy, life's pretty good in Higashi.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There's some trouble lately. I hear things between us and the Kougon guys up north are getting heated again. This sucks... I wonder if their latest games will make it through…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Um… Doctor, do you think my hobbies are weird or anything? When I was young, the other kids would make fun of me, calling me gross and gloomy. Hmph. Who cares what they said, I certainly don't.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctoooor! I'll lend you this game, this manga, and this CD! They're masterpieces that I handpicked, so once you go through them, we'll be otaku buddies for life! We will have so much to talk about. If you're into other genres, just say the word. Better yet, just come over and pick something you like.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Not now, pal, I'm busy right here! Just one more hit... one more hit and he's down! Perfect! Got the rare drop!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Kirara. Nice to meet you... Uh… um… If you don't need anything else, can I leave?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Wow, that's cool… Uhhhh, the ultimate's name's kinda cringe though.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? As in a job promotion? Ugh, a middle management job is gonna kill me.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I just want to thank everyone for, uh, sticking by me all this time. I realize that, uh some things are better… said in person than by text... So, um, I guess... Tha-that's all I want to say! Thank you!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: If you want a support, maybe I can help out… I guess.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: ...Huh? Me? Captain? Really? Are you serious?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Alright. Begin quest.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Ah. Look over there. Enemy came right out of the tall grass.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Whuh? Started already?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hfff... ha…

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Oh boy, I'm kinda nervous.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Woah, the mangas do not lie.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Feels like I'm smurfing here.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Just like this, right? Okay.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Give me five minutes.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Wait… That move was pretty awesome, huh?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Uso! I've seen no-damage runs, but this is on a whole new level!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Mission Accomplished. Phew… it's done.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Aaarrnngh, missed, darn. No save scumming in real life. I guess…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: That's it, time to remake.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: If it's an option, I'd like to just stay in my room forever…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whah! Aaaahh, wrong button... this round is lost.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Oh, hey, Doctor. What? Got an action game you want me to take over?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: First off, please do not invite me to anything today without a good reason. Nothing's wrong, it's just…urgh, you wouldn't get it—the terror of having to say Happy New Year to strangers at a party. Besides, I've decided to just dorm it up and play games all day. You're always welcome by the way, Doctor.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good stuff in the login rewards today.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy Birthday, got you a dedicated pager. Just press this button and mine will light up. It also works vice-versa. Hehe. This way, you can reach me whenever you want a game buddy! Um, friends do this with each other, right? This is, like, a normal friend thing?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: As an Infected, I get to live a stable life, and I can still read manga and play games outside of work… I never thought a fantasy like this could come true. Maybe there are more dreams that I can make real… Say, Doctor, let's take on the world, together.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: File organization is one of my fortes! Uhh... What are these? Data charts and theory analyses...? Seems very complicated, unlike the romance novels I read. Doctor, have you read any Victorian literature? Just between the two of us, I share my name with the protagonist from my favorite work.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I used to believe the Infected would understand if I smiled at them, but I was wrong... Before I smile, I should put myself in their shoes to learn their pain, and that goes for all those who are oppressed.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Now that I've talked to Amiya and the Doctor, I can understand why she, an elite operator... and the rest of Rhodes Island made that choice.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It's a little embarrassing to say... but I really admire Bagpipe. It doesn't matter what she has been through, she takes pride in the fact she was once a Victorian soldier. Oh, please don't get the wrong idea. I still love Victoria, and it is this love that drove me to leave my homeland.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: It wasn't easy to lose the Dublinns. I talked to the girl called Reed afterwards, but it doesn't seem she remembers me. I suppose... that's a good thing for her. Should we get the chance, I would love to have a chat with her about poetry and novels. Oh, and it would be lovely if we became friends.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I have every step of Trooping the Colour memorized by heart, but I still have a long way to go to truly carry the banner's weight and find the way forward.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: It takes a little time to care for my hair. I know merely keeping up appearances isn't enough, but I see this as part of living diligently. Doctor, your hair's kind of messy. Would you like me to fix it for you?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: If the day comes that you must face those countless fearsome enemies, I will stand by your side.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor... if we had met before that incident, I'm sure I would've found myself relying on your help. But I can't well wait forever for someone to tell me what righteousness is. At the very least, on this journey we walk together, I wish to be an ally you can count on.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, when I see you here like this, it reminds me of the days I spent lazing around in the Rhodes Island offices... the sunshine, the card games, and my friends... It really brings back memories.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You must be Rhodes Island's commander? Operator Saileach, reporting in!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oh, could you stop for a moment, please? I would like to take notes.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I was... disappointed in them. And so I threw away all the ribbons and medals I'd ever earned. But Rhodes Island is different. Thank you, Doctor. I accept this award.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Even now, the blinding light that fended off the darkness still shines in my dreams, though I am still far, far away from her.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: May my banner protect all those who are innocent before my eyes.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: My friends, as long as we stand together, there will be no evil we can't overcome!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Follow me. Forward!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: If battle is unavoidable, I will not allow my weaknesses to get in my way.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Phew... I'm ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your orders, please.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: It's my duty to stand here.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I will not back down.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Can't you hear the children's cries?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Can't you feel the cities crumbling away?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You've never ever noticed the hideous grins of conspirators.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Could you ever imagine… friends turning against each other, and homeland fading into nothing but memories?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I simply want to defend the people's right to live, and it doesn't matter if they are Victorians or Infected.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You showed me that even weeds struggling to grow in the ruins can stand tall. Thank you.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I can only hope they will come to understand their injustice.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, this time, I'll stay. Hurry and take the others to safety.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Phew... I reckon it won't be easy to slack off once I become an actual staff member here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Eh? Oh, hello!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Are you tired? I've baked some scones. Please, sit down, have some tea, and tell me what's on your mind.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Here's some trifle, pudding, and carrot cake... Oh, is it too much? Sorry, I've been a little nervous for the whole morning. Before I knew it, I'd already made this much... Hehe, let's just say I made you all these desserts to thank you for everything you've done. I hope you can spend the year surrounded by sweetness.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, you look cheerful as always!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: This Victorian poetry anthology is one I always used to read, back in County Hillock. Now, I'm giving it to you. Oh, there's one passage I really love—'Old Sunlight hugs tight all the town in her bosom. Old Moonlight bends down with a kiss to the wild.' The feeling you give me is, really, just as warm as that. Heheh, have a happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I may have left the military, but my honor and calling are things I won't lay aside. In future, I'll return to where my duty lies. Please, don't worry. The memories we've made, the ideals we've borne together at Rhodes Island, they will always be carved upon this ensign, to be forever by my side.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Have you figured out the style you wanna go with today? Huh...? You didn't call me here for that? I really, really hope you can give it at least a little more thought. Please?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Watch out! I've got tons of stuff in my pocket here. If this negative ion hair softener bumps into the horn growth stimulant and spills... Well... I could end up getting hanged on the deck! It's no joke!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You've probably heard how assassins who know their stuff in anatomy work more efficiently, no? Of course, my goal's not to take anyone's hope to survive away. Instead, I want to turn that hope into something more vivid and brilliant! Styling is an art, but it's also a science!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: She looks familiar... Is that the girl who shows up in all those kung fu movies? Whoa, don't ever tell her I'm here! Nah, it's not her that I'm afraid of, but I really don't wanna run into her stylist, Lauder! The last thing I need is anybody calling me 'Bobbi'...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm a researcher, not a modeler, and I definitely don't want to be the kind of girl who works her mindless brush on monotonous faces under spot light day in and day out! Coming on the ship's been kind of like a vacation to me, I guess? If I had to stare at those lifeless faces all day, my brain would get completely fried sooner or later. I'm not doing that no matter how much I get paid.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: If I got no money, I can't buy any new tools or materials. That's why even I got to work sometimes. Hm... I think the girl who came to me last time just got an academy award? She'd be fine to spot me, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, I asked Dr. Warfarin for some info about your body... and modified my brush texture based around that. I promise you it won't trigger any allergies this time!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: If you want to touch my hair, go right ahead. It's pretty messy already anyway. Is that weird? When you do styling work for as many people as I do, you definitely won't find yourself in the mood to work on yourself even if you have the time.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Interesting faces are like stories in their own right. Dr. {@nickname}, you are like... a kinda damaged videotape, waiting for someone to dust you off. If the day ever comes that you get repaired, what kind of story will you reveal?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Did you really fall asleep? In that case, I guess I can get to work? Your bone structure, your skin... Whoa, this is even more spectacular than I thought!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Roberta! We meet again! Once I sign here, I'll be your personal stylist, right? Huh... 'You'll be an operator?' Doesn't matter as long as I get to stay!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Beat up all the annoying guys, right? No more difficult than swinging ten brushes around while taking a sip of coffee. I'm from Siracusa, after all.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I've got an entire room full of medals like this one back in my studio in Wrankwood... Hey, Doctor, can't you give me something a little more interesting for my reward?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Since you're giving me another promotion, I want a bigger studio. You'll approve it, right?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Should I go with eyeshadow palette #3001... or perhaps #3002?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Doesn't look like we have a color base that works for all of us...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go, everyone! I'll do the re-touch in case your makeup slides off.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I know exactly which part of the face is the most fragile!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: You gotta put on the most suitable style even when you're giving out commands in the frontlines.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: These real battlefields give me so much more inspiration than any film set I've been to.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Bring your face closer this way, okay? Thanks. I'll pay attention to how much force I use.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Even the biggest stars out there gotta book me in advance, you know? You should count yourselves lucky!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Surface electrode tracking auto-filling concealer!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Infused Originium Slug acid styling spray!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Facial bone full structured self-image shading highlighter!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Wet/Dry ambient color adapted lipstick and blusher!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Whoa... Not even I can replicate that look on your face right now.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What a perfect operation. Makes me want to add a few more touches to bring out that joy on your face.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: There's nothing as boring as watching the cowards run. They always stiffen up like Rock Spiders that've spent a bit too much time in antiseptics.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Doctor, need me to give your face a little blush? If you go back like this, the others might worry when they look at you.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Can I do my experiments here? Relax, I won't blow the walls out. At most... I guess the doors and windows might bend a little?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Didn't I say I'm not seeing anyone...? Oh, it's you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, can I come over to your room this evening? Your face could really use a massage.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New Year, new scenery! Doctor, this stack of paper... Oh, no, actually, all these papers are brand new looks I've been thinking up just for you... Hey! Why are you running away, Doctor?!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, want to try this new look I designed just for you?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Tons of celebrities in Wrankwood would ask me to do their makeup for their birthday parties. Cover every trace of time on their faces, no matter the cost. But is that really beauty? Doctor, this mirror's my gift to you. I hope you'll find a true and beautiful you staring back.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I've noticed a lot of operators and patients covering up their Originium crystals. That's not gonna cut it! I've got a plan: I'm going to design a whole set of patterns for decorating your crystals. That's the most meaningful thing I can do for Rhodes Island as a makeup artist!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You would have me as your assistant? Well, if the said duty is akin to my last, where I served within the Hall of the Twelve Heroes as its priest, I shall be fine, I assume.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Ugh... Uh… Ehem… I must not drink so much... next time… Ah, Dr.{@nickname}. Why do you stagger and sway, so much in your movement today?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The city is a grand sight during the festivals. Theatrical performances, sparkling wine, sports competitions... Truth be told, I once joined Formula Chariot racing, competing with my equally unskilled fellows. That chariot was not cheap. I wonder if its fate was inheritance, or if it was simply abandoned after I left?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: To think there were so many like-minded souls at Rhodes Island. Ah, poetry, war, freedom! From within the torrent of history, you summon the strength of many to rebel against fate, and undo its blight upon the lands. How exhilarating! These tragic yet extraordinary stories… They should be immortalized, and passed down forevermore.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: After contracting Oripathy, I moved to a small village in the Minoan borderlands. There was a small ongoing war against the Sargon incursions... which ended with the victory of the Minoans. However, I would prefer this story to gradually spread as a tale, rather than live in its so-called reality.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Simply light the flames of resistance, and they shall burn hot and fierce. For those whose wishes for liberation are so dear, the story of the 'Goddess of War' shall be their flag, a banner under which they will unite in the forthcoming battles. For me, I have naught but this infected body of mine, and this unchanging faith.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I see... Vulcan, once the champion of weapon forging, is here at Rhodes Island. That is great news indeed! This weapon in my hand has confounded many a smith. But none could restore it to its rightful condition. Here, look upon this signature, that of the very same Vulcan... Hm? I ought to keep it a secret?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The stories of Minoan heroes… They include both comedy and tragedy alike. However, the noblest aspect of the Twelve Heroes is that——Without exception, each and every one of them returned to a simple, ordinary life.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: To suffer oppression for such a length of time, that their souls have grown numb to it… My heart goes out to those poor souls. Still, a heart without hope cannot burn with the fires of rage. I would never wish for anyone to face cruelty, but if a man is to be a warrior, then he needs a bit of faith, a little spark, and most importantly— a 'start.'

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I am used to thinking while standing upright. From time to time, I am suddenly poked, simply to check if I have fallen asleep on my feet.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am the Minoan priestess, Pallas. I shall be convalescing at Rhodes Island for a time... Be that as it may, I hope to enjoy my share of alcohol and theatre, and I yearn even more for battle.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Recording the valiant warriors in battle, and with such realism. What a great convenience it is.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Abandoning glory, the hero decided to return to normal life, but could not, due to Oripathy infection? No… It should not be so.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I, Pallas of Minos, am a woman of faith, a follower of the will of the heroes. My weapon shall remain ever sharp and free of rust, such that it may strike at the forces of injustice and cruelty. My humility shall not be forgotten, an eternal expression of my duty to salvation and redemption.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: O heroic heralds of victory, I welcome your blessings.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: O great warriors, I fight by your side, shoulder to shoulder.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The next time you turn your head, you will find us returning, with victory in hand.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Fear not, for we shall claim victory over these reckless foes.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Rejoice!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Come—

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: There is no room for regret.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: There is no need to retreat.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: O heroes, stand together with us, for the paramount power of faith!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Tremble, in the face of true bravery.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Weep, for that wavering faith of yours.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You shall kneel here.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Have we done it...? I feel only the greatest honor and joy.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Turn about, brave champions. We have achieved a perfect victory, and it is now time to return and enjoy the fruits of our labors.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Listen well, the lamentations have ceased. This calm heralds the arrival of peace and joy.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Even though the wars of humanity have no end in sight, we have protected our dignity, for the moment. Leave. Keep your heads held high.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: My horns might pose a threat to furniture. I shall be vigilant.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What would you do, should you possess wisdom and strength?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: There is a Minoan-themed multimedia room event. Shall we go and see what thrills await?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: A happy new year to you, Dr.{@nickname}. I have dined upon many delicacies of the East today, and experienced a uniquely different kind of celebration. I have even obtained many fun prizes, such as this... Oh? This 'firecracker', it is not to be used indoors?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Are you rested, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Congratulations on the day of your birth, Dr.{@nickname}. This wreath, a symbol of honor and victory, is a gift for you. On your road ahead, may you always journey alongside wisdom and courage. The glory befitting a hero, it's sure to be awaiting you at the end of the thorny path.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A boisterous celebration is always exciting no matter the venue. Sing! Rejoice! Let us engrave this moment's animated air into our mirth, and we ought to open our vision for tomorrow with some fine wine— What? I should limit my drinking, even on such a day as this...?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Good work, Doctor. Why don't you take a break? Oh, don't worry, I'm already done with the report… Haha, there's no need for a compliment. It's really not a big deal, I've simply become experienced with these things.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Wait, wait, Doctor, s-stop tugging, I'll take them out myself! There, all the cards I hid up my sleeves. Haha, I figured you'd see right through me. If we get a chance to go to Dossoles, I'll show you some even more interesting things.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Every time I talk to Miss Ch'en, as well as that Miss Lin, I get all nervous. Man, I really don't want to get beaten up again… What, you can't tell? Well, Doctor, here, check out my palms. They're all sweaty!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Yo, Doctor, fancy seeing you here. Looking for someone? Oh, Rafaela? I'm afraid I don't know where she is either. Guess you can tell, without the old man here, we have very little to say to each other.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My old man threw me into the army reserves when I was just a kid. We were all kids, really. Some of us had burning ambitions, but I'd say most of us didn't even know what we wanted. Life was tough, and we were just looking for a way out, nothing more.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Dossoles should be in good hands with Miss Candela. As for the old man, he's better off behind bars for now. He needs to calm down and reflect on his actions. You see, Doctor, when I agreed to help him one last time,  it was my way of trying to find answers,  and sort out my thoughts. Now... I've found my answers.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: When we first arrived in Dossoles, Rafaela and I were still very young. We quickly adapted to life there, but the old man still insisted on his integrity and his old ideology... Can't do anything about it, but I figure I should at least try to help.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, here's the mission report from last time. I've already handled the follow-ups. Ah, don't worry, there won't be any problems. It'd be a real bummer if something unexpected happened and ruined our carefully laid plans. I'm not about to allow that.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: So how about it, Doctor? Did you draw the card you wanted? Aw, better luck next time! Though I should say, in a game of chance, there's nothing less reliable than luck. But rest assured, if you're ever in need of it, I'll deliver luck right into your hands.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, I'll put all the materials I've organized over here. Hm? Asleep… Look at all the important documents you left lying here... You must trust me a whole lot…

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello there, are you the Doctor? Great, you're just as recognizable as Miss Ch'en said you'd be. Oh, right, I should pick out a code name, then? Hmm... Let's go with Tequila! Sounds pretty nice, eh?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I'm supposed to try this move myself? That… seems painful.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Already? Whoa… thanks a million. In any case, without further ado, let's talk about future changes to my work…

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: When Miss Ch'en brought me in, I never thought I'd see a day like this. So, does that mean I'm one of your most capable subordinates? Haha, it's not a joke, whether you need me to be a tour guide or something else, you can rest easy knowing you're in good hands.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: OK, Got it. Leave it to me.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm in charge of the squad? Haha, I appreciate the trust…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Follow my lead. Be careful, and don't fall behind.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Come, let us show our guests some hospitality.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Need my help with anything?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Awaiting orders.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Sorry, this path is closed for business.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Pardon me, I'd like you all to stop right there.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't get worked up, let's talk first.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Violence isn't really my thing, but well…

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Negotiation Failed.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Begone.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You even managed to anticipate their ambush, Doctor! I guess there's no shame in them losing like that. I still have much to learn.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Everything's taken care of, Doctor... How did I take care of it? Doctor, do you really need to hear that?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew, that was a close one. Are you alright, Doctor? Yeah… A few of 'em got away. Let me see…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's retreat for now! We'll live to fight another day!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Ah, so this is the dorm... Mind if I give it a makeover, and buy some little decorations for it?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Tsk... What the… Oh, it's you, Doctor.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: It was raining out there just now, and my hair got a little wet... Sorry, Doctor, could you pass me that towel?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy new year, Doctor! My new cards are here, so, how about a game? Entertainment at Rhodes Island is nothing compared to Dossoles, sure, but as long as you've got me, we'll manage. I know a thing or two about creating a festive atmosphere.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How are you feeling today? Want to head out for a bit?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here, Doctor, a birthday present for you. Guess what's in the box… Hey, no, don't shake it so hard! It's expensive, and we'll have nothing to drink if you break it!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: For those who seek change but set off on the wrong foot, no matter how flashy their appearance, they will always lack substance. That's why I appreciate Rhodes Island and its work. Salud, Doctor, to us both finding the right path forward.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: No problem, I'll handle it. Filling forms and organizing data are complicated and dull procedures to be sure. But it's necessary work, if we want local governments to help out in assisting the Infected. I'm sure you've nurtured a patience for it, as I have.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: No, no, I didn't put these healthy living advisories up. Our organization aims to help people live better lives, but I don't believe that gives us the right to dictate what a better life is. Besides, I personally prefer energy bars to regular meals... Oh, heh, I'll consider your advice.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Operators have been coming to me for talks? True enough. Even HR Operators are asking me about it. The only thing I can tell you is that I'm not here to poach people for Pure Heart Medical. You know very well I must keep all work engagements confidential, whether they've killed a relative, or simply stolen a cookie.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, could you help me review this script for a business conference? There's a part about distributing Oripathy medicine on the frontier. I'm not used to such loud public speeches. Quiet talks are more my thing... But I'm so good at pushing for a dangerous mission? Th-That's a very different situation!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The discussion went smoothly, so I'm in no position to feel down, but... I got yet another 'If the Infected were as well-mannered as you, we would have donated much more'. Tolerance or humility, people can only afford it when their backs aren't up against the wall.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I once escorted some Infected out of that city, with a few Sarkaz in tow. It was a long journey. They had no staves, and their condition only worsened when casting Arts to protect themselves, while I use my own Arts to keep them safe, at no cost to myself... ah, the irony of it all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Yes, the Infected are usually isolated from the masses, and physical contact can be an act of kindness. Though, hugs inherently make people happy. You don't have to be infected or have a particular reason to enjoy one. Would you like a hug, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Do we have to talk about Londinium...? I once attended an aristocratic ball where everyone covered their crystals as they danced; I helped workers move their lumber as I heard them hoping to build a home before they took their last breaths. They were all smiling, so I want to smile when I tell their stories.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Have a seat, Doctor. No, you aren't interrupting anything. The view isn't that special either. Just another sunrise in the barrens amidst dusky skies. I tell myself the sun rises the same every morning... just as it did that one time I didn't look back.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Ssh—Hello there, the Doctor's on break at the moment... No, no, the Doctor is being very responsible. No one can work 24/7—everyone has to recharge every once in a while, right?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm here at Rhodes Island for an exchange study, representing the Maylander Foundation's Pure Heart Medical. Your Operators saw me before in Victoria...? I'd like to avoid discussing my experiences there for the time being, if I could.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Sorry, could I just take a short break? It's honestly a bit too loud for me...

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you, Doctor. I'm glad Rhodes Island values me, but I'm afraid my suggestions won't be any better than what you're already doing.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I spent one afternoon in middle school reading a Maylander report on how the Infected live, and decided I had to do something for them. As my mind wanders back to that young boy's arrogant self-righteousness, I'm filled with shame. But I did the right thing. I have no regrets.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: All this noise... I've gotten used to it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Just follow me, everyone. Our plan is set and we have plenty of supplies, so we'll get through this.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: If you get too cold, come over near me.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: We should try talking with the other side, if it's not too late.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Are you nervous?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Of course, ready anytime.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Phew… My ears might need a second to get used to this environment.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: This confrontation is inevitable.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Fire is only a boundary.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Please don't force your way through.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I won't surrender, so I suggest you take a detour.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: If only you had more choices in life…

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: It's no wonder so many see you as hope itself... ah, sorry. Does that put a lot of pressure on you?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew— you're really incredible! How about taking a break to celebrate?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, just say the word and I'll go have a talk with them.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: ...It's alright, we have a contingency plan and plenty of medical supplies. No need to worry.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It's going to be hard, convincing other companies to follow this standard of treatment for Infected employees…

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: If you want to scare me, you should try yelling 'boo!' or something next time.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Would you like to talk? I'll bring the beanbag chairs over... oh, you don't have to be so formal. I'm happy to hear whatever you have to say.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: ...Did you call me? Ah, sorry. I had my earplugs in. They only asked me to untangle these streamers, so at least it wouldn't bother anyone if I didn't hear you. Oh, Please don't get me wrong, I do love New Year's. When people make their resolutions, it means they still have hope in their hearts.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Please let me know if you need anything. Oh yes, you can also ask me to join you on your coffee break.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: You're an important partner of Pure Heart Medical, so of course we got you a birthday gift. Please, open it. Haha, I'm sorry. I just wanted to see the shocked look on your face when you opened it. This body pillow is a personal gift from me, I hope you enjoy it as much as I do.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: It's crucial we consolidate our achievements so far, but it's inevitable that we'll recall our many regrets and sorrows as well... We should find another day for it, but could I talk to you about a few things I've had on my mind? Yes, I hope you can be the one to hear me out.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: The wind blew the documents all over the place… This can't be because of my luck, can it…?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: When I was a kid, Grandpa told me stories of how they built Siesta, but before he could see it to completion, he moved to Columbia with my parents. I went back to Siesta hoping to see what it had become in his place, only to find that it's all volcanic ash now.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: This is my grandpa's hammer. It's been with me all the way, from when I was a civil engineering student to my demolition work, and finally to what I always wanted to be——a builder. If Rhodes Island ever needs any demolition work done, just say the word! Uh, by that, I mean construction work! Anyway, for some reason, I find hammers more wieldy...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Everybody knows making bets with Rope is a good way to lose your stuff. And I know Glaucus's cocktails are a little different from the ones everyone else gets. And anything Savage's hammer touches is bound to blow up—Oh, um! I know all that, but not because I've got rotten luck!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: New Siesta has some unfinished city plates where you can see the volcano. Old workers like to gather there and chat about what the old Siesta looked like. I've heard most of their stories, but I still stay and listen, the same way I listened to Grandpa's stories... I still wonder what it was really like...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Back in school, my classmates always told me that Siesta is a tourist destination. It doesn't have its own architectural style. People just build whatever attracts the tourists. Look at Siesta today, though. We are her style.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Want some walnut jam? Freshly made. Uh, I didn't mean to make it. It just, you know, happened. What's that on my hammer, you ask? Oh, um... it's walnut husks... Okay, okay, I admit it. Vulcan said it's a good way to train my strength control, but I didn't get a single one right. So, do you want the walnut jam or not?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Look, the last time I came to the landship, the incomplete city plate was still empty, but now there are rows of houses there, and the lights of the high-tech district reach even the beaches nearby. I'm building our new homeland bit by bit, alongside many others. It's, how do you say, an interesting feeling, right?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: After I graduated, I could only find demolition work in Columbia, and I even caught Oripathy. I wanted to go back to Siesta to make a living, only to find a pile of volcanic ash waiting for me. It took a lot of work to find the new Siesta, so I was real happy that day. I even yelled out loud: Hey hey hey—That's it for my rotten luck! Everything's going to work out just fine from here on out!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: I've got classmates still with the demolition teams, another who's a contractor, and yet another who's a Pioneer... I'm the only one who, after that roundabout path, came back to Siesta to work on what I actually studied... I guess it worked out pretty well for me?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You're the Doctor that Ceylon talked about, right? I'm Poncirus. Thanks for agreeing to provide medical assistance to us workers. My codename? It's a kind of fruit that's very close to my hair in color. The workers like to squeeze its juices into wine.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Finding the structural support core in an instant and destroying it right away...  Alright, with a little practice, I'm sure I can do this, too.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotional medal... I'll take it. Thanks for your acknowledgment, Doctor. I'll work hard to make sure I'm worth it.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Senior Engineering Operator? Does that mean my pay goes up, too? That's great! I can send more money back home to my parents now, and I gotta write a letter to Grandpa, too. Yeah, everything's working out just fine!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll check out our surroundings.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What did those stubborn professors do back in college again... Hold a seminar first? Pff... Everyone would hate me so much...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Bring your site plans, everyone. Watch out for accident-prone areas.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Arrived at the most optimal combat location. Ready to move.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Request acknowledged.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'll give you the best plan possible.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: If you need me to, I'll wreck this place without hesitation.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: My hammer's not so weak!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Load capacity calculations complete!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Stress concentration point measured!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Enemy cover demolished.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: The structure's stable and sound. Nothing to worry about!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Like a building that'll never be destroyed.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Looks like luck's on my side instead of theirs this time!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: It's okay, Doctor. A city covered in volcanic ash is always pale, but beautiful flowers will eventually sprout on it.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: The road's been demolished. Enemy pursuit vehicles intercepted.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What a sophisticated design... I gotta find time to really look at it.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Got a new mission, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Ah! Doctor, remember to stay clear of my hammer the next time you talk to me. It's dangerous!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. You'll be there at the ceremony tonight, right? I gave the operators in charge of the hall's design a few suggestions and divided it into a few zones based on the operators' homeland... Right, on a special day like this, a sense of belonging is important.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Why don't we head outside together for some fresh air, Doctor? Staying in one place can really slow your thinking.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. This is a 'mini hammer' that I designed myself. It works on the same principles as my weapon, and you can wield it with just one hand. I'll be heading back to Siesta tomorrow. While I'm gone, you can use it to crack nuts.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I just tidied up our design documents from the past year. I didn't expect there to be so many, and it really gives me a rare sense of fulfillment. Although there isn't much I myself can do for Siesta, I know that each and every stroke I draw represents the journey I've traveled.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Make the most of everything, hm? As you've given approval, I'll do my very best to provide you all additional joint effort and technological support necessary, within our agreement's scope, of course. Fortunately, assistant work was my exact vocation.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Rhodes Island's ambience is more assuaging than I'd imagined, at least personally speaking. After all, you typically feel medical firms would be nothing but dour to almost insipid researchers. Not to even start on your armed force to keep the Oripathy-related technologies and personnel safe.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: In my time at Raythean, I took part in several project teams, but they mostly bored me. Obviously, one can't complain about their technological prowess, but if all it is is fulfilling orders to quota, without attempting to inject a little inspiration, doesn't work become just too dull?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You seem somewhat mindful of my manner of speech. Hmm, if possible, I'd like if you could bear with it. My last project team, whether superiors or juniors, all took up overly polite address that only sent communication efficiency to rock bottom. It posed a headache to me too.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: True, work calls for strict treatment, and serious accomplishment. But after work is over, you also need to understand keeping a balance and relaxing, which is what lets you adjust your own state and achieve glowing results next time in your work. Do you believe so, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Have you heard the observation that though many find satisfaction in neat, orderly things, there's a set that feels apprehension in a space holding the same qualities? Yes, every time a rest day passes and I return to a work station that's been tidied up, I feel suffering.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: A pileup of overdue reports and files just won't do. The paper shredder? No, Doctor, don't tell me you wouldn't want to try this environmentally-friendly corrosive, able to turn a ream of paper to pulp with a dropper's worth. There's no use? That's true. How about I launch a project to develop a papermaking machine utilizing this pulp?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: The impression you give may not seem quite like my project manager at Raythean, but there's some similarities. However, saying this with a wide open heart, you as a superior outstrip that unpredictable, outlandish black box of a crackpot project-intending plan-addled trickster genius by miles.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Both Raythean R&D projects and working together with you have been delightful experiences. I'm finding myself torn between choosing, and I don't mean it as a pleasantry. Perhaps, you'd mock my greed? But people like us might just all be greedy. What's your view?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Only when you have finished everything at hand can you rest carefree and firm-willed. At this rate, I'm worried you'll... heh, whatever. With this little left, I can figure it out for you without any worry.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello there, Dr. {@nickname}. Raythean Industries liaison, Corroserum. I'm sure you saw the relevant contracts and forms, despite your busy schedule. Now then, do share any upcoming workflow arrangements.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals Inc.'s battle records are more interesting than I expected.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You've raised your evaluation of me? Thank you, this'll be good grounds to include when I apply for another tour here.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: True, it's worth taking joy in a project's smooth progress, but the evaluation you've given me, in my opinion, seems to have already outclassed my resume. That is to say, do you have further expectations of me, even greater than this?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Ah, another assignment perfect for testing weapons. Of course, I'm very pleased to be working with you, Doctor.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: This is an anti-corrosive coating spray, with no toxic side-effect on the human body at all. Given you were all willing to sign the disclaimer and participate in this test, I sincerely hope none of you become collateral damage due to irregular operation in this weapon's test.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: The holiday's always over in the blink of an eye. Well, then, let's get to work.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'll be troubling you to make these test targets fall in line a little with our work, Doctor.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Do you have any additional directives?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: You can order me for anything you'd like.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Timed just like your simulation.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: The stressful test phase is now beginning.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Can I make sure none of you will surrender just yet?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I have an extra project here that needs all your cooperation for testing.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I'd like to ensure you all persevere until I can gather enough data.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Of course. This is part of work, too.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, this has thrown a slight wrench in things. After all, you've obtained combat results beyond expectations, and made it marginally more difficult for my assessment of weapon performance limits to be universal and objective. I'll have to increase the quantity of test samples to ensure accuracy... was that in your plans too?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: A pleasing result. It seems once we return and I finish collating this data, I'll have some spare time for free movement. Well, then, do you have any free time coming up, Doctor?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Not too ideal in terms of results. Deployment tactics still have room for optimization. Don't you think so, Doctor?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's not feel down, Doctor, you will find a solution to break this deadlock. After all, you'd like the reports we'll be writing to be worth more than scrap paper, wouldn't you?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Is there anything I'd be able to help with?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: I wouldn't trouble you with a matter this small.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor? I assume you're there.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I'm very glad I don't have to confront those nightmare piles of annual reports here at Rhodes Island. It seems quite a few Operators have requested advance leave to visit family at home? Well, then, do you have any upcoming plans for this provisionally idle time?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: It's nice to see you, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I apologize, Doctor, I'm currently working. If you wanted to chat, you'll have to wait until I'm on break. Oh, yes, I left your birthday present on your desk early this morning—if that's what you wanted to talk about, I'd be very happy to sit down with you at dinner this evening.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I originally came to Rhodes Island to test weaponry and nothing more, but your command never ceases to demonstrate the importance and value of people. I've certainly learned very much from it... So, the idea of formally joining Rhodes Island may be a decent one. Doctor, can we have an honest chat about your terms of employment for any job-hoppers?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Can I have this printer that's written off? And my gosh, how could you dump that whole pile of paper in the shredder? You can still write on the back!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Whoa whoa, Stay back. I just finished work, so I'm all sweaty. You need something? If it's not urgent, just go back to your office. Let me wash up and get a change of clothes, then I'll come talk to you.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hahaha, Check me out! I made this whole outfit by myself. Yeah, it looks like crap, but it's sturdy! And you see this sickle?  I tore a door off a huge car to make it. I've used it for years, and it's good as new.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: See that electric cooker of mine? I made it out of an old heater. And my space heater there, I made it out of an old TV. And As for the TV here, I put that together from the parts of a broken bread maker. Where did I get this bread maker? Aha, I modded an electric cooker I scavenged.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The Pioneer guys are different from us. They get to wander around. Not us. Once you come to the disposal plant, you're staying forever.  Think you can run? Not happening, my friend. Look at your supplies, how far could you go? There's nothing but wasteland for miles. Your only shot at survival is staying inside.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You have no idea how heartless those snobs are. They dump just about anyone in the disposal plant. Kids barely old enough to work, old folks in bad health. I can't stand it, but there's not much I can do other than making sure they get fed alongside me.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, remember that printer I took off your hands? Here, I fixed it. Oh, but keep an eye on the thermometer up top when you use it. If it goes over the threshold, it could explode.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Yeah, Doctor, I've got a temper, and I can't just sit by and watch bad things happen. In the end, I made the wrong enemies, and got thrown in the disposal plant. A whole decade came and went in the blink of an eye, like a nightmare... But now the dream's gone, and I'm awake! I don't regret it one bit. I'll keep my temper and make no compromises.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Ever since we were kids, if folks like us wanted to eat, we had to count on the scraps the snobs let slip from on high. Sadly, that's not enough to fill your stomach. So some folks end up stealing, naturally. That's not something anyone should do, I know. But if there was another way, why would you need to steal?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Whatever it is, it can wait until tomorrow! There's unlimited steak at the canteen today, I'd better get over there right away!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, Rhodes Island has done so much for me. What can I say except thank you? If you need anything, just say the word. I'll do whatever it takes to make it happen!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Doctor, I can read a little bit, but the jargon in this video is pretty dense. I can barely make any sense of it.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What? You're giving me a promotion? Me? For real? Hold up, what was I doing before this?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Thanks, Doctor... If only my old man had lived long enough to see this day. His kid... always up to no good... has finally made a name for himself.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Agh... It's been a while since I beat anyone up. Hope I didn't get too rusty.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Yeah, I can be the captain and chaperone these kids. I'll make sure all of them come back alive.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Stop right there, you little cubs! Don't just rush in ahead!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: You come at me like that, you can't blame me for what happens next.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm all set to go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Huh? I thought you wanted me here to fix a lock!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Whose car is this? I... How should I know?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: A one-on-one? Tough guy, huh.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: What, you think you're gonna grind me down with numbers?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: There's more of you? Ugh, what a day.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Arghhhh screw it! Bring it on, all of you!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ugh, I just hope these punks learned their lesson.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No enemies in sight. But I'm sure they left behind some pretty good stuff.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: No, no, don't chase them. Just let them be. They got beaten so bad, they won't be causing trouble for a long while.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Relax, nobody wins every fight. Go home, wash your face. Life goes on.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Man, this bed is too soft. I just can't fall asleep. Could you give me something firmer? That's how I like it.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm? Need some help? I'm your man.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Here, I grabbed you some tangerines from the canteen.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: When I first got to that stinking place, I didn't celebrate any holidays. That's for men who still got something to look forward to. But the kids kept pestering me, asking me to make them some fireworks. In the end, I burned the whole tent... Save it. Thinking back, I guess it was pretty funny, hahaha.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: No matter how busy you are, be sure to eat right, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: It's your birthday, huh...? *sigh* I didn't know, so I didn't get you anything. How about this? I'll treat you to a feast tomorrow. Whatever you want. But uh... try to not order anything too expensive.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I sorted through tons of trash at the disposal center, for years. You can use most things after a little cleaning. If cleaning isn't enough, you can probably still fix it. If that doesn't do the trick, you can disassemble it and use its parts. That goes for people too, don't you think? No one out there's completely useless.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Last time I was an assistant, I think I was still thirteen or fourteen, treating people with my mum. Of course, I can do much more than hand out herbals and sing well-wishing verses now. If you need my help, ask away! Don't be shy.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I think I've seen a few new faces this time after returning to Rhodes Island. Dr. {@nickname}, how does it feel to have more and more people under you? Do you feel that brimming and bursting vitality? We always say back home, rage against death with new life.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island Bridge-Climbing Competition? Dr. Kal'tsit shut that down midway, didn't she? Citing lack of safety ropes for all the contestants and so on. Well, I wasn't that likely to win it, and the look on Dr. Kal'tsit's face was a much greater sight to see anyway.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You look put out with all these reports on your desk. Don't worry, if there's any danger, I'll know it by the scent. But! If you just don't want to work, I can't help you there.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Of course it's much easier to gather intel when you're a lone operator. But every time I'm in the country, I pick a bag full of berries while I'm free, and I think to myself, maybe I want someone to share with after all. Otherwise, I've got no one to tell me how great I am at picking.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: You get the sense I served from how I work? You only got that impression from seeing my files. Service members come in all shapes and sizes, too. Some only like to read and research their comms tech, some spend all day dreaming about going on holidays in the city to see idol concerts...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Dr. {@nickname}, you might be covering your face, but I can tell you've perked up a lot more compared to when you came back from Chernobog. But if you spend the whole time under this low of a ceiling, your mind'll get dull. Head out onto the deck every now and then. Get some fresh air. It's good for you.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: When I looked after the ill back home, I ran across a couple Infected calling themselves 'Reunion'... and then I got into a fight with them. I can't stand it, seeing those children with firelight in their eyes lost in all the pointless violence, about to burn themselves through.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Those who depart us receive the land's forgiveness, and rest in her embrace... but some people go too quickly, the roots of the forests of their homes unable to hold onto their hands. Was that not like me, being so serious? You really should've seen me when I worked back home.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Not sure if the Doctor's a light sleeper... I'd better stand watch quietly.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Doctor. Call me Quercus. It's the first time we've met, but the intel on your desk about northern Victoria is straight from me... What, even you're going to tell me my reports aren't standard?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I wish I'd learned all this a little earlier.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: What's this promotion come out of nowhere for? My candied fruit must make a strong impression.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: In my hometown, you had to make a choice with Originium Arts. Whether to terrorize others, or to aid them... The result of my greed was that I couldn't commit properly to either. Even so, would you still have faith in me?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: As long as it's your decision, I'll have no objections.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: It's a major responsibility.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Shouldn't we consider marching routes other than on the ground?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: The more defined a battle's goal is, the clearer tactics become.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Will the land shake with fury, or display her mercy?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: If you're still hesitating, I can give some advice.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I will stand guard here.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Beginning collection of battlefield information.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: The land will forgive all in the end, but not now.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: The wind blows through; the leaves tell stories of those who sleep.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Arbor, reach your hands to me.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: I remember your face as well, now.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Wow, incredible! I've got the urge to snap a formal salute just to show my respect.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was a perfect operation! Once we're back, dinner will taste even better.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They can't be running far. Do you plan to pursue?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's alright, let me organize the retreat. I leave our next counterattack to you.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: It always feels a little hard to catch my breath when I'm shut in here for long.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh? Are you as much of a prank-lover as all those kids?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You want to hear me sing? Do you know who our songs are sung for? Usually, it's for the gravely ill.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! I've brought candied berries, canned home-style sandworms, and some rose-filled flower biscuits, all specialties from Victoria. Pick out what takes your fancy, Dr.{@nickname}? My homebrewed fruit wine's done fermenting too, so you'll want to taste as soon as you can, or else your share will be gone before you know it!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You're back here in your office again, Dr. {@nickname}. Have you refreshed your body and mind well?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Dr.{@nickname}. One look at the floral mess on your desk shows me your operators don't speak the language of flowers. Doctor, would you like to know their meaning? How about I give you a flower of my own here, and you listen carefully?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: New buds break through the soil, and tender flowers blossom from vines, while those branches that have grown shelter and surround them, protecting them from the elements. Whether Rhodes Island, or back home, that is always what I hope to be—like the branches, a shelter for the young children.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: With all this paper around, it's hard to resist the urge to start fires… Whoa, whoa, don't look at me like that, I'm just joshin', okay?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, our employees are all Billy natives who know the lay of the land. If any Rhodes operators are traveling to Rim Billiton and need an escort, come find us! We will offer you a fair price.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why hire Infected when it's bad for business? Well, umm, because... Ah, come on, we all know how Oripathy's transmitted. All you need is proper protection and monitoring. Rhodes Island does the same, right? Ahaha…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The right type of ammo can turn the tide of a battle', it's a line every artilleryman knows. So their bags are filled with grapeshot, flashbangs and tracers. 'Course, they always have trouble deciding which to use when the time comes. As for me, I just bring incendiaries. Use 'em right, and they replace any type of ammo you could need.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I hated it whenever anyone brought up my dad while I was in university. Are we on bad terms? Naw, he's not a bad dad, and I'm grateful to him. But I hate it when people look at me like a mining mogul's spoiled kid. I'm more than just my dad's daughter!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Dad wouldn't let me near fire, Mum didn't let me play with the miners' kids, my old boss told me not to poke my nose into business that isn't my own, and everyone told me not to be too nice to the Infected. I never listened to any of that. You decide what's right and wrong for yourself, and never get swept up if you need time to make a choice.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: That little firefighter always tenses up when she sees me, then points her hose right at me. Well, It's cute, sure, but that can't go on forever. The three of us should go for a drink sometime and clear up this misunderstanding. For the two of you, I'll make my special flaming cocktail.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I know I'm not great at business, but I also know how it feels to be helpless, relying on the kindness of others. It hurts, the company being in debt, but debtor's prison beats having to burn your own comrades to cinders.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I loved playing army when I was little, and I always dreamed of becoming a general. But Rim Billiton wasn't the place for that, so I had to settle for a private security firm... Now? Now I just want to keep my people warm and fed. My dream of becoming a general died the first time I saw someone get shot.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Yawn... I'm bored. Might as well build a grenade tower over here... Whoa?! You're awake? Er, these are blanks! Nah yeah, just blanks!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Thank you for choosing Firewhistle Security Services! My name is... huh? Codename? Umm, just call me Firewhistle. Yup, that's the key to raising brand awareness!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Nice strat. Would've been even better with some fire on that spot.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Thank you! If you've got any more security jobs for me and my people, that'd be even better. Hehe.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Working with Rhodes Island's seen my company turn a profit at last. I'm not paying my employees out of my own pocket anymore! Thank you so much, Doctor! You have all my appreciation and all my gratitude!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Firewhistle, at your service!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Captain? No problem, I'm used to running the show.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's go,everyone! I'll buy a round for us all when we're done.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Stay low. Wait 'till you see my fire.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Need some fire to turn up the heat?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Your orders please.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: In position and ready to light'em up.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Artilleryman in position!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Let's burn'em up!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This one's for you!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Panicking just spreads the fire faster.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Load, fire!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Your plan actually worked! Sure wish I had a tactical genius like you on my payroll.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We should put out the fires before we call it a day. Wanna join me?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Leaving a smoldering ember is a good way to end up with a wildfire. Let's watch out for those.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'll cover our retreat. Don't worry, I've done this a bunch of times.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Rhodes Island's base is outfitted so much better than my little office.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hey, Wanna see some fireworks?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Here, I made this ornament out of a shell casing. Hehe, I'm really good at it, right?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Just a sec, I need to file my annual financials... alright! I hear you've got a lot of good Billy cooks at Rhodes Island. Why don't we go for a little tasting together?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: G'day, Doctor! Need a warm fire?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here, Doctor, rainbow candles for your birthday! Hey, what's that look on your face? The flames are as colorful as the candles. How about that?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I thought about asking my family for help when my company was in debt. I even went home once, but when they asked how I was doing and whether I needed money, I just said everything was fine. I don't regret it one bit, but everytime I think of the concern in their eyes, I still feel sorry.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I can choose my own workplace? Thank you, I'll have the documents over shortly! Hmm, was the Convalescent Garden this way... or that way? Sorry, I'll still need you to show me the way after all…

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: My grandfather told me how wild roses used to grow all over behind the town. White ones, red ones, out in the mountains and fields... Children loved them. Dignitaries took pride in them... But I never saw any. Perhaps he just wanted to trick a naughty child into going to sleep...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The sunlight through the glass, the town's humid air, the aroma of petals and soil... Those were what made naps special for me, alone in the afternoons. No one would ever bother me—at most they'd quietly leave behind their coin, and take what flowers they fancied back home. At least, that's how it was until the tragedy.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I was bringing some seeds back, and Lena was smiling at me the whole time. Why...? Oh, I didn't even notice I had dirt on my face! I feel like when I get busy, I start letting all sorts of things slip my mind. Has it been this way? Well... I used to never have so many worries in the first place.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I don't think me stepping onto the front lines was an act of bravery. My time in the Self-Salvation Corps wasn't that dramatic either. My hometown's gone and I had nowhere to go. All I could do was carry on my friend's last wish, and never look back. Isn't that what war's all about?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Do you think flowers can grow once more, in steel and soil's gaps? Ever since I saw again what that city of iron's become, the question has been bothering me. Maybe Rockrock was right—I'd better take a bag of seeds back home after the war dies down... You don't think we'll be waiting too long?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Excuse me, Doctor, I'm not getting in the way of your sunbathing, am I? I like it here too... The portholes might not be that big, but their sunlight's enough for these flowers to grow. What do you think? It worries me when a place feels lonely, so I took the initiative to decorate the room with them.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, watch out for the thorns on the stems! It's not that I don't want to pick them for you, it's just that they haven't reached the peak of their beauty yet. Hm...? You'd like to help me take care of them? Oh, no problem. Do you need me to teach you how?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: To be honest, my greatest wish would be to return to my hometown, and rebuild my greenhouse. Doctor, are you laughing? I'm guessing you—think I should have loftier dreams...? No need, you say? Heheh, I suppose. Well, not that this'll be easy either, seeing as my hometown's rubble now.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Take a deep breath, Doctor. The scent of roses will put your mind at ease.

lines.title: Onboard
