lines.text: Greetings, Doctor. Vendela reporting in. Um, what did Rockrock write for me next, I can't remember... Never mind! Please take this flower, I insist! Its meaning is good luck.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: The method's a perfect fit. You prune leaves and branches the same way.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Then may I request a bigger room? No... It's not that I can't get used to it. I just have more and more roses in my room, and they need more sunlight... Okay, maybe the same goes for me.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Don't worry yourself about these entangled thorns. They're just trying to protect me.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I'll try my best to help everyone out.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Everyone, please follow where the petals flutter.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Don't be afraid of the thorns. They are here to help us.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I won't allow them to trample apart this land!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Ugh, there's a bad scent in the air.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Will it really be possible to plant seeds here?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I like these high places. They have plenty of sunshine.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I heard someone tried planting sunflowers on the roof? Not a bad idea.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Watch out for the thorns.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Bloom forth!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Pay attention to where the petals fall.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: What blooms, must also wither.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Do you see the dew shimmering on the petals? Such splendid scenery in the morning light… We wouldn't be enjoying this if not for you.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Scything, uprooting... It sounds cruel. But if we want to deal with the weeds competing for nutrients, then I think there's no other way, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: While on the front lines, I caught a glimpse of an unforgettable field of flowers, blooming with vigor and vitality. I was always curious where their nutrients came from. Now, I think I know…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Their petals... have crumbled away.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Cold and isolated... Is this the sort of atmosphere you prefer, Doctor?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh! Did you want to buy some flowers?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Eep. You knocked the flower out of my hair.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! Oh, the gift in front of everyone's room? That's poinsettia. In the past, I'd leave a bouquet at each and every doorstep to celebrate New Year's Eve... I didn't want this beautiful custom to disappear because of that incident.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You spotted it, Doctor? That's a new variety I've been breeding. Do you like it?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, these little florets are for you. They grow all across the outcrops and pastures of my homeland. Even when gales level them flat, all they need is a little bit of sunshine, and they'll bloom forth again with renewed vitality. Isn't that just like us Victorians? Thank you for everything you've done, and happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I was going around the greenhouse collecting all the fresh buds, when it suddenly struck me how long it's been since that tragedy. Do you think I'll be able to rebuild my greenhouse back home? I know you might not have all the answers, but somehow, seeing everyone brimming with confidence... just puts my heart at ease too.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Nah-ah, keep those documents away from me... I go all vertigo when I see too much text. Don't even think of making me help you on the paper work, Doctor, I'm just gonna stand here nice and good.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Armor paint? It's gotta be gold. I love gold. It's the color of lightning, and when they say things are fast as lightning, that's fast!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: For combat, I got my own way of doing things. If you want 'em to respect you, just beat 'em down. If you want 'em to listen to you, go for a round, and let 'em know they could never ever win.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Armorless Union assassins, Nearl family knights, the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub... how's Rhodes Island hold all of them together? Your recruiting standards are mad out of sight.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I‘ve been honing myself into a campaign knight since childhood. That's how I've learnt all my combat skills. But after I got infected…pssh, I still wanna be a 'knight.' If winning fights is the way to prove myself, then I'll win every fight to show'em all.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Sometimes I don't really get what Sona says, yet I still believe she'll lead us to do right and proper. She's changing and improving herself to adapt, so maybe I'll try working on my own faults too. But, that doesn't mean I'm gonna take up everything she says, haha.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: When Justyna says things, her first sentence is the most important part! But if you don't listen to what comes after, you don't get what the first sentence was about. Good thing I'm already used to that, so I can grasp her point nice and clear.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Justice Knight's my pet. I got people to give her a bunch of functions, so she's got the chops to do it all at least a little. Yeah, she's a real doer!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I made the title 'Wild Mane' renowned through my own hard work. It's the symbol of a Knight as strong as hell, and an Infected Knight even. However, the General Chamber of Commerce takes our lives and our glory no more than products and consumables. Tch. Sucks I can't pound their masks to pieces right damned now.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Man, I'm so bored... hey, let's go for a drink. It's always Ashley who drinks with me, and that's just dull.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Wild Mane' Iwona, I'm a Knight from Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub. Sona says this place does good by the Infected? Sounds cool.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ooh... that's a sick surprise attack to make! Can we rewind that and watch it again?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Then you can tell I've gotten stronger? Haha, fine by me, gimme a few more!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Those hypocrites, wearing hollow masks and treading on the Infected as they want. Screw them, my lance is gonna run them all through!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Who's got the guts to spar with me?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Phalanx formation suits me most. If I'm the captain, then let's go with my kind of tactics!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's roooooll!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Haha, I got you sighted.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Leave the brawling to me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I've been waiting forever!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: You guys think you're worth my full strength?

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Don't you dare go down in one!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Slow! Slow! Way too slow!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Haha, you're not dodging this!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Lance charge!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Piercing through!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Keep on winning, and you'll never be forgotten. It's that simple.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Cheers, Doctor. You're a solid commander.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: My Major Lance... *sigh* Gotta get repairs again.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Leave any regrets for later! Go, I'll cover the rear!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Any rooms in all gold around here? Just a little dream of mine.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: What, you wanna have a race with me?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Skirts? Nuh-uh. I don't wear 'em 'cept for special days.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Haha, just bought some confetti cannons from the stand over there. Sparking Golden ones, of course, to suit the day best! The instructions here... Gah, never mind, I'm not reading through this wordy crap. Here, Doctor, hold this one in your hand and I'll count to three. Three! Two! One— What the...? Where's the BOOM?  Production date, you say? ... EIGHT YEARS AGO?! Where's that stand owner? He'd better be gone for REAL!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Ready for the day, Doctor? Wanna try some breakfast from the Justice Knight?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here, your birthday present, you're gonna love it for sure! Last time when Sona and the rest unpacked my gifts, I could tell they were trying hard to keep a calm face just because they could barely contain their excitement inside! C'mon now, this time I wanna see YOUR reaction— Surprise! Did you guess it? A pair of lightning-patterned socks! Cool, isn't it?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I only agreed to move with the others to Rhodes Island at first because it was Sona's idea. I may not have her perception and capability, but one day people will come to realize I'm doing more than just proving my strength, that I'm giving my all so that people can look at us infected with unbiased eyes.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, watch your hands. If you aren't careful around my weapons, you'll get hurt.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Here are the instruments I used to play. There aren't too many of them, but the gems on them are very valuable. Sell them, and they should cover my medical fees... Once my debt's cleared, I'd like to go back to living on my own. Would that be alright?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I've seen pets kept around your hospital here, and you have a training room. I've seen some of the children you're giving intensive care in the wards. 'Instructor?' 'Professor?' My previous savior brought me to those with the same title, and look how I ended up.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: This? This is my lyre. I may be better with other instruments, but I like playing this one most. Listen. Such an airy, lingering timbre, and the hand moves so beautifully when playing. But when you fully lose yourself in the melody, the knife concealed inside will... I'm sorry, I got carried away.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, do you intend only to treat me here? Strange. You really don't need me to do anything? I can't trust kindness with no strings attached. Let me do a little something for you, okay? I'm sure you'll be satisfied, no matter the task—But, you must share with me your motivations.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I remember coming back from my first fulfilled mission when I was young, weeping and throwing up, scared I didn't do well enough, that I would starve to death in some forgotten corner, unknown to anyone... No longer do I fear these things. Thanks to the days with Rhodes Island, I now know how it feels to be truly alive.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The Originium on my arm... it hurts terribly, but it's much more manageable by now. I know none of the physicians, but I can tell how sincerely they're working to save me. Doctor, once my illness has stabilized to a point, can I... stay here?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: A lot of my past mistakes were made out of fear. I was scared—I felt that if I didn't listen to them, I was dead. But after catching Oripathy, they threw me out there to die. I should have been terrified at that moment, but instead I was... relieved. The sun shining on my face—it was so warm, it really was.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, could you take me with you on your next field mission? I want to know the reasoning behind your every decision. Why did you save me, a stranger? Just what does my life mean to you...? I want to figure you out, just a little clearer.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: All the ones before you would sleep with one eye open, when I was around. Do you... trust me that much?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: So you're the Doctor from Rhodes Island...? Thank you for what you did. I'll pay for my treatment in time. Otherwise, I'd like to be on my own for now.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I'm a fast learner, don't worry.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: So this is how it feels... to hold my life in my own hands.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This isn't the first time someone saves my life. But, if I had a chance to get back to those barrens, a chance to weigh up what's behind those helping hands again, I would choose to starve to death there. Doctor, I've been thinking... how nice it would've been, if you were there offering your hand instead.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: I trust your judgment. You won't lead me astray.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: If I make any mistakes, please point them out to me.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Things are different. I don't want to hide myself any longer.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: It's them, right?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What is it?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm listening.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: In time, I'll find the right place for myself too.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: This is the position, right?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'm aware of what I'm doing.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I know what it is I want.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I obey my own heart.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You've gone astray.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: That's one more step in the right direction, isn't it?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Someday in the future, I'll have as clear a direction as you do.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: We have a few runaways. A little like I once was.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: This isn't happening, don't abandon me... Doctor, where are you?

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Are you interested in my instruments? I can teach you how to play.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ah! Doctor... that's dangerous.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: If I leave someday, you'll send me off, won't you?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Such pretty fireworks... I used to think they were too far away, but here I am today, watching them lit below me. A single firework's just a tiny little thing, but there it goes, flying into the sky, blossoming into flowers so bright. Doctor, is that something I can aspire to?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: I heard the sound of your footsteps, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: So today's your birthday... I don't even remember my own. Does my record in Medical note what day I was saved? I want that day to be my birthday. Doctor, I'll spend the day with you, so when my birthday comes, would you spend it with me?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: They told me I was meant to be an assassin, twisted my life onto a path it never should've taken. But they never even gave me a reason, and I did far too much I never should have done. You've given me a new lease on life, and I'll be sure to use it well.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You need my help with your mountain of work? Haha, I'm not sure if I should be intervening in Rhodes Island's internal affairs though...? It's no problem? Uh, really?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Our laws are incapable of perfectly solving every dispute. There are many situations where even the saints can't help. I must admit, I have a deep respect for people like the bishop from that monastery, considering the problems he faced. Too bad I don't have such lofty faith.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Was that Arene earlier? Now when did that punk learn some manners...? You taught him? Wow, now that's impressive! I guess even a devious boy like him is still just a boy. Easy enough to trick him onto the right track... Huh...? You didn't trick him?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Yo, Doctor! Ambriel and the others are doing a dessert potluck, and I'm bringing donuts. Mind helping me taste test? Okay, so what do you think—Whoa whoa, slow down on the water! It's too sweet and greasy? Strange, I thought the sugar level was just right...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Don't get me wrong, Doctor, yes, I was elected as 'a representative of the Notarial Hall', but that's just because everyone's curious about what magical place could  Federico endorse, and they needed someone out to take a look for them. In other words, they picked me to come take a look-see here. I've got no say on any matters relating to the Notarial Hall, so don't ask me about that sort of thing, okay?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm lucky I was born a Lateran. No, Doctor, our good fortune does not lie in our halos, but in our material abundance and strong state. You have an ideal Rhodes Island of your own? It's not easy, chasing your dreams, but... good luck I guess?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Take note of your posture, keep your crossbow aimed straight ahead, turn your body slightly... Yes, just like that, and then pull the trigger! Wow, bullseye! Very nice! Oh no, no need to thank me, I just helped correct your posture, that's all. You're very talented, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Come sit over here, Doctor. I have something to discuss with you. There's a bunch of Sarkaz I know, and they're pretty good in a fight, so if Rhodes Island ever needs a few helping hands... Haha, yes, I'm not eager to make trouble for myself, but... Well, I might be going too soft, but why not consider it?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I thought you might have found this business annoying, so I dealt with it in your place, and here's the mission report. The scene was something of an eyesore, so I didn't attach any photos. I executed every last name in your notes, no exceptions.   What's with the look, Doctor? Do you feel unwell?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Oh, Doctor, you're awake… What? Please don't tell Dr. Kal'tsit and Amiya you were napping at work? Ahaha, what napping?

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Liaison from the Lateran Notarial Hall, Insider. Here's the paperwork for our collaboration. May I ask which office I should be heading to next? I'm making my first impression here at Rhodes Island, so I want to do this perfectly.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Let's see... Ezell is still so merciful in battle, huh... Sheesh, Federico is the exact opposite!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? Thank you for your affirmation, Doctor. However, does this mean I'm going to have to handle even more difficult work in the future?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Many thanks. I will report that Rhodes Island intends to deepen the level of cooperation with the Notarial Hall... Wait, this is a personal commendation for me? Haha, what an honor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got it. You've determined that use of force is required in the current situation, and I'll trust you on that.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm in charge? Alright then, I would like everyone to act freely as they wish. And everyone is responsible for their own actions.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Firearm, check.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I wish everyone could just calm down, before I raise my gun to settle things.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Alright, mission accepted.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Bullets may be fast, but they aren't always so quick to solve disputes.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Chill, everyone, I'm just here for a few questions.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: If you insist on being so stubborn, then... prepare for execution.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: I'm actually better at wrestling than shooting. Makes the cleanup easier.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I'll give you some time to cry out in pain while I adjust my weapon.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I was really hoping it wouldn't turn out like this.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: In our current situation... A complete sweep would be the most efficient solution.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I knew I was getting into trouble coming here, but thankfully I've got you, Doctor. I wouldn't have figured out how to resolve such a complicated conflict by myself.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Alright, time to pack up my gun. Mission complete, Doctor. We achieved victory just as planned, so there shouldn't be any post mortem work required, right?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: What, did some of them escape? Ah, I had one eye closed while aiming my shots, so maybe they happened to be out of my sight.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: It's clear we need to overhaul our plans.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: You have such good accommodation here? This place is top-notch in all the foreign posting I've had.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Haha, Doctor. You're not scaring me that easily.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: It's nice to occasionally get some rest in places like this corridor. After all, most of Laterano's benches are found only outdoors.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! A new year usually comes with a multitude of troublesome incidents, and I don't know how Rhodes Island deals with... Why aren't I back in Laterano to work right now? Ahaha, foreign missions are also very important, you know.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: You can take a break first, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, what would you like for your birthday? One of the occasional tasks I get is to help people return unwanted gifts. Instead of making things so troublesome, it's better to just outright ask the recipient what they would like, don't you think?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Hmm, the atmosphere calls for a serious talk, does it? Alright, I'll be serious, Doctor, I wasn't actually that curious about Rhodes Island compared to the other executors, but now, I really admire your capabilities. Moving towards conflict instead of avoiding it is definitely not easy.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I won't refuse if you insist, but my poor vision makes it difficult for me to handle clerical work.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The Engineering Department is very interested in my weapon. I wish I could explain how it works, but all I know is that it requires high-purity gem crystals to run. I have ways to acquire gem scraps, but cutting a precious stone of great value into pieces works the same.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: My gosh, briefing documents again? You're not lacking in manpower or technology. My advice would be to avoid spending time and effort on roundabout things... Oh, you didn't bring documents. Then I must express my gratitude. I don't want to be gazing at graphs or designs anymore. It hurts my eyes.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Whistle? Oh, it was me whistling a Leithanian tune. My sincerest apologies, this place just makes me feel relaxed, and it wasn't my... You seem to be fine with it? Strange... to my knowledge, every spire-dweller feels insulted when they hear the sound, and even the mildest scholar would lose his temper when a child whistles at them on the streets.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've lived with the Infected since I was little, so it was only natural that I would get Oripathy myself... Well, Rhodes Island doesn't seem to accept that explanation. Then how do you like the story of a single explosion at the quarry that also collapsed many futures? A story too fanciful to believe, don't you think?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I may have underestimated you, Doctor. Tell me, would you like to bet on me? Betting on whether I'm worth trusting, betting on what tricks I have up my sleeves, betting on if I'm more than an infected. Of course, should you have a change of mind, I'll get back and continue to work on my worthless stone.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I'm not interested in talking about the past. As you can see, my lab was destroyed, and all traces cut off. I no longer have to put a price on gems with blood on them... all of which have put my mind at ease, in fact. I no longer have to imagine the gems being cut into pieces, after all.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I don't know when I'll return to Leithanien, but I would like to invite you for my next operation. There won't be any cooperation, nor do I intend to share my plans... but I'll ask you to keep your eyes on me, to witness all that I do. You're the only one who can see through me, aren't you? Come then.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I can take you to the top of any spire in Leithanien. How does that sound? You'd understand me there. The scent of the wind is clean at the top... and that's all. That's all that young boy in the gem mine longed for.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: If you fall asleep, then nothing here can pique my interest.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Which name card would you like: the one in my left hand, or the one in my right...? Diamante, gemologist. Pleased to make your acquaintance. Don't worry, there's no target here worth my attention, even if you picked the other card.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: A practical video, free from excessive narration and trite background music.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thanks. I don't normally collect medals for the purpose of displaying status, but if you insist, I will place it at the top of my collection to demonstrate my respect for you.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Steal a piece of bread, go to jail. Offend a noble, get beaten. Steal a priceless treasure, and you get to stand at the top of the tallest spire. Be my guest, Doctor, and come watch my show, watch the audience cheer. Will it bring you joy, or sorrow?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Colluding with me is not something to be done lightly.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: One wrong step, and we'll pay a heavy price. I expect perfect teamwork from you.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: As promised.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: What do you possess that's mine to take?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: As you wish.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: This is the only value of gemstones.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: To all my enemies: I will Crack. You. Down.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I shall have the honor to pulverize what you treasure.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Will you cheer for me? I can't help but wonder!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: How will you struggle? How will you hold on to what you have?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: When will I strike, and take what you cherish the most?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Who has not earned their end?

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I shared my life with you. Repay that debt, and tell me what fruit our efforts have born. Tell me what's the rewards of valor.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We can leave now. I'm sure no witnesses escaped.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A gem loses its value when flawed with impurities and cracks. You might as well dispose of it.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Are you still alive? Good. We all have our share of misfortune, but now you've had your stakes back, which you can risk on the line in the next game. Allow me to congratulate you on that.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What assessment would you like from me? It's the only place I can call home for now. I don't dare to be critical.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Of course, it's your prerogative.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: If I may interest you with a grind such as gem polishing, then please, take the seat to my opposite.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Should I hang this up on that wall over there...? Don't look at me like that, I just want to have a good holiday season. I always hope for good things to happen when a new year comes around, even though I know that nothing ever changes without sacrifice.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Greetings, Doctor. Do you need something appraised?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Be careful when eating that cake, Doctor. I put a little ruby in it. Good luck to you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I laugh at those people who put such value on a rock, but I couldn't laugh at you, because you truly want to prove that even an Infected life is worth something. It's almost as absurd as I am.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: What's up, Doctor? Me, I'm just on standby.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: My shield? Fun fact: I personally provide a portion of the energy it needs.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What I look like beneath the mask? Well, I... Actually, let's keep it secret for a bit longer.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Man, nothing better than a break after you finish a mission.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, if I get to know you better, I figure my shield's gonna get even sturdier.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Course I know where my limit's at. But I don't want Yato to worry about me, which is what matters. We'll worry about the rest some other time!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: There's always the need for guys like me, you know? Nah, I'm not trying to act high and mighty. What I'm saying is: when you have a VIP plus a lot of danger, you need a guy to stand between them, that's all.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sometimes you've just gotta take off the mask and catch a breather.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Defender Noir Corne, reporting for duty. You need VIP protection, I'm your guy.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Cool... So this stuff is what Grandpa Rangers was talking about earlier.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: We bringing friends?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm gonna get even stronger!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Holding the line is a Defender's most important job!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: We're doing it!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: C'mon, say something.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What's up?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I've got this!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Here I come!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Watch it, buddy!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Reinforce defenses!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Even guys like me are happy to get through tough battles like these.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was all right.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Well, we managed.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: This wouldn't have happened if I'd worn my good mask! God dammit!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Alright, let's take a breather.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You wanna get some drinks after work?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's these kinds of days I love the most. Everyone has a blast getting together, and we're off work. C'mon, Doctor, you gotta try this burdenbeast offal flambé while it's still fresh from the pan! Whoa, whoa, I don't think Dr. Kal'tsit's gonna like you drinking that much, y'know?

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Nothing outta the ordinary, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Yo, Doctor! Here's a mask from my stash, straight to you! You've rocked the hood for long enough, right? You could try masking up, just for today. Think about it! And hey, if no one else is gonna say it, I will—I think you'll look cool as hell with it on.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: With all the years I've spent at Rhodes Island, I know exactly what's left on the agenda today. The Doctor's still got mad business, alright? Can't keep 'em any longer. Everyone, a toast to the Doctor, who's spent another year working hard for us! To you!

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Morning, Doctor... Mind if I lay out my sleeping bag here...? Thanks. The rest is up to you...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: How do I fight? Using Arts, of course... Want me to show you the power of earth?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What time is it...? See, I don't work mornings, noons, afternoons, or nights...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You'll make an S-sized uniform for me...? No thanks. My oversized one works as a sheet when I take naps... plus, it's really warm.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Dooooctoooooor? I need a break! I'm competing in the Speedy Sleep Contest.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, check this out. This isn't my normal wand, it's a pendulum. You're feeling very sleepy and will nap in five minutes without giving me any work... Zzzz...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I was hoping I could tell you about my homeland, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: After you went to sleep, I somehow didn't feel sleepy at all anymore... Hmmmph...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello? Hellooooo? Can you hear me? Down here. Down heeeeere! Nice meeting you, big Doctor. I'm Durin the Caster.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Whoa... I've fiiiinally gotten s-tron-ger.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The secret to staying healthy is to sleep whenever you can.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Captain's orders: everyone, save your energy and take a nap!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I wanna dig a hole in the ground and make a shelter to sleep in, if you don't mind.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Take over for me. Thaaanks.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Wooo.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: What a pain.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Okaaaay, I'll do it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You're going down!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Gooooooo!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Why do we have annoying missions like this? Can't we do something easier...? Still, it's nice that we won.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Of course we won. I worked real hard supporting you with my Arts.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, are you still worried about those ones that got through?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ugghh... Sorry... I'll try harder next time...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The Land of Giants... Here I aaaaaaaaaaaaaaam!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm in a good mood, so how about a magic trick?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Big Doctor. There's lots of tasty foods at the cafeteria. Have you been eating well? Oh, right, I saw Myrtle carrying a huge sack with her to the cafeteria just now. Too late, though. I already ate all the cheese fried fowlbeast.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: *Yawn*... Good morning...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Big Doctor, Big Doctor, Happy birthday! If you're another year older, does that mean you're getting taller, too? I bought you a sleeping bag. If you're getting taller, I don't know how long it'll fit...?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Because of how short I am, nobody ever notices whether I'm working or playing hooky... Rhodes Island gave me a really comfortable environment to sleep in, though, so I still gotta do some things every now and then to repay the favor. Doctor, I'm looking forward to a good year.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hey, Doctor. Do me a favor and just tell me what you need done.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I'll be watching you even when I'm off duty.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Hm? Do you need something?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My skin is sensitive to sunlight. So please assign me to nighttime missions, whenever you can.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There's limits to what I'm capable of, but even so, I want to help ease the burden you carry, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I can't help but feel just a little envious when I see how the other Operators fight...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I need no particular reason to fight for you, Doctor. I hope to see an exciting frontline battle someday...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, let me be your guardian, now and forever...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Vanguard Yato here. Are you the one I'm protecting?

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Yato has joined the team.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: We're ready to execute your plans, Doctor.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: All Operators, be on alert.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Targets spotted. Get ready for battle.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Understood!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: In a blink of eye!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Prepare yourself!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Haaaaghhh!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Slash you down!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: As long as we follow the Doctor's orders, we won't have any problems.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The Doctor's brilliant command was the key to victory.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Victory is the most welcome news.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I apologize... We failed to execute your plan, Doctor...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Please send me somewhere that sunlight can never touch.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: *Gasp*!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, thank you for always taking care of us.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy holidays, Doctor. Thank you for your work over the past year, and may you continue to guide us this year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, I will be your shield.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Please, accept this humble gift. Yes, of course I remember your birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A blade needs a sheath. It is a shelter, and a place to return. For me, Rhodes Island is that sheath.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I greatly admire your genius. It's my honor to be your guard.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: A man of my experience can tell you'll be a great leader one day, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I have an unusual skin tone, you say? Hah. Just a souvenir from back when I snuck into a biolab, and... Please, I'm joking around.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: I need to wear this scarf, even when I sleep, or else my neck will get cold.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: This face of mine might be a little too exotic for your typical townsfolk. Heh, I tend to draw a curious crowd when I wander.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm surprised how polite you are to this old man! Not many besides Durin ask after my health.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When I go barefoot, I can sense enemies through their vibrations on the ground.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm... Snoring is a bad habit. The other rangers will hear you.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I'm Rangers, the Sniper. Call whenever you need me.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Not bad.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: My turn, is it?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Good. Let me show you what an old man can do.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's get going.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Prey spotted. Commence operation.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm waiting for orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: What are your orders?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Alright.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Found you!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Taste my arrow!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Challenge after challenge. Exactly what we wanted. Right, Noir Corne?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: What a satisfying battle!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: A few of them got through. I'd call that decent.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Oh no, I'm out of breath...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: If you need anything, just say the word.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Urgh! Please, leave my tail be...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You like me that much, huh? Weird taste, I gotta say.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, it's been three hours, and the kiddos still clamoring for more of my stories. Talk to them, will ya...? The New Year always makes the young'uns so astonishingly lively. I can't compete with that…

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, how can I help you?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: I'm kinda too old to follow what you young'uns may want. But here's a little something I like. This scarf's made out of my favorite material, lightweight but warm. It will keep you cozy when it's cold, Doctor. Happy birthday.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Retirement? Too soon for that. Not while I still eat five buns for breakfast. Once my appetite declines, then—and only then, will I find some place to bask in the sun. But for now, don't you worry.
